kāryaṃ tena sarvamavāpyate | parākrameṇa rājāno bhavanti rājyabhoginaḥ || 12|| devā mūrtimayāḥ sarve vañcanārthaṃ prakalpitāḥ | na tatra jāyate cecchāpūrtirvā lābha uttamaḥ || 1 3|| na te vadanti dadati pūrayanti na vāñchitam | tasmānmūrtirmṛṣā bodhyā kevalā kājanaiḥ kṛtā ||14|| jīvikārthaṃ kṛtā tatra pāṣāṇe kārthanā bhavet | phalaṃ cetanavṛkṣādvai labhyate na tu bhittitaḥ || 15|| gavādibhyaḥ payolābho na pāṣāṇagavāditaḥ | makṣikāgṛhataḥ kṣaudraṃ labhyate na tu śūnyataḥ || 16|| cetanāllabhyate saukhyaṃ śavānnaiva tu labhyate | rājñe’rpitaṃ phalatyeva bahudhā na śavāya tat || 17|| tasmācchavātmakaṃ kāṣṭhapāṣāṇādyutthaputtalam | devatā nāsti sā sākṣācchilā pratāraṇārthikā || 18|| rājaveṣadharo nāṭyakāro rājā na vai kvacit | devaveṣadharā mūrtiḥ śilā na devatā kvacit || 1 9|| tādṛśī yā śilā mūrtiḥ khaṇḍanīyā hi sarvaśaḥ | evaṃ nāstikyamāpanno nindatyeva tu devatām ||4.52.20|| devālayān devatāyatanāni devabhūmikāḥ | khaṇḍayatyeva sarvatra kṣatriyo nāgavikramaḥ ||21 || tathā viśeṣataścāpi devadrohaparo’bhavat | śaṃkaraḥ sarvadā kāmī viṣṇurhiṃsāparāyaṇaḥ || 22|| indracandrādayaścāpi kāmavāsanayā hatāḥ | kathaṃ kalyāṇadāste syuḥ svayaṃ doṣaiḥ prapūritāḥ |||23|| sādhavo bhojanāsaktā rasāsvādaparāyaṇāḥ | viprā vivāhakarmāṇo nārīmanto gṛhāśramāḥ ||24|| lobhāḍhyāste doṣavantaḥ śreyase syurna sarvathā | guravo māninaḥ sarve pūjyatālālasānvitāḥ ||25|| evaṃ tṛṣṇāmayī sṛṣṭiḥ śreyase syāt kathaṃ tviha | ye taranti tārayanti nimajjanti na vai kvacit || 26|| nimajjantyeva ye te na tārayanti kathaṃcana | tasmāt sarvaṃ mṛṣā loke’nṛtaṃ mūrtirguruḥ suraḥ ||27|| parākramaṃ paraṃ satyaṃ yasya tātkālikaṃ phalam | parākramaḥ sadā kāryaḥ śreyase sarvathā janaiḥ |||28|| bhāvyaṃ śūreṇa vīreṇa na ṣaṇḍhena kadācana | parākramavihīnasya daivāśā ṣaṇḍhatā matā || 29|| na ṣaṇḍhājjāyate garbho na daivāllabhyate phalam | evaṃ śrībadrike nāgaparākramo hi khaṇḍanam ||4.52.30|| devadrohaṃ karotyeva tiṣṭhan gacchan janavraje | athaikadā vicāryetthaṃ yayau yuddhārthameva saḥ ||3 1 || svasadṛśān kṣatriyān viṃśatiṃ śreṣṭhān balānvitān | saṃghe kṛtvā śastrasajjān dravyārthaṃ niryayau bahiḥ ||35||| svagrāmād yojanaṣaṭke grāmaṃ phalodayaṃ tu yat | yuddhapuramahārājyaśāsane vartate tu tat ||3 3|| tatra yoddhuṃ gataḥ sarvaśūraiḥ saha sahetibhiḥ | parṇapatraṃ likhitvaiva prāhiṇot patramutsukaḥ ||34|| dūtena śārdūlavikramākhyaṃ grāmeśvaraṃ prati | grāmādhyakṣo drutaṃ yuddhapureśasya bhaṭeśvaram ||35|| nyavedayad vyavasāyaṃ nāgavikramanāminaḥ | yuddhapuramahārājo jñātvā vṛttāntamulbaṇam ||36|| sainyaṃ sampreṣayāmāsa gajairvimānakaistathā | dharmayuddhaṃ tadā badri tūrṇaṃ tatra vyajāyata ||37|| nārācaistomaraiḥ khaṅgairbhallaiḥ śilimukhaiḥ śaraiḥ | golakaiḥ karavālaiśca bhindipālaiśca mudgaraiḥ ||38|| divyādivyāyudhaiścāpi yuddhamardhadinaṃ hyabhūt | yuddharājamahārājasainyenābhijitāstu te ||39|| kṣatāścārdhajanāścārdhajanāśca prāṇato hatāḥ | nāgaparākramādyāśca daśakārāgṛhe tadā ||4.52.40|| kṣiptā nigaḍapādāste’bhavan kaṣṭaprapīḍitāḥ | kṣatapīḍānvitāścāpi punaste rogapīḍitāḥ ||41 || kārāgāre’bhavan sarve devadrohavidhāyinaḥ | dehāṃgaghātabhugnāsthimahāpīḍātipīḍitāḥ ||42||| nāpnuvam̐ste manāk śāntiṃ nidrāṃ nigaḍapātitāḥ | devadrohaphalaṃ teṣāṃ tṛṣṇayā yodhanāttadā ||43|| badrike tvāgataṃ tūrṇaṃ mohādgarvādbalāttathā | avalepāt sunāstikyānmṛṣā vyāpārayojanāt ||44|| prāptaṃ phalaṃ samastaṃ tadbhūmau yuddhamiṣeṇa vai | yuddhapurādhipo bhakto’bhavad rājā narāyaṇe ||45|| devadrohakaraṃ duṣṭaṃ kṣatraṃ jñātvātyapīḍayat | daṇḍaṃ dadau mahāghoraṃ devadrāgdhre viśeṣataḥ ||46|| drohajanyaphalaṃ nāgaprākramasyābhavacchṛṇu | badrike mūkatāṃ prāpto vṛkṇatāṃ khañjatāṃ ca saḥ ||47|| bādhiryaṃ kuṣṭhitāṃ liṅgakṣayatāṃ cāndhatāṃ gataḥ | anye sāhāyyakartāraścāpi yoddhāra eva ye ||48|| te’pi daṇḍagṛhe vyaṃgā nyūnādhikatayābhavan | bhagnagarvā mahākaṣṭāḥ kadaryā iva te’bhavan ||49|| badrike mugdhasaṃsāre lokā vivekavarjitāḥ | svabalairgarvamāpannā vṛthā garjanti meghavat ||4.52.50|| kṣaṇānte svavināśaṃ svasarvasvāpagamaṃ ca te | kālakṛtaṃ na jānanti garvavāyupraperitāḥ ||51 || yauvanaṃ na sthiraṃ cāste balaṃ naiva sthiraṃ kvacit | acchedyaṃ na śarīraṃ ca mṛṣā druhyanti mohitāḥ ||52|| svaṃ vināśaṃ cāhvayanti balināṃ drohakāriṇaḥ | devadroho balidrohaścātmadroho vināśakṛt ||53|| devānāṃ drohakaraṇād devā niryānti dehataḥ | andhā vṛkāḥ kuṣṭhinaśca paṅgavaste bhavantyataḥ ||54|| manuṣyāṇāṃ drohabhāvācchāpān saṃprerayanti te | śāpadagdhā vinaśyanti vaṃśairdhanaiśca sampadā ||55|| devadrogdhurakasmāt syāt daivaṃ kaṣṭaṃ prabhūtakam | duḥpradharṣyaṃ prayogaiścānivartyaṃ jīvanāntakṛt ||56|| sarvadrohātparo droho devadroho’dhiko mataḥ | pratikāro’nyadrohāṇāṃ devadrohasya nāsti saḥ ||57|| api svargagataṃ devadroho nipātayed drutam | api mokṣagataṃ devadrohastasmānnipātayet ||58|| adrogdhuḥ sarvadā śāntirdrogdhurvai sarvadā bhayam | tasmād garvaṃ parityajya śāntiṃ yacchenna vai bhayam ||59|| mānuṣāṇāṃ bhaye prāpte daivī śāntiḥ prayujyate | daive bhaye’pi śāntiḥ sā daivī bhayanivartinī ||4.52.60|| kintu devadrohaje tu bhaye sā nirbalā vṛthā | anyakṣetrakṛto droho devakṣetre nivartate ||61 || devakṣetrakṛto droho vajralepāyate sadā | devaroṣe pralayo vai phalaṃ nānyat phalaṃ kvacit ||62|| tasmād devāstoṣaṇīyāḥ sākṣādvā dūrato’pi vā | gocarā vāpyaviṣayāstoṣaṇīyāḥ surāḥ sadā ||63|| mūrtyātmakāśca vā caityavṛkṣātmakāḥ sthalātmakāḥ | pretātmakāśca vā devāstoṣaṇīyāḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ||64|| tuṣṭā devāḥ sukhaṃ smṛddhiṃ kurvanti toṣaṇaṃ sadā | ruṣṭā devā ruṣaṃ hāntiṃ kurvanti kaṣṭamulbaṇām ||65|| gṛhadevā grāmadevāḥ kuladevāḥ svadevatāḥ | iṣṭadevāḥ svargadevāstoṣaṇīyā vidhānataḥ ||66|| ṛtudevā yajñadevā bhūdevā vāyudevatāḥ | indriyāṇāṃ devatāśca toṣaṇīyā vidhānataḥ ||67|| dehadevā gurau devā godevāḥ sādhudevatāḥ | nārīdevāḥ satīdevāstoṣaṇīyā vidhānataḥ ||68|| adridevāḥ sariddevā vanadevāḥ pathaḥ surāḥ | gotradevāḥ sarvadevāstoṣaṇīyā vidhānataḥ ||69|| vāstudevā yajñadevā divyāḥ prāsādadevatāḥ | yantramantratantradevāstoṣaṇīyā vidhānataḥ ||4.52.70 || sīmadevā garbhadevāḥ gṛhadevā prajeśvarāḥ | śākhāmaṇḍapadevādyāstoṣaṇīyā vidhānataḥ ||71|| jaladevā vahnidevā viśvedevāḥ sabhāsurāḥ | śaktayo devatāḥ sarvāstoṣaṇīyā vidhānataḥ ||72|| vṛddhadevāḥ siddhadevāḥ pitṛdevāśca bhikṣukāḥ | brāhmadevāḥ pūjyadevāstoṣaṇīyā vidhānataḥ ||73|| gṛhadevā rājasā vā tāmasāḥ sāttvikāstathā | ābhicārikadevāśca toṣaṇīyā vidhānataḥ ||74|| svapnadevā divādevā rātridevāstadāśritāḥ | devavāhanabhṛtyādyāstoṣaṇīyā vidhānataḥ ||75|| vighnadevāḥ krūradevā bhūtadevā virodhinaḥ | āśāpāśahatā hate toṣaṇīyā viśeṣataḥ ||76|| āśāṃ kurvanti devāśca pitaro’pi tathāvidhāḥ | āśayā ye tu valganti sarve te bhikṣukā yataḥ ||77|| toṣaṇīyāstadiṣṭānāṃ pradānaiḥ sarvabhikṣukāḥ | prasannāste prakurvanti yogaṃ kṣemaṃ kṣukhaṃ savam ||78|| karāśāḥ sarvarājānaḥ pūjāśāḥ sarvadevatāḥ | mānāśāḥ śreṣṭhinaḥ sarve satkārāśāstu paṇḍitāḥ ||79|| dānāśā bhikṣukāḥ sarve śrāddhāśāḥ pitaraḥ sadā | bhikṣāśā bhikṣukāḥ sarve brahmādyāḥ sādhavaḥ sadā ||4.52.80|| putrāśā dampatīvargā dravyāśā nirdhanāḥ sadā | vivekino nirāśāśca santuṣṭā devatottamāḥ ||8 1|| evaṃvidhāsti vai sṛṣṭistoṣaṇīyā hi devatāḥ | toṣaṇaṃ sukhasaṃsthānaṃ toṣaṇaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tṛṣaḥ ||82|| toṣaṇaṃ paramaṃ svargaṃ tuṣṭo’tra brahmasadṛśaḥ | tṛptirdharmo hi sādhūnāṃ tṛptirdharmo’sti mokṣaṇe ||83|| sadā tṛptirharāvasti tṛptiḥ sampat parā matā | vāsanāvilaye tṛptiḥ sadātmanāṃ prajāyate ||84|| sā muktiḥ sā parā śāntiḥ paro modaḥ pramodanam | tṛptānāṃ tu kare nityaṃ brahmānandapravāhaṇam ||85|| badrike duḥkhamāpannaścātṛpto’pi nivartate | duḥkhaṃ kaṣṭaṃ gurustasya yena duḥkhī nivartate ||86|| tathā duḥkhaṃ paraṃ prāptaḥ kārāgāre paraśritaḥ | nāgaparākramaścānye’ntatastasya sahasthitāḥ ||87|| sarve te manasā dadhyurdevaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrutaṃ priyeśvaram ||88|| bālakṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīmādhavīpatim | dhyātvā smṛtvā ca śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ kārālaye hṛdi ||89|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāminnārāyaṇeti sañjaguḥ | bhaktiṃ ca bhajanaṃ jñātvā yuddhapuranarādhipaḥ ||4.52.90|| prasannamānaso bhūtvā doṣakṣamāṃ tato’karot | kārāgāravinirmuktān pracakāra daśāpi tān ||91 || te tūrṇaṃ śrīhareḥ sarvaṃ māhātmyaṃ paramaṃ śubham | jānanto drohaśāntyarthaṃ pāpanāśāya sarvathā ||92|| śarkarāpattanaṃ pārāyaṇasya maṇḍapaṃ yayuḥ | natvā devaṃ lomaśaṃ ca guruṃ dharmaprakāśakam ||93|| sabhāṃ natvā kṣamāṃ tatra yayācire hareḥ punaḥ | kathāvyāsāsane vyāsaḥ kṣamayāmāsa tatkṛtam ||94|| pāyayāmāsa tebhyaśca prasādāmṛtavāri ca | prasādānnaṃ tatra tāvad bhojayāmāsa tām̐stadā ||95|| dadau mantraṃ tatastebhyo’bhayadānaṃ tadā dadau | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||96|| prabhonārāyaṇa śrīmādhavīnārāyaṇa prabho | rādhākṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa lalitākṛṣṇa sadvibho ||97|| evaṃ tebhyo dadau nāma te’pi cakruśca kīrtanam | māse gate tu māghasya pūrṇāyāṃ sāyameva ha ||98|| kathottarakṣaṇe vyomnaścāgataṃ suvimānakam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yatra virājate ||99|| śrīvallabho drutaṃ tasmādavātarad bhuvaḥ sthale | pasparśa pāṇinā tām̐śca sarve mṛtāstadābhavan || 4.52.10 0|| divyadehā abhavam̐śca vimāne te’bhavan sthitāḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo ninye tān sarvānakṣaraṃ padam || 10 1|| evaṃ śrībadrike tatra mahāścaryamabhūttadā | paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ yayuste paramaṃ padam || 1 02|| ihaiva bhogamāpannā drohasya mokṣaṇaṃ tataḥ | śrīkṛṣṇakṛpayā jātaṃ kathāyāḥ śravaṇena ca || 1 03|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmajapena sādhusevayā | prasādānnāśanenāpi mokṣaṇaṃ jātamuttamam || 1 04|| sarvadrohapraṇāśo’pi śrīkṛṣṇasya kṛpāvaśāt | teṣāṃ jāto vajranāśo mokṣaścāpunarāgamaḥ || 1 05|| badrike śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo gopālabālakaḥ | kambharāśrīsutaḥ sarvān muktān karoti bhaktigān || 1 06|| doṣānnaiva tathāghāni naiva paśyati dehinām | kṛpayaiva mahāmokṣaṃ karoti śaraṇārthinām || 1 07|| paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇāt pravicintanāt | bhuktirmuktiḥ paraṃ svargaṃ labhyate śrīhareḥ padam ||1 08|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne nāgavikramasya kṣatriyasya sarvadrohiṇo devadrohiṇaśca tatsahāyināṃ ca vyaṃgatvādimahākaṣṭaṃ kārāgāravāsastataḥ saṃhitākathāśravaṇena navadrohisahitasya pāpanāśo mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 52 ||
<4.53> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi rājāsīt śālamitrakaḥ | kṣatriyo dharmaniṣṭhaśca prajāpālanatatparaḥ || 1 || dānadharmarato nityaṃ goviprasādhupūjakaḥ | annasatraṃ gṛhe yasya vastrasatraṃ mahattathā | dhanasatraṃ tathā yasya kośe’bhūd dīnarakṣakam || 2 || yasya grāme divyadevālayāḥ santi suśobhitāḥ | viprāśca sādhavaḥ sādhvyo devasevāparāyaṇāḥ || 3 || vartante’yasya nagare rāṣṭragrāmeṣu vai tathā | jīvikājīvanāḥ sarve rājñā dattārthavṛttikāḥ || 4 || pratidevālayaṃ kṣetraṃ sasyānāṃ janakaṃ mahat | mahatī vāṭikā cāpi godhanaṃ dāṃsadāsikāḥ || 5 || annavastrapradānaṃ ca prativarṣaṃ pṛthak tathā | dhanadānaṃ pṛthak cāpi jīvikā pratimandiram || 6 || evaṃ rājye sarvato’sya dharmaśālāstathābhavan | vṛkṣacchāyāśca mārgeṣu tathodyānāni mandire || 7 || vartante daivapuṣpārthaṃ jalakūpāḥ pratisthalam | devapūjāpravāhāśca candanākṣatakuṃkumam || 8 || dhūpadīpasunaivedyaphalatāmbūlakāni ca | rājakośāt prapadyante pratidevālayaṃ sadā || 9 || evaṃ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraiḥ pūrvatamaiḥ sujīvikāḥ | baddhā devārhaṇārthaṃ vai sarvathā pūrvajīvikāḥ ||4.53.1 0|| atha rājā vartamānaḥ śālāmitrastadā svayam | bhakto bhūtvā parīkṣārthaṃ pūjākāle’nvahaṃ drutam || 11|| pratyekaṃ mandiraṃ yāti yātrākṣurbhikṣuko yathā | vilokayati baddhāṃ tāṃ vyavasthāṃ pūjakaiḥ kṛtām ||2|| pūjakā naiva kurvanti pūjāṃ pūrvairyathārpitām | yathāklṛptāṃ na kurvanti sevānaivedyakaṃ hyapi || 1 3|| ārārtrikaṃ na kurvanti kvacit kvacinna vandanam | kutraciddhūpanaṃ naiva kutracinnaiva dīpanam || 14|| kutraciccandanaṃ naiva kutracinnaiva tūlasī | kutracinna mahādeve snānapuṣpāmbarādikam || 15|| kutracinna harau kṛṣṇe bhūṣāmbaranivedanam | kutracinna ravau devyāṃ pūjāśṛṃgāratarpaṇam || 1 6|| kutracinna nare nārāyaṇe naivedyakārpaṇam | kutracinnaiva pūjāsti nīrājanaṃ na jāyate ||17|| pūjakeṣu vyasanāni pratyakṣaṃ sa vyalokayat | narānāryo dharmahīnā vartante mandirādiṣu || 18|| snānasatkarmahīnāśca pūjakā malināstathā | svārthamātraparā naijodaraṃbharā vasanti ca ||19|| kvacittu mandire bhraṣṭācārā madyaparāyaṇāḥ | vartante pūjakāśceti pratyakṣaṃ sa vyalokayat ||4.53.20|| vīkṣyaivaṃ nijarājye vai mandireṣu ghṛṇāsthitim | vicāramakarod rājā buddhyā vivekamiśrayā ||21 || mama ye pūrvajā dattavanto dānāni jīvikāḥ | dharmārthaṃ devapūjārthaṃ daivakāryārthamanvaham ||22|| mandireṣu pūjakā ye pūjikā yāśca santi vai | na kurvanti yathārthaṃ te pūjanaṃ devatārcanam ||23|| vṛthā khādanti te sarve ghasāśino vṛṣojjhitāḥ | yena dhyeyena tebhyo vā devebhyo dattajīvikāḥ ||24|| taddhyeyaṃ jāyate naiva devapūjā na jāyate | vyasanāni pūjakāste samācaranti sarvathā || 25|| na tejo vidyate teṣāmānaneṣu manāgapi | nistejaso vilokyante pūjakā mandireṣu vai || 26|| bhraṣṭācārā bhraṣṭadharmāḥ kadaryā iva dhūmriṇaḥ | yatra pūjākarā bhraṣṭācārāḥ svodarapūrttikāḥ ||27|| vyasanābhibhūtacittā devāstatra vasanti na | yatra vai pūjakāḥ snānahīnāśca malināntarāḥ ||28|| malivastrā malidehā devāstatra vasanti na | yatra vai pūjakāḥ kāmikrodhilobhipratāriṇaḥ ||29|| asatyānṛtamithyāḍhyā devāstatra vasanti na | satṛṣṇāḥ pūjakā yatra pramādālasyasaṃbharāḥ ||4.53.30|| nistrapāḥ svādhyāyahīnā devāstatra vasanti na | pūjakāḥ snehahīnāśca bhaktisevojjhatāḥ khalāḥ ||31 || devagauravahīnāśca devāstatra vasanti na | yatrārcakā vratahīnā nāstikyāḍambarānbitāḥ ||32|| mṛṣāvādā mṛṣākāryā devotsavādivarjitāḥ | pūjāprakāraśūnyāśca devāstatra vasanti na ||33|| yatra gandhaḥ sugandho na dhūpo dīpo na vidyate | yatra nīrājanaṃ nāsti devāstatra vasanti na ||34|| yatra śuddhirna pātrāṇāṃ jalaśuddhirna vidyate | naivedyasya na vai śuddhirdevāstatra vasanti na ||35|| devagṛhasya śuddhirna śuddhiḥ siṃhāsanasya na | devaśayyādiśuddhirna devāstatra vasanti na ||36|| mandire mārjanaṃ nāsti prakṣālanaṃ na vā kvācit | dhūliniṣkāsanaṃ nāsti devāstatra vasanti na ||37|| nirmālyadūratā nāsti nūtnapuṣpārpaṇaṃ na ca | nūtnaśṛṃgārabhūṣā na devāstatra vasanti na ||38|| nūtnaveṣārpaṇaṃ nāsti nūtnajalārpaṇaṃ na ca | nūtnacandanacarcā na devāstatra vasanti na ||39|| nūtanākṣatakuṃkumatulasīphalaśarkarāḥ | madhvājyādi nūtanaṃ na devāstatra vasanti na ||4.53.40|| yatropakaraṇaujjvalyaṃ vastraujjvalyaṃ na vidyate | bhūṣaujjvalyaṃ bimbaujjvalyaṃ devāstatra vasanti na ||41|| andhakāro yatra śaityaṃ mahauṣṇyaṃ duṣṭavāyavaḥ | kleśāḥ kalahā yatsthāne devāstatra vasanti na ||42|| pūjako brahmacārī na pācakaḥ śuddhivarjitaḥ | stāvako bhāvaśūnyaśca devāstatra vasanti na ||43|| yaddevāgre sopānatkā mānavā yānti sannidhau | saśastrā garvayuktāśca devāstatra vasanti na ||44|| madyamāṃsāśanaṃ yatra durgandhibhakṣaṇādikam | duṣṭapānādikaṃ yatra devāstatra vasanti na ||45|| niṣiddhācaraṇaṃ yatra vihitatyajanaṃ tathā | pūjākālaniyamo na devāstatra vasanti na ||46|| devavādyāni pātrāṇi cāmarādīni santi na | mantrā yatra na vidyante devāstatra vasanti na ||47|| mānavā mandire devagṛhe svapanti yatra ca | sahanivāsanaṃ nityaṃ devāstatra vasanti na ||48|| devānāṃ gauravaṃ yatra pālyate mānavairnahi | pṛṣṭhe devā manuṣyāṇāṃ devāstatra vasanti na ||49|| śvānaśca śūkarā yatra gṛhe bhramanti vānarāḥ | bhraṣṭajīvā yatra santi devāstatra vasanti na ||4.53.50|| pāpināṃ pādasañcāraḥ sparśo devasya sarvadā | bhraṣṭavastvarpaṇaṃ yatra devāstatra vasanti na |||51|| ādaro bhāvanā nāsti prema sneho na vidyate | pūjakasyāṃ na cāstikyaṃ devāstatra vasanti na ||52|| yaddevāgre grāmyavārtā dehakāryāṇi yatpuraḥ | yadagre cittamālinyaṃ devāstatra vasanti na |||53||| vidhihīnā pratiṣṭhā cājalapuṣpaṃ prapūjanam | stutihīnaḥ praveśaśca devāstatra vasanti na |||54|| pūjakasya tapo yatra pūjā śreṣṭhā prajāyate | ābhirūpyaṃ yatra mūrterdevāstatra vasanti vai ||55|| sādhavaḥ pūjakā yatra brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ | sādhvyo vā dīkṣitāḥ śītavratāstatra hi devatāḥ ||56|| ātmaśuddhirbhāvaśuddhirdravyaśuddhiḥ samastikā | pūjāśuddhirbhaktaśuddhirdevāstatra vasanti vai ||57|| vidyamānāsu sarvāsu jīvikāsvapi ye narāḥ | pūjotsavānna kurvanti devāstatra vasanti na ||58|| apūjā vā nyūnapūjā bhraṣṭapūjāstu devatāḥ | ruṣṭā khananti vaṃśān vai sthāpakasya nṛpasya ca ||59|| vilokyante mayā sarvadevālayeṣu rāṣṭrake | pūjakā bhraṣṭapūjāste doṣaṃ kurvanta mandire ||4.53.60|| doṣabhāgo bhave’nyasmin nṛpateḥ śāsakasya ca | tasmātte śikṣaṇīyā vai rājājñayā mayādhunā ||61|| vicāryetthaṃ navaṃ kṛtvā niyamaṃ saprakāśakam | śrāvayāmāsa sarvatra devārcanārthamanvaham ||62|| adyārabhya tu devānāṃ pūjanaṃ vidhinā tu ye | sarvathā na kariṣyanti rājā vṛttiṃ hariṣyati ||63|| ityevaṃ nijarāṣṭre vai śrāvayāmāsa sarvathā | bhūtvā śrībadrike vṛttihānerbhayāttu kecana ||64 vidhivat pūjanaṃ cārebhire bhaktiyutā narāḥ | ye khalāśca śaṭhāścāsan pramādamohagarvitāḥ ||65|| nāstikyamithyāvādāśca mṛṣādevādivādinaḥ | te tu cittaṃ dadurnaiva pūjādau paramātmanaḥ |||66||| rājñā nirīkṣakenaiṣāṃ vṛttayaḥ saṃhṛtāstataḥ | daṇḍitāḥ kecana duṣṭā niṣkāsitāśca kecana |67|| utthāpitā bhagnabimbā apahṛtāśca jīvikāḥ | jīrṇadevālayāstena nītā vai śūnyatāṃ tadā ||68| evaṃ kṛtavatā sāṅgā vṛttihartṛtvapātakam | pūjakānāṃ kuṭumbānāṃ niḥśvāsāḥ śapathāni ca 69|| utpāditāni bhāgena bhāgena puṇyamarjitam | śāpastu sahasā hanti puṇyaṃ cireṇa rakṣati ||4.53.70|| jīvikāharaṇe pāpaṃ jāyate sarvanāśakam | jīrṇasya jīvikā naiva hartavyā vai kadācana ||71 || jīrṇoddhāraḥ prakartavyaḥ kartavyā riktatā na tu | śūnyatāyāḥ phalaṃ śūnyaṃ kartustatra prajāyate ||72|| badrike tasya bhūpasya jīvikāharaṇasya vai | pāpaṃ śāpasya cāyātaṃ tūrṇaṃ duḥkhapradaṃ tadā ||7 3|| rājā rogeṇa saṃvyāpto jalodareṇa sarvathā | ajīrṇena ca rogeṇa hyatisāreṇa vai rujā ||74|| abhibhūto’bhavanmandāgninā jāṭharavartinā | bhojanaṃ nāsya pacati vamanaṃ vai prajāyate ||75|| jalodaraṃ vardhate ca raktaṃ jale vivarttate | śuṣkāyante’sya māṃsāni raktotsargo bhavatyapi ||76|| udaraṃ garbhiṇītulyaṃ galitau pādahastakau | piṃgatāsyābhavaddehe śaktihāso’bhavattathā ||77|| apācanaṃ mahārogo badrike maraṇāntakaḥ | śālamitro bhūpatistu śreṣṭhauṣadhānyakārayat ||78|| tathāpi daivaroṣeṇa śāpenāptā hi rugṇatā | manāgapi na naṣṭā sā vṛddhiṃ gatā dine dine ||79|| jīvikāharaṇaṃ sarvapāpādhikaṃ hi pātakam | atraiva bhujyate badri hartavyā naiva jīvikā ||4.53.80|| rājñaḥ patnī jayālakṣmīrnāmnā sāpi tathā rujā | raktasrāvavatī nityaṃ jātā ca durbalā satī ||81 || rājā śokaṃ samāpannaścauṣadhaṃ na guṇāyate | śuśrāva saṃhitāvārtācamatkāraṃ tadā kṣaṇe ||82|| janā ye tīrthayātrārthaṃ yānti vai śarkarāpuram | saṃhitāyāścamatkāraṃ varṇayanti tu te kathām ||83|| pāpināṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cāpi sākṣācca darśanaṃ hareḥ | śuśrāva varṇitaṃ sarvaṃ janairmāhātmyamuttamam ||84|| tūrṇaṃ sajjo’bhavad gantuṃ saṃhitāśravaṇāya saḥ | parimeyānugo rājñyā samaṃ śrotuṃ kathāṃ yayau ||85|| bahubhirdakṣiṇābhiścopadābhirvācakaṃ munim | pūjayāmāsa nṛpatirgatvā kathāsthalaṃ drutam ||86|| āśīrvādān samagṛhya rājñyā samaṃ ca lomaśam | pupūja bhāvato rājā lomaśo vīkṣya durbalam ||87|| nīrugṇo bhava nṛpate nīrugṇā patnikā tava | pāpaśūnyāvubhau bhūtvā yātaṃ kārṣṇaṃ paraṃ padam ||88|| asāraḥ khalu saṃsāraḥ sārastasmāttu mokṣaṇam | jīvanaṃ sarvathā pāpaṃ puṇyaṃ saṃsāramokṣaṇam ||89|| evamāśīrvacanaistau drutaṃ duritavarjitau | sañjātau tadvarṣmaṇośca rogau tatraiva nirgatau ||4.53.90|| mūrtimantau jagadaturjīvikāharaṇotthitau | āvāṃ rogau cātisārau prāṇaharau dvayorapi ||91|| svastato’dya yuvayorāyuṣyaṃ śeṣaṃ na vidyate | lomaśasya saṃhitāyā vācakasya harerbalāt ||92|| nirgatau yuvayordehābhyāṃ tathāpi mṛtidhruvā | tato dānāni sarvāṇi datvā labdhvā manuṃ hareḥ ||93|| bhaktiṃ kṛtvā yātamevākṣaraṃ padaṃ prabhorhareḥ | ityuktvā yayatū rogau rājā rājñī drutaṃ tadā ||94|| rājyārpaṇaṃ kumāre ca kṛtvā patreṇa vai tadā | datvā dānāni sarvāṇi pradatvā jīvikā punaḥ ||95|| nairṛṇyaṃ sarvathā kṛtvā prāpya mantraṃ tu lomaśāt | bhaktiṃ kṛtvā māsamātramuṣitvā tau kathāntike ||96|| śodhayitvā nijātmānau sādhūn saṃsevya bhāvataḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||97|| prabhonārāyaṇa śrīśavedīnārāyaṇa prabho | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīkānta sadvibho ||98|| evaṃ mantraṃ ca bhajanaṃ cakraturbhṛtyasaṃghinau | ekāgramānasau bhūtvā kṣapayitvā tu vāsanāḥ ||99|| hareḥ prāsādikaṃ jagdhvā pāvayitvā samastakam | sajjau babhūvaturgantuṃ mokṣe dhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ || 4.53.1 00|| phālgunasyāsite pakṣe tvekādaśyāṃ kathottaram | prage divyaṃ vimānaṃ vai sauvarṇaṃ paramātmanaḥ || 101 || vyomnaścāvātarat tatra sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ śubham | badrike śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastasmādviniryayau || 1 02|| pasparśa tau pāṇinā ca vimucya dehataḥ pṛthak | divyamuktau divyadehau vidhāya sahasā prabhuḥ || 1 03|| nidhāya svavimāne tau yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ nijam | evaṃ tau vṛttihartārau tathāpi puṇyakāriṇau || 1 04|| devārthaṃ kṛtasarvasvau pāvayitvā prabhuḥ punaḥ | śrāvayitvā kathāṃ naijāṃ ninye mokṣadaṃ nijam || 1 05|| badrike jayakāro’bhūttadā sarvatra bhūtale | rājā rājñī gatau mokṣaṃ saṃhitāyāḥ kathābalāt || 1 06|| kathāṃ śrotuṃ samāyānti samantato’yutāyutam | manuṣyāḥ kṛṣṇacittāste labhante sveṣṭamuttamam || 1 07|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇādapi badrike | bhuktirmuktiśceṣṭasiddhiḥ svargaṃ dīrghaṃ ca labhyate || 1 08|| vāsanānāṃ kṣayaścāpi śuddhirnijātmanastathā | dhāmnyakṣare gatiḥ sthānaṃ śāśvataṃ sukhamāpyate || 1 09|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śālamitranṛpaterdevajīvikāpaharaṇena tadrājñyāśca mahātisārarugṇatāyurnāśaśceti vedanottaraṃ saṃhitākathāśravaṇārthaṃ gatayostatra muktirityādinirūpaṇanāmā tripañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 53 ||
<4.54> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kanyāghnasya kathāṃ tathā | yuddhapuramahārājye yuddharājo’bhavannṛpaḥ || 1 || dānadharmarataḥ puṇyakaraḥ sādhuprapūjakaḥ | prajārakṣākaraścāpi garvamānabharo’bhavat || 2 || tatra prathābhavad badri kanyāhiṃsāmayī purā | kanyāyā janma jāyeta kṣatriyasya gṛhe yadi || 3 || kanyābhrātā kasyacittu śālakaḥ syād bhaviṣyati | kanyāpitā śvaśuraḥ syāt tadaniṣṭaṃ paraṃ yataḥ || 4 || kṣatriyaḥ śālako na syājjāmātṛśvaśuro na ca | snuṣāśvaśuraḥ syādeva kutracit sā prathābhavat || 5 || ataḥ kanyā prahantavyā kṣatriyeṇa tu janmataḥ | mānino yuddharājasya rājñyāṃ kanyā tvajāyata || 6 || rājñīprasūtikāle’pi dāsyāṃ putro’pyajāyata | rājñīsnehena sā dāsī kanyānāśabhayena ca || 7 || kanyāṃ jagrāha datvā svaṃ putraṃ rājñyai susundaram | putro’bhavannṛpatestu prakāśe’prasaracchubham || 8 || atiharṣeṇa rājñā vai kṛtaḥ putrotsavaḥ śubhaḥ | kanyākumārau sadṛśau vṛddhimāptau śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 9 || kanyāmānaṃ tu sā dāsī rājakanyāvadācarat | rājñī cāpi tathā mānaṃ rājakanyāvadācarat || 4.54.10 || na tādṛśaṃ kumārasya prakṛtirhi balīyasī | kumāro’pi mahān jāto dāsīṃ svamātaraṃ prati || 11 || dāsīṃ kṛtvā vartate saḥ kiṃkarīṃ mānavarjitām | athaikadā snehamagnā dāsī rahaḥ svaputrakam || 12|| adhīrā prāha vṛttāntaṃ sarvaṃ jātaṃ yathātatham | rājakanyāprarakṣārthaṃ vinimayastu janmataḥ || 1 3|| kṛta eva mayā putra kanyā rājñyāḥ suto’si me | ato māṃ mātaraṃ garbhadhāriṇīṃ janmadāyinīm || 14|| viddhi vatsa prakāśaṃ māṃ kuru svaṃ kuśalaṃ kuru | kanyāyāḥ kuśalaṃ cāpi prakāśe sati naiva ha || 15|| ato gopyaṃ samastaṃ tanmāṃ viddhi tava mātaram | badrike strīhṛdayaṃ niṣṭhuraṃ bhinnakapāṭakam || 16|| kadācidbhidyate krodhāt kadācit snehato dhruvam | tenānirghāritaṃ syādvai vyasanaṃ duḥsahaṃ tataḥ || 17|| strīto gopyaṃ gopanīyaṃ prakāśyaṃ na striyāḥ puraḥ | athaivaṃ rājamātuśca putryāṃ sneho’tivartate || 18|| putrī vivāhayogyā sā jātā rājñīsamā śubhā | tadā putrī pradeyā kva kasmai ceti vyacintayat || 19|| rājñī svayaṃ cāticintāparābhavat sutākṛte | na dāsāya pradātavyā deyā kumārakāya vai || 4.54.20|| rājaputrāya dātavyā no ced rakṣyā kumārikā | evaṃ vyacintayad rājñī kanyā varaṃ pratīkṣate || 21 || kadā me syād vivāho vai mātā kathaṃ na vakti tat | ityevaṃ cintayānā sā papraccha mātaraṃ tvidam || 22|| kathaṃ mātarvivāhaṃ me naiva cintayasi kvacit | tadā mātā dāsikā sā prāha rājñī niṣedhanam || 23|| karotyeva sadā putri tato’haṃ na vadāmi tat | athaikadā sutā rājñyā dehasevāparāyaṇā || 24|| rahaḥ papraccha tāṃ rājñīṃ mātarnamāmi te muhuḥ | pṛcchāmyahaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ mā doṣaṃ mayi kalpaya || 25|| madrahasyaṃ tu pṛcchāmi yathāvad vaktumarhasi | kathaṃ vivāhayogyāyā vivāhaṃ me śubhapradam || 26|| kartuṃ na manyase niṣidhyase kathaṃ samucyatām | śrutvā mātā rājamātā nijāṃ putrīṃ tu dāsikām || 27|| ākṛṣya bahudhā dhṛtvā vakṣasyaśrūṇyavāsṛjat | tato dhairyaṃ samālambya jagāda putrikāṃ hitam || 18|| vatse matkukṣijā cāste nṛpasyāsi sutā śubhā | kintu nikṛṣṭabhāgyā tvaṃ dāsyai mayā purārpitā || 29|| dāsīputro mayā prāptaḥ tvatsamakṣaṇajanmavān | karomyevaṃ na ced rājā nihanyāt tvāṃ tu jīvanaḥ ||4.54.3 0|| rājā kasyāpi na syādvai śālakaḥ śvaśuro’thavā | bhrātā te tvagrajaścānyo vartate rājadāyabhāg || 3 1|| rājyādhikāravām̐ścāpi śālakaḥ sa kathaṃ bhavet | pitā te ca śvaśuro vā kathaṃ syāt kasyacit khalu || 32| tvaṃ kanyā me yadā jātā mayā guptā kṛtā na cet | aśālakatvarakṣārthaṃ cāśvaśuratvaguptaye ||33|| rājā tvāṃ nāśayettūrṇaṃ syāṃ putrī rahitā tvaham | mayā prāptā tvekaputrī mukhadarśanadāyinī ||34|| mārayituṃ kathaṃ dadyāṃ gataiḥ prāṇaśatairapi | vatse tadā mayā samyag cintitaṃ śreyase tava ||35|| prasūtaścābhavad dāsyāṃ putro’yaṃ yaḥ kumārakaḥ | sa mayā snehabaddhāyā dāsyāḥ prāpto drutaṃ gṛhe ||36|| tasyai tvaṃ cārpitā vatse prāṇarakṣaṇahetave | sā tvaṃ matkukṣijā putri vartase mama sannidhau ||37|| tāṃ tvāṃ rājakumārīṃ vai śreṣṭhāṃ madaṃgasaṃbhavām | yasmai kasmai tu dāsāya dātuṃ kathaṃ samutsahe ||38|| tataḥ putri mayā dāsī niṣidhyate pradānake | dāse dānaṃ nikṛṣṭaṃ yad rājaputre praśastakam ||39|| vada vatse rahaḥ proktaṃ tvatkṛte kiṃ karomyaham | tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ tataḥ sarvaṃ mayoktaṃ mama putrike ||4.54.40|| vinā rājakumāraṃ tu kaumāryaṃ te varaṃ sadā | tathāpyahaṃ yatiṣye vai putrike yacchubhaṃ bhavet ||41 || mā prakāśaya vṛttāntaṃ hānistena bhaviṣyati | mama nāśastava nāśo rājadvārā bhaviṣyati ||42|| ityevaṃ śayane rājñī jagāda nijabālikām | putrī jñātvā samastaṃ tanmātṛsevāparāyaṇā ||43|| viśeṣataḥ prajātā vai kumāro’pi prasūṃ prati | evaṃ svābhāvikasnehe vinimayo’pyajāyata ||44|| vacane hṛdaye dehe kriyāsvapi samantataḥ | svasvamātṛsnehabhāvo vyavardhata tayostadā ||45|| athaikadā nṛpo naije śayane nidrito’bhavat | madhyarātrau nṛpanidrā naṣṭā jāgarito nṛpaḥ ||46|| rājñī nṛpasya śayyāyāṃ suptāsīt svapnanidritā | svapne jajalpa nṛpateḥ śṛṇvato daivanoditā ||47|| aho putri mama putri mā rājñe tvaṃ nivedaya | rājñīputrīti caivāsi kumāro dāsikāsutaḥ ||48|| aho dāsi hyaho dāsi mā kasmaicinnivedaya | kumāro dāsikāputraḥ kumārī nṛpaputrikā ||49|| rājā śrutvā mahāścaryaṃ gataḥ satyārthavismitaḥ | mohito vākyabodhena ṛtārthaṃ samacintayat ||4.54.50|| nirṇayārthaṃ tvekadā tu dāsyai sauvarṇaśṛṃkhalām | dadau papraccha dāsīṃ sa vada cānyadabhīpsitam ||51|| prasanno’smi sevayā te kiṃ dadāmyaparaṃ dhanam | prāsādaṃ vāṭikāṃ kṣetraṃ grāmaṃ vā kiṃ dadāmi te ||52|| dāsī prasannavadanā badrike hrasvabuddhitaḥ | yayāce naiva vāṭīṃ vā kṣetraṃ grāmaṃ dhanaṃ gṛham |||53|| na me sarvaṃ rocate vai rājam̐stṛptāsmi sarvathā | yadi deyo varo mahyaṃ yayāce tu kumārayoḥ ||54|| dvitīyāya kumārāya rājyaṃ dehi samastakam | yadvārdhaṃ dehi nṛpate jyeṣṭhāyārdhaṃ pradehyapi ||55|| rājā śrutvā pakṣavākyaṃ papraccha kāraṇaṃ tadā | pralobhya bahuratnādyairdāsī jagāda kāraṇam ||56|| putro madgarbhasaṃbhūto vartate sa kumārakaḥ | putrī tvatpatnikājanyā vartate sā kumārikā ||57|| dehi rājyaṃ cārdhamapi rājan putrāya me śubham | badrike sābhavad dāsī kṣatriyā bhṛtyakarmiṇī ||58|| nāmnā prabhāvatī devī putrastasyāstu bhūpajaḥ | kṣatriyo’bhūd dvitīyaḥ saḥ sāto rājyamayācata ||59|| akathyaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ lobhavṛttyā bhujiṣyayā | snehavṛttyā sute naije kathitaṃ raha uttamam ||4.54.60|| atha rājā viditvaiva kumāraṃ dāsikāsutam | kumārīṃ nijaputrīṃ ca khyātāṃ tāṃ dāsikāsutām ||61|| kiṃkartavyapramūḍho’tivihvalaḥ so’bhavat sadā | śālakena na vai bhāvya jyeṣṭhakumārakeṇa vai ||62|| śvaśureṇa na vai bhāvyaṃ mayā cānyanṛpasya vai | vārtā prasiddhimāpannāvaśyaṃ prakāśameṣyati ||63|| rājyādhikārī jyeṣṭho’sti cārdhasya yāvato’pi vā | dāsīputrāya dāsye ced rājye’niṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati ||64|| mamāniṣṭaṃ bhaveccāpi tatastat kāryameva na | kanyākumārayoḥ prāṇapralayo’tra śubho mataḥ ||65|| viṣādisaṃprayogeṇa tūrṇaṃ dvayoḥ paretatā | bhaviṣyati na sandehaḥ kartavyaṃ śreṣṭhamatra tat ||66|| vicāryetthaṃ yuddharājo viṣaṃ mārakamulbaṇam | dāpayāmāsa kanyāyai kumārāya ca guptitaḥ ||67|| guptistatrābhavannāmnā ghaṭamālābhidhānugā | dāsī rājñaḥ karmakartrī khasajātisamudbhavā ||68|| tathā bhojanavelāyāṃ viṣaṃ prayojitaṃ tayoḥ | rājñī dāsī mātarau te jānīto na viṣārpaṇam ||69|| maraṇaṃ yannimittena likhitaṃ tadbhavatyapi | jīvanaṃ yannimittena likhitaṃ tadbhavatyapi ||4.54.70|| bhuktavantau sutāputrau bhojanaṃ viṣamiśritam | vyasū jātau ca tau tatra tāvadabhyāgato dvijaḥ ||71 || sādhuryatiścamatkārī viṣahauṣadhibodhavān | tadoṣadhirasagūṭīyuto bhraman samāyayau ||72|| daivena prerito nāmnā jīvanāyanasaṃjñakaḥ | atithirbhojanamātravāñcchayā tatra cāgataḥ ||73|| tāvat sa śrutavān rājye prakāśaṃ maraṇaṃ dvayoḥ | rājā tūrṇaṃ dahanāya preṣayāmāsa tau tadā ||74|| tathā jāte yatiḥ sādhurjñātvā mṛtau sutāsutau | rājaśmaśānapārśveṇa nirgato’yaṃ tu vaiṣṇavaḥ ||75|| jñātvā dehau nīlavarṇau tūrṇamoṣadhagūṭikām | niṣkāsya sandadau tayoroṣṭhayośca jalaṃ dadau ||76|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | mantramenaṃ dadau tābhyāṃ śmaśāne tāvadeva tu ||77|| utthitau śāntagaralau svasthau rogavivarjitau | prabhonārāyaṇasvāmin kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho ||78|| nāmadhunyaṃ dadau tābhyāmājīvayad dayānidhiḥ | atha rājñaḥ krūrakarma jñātvā yayau nṛpaṃ prati ||79|| rājannaitat tvayā duṣṭaṃ krūraṃ kṛtaṃ tu pāpakam | kanyāhatyā kumārasya hatyā prakāritā tvayā ||4.54.80|| yatiścāhaṃ vinirbhīkastvāṃ daṇḍayitumīśvaraḥ | hāhākāro vartate’dya rājñā viṣeṇa māritau ||81 || kiṃ rājyena tava rājan pāpātipāpakāriṇaḥ | yogyo nāsi sadā rājan tavāyuḥ kṣīṇatāṃ gatam ||82|| yāmyaloke tava vāsaściraṃ kaṣṭo bhaviṣyati | paśya kanyākumārābhyāṃ dattaṃ śāpaṃ tu gocaram ||83|| mriyatāṃ yuddharājo’yaṃ mārako nau viṣeṇa vai | śāpo’yaṃ mūrtimānāste tava prāṇaharastviha ||84|| idānīṃ te gatirnāsti vinā mṛtyuṃ parā bhuvi | hatyāpāpaṃ tava jātaṃ mṛtyuste’yamupāgataḥ ||85|| ityukte tatra cāyāto yamadūto bhayaṃkaraḥ | pāśahasto vikarālo vahniṃ samudgiran mukhāt ||86|| yatiṃ taṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ natvā kanyākumārarakṣakam | pāśena pāpinaṃ duṣṭaṃ babandha nṛpatiṃ tu saḥ ||87|| rājā parādhīnadeho vyajāyata tadābudhaḥ | mūrchāmavāpa sahasākruśan mudgaramāritaḥ ||88|| viṣapāśairnibaddhaśca viyojayituṃ varṣmaṇaḥ | tāvadrājā hṛdayena yatiṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||89|| nārāyaṇaṃ tathā smṛtvā śrīkṛṣṇaśaraṇaṃ gataḥ | kṣamāmayācata tatra mūrchito’pi nijātmani ||4.54.90|| śokaṃ cakāra bahudhā yāmyabaddho vaśaṃgataḥ | lokairdṛṣṭastathā dūto vikarālo’drisannibhaḥ ||91|| prajāśca rājavargāśca saṃhitāstatra vai drutam | śrutvā jñātvā paraṃ kaṣṭaṃ kanyākumārabhūbhṛtām ||92|| aniṣṭaṃ paramaṃ jñātvā śokaṃ sarve pracakrire | sādhumaiśvaryayuktaṃ taṃ jñātvā rājñī tu pādayoḥ ||93|| nāmnā nārāyaṇīdevī tuṣṭāva sādhumīśvaram | kṛpānātha kṛpāmūrte dayālo hitakṛt sadā ||94|| haritulya mahāyogin matpatiṃ svasthamāvaha | putrikā rakṣitā cāpi kumāro rakṣitastvayā ||95|| kṛpayainaṃ patiṃ me’pi prarakṣayāpi pāpinam | pāpāḥ pāpaṃ prakurvanti puṇyāḥ puṇyaṃ dadatyapi ||96|| pāpaṃ matsvāminaścātrāgaṇayitvāvanaṃ kuru | pāpanāśo bhavedyena mokṣaṇaṃ ca tathā bhavet ||97|| tathā tvaṃ bhagavannatra kurvasmākaṃ hitāvaham | eṣāhaṃ tava dāsyasmi vākyaṃ me pratipālaya ||98|| ityuktvā caraṇau dhṛtvā sādhoḥ rājñī jaḍābhavat | jīvanāyanasādhuḥ sa kṛtvā haste jalaṃ tadā ||99|| rājñyā mukhe dadau rājñī svasthābhavat sukhasthitā | tato gatvā nṛpasyāpi mukhe jalaṃ dadau sa hi ||4.54.1 00|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā| | prabhonārāyaṇa śrīśarvarīnārāyaṇa prabho ||101 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīkānta sadvibho | evaṃ mantraṃ nāmadhunyaṃ dadau vāriyutaṃ tadā || 1 02|| yāmyadūtaśca taṃ tūrṇaṃ nṛpaṃ tyaktvā yayau tataḥ | rājā bubodha sahasā yatiṃ neme tu rakṣakam ||103|| kanyāghnaṃ ca kumāraghnaṃ sādhuryāmyād rarakṣa tam | badrike ca tadā sarve śokaṃ vihāya sarvathā || 1 04|| prasannamānasā jātā jagṛhire manuṃ sataḥ | nāmadhunyaṃ jagṛhire sahasraśo narāḥ striyaḥ ||105|| vārtā sā yuddhanagare prāsarad vāyuveginī | hāhākārasamā śāntistadā punarajāyata || 1 06|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne yuddhapatanarājño yuddharājasyaviṣaprayogāt kanyākumārayorvyasutve’pi jīvanāyanasādhuyaugena punarjīvitatā, śāpena yuddharājasyāyurvināśena yāmyadūtāgamo mṛtyuśca pāpaphalaṃ, sādhukṛtaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catuṣpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 54 ||
<4.55> śrībadrīpriyovācatatastatra tu kiṃ jātaṃ kanyākumārabhūbhṛtām | sādhunā kiṃ kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇanaranārāyaṇaprabho || 1 || śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi mānavāstu sahasraśaḥ | lakṣaśo nṛpatermṛtyuṃ śrutvā ca jīvanaṃ punaḥ || 2 || samāyayurlokituṃ vai sādhuṃ nṛpaṃ camatkṛtim | vilokya jīvitaṃ bhūpaṃ kumāraṃ ca kumārikām || 3 || sādhujīvaṃ kumāraṃ taṃ nāmnā lokāstato’vadan | sādhujīvanīṃ kanyāṃ tāṃ lokāstatraiva cāvadan || 4 || jyeṣṭhaṃ kumārakaṃ lokā nirviṣādaṃ jagustadā | tattannāmnā prasiddhāste’bhavan prajāsu vai drutam || 5 || yā yāḥ prajā narā nāryaścāyayustatra te drutam | vīkṣya sādhoścamatkāraṃ tadāśrayaṃ pracakrire || 6 || sañjīvanāyanaḥ sādhuḥ prajābhyo mantradīkṣaṇam | pradadau nāmabhajanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ca || 7 || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa || 8 || bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa | evaṃ mantraṃ nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ tābhyo dadau muniḥ || 9 || prajāstā yuddhanagare gṛhe gṛhe sthale vane udyāne vāṭikāyāṃ ca kṣetre’raṇye ca gopure || 4.55.1 0|| catvare rājamārge ca rathyāyāmāpaṇeṣvapi | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa || 11 || bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa | ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ cakruḥ sanmahimāḍhyamānasāḥ || 12|| vaiṣṇavā lakṣaśo jātā yuddharājye narāḥ striyaḥ | pupūjuḥ svaguruṃ santaṃ yatiṃ sañjīvanāyanam || 1 3|| candanaiḥ puṣpanivahaiḥ phalaiḥ patraistathāmbaraiḥ | bhojanairvividhaiḥ pātheyakairarhāṃ pracakrire || 14|| siṣevire guruṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pāpanāśaṃ pralebhire | mahāpuṇyaṃ ca pāvitryamarjayāmāsuruttamam || 1 || sañjīvanāyanaḥ sādhurupādideśa tān hitam | saṃsāro’yamasāro’sti rāgadveṣamayo janāḥ || 16|| dehārthaṃ dehapuṣṭyarthaṃ rāgā dveṣā bhavanti hi | hiṃsanaṃ nāśanaṃ cānyadehināṃ kurute janaḥ || 17|| ajñānenaiva rāgeṇa dveṣeṇa yojitena vā | kālo’sti śrīparabrahmayojitaḥ sṛṣṭihārakaḥ || 18|| kālaḥ karoti sakalaṃ kālaḥ kalayate sadā | kālena tasya caiveha jagat sarvaṃ pravāhyate || 1 9|| kālapāśaṃ vihāyaiva cedgantumiṣyate’kṣare | kālakālaṃ pareśānaṃ bhajantāṃ mānavāḥ sadā ||4.55.20|| saṃsārahetu tvajñānaṃ saṃsāraṃ vāsanātmakam | vicārya samparityajyārjayantu mokṣakāraṇam ||21 || jñānaṃ bhaktiṃ satāṃ sevāṃ snehapūrvāṃ śubhāśrayām | nirvṛttiṃ paramāṃ śāntiṃ labhantāṃ śāśvatīṃ tviha || 22|| indre candre ravau vahnau vighneśe ca narāyaṇe | parabrahmamayaṃ dhyānaṃ carantāṃ pārameśvaram ||23|| carācaraṃ jagatsarvaṃ tyajantu bandhakṛddhi tat | carācarāṇāṃ cālayitāraṃ gṛhṇantu tadgatam ||24|| ābhyantarasthitaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śriyaḥ patim | arcayantu sadā śrīmannārāyaṇaṃ tadāśritān || 25|| nārāyaṇe dattacittān nārāyaṇaparāyaṇān | sādhūn saṃsevya divyena pathā yāntvakṣaraṃ padam ||26|| ābhyantarārcakāḥ pūjyāḥ sevyā divyakriyāparāḥ | virūpā vikṛtāścāpi na nindyā brahmadhāminaḥ ||27|| ābhyantarārcakāḥ sarve na parīkṣyāḥ kadācana | tannindakāstu duḥkhārtā bhavantyevālpajīvanāḥ ||28|| brahmavidastoṣaṇīyāḥ sevayā cāviṃśakayā | varṇāśramavinirmuktā varṇāśramasusaṃsthitaiḥ ||29|| satsaṃgaḥ sarvathā divyo mokṣadaḥ pāpanāśakaḥ | hatyāpāpādiśāntyarthaṃ kartavyo vai vijānatā || 4.55.30 || adhunā divyasatsaṃgo vidyate śarkarāpure | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ pārāyaṇātmakaḥ || 31 || tatra nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt svataḥprakāśarūpadhṛk | śrautaṃ sarvaṃ hi vijñānaṃ śrāvayatyadya mokṣadam || 32|| paraṃ brahma parāṃ lakṣmīṃ paraṃ mokṣaṃ paraṃ sukham | paraṃ dharmaṃ paraṃ jñānaṃ śrāvayatyeva śāśvatam ||33|| prayāmyahaṃ tu tatsthānaṃ mokṣalābhāya cātmanaḥ | sa lābho na punarbhūmau lokānāṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ||34|| tatra santo munayaśca siddhāśca cāraṇāḥ surāḥ | gandharvā yatayo vidyādharāśca kinnarā janāḥ ||35|| kiṃpuruṣā bhūdevāśca maharṣayo narāḥ striyaḥ | brahmacaryaparā devā divyā muktāḥ samāgatāḥ ||36|| yeṣāṃ tu darśanāt pāpadhvaṃso bhavati sarvathā | yeṣāṃ ca sevanāt sarvavāsanādagdhatā bhavet ||37|| yeṣāṃ prasādalābhena divyatā divyabhāgyatā | yeṣāṃ satsaṃgamātreṇa muktatā paramā bhavet ||38|| yeṣāṃ snehena satataṃ brahmānandārjanaṃ bhavet | yeṣāṃ samāśrayeṇaiva brahmadhāmagatirbhavet ||39|| ye bhajanti sadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapareśvaram | stuvanti pratyahaṃ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaṃ prabhumpatim ||4.55.40 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa | bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāyaṇa ||41 || evaṃ raṭanti nityaṃ taṃ parameśaṃ hi sādhavaḥ | teṣāṃ satsaṃgalābhena puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam ||42|| namastebhyaḥ samastebhyaḥ sādhubhyo’stu muhurmuhuḥ | namaḥ sādhusvarūpāya śrīkṛṣṇasvāmine namaḥ ||43|| namaḥ sarvādhipataye sarvapūrvāya cakriṇe | namo’vatārapūjyāya sṛṣṭīnāṃ prabhave namaḥ ||44|| jñānānāṃ prabhave tasmai karmaṇāṃ prabhave namaḥ | īśvarāṇāṃ praśāstre ca devānāṃ prabhave namaḥ ||45|| ṛṣīṇāṃ ca grahāṇāṃ ca ṛkṣāṇāṃ prabhave namaḥ | vidyutāṃ taijasānāṃ ca meghānāṃ prabhave namaḥ ||46|| varṣāṇāṃ ca bhūdharāṇāṃ nadīnāṃ prabhave namaḥ | sarvauṣadhīnāṃ bhakṣyāṇāṃ tṛptīnāṃ prabhave namaḥ ||47|| namo dharmādirūpāṇāṃ janayitre parātmane | tasmai rasānāṃ prabhave ratnānāṃ prabhave namaḥ ||48|| ṛtvādīnāṃ prabhave ca vārtānāṃ prabhave namaḥ | viśvānāṃ prabhave sarvavidyānāṃ prabhave namaḥ ||49|| vratānāṃ prabhave tasmai mantrāṇāṃ prabhave namaḥ | siddhīnāṃ prabhave sarvaujasāṃ ca prabhave namaḥ ||4.55.50 || lakṣmīnāṃ pataye tasmai śrīsvāmine namo namaḥ | namastasmai varadāya prajeśāya mahātmane ||51 || aṇave mahate tasmai sarvagāya namo namaḥ | namo yajñasvarūpāya namaḥ pūjātmakāya ca ||52|| namaḥ śastrāstradhārāya mādhavīṣṭāya te namaḥ | namastīrthāya devāya vediśīlāya te namaḥ ||53|| namo vīryāya kāmāya sadānandāya te namaḥ | namaḥ śrībālakṛṣṇāyābhayadānāya te namaḥ ||54|| varadāya vareṇyāya namaste’pratimāya ca | havyakavyādirūpāya medhyāya viṣṇave namaḥ ||55|| paṃktipāvanarūpāya nārāyaṇāya te namaḥ | namaḥ śuddhāya buddhāya sarvanetrāya te namaḥ ||56 || dṛśyādṛśyasvarūpāya dampatīrūpiṇe namaḥ | tyāgine ca suvarṇāya saumyarūpāya te namaḥ |||57||| namaḥ kāntāya śrīśāya vallabhāryāya te namaḥ | vatsalāyopajīvyāya mṛtyughnāya ca te namaḥ ||58 || aprameyāya bṛhate kulālāya namo namaḥ | rakṣoghnāya viṣaghnāya bhaktavedyāya te namaḥ |||59 || nirviśeṣāya hṛdyāya mokṣadāya ca te namaḥ | namo gopālabālāya kaṃbharāśrībhavāya ca ||4.55.6 0 || kāmadāya ca yuvatīsevitāya namo namaḥ | namo vṛddhātivṛddhāya purāṇāya ca te namaḥ ||61 || lokadhātrī tviyaṃ bhūmirmūrtirdivyā hi te matā | dyauḥ sarvaṃ mastakaṃ yasya pātālaṃ pādasaṃjñitam ||62|| sṛṣṭayaścodare yasya tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya paramātmane ||63|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetravāsabālāya te namaḥ | sarvahṛtsu nivāsāyāntaryāmiṇe ca te namaḥ ||64|| nārāyaṇastavenaivaṃ ye stuvantyātmanāṃ patim | śṛṇvanti stavanaṃ caivaṃ teṣāṃ bhāgyodayo bhavet ||689|| bhajanīyo raṭanīyaḥ sevanīyaḥ priyeśvaraḥ | sarvakarmasu viśvātmā snehanīyaḥ priyaḥ patiḥ || 26|| prāṇapatiḥ pālanīyo rakṣaṇīyo guhāntare | na kadācinmocanīyaḥ śāśvatānandalipsubhiḥ ||67|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | ityuktvā badrike sādhurjīvanāyana ekalaḥ ||68|| śarkarānagaraṃ gantuṃ samiyeṣa tadā janāḥ | nṛpādayaḥ saha yātuṃ sajjāḥ prajāstadābhavan ||69|| narā nāryo bālabālā vṛddhā yuvāna ityapi | saṃhitāśravaṇārthaṃ te sajjā viniryayurdrutam ||4.55.70|| saṃghayātrā cātidīrghā lakṣādhimānavātmikā |. abhavacchrībadrike vai śrīkṛṣṇalagnamānasā ||71|| kanyā sādhujīvanī sā kumāraḥ sādhujīvanaḥ | nirviṣādaḥ kumāro yo jyeṣṭho yo nāgavikramaḥ ||72|| yuvarājaḥ svayaṃ cāpi rājñī nārāyaṇī satī | dāsī prabhāvatīdevī ghaṭamālābhidhāparā ||73|| dāsā dāsyaḥ sahasraṃ ca prajāstu lakṣaśo janāḥ | niryayuḥ saṃhitāṃ śrotuṃ muktyarthaṃ ca samutsukāḥ ||74|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa | bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāyaṇa ||75|| narā nāryo vṛddhabālāḥ kurvanto dhunyakīrtanam | mārge yānti badrike te sarve brahmaparāyaṇāḥ ||76|| sindhughāṭaṃ samāsādya sasnustīrthe papurjalam | saṃhitāyā maṇḍapaṃ te yayuḥ kīrtanaghoṣiṇaḥ ||77|| nemuśca daṇḍavadvaktāraṃ taṃ svataḥprakāśakam | jagṛhuste prasādasya vāri kṛṣṇapadāmṛtam ||78|| upadā nidadhuścāgre pupūjuḥ saṃhitāharim | jagṛhustatra mantraṃ ca parabrahmasamīpataḥ ||79|| oḥ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | kathāśravaṇaṃ cakruśca pupūjurlomaśaṃ munim ||4.55.80|| satāṃ sevāṃ satīnāṃ ca sevāṃ cakrurniḥsaṃśayāḥ | māsamevaṃ kathāsevāṃ cakrustāvat samāhitāḥ ||8 1|| yuddharājasya pāpaṃ vai viṣadānasya yaddhyabhūt | kanyākumāraghātasya samūlaṃ tadvyapohitam |||82|| anyeṣāmapi pāpāni prajvalitāni sarvaśaḥ | viśuddhāḥ pāvanāḥ sarve jātā nṛpaprajādayaḥ ||83|| vāsanāḥ śrīkathāvārtāśravaṇād vilayaṃgatā | sādhūnāṃ sevanād divyabhāvāḥ sarve’bhavam̐stadā ||84|| pratīkṣante virāgasthā muktiṃ śrīpārameśvarīm | rājā dhāraṇayā dhyānaṃ labdhavān paramātmani ||85|| rājñī cāpi tathā dhyānaṃ labdhavatī priyeśvare | dāsī labdhavatī dhyānaṃ nrāyaṇe mādhavīpatau ||86|| vṛddhāścānye narā nāryo babhūvurdhyānayoginaḥ | phālgunaśuklaikādaśyāṃ muktīkṣakā hi tatparā ||87|| āsan gantuṃ mahāmuktiṃ tadā rājāgrajanmane | jyeṣṭhakumārakāyaiva nāgavikramanāmine ||88|| likhitvā samukuṭaṃ vai rājyadhiṣṇyaṃ tadā dadau | kārayitvā mahāyajñasaṃkalpaṃ sārvamedhikam ||89|| atha kanyā kumārau dvau sādhvī sādhū babhavūtuḥ | tyāginau sarvadā śiṣyau svataḥprakāśayoginaḥ ||4.55.90|| anye nāryo narāścāpi jagṛhustyāgidīkṣaṇam | sahasraśo’pare bhaktāstyāgāśramaṃ ca jagṛhuḥ ||91|| śṛṇu badrīpriye tatrāścaryaṃ jātaṃ paraṃ mahat | vimānāni kānakānyāgatāni vyomamārgataḥ ||92|| padmālakṣmīramārādhāmāṇikyāmādhavīstriyaḥ | muktamuktānikāpārṣadāśca tiṣṭhanti yeṣu vai ||93|| pratyeke rājate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’pi sundaraḥ | tadā vyoma brahmadhāmatulyaṃ taistu vyajāyata ||94|| kṛtvā kṛṣṇo divyadehān netuṃ yogyānnijāśritān | vimāneṣu sthāpayitvā sahasrādhikamānavān ||95|| yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ naijaṃ paśyatāṃ sarvadehinām | ekaṃ vāpi na vai varṣma tadābhūcchavarūpakam ||96|| bhautikā api dehāste divarūpāstadābhavan | taireva varṣmabhiḥ sarve yayurvimānasaṃsthitāḥ ||97|| aho līlā harerbadri hyagamyā tarkavarjitā | māyāṃ kuryānnijaṃ dhāma tadā kā vārtikāparā ||98|| athānye ye narā nāryo bālāśca bālikāśca vai | tyāgāśrame sthitāḥ sarve tadanye tu gṛhāśramāḥ ||99|| yayurnaijān śubhān deśān yuddharājyanivāsinaḥ | evaṃ badrīpriye tatra camatkāro’bhavanmahān || 4.55.1 00|| nāgavikramarājāpi dadau dānānyanekaśaḥ | bhojanāni vicitrāṇi bhūṣāmbarāṇi vai tadā | | 10 1|| kṛtvā śrīsahitāpūjāṃ natvā gurumṛṣiṃ tathā | sato natvājñayā rājyaṃ nijaṃ samāyayau sukham ||102|| kanyāghnasya kṛtā muktiḥ śaraṇe patitasya vai | sādhoḥ sevāratasyāpi kumāraghnasya badrike ||1 03|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena paramātmanā | dayālunā kṛtā muktirmuninā jīvanena ca || 104|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāccintanādapi | guṇagrāhād bhuktimuktī bhavetāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||1 05|| itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śrījīvanāyanena yuddharājena ca samaṃ rāṣṭrīyaprajādīnāṃ saṃhitāsthānagamanaṃ kathāśravaṇaṃ, yuddharājādīnāṃ mokṣaṇam, kanyakādīnāṃ tyāgitvam, itareṣāṃ yuvarājena samaṃ rāṣṭraṃ pratyāgamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 55 ||
<4.56> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāmanyāṃ supāvanīm | śarkarānagare tatra tvekāsīt kuṭṭanī sakhī || 1 || vārāṃganānāṃ maitryāḍhyā vyavāyināṃ niyojinī | yoṣitāṃ yuvatīnāṃ kanyakānāṃ śaulanāśinī || 2 || nāmnā sānaṅgavallīti yā sā nirdhanā hyati | vyavāyayogalabdhena nirvāhaṃ prakaroti sā || 3 || pāpinī pāparūpā sā jānāti hyauṣadhānyapi | jvaranāśakaraṃ cauṣṇyanāśakṛd roganāśakṛt || 4 || guptendriyādirogāṇāṃ tvauṣadhaṃ vetti sā sakhī | garbhasrāvauṣadhaṃ bhrūṇaghātauṣadhaṃ ca vetyapi || 5 || ata eva vyavāyādau nirbhayā yogadāyinī | pāpajñānavihīnāsījjaḍā kāmātikāminī || 6 || svayaṃ duṣṭā parā duṣṭāḥ sampādayati karmaṇā | evaṃ tayā tu bahvīnāmadhavānāṃ samudbhavāḥ || 7 || garbhā nipātitā bījanāśāścāpi kṛtā muhuḥ | pakvabālā janmayogyā auṣadhairmāritā hyapi || 8 || evaṃ sā bālahatyāghā śuśrāva saṃhitākathām | tayā jñātavatī pāpaṃ bālahatyādijaṃ mahat || 9 || duḥkhaṃ jñānavatī cāpi yāmyajaṃ duḥsahaṃ sakhī | svasyā api pratigarbhaṃ patanaṃ daṇḍamulbaṇam ||4.56.10|| jñātvā śuśoca bahudhā pāpānnyavartatāpi sā | prāyaścittasya jijñāsāṃ cakāra sadgurostataḥ ||1 1|| ekadā śrīlomaśāgre nivedayituṃ sā yayau | kathānte lomaśaṃ gatvā pūjayitvā tu dīnavat || 12|| kṛtvā tu daṇḍavadyogyaṃ jagrāha caraṇau muneḥ | pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā lomaśasya mahātmanaḥ || 1 3|| papau pādāmṛtaṃ sarvaṃ śiro dhṛtvā tu pādayoḥ | jagāda kṛtya pāpādi sarvaṃ kapaṭavarjitam || 14|| kṛpālulomaśaḥ śrutvā brahmakūrcavrataṃ dadau | palāśapatraprabhṛtikvāthaṃ ca pañcagavyakam ||15|| pātumājñāṃ dadau tasyai sā cakāra yathoditam | māsānte sā śuddhadehā mantraṃ jagrāha lomaśāt ||16|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa || 17|| bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāyaṇa | mantramevaṃ bhajanaṃ ca jagrāha lomaśānmuneḥ ||18|| mālāśataṃ kṛṣṇanārāyeṇanāmnāpyavartayat | nityaṃ snātvā sindhunadyā jale pāti padāmṛtam || 19|| nityaṃ kṛṣṇaprasādaṃ ca bhakṣayatyeva bhāvataḥ | sādhūnāṃ pātraśeṣaṃ ca bhakṣayatyapi pāvanam ||4.56.20|| sādhuvāseṣu nityaṃ sā mārjanaṃ pātramañjanam | karoti sevanaṃ gatvā gātrasaṃvāhanaṃ satām ||21 || dhūlibhirmārjitābhiścoddhūlanaṃ nijavarṣmaṇi | karoti bhāvato’naṅgavallikā pāpanuttaye ||22|| dhunyaṃ ca kīrtanaṃ nityaṃ karoti sadasi sthitā | dadāti phalapuṣpādi saṃhitāvācakāya ca ||23|| śrīkṛṣṇāya satīsadbhyo lomaśāya mahātmane | dhanaṃ tu ḍhabbukamātraṃ nitya dadāti cakriṇe ||24|| akṣatānāṃ nityamuṣṭiṃ vācakāya dadāti sā | evaṃ kṛtavatī nityaṃ bhaktyā sānaṅgavallikā ||25|| kathāṃ śuśrāva bahudhā sarvapāpaviśodhinīm | sarvājñānaharāṃ dīrghatamoghnīṃ jñānadāyinīm ||26|| māsaścāsyā vyatīyāya kathāsevādikarmabhiḥ | sā dadarśa tataḥ svapne prabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ samāgatam ||27|| spṛśantaṃ svāṃ hasantaṃ svāṃ hāsayantaṃ śriyaḥ patim | vadantaṃ svāṃ viśuddhāsi nayantaṃ svāṃ nijaṃ prati ||28|| kṣaṇamevaṃ pradarśyaiva bhagavān mādhavīpatiḥ | adṛśyatāṃ yayau sāpi jajāgāra samutsukā ||29||| utthāya sahasā brāhme muhūrte tu nijālaye | tūrṇaṃ sā paritaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ mārgayāmāsa bhāminī || 4.56.30|| premavihvalatāṃ prāptā yadā labdhavatī na tam | tadā mugdhā drutaṃ snātvā pūjāṃ kṛtvā parātmanaḥ ||31 || yayau tūrṇaṃ saṃhitāyāḥ pūjārthaṃ kuṃkumākṣataiḥ | brāhme muhūrte nārīṇāṃ pravāhastumulaḥ prage || 32|| satataṃ saṃhitāyāstu pūjane vartate sadā | tanmadhye sā gatā śīghraṃ dhyātvā svāpnaṃ priyaṃ prabhum ||33|| pūjayitvā tatastūrṇaṃ samutsukā tu lomaśam | gatvā jagāda sarvaṃ tat prasannamānasā sakhī ||34|| śrutvā śrīlomaśaḥ prāha śuddhā tvaṃ bhaktiyoginī | kṛṣṇaprasannatāṃ prāptā vartase’dya ramā yathā ||35|| bhava sajjā dhāma gantuṃ mokṣo te’tra bhaviṣyati | sarvaṃ pāpaṃ gataṃ te’dya kṛṣṇo yadgocaro’bhavat ||36|| tataḥ sāpi jagādainaṃ guruṃ śrībadrike drutam | sajjāsmi kintu bhagavannāste me hṛdi cintanam ||37|| mama yogena yā nāryo yuvatyo dhavavarjitāḥ | garbhapātādidoṣāḍhyā bhrūṇūhatyānvitāstathā ||38|| tāsāṃ kalyāṇamicchāmi pāpanāśanapūrvakam | kṛpā te’sti tathā cājñā kṛpāloste guroriha || 39|| tāḥ sarvāstvaccharaṇaṃ cānayāmīha pramuktaye | vinā nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā ca sadguruṃ kvacit ||4.56.40 || pāpānāṃ naiva nistāro yoṣitāṃ syāt kadācana | vinā vaiṣṇavabhaktānāṃ śaraṇaṃ naiva rakṣaṇam ||41 || vinā śrīkṛṣṇabhaktānāṃ sevanaṃ nāghamarṣaṇam | vinā satāṃ prasādaṃ na pāpināṃ vāsanākṣayaḥ |||42|| vinā cetanatīrthaṃ na pāpātmanāṃ viśodhanam | nārīṇāṃ durlabhā śuddhirguro loke’tra māyike ||43 || kāmakṣetre tu niṣkāmisatāṃ sevā hi śuddhidā | yā nārī vāñchati śuddhiṃ muktiṃ brāhmīṃ paraṃ padam ||44|| tayā sevyā hareḥ santo niṣkāmāḥ kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ | satāṃ prasevayā kāmakrodhalobhādināśanam ||45|| vāsanānāṃ vināśaśca bhavenme vai yathābhavat | tasmād guro samicchāmi matsakhīnāṃ viśodhanam ||46|| prāpte kṛṣṇe gurau divye tvātmamokṣaḥ puro mataḥ | kṛṣṇagurvoḥ kṛpayā tu cātmīyānāṃ mato’pi saḥ ||47|| ātmanastāraṇe puṇyaṃ tato’yutaṃ parasya tu | yoṣitāṃ tāraṇe tatra puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ matam ||48|| anāthānāṃ tāraṇe tu brahmāṇḍoddhārajaṃ hi tat | anāthā yoṣito yāstā matpāśe patitā guro ||49|| yāvattāsāṃ tu noddhārastāvanme narakaṃ bhavet | pātitasyodayaṃ kṛtvā kṣantvāparādhamasya ca ||4.56.50 || nirṛṇaṃ tu nijaṃ kṛtvā tato gamyaṃ divaṃ sukham | ityevaṃ me guro cāste matirnārīpramokṣiṇā ||51 || tāḥ sarvāstamasi sthāpya kathaṃ me mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet | sakhītvaṃ tu tadevātra samalābho yadātmanoḥ ||5 2 || svārthamātrastu lābhādirnarakaṃ kapaṭānvitam | tanmayā sarvathā tāsāṃ kartavyaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ prabho ||5 3|| punaḥ kṣaṇo divyagatirnāgamiṣyati sadguro | ityuktvā sā virarāma badrike’naṅgavallarī ||54|| lomaśo’pi śubhaṃ matvā kṛpayā tāṃ jagāda ha | yogyaṃ vadasi kalyāṇi śreṣṭhaṃ vicāryate tvayā ||55 || svārthasya sādhakaḥ prāṇī nārakī nātra saṃśayaḥ | sa eva kākaḥ sarpaśca sūkaraḥ svārthasādhakaḥ ||5 6 || tvaṃ parārthaparā sādhvī dvayoḥ kalyāṇakāriṇī | parakalyāṇakartryāstu svaṃ kalyāṇaṃ prajāyate ||57|| avaśyaṃ paralokām̐stvaṃ jitāsi copakāriṇī | yatheṣṭaṃ vartamānā yā cāpi pāpātipāpinī ||58|| paropakāradharmā cet svargaṃ vindati sā satī | paropakāraḥ puṇyārthaḥ parapīḍā tu pāpadā ||59|| parapīḍānāśayitrī mucyate duḥkhabandhanāt | pareṣāṃ sukhado lokaḥ svarge loke mahīyate ||4.56.60|| avaśyaṃ cānaṅgavalli samānaya sakhījanān | tābhyo mantraṃ pradāsye’tra dāsye nāmajapaṃ tathā ||61|| vrataṃ dāsye brahmakūrcaṃ kariṣye pāpanāśanam | pāvanāstāḥ kariṣye’haṃ mokṣabhāgā viśuddhigāḥ ||62|| ityevaṃ badrike soktā lomaśena maharṣiṇā | śarkarānagaraṃ tūrṇaṃ gatvā yatra ca yatra ca || 63|| yuvatyo dhavahīnāśca vyavāyavyavasāyikāḥ | garbhapātabhrūṇahatyādoṣavatyo’bhavan pure ||64|| anaṅgavallīsaṃginyastāstāḥ sānaṅgavallarī | bodhayāmāsa pāpānāṃ nuttaye śreyase tathā ||65|| tāśca viśvāsamāpannā anaṅgavallikāyutāḥ | snātvā pūjopasāmagrīrnītvā gurvagramāgatāḥ ||66|| yuvatyastāḥ śataṃ badri vidhavā garbhapātikāḥ | kanyakāśca śataṃ garbhahantryo’pi yauvanānvitāḥ ||67|| āgatāḥ śrīlomaśāgre pāpabhayena śokitāḥ | salajjā svasakhīvākyaviśvastā āyayurmunim ||68|| pādajalaṃ papuḥ sarvā lomaśasya tataḥ kathām | śuśruvustāstato brahmakūrcaṃ vrata ca jagṛhuḥ || 69|| pūjāṃ tāḥ saṃhitāyāśca pracakrurvācakasya vai | pradakṣiṇaṃ stutiṃ cakruḥ kṣamāṃ yayācire tataḥ ||4.56.70|| mantraṃ jagṛhurmunito nāmadhunyaṃ prajagṛhuḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||71 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa | bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāyaṇa ||72|| evaṃ mantraṃ ca bhajanaṃ prāpya tathā samācaran | snātvā tīrthe sadā tāśca śuśruvuḥ saṃhitākathām ||73|| evaṃ tāsu samastāsu vartamānāsu badrike | pūtāsu jāyamānāsu satāṃ sevāparāsu ca ||74|| ājñāparāsu sarvāsu lomaśasya prasannatā | abhavallomaśastābhyo dadau kṛṣṇaprasādajam ||75|| svabhuktaṃ phalamevāpi miṣṭānnaṃ nijapātrajam | sādhuprasādamāsādya bubhujire’tibhāvataḥ ||76|| tāvattāsāṃ śarīrebhyaḥ kṛṣṇāḥ kākā viniryayuḥ | sarve te garbhahatyākhyā bhraṇūhatyāstathābhavan ||77|| uḍḍīyoḍḍīya cākāśe nipetuḥ sindhusāgare | vināśaṃ sahasā prāpuḥ kākātmakānyaghāni vai ||78|| striyastāḥ śuddhatāṃ prāptā bhajanti sma narāyaṇam | pārāyaṇaṃ bhāvabhinnāḥ śṛṇvantvekāgramānasāḥ ||79|| tāvadanagavallīṃ tu netuṃ kṛṣṇaḥ samāyayau | phālgunasya tu pūrṇāyāṃ tithau kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||4.56.80|| vimānenāsthito bhūmāvanaṃgavallikāpuraḥ | prāha tāṃ tu samāgantuṃ mokṣārthaṃ tu vimānake ||81|| tāvat sā dayayā prāha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho | dve śate mama saṃginyaścaitāḥ striyo’ghabhājanāḥ ||82|| kathālomaśayogena niṣpāpā yadi santi cet | netavyāstāstava dhāmākṣaraṃ divyā vidhāya tāḥ ||83|| nānyathāhaṃ kṛṣṇakānta mokṣamicchāmi caikalā | uddhara tāḥ samastā vai tataścoddhara māmapi ||84|| śrutvā cātiprasanno’bhūd bālakṛṣṇaḥ prabheśvaraḥ | kṛpālurbhagavānāhānaṃgavalli śubhaṃ tava ||85|| yāḥ sarvā vidhavāstāstu neṣye me’kṣaramuttamam | tvayā sākaṃ vimānena kariṣye kamalāsamāḥ ||86|| yāstu santi kanyakā vai tāsāṃ mokṣo’dhunā nahi | tāḥ sarvāḥ svajanakasya gṛhe vasantu nirbhayāḥ ||87|| pūtā niṣpāpadehāstāḥ kṛpayā bhālitā mayā | vivāhya tāśca gārhasthyamanubhūya tataḥ param ||88|| āyuṣo’nte mama dhāma cāyāsyanti na saṃśayaḥ | ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pasparśa pāṇinā ||89|| sarvāstāstatra tatkāle saṃhitāśravaṇāsthitāḥ | pāvayitvā samastāstā vidhavāstu śataṃ tadā ||4.56.90|| divyadehā vidhāyaiva vimāne sve’dhyarohayat | kanyakāstu samājñāpya sthātuṃ pitṛgṛhe tadā ||91 || vimānena yayau kṛṣṇo dhāmākṣaraṃ nijaṃ mahat | sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ badri sānaṃgavallikā hyapi ||92|| divyadehābhavattūrṇaṃ divyā divyavibhūṣitā | vimānaṃ samadhiruhya yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ ||93|| jayakāro mahānāsīt puṣpavṛṣṭirabhūttadā | adhamoddhārake kṛṣṇe māhātmyamatulaṃ hyabhūt ||94|| badrike garbhaghātinyaḥ kathāśravaṇamātrataḥ | pūtatāṃ tā gatāḥ sarvā gurorbalātpramocitāḥ ||95|| aho balaṃ guroḥ śreṣṭhatamaṃ śrībhagavānapi | yadagre nirbalo bhūtvā karoti sadgurorvacaḥ ||96|| vīkṣya śrutvā tu māhātmyaṃ vyavāyadoṣanāśakam | anyā api tadā nāryaḥ kṛṣṇāśrayaṃ vyadhurmudā ||97|| svadoṣān kṣapayāmāsurananyabhaktitatparāḥ | mantraṃ tā raṭayāmāsurnāmakīrtanamāvyadhuḥ ||98|| satāṃ sevāṃ pracakruśca dānapuṇyaṃ pracakrire | prapattiṃ jagṛhuścāpi pavitratvaṃ prapedire ||99|| divyabhāvāḥ śīlaparā dharmadārḍhyāstato’bhavana | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktiyutāḥ sadā || 4.56.10 0|| evaṃ śrībadrike devi prabhuḥkṛṣṇo hariḥ svayam | cakāra mokṣaṇaṃ tāsāṃ prāptakāle dayānidhiḥ || 10 1|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāccintanādapi | guṇagrāhād vartanācca svargo mokṣo bhaved dhruvaḥ || 102|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śarkarāpuravāsinyāḥ vyavāyakārayitryā garbhrabhrūṇabālaghātinyā anaṃgavallaryāḥ tatsakhīśatadvayasyāpi ca saṃhitāśravaṇādinā mantravratasevābhiśca pāpanirmuktirmokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 56 ||
<4.57> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badripriye devi kathāṃ ṣaṇḍhavrajasya tu | ṣaṇḍhavrajābhidhaḥ ṣaṇḍho’bhavacchrīśarkarāpure || 1 || śataṣaṇḍhaguruḥ so’yaṃ bahucarāptadīkṣaṇaḥ | nārīveṣadharo naiva strīliṅgo na pulliṅgakaḥ || 2 || kāmadhātuvihīno’pi vāsanākāmasaṃbhṛtaḥ | vartate dīkṣitaḥ ṣaṇḍho ṣāṇḍhīdīkṣānvitaḥ sadā || 3 || bhikṣayā jauvanaṃ naijaṃ rājavṛttyā tu sarvathā | tathānyakliṣṭavṛttyāpi nirvahatyeva sarvadā || 4 || māhātmyaṃ taiḥ śrutaṃ tatra kathāyā mokṣadaṃ śubham | janebhyo mānavebhyaśca sarvapāpavināśakam || 5 || punarjanmādarśanaṃ ca kathāśravaṇato bhavet | pūrvapāpāni sarvāṇi naśyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 6 || bhasmībhavanti cānyāni hyetajjanmārjitānyapi | api mānavajanmā yaḥ kathāṃ naiva śṛṇoti ca || 7 || ātmamokṣaṃ nārjayati sa ṣaṇḍhaḥ paśureva saḥ | api rājā dhanī śreṣṭhī prajāpālaḥ prajāgragaḥ || 8 || tathāpyātmakṛte mokṣaṃ kuryānna sa tu gokharaḥ | api ṣaṇḍhaḥ paśuḥ pakṣī nārī pramatta ityapi || 9 || ātmaśreyaḥkaraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ śvapaco’pi śaṭho’pi ca | mokṣaḥ sādhyaḥ paraṃśreyaḥ puruṣārthaḥ paraḥ sa vai || 4.57.10|| sādhaneṣu samasteṣu satsu satsu sthiteṣu ca | mokṣo na sādhito yena sa kīṭaḥ sūkaro’pi saḥ || 11 || dharmārthakāmamokṣā vai puruṣārthā bhavanti hi | dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca prapālyāpi yathocitān || 12|| ante tyaktvā bandhakṛto mokṣamicchanti mānavāḥ | maharṣayaḥ pūrvajāste tathā kurvanti nānyathā ||1 3|| anye’pi cātmavettāraḥ pravartante kramāttathā | sanyāsinastu tām̐styaktvā mokṣamicchanti sādhavaḥ || 14|| rājāno’pi vanaṃ prāpya kāmaṃ dagdhvā tapaḥparāḥ | niṣkāmāḥ samprajāyante mokṣaṃ prayānti vai tataḥ || 15|| dhāturdoṣamayaścāste vāsanānāṃ pravartakaḥ | sa cennaiva bhavatyeva dehe sā tu kṛpā prabhoḥ || 16|| evaṃ matvā hariṃ śritvā sādhuṃ natvā pramokṣaṇam | prasevya satpuruṣām̐śca guruṃ bhaktyā prasādya ca || 17|| arpayitvā samastaṃ svaṃ cātmānaṃ gurave’pi ca | kṛtvā māyāpāśahīnaṃ nirmalaṃ vāsanojjhitam || 18|| divyabhāvaṃ divyadṛṣṭiṃ divyaṃ kṛtvā samastakam | kṛṣṇavimānamāruhya gantavyaṃ paramaṃ padam || 1 9|| dāso bhūtvā harerdāsī vaikuṇṭhe kṛṣṇavartinī | goloke cāmṛte cāvyākṛte brahmanivāsane ||4.57.20|| śrīpure bhagavaddhāmni tvāsvādayeddhareḥ rasam | aśnuvīta sadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprasādakam ||21 || sa evaṃ prāptakaivalyo naro vā yoṣideva vā | ṣaṇḍho vā tiryagevāpi sa eva puruṣo mataḥ ||22|| puruṣārtho mahān mokṣo yastena prasādhitaḥ | arthavān puruṣo loke puruṣasyārtha ityapi ||23|| mitho vai vartate saṃsargastayoḥ sārthakaḥ sadā | evaṃ naiva vijānāti pumarthānna tanotyapi |||24|| vṛthā puruṣagarvāḍhyaḥ ṣaṇḍhaḥ sa naiva saṃśayaḥ | ṣaṇḍhatā sā sadā tyājyā māyayā nirmitā purā || 25|| jīvānāṃ mokṣamārgādvai pātinī cātmaghātinī | sevyāḥ santaḥ kathāḥ śravyāḥ prāptavyaḥ śrīpatīśvaraḥ ||26|| parihāryaṃ punarjanma ṣaṇḍhākhyaṃ taruṣaṇḍavat | putrapautrādisampanno yadi mokṣaṃ pravindati ||27|| vṛkṣaṣaṇḍasvarūpaḥ saḥ sāṇḍo’pi ṣaṇḍha eva saḥ | vicāryetthaṃ badrike te ṣaṇḍhā gurusamanvitāḥ ||28|| ṣaṇḍhavrajaṃ puraskṛtya kalyāṇārthamupasthitāḥ | āyayuḥ śrīkathāsthānaṃ bhaktibhāvasamanvitāḥ ||29|| upadāśca kare kṛtvā pūjopasādhanānyapi | kṛtasnānā śuddhimanto bhajantaḥ kṛṣṇamuttamam ||4.57.30|| kīrtayantaḥ svāmikṛṣṇamādhavīśrīnarāyaṇa | nārīśvaranarāvāsabahucarādhiṣāyaṇa ||31 || evaṃ satālikaṃ gītaṃ gāyantaste kathāsthalam | yayuḥ ṣaṇḍhāḥ samastā vai dūrānnemurhi maṇḍapam ||32|| vartulaṃ te tadā klṛptvā rāsalīlāṃ pracakrire | rāsaṃ satālakaṃ sarve nārīveṣadharāstathā ||33|| sakūrdanaṃ sagītaṃ ca sabhramaṇaṃ pracakrire | savādyaṃ savilāsaṃ ca sunarmākhyaṃ pracakrire ||34|| ekaḥ kṛṣṇo’bhavanmadhye vaṃśīdharo narāyaṇaḥ | anyāḥ sarvā yoṣitaśca gopikā rāsamuttamam ||35|| vartulasthāśca khelādi darśayantyo vyadhuḥ śubham | sabhyā rāsaṃ tu ṣaṇḍhānāṃ vīkṣyāścaryaṃ paraṃ gatāḥ ||36|| ṛṣayo munayaścāpi prajā rājā narāḥ striyaḥ | prasannāścābhavam̐statra phālgunasya site dale ||37|| pūrṇimāyāṃ tadā sāyaṃ kathānte sarvavaiṣṇavāḥ | prasanno lomaśo jātaḥ svataḥprakāśako’pi ca || 38|| ṣaṇḍhāste lomaśaṃ natvā natvā śrīsaṃhitāṃ tathā | brahmaprakāśaṃ natvā ca pūjāṃ cakrustadottamām ||39|| hārān haimān ratnanaddhān śubhaveṣān dadustadā | svarṇarūpyādimudrāśca vastrapātrādi sandaduḥ ||4.57.40|| kuṃkumākṣatapuṣpādyaiḥ pupūjuḥ saṃhitāṃ tathā | vyāsaṃ ca lomaśaṃ cāpi pupūjuste napuṃsakāḥ ||41|| ārārtrikaṃ pracakruśca tālīvādanapūrvakam | mṛdaṃgakāṃsyavādyāḍhyaṃ ghurghurānṛtyaśobhitam ||42|| naivedyaṃ ca nyadhuḥ śreṣṭhaṃ pakvānnāni phalāni ca | brahmaprakāśavyāsena haraye tatsamarpitam ||43|| prasādaśca salilaṃ ca tathā tāmbūlakānyapi | tebhyo bhakṣyārthamevāpi dattāni pāvanāni vai ||44|| te ṣaṇḍhāḥ prāpya rasikaṃ prasādaṃ ca jalāmṛtam | phalaṃ ca bhakṣayāmāsuḥ papuḥ pādāmṛtaṃ tathā ||45|| tataste prārthayāmāsurlomaśaṃ pāvanaṃ munim | ṣaṇḍhatāpāpanāśārthaṃ ṣaṇḍhatājanmanuttaye ||46|| ṣaṇḍhatāyā nivṛttyarthaṃ mokṣārthaṃ śuddhaye’pi ca | dadau tebhyo lomaśastu mantraṃ ca bhajanaṃ tathā ||47|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa ||48|| bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāyaṇa | labdhvā mātraṃ nāmadhunyaṃ pāvanāste tadābhavan ||49|| nyūṣustatraiva te rātrau rāsagānaṃ pracakrire | phālgunasyāsite cādyadine puṣpāvadolanam ||4.57.50||| utsavaṃ paramaṃ cakruste sarve tu kathottaram | lakṣaśo mānavāścāpi puṣpadolāmahotsavam ||||51|| pracakruḥ raṃganikṣepaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ dolāsthitaṃ harim | snapayāmāsuratyarthaṃ remuśca lakṣaśo janāḥ ||52|| narā nāryaḥ pṛthagbhūtāścakruḥ raṃgaprakhelanam | evaṃ te vaiṣṇavā badri ṣaṇḍhā sarve’bhavam̐stataḥ ||53|| nityaṃ kathāṃ praśṛṇvanti kīrtayanti narāyaṇam | mantraṃ jepuśca mālābhiḥ sevante ca sato janān ||54|| tīvrasaṃvegabhaktānāṃ gocaro bhagavān drutam | jāyate’tha tu ṣaṇḍhānāṃ śīghraṃ prasannatāṃ gataḥ ||95|| caitre kṛṣṇe tu te ṣaṇḍhā ekādaśyā vrataṃ vyadhuḥ | cakrurjāgaraṇaṃ sarve prātaḥ snātvā kathāmṛtam ||56|| papuste nityavat prātastato madhyāhnake tu te | bhuktvā sabhāsthale gatvā niṣeduḥ sukhitāstadā |||57||| dhyānaṃ cakrurharestatra tāvat kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | āyayau divyarūpeṇa vimānasthaḥ priyeśvaraḥ |||98|| uvāca tān yatheṣṭaṃ vai bhavantviṣṭasurūpiṇaḥ | muktarūpaṃ tathā muktānikārūpaṃ yatheṣṭakam |||99|| yeṣāṃ yāsāṃ yadiṣṭaṃ tanmadicchayātra jāyatām | badrike evamukte tu nārīṣaṇḍhastu yo’bhavat ||4.57.60|| muktānikādivyarūpaṃ prāptavān sarvathā pṛthak | naraṣaṇḍhastu yasteṣu sa cāpto muktarūpatām ||61|| evaṃ divyasvarūpā vai muktā muktānikāḥ śubhāḥ | abhavam̐statra sahasā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ||62|| tatastānavadattatra ṣaṇḍhavrajo’gramānavān | bhūtvā divyasvarūpaśca bodhayāmāsa mānavān ||63|| ṣaṇḍhatvaṃ jāyate nāryā vighnakartryā ratikṣaṇe | sapatnyā vighnakartryāśca dampatyorvighnayoṣitaḥ ||64|| svapatyurvighnakartryāśca paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ tathā | yugalānāṃ vighnakartryāḥ ṣaṇḍhātvaṃ samajāyate ||61|| patiṃ tyaktvānyasaktāyāḥ ṣaṇḍhātvaṃ saṃprajāyate | ratiṃ cāsahamānāyā vidveṣiṇyāḥ striyāstathā ||66|| ābhicārikavetryāśca bhagabandhakayoṣitaḥ | liṃgāpātanavetryāśca ṛtubhañjakayoṣitaḥ ||67|| ṣaṇḍhātvaṃ jāyate tasyā janmāntare ca janmani | narasyāpi tathā tasya patnyakāmapradasya tu ||68|| viyonivartamānasya parabhāryāratasya ca | vighnakarturyugalayoḥ kanyādidūṣakasya ca ||69|| agamyāgamakasyāpi vṛṣaṇocchedakasya ca | liṃgādināśakasyāpi dehināṃ paśupakṣiṇām ||4.57.70|| ṣaṇḍhatvaṃ jāyate garbhahanturdhātukṣayasya ca | kukarmakāriṇāṃ prāyaḥ ṣaṃḍhatvaṃ jāyate bhuvi ||71|| mahāpāpaṃ hi tatproktaṃ mānave janmani hyati | puṃstvastrītvavihīnatvaṃ narakasyaiva rūpaṇam ||72|| tadgataṃ kṛpayā cādya kathāyāḥ śravaṇena naḥ | muktātvaṃ cāpi muktatvaṃ labdhamasmābhiruttamam ||73|| patirlabdhaḥ parabrahmanārāyaṇaḥ priyeśvaraḥ | amoghavīryo bhagavān brahmanandapradaḥ prabhuḥ ||74|| mā kurvantu striyo puṃso loke’tra kāmadūṣaṇam | kāmavighnakṛtānāṃ vai narakaṃ gocaraṃ tviha ||75|| yeṣāmuddharaṇaṃ na syād vinā śrīvallabhaṃharim | taṃ bhajantāṃ mahābhāgā narā nāryo bhayārditāḥ ||76|| svasvakukarmajālāni smṛtvā smṛtvā narāyaṇam | yāntu śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ bhavantu divyavigrahāḥ ||77|| śāśvatānandamagnāśca prajāyantāṃ tadaṅkagāḥ | vayaṃ snātvā tīrthajale pītvā kathāmṛtaṃ muhuḥ ||78|| bhuktvā kṛṣṇaprasādaṃ ca prāpya prasannatāṃ guroḥ | bhaktyā labdhvā patiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ yāmo’kṣaraṃ paraṃ padam ||79|| bhūtvā divyasvarūpāḥ śrīkṛṣṇayogyāḥ sukhāśrayāḥ | śāśvatānandasaṃmagnā bhavāmo rādhikāsamāḥ ||4.57.80|| ityuktvā badrike sarve muktarūpā narāḥ striyaḥ | kṛṣṇājñayā svarṇayāne niṣeduścākṣaraṃ yayuḥ ||81|| tenaiva khalu dehena svena svena napuṃsakāḥ | vivartamānakāyāste muktā divyāstadābhavan ||82|| abhūnnaiṣāṃ dehapātaḥ kāyākalpo vyajāyat | śrīkṛṣṇasparśanenaiva muktā jātā napuṃsakāḥ ||83|| sarve ṣoḍaśavarṣā vai narā nāryaḥ sutaijasāḥ | muktā muktānikāḥ sarve kṛṣṇarādhāramāsamāḥ ||84|| anyathākarturīśeśeśasya nārāyaṇasya tat | sāmarthyaṃ cāpratihataṃ prākāmyaṃ prakaṭībhavat ||85|| vyarājata manuṣyāṇāṃ hṛdaye tu kṛtāspadam | camatkāro mahāneṣaḥ kathāyāṃ kṛṣṇadarśitaḥ ||86|| jaḍaṃ sacetanaṃ kuryād vidadhyāccetanaṃ jaḍam | nārīṃ naraṃ vidadhyāt sa naraṃ nārīṃ vidhāpayet ||87|| naraṃ striyaṃ ca vā kuryādubhayaṃ tu napuṃsakam | napuṃsakaṃ vidadhyādvā naraṃ nārīṃ ca pārṣadam ||88|| muktaṃ muktānikāṃ vāpi jaḍaṃ divyaṃ vidhāpayet | māyāṃ kuryādakṣaraṃ so’kṣaraṃ kuryāttu prakṛtim ||89|| kuryāttattvānyatattvāni śūnyaṃ tattvātmakaṃ kriyāt | tattvāt tattvāntaraṃ kuryādetāstu śaktayo hareḥ ||4.57.90|| anantaśaktiyuktasya vimānaṃ durgamaṃ sadā | āścaryaṃ tatra nāstyeva sarvaṃ yadātmakaṃ yataḥ ||91|| badrike ca tataḥ śrutvā ṣaṇḍhānāṃ divyadehatām | guptaṣaṇḍhāḥ striyaścāpi guptaṣaṇḍhā narā api ||92|| saṃhitāyāḥ sthalaṃ gatvā śaraṇāgatimāpnuvan | mantraṃ ca bhajanaṃ dhunyaṃ lomaśājjagṛhurmudā ||93|| pakṣaṃ pakṣaṃ ca te kṛtvā bhajanaṃ śravaṇaṃ tathā | dhyānaṃ sevāṃ pūjanaṃ ca prasādabhojanāśanam ||94|| bhūtvā pāpavihīnāśca śuddhātmāno vṛṣānvitāḥ | supuṇyāḍhyāguptaprāptendriyāste tāstato’bhavan ||95|| kecana śrīhariṃ dhyātvā muktā bhūtvākṣaraṃ yayuḥ | evaṃ ṣaṇḍhāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya kṛpayā kṣitau ||96|| satyanarāḥ satyanāryaḥ satyamuktāstathābhavan | satyamuktānikāścāpyabhavan śāśvatavigrahāḥ ||97|| aho kimatra duṣprāpaṃ yatra kṛṣṇakṛpālavaḥ | aho kathāyā māhātmyaṃ badrike pārameśvaram ||98|| sarvaṃ niṣpāpatāṃ prāptaṃ yathā mokṣātmakaṃ jagat | sarve videhamuktā vā jīvanmuktāstathāthavā ||99|| śarkarāpattane jātāḥ śrīsaṃhitākathāśravāt | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktimuktiḥ kare bhavet || 4.57.10 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śarkarāpuravāsināṃ ṣaṇḍhavrajādiṣaṇḍhānāṃ saṃhitāśravaṇena pāpanirmuktiḥ, śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadarśanena taireva dehairdivyamuktānikātmakairakṣarapadasya prāptiśca, tathānyaguptanapuṃsakānāṃ śaraṇāgatyā puṃstvastrītvādyabhivyañjakatā, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 57 ||
<4.58> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ pāpavināśinīm | karāñcanīpure tvabdhitaṭe sindhumukhe purā || 1 || yavasandhābhidhaḥ kaścid dhenukhādakaghātakī | nyavasanmāṃsamadirāmatsvādano’tihiṃsakaḥ || 2 || śaśān kapīn varāhām̐śca hariṇān vanapakṣiṇaḥ | yādāṃsi cāpi hiṃsitvā gavayājoraṇānapi || 3 || sakuṭumbaḥ pācayitvā vikrīṇāti ca khādati | evaṃ pāpasamācāraḥ sadā pāpaparāyaṇaḥ || 4 || kukkuṭādaḥ kukkuṭāṇḍarasabhakṣaṇakārakaḥ | bhraṣṭadeho bhraṣṭakarmā yavasandhīyajātijaḥ || 5 || yavasandhābhidho vārtāṃ śuśrāva nāvikānanāt | śarkarānagare tatra saṃhitāyāḥ kathā śubhā || 6 || jāyate mokṣadā sarvapāpānāṃ kṣālinī tviti | jāyante divyadehāśca śrotāro brahmalokagāḥ || 7 || sarvapāpāni bhagavān śaraṇyo bhaktavatsalaḥ | śaraṇāgatabhaktasya kṣamate’rpayate divam || 8 || hiṃsakā bahavastena tāritāḥ strīnarā api | tatrāste lomaśarṣiśca svataḥprakāśa īśitā || 9 || tathā santaḥ sādhavaśca sādhvyo viprarṣayo’pi ca | yeṣāṃ vai darśanāt prasevanāt prasādanāttathā || 4.58.1 0|| śāśvatī jāyate muktirvimānena gatiḥ parā | naitādṛśo hi samayaḥ punarasmān miliṣyati || 11 || pāpanāśakaraḥ śuddho’nāyāsamokṣaṇapradaḥ | yavasandho badrike saṃśuśrāvaitāṃ giraṃ śubhām ||1 2|| mumukṣāsyābhavattūrṇaṃ pāpanāśāya tatkṣaṇam | mayā pāpānyanantāni kṛtāni ghātanāni vai || 1 3|| teṣāṃ na syāddhi nistāro vinā divyajanāśrayam | ete naukādharāḥ sarve vadanti ṛtameva tat || 14|| prayāmi śarkarāpuryāmaghāni kṣapayāmi ca | yadi pāpavināśo me bahuhatyāghanāśanam || 15|| tadā tasmāduttamaṃ me kimatra pariśiṣyate | karmaṇāṃ cet kṛtānāṃ tu bhūmāvatra nivartanam || 16|| kimasmādaparaṃ sādhyaṃ kartavyaṃ me’vaśiṣyate | avaśyaṃ tatra gantavyaṃ prāṇamātraṃ tu yatra vai || 17|| avaśyaṃ tatra vastavyaṃ yatra syācchāntirātmanaḥ | avaśyaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ yatroptaṃ phaladaṃ bhavet || 18|| avaśyaṃ tatra suptavyaṃ yatra nirbhīkatā bhavet | avaśyaṃ tatra martavyaṃ yatrānandastu śāśvataḥ || 19|| yadi gacchāmi tatraiva saṃhitāyāḥ kathārthakaḥ | pāpanāśo bhavenme ced gantavyaṃ mokṣameva ha ||4.58.20|| punarāvartanaṃ naiva karāñcanīpuraṃ prati | rocate me pāpakarma naiva naiva ca naiva ca ||21|| kuṭumbasahito yāsye śarkarānagaraṃ prati | mahatyā naukayā yantragantryā yāsyāmi satvaram ||22|| vicāryetthaṃ yavasandhaḥ patnīṃ nāmnā majāvalīm | jagāda mānasaṃ sarvaṃ saṃkalpitaṃ śubhāvaham ||23|| sāpi dhanyaṃ nijabhāgyaṃ mene deśāvalokanam | puṇyāvalokanaṃ cāpi mahotsavapralokanam ||24|| mokṣāvalokanaṃ mene śreṣṭhaṃ hiṃsādyapekṣayā | badrike sā sammatābhūt putrāḥ putryastathāvidhāḥ ||25|| ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyāste kuṭumbino drutaṃ tataḥ | dhanaṃ dravyaṃ bhūṣaṇānyambarāṇi bhojanānyapi ||26|| gṛhayogyānyauṣadhāni veṣavārāṇi yānyapi | dehādisādhanakāni pātrāṇyāvaśyakāni ca ||27|| peṭikā copakaraṇaṃ śavayādyaṃ te samutsukāḥ | ninyire sarvamevāpi yogyaṃ yātrādi yaddhitam ||28|| naukayā yantravegābhigamayitryābdhitīrake | yayuragre sindhumukhe tato nadyāṃ tu naukayā ||29|| tayaiva sahasā sarve pratipūraṃ yayurmudā | prāpuḥ śrīśarkarābhūmiṃ snātvā sindhujale tu te ||4.58.30|| nītvopadāḥ prajagmuste kathāmaṇḍapamuttamam | śuśruvuste kathāṃ ramyāṃ sarvapātakanāśinīm ||3 1|| kathānte vācakaṃ sarve pupūjurvastubhiḥ śubhaiḥ | lomaśaṃ ca tathā sādhūn praṇemuste tataḥ param ||32|| prārthanāṃ cakrire pāpamokṣārthinīṃ śubhāvahām | lomaśaśca tadā tebhyo dadau śrībrahmakūrcakam ||33|| vrataṃ ca pañcagavyaṃ ca tathā śrīkṛṣṇanāma ca | mantraṃ dhunyaṃ bhajanaṃ ca dadau pādāmṛtaṃ tathā ||34|| prasādānnaṃ dadau tebhyaḥ pāpanāśanahetave | te’pi sarve’tibhāvena cakhadurannamuttamam ||35|| papurvāri vrataṃ cakruḥ kathāśravaṇamācaran | māsānte pāvanā jātāḥ sarve vigatakalmaṣāḥ ||36|| bhāvanānukūla eṣāmāyuṣyānto’bhavattathā | dvādaśyāṃ caitrakṛṣṇasya madhyāhne kṛtabhojanāḥ ||37|| sarve te tu niṣedurvai vāsagṛhāṃgaṇe tadā | akasmāccāgataṃ divyaṃ vimānamambarāt tataḥ ||38|| vimānataijasā spṛṣṭāḥ sarve mūrchāṃ prapedire | caturbhujo haristeṣāṃ gocaro’pi tadābhavat ||39|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīmādhavīśvaraḥ | tān kṛtvā divyadehām̐śca tyājayitvā śavāni ha ||4.58.40|| ninye vimānagān kṛtvā naijaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ śubham | āścaryaṃ paramaṃ dṛṣṭvā maharṣayo’pi vai tadā ||41|| praśasaṃsuḥ priyakṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dayānidhim | praśasaṃsuśca tān sarvān śaraṇāgatamānavān ||42|| mahāpāpān pāpaśūnyān śaśaṃsurbhaktisaṃbhṛtān | aho’saṃkhyāghakartṝṇāmapi śrībhagavānhariḥ ||43|| kṛpayā cānivartinyā karoti mokṣaṇaṃ param | dhanyo nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo dhanyāste mokṣabhāginaḥ ||44|| dhanyaṃ śārkaranagaraṃ kathā dhanyā pramuktidā | badrike evamevānye muktiṃ tatra hi lebhire ||45|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya cintanādaghamokṣaṇam | bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi tathā syācchāśvatī gatiḥ ||46|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne karāñcanīpurīsthasya sadāhatyākarasya yavasandhasya sakuṭumbasya saṃhitākathāśravaṇena mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 58 ||
<4.59> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ bhāṇḍasya mokṣadām | dvārāmṛte tu nagare’bhavad bhāṇḍaḥ kuṭumbavān || 1 || jñātivṛddho’timatimān hāsyanarmādipaṇḍitaḥ | rājotsaveṣu sarveṣu prajotsaveṣu cāpi saḥ || 2 || āmantritaḥ prayātyāśu rātrau khelaṃ karoti ca | gāyanaṃ narmapadyāni narmakarmāṇi vai tadā || 3 || kṛtvā pradarśya nṛpatīn hāsayatyeva tatprajāḥ | evaṃ sa kuśalaścāste prāpnoti pāritoṣikam || 4 || prasiddhaḥ so’bhavadbhūmau nāmnā tu bhaṇḍaśīlakaḥ | janebhyaḥ so’pi śuśrāva pārāyaṇamahotsavam || 5 || lakṣātilakṣalokānāṃ samājo yatra jāyate | kathā divyā bhavantyeva vinodāśca navā navāḥ || 6 || khelanāni bhavantyeva nūtnapradarśanānyapi | pāpanāśo bhavatyeva kathāśravaṇato’pi ca || 7 || satāṃ samāgamaścāpi darśanaṃ paramātmanaḥ | prajāyate prabhaktānāṃ camatkāro bhavatyapi || 8 || vimānaṃ śrīharestatra samāyāti suśobhanam | muktā bhūtvā janā yānti parameśapadaṃ param || 9 || narā nāryaḥ prayāntyeva dhāmākṣaraṃ hareriha | pāpānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tatra kāryate paramātmanā || 4.59.10 || evaṃ bhāṇḍān samastān vai kathayitvā harerbalam | svayaṃ samastabhāṇḍaiśca naranārīsamanvitaḥ || 1 1|| bālikābālayuktaśca vṛddhapūjyasamanvitaḥ | anobhiḥ sahitaḥ sarvaiḥ pātheyavastubhiḥ saha || 12|| paśvādivāhanairyuktaḥ sajjo bhūtvā samutsukaḥ | pratasthe śrīhariṃ dhyātvā natvā grāmasya devatām || 1 3|| dhanaṃ dānārthakaṃ cāpi bhūṣāvastrāmbarāṇyapi | iṣṭopakaraṇādyaṃ ca nītvā yayau kathāṃ prati || 14|| śarkarānagarābhyāśe snātvā sindhujale sa tu | sarvakuṭumbasahito mānavaistriśatairyutaḥ || 15|| rājodyāne vidhāyaiva vasatiṃ svāsthyamāptavān | pūjāsāmagrikāyukto vṛddhamānavasaṃyutaḥ ||1 6|| kathāmaṇḍapamabhyāgād vyāsapūjanahetave | saṃhitāyāḥ sthalaṃ gatvā natvā sabhājanānapi || 17|| jayamokṣapradakṛṣṇa vyāsajīva ciraṃ jaya | ṛṣayo vṛddhapūjyāśca jayatātra kṛpākarāḥ || 18|| jayantvime sādhavaśca śrotāro’pi jayantviha | yātrālavastīrthavāsā jayantu sarvadā bhuvi || 19|| viprāḥ sādhvyaḥ sādhavaśca jayantu mokṣakāriṇaḥ | ajñānapāpahartāro jayantu vaiṣṇavā janāḥ ||4.59.20|| ityevaṃ te vadanto vai cakrire daṇḍavanmuhuḥ | dhūliṃ sabhāsthalasyāpi dadhyuḥ śirassu varṣmasu || 21 || athājñāṃ vyāsadevasya labdhvā pūjārthamāyayuḥ | upadā vividhā nyasya puṣpahārām̐stilākṣatān ||22|| phalāni tāmbūlakāni nyadhuste saṃhitāpuraḥ | vyāsasya candanādyaiśca pūjāṃ pracakrire tataḥ ||23 || nīrājanaṃ vyadhuścāpi cakrustasya pradakṣiṇam | nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ cakrurbhāṇḍāḥ sarve subhāṇḍinaḥ ||24|| subhāṣayā hāsayanto janānnatvā sabhāntare | prasādaṃ ca jalaṃ pītvā niṣeduḥ śravaṇārthinaḥ ||25|| kathāṃ śrutvā jagṛhuste mantraṃ śrīlomaśānmuneḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||26|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa | bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāyaṇa ||27|| evaṃ dhunyaṃ dadau tebhyo nāmasaṃkīrtanāya vai | tataste svanivāsaṃ vai gatāḥ svasthā hariśritāḥ ||28|| nityaṃ kathāṃ praśṛṇvanti gāyanti gītikā hareḥ | ābālavṛddhāḥ sarve te sevante sādhuyoginaḥ ||29|| evaṃ nityaṃ tu yatsaṃgaṃ kṛtvā māso gato drutam | caitrakṛṣṇaikādaśikārātrau jāgaraṇaṃ vyadhuḥ ||4.59.30|| dvādaśyāṃ te kṛtasnānā kathāśravaṇataḥ param | sabhāyāmeva sahasā vyāsāsane’ti bhāsuram ||3 1 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīśaṃ hasantaṃ vilulokire | paśyatāṃ tu sadasyānāṃ vyāse prakāśake prabho ||32|| tiro’bhavaddharistūrṇaṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ramāviśat | āścaryaṃ paramaṃ tattu dṛṣṭvā śrīlomaśo muniḥ ||33 || bhāgyodayaṃ tu bhāṇḍānāmavocattatra saṃsadi | trayodaśyāṃ punaścaivaṃ kathottaraṃ prakāśanam || 34|| prasañjātaṃ caturdaśyāṃ tathaiva pārameśvaram | amāyāṃ tu prage bhāṇḍāḥ svāpnaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vyalokayan ||35 || vimānenākṣaraṃ dhāma prayāntītyabhyalokayan | tataḥ prasannacittāste brāhme protthāya satvaram ||36 || snātvā sajjā bahavo’pi bhūtvā kathāsthalaṃ yayuḥ | kathānte tu prakāśaṃ te vyājahruḥ svapnagocaram ||37|| lomaśastu samākarṇya prāhādya mokṣaṇaṃ tu vaḥ | sāyaṃ kathānte bhāvyaṃ vai sajjā bhavata muktaye ||38|| bhāṇḍāste’pi yathāyogyaṃ sajjā gantuṃ tato’bhavan | sāyaṃ kathānte bhagavān svāmīkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||39|| vimānenāyayau netuṃ kānakena suvarcasā | sajjān niṣkāsya dehebhyo divyadehān vidhāya ca ||4.59.40|| labdhvā divye vimāne tān yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ nijam | sārdhaśataṃ yayurmuktā muktānikāstu bhāṇḍakāḥ ||41 || brahmāṇḍabhāṇḍaṃ nirbhidya brahmabhāṇḍaṃ prapedire | aho dayā vicitrā vai śrīmādhavaparātmanaḥ ||42|| bhāṇḍānnītvā yayau kṛṣṇo lakṣmīpadmāvatīpatiḥ | athānye badrike śiṣṭā bhāṇḍāstadūrdhvadaihikam ||43|| cakrire singhutīre vai bhūtvā te vaiṣṇavāḥ parāḥ | kathāyāḥ śravaṇārthaṃ te vasatiṃ tatra cakrire ||44|| te’pi sevāṃ satāṃ nityaṃ sādhūnāṃ cakrire mudā | satīnāṃ brahmacārāṇāṃ yatīnāṃ sevanaṃ vyadhuḥ ||45|| niṣpāpāḥ samajāyanta sevāpūjanadarśanaiḥ | mahābhāgavatā jātā yeṣāṃ vaṃśāśca pāvanāḥ ||46 || narā nāryaḥ sādhubhaktāḥ sādhutulyāstato’bhavan | sarvārpaṇavidhāne’pi niḥsaṃśayātmavedinaḥ ||47|| badrike teṣu cāyuṣyakṣayo yeṣāṃ vyajāyata | te’pi divyena yānena śanairdhāmākṣaraṃ yayuḥ ||48|| anye bālā yuvānaśca yuvatyo bhejire harim | ājīvanaṃ kṛṣṇakāntaṃ śrīprabhuṃ mādhavīpatim ||49|| teṣāṃ yogena bahavo jñātibandhava ityapi | śrīkṛṣṇakāntabhaktāśca jātā yātāḥ paraṃ padam ||4.59.50|| badrike tatra cānyattu mahāścaryamabhūcchṛṇu | trigālavakuṭumbāni saṃghaśastatra phālgune ||51|| āsan samāgatānyeva mūlatantukapattanāt | bhavāyano’bhavatteṣāmagresaraḥ kalāvidām ||52|| veṣāṇāṃ dhāraṇe cānukaraṇe kuśalaḥ kṛtau | śikṣāprado’bhavatteṣāṃ gururbhavāyanaḥ svayam ||53|| bhavāyanasya yā śālā śubhā nāṭyakalāvidaḥ | tasyāmāsan śikṣaṇīyāḥ śiṣyāḥ pañcaśatāni vai ||54|| taiḥ sarvaiḥ sahitaḥ śrutvā mahimānaṃ hareḥ sa ca | āgato’bhūt kathāyāṃ vai śravaṇārthaṃ tathāparam ||55|| śrutamāścaryamevāpi parīkṣituṃ vilokitum | sindhutīre vane ramye ārāmavatsamasthite ||56|| vasatiṃ kṛtavān śreṣṭhāṃ bhavāyanakalāpinaḥ | athaikadā kathāṃ śrutvā rātrau khelaṃ pracakrire ||57|| tatra te darśayāmāsuḥ śṛṇu tad varṇayāmi te | brahmaṇastu purā jātaḥ kumāraḥ kṣutasaṃbhavaḥ ||58|| kṣupanāmākarottasya brahmā svayaṃ tu viśvasṛṭ | tasya mitraṃ dadhīcākhyo maharṣiścyavanātmajaḥ ||59|| sa provāca prasaṃgena dvayoḥ śraiṣṭhye vicārite | vipraḥ śreṣṭha iti śrutvā nṛpaḥ prāha tu bāhujaḥ ||4.59.60|| yato rājñi nivasanti dikpālā aṣṭasaṃkhyakāḥ | tato vai kṣatriyaḥ śreṣṭho mūrdhābhiṣiktadaivataḥ ||61 || śrutvaitadroṣamāpanno dadhīco vāmahastajām | muṣṭiṃ dṛḍhāṃ prāharadvai nṛpasyorasi nirbhayaḥ ||62|| rājā ruṣā tu khaṅgena śiraściccheda tatkṣaṇam | tato hatyā brahmahatyā prādurbhūtā bhayaṃkarī ||63|| kṣupaṃ vavalga sahasā mārayāmītyuvāca tam | yadvā jīvaya viprendraṃ sañjīvanyā sukhī bhava ||64|| śrutvā rājā prasasmāra śukrācāryaṃ sa āyayau | sañjīvanyā bhārgavaḥ sa śiraḥsandhānamācarat ||65|| dadhīco jīvanaṃ labdhavān sā hatyā vyalīyata | atha viprastapaścakre śaṃkarasyopari dhruvam ||66|| śaṃbhuḥ sākṣāt samāyāto dadau tatra varadvayam | avadhyatvamajeyatvaṃ stāṃ te dadhīca sarvadā ||67|| dadhīcaścādhikaṃ vavre vajrāsthitvaṃ tṛtīyakam | tathāstviti hara uktvāntardhāmaṃ prajagāma ha ||68|| ataḥ kālāntare viprakṣatrayormitrayoḥ punaḥ | śraiṣṭhyavāde prajāte svaṃ dadhīcaḥ śreṣṭhamāha vai ||69|| rājā śraiṣṭhyaṃ nijaṃ prāha tadā vipro ruṣā jvalan | vāmapādena nṛpatermūrdhni dṛḍhamatāḍayat ||4.59.70|| atha rājā purā kṛtvā bhaktimindrāt kulīśakam | prāptavān yat prajahāra tena viprasya vakṣasi ||71 || vajraṃ spṛṣṭvā papātaiva na prāvartata mṛtyave | vyarthaṃ vajraṃ vilokyaiva rājā roṣamavāptavān ||72|| utthāya prayayau pūjāgṛhaṃ viṣṇumatoṣayat | pratyakṣaṃ tvāgataṃ viṣṇuṃ rājā prāha varārthakaḥ ||73 || viṣṇo sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ dehi me vijayapradam | viṣṇustasmai pradāyaiva yayau vaikuṇṭhamacyutaḥ ||74|| atha rājā roṣayukto mumocāsya sudarśanam | dadhīcasya gale yāvattāvad dadhīca ulbaṇam ||75|| phutkāraṃ janayāmāsa sudarśanāyudhopari | sahasradhārāḥ sarvāstāḥ phutkāravahninā tadā ||76|| rasabhāvaṃ dravabhāvaṃ gatāścakraṃ prakuṇṭhitam | papāta sahasā bhūmau niṣphalaṃ lohapiṇḍakam ||77|| tadā kṣupo vivedāpi balaṃ viprasya vai mahat | athāpi roṣamāpanno viṣṇuṃ cārādhayatpunaḥ ||78|| viṣṇuḥ samāyayau rājā viṣṇuṃ prāha kṛtāñjaliḥ | dadhīcasya vināśaṃ tvaṃ kuru garvaharaṃ prabho ||79|| viṣṇustaṃ pratyuvācāpi viprahatyā bhayāvahā | na kartavyā kadācidvai rājan svārthahitaiṣiṇā ||4.59.80 || kintu taṃ saṃkathayāmi vivadasva nṛpeṇa mā | iti viṣṇurdadhīcaṃ tu śikṣādānāya cāyayau ||8 1 || dadhīcastaṃ prabhuṃ natvā ruṣā novāca kiñcana | atha viṣṇurnije dehe darśayāmāsa vai jagat ||82|| sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ rudraṃ dadhīcaṃ sthirajaṃgamam | tadā dadhīco haraye darśayāmāsa yogirāṭ ||83|| sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ sarvaṃ viṣṇuṃ nṛpaṃ svavarṣmaṇi | uvāca viṣṇuṃ ca tato mā māyāṃ me pradarśaya ||84|| nāhaṃ tayāpi mugdho’smi sadā vipraḥ samuttamaḥ | śreṣṭho vipraḥ sadā cāsti na kṣatraṃ garvasaṃbhṛtam ||85|| yāhi viṣṇo nijaṃ sthānaṃ labha janma punaḥ punaḥ | kṣatrapakṣagato yasmāt phalaṃ bhuṃkṣva mayoditam ||86|| sudarśanaṃ te galitaṃ punaḥ prāpnuhi tattathā | daityanāśārthamevāpi na viprasya vicchittaye ||87|| evaṃ śapto haristena dadhīcena mahātmanā | tato vipre tu bāṇena jayaṃ karoti mādhavaḥ ||88|| avatāreṣu sarveṣu daitye sudarśanena ca | atha kṣupo’bhavad bhakto dīkṣāvān sādhuruttamaḥ ||89|| sannyāsayogamāpanno vaiṣṇavottama uttamaḥ | tadā dadhīco vipro’pi sādhuṃ neme punaḥ punaḥ ||4.59.90|| uvāca viṣṇurūpo’si sādho śreṣṭhatamo’dhunā | ṛbhuḥ sanatkumāraśca kapilo dattavāmanau ||91|| parśurāmaśca sarve te vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaḥ parāḥ | parabrahmasvarūpāste viprāṇāṃ guravo’malāḥ ||92|| viprāṇāṃ sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ pūjyāste brahmagotriṇaḥ | varṇānāṃ guravo viprā viprāṇāṃ tu gururyatiḥ ||93|| sādhavaḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ guravaḥ śreṣṭhayoginaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sādhūn samarhati ||94|| evaṃ badrīpriye tatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | samāyayau divyarūpaḥ pupūja vyāsarūpiṇam ||95|| sādhuṃ nijaprakāśaṃ vai mahāviṣṇusvarūpiṇam | dadhīco’pi kṣupāyanābhidhaṃ santaṃ pupūja ha ||96|| evaṃ sādhau hariścāste sādhurūpa svaya hariḥ | nijaprakāśe tatraiva prabhuḥkṛṣṇastiro’bhavat ||97|| ityevaṃ nāṭakaṃ sarvaṃ darśayāmāsurutyukāḥ | bhavāyanasya śiṣyāste lakṣajanā vyalokayan ||98|| darśakāḥ sarva evaite prasannāḥ ṛṣayo’malāḥ | mānavāśca narā nāryaḥ prasannā vīkṣya nāṭakam ||99|| santaśca munayaḥ sarve sādhvyaśca sādhavo’pi ca | lomaśo’pi tathā vyāsaḥ prasannāste’bhavam̐stadā || 4.59.1 00|| varadānāya tānāhuste sarve varadānakam | pāpanāśaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ ca yayācire tu vācakāt || 10 1|| sadā loke ca naḥ syādvai nāṭakaṃ tu yaśaḥpradam | evaṃ tadvaṃśajānāṃ tu kṛte yayācire’pi ca || 1 02|| tathāstviti prāha tatra vyāsaḥ prakāśakṛt svayam | ṛṣayo’pi tathā prāhurjayakāro’bhavattadā || 1 03|| praśaśaṃsurnarā nāryaḥ kṛṣṇārthakṛtakhelanān | mokṣārthavarayācitṝn kṛtakṛtyān prabhupriyān || 1 04|| śrīlomaśājjagṛhuste mantraṃ ca nāmadhunyakam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svahā || 1 05|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa | bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāyaṇa || 1 06|| dhunyaṃ pracakrire premṇā sādhusevāṃ pracakrire | tataḥ pāpāni naṣṭāni vāsanā vilayaṃ gatā || 1 07|| caitrakṛṣṇāmāvāsyāyāṃ sāyaṃkāle hariḥ svayam | divyarūpo bālakṛṣṇo vimānena samāyayau || 1 08|| bhavāyanaṃ tathā vṛddhān kṛtvā tu divyavigrahān | ninye dhāmākṣaraṃ naijaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 09|| bhavāyanasya śiṣyā vai pare gṛhastharūpiṇaḥ | narā nāryaśca te sarve bhāvāyanā bhuvi śrutāḥ || 11 0|| abhavan pāvanā lokarañjakā khelakovidāḥ | vaiṣṇavāste’bhavan sarve’vaśiṣṭāḥ śarkarāpure || 11 1|| kathānte te yayunaijaṃ mūlatantukapattanam | trigālavāste sarve vai badrike ca tataḥ param || 11 2|| bhaktyā nārāyaṇaratā yāsyanti paramaṃ padam | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi || 1 13|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bhaṇḍaśīlākhyaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ sārdhaśatabhāṇḍasahitaṃ tathā bhavāyanatrigālavaṃ kṣupadadhīcanāṭyakāriṇaṃ bahubhiḥ sahitaṃ ca kathāśravaṇato harirmuktisthānamanayadityādi nirūpaṇanāmā navapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 59 ||
<4.60> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ mallapramokṣiṇīm | śrīkāranagare tvāsan mallāstadyuddhakovidāḥ || 1 || pañcāśatsaṃkhyakāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ kṛtābhyāsā dṛḍhāsthinaḥ | anye’pi
