mallavargasya kuṭumbino’bhavam̐stathā || 2 || narā nāryaśca te yānti nityaṃ kathāśravāya vai | śrutvā nityaṃ samāyānti gṛhāṇi varṇayanti ca || 3 || gṛhasthebhyaḥ kathāṃ divyāṃ śrutāṃ yāṃ mokṣakāriṇīm | tathā vadanti dṛṣṭaṃ yaṃ camatkāraṃ vimānajam || 4 || ye ye mokṣaṃ prayāntyeva tāṃ tāṃ vārtāṃ vadantyapi | tato mallāḥ prasannāśca kathāsthalīṃ yayurdṛḍhāḥ || 5 || bahubhiḥ svajanaiḥ sākaṃ maṇḍapāntamupasthitāḥ | kathānte te mallayuddhaṃ mahāścaryakaraṃ vyadhuḥ || 6 || lomaśastu prasannaḥ san mantraṃ tebhyo dadau mudā | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||7 || nāmasaṃkīrtanārthaṃ ca bhajanaṃ pradadau tadā | prabhonārāyaṇasvāminārāyaṇa narāyaṇa || 8 || anādimādhavīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāyaṇa | mallāste sakuṭumbā vai bhajanaṃ cakrire sadā || 9 || kathāśravaṇamevāpi nityaṃ nityaṃ pracakrire | satāṃ sevāṃ vyadhuḥ premṇā pūjanaṃ vācakasya ca || 4.60.1 0|| ārārtrikaṃ saṃhitāyāścakrire dharmamānasāḥ | dānāni svarṇaratnānāṃ bhūṣāpātrānnavāsasām || 11 || cakrire mudrikāṇāṃ ca gavāṃ dānāni cakrire | bhejuḥ śrīparamātmānaṃ śuśravuḥ saṃhitākathām || 1 2|| pavitrāste prajātā vai niṣpāpā vāsanojjhitāḥ | muktiyogyāstu ye jātā vṛddhā nāryo narā api || 1 3|| teṣāmagresarā nāmnā harivaryo gajakramaḥ | śatavājaḥ siṃhamardaḥ śarabhārdaḥ kaserukaḥ || 14|| drumabhañjo vaṃśavāraḥ śilādo lohapeṣaṇaḥ | ityevamādyāścānye’pi kṛtakṛtyā nirāśayāḥ || 15|| pradagdhavāsanā jātā nāryo’pi vṛddhayoṣitaḥ | pratīkṣante tu muktyarthaṃ savimānāgamaṃ hareḥ || 1 6|| sāyaṃ caitrāmāvāsyāyāṃ kathānte kṛtapūjanāḥ | sajjā ye cābhavan tāṃstu netuṃ kṛṣṇa upāyayau || 17|| divyavimānasahito divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ | śriyā lakṣmyā padmayā ca ramayā saha tejasā || 18|| prakāśayan diśo harirhasan mallānuvāca ha | mokṣayogyā bhavanto vai mokṣapuṇyābhibhāginaḥ || 19|| vihāya bhautikāndehānārohantu vimānakam | ityuktā mallabhaktāste ye sajjā gantumakṣaram ||4.60.20|| narā nāryaśca te dehān vihāya divyamūrtayaḥ | bhūtvā kṛṣṇecchayā tūrṇamāruruhurvimānakam ||21 || sarvā muktānikā muktā divyātmānaḥ surūpiṇaḥ | bhūtvā śrīkṛṣṇadāsāśca jayaśabdān pracakrire |||22|| tānnītvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo badrīśvari nijam | dhāmākṣaraṃ yayau vyomnā sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ satām || 23 || teṣāṃ dehānapare tu śiṣṭā mallakuṭumbinaḥ | nītvā pradāhayāmāsuścordhvadaihikamācaran ||24|| camatkāro mahām̐ścāyaṃ prasasārātivegataḥ | deśe grāmeṣu mallānāṃ mokṣātmako’timānavaḥ ||25|| śṛṇu badrīpriye devi camatkāraṃ tathāparam | vārdhūṣikāśca godhādā lūṇīnagaravāsinaḥ ||26||| dantadhāvanavikretāraśca kuṭumbinastadā | śrutavanto mānuṣebhyaḥ praśaṃsāṃ paramātmanaḥ ||27|| kathāyāśca camatkāraṃ pāpināṃ pāpanāśanam | mokṣaṃ divyavimānena yānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇadarśanam ||28|| tena prajātajijñāsā narā nāryaśca saṃhitām | śrotuṃ kṛtādarāḥ sajjā babhūvurvṛddhasaṃhitāḥ| ||29|| bālāśca bālikāścāpi śataṃ te mānavāḥ sukham | vṛṣabhairnijasāmagrīrnīyamānāḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||4.60.3 0|| vāghgharayaḥ śraukṛṣṇaṃ śrīnārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram | smarantaḥ prayayuḥ sindhujale sasnustato drutam ||3 1|| bhakṣayitvā tu pātheyaṃ prayayurmaṇḍapāntikam | udyāne vṛṣabhāvāsaṃ cakrire taruṣaṇḍake ||32|| tataḥ śrotuṃ kathāṃ nītvā pūjāsāmagrikāḥ śubhāḥ | vyāsāsanaṃ kathāsthānaṃ yayurbhāvabharāśca te || 33|| pupūjuḥ parayā bhaktyā bhāvaprakāśavācakam | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāṃ pupūjuḥ samāhitāḥ ||34|| upadā phalapuṣpāṇi svarṇamudrāḥ puro nyadhuḥ | vastrabhūṣāmālikāśca maṇihārān dadustathā ||35|| guñjāhārān puṣpahārānakṣatān nidadhuḥ puraḥ | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ kuṃkumāgurucandanam || 36|| samarpyārārtrikaṃ cakruḥ sarve cakruśca daṇḍavat | dakṣiṇāṃ rūpyamudrāśca puro nyadhustataḥ kathām ||37|| śaśruvurbhāvataścāpi pupūjurlomaśaṃ munim | satāṃ sevāmāśrameṣu gatvā cakruraharniśam ||38|| evaṃ vārdhūṣikāḥ sarve kathāsevāvidhānataḥ | gatapāpā viśuddhāścābhavan tebhyastu lomaśaḥ ||39|| mantraṃ saṃśrāvayāmāsa nāmadhunyaṃ dadau tathā | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||4.60.40|| prabhonārāyaṇasvāminmālatīnrāyaṇaprabho | jayākṛṣṇalalitānrāyaṇarādhāpate vibho ||41 || prāpya mantraṃ nāmadhunyaṃ jepuścakruḥ sadā prage | sāyaṃ tvevaṃ kathāṃ śrutvā jepuścakruḥ samāgatāḥ |||42| nityaṃ cānāyya dadati dantadhāvanakānyapi | barburādidrumāṇāṃ vā kṣīravatāṃ suśākhinām ||43|| tanuśākhāntalabhyāni mṛdūni surasāni ca | evaṃ gatvā pārśvavane tvānayanti madhūnyapi ||44|| samarpayanti sādhubhyo vācakāya maharṣaye | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyāpi pūjārthamarpayantyapi ||45|| ānayanti ca samidhaḥ kāṣṭhāni dhunihetave | mṛttikāṃ cānayantyatra sevante sādhuyoginaḥ ||46|| evaṃ sarve kroṣṭṛvyādhā vaiṣṇavāḥ sevayābhavan | pāvanāḥ pāpahīnāśca kathāśrutervivāsanāḥ ||47|| māsānte śrīprabhurnārāyaṇaḥ śrīmādhavīśvaraḥ | kṛṣṇaḥ prasannasteṣāṃ vai svapne sākṣāttadābhavat ||48|| caturbhujaḥ śrīsahitaḥ kṛtasevādivastuyuk | hasan divyasvarūpaśca sahasrasūryabhāyutaḥ ||49|| kṣaṇāttiro’bhavaccāpi tataste prātareva ha | utthāya tūrṇaṃ saṃsnātvā prasannā lomaśaṃ yayuḥ ||4.60.50|| pūjayitvā tu vṛttāntaṃ svāpnaṃ nyavedayanmudā | lomaśo’pi samākarṇya prāha kroṣṭṛhaṇaḥ śubham ||51|| yuṣmākaṃ pātakaṃ naṣṭaṃ puṇyamabhyuditaṃ bahu | devānāṃ durlabhaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanaṃ va upasthitam ||52|| yūyaṃ yogyā mokṣapade netuṃ vitta hi sarvathā | bhagavān śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo neṣyati vastataḥ ||53|| sajjā bhavata vṛddhādyā ye vāñcchantyakṣaraṃ padam | nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ lakṣmīpatiḥ samāgamiṣyati ||54|| ityuktāste vāghgharayo’bhavan sajjāstu muktaye | vṛddhā nāryo narāścāpi pratīkṣante tadāgamam ||55|| caitrakṛṣṇāmāvāsyāyā rātryante pratipaddine | prātareva samāyātaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||56|| caitraśuklādyadivase śuklātiśuklarūpavān | ujjvalaḥ śrīsahitaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||57|| sarvabhūṣāprabhūṣitaḥ sarvathā saumya īśitā | vimānena drutaṃ cāvātarat pṛthvyāṃ puraḥkṣitau ||58|| āścaryaṃ paramaṃ jātaṃ samujjvalaṃ tadāmbaram | jayanādāḥ surāṇāṃ ca puṣpavṛṣṭirdivaukasām ||59|| abhavan paritastatra kroṣṭṛhantṝnuvāca saḥ | āyāta saṃprasanno’smi bhaktyā kathāśraveṇa ca ||4.60.60|| sādhūnāṃ sevayā cāpi mannāmakīrtanena ca | pāvanāḥ sthaḥ samāyāta vimānaṃ mokṣanetṛ me ||61 || śrutvā tu badrike ye ye sajjā gantuṃ paraṃ padam | abhavam̐ste drutaṃ dehām̐styaktvā tatra hi bhautikān ||62|| vimānaṃ te divyadehā bhūtvāruruhurutsukāḥ | harṣalālādināmāno natvā śrīpatimīśvaram ||63|| śriyaṃ natvā narā nāryo muktā muktānikāstadā | śrīkṛṣṇena praṇītāste yayurbrahmākṣaraṃ padam ||64|| sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ badri paraṃ mokṣaṃ yayurhi te | kṛpayā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ca kathābalāt |||65||| athānyatte kathayāmi mahāścaryaṃ tadā tathā | śṛṇu badrīpriye devi śṛṇvatāṃ pāpanāśakam ||66|| kaścinmṛgayurabhavat sindhuvane kuṭumbavān | dṛṣṭavānambare tejaḥ prātareva vimānakam ||67|| mumude vīkṣya sahasā kuṭumbena samanvitaḥ | tasyābhavattato buddhiḥ śuddhā mokṣābhigāminī ||68|| hiṃsāṃ vihāya pāpānāṃ nāśārthaṃ sakuṭumbakaḥ | kathāsthalaṃ yayau tatra pupūja lomaśaṃ munim ||69|| nyavedayat svavṛttāntaṃ pāpanāśanahetukam | kathāṃ śrotuṃ tathā mantraṃ cāptuṃ gantuṃ paraṃ padam ||4.60.70|| lomaśastaṃ kīravaṇaṃ mṛgayuṃ prāha vai vratam | snānaṃ prapūjanaṃ mālāvartanaṃ sevanaṃ satām ||71|| nityaṃ kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ kamalāpateḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||72|| dadau mantraṃ hareḥ pādavāryamṛtaṃ dadau tathā | prasādaṃ ca dadau brahmakūrcaṃ vrataṃ dadau tataḥ ||73|| kīravaṇādayaḥ sarve kuṭumbino vyadhurvratam | bhajanaṃ sevanaṃ kathāśravaṇaṃ raṭanaṃ sadā ||74|| evaṃ māse gate sākṣāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | āyayau sādhurūpo vai drutaṃ kīravaṇaṃ prati ||75|| bhikṣāṃ yayāce sahasā phalapuṣpādibhojanām | pātrāmbarādirūpā ca nāryarpaṇātmikāmapi ||76|| prasannaḥ sa kīravaṇo vīkṣya sādhuṃ samujjvalam | nārāyaṇaṃ vicintyaiva dadau nārīṃ phalādikam ||77|| niḥsaṃśayaṃ nijaṃ bhaktaṃ bhaktāṃ parīkṣya mādhavaḥ | sādhurūpādāvirāsa viṣṇurūpaścaturbhujaḥ ||78|| prāptvā phalaṃ prapasparśa nārīṃ naraṃ kuṭumbakam | dakṣakareṇa bhagavān tāvat kīravaṇādayaḥ ||79|| divyadehā drutaṃ jātā divyarūpāḍhyamūrtayaḥ | viṣṇurnārāyaṇastām̐śca sarvasvadānakāriṇaḥ ||4.60.80|| śaraṇāgatabhaktān vai vimānena suvarcasā | anayad brahmalokaṃ vai paśyatāṃ dehadhāriṇām ||81 || badrike sā kṛpā svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai | mṛgayuṃ tvanayat kṛṣṇo yannijaṃ dhāma cākṣaram ||82|| śrībadrīpriyovācakathaṃ vai bhagavannārāyaṇa viṣṇo jagatpate | hiṃsakasyābhavad vyomni vimānasyāsya darśanam ||83|| śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca badrīpriye vane nityaṃ sādhusevāparaḥ sa hi | phalapuṣpādibhiścāpi viśrāntisaṃpradānakaḥ ||84|| satāṃ pādādisaṃvāhasevākṛt sakuṭumbakaḥ | nārāyaṇamprabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ japan satsaṃgakārakaḥ ||85|| tena yogena deveśi nirmalātmā supuṇyavān | tyaktamṛgayādharmaḥ sa paścakālādavartata ||86|| evamāsīt puṇyaśālī sādhubhakto’tibhāvavān | tato’sya śrīvimānasya darśanaṃ tvabhavattadā ||87|| badrike ye bhāgavatāste tu kṛṣṇapratāpinaḥ | divyadṛṣṭayaḥ paśyanti divyaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vimānakam ||88|| ye pāpā doṣabhṛddehā doṣātmānaśca doṣiṇaḥ | nāstikā bhaktihīnāśca satāṃ vidveṣiṇastathā ||89|| teṣāṃ naivāsti nistārasteṣāṃ na divyadarśanam | teṣāṃ na yogaḥ subhago mokṣadaḥ svargado’pi vā ||4.60.90|| api satsaṃgapārśve ye vasanto’pi tu nāstikāḥ | teṣāṃ satsaṃgalābho na na puṇyaṃ naiva mokṣaṇam ||91 || api dūre vasanto ye snehavanto harau sati | satsu tādātmyahṛdayāsteṣāṃ puṇyaṃ ca mokṣaṇam ||92|| badrike bāhyasadbhiśca sahāntarikasādhavaḥ | melanīyāḥ prayatnena tadā muktiḥ kare sthitā || 13|| bāhyato na satāṃ yogaścāntare viṣayānvitaḥ | tādṛk satsaṃgahīnasya na svargaṃ na parā gatiḥ ||94|| badrike vai jagat sarvaṃ māyāvikṛtiśobhanam | antarnagnaṃ bahiśchannaṃ gārhasthyaṃ sutarāṃ tathā || 95|| sadā viṣayacittātma sadā bhogaparāyaṇam | barhiḥ suveṣamapi tannagnaṃ na yāti mokṣaṇam || 96|| badrike sādhavaḥ śāntā jitendriyā harau sthirāḥ | antarviṣayahīnāśca bahirdigvāsaso’pi ca || 97|| brahmaguṇairdivyavastraiśchannā vibhūṣitāstu te | avikṛtā akāmāśca vāsanāviṣavarjitāḥ ||98|| strīpuṃbhānavihīnāste suveṣāḥ sādhavo matāḥ | teṣāṃ yogena pāpānāṃ vināśo brahmadarśanam ||99|| ātmanā divyatāprāptiraiśvaryāṇāṃ samarjanam | mokṣaprāptirhareḥ prāptiḥ satāṃ yogena jāyate || 4.60.100|| kālanāśastathā māyānāśaḥ karmavināśanam | bandhanāśo vāsanānāṃ kṣayaḥ sadyogato bhavet || 10 1 || evaṃ mṛgayuścāraṇye sādhusevāparāyaṇaḥ | bījabalavān kṛṣṇasya vimānaṃ samalokayat || 1 02|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya svargo muktirbhavedapi | bhuktiḥ syāttu sakāmānāṃ sādhusaṃgāddhi mokṣaṇam ||1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne harivīryādimallānāṃ, harṣalālādimṛgayūṇāṃ, kīravaṇādivyādhānāṃ ca kathāśravaṇādito mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 60 ||
<4.61> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi līnakṣāranivāsinaḥ | nāgādasya kathāṃ cāpi pāpatāpapraṇāśinīm || 1 || līnakṣāre tu nagare nāgakhelakaraḥ sadā | sarpapālo’bhavad vādī nāgādanāmakaḥ khalu || 2 || vādikuṭumbakaṃ tatra vartate sarpapālakam | nakulānāṃ ca sarpāṇāṃ śīlānāṃ yuddhadarśakam || 3 || āraṇyakapaśūnāṃ ca sarīsṛpāṇāṃ pālakam | vānarāṇāṃ ca ṛkṣāṇāṃ kukkuṭānāṃ ca pālakam || 4 || paśūnādāya rāṣṭreṣu rāṣṭrāntareṣu yāti hi | paśupakṣisarīsṛpakhelanairjīvavṛttikām || 5 || utpādya nirvahatyeva grāme grāme bhramatyapi | pakṣipaśūn bhakṣayati paśuvad vartate’pi ca || 6 || poṣaṇārthaṃ bhramattadvai kuṭumbaṃ śarkarāpuram | āyayau tat sindhutaṭe vṛkṣaṣaṇḍe samīpataḥ || 7 || maṇḍapānnātidūre ca kathāśabdābhisāriṇi | sthale vāsaṃ vidhāyaiva tasthau jīvanahetave || 8 || mānavānāṃ tu sammarde khelaṃ darśayati prage | madhyāhne ca tathā sāyaṃ janā dadati bhojanam || 9 || annaṃ vastraṃ ca piṣṭaṃ cākṣatān vastrāṇi dugdhakam | śarkarāṃ ca guḍaṃ śākaṃ pātraṃ phalaṃ dalādikam || 4.61.1 0|| ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ cekṣudaṇḍaṃ ghāsaṃ kaṇān supolikāḥ | roṭakān caṇakān bhakṣyaṃ dadatyeva dayāvaśāḥ ||1 1|| nāgādanādayaste’pi vādiṭāḥ sarpakīśayoḥ | sarpanakulayoścāpi pradarśya khelanaṃ muhuḥ || 12|| lokān prarañjayantyeva vṛttinirvāhahetave | athaivaṃ khelanaṃ kṛtvā yathākāle kathārthinaḥ || 13|| vādiṭāste kathāṃ śrotuṃ sāyamāyānti nityaśaḥ | pūjanaṃ vyāsadevasya saṃhitāyāśca pūjanam || 14|| sādhūnāṃ lomaśādeśca kurvanta pūjanaṃ śubham | upadāścārpayantyeva phalapuṣpāmbarādikam || 16|| ekadā svapaśūnāṃ te sabhārañjanahetave | vyadhuḥ khelaṃ sabhāraṃge satāṃ prasannatāptaye || 16|| bhallukānāṃ ca ṛkṣāṇāṃ kīśānāṃ vṛścikasya ca | kukkuṭānāṃ bhogināṃ ca nakulānāṃ ca meṣayoḥ || 17|| rañjitāḥ khelanaiḥ santaḥ prasādaṃ te dadustadā | miṣṭānnāni bhojanāni phalāni piṣṭakāni ca | |18|| śarkarāśca payaḥ sūpaudanāni bhājikāstathā | polikāḥ pūrikāścāpi śaṣkulīlaḍḍukānapi || 19|| pāyasānnamapūpāni śākānyuccāvacāni ca | randhitānnāni caṇakān saṃskṛtān pācitān śṛtām | |4.61.20|| caṭanīṃ dadhidugdhāni takrāṇi kṛsarāṇi ca | mahābhojyāni sarvāṇi vādiṭebhyastu sādhavaḥ ||21 || daduḥ prasādarūpāṇi paśubhyo’pi śubhāni ca | prasādānnāni sarvāṇi daduḥ payāṃsi yāni ca ||22|| hareḥ pādāmṛtaṃ vāri dadustebhyo dayānvitāḥ | bubhujuste hṛṣṭacittā vādiṭāḥ sarvaśastadā ||23|| paśavo’pi prasādena tṛptāḥ kiṃ vādiṭāḥ punaḥ | pāvanāḥ pāpaśūnyāste’bhavan prasādabhojanāt || 24|| kathānāṃ śravaṇaiścāpi sattvacittāstato’bhavan | mokṣārthamarthayāmāsurlomaśaṃ śreyase muhuḥ ||25|| lomaśaḥ pradadau tebhyo mantraṃ nāma harerapi | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||26|| prabhonārāyaṇasvāminmādhavīnrāyaṇaprabho | jayākṛṣṇalalitānrāyaṇarādhāpate vibho ||27|| athaivaṃ prāpya mantraṃ te nāmadhunyaṃ pramuktidam | vaiṣṇavāḥ paramā jātāścakruste bhajanaṃ hareḥ ||28|| māsānte pāvanānāṃ vai prasannaḥ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ | caitrasyaiva śvetapakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ śriyaḥ patiḥ ||29|| bhagavānāyayau teṣāṃ śreyase savimānakaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇasvāmī vallabho hi mahāprabhuḥ ||4.61.3 0|| vimānāt sahasā sāyaṃ cāvātarat sabhāsthale | kathottaraṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo jagāda vādiṭān hitam ||3 1 || āyāta vādiṭā yūyaṃ mokṣārthaṃ madvimānake | ye sajjāstviha mokṣārthaṃ teṣāṃ karomi mokṣaṇam ||32|| kṛpayā cāgatastvatra vo dadāmi kathāphalam | ityuktā mohamāpannāḥ svāminikṛṣṇamādhave ||33|| vādiṭāścābālavṛddhāḥ pañcāśannarayoṣitaḥ | śatena sahitāḥ pakṣipaśuvṛścikabhoginām || 34|| anyaiśca paśubhiḥ sarvaiḥ sahitāḥ śreya ārthayan | prāhuḥ śrīparamātmānaṃ paśvādyā bālakā hi naḥ ||35|| tān vihāya kathaṃ kṛṣṇa yāsyāmaḥ śreyase vayam | tān samuddhara bhagavan śaraṇāgatavatsala ||36|| eteṣāṃ na bhavenmuktiḥ pratyakṣaṃ māpatiṃ vinā | tiryagyonigatānāṃ vai tatastvaṃ tān samuddhara | |37|| ityarthito hi bhagavānnanādiśrīnarāyaṇaḥ | vādiṭaiḥ saha paśvādīn jalena prokṣya tatkṣaṇam ||38|| divyadehān vidhāyaiva muktarūpān caturbhujān | devākṛtīn samastām̐stān vimāne nyasya yāvataḥ ||39|| sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ ninye dhāmākṣaraṃ nijaṃ hariḥ | nāgādanādayaḥ sarve kṛpayā sevayā śruteḥ ||4.61.40 || yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ badri bhaktyā prapattirūpayā | jayakāro’bhavattatra mahotsavo vyavartata ||41|| athānyaṃ ca camatkāraṃ śṛṇu badrīpriye tathā | ārśaphalākhyanagarācchrutvā kathāmahotsavam ||42|| āyayurvyāyāmakhelakuśalā dve śate narāḥ | nāryaścāpi ca khelinyaḥ siṃhādyāḥ paśavo gajāḥ ||43|| vājinaḥ śarabhā bhallukā dvipā gavayāḥ kharāḥ | sārahāsyavidaḥ sarve vyomarajjvādidolinaḥ ||44|| vajrakāryavido nirālamboḍḍayanavedinaḥ | mahābalā narā nāryo dehakauśalyadarśinaḥ ||45|| udyāne te nivāsaṃ vai cakruḥ khelaparāyaṇāḥ | nityaṃ rātrau sukhelāni kurvanti kārayantyapi ||46|| ekadā te vinā mūlyaṃ khelanāni vyadhurniśi | satāṃ kathārthināṃ cāpi mānavānāṃ pradṛṣṭaye ||47|| raṃgastatra hi bhaktānāṃ prabhaktānāṃ mahānabhūt | lakṣaśo mānavā draṣṭuṃ samāyātāstadā niśi ||48|| gajānāṃ vājināṃ cāpi siṃhānāṃ khelanānyapi | kṛtavantaśca te sārahāsyamaṇḍalikā narāḥ ||49|| nārīṇāṃ gītakāryāṇi nartanāni vyadhuḥ striyaḥ | paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ yāni khelanāni vyadhuśca te ||4.61.50|| vyomoḍḍayanarūpāṇi vahnikāryāṇi yānyapi | yantrakhelāni hṛdyāni cakrire mānavādayaḥ ||51 || prasannāstāni saṃvīkṣya vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavo’pare | narā nāryaḥ prasannāśca sañjātāḥ khelalokanaiḥ ||52|| upadā khelakebhyaśca daduḥ śrīvaiṣṇavā janāḥ | nṛpāḥ prajāḥ śreṣṭhinaśca dhanāni bahudhā daduḥ ||53|| khelānte sādhavastebhyo mokṣāśiṣo daduḥ śubhāḥ | svataḥprakāśo bhagavān prasādaṃ bahuśobhanam ||54|| bhojanaṃ pradadau tebhyo miṣṭānnaṃ caraṇāmṛtam | bhuktvā te pāvanā jātā mānavāḥ paśupakṣiṇaḥ ||55|| prātaḥ snātvā ca te nadyā jale śrīlomaśaṃ yayuḥ | kathāsthānaṃ pūjanārthaṃ vyāsasya pustakasya ca ||56|| prātaḥ prapūjanaṃ cakrurbahubhirvastubhiśca te | upadāśca puro dhṛtvā candanādyairapūjayan |||57||| prārthayan śreyase te’pi kathāśravaṇapāvitāḥ | lomaśastatra sarvebhyo manuṃ nāma dadau mudā ||98|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | prabhonārāyaṇasvāminmādhavīnrārāyaṇaprabho ||99|| jayākṛṣṇalalitānrāyaṇarādhāpate vibho | evaṃ mantraṃ nāmadhunyaṃ dadau śrīlomaśo muniḥ ||4.61.60|| te sarve sārahāsasthā jepurmantraṃ vidhānavat | nāmadhunyaṃ pracakruśca mokṣārthaṃ kṛtaniścayāḥ ||61 || sevāṃ satāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ sādhvīnāṃ cakrire mudā | kathāṃ nityaṃ śuśruvuste dānadharmaparāyaṇāḥ ||62|| nityaṃ te bhajanaṃ cakruḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhoḥ | māsānte pāvanānāṃ tu mokṣadātā narāyaṇaḥ ||63|| mahāvimānamādāya sūryabhāsaṃ suvarṇajam | lakṣmyā śriyā prajñayā padmayā muktairyutaṃ śubham ||64|| āyayau maṇḍapodyānamadhyadeśe hyavātarat | vimānaṃ tatsūryatulyaṃ vyalokayan prajājanāḥ ||65|| sāyāhne vai caitraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ drutaṃ janāḥ | mahāścaryaparāstatra kathānte’bhita āyayuḥ ||66|| cakruste darśanaṃ svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai | sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sārahāsasya mānavān ||67|| narānnārīḥ prāvadadvai tvāyāntvatra vimānake | bhavanmokṣāyāṣṭhagato’smi samārohantu satvaram || 68|| ye vāñchanti paraṃ mokṣaṃ te tvāyāntu vimānake | ityuktā badrike sārahāsamaṇḍalino janāḥ ||69|| narā nāryo bālikāśca bālā vṛddhāstathāpare | yuvānaśca vimalā ye gatamohā nirañjanāḥ ||4.61.70|| nirdagdhavāsanā ye ca kathāśravaṇapāvitāḥ | sajjā gantumabhavan ye vairāgyavegaśālinaḥ ||71|| te sarve tvaritāścāsan samutsukā hi muktaye | cakrurhalahalāśabdān vimānaṃ prati dudruvuḥ ||72|| pārvaṇena kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapādajalena tān | saṃprokṣya divyadehān vai kṛtvā tatraiva tatkṣaṇam ||73|| divyoḍḍayanaśaktām̐śca kṛtvā dhṛtvā vimānake | dehaistaireva ṣoḍaśavarṣān vidhāya mādhavaḥ ||74|| mānavānāṃ śataṃ cāpi nītvā dhāmākṣaraṃ yayau | śataṃ tatrāvaśiṣṭāśca paśupakṣisamanvitāḥ ||75|| mahāścaryaparāste’pi bhajanaṃ cakrurādarāt | te’pi paścājjātavegā mokṣārthaṃ niścayaṃ vyadhuḥ ||76|| kīrtanaṃ nityamevaite cakrurvai bhaktibhāvataḥ | dadhyurnārāyaṇakṛṣṇaṃ tanmānasāśca tatparāḥ ||77|| satāṃ sevāṃ pracakruśca viśeṣataḥ samarpitāḥ | kathāśravaṇaṃ cakruśca nityaṃ nityamatandritāḥ ||78|| prārthanāṃ te’pi mokṣārthaṃ cakruḥ śrīlomaśāgrataḥ | tathāstviti prāha ṛṣiścāśīrvādān dadau tataḥ ||79|| caitrasya śuklaikādaśyāṃ prātasteṣāṃ janārdanaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo viṣṇurmokṣārthaṃ samupāgataḥ ||4.61.80|| badrike te kṛtasnānā kṛtārhaṇāḥ sabhāsthalam | āyāyustatra vai śrutvā kathāṃ tiṣṭhanti yāvatā ||8 1|| tāvadvimānamākāśādavātarat suvarṇajam | divyaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇena vāhitaṃ suviśālakam ||82|| sarveṣāṃ gocaraṃ ramyaṃ tasmāt kṛṣṇo bahirmudā | āgatya sārahāsasthānavaśiṣṭān hi mānavān ||83|| hariḥ prāha samāyāntu mokṣapadaṃ nayāmyaham | sārahāsasyāgranetā nāmnā mārtaṇḍamaṇḍalaḥ ||84|| yo vai mokṣaṃ gataḥ pūrvaṃ tasya putro’rkamaṇḍalaḥ | tūrṇaṃ kare jalaṃ gṛhya saṃkalpaṃ pra vyadhānmudā |||85|| yaddhanaṃ copakaraṇānyuccāvacāni yāni ca | vāhanāni ca yānāni vastrabhūṣāsamṛddhayaḥ ||86|| sārahāsīyakaṃ sarvaṃ dhanādi vividharddhikam | atra sthitaṃ tvarpayāmi pārāyaṇārthamatra yat ||87|| jīvatpaśūn pakṣigaṇān sarīsṛpādikānapi | asmābhiḥ saha śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo nayatvapi ||88|| mokṣapadaṃ prayāntyeva pañcādyā api ye’tra ha | mānavāśca narā nāryo bālāśca bālikā api ||89|| divyadehā vimānena prayāntvakṣaradhāma te | śṛṇvatāṃ vai sadasyānāṃ jalaṃ mumoca vai kṣitau ||90 || tāvacchrīkṛṣṇabhagavān jalaṃ cikṣepa teṣu tu | jalasparśena sahasā divyadehāḥ samujjvalāḥ ||4.61.9 1 || sārahāsajanā āsan divyāśca divyavigrahāḥ | paśvādyāśca sthitā vāse mṛtāste paśuvigrahāḥ ||92|| divyadehā abhavam̐śca devatulyāḥ samastataḥ | āruruhurvimānaṃ te sarve vai muktavigrahāḥ ||93|| narā nāryaśca paśvādyāḥ sārahāsagatāstu ye | sarve vimānamārūḍhāḥ śrīkṛṣṇājñāvaśāstadā ||94|| jayaśabdaṃ nāmadhunyaṃ vimāne te pracakrire | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇanītā yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ ||95|| badrike jayaśabdāśca tadāsan sarvato hyati | puṣpāṇāṃ vṛṣṭayastatra divyānāmabhavan śubhāḥ ||96|| candanānāṃ vṛṣṭayaścābhavan meghapathaścyutāḥ | satāṃ sevāphalaṃ mantranāmajāpaphalaṃ tathā ||97|| kathāśravaṇajanyaṃ ca phalaṃ śraddhāsamanvitam | badrike sārahāsasya maṇḍalasya prajīvinām ||98|| prāptaṃ kṛpātmakaṃ cāpi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ha | kṛṣṇasya kṛpayā sarve muktiṃ yayuḥ parākṣare ||99|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇādapi mokṣabhāg | sarveṣṭasiddhiratyarthā sammukhī samprapadyate || 4.61.1 00|| saṃkalpitaṃ samastaṃ vai labhyeta śravaṇādapi | bhuktirmuktirmahāsvargaṃ sarvaṃ karagataṃ bhavet || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne vādiṭasya nāgādananāmakasya sakuṭumbasya, sārahāsamaṇḍalasthānāṃ mārtaṇḍamaṇḍalādīnāṃ samastānāṃ ca, kathāśravaṇasādhusevanabhaktyādibhimoṃkṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 61 ||
<4.62> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi luñcādasya kathāmapi | lālākhānapure vipro’bhavat pradhānadhiṣṇyapaḥ || 1 || nāmnā vilāsadevaḥ sa rāṣṭre pradhānakāryakṛt | śarkarānṛpaterājñākaro vivādamadhyagaḥ || 2 || nyāyakartābhavaccāpi dharmaśāstrānusārataḥ | kuṭumbasahitaścāpi rājyasattādhikāravān || 3 || prajānāṃ vādaviṣaye śreyaskṛt suvicāravān | kuśalo rājyakaraṇe kintu lobhaparāyaṇaḥ || 4 || dvayorvivāde pracchannāṃ luñcāṃ gṛhṇāti vai dvayoḥ | dvayoḥ kāryāṇi yogyāni nistārayati nyāyataḥ || 5 || evaṃ jāte bahukāle pratiṣṭhāmāptavānati | luñcādhanaistu bahulaiḥ śreṣṭhī dhanapatiḥ sa vai || 6 || jātastathāpi lobhāḍhyo dānaṃ puṇyaṃ karoti na | na tīrthaṃ na makhaṃ dānaṃ sādhubhyo vā karotyapi || 7 || nātithīnna satīḥ sādhvīrna devān pūjayatyapi | notsavānna ca vā śrāddhaṃ karoti kārayatyapi || 8 || na vratāni na bhajanaṃ śreyaḥ kiñcit karotyapi | ātmahitaṃ nācarati badrike sa dvijo hyapi || 9 || nārakīva sadā cāste samṛddho’pi daridravat | dīyate na na bhujyate tat tṛtīyāṃ vindate gatim ||4.62.1 0|| evamasya bhūdevasya vilāsadevanāminaḥ | dhanaṃ sañcayamāpannaṃ bhūmau cañcalatāṃ gatam || 1 1|| luñcājanyaṃ dhanaṃ sarvaṃ raktavṛścikatāṃ gatam | bhūtvā vṛścikarūpaṃ tannirgataṃ bhūmigartataḥ || 12|| koṭiśo vṛścikā raktā bhavane nirgatā niśi | bhayamāsādya tatpatnī putrāḥ putraśca dāsikāḥ || 1 3|| niryayurvihvalāḥ sarve gṛhādbahirdrutaṃ tadā | vilāsadevo vipro’pi parāṃ vihvalatāṃ gataḥ || 14|| śāstradṛṣṭyā vivedāpi dhanaṃ vṛścikatāṃ gatam | śuśoca bahudhā tatra śrāvayan svakuṭumbinaḥ || 15|| aho bhārye sutāḥ putryo dhanaṃ sarvaṃ gataṃ hi naḥ | durbhāgyasyārjitaṃ cāpi prayāti vṛścikātmakam || 16|| paśyantvimān tāmrakuṃbhān riktān pūrvaprapūritān | lakṣmīrmayārjitā sā na yojitā satsu karmasu || 17|| nātmārthaṃ nāpi devārthaṃ kuṭumbārthaṃ na yojitā | sañcitā sarvadā garte mūrchitā sā gatā svayam || 18|| kadaryasya dhanaṃ lakṣmīrbhogaśūnyā vijīryati | abhoktāraṃ vihāyānyaṃ yāti ṣaṇḍavadhūriva || 19|| bhogātmakaṃ phalaṃ naiva prāptaṃ mayā kadācana | pratyutāghaṃ mahat prāptaṃ luñcājanyaṃ pralobhinā ||4.62.20|| bhoktavyaṃ paraloke talluñcākarmaphalaṃ mayā | ubhayorlokayoḥ kaṣṭaṃ pratyakṣaṃ mama vartate ||21 || pāpametadbrāhmaṇasya tato’nyaccāpi me’bhavat | dravyārjane prasaktasya sandhyākarmādihīnatā |||22|| satyaṃ śaucaṃ kṣamā śāntistṛptirvrataṃ surārcanam | santoṣaścātmaveditvaṃ svābhāvikaṃ dvijasya yat ||23|| mayā tadvihitaṃ sarvaṃ lobhātmanā tu pāpinā | pāpasya loke pāpānāṃ mūlaṃ lobho nigadyate ||24|| adharmaputro lobho’styadharmo lobhāt pravardhate | lakṣmīḥ ruṣṭā hareḥ patnī mamādharmasthitasya vai ||25|| jaḍāpi sā gatā caityā bhūtvā vṛścikarūpiṇī | tasyāḥ prasannatārthaṃ tu sādhanaṃ harisevanam ||26|| vinā prasannatāṃ lakṣmyā vaikuṇṭhe vasatirna hi | tasmāt prasādanīyā sā nārāyaṇasya sevanāt ||27|| ityevaṃ sa śuśocāpi nirdhanaḥ svajanaiḥ saha | vicittatāṃ gataścāpi luñcādhanalayāttathā ||28|| kuṭumbaṃ duḥkhamāpannaṃ sukhaśūnyaṃ tato’bhavat | padaṃ pradhānaṃ kaṣṭākhyaṃ sarvaṃ tasyāpyabhāsata ||29|| anyāyopārjitaṃ dravyaṃ mūlamādāya nirgatam | tasmāt pradhānatā duṣṭā lobhakrodhādisaṃbhṛtā ||4.62.30 || svargamokṣādihantryeva viprasya tu viśeṣataḥ | viprasya yogyatā daive sukhadā na tu rājake ||3 1|| sadā kleśamayaṃ rājyaṃ sattā pāpānvitā sadā | pradhānatā śāṭhyayuktā kathaṃ viprasya mokṣaṇam ||32|| gāyatrījāpakāle’pi rājyakāryavicintanam | śrīkṛṣṇadhyānakāle’pi śatrvādidhyānamarṣaṇam ||33|| pūjākāle mahīmānasammānādividhāpanam | devadarśanakāle’pi cauraduṣṭādicintanam ||34|| ātmasādhanakāle’pi māyāsādhanamanvaham | mokṣasādhanasamaye bandhasādhanamulbaṇam ||356|| puṇyasādhanasamaye pāpasādhanamāyatam | aho kaṣṭapadaṃ nityaṃ pradhānapadamīdṛśam ||36|| tasmāt tyājyaṃ pradhānatvaṃ sukhanidrā na yatra vai | śāśvataśca na kośo’sti sā vai tyājyā pradhānatā ||37|| bhāgyarekhā daridrasya dāridryamātanoti vai | yatamānasya yatno’pi nirbalo rekhayā kṛtaḥ ||38|| janmarekhā balavatī cānte svasyāṃ nayatyapi | tathā mamāpi sampannā sthitiḥ pūrveva tāpasī ||39|| tasmāt tyaktvā pradhānatvaṃ yāmi tvanyatra yat sukham | śrūyate tu mayā nityaṃ śubhaṃ lokamukhādapi ||4.62.40|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ pārāyaṇaṃ param | vārṣikaṃ vartate nātidūre vai śarkarāpure ||41|| viprāstatra samāyātā rājāno rājayoginaḥ | ṛṣayaḥ sādhavo bhaktā vaiṣṇavā bahavo janāḥ ||42|| śreṣṭhinaśca narā nāryo lakṣādhimānavāḥ sadā | śṛṇvanti tu kathā divyāḥ pāvanāste bhavantyapi ||43|| lakṣmīḥ prasannā bhavati prasannaśca narāyaṇaḥ | pāpināṃ cāvīkṣya doṣān karoti pāvanām̐stu tān ||44|| kṛpayaiva prabhuḥ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaḥ pareśvara | āgatya darśanaṃ datvākṣaraṃ dhāma nayatyapi ||45|| vipro’haṃ pāpasampanno me gatirnānyathā śubhā | gatvā tatra kathāṃ śrutvā kṛtvā pāpavidhūnanam ||46|| brahmagatiṃ prayāsyāmi syāt sāphalyaṃ janermama | asāraḥ khalu saṃsāraḥ kṛto’pyakṛta eva saḥ ||47|| vivekena tu taṃ tyaktvā yāsyāmi paramāṃ gatim | yadvā tadvā kathāṃ śrutvā sadgatirme bhaviṣyati ||48|| kuṭumbena sahito’haṃ tato yāmyadhunā kathām | dharmakṛtye ciratā vai vighnadā na tu sādhikā ||49|| dharmakārye tvātmakārye prakurvīta drutaṃ mudā | prātaḥ kālo nivarteta na cāgacchet punaḥ śubhaḥ ||4.62.50|| vicāryetthaṃ badrike sa vipro vilāsadevakaḥ | sajjo bhūtvā kuṭumbena sahitaḥ suvicāravān ||51 || tyaktvā prajāsamakṣaṃ vai padaṃ prādhānikaṃ tu tat | virāmaṃ tu samāsādya parihāraṃ vidhāya ca ||52|| niryayau nagarāttasmāccharkarāpuramāyayau | mahodyāne nijāvāsaṃ sabhāmaṇḍapasannidhau |||93|| akarodbhagavatprāptyai mano dadhe’tiśāntaye | sasnau tīrthajalaiścāpyādāyopadāstataḥ svayam ||54||| kuṭumbasahito vipraḥ kathāmaṇḍapamāyayau | badrike hṛdaye śāntirviprasya bahudhābhavat |||95||| muktāgaurī tu tatpatnī parāṃ śāntimavāpa ha | maṇḍapadarśanaṃ kṛtvā putryaḥ pañca sutāstrayaḥ ||56|| sarve śāntimagustatra kṛtvā vyāsasya darśanam | saṃhitāyā darśanaṃ ca lomaśasyāpi darśanam ||57|| kṛtvā satāṃ darśanaṃ cāsādhvīnāṃ darśanaṃ tathā | vaiṣṇavānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca bhaktānāṃ darśanaṃ hyapi ||58|| evaṃ teṣāṃ darśanena saṃkalpā vilayaṃ gatāḥ | hṛdayānyamalānyeva jātāni mānasānyapi ||99|| udvegā vilayaṃ prāptāścintā cittānnyavartata | duḥkhaṃ vyādhirādhyupādhī sarvaṃ tad vilayaṃ gatam ||4.62.6 0|| brahmasukhaṃ yathā syādvā tathā kṛṣṇasukhaṃ bhavet | muktisukhaṃ yathā vā syāt tathā śāntirvyavartata ||61|| aho sthānasya māhātmyaṃ māyājālaṃ layaṃ gatam | aho darśanamāhātmyaṃ manomalamalīyata ||62|| aho satāṃ pramāhātmyaṃ vāsanā vilayaṃ gatā | darśanādeva viprasya tāpāstatra layaṃ gatāḥ ||63|| tatra cāgatya purato vyāsasyārhaṇamācarat | saṃhitāyāḥ pūjanaṃ ca lomaśasyāpi pūjanam ||64|| satāṃ prapūjanaṃ cāpi nīrājanaṃ vyadhādapi | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ daṇḍavacca naivedyaṃ ca phalārpaṇam ||65|| jalaṃ payaḥ śarkarāṃ ca nyadhācchubhākṣatānapi | tulavīpatrahārām̐śca kundakusumahārakān ||66|| candanaṃ kaisaraṃ cāpi nyadhāt sa saṃhitāntike | kambalān divyavastrāṇi bhūṣāḥ sauvarṇajā nyadhāt ||67|| vedhopaveṣān ramyām̐śca rājārhakaṭakānapi | nyadhāt kathāyāḥ purato divyaratnopadāstathā || 68|| pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā natvā nārāyaṇaṃ harim | vyāsaṃ sabhāṃ tataḥ kuṭumbānvito maṇḍape dvijaḥ ||69|| niṣasāda puraḥsthāne sabhyasammānito hi saḥ | tatpatnīputrikāputrāḥ pupūjurvyāsamutsukāḥ ||4.62.70|| natvā dhṛtvā prasādāmbu mukhe ca mastakopari | niṣeduśca sabhāyāṃ vai śrotuṃ kathāṃ hi pāvanīm ||71 || śrutvā jagmurnijāvāsaṃ tvevaṃ nipeyamatandritāḥ | kathāṃ śṛṇvanti sevante sādhūn maharṣipuṃgavān ||72|| kathāśravaṇatasteṣāṃ vairāgyaṃ samapadyata | dīkṣāṃ prāptuṃ samīhāpi samajāyata vai drutam ||73|| māsānte śrīlomaśo vai mantraṃ tebhyo dadau purā | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||74|| prabhonārāyaṇasvāmin mādhavīnrāyaṇaprabho | jayākṛṣṇalalitānrāyaṇarādhāpate vibho ||75|| evaṃ nāmabhajanaṃ ca dadau tebhyo mudātha te | cakrustannāmabhajanaṃ nityaṃ śrīkṛṣṇavaiṣṇavāḥ ||76|| atha tyāgāśrame sthātuṃ samaicchan te kuṭumbinaḥ | prārthayan vācakaṃ vyāsaṃ svataḥprakāśakāyanam ||77|| vyāsastathāstviti prāha caitrāntaikādaśītithau | dhavale pakṣake prātaḥ prāyaścittamakārayat ||78|| pāpaviśodhanaṃ śrāddhaṃ pitṛkāryamakārayat | ṛṇāpākaraṇaṃ cāpi grahāpākaraṇaṃ tathā ||79|| kārayitvā tīrthavidhiṃ rakṣāmantraṃ dadau tataḥ | kālamāyāpāpakarmaśanuyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt ||4.62.80|| śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava | rakṣāmantramiti datvā prapattiṃ pradadau tataḥ ||81|| śaraṇaṃ śrākṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu mama sarvadā | evaṃ śaraṇamantraṃ ca datvā brahmamanuṃ dadau ||82|| brahmāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto’smi śāśvataḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me ||83|| brahmabhāvamanuṃ datvā cātmanivedanaṃ dadau | bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ ||84|| pitā bandhuḥ suhṛnmitraṃ rakṣakaḥ pālako’stu saḥ | oṃ śrīlakṣmyai mahālakṣmyai duḥkhamantryai śriyai namaḥ ||85|| oṃ māṃ śrībālakṛṣṇāya samarpayāmi oṃ namaḥ | evaṃ samarpaṇaṃ datvā kāṣāyāmbaradhotrakam ||86|| uttarīyaṃ śirastrāṇaṃ tathā cāpyaṃgarakṣakam | gātrarakṣakamevāpi kāṣāyāmbaramārpayat ||87|| yajñopavītakaṃ kaṇṭhīṃ taulasīṃ candanaṃ tathā | mālikāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtiṃ dadau tataḥ ||88|| evaṃ narebhyo datvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca | nāmajapātmakaṃ datvā nārībhyo dīkṣaṇaṃ dadau ||89|| mantrān datvā ca kāṣāyāmbaraśāṭīṃ navāṃ śubhām | kāṣāyaghargharīṃ cāpi kāṣāyacolikāṃ dadau ||4.62.90|| kāṣāyakucarakṣāṃ ca kāṣāyamūrdhakeśalīm | yajñopavītakaṃ kaṇṭhīṃ taulasīṃ kuṃkumaṃ tathā ||91|| mālikāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtiṃ tato dadau | jñānaṃ vistārataścāpi dadau sarvārpaṇātmakam ||92|| dehendriyāntaḥkaraṇaiścātmanā guṇakarmabhiḥ | arpaṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe dānātmakaṃ hi tat ||93|| upavāsastapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ brahmacaryaṃ tapaḥ param | kṛṣṇacaryā parā bhaktiḥ parākṣarapradā matā ||94|| upavāsena naśyed vai kāyendriyāghajātakam | āntarāṇāṃ bhavecchuddhirdoṣāṇāṃ kṣapaṇaṃ tathā ||95|| brahmacaryeṇa kāmānāṃ nirodho doṣanāśanam | vāsanāvilayaścāpi nārakitvapramokṣaṇam ||96|| śrīkṛṣṇacaryayā sarvaṃ naiṣkarmyamabhijāyate | śrīkṛṣṇānugrahaścāpi śrīkṛṣṇārthasamastatā ||97|| tadbhaktyā taddhāmagatistanmūrtāvabhivāsitā | tadānandāśanamātraṃ kṛṣṇatādātmyamityapi ||98|| evaṃ samupadiśyaiva prasādānnajalāmṛtam | dadau tebhyaśca te bhaktā mahābhāgavatottamāḥ ||99|| tyāgisanto bhāvabhaktyā pupūjurvyāsasadgurum | evaṃ badrīpriye luñcādano’pi dvijapuṃgavaḥ || 4.62.10 0|| kuṭumbasahito jātaḥ sādhuḥ pradhānatāṃ jahau | dīkṣānāmābhavattasya divyaprakāśakāyanaḥ || 101 || triputrāṇāṃ tu nāmāni suraprakāśakāyanaḥ | muniprakāśāyanakaḥ kṛṣṇaprakāśakāyanaḥ || 1 02|| patnī sādhvī dadhe nāma gaurīmuktāyanīti vai | pañca putryo nāma dadhyuḥ mauktikāyanikā tathā || 1 03|| śrīsattāyanikā ceti brahmadhāmāyanī tathā | kṛṣṇakāntāyanī cāpi viṣṇukāntāyanīti ca || 1 04|| evaṃ badrīpriye tyāgāśrame tasthuḥ sadā tu te | kālāntare kṛpāṃ prāpya yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ || 1 05|| dīkṣāṃ vīkṣya tadā nāryo narāścāpi sahasraśaḥ | jagṛhurvaiṣṇavīṃ dīkṣāṃ tatra tyāgamayīṃ dine || 1 06|| āturadīkṣitāstatra bahavo’pi narāḥ striyaḥ | caitraśuklaikādaśyāṃ te dvādaśyāmapi kecana || 1 07|| trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ pūrṇāyāmapi kecana | divyadehā abhavam̐śca tānnetuṃ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ || 1 08|| vimānasahitastatrāyayau nināya cākṣaram | evaṃ cākṣaradhāmnastu mārgaṃ uddhāṭitastadā || 1 09|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāntena badrike | sahasraśaścaitraśukle yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ || 4.62.11 0|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya camatkārāvabodhanāt | bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi kṛpayā śrīpateḥ prabhoḥ || 111|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne luñcādanasya vilāsadevaviprasya sakuṭumbasya rājyapradhānasya kathāśravaṇena sādhudīkṣāgrahaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāya || 62 ||
<4.63> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīśvari devi sarvādasya kathāṃ tathā | mahīrāyapure tvāsīd duritaghoṣanāmakaḥ || 1 || pradhānapadabhāg vipraḥ sarvabhakṣī yathā janaḥ | sarvādanaḥ sarvabhojī sarvahārīti viśrutaḥ || 2 || sarvādānaparaḥ pāpī pāpācāro’tidūṣitaḥ | prasahya vā prasādena sarvaṃ gṛhṇāti sarvataḥ || 3 || nāgrāhyaṃ nābhakṣyamasya kimapyāsīcca kasyacit | mlecchadharmābhavat pāpāt pāpisaṃgāt paśuryathā || 4 || pūrvaṃ sudharmakarmāpi paścāt pradhānatāṃ gataḥ | sarvadharmavihīno’bhūnnāstiko nindakaḥ khalaḥ || 5 || rājyadravyaṃ tathā pāpaṃ matibhedakaraṃ hi tat | pāpamiśraṃ prajānāṃ tad dhanamannaṃ karādikam || 6 || daṇḍadravyaṃ nikṛṣṭaṃ ca cauradhanaṃ tato’pyadhaḥ | ghātakānnaṃ gaṇikānnaṃ yathādhonāṇakaṃ tathā || 7 || tatprayogeṇa jaṭharā malinā malinaṃ manaḥ | buddhermālinyamevāpi dharme nāstikyameva tat || 8 || satkarmaṇāṃ parityāgo duṣṭakarmānuvartanam | devapūjāparityāgo mokṣamārgādivarjanam || 9 || abhakṣye ca tatastasya pravartanā prajāyate | sarvāśano bhavet paścād vipro’pi rākṣaso yathā || 4.63.1 0|| evaṃ duritaghoṣo’pi badrike mānavo’pi san | vipro’pi dhiṣṇyasaṃstho’pi dhikkṛtiṃ samupāgataḥ || 1 1|| militvātha samastābhiḥ prajābhiḥ sa nirākṛtaḥ | vimānito nijagrāmānniṣkāsitaḥ kuṭumbayuk || 12|| tataḥ śokaṃ jagāmāpi dharmatyāge hi dhikkṛtiḥ | avamānaṃ prajābhyaśca devebhyo’pi sadā tathā || 1 3|| dhikkṛto mānavairnaiva paralokāya kalpyate | na gatiḥ subhagā tasya dagdhabhāgyaśca kācana || 14|| rudanti pitaraścāsya kuladevā ruṣanti ca | dharmo ruṭhati lakṣmīśca pādau kṛtvā nivartate || 15|| sammānaḥ svāgataśceti śrīputrau viprakarṣagau | sampado vividhā ramyā vilīyante hyadharmiṇaḥ || 1 6|| vighnāḥ kāryeṣu jāyante skhalanaṃ ca pade pade | parājayaḥ samagreṣu naiṣphalyaṃ ceṣṭakarmasu || 17|| ārabdheṣu kṣatiścāpi prārabdheṣu śilāhatiḥ | durbhikṣatvaṃ phaladeṣu niṣphaleṣu pravartanā || 18|| gṛhe kuṭumbavarge’pi kalistasya pade dhṛte | nārīputrādyamānaṃ ca śvavṛttivattu jīvanam || 19|| grāme sūkaravadvṛttiḥ prakāśe’pyandhatāsya ca | hṛdaye’pi pāpapuñjād vahnijvalanamanvaham ||4.63.20|| āpattayaḥ paritaścāgatyainaṃ tvardayantyapi | harerbhaktiṃ satāṃ sevāṃ guroḥ prāptiṃ haranti ca ||21 || dānaṃ vrataṃ tīrthayātrāṃ virundhanti kṣaṇe kṣaṇe | abhyudayaṃ paraṃ śreyaḥ kalyāṇaṃ nāśayantyapi ||22|| kiṃ bahunā badrike’sya puruṣārthā viyanti ca | nirarthakā hi sarve te tato yātyadhamāṃ gatim ||23|| evaṃ vicārya bahudhā kalyāṇamārgaṇaṃ vyadhāt | śuśrāva janamukhataḥ pārāyaṇamahotsavam ||24|| camatkārān hareścāpi pāpināṃ pāpanāśakān | mokṣadān divyatādhānān śuśrāva sakuṭumbakaḥ ||25|| tatra gantuṃ tadā buddhimakarot sa nirāśrayaḥ | sajjo’bhavad drutaṃ cāśvaśakaṭyoṣṭrānasā tathā || 26|| yogyavastūnyupakaraṇāni cādāya satvaram | pratasthe sakuṭumbaḥ sa smarannārāyaṇaṃ harim ||27|| śarkarānagaraṃ prāpya gatyā sabhāsumaṇḍapam | mahodyāne kṛtāvāsaḥ kṛtasnānavidhistataḥ || 28|| dhṛtopadaḥ sakuṭumbo yayau vyāsāsanaṃ mudā | sāyaṃ pūjāṃ pracakāra saṃhitāvyāsayormudā ||29|| lomaśādestataḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvā natvā sato janān | sabhāyāṃ śravaṇārthaṃ sa upāviveśa mānitaḥ ||4.63.30|| kathānte sa pracakre nīrājanaṃ bhāvapūrvakam | kṛṣṇapādāmṛtaṃ cāpi papau prasādamāśa ca ||3 | || pūtātmā sahasā jāto mantraṃ jagrāha lomaśāt | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||32|| prabhonārāyaṇaśrīmanmādhavīnrāyaṇa prabho | jayākṛṣṇalalitāśrīkṛṣṇarādhāpate vibho | |33|| evaṃ śrīkṛṣṇadhunyaṃ ca jagrāha lomaśādapi | nityaṃ cakre nāmadhunyaṃ satāṃ sevanamanvaham ||34|| kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ cāpi pāpakṣayo’bhavattataḥ | lomaśasyopadeśena brahmakūrcavrataṃ vyadhāt ||35|| māsāntaṃ tasya manasi vyajāyata śubheṣaṇā | tyāgidīkṣāgrahaṇecchā prabalā saṃvyajāyata || 36|| prārthayat sa vyāsadevaṃ so’pi dīkṣāṃ dadau tataḥ | prāyaścittottaraṃ śrāddhaṃ kārayitvā vidhānataḥ ||37|| havanādi tataḥ kṛtvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇārhaṇam | pañcagavyaṃ tataḥ prāśayitvā yajñopavītakam ||38|| dadau mantrān śaraṇaṃ tu prathamaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ tataḥ | brahmamantraṃ tata ātmanivedanaṃ tataḥ param ||39|| sarvasamarpaṇaṃ cāpi dadau kāṣāyavastrakam | samastaveṣaṃ pradadau viprāya tatstriyai tathā | |4.63.40|| putrebhyaśca caturbhyo’pi saptaputrībhya ityapi | dīkṣāṃ kaṇṭhīṃ taulasīṃ ca mūrtiṃ pūjārthamityapi | |4 1 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtiṃ śrīyutāṃ pradadau tadā | nāmajapaṃ mahādīkṣāmādāya te pracakrire | |42|| jayakāro’bhavatteṣāṃ sarvamanyacchubhaṃ tathā | abhavadvai mahādānādikaṃ tatra tu dīkṣaṇe | |43 || evaṃ tyāgāśrame tasthurnāmnā saddhoṣaṇāyanaḥ | patnī nāmnā mahāsatyāyanī bhāgavatottamā ||44|| putrā nāmnā tu vairāgyāyanaḥ śaṃbhvāyanastathā | yogāyanastathā jñānāyanaścetyabhavam̐stathā ||45|| putryaḥ sādhvyaḥ sapta nāmnā prajñāyanī kṛtāyanī | sevāyanī tathā sattvāyanī rāmāyaṇī tathā ||46 || bodhāyanī ca pratibhāyanīti vaiṣṇavītamāḥ | sarve te cābhajan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabheśvaram ||47|| kālena te yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ | evaṃpratāpā badari saṃhitāyāḥ kathā parā | |48 || pāpināṃ pāpalayadā mahāpuṇyapradā tathā | ante mokṣapradā divyā śāśvatānandadāyinī ||49 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptipradā śubhā | svargamuktipradā sampatpradā sarvarddhisampradā || 4.63.50 || śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ cānyāṃ supāvanīm | dardurākhye pure tvāsīd vipro’mātyo’tibuddhimān ||5 1 || nāmnā dharmabhaṭo rāṣṭrayogakṣemakaraḥ sadā | sa śuśrāva manuṣyebhyo māhātmyaṃ bahulaṃ yataḥ |||52|| kathāyāḥ śravaṇe tena vāñcchā tasya vyajāyata | sapatnīko yayau tvekahastinā vāhanena saḥ ||5 3 || parimeyānugo nītvā dhanaṃ tu svarṇarūpyakam | snātvā tīrthajale gatvā kathāmaṇḍapamuttamam ||54|| pūjāṃ cakre saṃhitāyā vyāsasya lomaśasya ca | satāṃ satīnāṃ sādhūnāṃ pūjāṃ cakre sa yoginām ||55 || upadāśca nyadhāttatra svaprakāśasya sannidhau | svarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ ratnamaṇīn mauktikānuttamānapi ||56||| patnī pupūja vai tatra saṃhitāṃ vācakaṃ gurum | sādhvīśca pūjayāmāsa dadau tābhyo’mbarāṇi ca ||57|| dhanāni phalapuṣpāṇi bhojanāni dadāvapi | nīrājanaṃ pracakrāte hyubhau svarṇasya dakṣiṇām |||58 || nyadhātāṃ sthālikāyāṃ ca cakraturdaṇḍavanmudā | niṣedatuḥ sabhāyāṃ tau mānitau ca maharṣibhiḥ ||59|| śuśruvatuḥ kathāṃ divyā manoniḥsaṃgakāriṇīm | vairāgyotpādikāṃ sādhusevāmāhātmyabodhinīm || 4.63.6 0|| bhaktiśikṣāpradāṃ kṛṣṇe snehadāṃ dāsyadāyinīm | kathānte tu mahodyāne saudhe tau yayaturmudā || 61 || evaṃ praśāntahṛdayābūṣaturdinapañcakam | tāvat satāṃ satīnāṃ ca cakrāte sevanaṃ mudhā ||62|| pāvanau tau sevayā ca pāvitau punareva ha | prapāvitau ca kathayā bhaktyā nītau ca divyatām ||63|| apaśyatāṃ niśāyāṃ tau nidrāyāṃ mādhavīśvaram | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇacandrakam ||64|| kṣaṇenādṛśyatāṃ prāptaṃ divyaṃ śriyā yutaṃ harim | atha tau sujñātakṛṣṇamahimānau prage drutam ||65|| utthāya darśanaṃ svāpnaṃ parasparaṃ mudāhatuḥ | prasannau tau mithaḥ śrutvā kṛṣṇadarśanamuttamam ||66||| mene dharmabhaṭo bhāgyaṃ dhanyaṃ naijaṃ tadā khalu | patnī nāmnā śīlayānī mene bhāgyaṃ paraṃ nijam ||67|| snātvā sampūjya deveśaṃ yayatustau kathāsthalam | tatra kathāntike’mātyasannidhau śīlayānikā ||68|| gatvā prapūjya taṃ vyāsaṃ dṛṣṭvā śrīkṛṣṇasannibham | nārāyaṇasamaṃ vyāsaṃ svaprakāśaṃ samuttamam ||69|| devavaccojjvalaṃ yogyamupāveṣṭuṃ gajāsane | saṃkalpaṃ vidadhe tatra tāvad rājāpi tadvidham ||4.63.70|| saṃkalpaṃ vidadhe vyāsaṃ gajasthaṃ lokituṃ mudā | prakāśaṃ prāhatustau ca svaprakāśaṃ samutsukau | |7 1 || vyāsastathāstviti prāha kathānte tau mudā tadā | gajaṃ śṛṃgāritaṃ svarṇāmbālikāsahitaṃ śubham ||72||| ānayāmāsaturdivyaṃ piśaṃgaṃ lambadantinam | tatastau śrīvyāsadevaṃ niṣādya vāraṇopari ||73 || ṛṣiṃ ca lomaśaṃ cāpi niṣādya tatra vāraṇe | dharmabhaṭo dadhe svarṇacāmaraṃ lomaśopari | |74|| śīlayānī dadhe svarṇacāmaraṃ vācakopari | vādyanādairjayanādaiḥ sādhvīsādhusukīrtanaiḥ | 72|| vanditau pūjitau mārge bhaktābhivardhitau sumaiḥ | sindhutaṭaṃ yayatustau gajenāmātyavāñcchayā ||76|| jalapānādikaṃ kṛtvā snātvāmātyālayaṃ tataḥ | yayatustatra tau patnīpatī pupūjaturgurū ||77|| ārārtrikaṃ vyadhātāṃ ca svarṇapātre dhanāni ca | kambalāni vicitrāṇi kauśeyānyambarāṇi ca ||78|| maṇiratnādihārām̐śca hīrakāḍhyavibhūṣaṇam | bahudhā suvibhūṣāśca phalapuṣpādi sampadaḥ ||79|| dadatustau tataḥ pādārcanaṃ śrīcandanādibhiḥ | cakraturbhāvataścārārtrikaṃ stutiṃ ca daṇḍavat ||4.63.80|| praṇāmān cakratuścātha tato mantraṃ tu vācakāt | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||81 || jjagṛhatustathā nāma śrīkṛṣṇacandraketi ca | prabhonārāyaṇa śrīmādhavīnārāyaṇaprabho ||82|| jayākṛṣṇalalitānrāyaṇa rādhāpate vibho | nāmadhunyaṃ jagṛhatustato pādajalaṃ śubham ||83|| prasādaṃ jagṛhatuśca niṣādya vāraṇopari | mahotsavayutau vyāsagurū cāmararājitau ||84|| prāpayāmāsatuḥ sthānaṃ saṃhitāmaṇḍapaṃ punaḥ | evaṃ śrīkṛṣṇacandrasya svarūpaṃ vyāsamanvaham ||89|| bhāvabhaktyā siṣevāte tau dvau tallagnamānasau | śṛṇu badrīpriye devi camatkāraṃ harestataḥ ||86|| vidyamāne vāraṇe’pi tvādāya divyavāraṇam | tameva vāraṇaṃ kṛṣṇaścāruhya śrīsamanvitaḥ ||87|| tayaiva divyakānakyāmbālikayā virājitam | tau dvau dharmabhaṭaṃ śīlayānīṃ netuṃ hariḥ svayam ||88|| samāyayau vyomasṛtyā ghaṇṭānādena nādayan | ambaraṃ tejasā sarvaṃ dhavalayan kṛpānidhiḥ ||89|| caitrakṛṣṇadvādaśyāṃ vai paśyatāṃ divyacakṣuṣām | kathottaraṃ tu madhyānte tvāyayau bhagavān prabhuḥ ||4.63.90|| uvāca prahasan dharmabhaṭa ehi paraṃ padam | śīlayāni samāyāhi muktipadaṃ paraṃ padam ||9 1 || śrutvā śrībhagavadvākyaṃ tyaktasaṃsārabandhanau | ubhau sajjāvabhavatāṃ tūrṇaṃ dhṛtvā kare jalam |||92||| hastidānādi sarvaṃ śrīvyāsadevāya ca tadā | dharmabhaṭaḥ śīlayānī dadatuśca dhanādikam ||93|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchayā tu badrike | divyadehau muktarūpāvajāyatāṃ manoharau ||94|| vāraṇaṃ cāruruhatuḥ puṣpavṛṣṭistadābhavat | paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ gajena vyomagāminā ||95|| harirnināya tau tūrṇaṃ nijaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ śubham | jayakārastadā sarvalokeṣu prābhavanmuhuḥ ||96|| camatkāraṃ samākarṇya janā vismayamāpnuvan | bhakto’mātyo yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ dhanyajanurbhuvi ||97|| dhanyā sā śīlayānī ca patyā sārdhaṃ yayau divam | ityevaṃ praśaśaṃsurvai mānavāḥ sarvataḥ sthitāḥ ||98|| badrike saṃhitāyāstu śravaṇena pramokṣaṇam | nūnaṃ prajāyate sarvapāpānāṃ cātmanāṃ tathā ||99|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya cintanādapi mokṣaṇam | iṣṭasiddhiḥ samastā ca bhuktirmuktistathā bhavet || 4.63.1 00|| yatra kṣaṇe yadā kṛṣṇo yaddeśe cābhiyāti vai | gantavyaṃ tena sākaṃ vai māyāṃ tyaktvātibandhinīm || 10 1|| kartavyaṃ tu tadevāsti yanmāyāmokṣaṇaṃ vrataiḥ | bhaktyā dhāmākṣaraprāptistatra śrīharisevanam || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne duritaghoṣanāmakasya pradhānasya sakuṭumbasya kathāśravaṇena tyāgidīkṣāgrahaṇaṃ, dharmabhaṭanāmakāmātyasya śīlayānīpatnīsahitasya kathāśravaṇena mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā triṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 63 ||
<4.64> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ duritanāśinīm | nyāyādhīśasya te vacmi paramokṣapradāyinīm || 1 || prasevanākhyanagare nyāyādhīśo’bhavad dvijaḥ | nāmnā mukundasāvitro dharmādhyakṣo’tibuddhimān || 2 || samastanyāyaniṣṇāto vādavivādaśāntikṛt | nirṇayaṃ pradadātyeva nyāyālayakṛtāsanaḥ || 3 || prajānāṃ hitakṛccāpi sa vādiprativādinoḥ | luñcāṃ prāpyobhayayoścobhayalābhaṃ tu nirṇaye || 4 || pradarśya vādaśāntiṃ sa karotyeva visaṃśayām | kintvevaṃ bahudhā luñcādhanaṃ saṃprāptavān param || 5 || pāpena pakṣaghātena rogeṇābhibhavaṃ gataḥ | khadvāyāṃ sa sadā śete vāmāṃgaśūnyabhāgavān || 6 || parādhīno hyati jātaḥ patnībhṛtyakṛtakriyaḥ | duḥkhamāpnoti hṛdaye śuśrāva bhṛtyavargataḥ || 7 || duḥkhanāśakaraṃ vākyaṃ kathāmāhātmyamuttamam | ye prayānti kathāyāṃ vai rugṇāḥ pāpā adharmiṇaḥ || 8 || śuddhāḥ śrutvā kathāṃ yānti brahmadhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ | rogahīnāḥ prajāyante puṇyabhājo bhavantyapi || 9 || śrutvaivaṃ sa satīṃ patnīṃ prāha me mokṣaṇaṃ ca vā | roganāśo yathā syādvai tathā vidhehi matkṛte || 4.64.1 0|| sāpi śrutvā svāmivākyaṃ svāmiśreyaḥparā satī | prajājanānāṃ vṛddhānāṃ sammatiṃ jagṛhe satī || 11 || kathaṃ patyuḥ roganāśaḥ pāpanāśaśca mokṣaṇam | tat kartavyaṃ mayā tūrṇaṃ papraccheti mahājanān || 1 2| mahājanā guṇagrāhā śreyase nyāyadāyinaḥ | prāhuradya varaṃ śreyaḥ saṃhitāśravaṇaṃ matam || 1 3|| camatkārā nityanavāḥ śrūyante tu kathāsthale | kalyāṇaṃ dehināṃ tatra karoti kṛpayā hariḥ || 14|| tamenaṃ nyāyakartāraṃ naya tatra kathāsthalīm | kathāṃ śrutvā sato dṛṣṭvā natvā sabhāṃ samantataḥ || 15|| prapūjya paramātmānaṃ taveṣṭaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati | patyuste sarvathā ceṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 16 || ityuktā sā satī bhāryā nāmnā gayākṣiṇī yayau | dravyaṃ bhṛtyān patiṃ nītvā narayāṇeḥ kathāsthalīm || 1 7|| mahodyānaṃ sthalīvāsaṃ kṛtvā snātvā suśobhanā | patiṃ nītvā narayāne kathāmaṇḍapamāyayau || 18|| pakṣaghātābhibhūto’pi patirneme sabhājanān | saṃhitāṃ vācakaṃ kṛṣṇamūrtiṃ neme ca lomaśam || 1 9|| ṛṣīn sādhūn praṇeme ca supto’pi narayānake | tṛṇaṃ labdhvā mukhe pāpakṣamāṃ sadbhyo’pyayācata ||4.64.20 || santo dayālavastasmai daduḥ pādajalāni ca | prasādaṃ pradadustatra so’pi cakhāda satvaram ||21|| bhadrike tāvatā tasya dehe śaktirvyavardhata | pakṣaṃ vāmaṃ suśaktaṃ saṃjātaṃ jāḍyavihīnakam ||22|| śūnyabhāvaṃ vihāyaiva caitanyasaṃbhṛtaṃ hyabhūt | utthāya sahasā khaṣṭvāmadhyataḥ sa sabhāṃ prati || 23|| cakāra daṇḍavadbhūmau vidan māhātmyamuttamam | nīrugṇatvaṃ darśanāttu tatkālaṃ samajāyata |||24|| tataḥ pūjāṃ cakārāpi dhanaratnādibhistadā | vyāsapūjāṃ kathāmūrtipūjāṃ lomaśapūjanam |||25|| saṃhitāpūjanaṃ sādhusādhvīprapajūnaṃ tathā | dvijarṣipūjanaṃ cakre bhūridānādidakṣiṇam ||26||| kathāṃ śuśrāva ca tataścaivaṃ nityaṃ cakāra ha | mahimānaṃ vivedāpi kathāyā navajīvane ||27|| mṛtyormukhānmahārogānmuktiḥ kathāprabhāvataḥ | satāmāśīrvacanaiśca viveda strīyuto hi saḥ || 28|| nyāyākṣiṇī tathā nyāyādhīśaḥ sādhuniṣevaṇam | nityaṃ pracakratustatra nijāvāse muhurmuhuḥ ||29|| akurvātāṃ vicāraṃ ca maraṇād rakṣaṇaṃ tviha | jātaṃ tasmājjīvanaṃ vai dātavyaṃ kṛṣṇalabdhaye ||4.64.3 0|| na gantavyaṃ gṛhe cetaḥ sthātavyaṃ sādhumaṇḍale | śrotavyā śrīsaṃhitāyāḥ kathā sarvārthadāyinī ||31 || sevanīyāḥ sādhavaśca toṣaṇīyā maharṣayaḥ | tāraṇīyo nijātmā ca prāptavyaṃ paramaṃ padam |||32|| api nyāyo hi jagatāṃ kṛto’pi koṭilakṣadhā | ātmanyāyaḥ kṛtaścenna kṛtaṃ kimapi tena na ||33|| toṣitā vādavivadāḥ kaliprāyā janā api | api kṛṣṇastoṣito na kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||34|| rañjitāḥ kalikartāraḥ śamitā māyikā janāḥ | santaśced rañjitā naiva kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||35|| arjitaṃ nāṇakaṃ koṭiḥ vardhitāḥ sampado jaḍāḥ | arjitaṃ nātmakalyāṇaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam || 36|| sevitāḥ strīmahīmānāḥ satkṛtāśca kuṭumbinaḥ | sevitāścet sādhavo na kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam || 37|| vanditā dravyadātāro bhojitā lampaṭā janāḥ | nātithayaḥ pūjitāścet kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam || 38|| smṛtā nityaṃ kalahiṇaḥ vitaṇḍā uditāḥ sadā | nārāyaṇo neritaścet kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||39|| poṣito nijadehaśca saṃskṛtā mūrdhajāḥ sadā | saṃskṛtaṃ na hṛdayaṃ cet kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||4.64.40|| ādhattaṃ bāhyavijñānaṃ vistāritāśca kalpanāḥ | kṛṣṇadhyānaṃ na cādhattaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||41 || nirṇayā laukikā dattāḥ sattāḥ bhuktā tu māyikī | ātmamokṣo niścito na kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||42|| śraddhā mṛṣā vivādeṣu kṛtā naije ca gaurave | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe cenna kṛtā sarvā nirarthikā ||43|| sammānaṃ bahudhā labdhaṃ svāgataṃ cāti vīkṣitam | mānitaścenna kṛṣṇena mānaṃ cānyannirarthakam ||44|| tāḍitā daṇḍitā duṣṭāḥ kārāgāre nipātitāḥ | kāmādayo daṇḍitā na daṇḍaścānyo nirarthakaḥ ||45|| mocitāḥ pīḍitā lokā vipado vinivāritāḥ | svasya yāmyaṃ vāritaṃ na kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||46|| gatayo bahudhā klṛptā mārgāścānye’vadhāritāḥ | brahmamārgo dhṛtaścenna kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||47|| dattaṃ bahubhyo lokebhyo na dattaṃ paramātmane | bhaktebhyo na na yajñebhyo dattamanyannirarthakam ||48|| arjitā bahudhā ṛddhiḥ kīrtiḥ khyātiḥ pratiṣṭhikā | na tvarjitā kṛpā kārṣṇī tadarjitaṃ nirarthakam ||49|| kośe surakṣitaṃ svarṇaṃ rajataṃ peṭikāsu ca | hṛdi kṛṣṇo na nihito rakṣitaṃ tannirarthakam ||4.64.50||| ārohitāni yānāni vāhanānyādṛtāni ca | śrīkṛṣṇasya vimānaṃ nādṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||51 || rājyaṃ prapālikaṃ samyak prajāḥ samyaṅnibhālitāḥ | dṛṣṭo nārāyaṇaścenna dṛṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam || 52|| śrutaṃ saṃśayitaṃ sarvaṃ mataṃ mṛṣābhivardhitam | na śrutā na matā kṛṣṇakathā sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||53|| dīnānāthā āśvasitā bhṛtyādyāḥ svāśrayīkṛtāḥ | bhaktā nāśvāsitā divyā āśrayādi nirarthakam ||94|| vyākhyātānyanyatattvāni bhautikāni kṣaṇe kṣaṇe | kṛṣṇatattvaṃ na cākhyātaṃ gataṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||55|| likhitā rājapadakā yojitā pāśavī kalā | nātmā saṃyojitaḥ kṛṣṇe yojanā sā nirarthikā ||56|| apyabdhayaḥ kṣālitāścāloḍitā nyāyakoṭayaḥ | vāsanā jvālitā naiva śramaḥ sarvo nirarthakaḥ ||57|| śatravaḥ sajjitāścāpi baliṣṭhāśca virodhinaḥ | kāmanā na jitā yena jayastasya nirarthakāḥ ||58|| sarve tvadhītamevāpi vācitaṃ puṣkalaṃ sadā | nādhītaṃ śrīharernāma raṭanā sā nirarthikā ||59|| preṣitāni tu patrāṇi lagnāni yojitānyapi | kṛṣṇalagnaṃ na cāpannaṃ sarvamanyannirarthakam ||4.64.60|| striyo vivāhitā bahvyaḥ pravāhitāśca dakṣiṇāḥ | saṃvāhitā gajā haṃsā nāhitāḥ kṛṣṇavaiṣṇavāḥ ||61|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo naiva dhṛto vakṣasi keśavaḥ | tadā nirarthakaṃ sarvaṃ bhārarūpaṃ hi vāhitam ||62|| api veṣā dhṛtā ramyā dhṛtā bhūṣā suśobhitāḥ | kṛṣṇakaṇṭhī dhṛtā naiva dhṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||63|| pītaṃ bhuktaṃ bahu miṣṭamāsvāditā rasā parāḥ | prasādo na harerbhukto bhuktaṃ sarvaṃ tu pāpakṛt ||64|| sugandhādi samastaṃ saṃyojitaṃ varṣmahetave | kṛṣṇārthaṃ yojitaṃ naiva tat sarvaṃ pāpadaṃ kṛtam ||65 || utsavā vihitāścānye daivotsavāḥ kṛtā nahi | satāṃ mahotsavāstyaktāstasya sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||66|| svajanmāhāni satataṃ pālitānyaparāṇyapi | kṛṣṇajanmadinaṃ cenna pālitaṃ tena kiṃ kṛtam ||67|| āyuḥ saṃkṣapitaṃ sarvaṃ dehaḥ karmasu dharṣitaḥ | rāgo na dharṣito dveṣo na dharṣito vṛthāśramaḥ ||68||| vibhājitā nijā sampat putrādyāśca vibhājitāḥ | bhajito na harikṛṣṇo bhaktaṃ sarvaṃ viḍambanam ||69|| āvṛtaṃ nagaraṃ sarvamāvṛtānīndriyāṇyapi | nāvṛtaṃ hṛt śrīkṛṣṇena sarvamāvṛtamāvṛtam ||4.64.70|| anugrahītā bahavo mocitā vipadāṃ mukhāt | nijātmā mocito naiva mocanaṃ tannirarthakam ||71|| mātā pitā suhṛd bandhuḥ pūjitāḥ sevitāstathā | sādhavaḥ sevitāścenna mokṣamārgo’sya durghaṭaḥ ||72|| pitarastarpitā dīnā bhojitā vanditāḥ surāḥ | nopāsitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo gurvī tu sā kṣatiḥ ||73|| āsāditāni dhiṣṇyāni mānapatrāṇi śobhanāḥ | padavyaścāpi saṃlabdhā nāptaṃ kṛṣṇapadāmbujam ||74|| nāpyāptamāsanaṃ kṛṣṇapādāsanasamīpagam | tadā nāptaṃ tvantatastu kiñcit śūnyamivābhavat ||75|| sarvaṃ śūnye gataṃ tasya kṛṣṇahīnasya dehinaḥ | ataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prāpaṇīyaḥ sarvamanyannirarthakam ||76|| atraiva sarvadā kṛṣṇakathālābhārthamuttamā | vasatiḥ rocate tasmādvasitavyamihādhunā ||77|| vicāryetthaṃ mithaḥ patnīpatī tatra nivāsanam | cakraturbadrike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇārpitātmakau ||78|| jagṛhatuśca tau mantraṃ nāmadhunyaṃ tadā mudā | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||79|| prabhonārāyaṇaśrīmādhavīnārāyaṇaprabho | jayākṛṣṇalalitānrāyaṇarādhāpate vibho ||4.64.80|| svaprakāśo hi bhagavān mantraṃ datvā ca taulasīm | dadau kaṇṭhīṃ bhajanārthaṃ mālikāṃ pratimāṃ dadau ||8 1 || tatastau kṛṣṇacittau vai pratīkṣete pramokṣaṇam | māsānte śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vimānamāsthitaḥ ||82|| netuṃ samāyayau tau tu caitrasyāmādine hariḥ | ujjvalaḥ śvetavasanaḥ svarṇabhūṣāvibhūṣitaḥ ||83|| uvāca tau samāyātaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ mama | uktamātrau dampatī tau svarṇarūpyādidānakam ||84|| cakraturyānadānaṃ tāvadhyāroḍhuṃ vimānakam | kṛtakramau ca yāvattu tāvad vimūrchitau drutam ||85|| tyaktadehau labdhadivyasvarūpau saṃbabhūvatuḥ | sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ badri vimānamadhyatiṣṭhatām ||86|| puṣpavṛṣṭirvyomamārgājjayaśabdā janavrajāt | abhavan bahulāstatra tāvad vimānamambare ||87|| ūrdhvaṃ jagāma sahasā divyaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ prati | tiro’bhavad viprakṛṣṭaṃ mahāścaryamabhūddhi tat ||88 || evaṃ śrībadrike bhaktau tyaktasarvapravartanau | snehabhaktyā yayatuḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇālayam ||89|| tayorbhṛtyajanāstatra tayoścakruḥ pradāhanam | tataste’pi harerbhaktiṃ nāma mantraṃ ca jagṛhuḥ ||4.64.90|| bhejuḥ śrīparamātmānaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | kṣapitāghā gatakleśā nirmalāḥ sādhusevinaḥ ||9 1 || abhavam̐ste kṛpāpātrāṇyanvahaṃ śrīkathāparāḥ | prāptavairāgyavegāśca dhyānabhajanayoginaḥ ||92|| vaiṣṇavāḥ paramā bhūtvā labdhvāśīrvādamuttamam | yayurgṛhāṇi naijāni smarantaḥ parameśvaram ||93|| pakvakālena te sarve satsaṃginaḥ śubhāśayāḥ | kṣīṇavāsanāḥ saṃlagnā śrīharau mokṣasanmukhāḥ ||94|| pratīkṣante sma deveśaṃ prabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ narāyaṇam | tāvat teṣāṃ śreyase vai vimānaṃ tvāgataṃ divaḥ ||95|| yayuste’pi harerdhāma kṛṣṇavimānavāhitāḥ | prasevane pure sarve vyapaśyan svavimānakam ||96|| divyaṃ divyaśrīharyāḍhyaṃ divyamuktādhivāsitam | darśakā nijabhāgyāni menire mokṣabhāñji ha ||97|| bhajanaṃ te vyadhuḥ svāmin kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho | kālena kṣīṇapāpāśca prayātāste paraṃ padam ||98|| evaṃ badrīpriye mokṣaṃ gatau nyāyādhikāriṇau | nyāyākṣiṇī ca mukundasāvitraḥ satkathāśravāt ||99|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāt sevanāt satām | bhuktirmuktirbhaved badri svargaṃ sveṣṭaṃ bhavedapi || 4.64.1 00|| sarvadivyaguṇāścāpi divyā sampadvarā api | divyadhāmanivāsaśca divyaśrīkṛṣṇayogitā || 101 || divyatā sarvathā syācchrīsaṃhitāśravaṇādiha | prāptavyaṃ sarvamāpyeta na nyūnaṃ tasya vidyate || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne nyāyakarturmukundasāvitraviprasya nyāyākṣiṇyāstatpatnyāśca kathāśravaṇādibhirmokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuṣṣaṣṭittamo’dhyāyaḥ || 64 ||
<4.65> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāmanyāṃ ca pāvanīm | lekhakaścābhavat tāḍapatreṣu paṭṭakeṣvapi || 1 || dhātupatreṣu ca kāṣṭhaphāleṣu cāmbareṣvapi | nāmnā viśālarekho vai vaiśyaḥ sukarade pure || 2 || lekhotpannena satataṃ jīvikāṃ samavartayan | kuṭumbapoṣaṇaṃ tuṣṭyā karoti dharmavṛttimān || 3 || tasyaikadā samāyātaḥ śvā gṛhe ca gṛhāntare | sampraviṣṭaḥ pātragataṃ payo’pibattu dhenujam || 4 || aśuddhaṃ tatpayaḥ sarvaṃ jātaṃ ghaṭagataṃ tataḥ | vaiśyo’paśyat pibantaṃ taṃ śvānaṃ gṛhāntare gataḥ || 5 || ruṣā yaṣṭiṃ samagṛhyātāḍayat śvā tu mūrchitaḥ | ākrośan patito bhūmau pādān vikṣepayan muhuḥ || 6 || mṛtyuṃ jagāma yāvattu tāvad vaiśyena karṣitaḥ | catvare kṣipta evāpi tāvatpārśvālayā janāḥ || 7 || śrutvākrośaṃ satvaraṃ te kutūhalasamanvitāḥ | āyayuścatvare tatra vyapaśyan māritaṃ tadā || 8 || śvānaṃ vaiśyena vai kṣiptaṃ mṛtaṃ vaiśyena māritam | tiraścakrustu te vaiśyaṃ dhikkāraṃ pradadustathā || 9 || śvaghno’yaṃ krūrakarmā cāgrāhyajalānna eva ca | śrutvaivaṃ tu tadā pāpaśabdān lajjāṃ gato’bhavat || 4.65.1 0|| dharmavān kīrtimām̐ścāpi vegena pāpamācaran | avācyatāṃ gato vaiśyaḥ śuśocātijanāntike || 11 || uvāca tān pārśvalokān na mayā mṛtyuhetave | tāḍitaḥ śvā kintu śikṣaṇārthaṃ pratāḍito’styayam || 1 2|| gṛhaṃ praviśya sa yato dugdhaṃ papau hi dhenujam | sarvaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ cakārāsau tena vai tāḍito mayā || 1 3|| pārśvamarmasthale māraḥ kṛto nahi vijānatā | akasmāt patito māraḥ pārśve marmaṇi tena saḥ || 14|| mṛto’yaṃ tasya hatyā me jātā karomi niṣkṛtim | viprāḥ śiṣṭā bhavanto me bruvantu tasya niṣkṛtim || 15|| ityarthitā bhūsurāstaṃ jagadurvratamuttamam | māsaṃ kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ caikabhuktavrataṃ tathā || 1 6|| satsaṃgaḥ sādhusevā ca dānaṃ yathādhanaṃ tathā | tīrthasnānaṃ māsamātraṃ nitya mantrasahasrakam || 17|| harernāmnāṃ japaśceti prāyaścittaṃ dadurdvijāḥ | viśālarekhaḥ pāpasya nuttaye vicacāra ha || 18|| śarkarānagaraṃ tīrthaṃ kathāsthānamanuttamam | sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ cetyubhayaṃ tīrthaṃ hi tatsthale || 19|| prāptaṃ tena tu vidhinā tīrthaṃ kṛtaṃ hi sindhujam | kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ nityamekabhuktavratānvitam ||4.65.20|| māsamātraṃ kṛtaṃ tena labdhvā yathoditaṃ manum | sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ cāpi kṛtaṃ tena hitaiṣiṇā ||21|| naṣṭapāpo’bhavannaṣṭavāsano vaiśya eva ha | pūrvajanmārjitāghāni naṣṭāni sevanāt satām ||22|| prārabdhaṃ sañcitaṃ karma sarvamanta samāvrajat | āyuḥ pūrṇaṃ tu sañjātaṃ mṛtyukāla upāgataḥ ||23|| māsānte caitraśuklasya pañcamyāṃ prātareva saḥ | snātvā kathāsthalaṃ prāpa pupūja vyāsapuṃgavam |||24||| saṃhitāṃ lomaśaṃ cāpi natvā maharṣimaṇḍalam | kathāṃ śuśrāva mālāyā āvartanapuraḥsaram ||25|| kathānte kīrtanānte’sya jṛṃbhaṇānyabhavan muhuḥ | tāvad vyomno hariḥ kṛṣṇonārāyaṇaḥ samāyayau ||26||| sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ prāha tamāyāhi vimānakam | śrūtvā viśālarekhaḥ sa mumude mokṣabhāgyavān || 27|| drutaṃ mūrchāmavāpāpi divyadeho babhūva ha | vimāne taṃ samādāya yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ hariḥ ||28|| kṛpaiṣā badrike śrīmatkṛṣṇasya mokṣadāyinī | prāyaścittanimittena mokṣaṃ yayā jagāma saḥ |||29|| tasya patnī śucikāntānāmnī tasyaurdhvadaihikam | cakāra vidhivad bhaktā vaiṣṇavī bhāgyaśālinī || 4.65.30|| vairāgyaṃ sā samāpannā hyanapatyā satī śubhā | bhaktiṃ cakre manuṃ nāma labdhvā śrīlomaśāt sadā || 31 || nityaṃ kathāṃ śṛṇotyeva sādhvīvrajaṃ prasevate | sā tu vairāgyavegena jñānena sevayā tathā ||32|| tyāgadīkṣāṃ jagṛhe vai sarvamantrasamanvitām | kāṣāyadhāriṇī bhūtvā sādhvīnāṃ maṇḍale’vasat || 33|| bheje’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pārvīprabhumpatim | badrike sā svatantrābhūt sādhvī svargādigāminī ||34|| brahmasabhāmapi yāti sā samādhimatī tathā | śucikāntābhavannāmnā kṛṣṇakānteśvarī tataḥ ||35|| caturyugaṃ tu sā sādhvī pṛthvyāṃ tataḥ sthitābhavat | bhajanaṃ kārayitvāpi nārījanānasaṃkhyakān || 36|| preṣayāmāsa muktyarthaṃ kārṣṇaṃ padaṃ hi pāvanam | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre vāsaṃ vyadhāccaturyugam ||37|| tato dhāmākṣaraṃ prāpa sādhvyayutaṃ vidhāya sā | śiṣyāṇāṃ maṇḍalaṃ tasyāḥ sādhvīnāṃ cāyutātmakam || 38|| vyacarad bhūmikhaṇḍeṣu nārīṇāṃ bodhadāyakam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇīsatyaḥ sarvā bhejurnarāyaṇam || 39||| śākhāḥ praśākhāḥ śiṣyāḥ praśiṣyāḥ sthāpya dharātale | yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ tāśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇālayam ||4.65.40|| ityevaṃ badrike vaiśyo mokṣaṃ jagāma bhaktarāṭ | kṛṣṇasya kṛpayā bhaktyā sevayā śravaṇena ca ||41 || athānyaṃ te kathayāmi camatkāraṃ mahattamam | kāyasthā bahavaḥ śrutvā camatkāraṃ pramokṣadam |||42|| āyayuḥ parito rāṣṭrāt saṃhitāyāḥ kathāsthalam | upadā vividhā nītvā pūjāsāmagrikānvitāḥ ||43 || kīrtayanto harernāma gāyanto gītikā hareḥ | narā nāryo bālavṛddhā yuvamaṇḍalakānyapi ||44|| āyayuḥ śarkarābhyāśaṃ mahodyānaṃ samutsukāḥ | mahodyāne kṛtāvāsā kṛtasnānāśca tīrthake ||45|| upadākarapātrāścāyayuḥ kathāsabhāsthalam | jayanādān pracakruśca daṇḍavannamanāñjalim ||46|| pūjāṃ cakruḥ saṃhitāyāḥ mūrteśca vācakasya ca | satāṃ maharṣivaryāṇāṃ satīnāmarhaṇāni ca ||47|| viprāṇāṃ yogināṃ pūjāṃ cakruścārārtrikaṃ vyadhuḥ | upāviviśuḥ sadasi śuśruvuśca kathāmṛtam ||48|| mantraṃ svataḥprakāśācca jagṛhurnāmadhunyakam | yayuścāvasathānnaijān māsaṃ tasthuḥ kathārthinaḥ ||49|| satāṃ sevāṃ ca bahudhā cakrire kīrtanānyapi | tīrthāplavanaṃ dānāni cakrire bhajanaṃ mithaḥ ||4.65.50|| hṛtapāpā abhavam̐ste gatamāyikavāsanāḥ | śuddhātmāno’bhavam̐ścāpi narā nāryaḥ sahasraśaḥ |||5 1 || caitraśuklaikādaśyāṃ ca badrike tvāyayau hariḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svarṇavimānayuk ||52|| hasan prāha hariḥ sarvān kāyasthān kṛpayā mudā | śṛṇvatāṃ matkathāṃ sevāṃ kurvatāṃ ca satāṃ mudā ||5 3|| bhajatāṃ māṃ ca vaḥ kalyāṇārthaṃ cāhamupāgataḥ | āyāntu te ya icchanti tvāgantuṃ dhāma me’kṣaram ||54|| sajjā bhavantu tūrṇaṃ cārohantu me vimānakam | nayāmi cākṣaraṃ dhāma śāśvatānandamandiram | |55|| evamuktāḥ karaṇādyāḥ kāyasthā narayoṣitaḥ | pañcaśatāni sahasā sajjāstu muktaye’bhavan ||56|| teṣāṃ halahalāśabdaḥ sahasrotkṣepaṇāhvanāḥ | paritaścābhavan badri mahāścaryavidhāyinaḥ ||57|| pañcaśatāni kāyasthā narā nāryastadā drutam | tyaktvā bhautikavarṣmāṇi cābālavṛddhadehinaḥ ||58|| abhavan divyadehāste kṛṣṇaprokṣitavāribhiḥ | sarve ṣoḍaśavarṣāste muktā muktānikāḥ śubhāḥ ||59|| āruruhurvimānaṃ copāviviśurhareḥ puraḥ | pupūjuḥ parayā bhaktyāśleṣasparśāñjalistavaiḥ ||4.65.6 0|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇanītā yayuste paramaṃ padam | badrike śṛṇvatāṃ teṣāṃ dhunyaṃ ca paśyatāmapi ||61 || sarveṣāmanyalokānāṃ vimānaṃ divamāviśat | camatkāro mahān jātaḥ kṛpayāyaṃ hareḥ prabhoḥ ||62|| paścasthaiśca kṛtānyūrdhvadaihikāni tataḥ param | te’pi virāgamāpannāḥ kathāṃ śrutvā yayustataḥ ||63|| nijānnijānālayām̐śca kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ pracakrire | kālena te yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ ||64|| badrike paramāścaryaṃ kathayāmi nibodha me | trivādanagare tvāsīt śāstā śāhavilāpanaḥ ||65|| tasya sampattayaścāsan vāṭīkṣetragṛhādikāḥ | aśvā vṛṣabhā gavayā uṣṭrāśca paśavo’bhavan ||66|| go’jāmahiṣya āsam̐śca bhṛtyāścāpi śatādhikā | grāmādhipaḥ khaṇḍarājaḥ śāhavilāpanastadā ||67|| aśvapālām̐śca gopālān vetanaiḥ saṃrarakṣa vai | kṣatriyaḥ sa hi śuśrāva kathotsavaṃ mahattamam ||68|| manaścakre tatra gantuṃ sāśvagopālakaiḥ saha | sajjo’bhavat sa tūrṇaṃ vai śrīsvāminyā striyā saha ||69|| śrīsvāminī satī patnī gavāṃ śataṃ nināya ha | dānadharmārthamevāpi dugdhapānārthamityapi ||4.65.70|| pratasthire te gṛhataḥ śarkarānagaraṃ yayuḥ | gopālāścāśvapālāśca tathā śāhavilāpanaḥ ||71 || śrīsvāminī tathā tasyāḥ sakhyo dāsyaḥ śataṃ tadā | sabhūṣāḥ sopakaraṇāḥ sopadāḥ sasamṛddhayaḥ ||72|| mahodyāne pracakruste svāvasathān yathāyatham | snātvā te darśanārthaṃ vai sopadāḥ prayayuḥ sabhām ||73|| kathāṃ śrutvā tataḥ pūjāmārārtrikaṃ pracakrire | rājā rājñī dhanavantastathā bhṛtyādayo’pi ca ||74|| nyadhurvyāsapuraḥsthāne bhūṣāmudrāmbarāṇi ca | phalapuṣpānnamiṣṭānnadugdhadaugdheyakāni ca ||75|| svaprakāśāyanako’pi lomaśaśca maharṣayaḥ | āśīrvādān dadustebhyo yayuścāvasathām̐stataḥ ||76|| evaṃ nityaṃ niyamitāḥ śṛṇvanti saṃhitākathām | rājaikadā niśi svapne dadarśa svaṃ śavaṃ prage ||77|| utthāya sabhayo bhūtvā kathāsthānaṃ samāgamat | nyavedayallomaśāya svāpnavṛttāntamulbaṇam ||78|| lomaśaḥ prāha rājānaṃ samāptāyuṣyakaṃ tadā | rājan karmasamāptiste jātā kathāniṣevaṇāt ||79|| mantraṃ gṛhāṇa nāmāpi gṛhṇa śrīparamātmanaḥ | sajjo bhava ca mokṣārthaṃ tyaja rāgaṃ tu bhautikam ||4.65.80|| ityuktaḥ sa tu śīghraṃ vai mantraṃ jagrāha nāma ca | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||8 1 || rājñīdāsyastathā dāsā jagṛhurmantramuttamam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||82|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa | bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāyaṇa ||83|| prabhonārāyaṇaśrīmādhavīnārāyaṇa prabho | jayākṛṣṇalalitānrāyaṇarādhāpate vibho ||84|| labdhvā mantraṃ bhajanaṃ te cakrurmitho nijālaye | rājā rājñī dadatuśca dānāni gajavājinām ||85 || gavāṃ suvarṇaratnānāṃ bhūṣāvastrādisampadām | sajjo bhūtvā pratīkṣāṃ tu rājā rājñīsamanvitaḥ ||86|| karoti śrīhareḥ samyag gantuṃ mokṣapadaṃ param | dvādaśyāṃ caitraśuklasya vimānenāgato hariḥ ||87|| satāṃ prasevayā śuddhaṃ bhaktaṃ rājñīsametakam | divyadehaṃ vidhāyaiva svāmīkṛṣṇonarāyaṇaḥ ||88|| tathānyān dāsadāsīśca bhaktisarvasvasaṃbhṛtāḥ | divyadehān vidhāyaiva niṣādya svavimānake ||89 || paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ ninye dhāmākṣaraṃ nijam | badrike tanmahāścaryaṃ vīkṣyānye bhṛtyadāsikāḥ ||4.65.9 0|| sarvadānāni datvaiva mokṣārthaṃ kṛtaniścayāḥ | jyeṣṭhāya tu kumārāya nāmnā bhāskarabhūtaye ||9 1|| rājyadhuraṃ vinirdiśya sajjāste muktaye’bhavan | bhejurnārāyaṇakṛṣṇaṃ tyaktānnabhojanādayaḥ ||92|| dinatrayānte bhagavān svāmīkṛṣṇonarāyaṇaḥ | kṛpayā tvāyayau tūrṇaṃ netuṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ nijam ||9 3|| vimānena samastām̐stān kṛtvā mūrchāsamanvitān | tyājayitvā tu dehām̐śca divyadehān vidhāya ca ||94|| ninye dhāmākṣaraṃ naijaṃ paśyatāṃ sarvadehinām | kumāro bhāskarabhūtiścakre tadaurdhvadaihikam ||95|| bhakto bhūtvā kathāṃ śrutvā bhāgyaṃ matvā paraṃ mahat | yayau trivādanagaraṃ śaśāsa nyāyataḥ sadā ||96|| bhaktyā kāle samāyāte pāvanaḥ sopi vai mudā | vāsanāśūnyahṛdayo vaṃśe nyasya dhuraṃ nijām ||97|| yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena vāhitaḥ | evaṃ badrīpriye lokairdṛṣṭā camatkṛtiḥ parā ||98|| mokṣadā pāpahantrī ca sākṣātkṛṣṇāṅghriyojikā | trivādanagare ye ye śuśruvustāṃ camatkṛtim ||99|| te’pi pārokṣyabhāvāḍhyā bhejuḥ kṛṣṇaṃnarāyaṇam | kṣīṇapāpā abhavam̐śca satāṃ sevāparāyaṇāḥ || 4.65.1 00|| satsaṃgena yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ tvante kṛpāśrayāḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktibhavedapi || 10 1|| aśvapālāśca gopālā ye ye cāsan trivādake | te’pi kṛṣṇaṃ bhajitvaiva yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ param || 1 02|| nikṛṣṭayonayaścāpi paśavo’jāgavādayaḥ | te’pi dugdhārpaṇayogairyayurdhāmākṣaraṃ prabhoḥ || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kathāśravaṇādinā lekhakasya viśālarekhasya sapatnīkasya, karaṇādyānāṃ kāyasthānāṃ bahūnāṃ, śāhavilāpanakṣatriyasya sapatnīdāsīdāsasya ca, mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 65 ||
<4.66> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ gṛdhrasya mokṣadām | pārāyaṇasthale nityaṃ satāmucchiṣṭabhojanam || 1 || gṛdhro jagdhvā tu madhyāhne muktimavāpa śāśvatīm | nyagrodhaṣaṇḍe jaraṭhā gṛdhrā āsan śatādhikāḥ || 2 || ābālavṛddhāḥ sarve sma vaṭaṣaṇḍe vasanti vai | uḍḍīyoḍḍīya gagane mārgayanti sma bhojanam || 3 || dūraṃ dūraṃ parākramya bhakṣayanti sma mārgitam | teṣāṃ pārāyaṇakāle mahotsavaḥ sadābhavat || 4 || nityaṃ yatra bhojanāni kurvantyasaṃkhyamānavāḥ | tatra pārāyaṇakṣetre bhojanānāṃ tu bhūmiṣu || 5 || ucchiṣṭāni patanti sma vividhānnāni badrike | bharjitānnāni śākāni miṣṭānnāni patanti ca || 6 || vaiṣṇavānāṃ paṃktayo vai yatra bhavantyaharniśam | sādhvīnāṃ paṃktayaścāpi sādhūnāṃ paṃktayastathā || 7 || bhavanti bhuñjate tatra prasādānnāni sādhavaḥ | taducchiṣṭāni pātrebhyaḥ patitāni tu yāni vai || 8 || pātrocchiṣṭāni cānnāni gṛdhrāste śataśaḥ sadā | paṃktyante bhuṃjate sarve tṛptā bhavanti cānvaham || 9 || ucchiṣṭakṣepaṇasthāne mahotkare’pi pakṣiṇaḥ | prakṣiptocchiṣṭaparyuṣitānnaśākāni bhuṃjate || 4.66.10 || śṛṇu badrīpriye caitraśukladvādaśikādine | svataḥprakāśo bhagavān vyāso madhyāhnake śubhe ||1 1 || bhuktvocchiṣṭaṃ pracikṣepa pārśve kṣetre sapātrakam | gṛdhrastveko hi jaraṭho vaṭāduḍḍīya cāgamat || 12|| abhakṣayat taducchiṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇaprasādamiśritam | tāvattasya samastāni naṣṭāni pātakāni vai || 1 3|| puṇyātmā tvabhavattūrṇaṃ karmāśayo’sya bhasmitaḥ | bahūnāṃ paśyatāṃ pakṣī papāta bhūtale drutam || 14|| nirgatya pakṣidehāt sa divyadehaścaturbhujaḥ | śrīhareḥ pārṣado bhūtvādṛśyata tatra cāmbare || 15|| vismitāḥ sādhavaḥ sarve tathānye vaiṣṇavā api | vīkṣya taṃ pārṣadarūpaṃ papracchuḥ sādhavastu tam || 16|| ko bhavān pakṣirūpo’pi pārṣadaṃ rūpamāptavān | vada sarvaṃ yathātathyaṃ nivartaya kutūhalam || 17|| ityevaṃ pārṣadaḥ śrutvovāca sādhūn samutsukaḥ | abhuvaṃ pūrvadeho’haṃ kauliko mānavo bhuvi || 18|| nāmnā daṇḍāraṇiścāsaṃ hiṃsācauryaparāyaṇaḥ | khādake nagare cāsaṃ mahākuṭumbavānaham || 19|| mama vṛddhasya vṛddho yastasya putrā daśābhavan | daśānāṃ śataśaścāsan śatānāṃ tu sahasrakam ||4.66.20|| kanyakāśca tathā hyāsam̐stāsāṃ vaṃśāḥ sahasrakam | khādakaṃ nagaraṃ sarvaṃ prāyaḥ kaulikaveśitam ||2 1|| te sarve’pi vayaṃ nityaṃ gṛhasthāḥ sukuṭumbinaḥ | akaravāma vṛttyarthaṃ kṛṣikarmāṇi nityadā ||22|| duṣkāle coṣṇakāle vā kurmaścauryaṃ prasahya vā | luṇṭanaṃ cāpaharaṇaṃ dhanānnāmbarasampadām ||23|| viprāṇāṃ vāpi sādhūnāṃ kṣatrāṇāṃ cānyadehinām | bhakṣayāmastadannādi dhārayāmo’mbarādikam ||24|| tena pāpena pāpiṣṭhā mṛtā vayaṃ tu ye ca ye | vṛddhā bālā yuvāno vā narā nāryaśca te khalu ||25|| sarve vayaṃ vaṭe gṛdhrā ime jātāḥ sma vaṃśajāḥ | yāmyaduḥkhānyanubhūya gṛdhrā jātā vaṭe tviha ||26|| teṣu sarveṣu vṛddho’haṃ cauro’bhavaṃ viśeṣataḥ | corayitvā muhusteṣāṃ poṣaṇaṃ saṃvyadhāṃ tadā ||27|| tena yāmyamahākaṣṭaṃ muktvātra gṛdhratāṃ gataḥ | vṛddhaḥ prācīnatamaśca bhavāmi bahuvatsaraḥ ||28|| vyāsasyocchiṣṭamāsādya hareḥ prasādamuttamam | dagdhapāmābhavaṃ naṣṭavāsanaśca drutaṃ tviha ||29|| muktadaśāṃ gataścāsmi muktaḥ pakṣiśarīrataḥ | prayāmi tvadya badarikāśramaṃ pāvanaṃ tataḥ ||4.66.30|| śvetadvīpaṃ prayāsyāmi vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca tataḥ param | evaṃ me mokṣaṇaṃ jātaṃ prasādasyaiva bhakṣaṇāt ||3 1|| prasādasya tu māhātmyaṃ mayā vaktuṃ na śakyate | mahāpāpāḥ prasādena mucyante cādhamā api ||32|| prasādasya tu māhātmyamati jānantyajādayaḥ | matsyo bhūtvā svayaṃ brahmā cakhāda suprasādakam ||33|| surāḥ prasādamicchanti pitaraḥ sutarāṃ sadā | pāpaghnaṃ puṇyadaṃ sattvavardhanaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā ||34|| prāṇā yeṣāṃ na niryānti mṛtyuduḥkhajuṣāṃ yadi | teṣāṃ prasādalābhena prāṇā niryānti vai drutam ||35|| bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ chāyā tasya na lumpati | na bādhante ḍākinīśākinīpiśācikāśca tam ||36|| prasādabhakṣabhaktānāṃ nirmalānyāntarāṇyapi | dhārmikāni pravartante tamaḥpāpakṣayāṇi ca ||37|| aprasādabhojino’tra dehaṃ sadā piśācakaḥ | prasādabhakṣabhaktasya tanuḥ sadā tu devatā ||38|| prasādabhojane dehe devā vasanti nityaśaḥ | prasādabhojināṃ divyaṃ śarīraṃ pāvanaṃ sadā ||39|| aprasādaprabhoktāraḥ pāpabhoktāra eva te | bhūtapretapiśācānnaṃ prasādavarjitaṃ hi yat ||4.66.40|| prasādabhojināṃ nityaṃ kṛpā kṛṣṇasya jāyate | kṛpayā sampadaḥ sarvā dehānte mokṣasampadaḥ ||41 || prasādabhojanaṃ nityaṃ nirguṇaṃ doṣavarjitam | api svādabharaṃ sarvaṃ niḥsvādaṃ tat sadā matam ||42|| kṛṣṇārpitā rasāḥ sarve bhuktā badhnanti te nahi | rūpāṇi yāni ramyāṇi surūpākṛtayaśca yāḥ ||43|| cākacakyayutāścāpi tejaḥprabhāsamanvitāḥ | kṛṣṇārpitāstu tā bhuktā naiva badhnanti nirguṇāḥ ||44|| gandhā uccāvacā ye ye tailasārādayo’pi ca | kastūrīkesarādyāśca karpūraṃ gandhasārakāḥ ||45|| kṛṣṇārpitā nirguṇāste bhuktā badhnanti naiva ha | śabdā ramyāḥ svarthabharā manoharāśca narmadāḥ ||46|| susvarā utsavapūrṇā ākarṣakāśca tāninaḥ | kṛṣṇārpitā nirguṇāste bhuktā badhnanti naiva ha ||47|| vāditrāṇi samastāni saṅgītāni ca gītayaḥ | ālāpāścārpitāḥ kṛṣṇe nirguṇā bandhavarjitāḥ ||48|| sparśāśca komalāḥ snigdhā mṛdavaḥ śītalā api | uṣṇā gamyā iṣṭavaryā mahānandapradāḥ sukhāḥ ||49|| cetanasthā jaḍasthā vā kṛṣṇārpitā na bandhadāḥ | saṃyogā vividhāścāpi kaṭhinā śithilāśca ye ||4.66.50|| dravāścāpi samastā ye snehā ye ca mithaḥ śubhāḥ | vijñānāni ca kāvyāni tarkāśca buddhayastathā ||51 || sukhaduḥkhe sarvavidhe sarvā icchāśca vāsanāḥ | dveṣā yatnāḥ kriyāḥ sarvā dharmādharmādayo’pi ye ||52|| bhāvanāśca samastā vai sarvakarmāṇi yāni vai | bhāvā abhāvāḥ śrīkṛṣṇe’rpitāste nirguṇāḥ sadā ||53||| tadbhoktāraṃ na badhnanti yato māyāvivarjitāḥ | māyāsattvaṃ rajaścāpi tamo’haṃmamatādayaḥ ||54|| svatvaṃ nidrā ca tandrā ca kṛṣṇe’rpitā tu nirguṇāḥ | naro nārī bālikā ca bālaḥ kanyā yuvā tathā ||55|| vṛddho vṛddhārpitāḥ kṛṣṇe nirguṇā mokṣabhāginaḥ | gāvo vṛṣā gajā uṣṭrā aśvā ajāḥ prajāstathā ||56|| gṛhaṃ sarvopakaraṇaṃ bhogyajātaṃ samastakam | veṣā bhūṣāḥ sampadaśca yānāni vāhanānyapi ||57|| raktāni maṇayaścāpi kaṇāḥ patrāṇi sarvathā | phalapuṣpāṇyarpitāni kṛṣṇe nirbandhanāni vai |||98|| snānaṃ dhyānaṃ dhāraṇā ca pūjā sevā pradānakam | vrataṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyamiṣṭaṃ vāpīkūpataḍāgakam ||59|| sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārpitaṃ divyaṃ nirguṇaṃ bandhavarjitam | pravāso bhāravāhitvaṃ bhṛtyatā dāsatā kṛtiḥ ||4.66.60|| śilpitā kārutā kṛṣṇasamarpitaṃ tu nirguṇam | kalākauśalyamatyarthaṃ navāviṣkaraṇānyapi ||61 || sādhanānyutsavānāṃ ca pratimāśca pṛthagvidhāḥ | śṛṃgārāṇi nirguṇāni kṛṣṇe’rpitāni sarvathā ||62|| pācanaṃ karṣaṇaṃ yānaṃ kartanaṃ lavanaṃ tathā | sīvanaṃ cāpi sandhānaṃ kṛṣṇārpitaṃ tu nirguṇam ||63|| śvasanaṃ darpaṇaṃ sparśaḥ svādaśca ghrāṇanaṃ tathā | bhogaḥ phalaṃ samastaṃ ca kṛṣṇārpitaṃ tu nirguṇam ||64|| vapanaṃ secanaṃ cābhyavardhanaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ tathā | poṣaṇaṃ grahaṇaṃ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārpitaṃ tu nirguṇam ||65|| mañjanaṃ kṣuvanaṃ cāpi mroḍanaṃ troṭanaṃ tathā | hasanaṃ ramaṇaṃ cāpi kṛṣṇārpitaṃ tu nirguṇam ||66|| vihāraśca samāptiścārambho vistāraṇaṃ tathā | saṃkocaśca vikāsaśca kṛṣṇārpitāṃstu nirguṇāḥ ||67|| jṛṃbhaṇaṃ pakṣaṇaṃ cāpi nimeṣonmeṣaṇe tathā | svapanaṃ kūrdanaṃ pātaḥ kṛṣṇārpitāstu nirguṇāḥ ||68|| dhāvanaṃ kramaṇaṃ nyāsaḥ sthairyamuḍuyanaṃ layaḥ | prakāśanaṃ yaśaḥ kīrtiḥ kṛṣṇārpitāstu nirguṇāḥ ||69|| kaṇḍanī peṣaṇī cullī jalakuṃbhī ca mārjanī | vardhanī śayanī koṣṭhī kṛṣṇārpitāstu nirguṇāḥ ||4.66.70 || mastakaṃ netrakarṇoraḥkaṇṭhahastodarādayaḥ | jaghanorusakthijānujaṃghāpādādayastathā ||71 || kṛṣṇārpitāṅgasarvasvaṃ nirguṇaṃ mokṣadaṃ bhavet | rugṇatā svāsthyamudayo vṛddhirhāniḥ praśāsanam ||72|| arjanaṃ vyavahāraśca kṛṣṇārpitāstu nirguṇāḥ | vyāpāro vikrayo vinimayaḥ krayo’pahāritā ||73|| bhikṣā copārjanaṃ vṛttirjīvikāyavyayau tathā | sadasad yat samastaṃ tat kṛṣṇārpitaṃ tu nirguṇam ||74|| strīpuṃnapuṃsakabhāvā dhātavaśca pravartanā | nivartanādyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇārpitā nirguṇamuktidāḥ ||75|| bandhaśūnyā harāvarpaṇamāptāḥ sarvasampadaḥ | mokṣāyaiva prajāyante kṛṣṇaprasannatāpradāḥ ||76|| yasya dravyaṃ kṛṣṇaśūnyaṃ naiva naiva guṇāstathā | yasya karma kṛṣṇaśūnyaṃ naiva naiva tathāstitā ||77|| na jīvanaṃ kṛṣṇaśūnyaṃ na prāṇāḥ kṛṣṇavarjitāḥ | na caitanyaṃ kṛṣṇaśūnyaṃ na varṇaḥ kṛṣṇavarjitaḥ ||78|| nāśramaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaśūnyo na tyāgaḥ kṛṣṇavarjitaḥ | na dīkṣā śrīkṛṣṇaśūnyā na mṛtyuḥ kṛṣṇavarjitaḥ ||79|| neṣaṇāḥ śrīkṛṣṇaśūnyāstasya sarvaṃ hi nirguṇam | divyaṃ kṛṣṇārthakaṃ sarvaṃ sarvaṃ mokṣapradaṃ hi tat ||4.66.80 || kṛṣṇaprasannatādaṃ tat tasya sarvaṃ virājate | so’pi prasādapātraṃ śrīkṛṣṇārpitastadīyakaḥ ||8 1 || kṛṣṇatādātmyamāpto vai mahābhāgavato hi saḥ | koṭikalyāṇabhūmiḥ saḥ sarvakalyāṇado’pi saḥ ||82||| adharmoddhārakaḥ sa syādaṃśāvatāra eva saḥ | sādhuḥ sa eva śrīkṛṣṇasampadvān mukta uttamaḥ ||83|| brahmaiva sa tu vijñeyo yaḥ śrīkṛṣṇārthakaḥ sadā | mūrtiḥ sā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavāsārthamandiram ||84|| taddehaḥ śrīkṛṣṇadehastanmanaḥ kṛṣṇamānasam | tadindriyāṇi śrīkṛṣṇendriyāṇyeva na vai pṛthak ||85|| tatkriyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakriyā na cetarāḥ | tatsarvasvaṃ kṛṣṇa eva tatpūjā kṛṣṇapūjanam ||86|| tatsevā śrīkṛṣṇasevā sa eva kṛṣṇamūrtikaḥ | tasya prasannatā kṛṣṇaprasannatā na saṃśayaḥ ||87|| tadvākyaṃ kṛṣṇavacanaṃ tadāśīḥ kṛṣṇakīrtitā | tasya prāptiḥ kṛṣṇaprāptirnāsti bhedo manāgapi ||88|| avatārāsta evoktā lokoddhārakarā bhuvi | taṃ bhajantu mahārājaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||89|| prayāmyahaṃ viśālāṃ ca prasādamātrabhojanaḥ | svasti vo’stu kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīnāthavallabhaḥ ||4.66.90|| hatyuktvā badrike gṛdhro divyo badrīśvaraṃ yayau | naranārāyaṇaṃ māṃ tu prāptastapaścakāra ha ||9 1 || tataḥ śvetadvīpadhāma yayau nārāyaṇāśritam | tato yayau sa vaikuṇṭhaṃ prāptapūrṇamanorathaḥ ||92|| atha tasmād brahmadhāma prayāsyatyakṣaraṃ padam | prabhonārāyaṇakṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti vai japan ||93|| ityevaṃ badrike jāto mokṣastasya prasādataḥ | tasmāt sarvaṃ karaṇīyaṃ kāraṇīyaṃ prasādajam ||94|| athānye śataśo gṛdhrā vaṭe prasādabhojinaḥ | kaulikasya purā sambandhino gṛdhragatiṃ gatāḥ ||95|| te’pi nityaṃ bhuṃjate sma prasādaṃ sādhuyoginām | tena kṣapitakarmāṇo’bhavan puṇyābhibhāginaḥ ||96|| dehāṃstiryagjātijātān tyaktvā divyaśarīriṇaḥ | bhūtvā śrībadarīnāthaṃ yayurdivyāśramaṃ tu nau ||97|| tatra taptvā tapaste ca yayuḥ śvetālayaṃ hareḥ | tatra nārāyaṇasevāṃ kṛtvā vaikuṇṭhakaṃ yayuḥ ||98|| te’pi yāsyanti paramaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ tataḥ param | prajñānārāyaṇapadmāśrīnārāyaṇajāpinaḥ ||99|| badri prasādavat kṛṣṇasattāṃ dhuliṃ ca pāvanīm | satāṃ pādajalaṃ pūtaṃ pītvā yānti paraṃ divam || 4.66.10 0|| satāṃ prasevayā pūtā na kalpante bhavāya te | satāṃ mūrtiḥ kṛṣṇamūrtiḥ kathā kṛṣṇavacaḥ śubham || 101 || kṛṣṇārpitaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vai tat sevyaṃ netarat kvacit | bhuktirmuktirbhavettena śrīkṛṣṇāptirbhavetsadā || 1 02|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya tiryagyonipradaṃ tvagham | naśyatyeva paraṃ puṇyaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1 03|| kṛṣṇe bhaktirjāyate’pi satsu prītiḥ prajāyate | sarvārpaṇādibhāvaḥ syāt tanmayatvaṃ tato bhavet || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne pūrvajanmani daṇḍāraṇināmakaulikasya gṛdhrajanmani kathāsthale bhagavatsādhuprasādocchiṣṭabhojino mokṣaṇaṃ, tatsambandhigṛdhrāṇāmapi prasādabhojanena mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 66 ||
<4.67> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ sarvāghahāriṇīm | taṭādhiṣṭhānake grāme govāro nāmato’bhavat || 1 || gavāṃ pālaḥ kuṭumbāḍhyaścārayatyeva gāḥ sadā | gavāṃ pañcaśataṃ sīmni kṣetreṣu pīḍakeṣu ca || 2 || sasyabhūmiṣu ghāsāḍhyakṣitāvucchrāyakeṣu ca | nītvā nityaṃ cārayati govyāpāraśca jīvati || 3 || dugdhadadhyājyavikretā govāraḥ sa prajīvati | karoti cāparaṃ kāryaṃ grāmīṇagopracāraṇam || 4 || grāmīṇānāṃ gavāṃ cāpi cāraṇaṃ svīyadhenubhiḥ | sākaṃ sīmasu sarvatra vṛttikāṃ labhate tathā || 5 || evaṃ nirvāhamāpnoti kintu lobhābhikarṣitaḥ | anyāsāṃ tu gavāṃ dugdhaṃ dohayitvā ca vikrayam || 6 || kvacit kvacit karotyeva dugdhacauryaṃ tathāvidham | catuḥśatāni gāvastu grāmīṇānāṃ bhavanti tāḥ || 7 || nijā gāvaḥ śataṃ ceti dugdhadāstu tadardhikāḥ | grāmīṇānāṃ gavāṃ nityaṃ pañcānāṃ dugdhameva saḥ || 8 || corayatyeva madhyāhnottaraṃ sīmnyeva pratyaham | nityamevaṃ rasacauryaṃ karoti gosatīṣvapi || 9 || dogdhrīṣu ca svakīyāsu tṛṣṇātanturhi durjaraḥ | rasastainyajapāpena kālāntare mṛto vane || 4.67.1 0|| jalānnarahitaḥ so’yaṃ vane mārjāratāṃ gataḥ | śarkarānagarābhyāśe mārjāro bhramati prage || 1 1|| yadvā rātrau bhojanārthaṃ samanveṣaṇatatparaḥ | samāyāti mahodyānaṃ gandhena karṣitastataḥ || 1 2|| āyayau bhojanocchiṣṭotkarapuñjasamīpagaḥ | tatra kṛṣṇaprasādānnabhojināṃ sādhuyoginām || 1 3|| ucchiṣṭaṃ prāptavān vanyabiḍālako mudaṃ gataḥ | bhakṣayāmāsa tṛptaśca yayau rātrau vanāntaram || 14|| evaṃ karoti nityaṃ sa miṣṭagariṣṭabhojanam | tenālasaḥ sa sañjāto māsānte puṣṭadehavān || 15|| utkarasyaiva pārśvasthatṛṇapuñje divāniśam | vāsaṃ sa rocayāmāsa nirbhīkaḥ stabakeṣvapi || 16|| stambeṣu ca kvacidasti svapiti bhakṣaṇottaram | kvacid divā samāyāti bahiḥ śvādivivarjite || 17|| caitraśuklatrayodaśyāṃ bhoktumutkarake sa tu | madhyāhnottaravelāyāmāgato bhayavarjitaḥ || 18|| ucchiṣṭaṃ bhuktavām̐statra mūrchāṃ jagāma vai tataḥ | vyasurjātaḥ kṣaṇāt tasmād divyaḥ pumān vyajāyata || 19|| suravad divyadehaśca sarvāṃgaśobhanaḥ śubhaḥ | ucchiṣṭamārjakā dṛṣṭvā mahāścaryamidaṃ tataḥ ||4.67.20|| papracchustaṃ devajanaṃ kastvaṃ mārjāratāṃ gataḥ | kathaṃ devatvamāpanno namastubhyaṃ vadātra naḥ ||21 || sa cāhocchiṣṭahārām̐stu taṭādhiṣṭhānake pure | govāranāmakaścāhaṃ gavāṃ cāro’bhavaṃ purā ||22|| grāmīṇānāṃ dhenavaśca dogdhrayaḥ sucāritā mayā | kintu tāsāṃ sudugdhāni sīmni pralobhinā mayā ||23|| coritāni dohitāni vikrītāni ca cauryataḥ | ājīvanaṃ kṛtaṃ cauryaṃ tena pāpena vai mṛtaḥ ||24|| yāmyapure duḥkhamayīryātanāḥ samalokya ca | bhuktvā duḥkhānyasaṃkhyāni tato mārjāratāṃ gataḥ ||25|| jalānnaśūnyadeśe vai kṣudhātṛṣātipīḍitaḥ | śvapadānāṃ bhautiyukto bhramāmi rakṣayam̐stu mām ||26|| mārgayāmi bhakṣyameva jalaṃ cāpi miled yadi | aṭan vanāni cāgacchaṃ vane sindhutaṭe’dhunā ||27|| jalayukte pradeśe’haṃ nivāsaṃ samarocayam | rātrau rātrau vicarāmi bhakṣyalābhāya kheṭakān ||28|| mahodyānābhibhūmau cāgacchaṃ daivānuyojitaḥ | utkaraṃ dṛṣṭavān rātrāvucchiṣṭabahulaṃ tadā ||29|| abhakṣayaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ ca tṛptiṃ śāntimavāpa ca | nityamevaṃ bhakṣyamatra prāptaṃ mayā divāniśam ||4.67.30|| puṣṭiṃ prāpto’tra dehasya mahālasyaṃ gato’pi ca | alasaḥ sannivāsaṃ cārocayaṃ tṛṇapuñjake ||3 1|| nātidūre stabakeṣu stambeṣvapi bhramāmyaham | bhuktvā cātra prayāmyevaṃ māso’tra me vyavartata ||32|| ucchiṣṭaṃ bhuktavānnityaṃ kṛṣṇaprasādabhojinām | sādhūnāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca tenāghāni gatāni me ||33|| naṣṭapāpo bhavāmyadya prasādocchiṣṭabhojanaḥ | puṇyavān bhāgyavānasmi jātaścādya bhuvastale ||34|| kathāsthalīsthasādhūnāṃ prasādaṃ prāptavānaham | devabhāvaṃ cādhigatastyaktvā biḍālavigraham ||35|| prayāmi vyomacāro’haṃ svargaṃ mahendrapālitam | tatra śatayugaṃ sthitvā yāsyāmi badarīvanam ||36|| śvetadvīpaṃ tataścāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca tataḥ param | tatokṣarapadaṃ divyaṃ prayāsyāmi ca saṃśayaḥ ||37|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ | sādhūnāṃ suprasādasyocchiṣṭabhogaphalaṃ tvidam ||38|| jātaṃ me sarvathā lokā yāsyāmi svargamuttamam | svasti vo’stu namo vo’stvityuktvā divaṃ yayau drutam ||39|| ucchiṣṭamārjakāḥ sarve mahāścaryaṃ prapedire | aho prasādamāhātmyaṃ paśūnāṃ devatākaram ||4.67.40|| viditvā te kathāyāṃ vai kathānte cāhurutsukāḥ | sarve jñātvā menire tāṃ kṛpāṃ kṛṣṇasya sarvathā ||41 || śṛṇu badrīpriye devi ṭhaṭhṭholasya kathāṃ tathā | vastracauro’bhavaddhūrtaḥ ṭhaṭṭholākhyo vaṇigjanaḥ ||42|| hanūdarākhyanagare vastravyāpāravān sadā | vastrāpaṇād vastrajātīnyabhikrīṇāti nityadā ||43|| vikrīṇāti ca tānyeva vyāpāraṃ prakaroti ca | kvacit kvacid vastracauryaṃ karoti paravastrataḥ ||44|| kraye cauryaṃ vikraye’pi parakośebhya ityapi | granthicauryaṃ karotyeva yathā jānāti netaraḥ ||45|| vastracauryotthapāpena dāridryaṃ samajāyata | annavastrādihīnaḥ sa vyajāyata śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||46|| kuṭumbapoṣaṇāśakto vicittaḥ so’bhavam̐stataḥ | unmattaḥ sa gṛhaṃ tyaktvābhramad grāmāntare’pi ca ||47|| prārabdhavaśatāpanno jvarāviṣṭobhavattaḥ | mṛto nirjanadeśe’sau dehaṃ kākā abhakṣayan ||48|| vastracauryasya pāpena yāmyapuraṃ gato’bhavat | tatra bhuktvā narakān sa vane jambukatāṃ gataḥ ||49|| kṣudhāvyāpto vastrahīnaḥ śītoṣṇapīḍitaḥ śaṭhaḥ | dhūrtasvabhāvayuktaḥ sa jambukaḥ śarkarāpuram ||4.67.50|| adūravanatastatra kathābhyāśamupāyayau | rātrau bhojanalabdhīcchāpreritaḥ paryaṭan svayam ||51|| utkaraṃ khādyasampannamucchiṣṭasañcayānvitam | prāpa cakhāda tatrānnaṃ prasādocchiṣṭamujjhitam ||52|| satāṃ prasādocchiṣṭaṃ ca bubhuje tṛptipūrvakam | evaṃ nityaṃ bhuktavān sa badrike cotkarojjhitam ||53|| tena pāpāni naṣṭāni paśujanmārthakānyapi | pūrvajāni samastāni nūtnajanmāni yānyapi ||54|| sarvapāpāni naṣṭāni vāsanāśca kṣayaṃ gatāḥ | śuddho jātaḥ śṛgālo yat prasādo bheṣajaṃ satām ||55||| janmarogaharaḥ sarvavāsanākṣayakṛttathā | hareḥ satāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ prasādo bheṣajaṃ mahat ||56|| saṃsārarogamagnānāṃ prasādo roganāśakaḥ | brahmasvāsthyapradaścāpi svargasaukhyapradastathā ||57|| paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ cāpi kīṭānāṃ kṣudradehinām | śākhināṃ tṛṇajātīnāmapi pāpavināśakaḥ ||58|| svargadaḥ puṇyado mokṣapradaścāpi prasādakaḥ | divyadṛṣṭiprado divyagatipradaḥ prasādakaḥ ||59|| prasādānnaṃ prasādāpo bhuktaṃ pītāḥ pramokṣadāḥ | pitaro mānavā devāḥ pibanti bhuñjate tataḥ ||4.67.60|| hareḥ prasādaṃ muktyarthaṃ satāṃ
