prasādamityapi | evaṃ bhuktvā nityameva jambukaḥ śuddhatāṃ gataḥ ||61|| badrike caitrapūrṇāyāṃ madhyandinottaraṃ sa tu | bhakṣayāmāsa cocchiṣṭaṃ mūrchāmavāpa tatkṣaṇam ||62|| tāvajjambukadehāttu puruṣo devarūpavān | sudivyaḥ prāvirabhavat sarvatejo’bhibhāsuraḥ ||63|| karmacāraistathānyaiḥ saṃvīkṣitaḥ sa tadāmbare | pṛṣṭaḥ kastvaṃ kathaṃ devo jambukādvai vyajāyathāḥ ||64|| sa prāhāhaṃ vaṇigjātirhanūdarapurālayaḥ | purāsaṃ ṭhaṭṭholakākhyo vastravyāpāravān sadā ||65|| viśvastānāṃ cāpaṇebhyo vastracauryaparo’bhavam | vastrakośebhya evāpi granthikācauryatatparaḥ ||66|| evaṃ cauryaprapāpaiśca dāridryaṃ prāptavām̐stataḥ | unmattaścābhavaṃ mṛtyuṃ gato bhraman vanāntike ||67|| dehaṃ tvabhakṣayan kākā gṛdhrāśca jambukā mama | yāmyaduḥkhāni saṃbhuktvā pāpaleśena jambukaḥ |||8||| vane’trāsmi prasaṃbhūtaḥ kṣudhāviṣṭo bhramāmi ca | vastrahīnaḥ sadā duḥkhī bhojanārthamihotkaram ||69|| āgatya pratyahaṃ cānnaṃ bhunajmyucchiṣṭamuttamam | hareḥ prasādajaṃ cānnaṃ satāmucchiṣṭamuttamam ||4.67.70|| pāvanaṃ pāpahāraṃ ca nityaṃ bhuktvāghavarjitaḥ | pāvano vāsanāhīno jāto’smi puṇyavānaham ||71 || kathāprasaṃgataścātra mayā prāptaṃ subhojanam | yenāhaṃ devatārūpo jāto’smi ca divaṃgataḥ ||72|| uṣitvā suciraṃ mārge tato yāsyāmi mokṣaṇam | ityuktvā prayayau badri devo bhūtvā divaṃ tadā ||73|| āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptāḥ karmacārāstadā janāḥ | vividuśca prasādasya māhātmyaṃ svargamokṣadam ||74|| śṛṇu badrīpriye paścādāścaryaparamaṃ manaḥ | abhavat karmacārāṇāṃ prasādānnādibhakṣaṇe ||75|| māhātmyasaṃvidaste ca prasādaṃ karmacāriṇaḥ | pāpanāśakaraṃ jñātvā cakhadurbhāvasaṃbhṛtāḥ ||76|| teṣāṃ vai karmacārāṇāṃ nirmalānyāntarāṇi vai | indriyādīnyabhavam̐śca hṛdayāni śubhāni ca ||77|| pāpaśūnyāni jātāni śreṣṭhavivekavanti ca | teṣāṃ tadābhavan hṛtsu saṃkalpā mokṣahetave ||78|| mantrāṇāṃ grahaṇe cāpi satāṃ prasevane’pi ca | nāmnāṃ kṛṣṇasya raṭane kīrtane paramātmanaḥ ||79|| atha te vai śataṃ karmacārāḥ sevāparāyaṇāḥ | jagṛhuḥ paramaṃ mantraṃ nāmadhunyaṃ ca kīrtanam ||4.67.80|| svataḥprakāśāyanato jāpaṃ cakruśca kīrtanam | nityaṃ kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ kṛtvā kurvanti kīrtanam ||8 1|| evaṃ te śraddhayā yuktā mantramāhātmyavedinaḥ | prasādasya satāṃ sevāyāśca māhātmyavedinaḥ ||82|| bhaktyā kṛṣṇasya bhajanaṃ cakrire bhojanottaram | māsānte bhajatāṃ teṣāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prasannatāṃ gataḥ ||83|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīkāntavallabhaḥ | ākāśādāyayau tūrṇaṃ svarṇavimānavāhanaḥ ||84|| prasannamānaso divyaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ | lakṣmyā juṣṭo lalitayā māṇikyā parisevitaḥ ||85|| rādhayā japayā padmāvatyā ca prajñayārcitaḥ | karmacārairnaraiḥ sarvaistathā karmaparāyaṇaiḥ ||86|| tadanyamānavaiścāpi yoṣidbhiḥ karmajuṣṭibhiḥ | dṛṣṭaḥ śrībhagavān ramyaḥ sarvakāmārthapūrakaḥ ||87|| nato muhurjayaśabdairvardhitaścākṣatādibhiḥ | pūjito hārdakusumairvimānād bhuvamāgamat ||88|| prāha sarvān prasaṃvīkṣya karmacārāgramānavam | gṛhṇannāma hariṃ prāha sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tadā ||89|| bho svarṇāñjana bhṛtya tvaṃ pavitro’si prasādataḥ | manye nārīnarāḥ sarve prasādabhojino’pi ca ||4.67.90|| kathāsevāparāḥ santi pāvanā gatakalmaṣāḥ | muktiyogyāḥ samastā vai sarvānnetuṃ mamākṣaram ||91||| āgato’pi samāyāntu sarve me śāśvatālayam | ityuktā badrike sarve karmacārā narāḥ striyaḥ ||92|| sajjā halahalāśabdairvimānaṃ prati dudruvuḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇenaite vārikaṇaiḥ prasiñcitāḥ ||93|| mūrchāṃ labdhvā tanūstyaktvā bhūtvā sudivyavigrahāḥ | vimānamadhiruhyaite divyā dhāmākṣaraṃ yayuḥ ||94|| vaiśākhakṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ | śataṃ narāḥ śataṃ nāryo divyā muktāḥ sadābhavan ||95|| jayanādān prakurvanto modapramodarañjitāḥ | śrāvayanto janān sarvān kirtanaṃ te yayustadā ||96|| prabhonārāyaṇakṛṣṇamālataunrāyaṇa prabho | jayākṛṣṇalalitānrāyaṇarādhāpate vibho ||97|| evaṃ tālīrvādayantaḥ kurvantaḥ kilakilāṭikāḥ | āhvayanto bhūtalasthān yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ he te ||98|| badrike śrīhareścāyaṃ prasādaḥ kṛpayānvitaḥ | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ dadātyeva tatheṣṭaṃ pradadātyapi ||99|| bhajatāṃ bhagavantaṃ vai na nyūnaṃ tvavaśiṣyate | sevatāṃ sādhūvaryāṃśca sarvaṃ pūrṇaṃ pravartate || 4.67.10 0|| raṭatāṃ śrīharernāma bhasmībhavantyaghāni vai | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā || 10 1|| ityevaṃ japatāṃ mantraṃ jāyante puṇyakoṭayaḥ | smaratāṃ śrīhariṃ badri sākṣāt kṛṣṇo’bhiyāti ca || 10 2||| arpayatāṃ samastaṃ ca gatirdhāmnyakṣare’sti ca | svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmānnayatyetānnijālayam || 1 03|| paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ cāpi smaratāṃ mokṣadaṃ tvidam | sarveṣṭapūrakaṃ badri śāśvatānandadāyakam ||104|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne pūrvajanmani dhenupālasya govārābhidhasya mārjāratāṃ gatasya, pūrvabhave ṭhaṭṭholākhyavaṇigjanasya śṛgālatā prāptasya, svarṇāñjanādiśatadvayakarmacārinaranārīṇāṃ ca, prasādabhojanena sevākathādinā ca, mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 67 ||
<4.68> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ cānyāṃ hitāvahām | bharavāṭo’bhavadgrāme gundrake paramīrakaḥ || 1 || paramīrābhidhaḥ so’yamajāsahasrapālakaḥ | ajāmātrapayovṛttyā tathorṇavikrayādibhiḥ || 2 || ajāvikrayavṛttyā ca jīvatyeva kuṭumbavān | ajāmāṃsāśanaścāpi tathājābālabhakṣakaḥ || 3 || evaṃvidho’bhavat pāpī sadājāpaśujīvanaḥ | cārayatyeva sarvājāḥ sīmakṣetrādiṣu nṛṇām || 4 || sasvāmikeṣu kṣetreṣu sasyaghāsatṛṇāni ca | yāni tānyapi cauryeṇa cārayatyapi vai niśi || 5 || evaṃ doṣakaraścāyaṃ bharavāṭo’ghasaṃbhṛtaḥ | dharmakarmādihīnaḥ sa kālapāśavaśaṃgataḥ || 6 || yayau yamālayaṃ yāmyairnītaśca tatra raurave | asipatravane kālapāśe sandaśake tathā || 7 || agnijvāle narakeṣu kṣipto lālāśane’pi ca | yāmyaduḥkhānyanubhūya bhūtale śyenatāṃ gataḥ || 8 || araṇye śyenapakṣī sa jātaḥ pāpāvaśeṣataḥ | sa tūḍḍīya vanād vanāntaraṃ sindhutaṭe’gamat || 9 || prāpto’yaṃ śarkarābhūmiṃ yatra kathā pravartate | taruṣaṇḍeṣu viśrāntiṃ lebhe madhyāhnake tadā || 4.68.1 0|| tatra tatra ca caṭakā mārgayan tūtkare sthitāḥ | bhakṣayantīścaṭakāḥ sa vyalokayat sudūrataḥ || 1 1|| sādhūcchiṣṭaudanakaṇān kṛṣṇaprasādarūpiṇaḥ | bhakṣayantīrbhakṣyacittāścaṭakā vīkṣya vai drutam ||1 2|| utpapāta drumāttūrṇaṃ papāta caṭakopari | sahasraśaścaṭakāstā uḍḍīya bhayato drutam || 1 3|| utpeturambaraṃ tvekāṃ dhṛtavān bhakṣyamuttamam | cañcvā tāṃ mārayāmāsa tāvaccaṭakāvarṣmaṇaḥ || 14|| viniryayau divyanārī sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā | svargasya devatā yadvat kanyā tejasvinī śubhā ||15|| puṣpamālāṃ kare dhṛtvā sāpsaraḥsundarī drutam | kathāmaṇḍapamāgatya vyomamārgeṇa pūjanam || 16|| pracakre śrīprabhe badri saṃhitāyāḥ samutsukā | vilokitā samastaiśca maṇḍapasthairjanaistadā ||17|| pṛṣṭā kā tvaṃ natā cāpi pratyuvāca janān prati | caṭakāhaṃ prasādānnabhakṣaṇāt pāpavarjitā || 18|| pavitrā puṇyasaṃyuktā bhavāmyadya janāstviha | satāmucchiṣṭamāsādyābhavaṃ svargāya devatā || 19|| apsarovaratāṃ prāptā svargaṃ prayāmi cādhunā | caturyugaṃ divi sthitvā śrīsaṃhitārhaṇodbhavam ||4.68.20|| puṇyamāsādya yāsyāmi vaikuṣṭhaṃ muktavigrahā | śyeno’yaṃ tu purā cāsīdbharavāṭo hyajāpatiḥ ||21 || ahamāsamajā tasya mṛtātra caṭakābhavam | tena dhṛtā mṛtā cāsmi prayāmi svargamuttamam ||22|| anyāścaṭakā uḍḍīya prayātāścāmbaraṃ drutam | tā api bharavāṭasyābhavannajādimaṇḍalam ||23|| tāḥ sarvā api kālena prasādabhakṣikā yataḥ | niṣpāpāḥ puṇyavatyaśca prayāsyanti paraṃ padam ||24|| śyeno’pi mama dehasya prasādapāvitasya vai | bhakṣaṇena puṇyabalo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||25|| śanaiḥ śanaiḥ kaṇabhakṣī bhaviṣyatyutkare sthitaḥ | prasādakaṇabhug bhūtvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ sa prayāsyati ||26|| ityuktvā caṭakā badri natvā saṃpūjya cāmṛtam | vāri pītvā yayau svargaṃ sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ parī ||27|| mahāścaryamabhūtteṣāṃ paśyatāṃ dehināṃ tadā | badrike cātha caṭakāṃ śyenaḥ sa bubhuje tadā ||28|| odanaṃ susugandhaṃ ca prasādocchiṣṭamityapi | bubhuje’nyānnakaṇakān śṛtān svādūn sumodavān ||29|| miṣṭānnakhaṇḍakām̐ścāpi ghṛtapakvān surandhitān | kaccarasthān nityamevamāgatya śyena āda tān ||4.68.30|| pūtātmā cābhavacchyenastatyāja māṃsabhakṣaṇam | jātismaro’bhavattena mokṣamaicchannijātmanaḥ ||3 1|| caṭakānāṃ tathā mokṣamaikṣat purājajanmanām | nityaṃ śyenastaruṣaṇḍe pratīkṣan caṭakāgamam ||32|| pracchannastiṣṭhati kroḍe divase cotkaronmukhaḥ | caṭakāśca samāyānti prasādocchiṣṭavāñcchayā ||33|| bhakṣayantyekacittāśca tāvatpatati pakṣirāṭa | caṭakaṃ vā caṭakāṃ vā samādatte’danāya saḥ ||34|| caṭakāpi mṛtā tūrṇaṃ devo vā devatā tadā | bhūtvā yātyambaraṃ svargaṃ prayātyeva mudāvyayam ||35|| evaṃ nityaṃ prakurvāṇaścaikadāha tarau sthitaḥ | caṭakā yūyamevādāvajā āsta śubhā mama || 36|| karmayogena janmātra bhavatīnāṃ hi vartate | mayā pūrvaṃ bhavatīnāṃ dugdhānyatithaye tathā ||37|| sādhubhyo dharmakāryārthaṃ nārāyaṇāya caikadā | arpitāni śivarātryāṃ śivasnānārthamityataḥ ||38|| tena puṇyapratāpena bhavatyaścaṭakāstviha | sañjātā api kṛṣṇasya prasādocchiṣṭabhakṣikāḥ ||39|| pavitrāḥ puṇyaśālinyo bhavathaiva divārthikāḥ | smarantu pūrvajanmādya spṛṣṭvā māṃ bharavāṭakam ||4.68.40|| śyenātmānaṃ tato yāntu divaṃ vaikuṇṭhamityapi | śrīsaṃhitākathāṃ śrutvā prapūjya vācakaṃ tathā ||41|| sādhūn sampūjya divyān vai mokṣadān yāntu mokṣaṇam | ityevaṃ badrike jātismaraḥ śyeno jagāda tān ||42|| te’pi sarve caṭakāśca narā nāryastadā śubhām | śyenagiraṃ samākarṇya mahāścaryapuraḥsarāḥ ||43|| sasmaruḥ pūrvajanmāni bharavāṭasya tā ajāḥ | tadā viśvāsamāpannā nemuḥ śyenaṃ purā patim ||44|| śyeno’pi satkṛtastaiśca samāyayau tamutkaram | militaścaṭakebhyaśca caṭakābhyaśca sādaram ||45|| jātismarāḥ samastāste vṛttāntān jagadurmithaḥ | utsavaṃ menire tatra bubhujire prasādakam ||46|| ahiṃsāvratamāsthāya nyūṣustarugaṇe mithaḥ | ucchiṣṭaṃ bhakṣayantaste śṛṇvantaśca kathāmṛtam ||47|| māsaṃ mitho’vasan tāvanmṛtyusteṣāmupāyayau | sarve kṣapitakarmāṇo niṣpāpāścaṭakādayaḥ |||48||| vaiśākhakṛṣṇadvādaśyāṃ madhyāhnottarameva ha | prasādocchiṣṭabhakṣāste śyenena sahasā saha ||49|| tyaktadehā abhavam̐śca babhūvurdevajātayaḥ | sahasraśaḥ surā devyaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ||4.68.50|| tannetā bharavāṭo’pi deveśvaro vyajāyata | gṛhītakaramālāste gṛhītakusumāstathā ||51|| saṃhitāṃ te prapūjyāpi vyāsaṃ prapūjya vai drutam | dhṛtvā dhūliṃ kathābhūmerjanitvāścaryamuttamam ||52|| jayaśabdānuccaranto yayuḥ svargaṃ sahasraśaḥ | badrike te divo’nte ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ dhāma śobhanam ||53|| prayāsyanti mahābhāgā muktā muktānikāstadā | tatra nārāyaṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ prasevya kṛpayā hareḥ ||54|| golokaṃ saṃprayāsyanti rādhākṛṣṇakṛpālayāḥ | tatra prasādya rādhāṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ prasādya vai tataḥ ||55|| prayāsyantyakṣaraṃ dhāma paramaṃ śāśvataṃ sukham | ityetat kathitaṃ tubhyaṃ māhātmyaṃ tu kathodbhavam ||56|| prasādasyāpi māhātmyaṃ yasya pāṭhācchruterapi | bhuktirmuktirdivaṃ sveṣṭaṃ labhet kṛṣṇakṛpālavāt ||57|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne’jāpālabharavāṭasya śyenajanmani, ajānāṃ caṭakājanmasu ca, hareḥ sādhūnāṃ ca prasādocchiṣṭabhakṣaṇalābhena kathālābhena ca mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 68 ||
<4.69> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāmanyāṃ supāvanīm | kapotāścāyayurvyomnā daśotkarānnavāñcchayā || 1 || kathāmaṇḍapamāsādya kṣaṇaṃ tasthurghaṭadhvaje | niṣedurmaṇḍape śāntāḥ kathāśravaṇahetave || 2 || jātismarāśca te sarve kathānte dvādaśīdine | vaiśākhakṛṣṇe pakṣe vai madhyānhottarameva ha || 3 || pākaśālābhyāśabhūmau bhojanālayabhūtale | vīkṣya lokām̐stu bhuñjānān sādhūn sādhvīśca vaiṣṇavān || 4 || āśayocchiṣṭalabdheste samuḍḍīya punaḥ punaḥ | maṇḍapopari tiṣṭhanti niṣīdanti samīhayā || 5 || tāvanmiṣṭaudanādyaṃ ca bhakṣyaṃ pakvānnamuttamam | ucchiṣṭaṃ sādhusādhvyaśca cikṣipuścotkare tataḥ || 6 || kapotā daśa śīghraṃ nirbhīkā bhakṣyārthamāyayuḥ | prasādaṃ sahasā bhuktvā pītvā sūpaṃ jalaṃ tathā || 7 || tṛptāstuṣṭāḥ prasannāśca babhūvurgatakalmaṣāḥ | pāvanā dhanyabhāgyāḍhyā menire puṇyamuttamam || 8 || uḍḍīya te vṛkṣaṣaṇḍe niṣaṇṇā jagadurmithaḥ | aho bhāgyaṃ tu naḥ śreṣṭhaṃ prasādo’dya hareḥ satām || 9 || ucchiṣṭo labdha utkṛṣṭo bhakṣitaḥ pāpanāśakṛt | pūtā adya tu jātāḥ sma pakṣiṇo bhāgyaśālinaḥ || 4.69.10 || śrutāsmābhiḥ kathā divyā mokṣadā saṃhitātmikā | aho bhāgyaṃ mānavānāṃ ye śṛṇvanti sadā kathām || 1 1|| aho bhāgyamatithīnāṃ prasādaṃ bhuṃjate tu ye | aho bhāgyaṃ tu kīṭānāmadantyucchiṣṭamatra ye || 1 2|| aho bhāgyaṃ paśūnāṃ ca ye’dantyucchiṣṭamatra vai | dhanyeyaṃ bhūmikā mokṣakarī jātā tu pāvanī || 1 3|| dhanyā sindhuḥ sudhāsindhusamādya vartate bhuvi | vadantyevaṃ kapotāste tacchrutaṃ tvekasādhunā ||14|| nāmnā kṛṣṇavirāmeṇa bhūtarutābhivedinā | tena pṛṣṭāḥ kapotāste premṇā jijñāsayā drutam || 19|| ke bhavantaḥ kapotā yat prasādotkarṣavedinaḥ | hareḥ satāṃ ca māhātmyavido divyā ivottamāḥ || 16|| jātismarāḥ kapotāste prāhurvayaṃ purā kṣitau | ekagrāmanivāsā vai sārthavāṭetijātijāḥ || 17|| āsma vai mṛttikāpuryāṃ dāridryadoṣapīḍitāḥ | daśaiva navakuṭṭākhye nagare jīvikecchayā || 18|| agacchāma ca tatrāpi bhṛtyatāyāṃ dhanigṛhe | dhaninā nijakāryārthaṃ yojitā vetanena vai || 1 9|| sarve vayaṃ tu kārpāsavyāpāre tena yojitāḥ | kārpāsānāmānayane grāmāntarebhya ityapi ||4.69.20|| kārpāsānāṃ vikraye ca kraye’pi yojitā vayam | ekadā kṛtā ntrāśca vayaṃ tu dhanalālasāḥ ||2 1 || jānanto bhūmigaṃ dravyaṃ śreṣṭhino rāmavarcasaḥ | rātrau viśvāsamāpannaṃ samastā rāmavarcasam ||22|| ekalaṃ galapāśena rurudhimātinirdayāḥ | rāmavarcā mṛtiṃ prāpto vayamādāya nāṇakam ||23|| niryayima nagarādvai tena pāpena vai pathi | caurairmilitairbahubhirluṇṭitā māritāstathā ||24|| śavāḥ kṣiptāśca garteṣu phalaṃ prāptā drutaṃ tadā | yamadūtairdhṛtāḥ pāśairnītā yāmyapuraṃ daśa ||25|| bhuktavanto yātanāni kuṇḍeṣu pātitā yamaiḥ | nirgatya ca tato jātā vane vayaṃ tu bhallukāḥ ||26|| mṛtāstato vānarāśca jātā saha daśaiva tu | punarmṛtāśca kākā vai jātāstataḥ sahaiva ca ||27|| mṛtāḥ kapotakā jātā vartāmaścātra bhakṣakāḥ | ucchiṣṭabhojino jātā jātismarāstu pāvanāḥ ||28|| bhavatprasādocchiṣṭasyādanādadyāghanāśanam | jātaṃ sarvavidhānāṃ vai pāpānāṃ vinivartanam ||29|| uktaṃ sarvaṃ smarāmo’dya kṛtapāpaphalādikam | bhāti no’dya paraṃ śreyo bhavanāśo bhaviṣyati ||4.69.30|| kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyaṃ prasādabhojanam | puṇyaṃ satāṃ darśanaṃ ca satsaṃgo mokṣadaḥ sadā ||3 1|| sādho bhavatprasaṃgena nirbhīkāḥ smo vayaṃ tviha | mokṣārthaṃ sādhanaṃ yattad dehi naḥ śīghrameva ha || 32|| prāptalābhaḥ punarnaiva miliṣyatīti mā ciram | ityevaṃ badrike taistu kapotaiḥ paribhāṣitaḥ ||33|| kṛṣṇavirāmaḥ salilaṃ kare dhṛtvā sthito’bhavat | āhvayāmāsa tānsarvān kapotān śaraṇaṃ prati || 34|| āyayuste drutaṃ matvā kalyāṇaṃ samupasthitam | nipetuḥ pādayostasya so’pi vārābhyaṣecayat || 35|| śrāvayāmāsa nāmāpi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca | tāvatte pakṣivaṣmāṇi samutsṛjya surāḥ śubhāḥ || 36|| divyā devāḥ surūpāścābhavan sādhoḥ prapaśyataḥ | athocuste santamenaṃ dehi mantraṃ tu mokṣadam ||37|| devalokaṃ na cecchāmo yataḥ prapatanaṃ punaḥ | śrutvā sādhurdadau mantraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ||38|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | mantraṃ prāpya kapotāste devāstiro’bhavan drutam ||39|| caturbhujāstu muktāste’bhavan sādhoḥ prapaśyataḥ | prabhonārāyaṇa padmāvatīnārāyaṇa prabho |||4.69.40|| jayākṛṣṇa lalitānrāyaṇāya rādhāpate vibho | evaṃ te bhajanaṃ cakrustāvattatra vimānakam ||41 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmiyuktaṃ cāvātarattu khāt | tānāha bhagavān kṛṣṇovallābhāryaḥ kṛpāvaśaḥ |||42|| āyāntu me vimānaṃ vai muktā bhaktā mamāśritāḥ | kapotakā bhavanto’dya supotakāḥ sumuktigāḥ ||43|| ityuktvā tān kare dhṛtvā bhagavān kṛṣṇamādhavaḥ | nināya śāśvataṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ sāghoḥ prapaśyataḥ ||44|| badrike te sadā māyābandhād viniryayuḥ sukham | athānyaṃ te camatkāraṃ kathayāmi nibodha me ||45|| kākānāṃ śatasaṃkhyānāṃ maṇḍalaṃ vyomavartmanā | yadṛcchayāyayau tatra mahānasasamīpataḥ ||46|| gandhaṃ prāpya ca miṣṭānnaṃ vīkṣya ghrātvājyadhūmrakam | avātarat taruṣaṇḍe bhojanocchiṣṭavācchayā ||47|| vaiśākhasyāsite pakṣe trayodaśyāṃ dinārdhake | bhāge teṣāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ satāṃ vai bhojanottaram ||48|| ucchiṣṭamutkarasthaṃ tu bhakṣayituṃ prasādakam | uparyupari cotpetuḥ kākāste hṛṣṭamānasāḥ ||49|| nipeturhṛṣṭaśabdāste bubhujurmiṣṭamuttamam | kṣīraṃ ca dugdhasārādi polikāḥ pūrikādikam ||4.69.50|| odanaṃ ca tathā sūpaṃ caṇakān granthakām̐stathā | pūpānapūpān kalikā bubhujuścotkarojjhitān ||51 || sādhuprasādarūpām̐śca sarve kākā mudānvitāḥ | badrike mahadāścaryamabhūttatrāpyatarkitam ||52|| kṛṣṇapakṣāstu te kākā babhūbustatra sarvathā | karburapakṣiṇo ramyā nānāraṃgāḍhyapakṣiṇaḥ ||53|| kṛṣṇaṃ rūpaṃ hi pāpātma līnaṃ pakṣeṣu bhāgataḥ | athānyasmid dine cāpi bubhujuste tathāvidham ||54|| tena śvetabahulā vai pakṣāsteṣāṃ tadābhavan | athāparasmin divase bubhujuste tayojjhitam ||55|| sampūrṇaśvetapakṣāste’bhavan dugdhasvarūpiṇaḥ | athetarasmin divase bubhujuste tathojjhitam ||56|| sarvathā kākadehāste śvetarūpā babhūvire | aho prasādamāhātmyaṃ pāpānāṃ nāśakaṃ param ||57|| satāmucchiṣṭamāhātmyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam | pātakaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ vai śvetaṃ puṇyaṃ sadā matam | |58|| puṇyavantaḥ prajātāste kākā haṃsasamāstadā | evaṃ te bubhujurnityaṃ śuddhātmāno’bhavam̐stataḥ ||59|| kākajātīyadoṣāśca naṣṭāsteṣāṃ tadātmanām | jātismarāśca te jātā jñānino haṃsavattadā ||4.69.60|| tān draṣṭuṃ mānavāstatrāyānti kutūhalānvitāḥ | kākāste nirbhayāstatra vicaranti ca bhūtale ||61 || praśaṃsanti prasādasyocchiṣṭamāhātmyamadbhutam | aho prāptā hareścāpi satāmucchiṣṭabhojanam ||62|| tena puṇyena pāpāni naṣṭāni tāmasāni naḥ | rājasāni samastāni naṣṭānyaghāni sarvathā ||63|| sāttvikāni tu puṇyāni svargapradāni yāni vai | tāni jātāni cāsmākaṃ satāṃ prasādasevayā ||64|| kākā vayaṃ hi pāpiṣṭhā viḍabhujaḥ pūrvakarmataḥ | teṣāṃ kalyāṇakartāraḥ santaḥ satāṃ prasādakāḥ ||65|| ye na bhuṃjate kṛṣṇasya prasādaṃ ca satāṃ tathā | te loke śvetavarṇāścet tathāpi kākakoṭikāḥ ||66|| ye tu bhuṃjate kṛṣṇasya satāṃ prasādamuttamam | te kṛṣṇā api nityaṃ vai devāste haṃsakoṭikāḥ ||67|| śvetatvaṃ niṣphalaṃ teṣāṃ yeṣāṃ pāpātmabhojanam | kṛṣṇatvaṃ saphalaṃ teṣāṃ yeṣāṃ vai vighasāśitā ||68|| tadgṛhaṃ malavat proktaṃ yatra devā na bhuṃjate | sā bhāṣā kākabhāṣā vai na yatra kṛṣṇakīrtanam ||69|| tadrūpaṃ kuṣṭharūpaṃ vai yanna kṛṣṇārthamarpitam | tadbhojyaṃ tajjalaṃ miṣṭaṃ śākaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ dalam ||4.69.70|| vastraṃ copakaraṇādi kṛṣṇārthaṃ na kṛtaṃ tu yat | sarve tat kākamalavat pāpabhṛtaṃ mataṃ tviha ||71|| tiraścāṃ naiva doṣo’sti paśūnāṃ nāpi dūṣaṇam | doṣastu mānavānāṃ yajjānanto’pyarpayanti na ||72|| na bhajante na sevante nāśrayanti hariṃ sataḥ | yatante nāpi cātmārthe te hareraparādhinaḥ ||73|| āgaskṛtasta evātra kartavyaṃ nācaranti ye | mānavatvaṃ vyarthayanti na smaranti hariṃ prabhum ||74|| vaiṣṇavānāṃ sevanaṃ na guroḥ prasannatāṃ na ca | pitrorāśīrvacanaṃ na prāptāste nārakā dhruvāḥ ||75|| api candrasamaṃ tvāsyaṃ vāṇī miṣṭā sudhāsamā | dehaḥ svarṇasamaścāpi kṛṣṇaśūnyāstu te yadi ||76|| tadā te nirayā bodhyā doṣākarāghakośakāḥ | sarve kākāṃgarūpāste nikṛṣṭā narakapradāḥ ||77|| kākaśabdaḥ sārthako naścādya samyag vyajāyata | kaṃ sukhaṃ tadbhinnameva duḥkhamakaṃ samucyate ||78|| kutsitaṃ tu kṛtaṃ duḥkhamadya prasādasevanāt | kākāstena vayaṃ tvadya sukhārthino’ghavarjitāḥ ||79|| kā śaktirbrahmaṇaḥ proktā rādhā lakṣmīḥ satī prabhā | tayā kaṃ sukhamastyeṣāṃ kākā vayaṃ sukhāśrayāḥ ||4.69.80|| kā kāyā pṛthivī tatra kaṃ sukhaṃ cātra vartate | asmākaṃ kākavācyatvaṃ sukhitvaṃ ghaṭate’dya vai ||8 1|| ityeva badrike kākā vārtā kurvanti vai mithaḥ | tāṃ śṛṇvanti janāsteṣāṃ darśakāḥ smayasaṃbhṛtāḥ ||82|| janāstān śvetavarṇāstu papracchuḥ pakṣiṇaḥ śubhān | kathaṃ kākā bhavanto’tra pūrvaṃ ke ke tataḥ param ||83|| kākastvekaścāgragaṇya uvāca mānavān prati | vayamāsva kaṃkavarṇāḥ kaṃkāḥ pūrve hi mānavāḥ ||84|| luṇṭakā malināhārāḥ paradārapradharṣakāḥ | paradravyaharāścāpi parānnabhojakāstathā ||85|| khadiragrāmavāsāśca madyamāṃsaparāyaṇāḥ | ekadā pūrvanārāyāḥ saritaḥ sannidhau vane ||86|| prayāntaṃ śreṣṭhinaṃ prāpya samācarāma luṇṭanam | śreṣṭhī lakṣeṇa sahito nāṇakena praluṇṭitaḥ ||87|| tāvad yadṛcchayā tatrāyayuścānye praluṇṭakāḥ | pañcāśat te parijñāya vṛttāntaṃ vaṇijo drutam ||88|| luṇṭituṃ naḥ samāyātā yuddhaṃ mitho’bhavat tadā | mṛtāḥ parasparaṃ sarve śastrairyāmyapuraṃ gatāḥ ||89|| kṛtānāṃ karmaṇāṃ sarvaiḥ phalaṃ bhuktaṃ tu kuṇḍajam | yāmyapāśānnirgatāśca dvipino’raṇyavāsinaḥ ||4.69.90|| hiṃsakāḥ smo vayaṃ jātā vṛkā jātāstataḥ param | mārjārāśca tato jātāstataḥ kākāstu sāmpratam ||91 || atra prāptaṃ prasādasyocchiṣṭaṃ hareḥ satāṃ tathā | vaiṣṇavānāṃ śubhaṃ sarvaṃ sarvapātakanāśakam ||92|| pātakāni samastāni naṣṭānyucchiṣṭabhojanāt | śvetā idānīṃ jātāḥ smaḥ puṇyavantaḥ surā yathā ||93|| yadi labhema sākṣācchrīvyāsahastajalaṃ tviha | devā bhūtvā prayāsyāmo divaṃ tūrṇaṃ sukhāśrayam ||94|| pratīkṣāmo jalaṃ tasyāmṛtaṃ taṃ sūcayantu vai | śrutvā lokā vyāsasaudhamāgatya tamudantakam |||95|| kathayāmāsurīśaṃ taṃ svataḥprakāśakāyanam | vyāsastūrṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprasādavāri ca ||96|| nītvā yayau tu tān sarvān vāriṇā so’bhyaṣecayat | prabhonārāyaṇakṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti kīrtayan ||97|| tāvatte badrike sarve tyaktadehāstadābhavan | pītvā jalakaṇān spṛṣṭvā jalabindūn drutaṃ surāḥ ||98|| suratulyā divyarūpā sañjātā divyamūrtayaḥ | mantramayācan vyāsātte prapūjya caraṇau tataḥ ||99|| vyāsadevo dadau mantraṃ nāmadhunyaṃ dadau tadā | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā || 4.69.10 0|| prabhonārāyaṇa padmāvatīnārāyaṇa prabho | jayākṛṣṇa lalitāśrīkṛṣṇa rādhāpate vibho ||10 1|| prāpya mantraṃ prāpya dhunyaṃ labdhvā pādāmṛtaṃ tathā | labdhvā kṛpāṃ prāpya cāśīrvādān vyāsasya te surāḥ || 10 2|| caturbhujāḥ sma sañjātā muktā vaikuṇṭhayoginaḥ | natvā yayuste sahasā divyā ambaravartmanā || 10 3|| vaikuṇṭhaṃ bhagavaddhāma nārāyaṇavimānagāḥ | vaiśākhaśuklatṛtīyātithau madhyānhakottaram || 1 04|| prāptā vaikuṇṭhalokaṃ te sādhuprasādabhojinaḥ | evaṃ śrībadrike teṣāṃ muktistatrābhavattadā || 1 05|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇāt pāpanāśanam | bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi kṛṣṇaprāptiḥ śubhā bhavet || 1 06|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kathāśravaṇādinā purā sārthavāṭajātīnāṃ daśakapotānāṃ, tathā purā kaṃkajātīnāṃ śatakākapakṣiṇāṃ, sādhoḥ kṛpādibhiścocchiṣṭabhojanena ca mokṣaṇamityādi nirūpaṇanāmā navaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 69 ||
<4.70> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ mokṣakarīṃ tathā | gṛhagodhābhavat tatra kathāmaṇḍapabhittigā || 1 || dūtī sā tvabhavat pūrvaṃ bhāṇavāṇīsahāyinī | dineśvaryā mahārājñyāḥ kṛpāpātraṃ kriyākarī || 2 || jātyā khavāsinī nārī kuśalā svārthasādhane | parārthacintāśūnyā ca dhūrteva śāṭhyaśālinī || 3 || rājñyā ādeśakartryeva tadanyājñāvamāninī | rājñyāḥ sahacarī nityaṃ rājñyagre dīnakiṃkarī || 4 || tadānyāgre siṃhikeva vartamānā balādhikā | adhṛṣyā bhṛtyavargasya varcasvinī tu sarvathā || 5 || pracchannasvārthakuśalā pracchannadravyasaṃgrahā | krayavikrayavārtāyāṃ dānādau dharmakarmasu || 6 || rājñyā pradattadhanataścauryavṛttyā pratāriṇī | dhananiṣkāsane nityaṃ kuśalā śāṭhyadharmiṇī || 7 || nityamevaṃ dattadhanānniṣkāsya svaṃ karoti sā | tena pāpena sā dūtī nāmnā nāṇakinī mṛtā || 8 || yayau yāmyapuraṃ tatra kuṃbhīpāke gatā tataḥ | niṣkāsitā tu janmārthaṃ gṛhagodhābhavaddhi sā || 9 || kathāyā maṇḍape dīpasannidhau jantubhakṣiṇī | bhittibhāge toraṇasthāvasad bhītivivarjitā || 4.70.1 0|| nityaṃ khādati kīṭām̐śca makṣikā bhittisaṃgatāḥ | divāniśaṃ toraṇe’pi viśrāntiṃ labhate mudā || 11 || athaikadā sā tvaritā kathāmaṇḍapikopari | āgatya saṃsthitā śrīmatsaṃhitāyā vitānake || 12|| gṛhṇātyājyadīpadhūmaṃ sugandhi dhūpamuttamam | puṣpapallavapatrāṇāṃ śaityaṃ śītajalodbhavam || 1 3|| pūjāvaśiṣṭasalilaṃ patrapuṣpādiṣu sthitam | bindvātmakaṃ svedarūpaṃ pibatyapi sutṛptidam || 14|| guḍaṃ ca śarkarāṃ miṣṭamannaṃ pūjārthamarpitam | jihvayā rasalubdhā sā lihatyātṛptidaṃ sukham || 15|| evaṃ prasādamāsādya jātā pāpavivarjitā | jātismarā ca sā jātā smṛtvā smṛtvā ca duḥkhitā || 16|| śūhagodhāvapustyaktumīhamānā virāgiṇī | abhavat tvaritā badri nimittasyābhikāṃkṣiṇī || 17|| vaiśākhaśuklatṛtīyādine prātaḥ kathāsane | pūjanārthaṃ saṃhitāyā lomaśaḥ samupāyayau ||18|| dineśvarī rāyaharistathānye’pi samāyayuḥ | candreśvarī koṭirāyastatharṣisādhavo dvijāḥ || 19|| sahasraśo janāścāpi darśanaśravaṇārthinaḥ | sabhāmaṇḍapamāsādya tasthuryathocitaṃ tadā ||4.70.20|| pūjāmārārtrikaṃ cakre lomaśaḥ pustakasya ha | vyāsapūjāṃ pracakre’pi patrapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ||21|| śaṃkhajalena ca nīrājanaṃ vyāvartayat tridhā | śaṃkhajalaṃ tu cikṣepa lomaśaḥ parito’pi ca ||22|| prasādabindulābhārthaṃ sarveṣāmākṣipanmuniḥ | dakṣakarāñjalau vāri dhṛtvā dhṛtvordhvavartinā || 23|| bhramatā svakareṇaiva vāri cikṣepa cābhitaḥ | gṛhagodhāpi sā vārispṛśābhavad vitānake ||24|| apibajjalabinduṃ sā lomaśasya karojjhitam | tūrṇaṃ sā gatapāpā ca dagdhakalmaṣavāsanā ||25|| śuddhātmā sādhuvṛttirvai jātā prakṣīṇajīvanā | mūrchāmāsādya bhūbhāge saṃhitāgre’pataddhi sā ||26|| gṛhagodhāśarīrāttu nirgatā divyakanyakā | pūrvarūpānurūpā sābhavad yathā khavāsinī ||27|| tatsarūpāpi divyābhā divyasvarṇātisundarī | ṣoḍaśavatsarā bālā devakanyeva cāparā ||28|| sarvaśṛṃgārasaṃśobhadvigrahā suvibhūṣitā | tejaḥparidhiyuktā sā vyadyotata sabhāntare ||29|| aho kṛṣṇasya māhātmyaṃ badrike ca kṛpālutā | lohāt svarṇaṃ kaṃkarācca hīrakaṃ mauktikaṃ jhaṣāt ||4.70.30|| ratnaṃ kṣiteḥ sutaṃ vīryānmokṣamucchiṣṭabhakṣaṇāt | jantordevaṃ paśormuktaṃ jīvācchivaṃ karoti saḥ ||3 1|| badrike gṛhagodhāṃ tāṃ mṛtāṃ tu surakanyakām | cakṣuṣāṃ gocarāṃ sarvatejaākarṣiṇīṃ śubhām ||32|| vīkṣya nāryo narāstatra lakṣaśo vismayaṃ gatāḥ | svaprakāśo hi bhagavān puṣpahāraṃ dadau gale ||33|| lomaśastilakaṃ tasyā bhālamadhye cakāra ha | candrakaṃ kuṃkumenāpi pracakāra sa lomaśaḥ ||34|| pṛṣṭavām̐stāṃ lomaśo vai kā tvaṃ purādhunāpi ca | kamalā vā satī bhaktiḥ sāvitrī kāsi kanyake ||35|| devatā vā saṃhitā vā gṛhagodhotthavigrahā | kā tvaṃ kalyāṇasaṃsthānā vada sandehanāśini ||36|| pṛṣṭaivaṃ sā badrike saṃjagāda śṛṇvatāṃ satām | sabhājanānāṃ sarveṣāṃ meghagaṃbhīrayā girā ||37|| namo vo’stu samastebhyo vyāsāya te namo’stu ca | śrīsaṃhitāsvarūpāyai lakṣmyai devyai namo namaḥ ||38|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇāyātra kṛṣṇakāntāya vai namaḥ | lomaśāya gurave ca mokṣadāya namo namaḥ ||39|| sarvarṣibhyaśca sādhubhyaḥ sādhvībhyaśca namo namaḥ | namo mātre mahārājñyai mahārājāya vai namaḥ ||4.70.40|| vaiṣṇavebhyaḥ samastebhyaḥ kathāśrotṛbhya oṃ namaḥ | namo maṇḍapadevebhyo devībhyaśca namo namaḥ ||41|| muktamuktānikābhyaśca sarvebhyaśca namo namaḥ | kṣamadhvaṃ cāparādhānme doṣān kṣamadhvamīśvarāḥ ||42|| sādhavaḥ ṛṣayaḥ sarve rājā rājñī ca vaiṣṇavāḥ | sakhījanāḥ sakhāyaśca kṣamadhvaṃ me’parādhakān ||43|| ahaṃ nāṇakinīnāmnī khavāsinī purābhavam | bhāṇavāṇīsakhī rājñyā dineśvaryāśca kiṃkarī ||44|| svārthaparā stainyaparā dharmadhanāvacorikā | sāhaṃ mṛtā yāmyadūtairnītā yāmyapuraṃ tataḥ ||45|| bhuktvā pāpaphalaṃ tasmājjanmārthaṃ tviha cāgatā | gṛhagodhā karmavaśājjātāvaśeṣabhoginī ||46|| pūjāvārispṛṣṭadehā mṛtātra kṛpayā muneḥ | prasādāśanato naṣṭā vāsanā mama sarvathā ||47|| bahupuṇyāsmi sañjātā kathāyāḥ śravaṇādiha | divyā devyasmi sañjātā kṛpayā lomaśasya ca ||48|| mokṣamicchāmi gantuṃ vai necchāmi svargamityapi | mahyaṃ mantraṃ hareścāpi nāmadhunyaṃ prapattidam ||49|| lomaśo’yaṃ dadātvatra yena yāmi parākṣaram | namāmi pādayorvaśca kiṃkarī devikāsmi ca ||4.70.50|| uktvaivaṃ badrike sā tu cakāra daṇḍavad bhuvi | dhūliṃ ghṛṣṭvā śarīre sve cikṣepa ca prasādajām |||51|| aluṭhat pañcavāraṃ sā pṛthvyāṃ luṇṭhaccharīriṇī | utthāya sahasā śrīmallomaśānmantramādadhe ||52|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | prabhonārāyaṇa padmāvatīkṛṣṇa hare prabho ||13|| jayākṛṣṇa lalitāśrīkṛṣṇa rādhāpate vibho | evaṃ dhunyaṃ dadau tasmai lomaśaḥ sāpi jagṛhe ||54|| prasannahṛdayā śāntā jātā sā brahmarūpiṇī | brāhmī śaktirhareḥ śaktirmuktānikābhavaddhi sā ||55|| oṃ namaḥ kamalāyai me mātre lakṣmyai namo namaḥ | ityevaṃ sā nāmadhunyaṃ svayaṃ cakre samutsukā ||56|| tāvad vyomnā vimānaṃ tu lakṣmīnārāyaṇānvitam | avātarattu sahasā maṇḍapasya samīpataḥ ||57|| jayanādā vaiṣṇavānāṃ pūjāyuktāstadābhavan | nārāyaṇena kṛṣṇena lakṣmyā kamalayā tadā ||58|| āhūtā kanyake nāṇakinītyevaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | sāpi sarvānnamaskṛtyoḍḍīya vimānamāyayau ||59|| sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ tāṃ tu nītvākṣaraṃ yayau hariḥ | ityevaṃ badrike dūtī gṛhagodhāpi devatā ||4.70.60|| muktānikā kṛpāyogād bhūtvākṣaraṃ yayau tadā | kiṃ vacmyatra camatkārān kathāprasaṃgajān bahūn ||61 || makṣikā matsarāḥ kīṭāḥ pataṃgāśca pipīlikāḥ | jantavo’pyakṣaraṃ yānti prasādocchiṣṭabhojinaḥ ||62|| athāpyanyā kathāṃ badri camatkārānvitāṃ tava | kathayāmi mūṣakāṇāṃ mokṣadāṃ pāvanīṃ parām ||63|| pūrvanārānadītīre grāme bhāgalake’vasat | saṃghavāṭābhidhaḥ śūdraḥ śastradhārī balī tathā ||64|| dhanurdhārī gadādhārī saṃgarajñaḥ kalālayaḥ | prasiddhaḥ saṃgare yuddhe vijaye parabhīpradaḥ ||65|| tathāpi tu svabhāvena cauryaṃ rātrau karotyapi | annānāṃ kṣetrasasyānāṃ kvacittu paśudehinām ||66|| ekadā saṃghaśo bhūtvā vrīhīṇāṃ dīrghabhūmiṣu | cauryārthaṃ pākayuktānāṃ rātrau kṣetreṣu so’gamat ||67|| vrīhīṇāṃ sañcayān bhṛtvānassu yāvat pragacchati | tāvat kṣetrapatiḥ śastrasampannaḥ saṃghaśo’pi saḥ ||68|| samāyayau rakṣaṇārthaṃ tayoryuddhamabhūttadā | saṃghavāṭo hatastatra khaḍgasya tīkṣṇadhārayā ||69|| parasparaṃ hatāścānye caurāśca svāmino’pi ca | mṛtāste karmabhogārthaṃ yāmyaṃ puraṃ yayustataḥ ||4.70.70|| anubhūya kṛtānāṃ tu bhogān duḥkhāni sarvathā | janma prāptā mayūrāṇāṃ kukkuṭānāṃ tataḥ param ||71 || tittirāṇāṃ tataścāpi ghūkānāṃ ca tataḥ param | mūṣakāṇāṃ tato janma labdhavanto’tiduḥkhadam ||72|| kathāmaṇḍapasānnidhye utkarābhikṣitau ca te | stabakānāṃ samūheṣu tṛṇaghāsādiṣu sthitāḥ ||73|| bilavāsāstṛṇaghāsasasyakaṇādino’bhavan | te vaiśākhāsitapakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ kathottaram ||74|| mūṣakā dvātriṃśadeva prasādocchiṣṭabhojinaḥ | nityabhojanapūtāśca kathāsthalaṃ niśāmukhe ||75|| ārārtrikottaraṃ yadṛcchayāyayurhi maṇḍape | saṃhitāpaṭṭikāmūle cāyayuḥ prasamutsukāḥ ||76|| prasādasya kaṇām̐statra yavasasyāni yāni ca | godhūmasyāpi sasyāni komalāni navānyapi ||77|| prācīnāni kaṇiśāni labdhavanto hi sadrasān | miṣṭānnakhaṇḍakām̐ścāpi prasādarūpiṇastadā ||78|| bhuktavantaśca te tatra ramamāṇā itastataḥ | sarvathā pāvanā jātāḥ sarvakṣapitavāsanāḥ ||79|| niṣkalmaṣāḥ śuddhabhāvāḥ śuddhātmānaḥ surā yathā | drutaṃ te mūṣakadehām̐styaktvā vai maṇḍapāntare ||4.70.80|| sudivyā devavajjātā devā devyaśca śobhanāḥ | sarve ṣoḍaśavarṣāśca bhāsamānāḥ prabhāviṇaḥ ||81 || tuṣṭuvuḥ paramātmānaṃ saṃhitāsthaṃ hariṃ prabhum | namo mokṣapradānāṃ tu satāṃ lakṣyaikabindave ||82|| muktānāṃ dhyānalakṣyāya sarvāvatāriṇe namaḥ | namaḥ kṛṣṇāya kṛṣṇādisvāmine paramātmane ||83|| bālakṛṣṇāya kāntāya sarvakāntāya rakṣiṇe | śrīśāya kamaleśāya rādheśāya vihāriṇe ||84|| namo devādhivāsāya sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ | namo’nādinidhanāya mokṣadātre kṛpālave ||841|| namaḥ śrīlomaśāyāpi sadbhyaścāpi namo namaḥ | namo vyāsāya divyāya svayamprakāśine namaḥ ||86|| namaḥ padmāvatīlakṣmīprajñābhūpataye namaḥ | namastasmai hṛdisthāya dhāmasthāya ca te namaḥ ||87|| prasādāya namaścāpi maṇḍapāya ca vai namaḥ | namo maṇḍapadevebhyo namaḥ śravaṇibhyastathā ||88|| tārakebhyaḥ pāvakebhyaḥ sadbhyaḥ sadā namo namaḥ | sādhvībhyaśca satībhyaśca vaiṣṇavebhyo namo namaḥ ||89|| vayaṃ pāpāḥ prasādenoddhṛtā yadṛcchayā tviha | kṛpayā divyatāṃ prāptāḥ satāṃ darśanatastathā ||4.70.90|| jātismarāḥ sma sañjātāḥ kathāsthānaprabhāvataḥ | punarjanma na cecchāmaścecchāmaḥ śāśvatākṣaram ||91|| svaprakāśo hi bhagavān dadātu mantramuttamam | nāmadhunyaṃ pradadātu yena yāsyāma uttamam ||92|| akṣaraṃ paramaṃ dhāma parameśvararājitam | ityevaṃ badrike te samprārthayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||93|| svaprakāśo hi bhagavān dadau tebhyo manuṃ tadā | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||94|| prabhonārāyaṇa padmāvatīnārāyaṇa prabho | jayākṛṣṇa lalitāśrīkṛṣṇa rādhāpate vibho ||95|| dhunyaṃ dadau tadā tebhyaste’pi cakruḥ prakīrtanam | ekatānā abhavam̐śca śrīkṛṣṇevallabhe prabhau ||96|| tāvacchrīlalitāsvāmī badrīnāthaḥ samāyayau | māṇikyāpadmajāprajñopetaḥ kṛṣṇo’tivallabhaḥ ||97|| rādhālakṣmīyutaścāpi vimānavarasaṃsthitaḥ | tānsarvānpārṣadān muktān kṛtvā muktānikāstathā ||98|| vimāne tānupāgṛhya paśyatāṃ sarvadehinām | jayanādaiḥ sahitaḥ śrīharirnināya cākṣaram ||99|| mahāścaryaṃ gatāḥ sarve praśaśaṃsuḥ prasādanam | kṛpāṃ hareḥ praśaśaṃsurmantrabalaṃ ca kīrtanam || 4.70.10 0|| bhaktiṃ sevāṃ kathāṃ cāpi praśaśaṃsurhi mokṣaṇam | dhanyavādāndaduścāpi bhūmaye maṇḍapāya ca || 101 || muktiṃ gatebhyaḥ sarvebhyo dhanyavādāndadurjanāḥ | evaṃ badrīpriye muktiṃ gatāste mūṣakāstadā || 1 02|| vaiśākhaśuklatṛtīyādine vimānasaṃsthitāḥ | na svargaṃ sampadasteṣāṃ bandhanāya tadābhavat || 1 03|| kṛpaikā paramo heturgamane cākṣaraṃ prati | yayāgatya svayaṃ kṛṣṇo nayatyevākṣaraṃ nijān || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kathāśravaṇaprasādabhojanajalaprokṣaṇādibhiḥ pūrvajanmani nāṇakinīkhavāsinyāḥ paścād gṛhagodhāyāḥ tathā pūrvajanmani saṃghavāṭādidvātriṃśacchūdrāṇāṃ paścānmūṣakāṇāṃ ca mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 70 ||
<4.71> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ nakulamokṣadām | prasādocchiṣṭasampanne cotkare tu bubhukṣitaḥ || 1 || nakulaḥ kaścidāyātaḥ kathāmaṇḍapasannidhau | bhuktavān sa tadocchiṣṭaṃ satāṃ prasādamiśritam || 2 || tāvat sa mūrchitastatra tatyāja nijavigraham | devasvarūpaḥ sañjāto vaiśākhapañcamīdine || 3 || śuklapakṣe tadā sarvairdṛṣṭaḥ surottamaḥ sa tu | pṛṣṭaścovāca vṛttāntaṃ naijaṃ pūrvabhavasya tu || 4 || śṛṇvantu vaiṣṇavā lokā acchodarapure purā | ahamāsaṃ jñānivaryo vāruṭaḥ sāgarābhidhaḥ || 5 || lokāḥ sāgaradāneti vidurmāṃ jñānināmbaram | itihāsakathābhijñaṃ samāhūya nijālayān || 6 || kārayanti kathākhyānaṃ śṛṇvanti mānavāstadā | pūjayanti prasannāste’rpayanti me dhanādikam || 7 || ahaṃ tṛpto dhanaṃ labdhvā prayāmi sma svamandiram | kathāsu dānavārtāṃ vai karomi pūrvabhūbhṛtām || 8 || dharmavārtāṃ gavāṃ sevāṃ pitṛsevāṃ vadāmi ca | tīrthasevāṃ vratarakṣāṃ devapūjāṃ samutsavān || 9 || niyamām̐śca yamām̐ścāpi janānupadiśāmi ca | snānadharmādikaṃ sarvaṃ copadiśāmi sarvathā || 4.71.1 0|| nāhaṃ kiṃcinmanāg vāpi pālayāmi tu tattathā | mṛṣāvādī miṣṭavādī svārthasiddhiparāyaṇaḥ || 1 1|| duṣṭātmāhaṃ dhanadhūrto dhanaṃ harāmi vārtayā | na dharmaṃ na niyamaṃ yamaṃ vrataṃ karomyapi ||12|| āsīt sarvaṃ vacane me na kriyāyāṃ tu kiñcana | ācārahīnaḥ satataṃ tadābhavaṃ pratārakaḥ || 1 3|| gavāṃ pitroḥ surāṇāṃ ca sevayā hīna ityapi | abhavaṃ sarvathā āryā asatpralāpagarjanaḥ || 14|| tena pāpena me vidyā kuvidyā samajāyata | vyākhyānāni samastāni śāṭhyapāpaphalāni ca || 15|| vākchalairgrathitānyeva pāpadāni mamābhavan | evaṃ pāpātibhāreṇa naṣṭāyuṣyo mṛto’bhavam || 16|| yāmyapuraṃ gatastatra yāmyaiḥ saṃdaṃśakuṇḍake | kṣipto jihvā kartitā me bahiḥ kṛṣṭā cipīṭakaiḥ || 17|| saṃdaṃśaistīkṣṇadhāraiśca niṣkāsitā muhurmuhuḥ | bheditā cheditā cāpi prajvālitā ca kūrcitā || 18|| vidāritā kaccaritā tanurme kardamīkṛtā | bahūni tatra kaṣṭāni bhuktvā nakulatāmiha || 1 9|| gato’smi kṣudhayā tvatrotkarocchiṣṭaṃ prajagdhivān | tena naṣṭāni pāpāni mamāvaśeṣakāṇyapi ||4.71.20|| pūtātmā pūṇyavānasmi sañjāto’dya divaṃgamaḥ | suro’smi cādya sampannaḥ prayāmi svargamuttamam ||2 1 || ityuktavān badrike sa neme sarvān suvaiṣṇavān | atha tatra suraṃ taṃ tu jagāda lomaśo muniḥ ||22|| śṛṇu tvaṃ suravaryādya devatvaṃ gatavānapi | maraṇaṃ te punaścāsti deve’mṛtatvamasti na ||23|| tasmāt sādhaya puṇyātmannamṛtatvaṃ tu śāśvatam | apunarbhavasaṃjñaṃ ca brahmalokamanāmayam ||24|| śrutvetathaṃ lomaśaṃ so’pi papraccha kuśalaṃ dhruvam| kathaṃ mune’mṛtadhāmaprāptiḥ syād vada me drutam ||25|| lomaśaḥ pratyuvācainaṃ kathāṃ śṛṇu sthiro bhava | prasādaṃ śrīharerbhuṃkṣva naivedyaṃ haraye’rpitam ||26|| vrataṃ rakṣa satāṃ sevātmakaṃ bhaktiṃ kuru prabhau | kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ samastaṃ vai vidhehi parameśvare ||27|| mantraṃ dhunyaṃ gṛhāṇāpi vaiṣṇavo bhava uttamaḥ | mahābhāgavato bhūtvākṣaraṃ dhāma prayāsyasi ||28|| ityuktaśca tadā devasvarūpaḥ sa kathālaye | devānāṃ maṇḍale divyarūpastatra tiro’bhavat || 29|| saṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ śrotuṃ devagaṇe sthiro’bhavat | vrataṃ cakre prasādānnabhojanaṃ saptavāsarān ||4.71.30|| satāṃ sevāṃ mānavena svarūpeṇa karotyapi | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ dehamardanaṃ darśanādikam ||31 || vaiśākhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ prātaḥ kathāśravottaram | lomaśaḥ kṛpayā tasmai mantraṃ dhunyaṃ dadau drutam ||32|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā | prabhonārāyaṇa padmāvatīnārāyaṇa prabho ||33|| jayākṛṣṇa lalitāśrīkṛṣṇa rādhāpate vibho | so’pi devo manuṃ labdhvā nāmadhunyaṃ cakāra ha ||34|| naivedyabhojanaṃ kṛtvā yāvad devagaṇe sthitaḥ | akasmādāyayau tāvanmadhyāhne śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ||35|| divyaśvetahayārūḍhaḥ śrīpatiḥ kamalāpatiḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīpativallabhaḥ || 36|| taṃ netumāyayau pakṣiturage chatraśobhite | āhvayāmāsa taṃ devaṃ bhagavān kambharātmajaḥ ||37|| sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ devaścāśvārūḍho babhūva ha | nītvā taṃ bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’kṣaraṃ yayau ||38|| kṛpaiṣā śrīhareścāti lomaśasyāpi bhūyasī | sāntamamarabhāvaṃ taṃ śāśvatāmaratāmitaḥ ||39|| nakulaḥ sakulaścāpi bhagavatkulavān kṛtaḥ | badrike sā kathā cātra prabhūtā kathitā parā ||4.71.40 || athānyaṃ te pravadāmi camatkāraṃ hareḥ prabhoḥ | bhāṭaḥ kaścitkathāṃ śrotuṃ samāyātaḥ kathāsthalam ||41 || nārāyaṇahare kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti saṃjapan | ślokaṃ kṛtvā stutiṃ cakre saṃhitāyāḥ sabhāsthale ||42|| kathā kalyāṇadā ceyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ karuṇāpradaḥ | kīratārābhidho bhāṭaḥ śreyase’ta upāgataḥ ||43|| namo vyāsāya kṛṣṇāya saṃhitāyai namo muhuḥ | vaiṣṇavānāṃ sabhāyai ca lomaśāya namo muhuḥ ||44|| namaḥ sadbhyo maharṣibhyaḥ sādhvībhyaśca namo muhuḥ | pāvanebhyo’tra devebhyaḥ sarvebhyaśca namo muhuḥ ||45|| śrūyante bahavaḥ pāpāstāritāḥ kṛpayā khalāḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇenātra kīratāraṃ samuddhara ||46|| hṛdaye vartate yaśca vyāse ca pustake’pi yaḥ | sadasyeṣu ca bhāṭe yaḥ sa māmuddharatu prabhuḥ ||47|| bahūnāṃ janmanāmante prāpto’smi parameśvaram | śaraṇyaḥ sa harirbhāṭaṃ prapannaṃ pātu pāmaram ||48|| prāptamadya mayā svarṇaṃ ratnaṃ pīyūṣamamṛtam | pītvā pītvā dṛḍho bhūtvā prayāsyāmi paraṃ padam ||49|| uddhartānādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabheśvaraḥ | paraṃ dhāma prayāsyāmi mantradhunyādilābhavān ||4.71.50|| evaṃ tuṣṭāva ca namaścovāca daṇḍavattathā | cakre svātmārpaṇaṃ tatra dhūliṃ dehe’pyagharṣayat ||51 || atha śrīvyāsadevaśca svataḥprakāśakāyanaḥ | dadāvasmai manuṃ nāmadhunyaṃ salilasākṣikam ||52|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | prabhonārāyaṇa padmāvatīnārāyaṇa prabho ||53|| jayākṛṣṇa lalitāśrīkṛṣṇa rādhāpate vibho | bālakaṣṇāya vidmahe’nādikṛṣṇāya dhīmahi ||54|| tanno hṛtsthaḥ pracodayāditi mantraṃ ca jagṛhe | bhāṭaḥ pavitratāṃ prāpto’bhavad vigatakalmaṣaḥ ||55|| badrike sa prasādaṃ ca jagdhvā pītvā padāmṛtam | dadhāra taulasīṃ kaṇṭhīṃ cakre tilakacandrakau ||56|| dhunyaṃ cakre mudā nṛtyan kathāṃ śuśrāva līnavat | brahmarasaṃ papau nityaṃ sādhusevāṃ cakāra ca ||57|| māsamātraṃ sthitastvevaṃ bhajan śrīkāntavallabham | kathārthāṃścintayan dhyāyan hṛdaye parameśvaram ||58|| gopālanandanaṃ divyaṃ dhārayan kambharātmajam | vaiśākhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ muktasaṃsārabandhanaḥ ||59|| kīratāraḥ kathāṃ śrūtvā samādhiṃ prāpa maṇḍape | yāvattatra samāyātaṃ vimānaṃ kṛṣṇaśobhitam ||4.71.60|| divyaṃ tejāṃsi paritaḥ prāsṛjat svarṇakāntimat | kīratāro’bhavanmuktastadā vai divyavigrahaḥ ||6 1|| caturbhujaḥ surūpaśca pārṣadaḥ paramātmanaḥ | svarṇakuṇḍalamukuṭasragāpīḍādibhūṣitaḥ ||62|| āruroha vimānaṃ tat samāhūto dayālunā | paśyatāṃ tu sadasyānāṃ yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ ||63|| śṛṇu badrīpriye cātra kṛpaiva kāraṇaṃ hareḥ | ya icchati mokṣaṃ taṃ drutaṃ nayati mādhavaḥ ||64|| śāśvatānandalabdhestu sādhanaṃ śaraṇāgatiḥ | tavāsmīti yācakāya sa dadāti paraṃ padam ||65|| dehī divyo bhavatyeva prārabdhaṃ parivartate | kṛṣṇamandiravāsārho jāyate kṛpayā hareḥ ||66|| naro muktaḥ pārṣadaḥ syānnārī lakṣmīḥ prajāyate | kṛṣṇena saha ramate’śnute kṛṣṇasya sadrasān ||67|| na nyūnaṃ vidyate tasya tādātmyadravatāṃ labhet | svāmināthāt sarvakāmān bhuṃkte kṛṣṇāsanāsanaḥ ||68|| sparśānandān samastām̐śca kṛṣṇamāliṅgya so’śnute | rūpānandān rasānandān jihvāsvādān samastakān ||69|| gandhānandān girānandān samastāśleṣamodakān | śayyānandān samastām̐śca kṛṣṇakāntāt samaśnute ||4.71.70|| kvaciddhāmni nijaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ rahaḥ prasevate | kvacid ramyāṇi puṣpāṇi bhūtvā gandhaiḥ prasevate ||71 || kvacit phalaṃ svayaṃ bhūtvā kṛṣṇaṃ rasena sevate | kvacidbhūtvā kāmadhenuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ dugdhena sevate ||72|| kvacidbhūtvā ramā rāmaṃ vakṣasyārāmamicchati | kvacicchrīmāṇikī bhūtvā vahate kāntamuttamam ||73|| kvacid bhramarikā bhūtvā kṛṣṇagandhaṃ samaśnute | kvacid rādhā sakhī bhūtvā tāmbūlaṃ pradadātyapi ||74|| bhūtvā lakṣmīrhareroṣṭhatāmbūlarasameti ca | āndhasikī kvacid bhūtvā pācayatyasya bhojanam ||75|| dāsī bhūtvāplavanaṃ sā kārayatyacyutasya vai | dehasaṃvāhanaṃ dāso bhūtvā karoti sevanam ||76|| yaṣṭiḥ svarṇamayī bhūtvā karasparśaṃ suvindati | naktakaśca kvacid bhūtvā mukhasparśaṃ pravindati ||77|| pādukārūpamāsādya pādacūmbanamṛcchati | ādarśarūpamāsādya kṛṣṇaṃ svasmin dadhātyapi ||78|| gendukatāṃ samāsādya kṛṣṇapṛṣṭhaṃ dadhātyapi | kuṃkumaṃ candanaṃ bhūtvā bhālasukhaṃ pravindati ||79|| kajjalaṃ ca kvacid bhūtvā netrasparśaṃ pravindati | dugdhaṃ dugdhāmṛtaṃ bhūtvā jaṭhare saṃviśatyapi ||4.71.80|| jalaṃ bhūtvā tathā dhautraṃ kaṭisparśaṃ ca vindati | tailaṃ bhūtvā romamūlasparśasukhaṃ ca vindati ||81 || manobhavaḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā kṛṣṇānandaṃ samaśnute | rādhā bhūtvāsya ramate yānaṃ bhūtvā vahatyapi ||82|| siṃhāsanaṃ kvacid bhūtvā rājate svāmināśritam | kambalaśca kvacid bhūtvā paritaḥ sevate harim ||83|| sugandhipavano bhūtvā sevate śītalo’pi san | ūrmikā vāṃgarakṣaṃ ca bhūtvāṅguliṃ ca varṣma ca ||84|| kaustubho raśanā bhūtvā vakṣaḥ kaṭiṃ ca sevate | bhuktipātraṃ kvacid bhūtvā prasādaṃ sarvamaśnute ||85|| snānakuṇḍaṃ kvacid bhūtvā sparśaṃ vindati sarvataḥ | kvacit kāntā pramā bhūtvā kāntamāśliṣyati prabhum ||86|| kvacittu garuḍo hastī bhūtvā vājī vimānakam | vāhanaṃ narayānādi bhūtvā dhārayati prabhum ||87|| kvacit pāśaṃvatī bhūtvā sarvasevāṃ karoti hi | muktā muktānikā premṇāstuvate harijaṃ rasam ||88|| badri dhāmnyakṣare premṇā muktāḥ pibanti tadrasam | goloke gopikā gopā pibanti kṛṣṇajaṃ rasam ||89|| vaikuṇṭhe pārṣadāḥ pārṣadānyaḥ pibanti tadrasam | avyākṛte’mṛte dhāmni śrīpure badarīvane ||4.71.90|| śvetadvīpe kṣīravārdhau pibanti sevino rasam | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre brahmapriyā haripriyāḥ ||9 1 || pibantyanādikṛṣṇasya rasaṃ rādhāramāśriyaḥ | jayā ca lalitā lakṣmīḥ mālatī māṇikī priyā ||92|| padmāvatī sukhadāśrīrnārāyaṇī ca bhārgavī | tulasī padminī padmā pibanti tā hareḥ rasam ||93|| badarī ca vikuṇṭhā ca muktiḥ śaktiḥ sarasvatī | tā etāḥ śrīkṛṣṇakāntarasaṃ pibanti śāśvatam ||94|| sanakādyāḥ sādhavaśca nāradādyā maharṣayaḥ | vyāsādyāḥ śaṃsakāścāpi kārṣṇaṃ rasaṃ pibanti hi ||95|| balirājādayo daityā vibhīṣaṇādirākṣasāḥ | īśvarāḥ śaṃkarādyāśca pibanti śrīhareḥ rasam ||96|| agnyādayo devatāśca kāśyapā garuḍādayaḥ | mānavā dhruvamukhyāśca pibanti śrīhareḥ rasam ||97|| bhoginaḥ śeṣasarpādyā gāvastu kāmadhenavaḥ | ātmanivedino bhaktāḥ pibanti śrīhareḥ rasam ||98|| badrike śaraṇaṃ prāptāḥ sāmastyena samarpitāḥ | dāsā dāsyaḥ priyavargāḥ pibanti śrīhareḥ rasam || 99|| ye ye dhāmākṣaraṃ prāptāḥ parabrahmarasaṃ tu te | pibanti satataṃ badri parabrahmakṛpāśrayāḥ || 4.71.10 0|| kṛpayā ca gatau muktiṃ sāgaraḥ kīratārakaḥ | pāṭhako vācakaḥ śrotā saṃhitāyā hi mokṣadāḥ || 10 1|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne sāgaradānavāruṭasya kīratārabhāṭasya ca kathāśravaṇasādhusevādibhirmokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 71 ||
<4.72> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ jyotirvidasya vai | vikramanagare vipro nāmnā devamatīśvaraḥ || 1 || kulakuṭumbasahitaścāsīddharmavratādimān | devasevāparaścāpi prajākalyāṇacintanaḥ || 2 || ātitheyaḥ śaraṇyaśca paraduḥkhaprabhañjanaḥ | brahmakarmaparaścāpi jyotirvidyārdhapaṇḍitaḥ || 3 || badrike sarvalokeṣu cārdhajñaḥ sarvakarmasu | na pāraṃ nirṇayaṃ yāti tato bhavati kleśabhāk || 4 || auṣadheṣu bhāgyavitsu jyotirvitsu kalāsu ca | sarvathā pārago dīrghānubhavī ca bahuśrutaḥ || 5 || sādhaneṣvanukūleṣu dhruvaṃ phalaṃ samaśnute | apāragastu yatnena daivānukūlavartmani || 6 | | akasmāllabhate puṣpaṃ phalaṃ vā labhate kvacit | prāyaśo na phalaṃ yāti viphalaṃ labhate sadā || 7 || asatyāḍambaradoṣairlipyate vijñagarvavān | ardhadagdhena bhāvyaṃ na prāyaśaḥ kleśakāriṇā || 8 || ardhābhijño bhiṣaṅmadhya śatahiṃsottaraṃ varaḥ | utkṛṣṭabhāvamāyāti hiṃsāpāpaśatānvitaḥ || 9 || ardhābhijñastathā jyotirvettā rekhāvidastathā | bahūnāmanṛtānāṃ ca pāpavān jāyate sadā || 4.72.1 0|| asatyakathanaiścāpi sandigdhānāṃ pradarśanaiḥ | niścitajñānavidhurā viśvāsaghātadūṣitāḥ || 1 1|| vipathe vartamānāste parān vipathayanti ca | tena doṣeṇa jāyante mṛtāstiryañci rākṣasāḥ || 12|| upadeśakarā evaṃ vṛthā vācāṃ vihāriṇaḥ | svayamuktārthaśūnyāste paropadeśapaṇḍitāḥ || 1 3|| tiraścāṃ yonimṛcchanti jāyante rākṣasā api | badrike’to bhiṣaktvaṃ vidvattvaṃ jyotiḥpravetṛtā || 14|| satyena yuñjitāḥ sarve svargadā mokṣadā api | asatyayuñjitāḥ sarve’dhogatau nirayapradāḥ 15|||| badrike sa tathā cārdhajyotiṣī grahadarśakaḥ | bhāgyābhāgyapravaktā ca mithyācāro’bhavattadā || 16|| tena pāpena saṃlipto devagatīśvarābhidhaḥ | galagaṇḍena rogeṇa kaṇṭhamālarujā tathā || 17|| gale karkaṭavṛddhyā ca pīḍitaścābhavattadā | jihvāmūlaṃ rujā channaṃ jihvā hrasvā tato’bhavat || 18|| aspaṣṭavarṇā vāṇī ca śanairvai mūkatāṃ gatā | evaṃ rogābhibhūtasya śiraso vedanābhavat || 19|| gaṇḍayoścābhavat pākastena duḥkhena pīḍitaḥ | pūyapāko’bhavad bhāle pūyasrāvaśca karṇayoḥ ||4.72.20 || netrayorāndhyabhāvaśca bādhiryaṃ cāpyajāyata | aho prārabdhaduḥkhaṃ vā sañcitaṃ tatsamāgatam ||21 || kṛtaṃ mithyāpracāraṃ yat samastaṃ bhujyate tviha | tasmānmithyā na kartavyaṃ na kartavyaṃ mṛṣā kvacit || 22|| asatyaṃ nācaraṇīyaṃ nopadeṣṭavyamanṛtam | ajñātaṃ nopadeṣṭavyaṃ darśanīyaṃ na cānṛtam |||23 || sandigdhaṃ viparītaṃ vā kathanīyaṃ na sarvathā | nāhitaṃ cintanīyaṃ ca svārthadoṣābhipātinā || 24|| nāniṣṭaṃ karaṇīyaṃ ca kāraṇīyaṃ na kenacit | nāndhamārge dhāvanīyaṃ nākṛṣṭavyāḥ pare’pi ca |||25|| na pātanīyā garte’ndhe patanīyaṃ na sarvathā | dṛṣṭaṃ vācyaṃ na tvadṛṣṭaṃ vācyaṃ prāmāṇikaṃ tu yat ||26|| vaktavyaṃ phalavad badri niṣphalaṃ nānṛtaṃ mṛṣā | āptaśrutaṃ pravaktavyaṃ hyāptaśrutyā svayā na tu ||27|| āśīrvādāḥ pradātavyāḥ kṛṣṇārpaṇavidhitsayā | vacanaṃ tu pradātavyaṃ phalāyatibhṛtaṃ sadā || 28|| ājñā kāryā vahyasahyā stutiḥ pramodakārikā | nāṭakaṃ rasavat kāryaṃ samājāścaryakārakam ||29|| bhajanaṃ kīrtanaṃ gītaṃ kartavyaṃ tuṣṭaye hareḥ | praśaṃsā tu mahatāṃ vai kartavyā pūjyabhāvataḥ ||4.72.30 || varṇanaṃ sarvathā kāryaṃ śataguṇaṃ tato’dhikam | cintanaṃ tu vidhātavyaṃ sahasratarkitaṃ tathā ||3 1 || kintu roge grahe satyaṃ vācyaṃ viśvāsakarmasu | vyavahāre yathāyogyaṃ vaktavyaṃ satyameva ha ||32|| prāṇatrāṇāya yad yogyaṃ tadvaktavyaṃ vijānatā | badrike gaṇakaḥ so’yaṃ bhiṣaṅmithyābhidūṣaṇaiḥ ||33|| pīḍito bahudhā rogaistrātāraṃ na lalābha ha | bahudhāpi vyayaṃ kṛtvā prāpto nirdhanatāṃ punaḥ || 34|| anyāyopārjitaṃ sarvaṃ rogeṇa viniyāpitam | athāsya matirutpannā śrutvā śrutvā punaḥ punaḥ || 35|| kathāpraśaṃsāṃ bahudhā rogaghnīṃ mokṣadāṃ tathā | kathāsthalaṃ tato gantuṃ rakṣituṃ svaṃ vratādibhiḥ || 36 || patnyai nivedayāmāsa vicāraṃ gamanātmakam | badrike duḥkhabhāk prāṇī bhajate śrīprabhumpatim || 37|| sukhe naiva smaratyenaṃ sukhadaṃ mādhavīprabhum | vipadyeva smaratyenaṃ svārthī prāṇī budho’pi san || 38|| mānuṣyaṃ sarvathā prāptaṃ smṛtyarthaṃ śrīhareḥ sadā | tad vismṛtya dhane patnyāṃ yāpayanti kṣaṇaṃ khalāḥ || 3 9|| pūrvakṛtaṃ bhakṣayanti navīnaṃ nārjayantyapi | puṇyaṃ tyaktvā pāpamevācaranti nirayāya te ||4.72.40 || asatyaṃ hṛdaye yasya vāci tvasatyatā bhavet| | karmasvasatyatā tasya trīṇyatra nirayāṇi vai ||41 || tatphalaṃ ghorapāpaṃ ca nirayaṃ nirayapradam | phalaṃ ca narakaṃ duḥkhaṃ sarvamasatyakāriṇaḥ ||42|| prathamaṃ narakaṃ dehe rogaḥ samparikīrtitaḥ | dvitīyaṃ narakaṃ cānnāmbaralabdhistvatuṣṭidā || 43 || tṛtīyaṃ narakaṃ bhāryā duṣṭā duṣṭaḥ patiśca vā | caturthaṃ narakaṃ dāsyaṃ kaiṃkaryaṃ paravaśyatā || 44|| pañcamaṃ narakaṃ nityaṃ kalahaḥ svajaneṣu vai | ṣaṣṭhaṃ tu narakaṃ grāme deśe ca bahuśatrutā ||45|| saptamaṃ narakaṃ rājadaṇḍaścātiprayāsitā | aṣṭamaṃ narakaṃ tṛṣṇā vāsanā cānivartinī ||46|| navamaṃ narakaṃ ceṣṭālābhastathāvamānanam | daśamaṃ narakaṃ nityadāridryaṃ sarvato’dhikam ||47|| ekādaśaṃ tu naraka sarvatraivārdhadagdhatā | dvādaśaṃ tu narakaṃ yannityaṃ narakakṣālanam || 48 || trayodaśaṃ tu narakaṃ navadvāramalāni vai | caturdaśaṃ tu narakam udarasthaṃ sadā malam || 49 || malakuṇḍaḥ śarīraṃ vai nityaṃ narakasaṃbhṛtam | pañcadaśaṃ tu narakaṃ paśuvanmalinā sthitiḥ ||4.72.50 || ṣoḍaśaṃ narakaṃ yāmyaṃ sahasradhā tu vistṛtam | ityevaṃ badrike loke bhavanti narakāṇi hi | |51 || duṣṭaputro duṣṭaśiṣyo rājā duṣṭaśca bhakṣakaḥ | rakṣako bhakṣakastrātā hanteti narakāṇi vai || 52|| prātikūlyaṃ tathāniṣṭaprāptirvighnāni yānyapi | sarve te nirayā loke durbhāgyānāṃ bhavanti hi ||53|| kārāgāre nivāsaśca tathārāteradhīnatā | durbhikṣe bhikṣukī vṛttirnarakāṇi bhavanti hi |||54|| lobho mānaṃ ca ruṭ kāmo dveṣo rāgo’pyasūyikā | īrṣyā matsara udvegaḥ sākṣātte nirayāstviha ||55 || ajñānaṃ ca tamo mohaścauryaṃ śāṭhyamapūrṇatā | pratāraṇaṃ ca viśvastaghātanaṃ nirayāstvime ||56 || unmattatvaṃ vicittatvaṃ śītoṣṇāgama ulbaṇaḥ | chedyabhedyāṅgahīnatvaṃ narakāste sadā matāḥ ||57 || malamūtrāśayāḥ sarve narakā deharūpiṇaḥ | garbhavāso janmamṛtyū narakāste sadā matāḥ |||58||| yāvantaḥ kardamāḥ svedā durgandhā narakā hi te | apakīrtiśca narakaṃ śokāgnirnirayo mahān |||59 || ādhayo vyādhayaścopādhayaste narakāḥ sadā | badrike yasya santoṣastasya svargamanuttamam || 4.72.60 || tṛṣṇākṣayasukhaṃ svargaṃ nirīhatā sukhaṃ param | pratiṣṭhāṃ śaukarīṃ viṣṭhāṃ gauravaṃ rauravaṃ tathā || 61 || abhimānaṃ surāpānaṃ tyaktvā trīṇi sukhī bhavet | necchānāṃ vilayaścāsti bhogānāṃ viratirna hi || 62|| karmaṇāṃ śūnyatā nāsti trīṇi tyaktvā sukho bhavet | tṛptirnāsti rasānāṃ vai śāntirnāsti ca karmiṇām || 63 || nivṛttirdehināṃ nāsti triguṇaḥ sarvadā sukhī | adhyātmajñāne divaso rātriryasya narāyaṇe || 64|| nidrā brahmātmasandhāne sa vai syāt sarvathā sukhī | duḥkhadā sukhatṛṣṇāpi tāṃ tyaktvā syāt sukhī sadā || 65|| śarīraṃ narakaṃ sarvaṃ navadvāraṃ malairbhṛtam | puṣṭaṃ malātmakairbhāvairātmano nirayātmakam || 66 || are prapaśya badari nāsikāyāḥ pragartayoḥ | pūyabhāgaḥ prasravati durgandhaścauṣṭhalepakaḥ || 67|| lālājālaṃ mukhe nityaṃ kaphaścāntaḥpradeśataḥ | mukhamāyāti nityaṃ ca dantamūleṣu pūyakam || 68|| durgandhaṃ dantamūleṣu pakvaṃ pūyaṃ pravardhate | prātarmukhaṃ hi durgandhaṃ śvāso durgandhasaṃbhṛtaḥ ||69 || svedaḥ sarveṣu sarvatra romasvabhisravatyapi | durgandhaḥ kṣārabhṛt sarvaḥ sugandho yatra durlabhaḥ ||4.72.7 0 || śreṣṭhāṃgamevaṃ durgandhamanyāṃgānāṃ tu kā kathā | manuṣyāṇāṃ viḍālānāṃ siṃhānāṃ rakṣasāṃ tathā ||7 1 || piśācānāṃ sūkarāṇāṃ kākānāṃ dehasāmyatā | badrike sarvathā nityadurgandhāśuddhisaṃbhṛtām ||72|| naisargāśuddhadeho’yaṃ kathaṃ śuddhimavāpnuyāt | tasmād yogijanā nityaṃ kṣālayantyāntaraṃ sadā ||73 || dhyānena cetanaṃ dehasthitamātmānamutsukāḥ | samādhināpnuvantyenaṃ satyaṃ satyātmanānvitam ||74|| paramātmā nityaśuddhaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ | yatrāste cāsane taccāsanaṃ śuddhaṃ sadātmakam || 75 || sannātmā cetano nityasaccidānandatattvakaḥ | taṃ santaṃ sāttvataṃ bhaktaṃ bhāvayanti budhāḥ sadā ||76|| hṛdaye vartamānaṃ taṃ svāminā saṃvirājitam | prakāśitaṃ śritaṃ nityaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaparamātmanā || 77|| dhyāyanti jñānavimalā dehabhāvavivarjitāḥ | vivekalabdhavairāgyāḥ santaḥ santaṃ hṛdi sthitam ||78 | | yatrāsatyamanṛtaṃ ca phalgumithyāmṛṣātmatā | aṇutulyāpi nāstyeva santo dhyāyanti taṃ nijam | | 79 | | te pāraṃ samprayāntyasya kardamasya hi varṣmaṇaḥ | sarvamalāni santyajya prayānti parameśvaram ||4.72.8 0 || māyā malātmikā nityaṃ tatrāpi rājaso guṇaḥ | tamastu malinaṃ nityaṃ malaṃ sarvaṃ hi tāmasam ||8 1 || tata utpannatattvāni mahadahaṃ ca māyikau | indriyāṇi viṣayāśca bhūtāni malināni vai ||82| | bhautikāni samastāni malināni malāni ca | badrike tāpasāḥ santastasmāt tyajanti bhautikam ||83 || śāśvataṃ cintayantyeva bhajante śāśvataṃ harim | tiṣṭhanti brahmabhāve ca modante cātmagahvare ||84|| pariharantyasatyaṃ tajjagat pāpaughasaṃbhṛtam | mokṣārthaṃ ca yatante te sadgurvāśrayamāsthitāḥ ||85|| evaṃ badrīpriye devagatīśvarastu bhūsuraḥ | satyāsatyamayaṃ vīkṣya parabhāgyaṃ grahām̐stathā ||8 6 || satyānṛtamayaṃ sarvaṃ sandigdhaṃ bhāvi dehinām | nivedayati dehibhyaḥ pāpamardhaṃ yathātatham ||87|| tena pāpena pīḍāvān patnyai saha pramuktaye | patnī dharmavatī śrutvā patyuḥ priyacikīrṣayā ||88 || patiṃ nītvānasā sādhvī jagāma śarkarāpuram | kathāsthalaṃ muniṃ vyāsaṃ dadarśa ca pupūja ca ||8 9 || nyavedayat svāmiduḥkhaṃ muktaye prārthayanmunim | vyāsaṃ svataḥprakāśākhyaṃ vyāso’pi dayayā tadā || 4.72.90 || bhūsurāya dadau mantraṃ nāmadhunyaṃ dadau vratam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā || 91 || prabhonārāyaṇa padmāvatīnārāyaṇa prabho | jayākṛṣṇa lalitāśrīkṛṣṇa rādhāpate vibho ||92|| patnī cāpi prajagrāha mantraṃ dhunyaṃ vrataṃ tathā | papatustau hareḥ pādāmṛtavāri śubhapradam ||93|| cakhadatuḥ prasād ca śuśruvatuḥ kathāmṛtam | māsānte śrīharistābhyāṃ darśanaṃ pradadau prabhuḥ ||94|| pasparśa taṃ karāgreṇa rugṇaṃ nīrogiṇaṃ vyadhāt | divyabhāv vyadhāccāpi bhāryāṃ divyāṃ vyadhāttathā ||95|| tatastābhyāṃ prārthitaśca harirmokṣārthamatyati | hariḥ kṛtvā divyadehau tau tu nije vimānake ||96|| nyasya vaiśākhapūrṇāyāṃ ninye dhāmākṣaraṃ nijam | paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ jyotirvit prāpa mokṣaṇam ||97|| puṇyavatyā striyā sākaṃ paraṃ mokṣamavāpa saḥ | badrike mahadāścaryamabhūt tat sarvadehinām ||98|| māsamātreṇa viprasya roganāśaśca mokṣaṇam | praśaśaṃsurjanā viprabhāryā pativratāṃ śubhām ||99|| yayā svāmī prāpito vai mokṣaṃ cājñāpravṛttayā | dhanyā sā gṛhiṇī loke yājñākarī varasya vai || 4.72.1 00|| dhanyo nārāyaṇaścāpi śaraṇyo mokṣado varaḥ | badrike jīvaloke’tra snehaḥ svargaḥ sadottamaḥ || 101 || paropakāraḥ snehena sevā snehena jāyate | sukhadatvaṃ premabhāvairjāyate śraddhayā tathā || 102|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇādvartanāttathā | bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi kṛpā kṛṣṇasya vai bhavet || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne devagatīśvarasya viprasyārdhajyotirvido’satyapāpādināśena kathāśravaṇakāriṇaḥ puṇyavatībhāryāsahitasya mokṣa ityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 72 ||
<4.73> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi bandijanasya pāvanīm | kathāṃ mokṣakarīṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastavānvitām || 1 || dveṣarāgajayanāmni nagare pāvanaḥ paraḥ | bandijano’bhavannāmnā jayamānābhidhaḥ sukhī || 2 || kuṭumbasahitastatra vasamānaśca jīvikām | bandiṃ suvandanaṃ rājñāṃ kṛtvā nirvahate sadā || 3 || dveṣarāgajaye grāme rājāsīd vajravikramaḥ | bandipriyo hi bahudhā dānapriyastathottamaḥ || 4 || nityaṃ rātrau divā prātarbandistriyaśca bandinaḥ | vandanāmiśritā gītīrgāyanti tasya sannidhau || 1 || viṣṇutulyamindratulyaṃ rudratulyaṃ śaśiprabham | ravitulyaṃ cakravartitulyaṃ matvā narāḥ striyaḥ || 6 || kalpitāstatkathāḥ sarvā gāyanti supraśaṃsitāḥ | jayamāno vandakastu nūtnaṃ nityaṃ pragāyati || 7 || prasanno’sya viśeṣeṇa jāyate vajravikramaḥ | pāritoṣikamasmai sa svarṇamudrāṃ dadāti ca || 8 || jayamāno jayaṃ datvā natvā taṃ nṛpatiṃ gṛham | nityaṃ prayāti muditaḥ kāvyaṃ nūtnaṃ karoti ca || 9 || dvitīye ca dine prātargatvā gāyati sannidhau | evaṃ sadā karotyeva jīvikāṃ labhate sadā || 4.73.1 0|| athaikadā jayamāno jvareṇātīva pīḍitaḥ | śeke gantuṃ na bhūpāgre bhūpaśca vihvalo’bhavat || 1 1|| pratīkṣamāṇastaṃ rājā na lebhe darśanaṃ kaveḥ | utthāya sa yayau padbhyāṃ jayamānasya mandiram || 12|| jayamānaścakārāsya bhūpasya svāgatādikam | āsanaṃ pradadāvupāviveśa nṛpatiḥ sa ca || 1 3|| pṛṣṭvā tu kuśalaṃ vīkṣya jvaritaṃ kavimuttamam | bandino jvaraśāntyarthaṃ vaidyamāhūya cauṣadham || 14|| kārayāmāsa nṛpatistasyāgre tvavasannṛpaḥ | muhūrtānte jvaro naṣṭo nīrugṇo jayamānakaḥ || 15|| nṛpaṃ bandipriyaṃ tatra vavande tanmano vidan | aho rājan yathārthaṃ vai bhavato nāma vidyate || 1 6|| rājase devavalloke rakṣasi dyunivāsivat | śobhase kṛṣṇavad viṣṇutulyo dadāsi sampadaḥ || 17|| dayāṃ karoṣi lakṣmīvannibhālayasi brahmavat | āyāsi meghavad rājan śṛṇoṣi paramātmavat || 18|| prerayasi prabheśābhaḥ prajāṃ dharasi dharmavat | sudhāṃśuvat poṣayasi prakāśase tu candravat| || 19|| sevase mātṛvad rājan sukhākaroṣi rātrivat | pitṛvat pālayasi śrīsamo bhavasi bhūtale ||4.73.20 || kubero’nya ivābhāsi dhanadātā dhaneśvaraḥ | suvarṇaṃ srāvayasyatra vahniḥtulyaḥ pratāpavān ||21|| śāsane dharmarājābho vibhāsi ca diśāṃpatiḥ | yatra rājan vidyase tadvanaṃ prajāyate divam ||22| prajā svargāyate cāpi svargaṃ tatheśvarāyate | yatra rājan vartase golokāyate tu tatsthalam ||23|| saudho vaikuṇṭhāyate sa yatra bhramasi bhāgyavān | yatra vasasi kṣaṇavat sthalaṃ mokṣāyate’pi tat ||24|| ājñāpayasi kṣmeśām̐śca sureśānīśvarānapi | sarve vahanti satataṃ sabhayā bhṛtyakā iva || 25|| sarvaśāstrāṇi gāyanti vajravikramasadguṇān | śrutaṃ rājan mayā tvadya śarkarānagare’dhunā ||26|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathā pravartate | yasyāṃ pravarṇyate’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||27|| sarveśvareśvaraḥ svāmīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hi saḥ | sarvāvatāradhartā ca sarvabrahmāṇḍarakṣakaḥ ||28|| sarvarājādhirājaśca sarvalakṣmīramāpatiḥ | sarvamuktapatiḥ sarvadaivatānāṃ ca daivatam ||29|| sarvaśaktipatiḥ sarvasamrāḍ brahmāṇḍadhārakaḥ | sarvaviṣṇuśivapūjyaḥ sarvabrahmābhivanditaḥ ||4.73.30|| sarvatīrthanivāsaśca prajñāpadmāvatīpatiḥ | sarveśānaḥ sarvadehiniyantā sarvamokṣadaḥ ||31 || rādhājayāpatiḥ kṛṣṇo bālakṛṣṇo hi gīyate | rājan yathā sārvabhaumo bhagavān sa virājate ||32|| tathā virājate sārvabhaumo’nanyasamo bhuvi | aho bhāgyaṃ paraṃ manye kṛṣṇavannṛpatirgṛhe ||33|| aho bhāgyaṃ paraṃ rājan sādhuvad vartase sadā | mṛṣā mithyā vartase na satyavrataḥ pravartase ||34|| satyaṃ vadasi satyaṃ ca śṛṇoṣi vindase ṛtam | satyaṃ brahma cintayasi mokṣe sthito’si sarvathā ||35|| kālakavalatāṃ prāptāḥ pūrvanṛpatayo’dhruvāḥ | na tathā bhāsase rājan kālapāśātigo hyasi ||36|| mṛtyuḥ sarveṣu yaścāste sa nāsti vajravikrame | vārdhakyaṃ yāmyakaṣṭāni na santi vajravikrame || 37|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇatulyo vibhāsi me | aho kṛṣṇa aho kṛṣṇa aho kṛṣṇa hare hare || 38|| aho rājannaho rājannaho rājan hare hare | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa || 29|| bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāyaṇa | aho rājannaho kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāpate ||4.73.40|| aho viṣṇo aho śrīmadbālakṛṣṇa śriyaḥ pate | aho bhāgyaṃ mama rājan kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa hare hare ||41 || aho bhāgyaṃ nṛpateśca kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa hare hare | aho svāminnaho svāminnārāyaṇa jagatpate || 42|| aho yāminnaho yāminnārāyaṇa prabhopate | aho kṛṣṇahare svāmin padmāvatīsatīpate ||43|| aho’kṣarapate svāmin badarīsuguṇāpate | duḥkhahāśrīpate rādhāmaṃjulīmāṇikīpate ||44|| muktamuktānikāhaṃsāsvāmin jayādayāpate | jayālalitākāntaśrīsarvadhāmapate pate ||45|| ātmamokṣapate lakṣmīsaṃhitākhyakathāpate | māmuddhara kṛpāsindho vajravikramamuddhara ||46|| evaṃ brahmātmabhāvena jayamānastu vandakaḥ | tuṣṭāva kaṃbharālālaṃ gopālatanujaṃ prabhum ||47|| nṛpatiṃ cāpi taṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaikyabhāvataḥ | rājā kṛṣṇābhidhāḥ śrutvā tūrṇaṃ niṣkalmaṣo’bhavat ||48|| ajñānaṃ vigataṃ rājño moho naṣṭo’bhavattadā | naṣṭo rāgo nijaślāghāviṣayo viramo’bhavat ||49|| mithyābhimānanāśena prakāśo’sya vyajāyata | kathāyāḥ śravaṇecchā ca darśanecchā harestathā ||4.73.50||| kālamṛtyujarāvyādhināśecchā ca vyajāyata | vairāgyaścābhavattasya nāśaśīlāccharīrataḥ ||51 || vivekaṃ prāptavān rājā śrutvā mṛṣāpraśaṃsanam | aho’yaṃ jāyamāno me kurute yatpraśaṃsanam ||52|| tadaṃśo’pi mayi nāsti mayi śaktirna vidyate | vidyate naiva bhaktiśca nārāyaṇabalaṃ na ca ||53|| kālapāśasya yogyo’haṃ mariṣyāmi kṣaṇāntare | kīṭavadvartamāno’smi sṛṣṭau me gaṇanāsti na |||94|| nāhaṃ mṛtyuvihīno’smi kālasya kavalo’smyapi | māyāyāṃ vartamāno’smi mokṣe naiva sthito’smi ca |||55||| cintayāmi na cātmānaṃ na brahma na narāyaṇam | na pālayāmi satyaṃ ca mithyāyāṃ saṃrato’smi ca ||96|| na varte’haṃ sādhuvacca kutastaraṃ tu kṛṣṇavat | khaṇḍarājo’pi naivāsmi sārvabhaumaḥ kutastaraḥ |||57|| nājñāyāṃ mama deho’sti devādyāstu kutastarāḥ | durguṇo’haṃ sadā cāsmi sadguṇastu kutastaraḥ ||58|| bāliśo’haṃ pramūrkho’haṃ mṛṣākīrtipriyo’smyaham | māyājāle vicitto’haṃ pramattonmattavattathā |||55|| aho nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ smaryate na mayā hariḥ | icchāmi bhavituṃ nārāyaṇatulyo mṛṣāśravaḥ ||4.73.60|| pāpaṃ karomi satataṃ pāpātmā kṛṣṇaśatruvat | mahāpāpyatipāpātmā kārayāmi praśaṃsanam ||61|| nāsti pūgīphalaṃ haste vāñcchāmi śevadhīśatām | nirmalaṃ hṛdayaṃ nāsti samicchāmi sureśatām || 32|| malinaṃ sarvathā varṣma manye śivādhikaṃ khalaḥ | kīdṛśo’haṃ paśuśreṣṭho’dhamo mithyābhimānavān || 63 || dhanyo’yaṃ jayamāno hi bhakto’smi paramātmanaḥ | mama mokṣakaraścāsmi guruścāpyasti me’dhunā || 64|| praśaṃsāmiṣato yenāhitaṃ jñānaṃ mayi dhruvam | vivekaścāhitastena mṛṣāgarvavināśakṛt || 65|| smāritā devatāḥ sarvāḥ smāritaḥ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ | smāritā śrīsaṃhitāyāḥ kathā pāpavimocinī || 66|| avaśyaṃ pāpanāśārthaṃ gacchāmi tatkathāsthalam | pāvanīṃ sādhutāṃ labdhvā kariṣye bhajanaṃ hareḥ || 67|| tariṣyāmi bhavābdhiṃ ca kariṣye svātmamokṣaṇam | mṛṣāpāpaṃ kṣālayiṣye grahīṣye satyavartanam || 68 || nāmaśravaṇamātreṇa hṛdayaṃ pūtatāṃ gatam | tatkathāśravaṇāt kiṃ kiṃ syānme śreya uttamam || 69 || jayamāno jayatveva me vivekaprado guruḥ | vandakā vandinaḥ santu tādṛśā mokṣadarśakāḥ ||4.73.7 0 || ajñānahārakā santu na santu śaṃkhavādinaḥ | mithyāgālaphaṭā mā ca santu santu ṛtaṃvadāḥ ||7 1 || vicāryetthaṃ nṛpaḥ prāha śiṣyavad bandinaṃ gurum | aho vivekadānena tārito’haṃ tvayā gṛhe || 72|| praśaṃsā yā tvayā proktā śrutā mayātirāgiṇā | śrutottaraṃ mama naṣṭo rāgastṛṣṇā layaṃ gatā |||73 || mṛṣā satyaṃ ca yattattvaṃ prakāśitaṃ tu me hṛdi | dāso’smi te gurustvaṃ ca saṃsāroddhārakṛnmama ||74|| vada me kva haristvāste kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | kathā kva vartate lakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃbhavā ||75 || śravaṇecchā vartate me mṛṣapāpaṃ vyapohitum | mokṣecchā vartate bandin naya yatra kathāmṛtam || 76 || ityevaṃ vadatastasya nṛpaterdarśanaṃ hareḥ | ajāyata prakāśe svahṛdaye paramātmanaḥ ||77|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastūrṇaṃ pradarśya rūpamātmanaḥ | tirobhavaddhi hṛdye vṛttīrākarṣayan drutam ||78 || mūrtidarśanamātreṇa rājā paravaśo’bhavat | nanarta bahudhā tatra dehabhānavivarjitaḥ ||79|| agāyata harikṛṣṇakṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhum | satālagālavādyena kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa hare hare ||4.73.8 0 || jayamāno’pi tenaiva sārdhaṃ saṃkīrtanaṃ vyadhāt | pramodasaṃbhṛtaścāpi rājñā saha nanarta ha || 81 || aho badrīpriye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai kṛpā | kathākṛṣṇapraśaṃsābhiḥ kṛṣṇaścopasthito’bhavat ||8 2 || evaṃ muhūrtamātraṃ tau nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ pracakratuḥ | tataḥ śāntau sukhānandabhṛtau virematuḥ kṣaṇam ||83 || parasparaṃ ca kathayāmāsatuḥ pārameśvaram | darśanaṃ ca mahānandaṃ mahāsaubhāgyamātmanoḥ ||84|| śuśruvuścānyamanujā narā nāryastadā gṛhe | āyātā ye mahāścaryaparā draṣṭaṃ nṛpaṃ tadā ||85 || rājā bandī bandipatnī bandiputrāstathā striyaḥ | putryaśca bāndhavāścāpi śarkarānagaraṃ prati ||86|| gantuṃ sajjā babhūvuste nṛpo rājñī ca tatsutāḥ | putryo rājñyāstathā lokāḥ prajā nāryo narā api ||87|| sahasraśo mānavāste śarkarānagaraṃ prati | gantuṃ sajjā babhūvuścāmātyapradhānakarmiṇaḥ | |88 || dāsyo dāsāḥ karmacārā bhaṭāḥ saṃrakṣakāstathā | gajavāhanasaṃyuktā aśvavārāśca niryayuḥ ||89 || bahusvarṇaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ puṣkalaṃ saha jagṛhuḥ | dānayogyāmbarapātrabhūṣākambalakānapi ||4.73.9 0 || sotsavā bahavo lokā halahaleti vādinaḥ | niryayuste tīrthayātrākṛte kathāsthalīṃ prati || 91 || bhajanaṃ cakrire mārge mahodyānamupāyayuḥ | kathāmaṇḍapasānnidhye sahasraśastu te janāḥ || 92|| mahodyāne nivāsāṃśca yathāyogyaṃ pracakrire | snātvā tīrthajale devān prapūjya maṇḍapaṃ prati || 93 || yayuste pūjanaṃ cakruḥ saṃhitāyāḥ kathottare | vyāsasya pūjanaṃ cakrurlomaśasya satāṃ tathā || 94|| ārārtrikaṃ pracakruścopadā nyadhuḥ purastadā | vyāsādyāḥ svāgataṃ cakrurdaduḥ prasādabhojanam || 95|| atha rājādayaḥ sarve yayurnivāsamutsukāḥ | prātaḥ sarve samāgatya vyāsāttathaiva lomaśāt || 9 6|| mantraṃ dhunyaṃ srajaṃ caiva jagṛhustaulasīṃ mudā | vaiṣṇavāste tato jātāḥ pāvanāḥ śaraṇāgatāḥ || 97|| śuśruvuste kathāṃ nityaṃ pupūjurvyāsamanvaham | ṛṣīn sādhūn satīḥ sādhvīḥ siṣevire hariṃ prabhum || 98 || bhejire paramātmānaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ narāyaṇam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa || 99|| cakrire sarvadā dhunyaṃ prasādaṃ ca jalāmṛtam | sarve bubhujire bālavṛddhayuvajanāḥ sadā || 4.73.100 || tena jātāḥ pāvanāste kṣapitāghaughasañcayāḥ | sāttvatāḥ paramāsteṣāṃ māsānte kṛṣṇa āyayau || 101 || prabhurnārāyaṇo divyamūrtirvimānamāsthitaḥ | sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ bhūmāvavātatāra cāmbarāt || 102 || jalaṃ cikṣepa paritasteṣāmupari gopajaḥ | sarve divyadṛśo jātā bhālayāmāsuracyutam || 103 || uktā bhagavatā gantuṃ nṛpādyāścākṣaraṃ padam | sahasrādhijanāḥ sajjā babhūvurgantumakṣaram || 1 04|| divyān dehān vidhāyaiva nītvā vimānake ca tān | śeṣām̐styaktvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’kṣaraṃ jagāma ha || 1 09|| jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇasya pañcamyāṃ ninye tānakṣaraṃ hariḥ | mahāścaryamidaṃ jātaṃ khyātaṃ sarvaṃ vyajāyata || 106 | | badrike śeṣavargāstu mahābhāgavatottamāḥ | kathāṃ śrutvā yayurnaijaṃ dveṣarāgajayaṃ puram || 1 07|| te’pi kālena govindaṃ bhajitvā cākṣaraṃ yayuḥ | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirdivaṃ milet || 108 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne jayamānākhyabandijanasya stavanena prāptavairāgyavivekasya vajravikramanṛpatestatprajānāṃ ca kathāśravaṇādibhirmokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā trisaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 73 ||
<4.74> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye lakṣmi kathāṃ sūtasya mokṣadām | pañcanade śubhe deśe sindhucīnāpagāntare || 1 || saṃgame bhūtale tvāsīnnagarī pañcanādinī | tasyā rājābhavannāmnā saptābdhisiṃha uttamaḥ || 2 || mahāparākramaḥ khyātaśauryaḥ prajāprarakṣakaḥ | hastivājimahāyānavimānādicamūpatiḥ || 3 || prajāpālo dharmabuddhirbrahmakarmaparāyaṇaḥ | tasya svasya rathavāhaḥ sūto’bhavat sukesarī || 4 || so’pi bhūpasamo dehe bhāne mantre raṇe matau | sūtakāryakaro nityaṃ rājñaḥ priyataro’bhavat || 5 || sa rājā rathamāsthāya sūtanoditamuttamam | mṛgayārthamaraṇyānīṃ vicacāra nadītaṭe || 6 || tatra pātuṃ jalaṃ sindhutaṭaṃ yayau rathānvitaḥ | viśaśrāma papau vāri sūto vāri papau tataḥ || 7 || aśvāḥ papurjalaṃ śrāntā muktā rathayugāt kṣaṇam | vaṭacchāyātale rājā sūryatāpena noditaḥ || 8 || lebhe nidrāṃ manāk tāvat sarpo vaṭāt papāta ha | nṛpakaṇṭhopari śvetavarṇo’daśannṛpaṃ drutam || 9 || sūto dadarśa sarpaṃ taṃ daśantaṃ dīrghavigraham | neme dūrāt sūtavaryo jānan devasamaṃ sṛpam || 4.74.10 || namaste śvetavarṇāya śeṣarūpāya bhogine | daṃśate mama rājānaṃ viṣṇurūpāya te namaḥ || 11 || kālarūpāya rudrāya raudrāya prāṇahāriṇe | namaste duḥkhahārāya rakṣākartre muhurnamaḥ || 1 2|| eṣo’haṃ nṛpateḥ sūto bhṛtyo’smi kiṃkarastviha | aparo na sahāyo’sti dayālo māṃ prarakṣaya || 1 3|| īdṛśe nirjane’raṇye jīvite mayi kiṃkare | svāmino maraṇaṃ yogyaṃ naiva naiva ca naiva ca || 1 4|| tato matsvāminaṃ sarpa samuddhara viṣānalāt | tatsthāne māṃ daśa sarpa svasti me te muhurnamaḥ || 15|| rājārthe devatārthe ca guvarthe gokṛte tathā | pitrarthe prāṇadātā yaḥ sa svargaṃ divyamaśnute || 16 || naṣṭe nṛpe mama mṛtyurdhruvaścātra bhaviṣyati | tatpāpaṃ te bhavet sarpa tasmāduddhara mannṛpam || 1 7|| nṛpoddhāre mama bhṛtyau pāpa te na bhaviṣyati | mṛte svāmini bhṛtyasya jīvanaṃ garhitaṃ kṣitau || 18 || tasmād rakṣaya bhogīndra dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari | viṣaṃ vārāya śīghraṃ tu yāvanniryānti nāsavaḥ || 19 || tvaṃ vane vidyase svāmī vaṭasthāyīti tarkaye | tavātithisvarūpo’haṃ nṛpaste’tithirasti ca || 4.74.20 || ātitheyo bhavān bhūtvā prarakṣatu kṣitīśvaram | vidhehi svāgataṃ sarpa jīvadānena bhūpateḥ || 21 || na cet pāpaṃ bhavette’tra puṇyanāśo bhavettava | āśābhagno’tithiryasya gṛhātpratinivartate ||22|| pāpaṃ datvā puṇyamapyādāyātithiḥ sa gacchati | dhanyāste gṛhiṇaḥ sarpa pūjyante’tithayo’nvaham || 23 || yeṣāṃ gṛheṣu pūjānnavastravāripradānakaiḥ | jīvadānasamaṃ dānaṃ paraṃ dānaṃ na vidyate || 24|| sarvadānakṛtaṃ puṇyamabhayasya prade bhavet | sarvapāpāni bhayade tiṣṭhanti nātra saṃśayaḥ || 25 || bhayaṃ kāryaṃ na kasyāpi sūkṣmasyāpi tu dehinaḥ | bhayadasya phalaṃ syādvai pratibhayaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 26 || tasmād rakṣaya rājānaṃ sarpa tvaṃ vaṭasaṃgṛhī | na cet prāṇabhayaṃ te’pi mama bāṇena viddhi hi ||27|| ekasya paścādubhayorvyasutvaṃ niścitaṃ tviha | datvā prāṇaṃ tava prāṇānnītvā yāsye yamālayam ||28|| vadātra śīghraṃ kartavyaṃ śara eṣo’nusandhitaḥ | ityuktvā badrike dhanuḥ saguṇaṃ saśaraṃ tathā ||29|| vidhāya krodhamāpannaḥ pratīkṣate hitaṃ vacaḥ | tāvat sarpo bhīta iva pratyuvāca tu sāntvayan ||4.74.30|| śṛṇvatithe tathyamatra tato yogyāya cārhasi | avicāryakṛtaḥ śīghraṃ bhayamāpadyate ṛtam ||3 1|| sukesarin purā sṛṣṭau brahmā rudrāya sṛṣṭaye | ājñāṃ cakāra rudro’sau na svīcakāra vai tadā ||32|| svayaṃ brahmā tu vividhāḥ prajāḥ sasarja śāntimān | athotpannāḥ prajāścāsannākalpasthāyijīvanāḥ ||33|| nāpyavardhanta ca nāśaṃ na prāpurvai yadā tadā | vṛddhyarthaṃ sa nijāddehāt prajāḥ sasarja maithunīḥ ||34|| yugalāni sahasrāṇi sahasrāṇāṃ śatāni ca | bahvyaḥ prajāstā utpannā yugalebhyo’rbudārbudam ||35|| tāsāmasaṃkhyasaṃtatyā prapūritamidaṃ jagat | tāsāṃ puṣṭiṃ cakāraiva viṣṇurlakṣmīpatiḥ prabhuḥ ||36 na nāśo’sti tadā tāsāṃ saṃkulitaṃ jagad yadā | tadā brahmā tu rudrāya prajānāśakalāṃ dadau ||37|| rudraḥ prāha na me hiṃsā rocate bhayakāriṇī | hiṃsāphalaṃ tu narakaṃ śāpo duḥkhaṃ tatholbaṇam ||38|| krūraṃ karma dayāhīnaṃ hiṃsanaṃ prāṇaghātanam | na tat kariṣye doṣāḍhyaṃ pāpāḍhyaṃ vai prajāpate ||39||| tadā brahmā vicāryaiva rudramuvāca tatkṣaṇam | kālaṃ mṛtyuṃ jarāṃ vyādhīn sṛjāmi paśya nāśakān ||4.74.40|| te vināśān kariṣyanti mā te hiṃsā bhavecchiva | nimittena vināśaḥ syāt tvaṃ tannirīkṣako bhava ||41 || ityuktaḥ śaṅkaro devo jagṛhe brāhmaṇo vacaḥ | saṃhārakarmaṇāmādhidaivatvaṃ jagṛhe haraḥ ||42|| tato brahmā sasarjoktān kālamṛtyujarādhikān | krūrān nimittabhūtām̐śca dehino naḥ sasarja ca ||43|| sarpān vyāghrān vṛścikām̐śca viṣāḍhyān dehinastathā | jvarān rogānmandaśaktauḥ sasarja mārakānajaḥ ||44|| tebhyo’smabhyo dadāvājñāṃ yeṣāṃ mṛtyuryathā mataḥ | yena nimittamātreṇa bādhadhvaṃ tān tathaiva ha ||45|| evamājñāṃ pradāyaiva śaṅkarāya samarpitāḥ | te vayaṃ nāśakartāro naṣṭāyuṣāṃ na cānyathā ||46|| preryante śaṅkareṇaiva kālā rogā aśaktayaḥ | viṣāḍhyā rūpavantaśca bhūtvā bhūtvā prajāsu ca ||47|| vicarāmo nāśarekhāṃ nāśakṣaṇaṃ vilokya ca | daśāmo nānyathā sūta gatāyurnṛpatistviha ||48|| dṛṣṭo mayā na doṣo me na vayaṃ bhayaśālinaḥ | ye ye’smākaṃ mahīmānā bhavantyatithayastathā ||49|| kurmasteṣāṃ tu sammānaṃ viṣārpaṇairhi mṛtyave | kṛto mayā cātitheyaḥ satkāro yo’stimadgṛhe ||4.74.50|| rājā gato hi nidhanaṃ na punaḥ prāṇameṣyati | sūta te jīvanaṃ cāste śavaṃ naya prayāhi ca ||51 || yadi tvaṃ śarasandhānairmama prāṇān hariṣyasi | nūtnena karmaṇā tvaṃ ca prāṇān tyakṣyasi cātra vai ||52|| mānuṣāṇāṃ tu śastrāṇāṃ daive pravartanaṃ nahi | sarpo’haṃ kālarūpo’haṃ tathyaṃ vacmi prayāhi ca ||53|| viramāsmāt karmaṇaśca mā svāyuṣyaṃ vināśaya | vicāryātra yathāyogyaṃ yad vidheyaṃ vidhehi tat ||||54|| eṣo’smi vaṭaśākhāyāṃ nirbhīko hṛdgataṃ kuru | kartustu sāhasasyaivāpadyante duḥkhakoṭayaḥ ||55|| vayaṃ niyāmakāḥ sṛṣṭestvaṃ niyāmyo’si sanṛpaḥ | hiṃsāyāṃ mama pāpaṃ na tava pāpaṃ tu vai dhruvam |||56||| hiṃsāyāṃ me na narakaṃ te narakaṃ dhruvaṃ bhavet | rājñā kāryo virodho na janena sukhamicchatā ||57|| virodho nāpi daivena bhāgyenāpi ca naiva ha | yadāpatet tadbhoktavyaṃ yathākarma hyupasthitam ||98|| sūta naiva hi kartavyo virodho vahninā saha | na kālena saha kāryo virodhaḥ sukhamicchatā ||59|| na mṛtyunā neśvareṇa na śāstrā na striyā hyapi | na mūrkheṇa na kruddhena na śastradhāriṇāpi ca ||4.74.60|| na samarthena kartavyo virodho mṛdunā satā | na śastreṇa na bhūtaiśca na camatkārakāriṇā ||6 1|| balinā na viroddhavyaṃ na mātrā janakena ca | guruṇā na viroddhavyaṃ tapasvinā na sādhunā ||62|| bahubhirna viroddhavyaṃ kṣemaṃ kuśalamicchatā | patinā na viroddhavyaṃ na gṛhasvāminā kvacit ||63|| na piśācena yoddhavyaṃ rakṣasā dānavena na | na siṃhena gajenāpi na sarpeṇa viṣeṇa ca ||64|| na duṣṭena ca yoddhavyaṃ na nirdayena śatruṇā | tatra dharmo na vai tiṣṭhecchaṭhe duṣṭe ca nirdaye ||65|| śaraṃ saṃhara rājānaṃ nayorddhvadaihikaṃ kuru | yadvā muñca śaraṃ śīghraṃ mayi yatphalamāpnuyāḥ ||66|| vivekena vidadhyādvai taddhīnastvāpadāṃ padam | manuṣyo’si ca medhāvī yad yogyaṃ tat samācara || 67|| nāyaṃ hato mayā sūta rājā hataḥ svakarmaṇā | nāhaṃ ghātamavāpsyāmi śareṇa tava kesarin ||68|| pratyuta tava ghātārthaḥ śaraścātra bhaviṣyati | mamāhamiti mohaṃ tvaṃ muñca mā kuru mohanam || 69|| kva te rājā kvāsya sūtaḥ sarvaṃ vai karmabandhanam bhautike puttale baddhā ātmāno nijakarmabhiḥ ||4.74.70|| bhuñjate svakṛtaṃ karma yāvad dehe vasanti hi | tat tyaktvā cāpare dehe punaḥ karmāṇi bhuñjate ||71|| mayi sarpe na viśvāsaste yadi muñca mārgaṇam | kṛtvā parīkṣāṃ ca tato mauḍhyaṃ svayaṃ prahāsyasi ||72|| ityuktvā badrike sarpo virarāma kathānakāt | sūto vicārya sahasā tyaktvā dhanuḥ śaraṃ tathā ||73|| eṣo’haṃ śaraṇe te’smi sarpadeva śucaṃ hara | devo’si kālakālo’si kālo’si śaṃkaro’si vā ||74|| yo’si so’si ṛtaṃ manye kṛtaṃ tvayā yathātatham | tathāpi vandanāṃ kurve hitaṃ me syād yathā tathā ||75|| nṛpateśca hitaṃ syād yat daṃśaste viphalo’pi na | tathā daivaniyogena vidhehi sarparāḍiha ||76|| ityuktvā badrike sūto daṇḍavatpracakāra tam | sarpo’pi kālarūpo’pi hitaṃ vyacintayat kṣaṇam ||77|| uvāca sūta bhīṃ tyaktvottiṣṭha nṛpaṃ samāhvaya | viṣaṃ harāmi cādyātra nṛpo jīvatu cādhunā ||78|| kintu dhāraya mantraṃ tva nṛpaṃ śrāvaya satvaram | puṇyena tena kālo’haṃ harāmyasya na jīvanam ||79|| ityuktvā badrike kālaḥ sarpo mantraṃ dadau tadā | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||4.74.80|| oṃ bālakṛṣṇāya vidmahe’nādikṛṣṇāya dhīmahi | tannaḥ śrīśaḥ pracodayādīti mantraṃ ca vai dadau ||8 1 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa | bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāyaṇa ||82|| nāmadhunyaṃ dadau cāpi sarpaḥ sūtāya vai tadā | sūtaḥ śrīnṛpateḥ karṇe śrāvayāmāsa satvaram ||83|| tāvad rājā samuttasthau nirviṣaḥ svasthadehavān | sarpaścainaṃ nṛpaṃ prāha yāhi rājan kathāsthalam ||84|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ śṛṇu kathāṃ śubhām | kuru sevāṃ satāṃ cāpi tataḥ śreyaḥ paraṃ vraja ||85|| sūtādatha viśeṣeṇa vṛttāntaṃ nṛpatiḥ svakam | jñātvā dadau dhanyavādān sūtāya bhogine’pi ca ||86|| namaskṛtya drutaṃ naijarathena gṛhamāyayau | gṛhiṇīṃ dāsadāsīśca nītvā saha yayau kathām ||87|| pupūja paramātmānaṃ prabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sumūrtikam | vyāsaṃ ca lomaśaṃ cāpi sādhūn pupūja bhūpatiḥ ||88|| dadau dānānyanekāni kathāṃ śuśrāva bhāvataḥ | bhojanānāṃ pradānaiśca sevāṃ satāṃ cakāra saḥ |89|| sūtena smārito rājā bhajanaṃ pracakāra ha | prasādaṃ pādasalilaṃ jagrāha nṛpatirmuhuḥ ||4.74.90|| kuṭumbasahito badri pāvanaḥ sambabhūva ha | mṛtyubhayāt kṛṣṇamūrtau līnavad vartate sadā ||9 1|| jyeṣṭhe kṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ tu madhyāhne bhagavān hariḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vimānamāsthitaḥ ||92|| āyayau tasya mokṣārthaṃ rājā sajjo babhūva ca | dadau dānāni sarvāṇi namaskṛtya samastakān ||93|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāhūto vimānamāruroha saḥ | sūtaḥ sukesarī cāpi rājñī rakṣāvatī tathā ||94|| putrāḥ putryoḥ bhṛtyavargā dāsā dāsyo nṛpāya vai | jayavādānnamovādān dadurmokṣapragāmine ||95|| sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ rājā saptābdhisiṃhanāmakaḥ | divyo bhūtvā badrike sa yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ ||96|| rājñyādyāśca nṛpasyaurdhvadaihikaṃ pravyadhustataḥ | sūtaḥ sukesarī rājñī rakṣāvatī sutādayaḥ ||97|| vaiṣṇavāḥ paramā bhūtvā śrutvā kathāṃ pramokṣiṇīm | yayunaiṃjāṃ hi nagarīṃ saindhavīṃ pañcanādinīm ||98|| bhajitvā vallabhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prabhuṃ gopālabālakam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ padmāvatīpatim ||99|| yayuḥ kālena sarve te harerdhāmākṣaraṃ param | evaṃ badrīpriye rājā mṛto mantreṇa jīvitaḥ || 4.74.1 00|| kathāṃ śrutvā hariṃ prāpya yayau brahmākṣaraṃ padam | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya cintanādapi sarvathā || 10 1|| kālamāyāpāpakarmavimuktiḥ saṃbhavettathā | bhuktirmuktirbhavecchreṣṭhā yatheṣṭāḥ syuḥ samṛddhayaḥ || 1 02|| kṛṣṇakathābalaṃ badri sarvabalādhikaṃ matam | tato’dhikaṃ kṛṣṇakṛpābalaṃ sarvārthasādhakam || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne sarpadaṣṭasya saptābdhisiṃhanṛpate sūtadattamantradhunyayogena saṃjīvanaṃ kathāśravaṇena ca mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 74 ||
<4.75> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye lakṣmi māgadhasya kathāṃ śubhām | amṛtākhyanagare vai tadāsīnmāgadho janaḥ || 1 || nāmnā tu harṣanayano vaṃśopavaṃśabodhavān | vaṃśopavaṃśapūrveṣāṃ caritrākhyānakārakaḥ || 2 || rājñāṃ pañcanadīyānāṃ sindhujānāṃ viśeṣataḥ | sa śuśrāva janebhyo vai camatkāraṃ kathodbhavam || 3 || rājñāṃ prajānāṃ bahvīnāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ pāpanāśanam | tato vicārya sahasā kathākarṇanahetave || 4 || āyayau śarkarāpuryāṃ kathāmaṇḍapamāgataḥ | neme sarvān saṃhitāṃ ca vyāsaṃ śrīlomaśaṃ harim || 5 || sādhujanān satīḥ sādhvīrvaiṣṇavān nṛpatīṃstathā | śrotṝn rājñījanām̐ścāpi neme śuśrāva satkathām || 6 || kathānte sa tu vaṃśān vai nārāyaṇasamudbhavān | jagāda bhaktiyuktaśca rañjayāmāsa mānavān || 7 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ | eko divyeśvarakoṭyavatārakoṭikāraṇam || 8 || akṣare parame dhāmni rājate puruṣottamaḥ | tadvaṃśe prathamaṃ kṛṣṇo vyāsudevo vyajāyata || 9 || tato nārāyaṇo jāto mahāviṣṇustataḥ param | tato virāḍ virājācca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || 4.75.1 0|| brahmataḥ sanakādyāśca ṛṣayo mānavādayaḥ | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre tvaśvapaṭṭasarovare || 1 1|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān prabhuḥ | kaṃbharāśrīmahālakṣmīsuto gopālanandanaḥ || 1 2|| lakṣmīrādhāramākṛṣṇāprajñāpadmāvatīpatiḥ | māṇikīsukhadālakṣmīlalitākamalāpatiḥ ||1 3|| vrahmapriyāpatirmuktapatirmuktānikāpatiḥ | haripriyāpatiḥ sarvapatirbrahmapatiḥ prabhuḥ ||14|| vartate viprarūpo’dya sarvagotrāgraśāśvataḥ | gīyate’tra harirlakṣmīnārāyaṇakathādibhiḥ ||15|| jayatvatra mahārājarājādhirājapuṃgavaḥ | vidhātā śreyasāṃ kartā mokṣasya duḥkhanāśanaḥ || 16|| śaraṇāgatarakṣākṛt jayatvānandaśevadhiḥ | parabrahma harikṛṣṇo nityaṃ vijayatetamām ||17|| sādhavo vijayante ca vaiṣṇavā vijayantyati | evaṃ śrībadrike harṣanayanaḥ śrīpatiṃ harim ||18|| abhiṣṭūya sabhāyāṃ sa daṇḍavat pracakāra ha | tulasīdalapuṣpāṇi phalāni śarkarāstathā || 19|| pūgīphalaṃ ca mudrāṃ ca kānakīṃ cāmbaraṃ śubham | vyāsāya ca tathā saṃhitāyai nyadhāt prapūjya ca ||4.75.20|| namaścakre prasādaṃ ca jagṛhe caraṇāmṛtam | mantraṃ ca nāmadhunyaṃ ca jagṛhe vyāsadevataḥ ||21 || jajāpa mantraṃ nityaṃ sa cakre dhunyaprakīrtanam | śuśrāva ca kathāṃ nityamekatāno’bhavat sadā ||22|| pāvanaḥ pūrṇabhāgyaśca samajāyata māgadhaḥ | jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ tu sāyaṃ bhaktyā vaśīkṛtaḥ ||23|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vimānamāsthitaḥ | āyayau taṃ samānetuṃ divyaḥ śrīsevito hariḥ ||24|| māgadhaṃ harṣanayanaṃ saṃkṛtvā divyavigraham | avasthāpya vimāne taṃ ninye dhāmākṣaraṃ nijam ||25|| śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kathāṃ cānyāṃ prapāvanīm | dāsastatrābhavad vṛddhaḥ saṃhitāmaṇḍapasthale ||26|| rātrau rakṣākaro nityaṃ jāgarti yaśca rakṣati | nityaṃ sa bhajate kṛṣṇaṃ kathāṃ śṛṇoti bhāvataḥ ||27|| pradakṣiṇaṃ niśānte ca karoti saṃhitāsanam | patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ nityamarpayatyapi bhāvataḥ ||28|| karoti kīrtanaṃ nityaṃ bhuṃkte prasādamuttamam | pibatyapaḥ prasādotthāḥ satāṃ prasādamaśnute ||29|| sevāṃ vyāsasya dehādisaṃvāhanaṃ karotyapi | mārjanaṃ sadasaścāpi vastrakṣālanamityapi ||4.75.30|| vaiṣṇavebhya iṣṭavastupradānaṃ prakarotyapi | evaṃvidhasya bhaktasya yogidāsābhidhasya tu ||3 1|| prasannaḥ śrīharirjāto badrike cāyayau hariḥ | divyaṃ haṃsaṃ samāruhya sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ||32|| uvāca yogidāsaṃ tvaṃ sajjo bhava vimuktaye | netuṃ samāgato’smyatra haṃsena mokṣaṇaṃ prati ||33|| yogidāso’timumude śrutvā vākyaṃ parātmanaḥ | cacāla śrīhariṃ haṃsaṃ prati yāvad vimuktaye ||34|| tāvanmūrchāmavāpāsau dehaḥ papāta bhūtale | divyarūpo yogidāso’bhavanmuktasvarūpavān ||35|| haṃse niṣādya bhaktaṃ taṃ yayau kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | śāśvataṃ paramaṃ dhāma paśyatāṃ sarvadehinām ||36|| ityevaṃ badrike mukto’bhavat kathādisevayā | yogidāso jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ kṛṣṇamānasaḥ ||37|| athānyāṃ te kathāṃ badri vadāmi bhaktamokṣadām | nāmnā saurabhasāvitro’bhavattāmbūlakārakaḥ ||38|| śarkarānagare badri satāṃ hareśca sevakaḥ | pratyahaṃ so’pi sevāyāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ sthiro’bhavat ||39|| dadāti tāmbūlakāni nityaṃ sahasraśo mudā | sugandhirasacūrṇādimiśritāni śubhāni ca | 4.75.40|| nityaṃ prātaḥ samutthāya snātvā cāyāti maṇḍapam | yathāsthānaṃ samāgatya patrapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ||41|| karoti pūjanaṃ kathāsaṃhitāyāstathā satām | vyāsadevasyārhaṇāṃ ca lomaśasyārhaṇāṃ tathā ||42|| lālāsanasyāpi pūjāṃ pūjāṃ vṛkāyanasya ca | nīlakarṇasya pūjāṃ ca yavakrītādipūjanam ||43|| tuṣitānāṃ hāritānāṃ divimānāyanasya ca | devāyatanameṣāyatamaṃkaṇādiyoginām ||44|| hemaśālāyanādīnāṃ sādhūnāṃ pūjanaṃ prage | karoti nityamevāyaṃ devānāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ||45|| vyāsāya saṃhitāyaicārpayatyeva phalānyapi | tāmcūlakāni tulasīpatrahārām̐śca kausumān ||46|| mudrāścākṣatagodhūmān vastrakambalakām̐stathā | yathāśakti dadātyeva pūjāyāṃ saurabhān rasān ||47|| evaṃ saurabhasāvitro bhaktyā niṣkalmaṣo’bhavat | satāṃ dehādisaṃvāhapādasaṃmardanādikam ||48|| kṛtvā bhuktvā prasādaṃ ca pītvā taccaraṇāmṛtam | śrutvā kathāḥ saṃhitāyāḥ sandagdhavāsano’bhavat ||49|| taṃ netuṃ cākṣare sthāne kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | āyayau śvetagaruḍe sthitvā kathāsthalaṃ hariḥ ||4.75.50|| avātatāra sahasā prasannānanapaṅkajaḥ | prāha saurabhasāvitraṃ prasannastava sevayā |||51|| āyāhi paramaṃ sthānaṃ divyaṃ vyoma mamākṣaram | śrutvā saurabhasāvitraḥ kūrdayitvā nanarta ha ||52|| dhanyaṃ mokṣapadaṃ matvāgataṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | natvā tyaktvā nijaṃ dehaṃ manuṃ japaṃ purārjitam ||53|| nāmadhunyaṃ śrāvayam̐ścāruroha garuḍopari | divyamuktaśarīro’sau yayāvambaravartmanā ||54|| jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇasya dvādaśyāṃ kathottaraṃ yayau param | āścaryaṃ paramaṃ dṛṣṭvā mumudire’timānavāḥ ||55|| śṛṇu badrīpriye devi bhaktagāthāṃ tathāparām | raṃgakārakathāṃ tatrabhūtāṃ paramapāvanīm ||56|| raṃgakāro’bhavannāmnā raṃgilo raṃgakṛt sadā |
