raṃgakalāsu sarvāsu kuśalaścitrakoṭiṣu ||57|| śarkarānagare nityaṃ raṃgakāryaprajīvanaḥ | devasevāparaścāpi sādhubhakto’bhavat sadā ||58|| badrike sa kathāyā vai maṇḍapaṃ samaraṃgayat | devacitrāṇi sarvāṇi bhaktacitrāṇi sarvaśaḥ ||59|| bhittīnāṃ raṃgakāryāṇi paṭaraṃgān suśobhanān | akarot sevayā bhaktyā satāṃ prasannatāptaye ||4.75.60|| hareḥ prasannatāyai ca raṃgasevāṃ tathākarot | abhajatparamātmānaṃ mantraṃ jajāpa nityaśaḥ ||61|| nāmasaṃkīrtanadhunyādīnyācarat kṛtādaraḥ | vaiṣṇavānāṃ sevanaṃ ca kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ vyadhāt ||62|| prasādabhakṣaṇaṃ pādāmṛtavāriprapānakam | pādadhūlivahanaṃ ca śarīre bhāvato’karot ||63||| evaṃ kṣapitapāpaḥ sa saṃprakṣālitavāsanaḥ | iyeṣa śrīharerdhāma gantuṃ śāśvatamakṣaram ||64|| badrike vyāpakaḥ kṛṣṇo’ntaryāmī śrīnarāyaṇaḥ | śvetāśvārūḍha īśeśeśeśvaraḥ samupāyayau ||65|| uvāca raṃgila ehi mama dhāmākṣaraṃ param | raṃgilaḥ sahasā dehaṃ tyaktvā bhautikamutsukaḥ ||66|| divyadeho’bhavat kṛṣṇadṛṣṭyāśvamāruroha ca | sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ nārāyaṇo ninye tamakṣaram ||67|| raṃgilaṃ raṃgakartāraṃ yāntaṃ vīkṣya sabhājanāḥ | jayavādān pracakruśca nemustāṃ diśamacyutam ||68|| jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ raṃgilo hyakṣaraṃ yayau | badrike ca tataścānyāṃ kathāṃ bhaktasya saṃśṛṇu ||69|| vādyakāro’bhavattatra śarkarānagare śubhaḥ | ḍamarūkābhidhaḥ so’pi bhakto vādyādinirmitim ||4.75.70|| kṛtvā vṛttiṃ nirvahati satāṃ sevāṃ karoti ca | kathāyāṃ vādyadānāni kṛtavān bhāvataḥ sa vai ||71 || kāṃsyān śaṃkhān paṭahām̐śca bherīdiṇḍimagomukhān | mṛdaṃgān paṇavām̐ścāpi murajāmbarakām̐stathā ||72|| mardalān veṇuvīṇāśca dardurān kacchapān dadau | talaghātānānakām̐śca dundubhīn tālakān dadau ||73|| tena puṇyena bhagavān prasanno’syābhavattadā | so’pi vādyakalāvijño vādyavādanamācarat ||74|| tena santaḥ prasannāśca badrike tasya cābhavan | sevāṃ cakre satāṃ nityaṃ kathāṃ śuśrāva nityadā ||75|| prasādaṃ jagṛhe nityaṃ pādāmṛtaṃ papau sadā | mantraṃ jajāpa satataṃ nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ vyadhāt ||76|| evaṃ vaiṣṇavasevāyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇasevane rataḥ | ḍamarūko’bhavat sarvanaṣṭapāpaḥ supāvanaḥ ||77|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīkāntavallabhaḥ | āyayau tvakṣaraṃ dhāma netuṃ taṃ ḍamarūkaṇam ||78|| so’pi mokṣakṣaṇaṃ jñātvā cāgataṃ harinā harim | neme dadhyau hṛdaye ca natvā sabhājanān muhuḥ ||79|| bhautikaṃ varṣma santyaktvā divyadehamavāpya ca | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāhūto gajaṃ samāruroha saḥ ||4.75.80|| yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ śrīmannārāyaṇasya śāśvatam | kṛpayā śrīharerbadri yayāvapunarāgamam ||8 1 || jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ yayau ḍamarūko’kṣaram | śṛṇu badrīpriye devi tathā kathāṃ supāvanīm ||82|| bhāvasāro’bhavattatra vastravyāpārakārakaḥ | śarkarānagare nāmnā cihnarāyeti viśrutaḥ ||83 || cihnarāyo dadau vastrasahasraṃ maṇḍapārthakam | bhaktyā kathāsthalārthaṃ sa vaiṣṇavo dhanavān sukhī ||84|| ūrṇikāprastaraṇāni vitānānyuttamāni ca | āsanāni suramyāṇi dadau kathotsave yataḥ ||85|| sādhūn sa sevayāmāsa śuśrāva cācyutīṃ kathām | mantraṃ jagrāha dhunyaṃ ca kīrtanaṃ vyāsadevataḥ ||86|| siṣeve nityamevāpi vastranāṇakadāṇakaiḥ | tatsevayā prasanno’bhūcchrīhariḥ puruṣottamaḥ | |87|| prasādena pavitrāya cihnarāyāya darśanam | pratyakṣaṃ pradadau kṛṣṇo vallabhāryaḥ śriyaḥ patiḥ ||88|| uvāca taṃ prasanno’smi dhāma cāyāhi me’kṣaram | etadvimānavaryeṇa nayāmi paramaṃ padam ||89|| jyeṣṭhāmāyāṃ tu madhyāhne kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā samāgatam | sajjo’bhavat pragantuṃ vai tatyāja bhautikīṃ tanum | |4.75.90|| divyadeho’bhavattūrṇaṃ vimānamāruroha ca | nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ kurvan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti saḥ ||91|| sārdhaṃ śrīhariṇā tūrṇaṃ vimānenākṣaraṃ yayau | jayanādāstadā tatra bhaktānāmabhavan muhuḥ ||92|| badrike ca tadā tatra sāyaṃkāle kathottaram | āścaryaṃ paramaṃ jātaṃ śṛṇu tadgrāmayājinaḥ ||93|| grāmayājī vipradevo’bhavannāmnā rameśvaraḥ | nityaṃ kathāṃ śṛṇotyeva vyāsārhaṇāṃ karoti ca ||94|| bhajate śrīhariṃ nityaṃ mantraṃ japati nityaśaḥ | nāmadhunyaṃ kīrtanaṃ ca karoti satataṃ mudā ||95|| prasādaṃ śrīharernityaṃ gṛhṇāti ca padāmṛtam | evaṃ pāvanahṛdayo vipro vyavartatānvaham ||96|| vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo nityaṃ sevate sādhupuṃgavān | niścayaṃ so’karod gantuṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ hareḥ ||97|| badrike’naśanaṃ cakre nirjalaṃ mokṣalabdhaye | dinatraye haristasya mokṣārthaṃ samupāyayau ||98|| amāyāṃ tu niśāraṃbhe vimānena samāyayau | āha taṃ bhakta cāyāhi vimānaṃ tvatkṛte tvidam ||99|| so’pi tūrṇaṃ divyadevo bhūtvā samāruroha tat | yayau kṛṣṇena sahito dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ padam || 4.75.1 00|| badrike te camatkārāḥ prāsaran bhuvi sarvataḥ | asaṃkhyā mānavā yānti kathāśravaṇahetave || 10 1|| tīvravegāstūrṇaśuddhāḥ prayānti tūrṇamakṣaram | madhyavegāḥ śanairyānti mandāścireṇa yānti ca || 1 02|| asnehāstu na vai yānti snehastatra hi kāraṇam | prasannatā kṛpā sevā śraddhā ca divyabhāvanā || 1 03|| vāsanāvilayaścāpi jigamiṣātiveginī | vairāgyaṃ śaraṇaṃ bhaktiḥ kāraṇāni tu mokṣaṇe || 1 04|| yeṣāṃ tīvrāste tu śīghraṃ prayānti paramaṃ padam | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhavediha || 1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kathāśravaṇasevādānādinā prasannaḥ śrīhariḥ, harṣanayanākhyaṃ māgadhaṃ, yogidāsākhyaṃ dāsaṃ, saurabhasāvitrākhyaṃ tāmbūlakāraṃ, raṃgilākhyaṃ raṃgakāraṃ, ḍamarūkākhyaṃ vādyakāraṃ, cihnarāyākhyaṃ bhāvasāraṃ, rameśvaraṃ grāmayājinaṃ ca, mokṣapadaṃ nītavānityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 75 ||
<4.76> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi camatkārabharīṃ kathām | vidyādharāṇāṃ mokṣasya kāriṇīṃ pārameśvarīm || 1|| svarṇāstaraṇanāmā tu vidyādharo’bhavattadā | brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putra himālayanivāsakṛt ||2|| sa vai nijavimānenāmbare vihartukāmyayā | niryayau sindhumārgeṇa paśyan deśān vanāśritān ||3|| mānasarovarādagre trivittān vīkṣya vai tataḥ | kāśamehān pañcanadān vīkṣya sindhutaṭām̐stataḥ || 4 || vimānenāyayau yatra śarkarānagaraṃ mahat | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathāyāśca maṇḍapaḥ || 5 || vidyate svargasadṛśo divā svarṇaprakāśanaḥ | viśālo lakṣaśo yatra mānavāḥ santi veśitāḥ || 6 || pravartate kathā yatra vyāsakaṇṭhaninādanam | meghānullaṃghya khe yāti devaśravaṇagocaram || 7 || havanasya ghṛtādīnāṃ dhūmāḥ sugandhaśālinaḥ | pravartante vāyuloke yatsthānādatipāvanāḥ || 8 || śāntiryadbhūtalādūrdhvamambare ca pravartate | santaptahṛdayānāṃ vai brahmaśāntiryato milet || 9 || yogināṃ sadṛśānyeva mānasāni tadāmbare | prajāyante prajānāṃ vai vimānānāmapi kṣaṇam || 4.76.10 || dhvajāḥ patākāḥ kalaśāḥ satāṃ saṃkīrtanāni ca | vaiṣṇavānāṃ samudāyāḥ saṃghāśca daivayoṣitām || 11 || āgamā vigamā vyomni vaiṣṇavānāmanāratam | devānāmavatārāśca vedaghoṣā dvijeritāḥ || 1 2|| sarvametattu vaikuṇṭhabhrāntiṃ kārayati kṣitau | etādṛśo mahān satraḥ kathārūpaḥ prajāyate || 1 3|| vīkṣyālocya vivicyāpi niścitya sukhamutsavam | devarṣisiddhasaṃghānāṃ vimānāvataraṃ tathā || 14|| vīkṣya naijaṃ vimānaṃ tu sindhutīre’bhyatārayat | vidyādhrīśatasaṃyukto dāsadāsaśatānvitaḥ || 15|| putraputrīśatairyukto vimānād bahirāyayau | mahodyānāṃgaṇe sthāpya vimānaṃ maṇḍapaṃ yayau || 1 6|| vācyamānāṃ kathāṃ tatra sthitvā niṣadya maṇḍape | śrutvā caikāgramanasā kathānte vyāsasannidhau || 17|| bahūpadābhiḥ sahitaḥ kuṭumbasahitastathā | āyayau vyāsapūjārthaṃ natvā sabhāṃ sataḥ satīḥ || 18|| svarṇāstaraṇo mukuṭaṃ cāvatārya tu mastakāt | neme vyāsaṃ saṃhitāṃ ca hariṃ neme punaḥ punaḥ || 19|| candanākṣatapuṣpādyai ratnahīrakabhūṣaṇaiḥ | svarṇamaṇimauktikādyaiḥ pūjanaṃ sa vyadhānmudā ||4.76.20|| ārārtrikaṃ sahasraikavarttibhiḥ pracakāra saḥ | vidyādharyo nanṛtuśca gāyantyo guṇagauravam ||21 || dāsā dāsyo nanṛtuśca kathāśravaṇamodinaḥ | lomaśaḥ svāgataṃ cakre’pṛcchat paricayaṃ tataḥ ||22|| sa āha lomaśasyāhaṃ śiṣyo’smi himaparvate | nivasāmi kuṭumbena sahito mānasārase ||23|| āgato’smi vihārārthaṃ dṛṣṭvotsavamavātaram | kṛtakṛtyo’smi sañjātaḥ kathāśravaṇapūjanaiḥ ||24|| śāntirme hṛdaye jātāmbare eva śubhārthinī | tataścāvātaraṃ cātra vṛttaṃ śreyaḥ paraṃ mama ||25|| vidyādharo’pi jijñāsāṃ cakre vyāsaṃ praveditum | tathā taṃ guruvaryaṃ ca lomaśaṃ jñātumityapi ||26|| tadā lālāyanaḥ sādhurvidyādhraṃ prāha satvaram | ayaṃ nārāyaṇo vyāsaḥ svataḥprakāśakāyanaḥ ||27|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśiṣyaśiromaṇiḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ katheyamuttamā ||28|| yasya tvaṃ śiṣya evāste sa cāyaṃ lomaśo muniḥ | ahaṃ lālāyanaścāpi himādrau ca vihāravān ||29|| ityuktaḥ sa tu vidyādhraḥ snehāśrūṇi samasṛjat | patitaḥ pādayostūrṇaṃ lomaśasya gurostadā ||4.76.30|| kuṭumbaṃ sarvamevāpi patitaṃ pādayormuneḥ | lomaśaḥ svāgataṃ cakre papraccha kuśalaṃ sukham ||3 1|| āvāsaṃ pradadau rājyodyāne bhojyaṃ tato dadau | mahīmānātithisevāṃ cakāra lomaśo guruḥ ||32|| lomaśasya vacanena māsamuvāsa tatra saḥ | śuśrāva ca kathāṃ nityaṃ bhavabandhavimocinīm ||33|| kuṭumbasahito nityaṃ prasādaṃ bubhuje hareḥ | dāsā dāsyo guroḥ sevāṃ satāṃ sevāṃ pracakrire || 34|| putrāḥ putryaśca vidyādhryaḥ cakruḥ sevāṃ guroḥ satām | nityaṃ cakruḥ kīrtanāni nāmadhunyaṃ pracakrire ||35|| dadau śrīlomaśastebhyo mantraṃ mokṣapradaṃ tataḥ | brahmāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadāsī bhavāmi om ||36|| mantraṃ labdhvā tu vidyādhrāḥ sarve vigatakalmaṣāḥ | abhavan muktarūpāste sarve kṣapitavāsanāḥ ||37|| mokṣetracchavo’bhavam̐ścāpi brahmānandātilipsavaḥ | prārthanāṃ cakrire śrīmadgurave mokṣalabdhaye ||38|| omityāha gurustebhyaḥ sasmāra parameśvaram | lomaśasmṛtamātraḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’bhyagāt ||39|| sarvavimānasaṃsthaśca rādhālakṣmīpriyāyutaḥ | mādhavīpārṣadamuktamuktānikānvito’bhyagāt ||4.76.40|| sūryaprabhavimānācchrīhariḥ prasannamānasaḥ | sarvābharaṇasaṃśobhāḥ prahasan bahirāyayau ||41 || lomaśādyairgurugaṇaiḥ sadbhiḥ satībhirarcitaḥ | vaiṣṇavairvanditaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jalāmṛtaiḥ |||42|| vidyādharavrajaṃ sarvaṃ divyatārthaṃ kṛpāvaśaḥ | aprokṣayad bindukaṇaiḥ sarve divyāstato’bhavan ||43|| parivartanamāptāste vidyādhrā muktavarṣmasu | divyadehā vyajāyanta kṛṣṇarādhāramāsamāḥ ||44|| pañcaśatāni sarve te vimānavaramāsthitāḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāpyābhavan muktā hi śāśvatāḥ ||45|| āśīrvādairvardhitāste maharṣisādhubhūsuraiḥ | kīrtayantaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti tālavādanaiḥ ||46|| ākāśaṃ garjayantaśca jayaśabdān pracakrire | harirvimānaṃ sahasā himālayena vartmanā ||47|| mānasarovaraṃ nītvā vidyādhranagaraṃ śubham | svarṇāstaraṇapautrāya yune nāmnā viśāline ||48|| datvordhvavyomamārgeṇa yayau brahmākṣaraṃ nijam | viśālāstaraṇaścāpi bhaktiṃ cakāra vai hareḥ ||49|| putrapautrādivaṃśāḍhyaḥ sampannaścābhavattataḥ | cireṇa so’pi kamalākāntabhaktyākṣaraṃ padam ||4.76.50|| prāpa badrīpriye mokṣaṃ parameśapadāsanam | jyeṣṭhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ te vidyādhrā yayurakṣaram ||51 || athānyaṃ te camatkāraṃ vadāmi śṛṇu badrike | gandharvā himavāsā ye citrabarhādayaḥ śubhāḥ ||52|| mānasarovare deśe vihartuṃ samupāyayuḥ | te vimānaṃ dṛṣṭavantaḥ sahasraśo himālaye ||53|| svarṇāstaraṇaṃ papracchuḥ pitā kutra gatastava | pratyāha svarṇāstaraṇo mokṣapadaṃ yayau pitā ||54||| vimānena sudivyena śrīkṛṣṇacālitena vai | pañcaśatāni vidyādhrā yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ ||55|| kathāśravaṇamātreṇa sarve mokṣapadaṃ yayuḥ | sā kathā śarkarāpuryāṃ sindhudeśe pravartate ||56|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ paramamokṣadā | yatra devo’nādikṛṣṇo vallabhāryo virājate ||57|| saṃhitādevatārūpaḥ sarvāvirbhāvakāraṇam | yatra vidyādharādīnāṃ guruḥ śrīlomaśo muniḥ ||58||| svataḥprakāśo bhagavān vyāso yadvācako’sti ca | devadānavagandharvāḥ pūtā yacchravaṇāt khalu ||59|| tāṃ kathāṃ prasamākarṇya matpitrādyā divaṃ gatāḥ | śrutvaivaṃ tu camatkāraṃ badrike himavāsinaḥ ||4.76.60|| citrabarhādayaścāpi vimānena kathāsthalīm | āyayuḥ strīpūruṣāśca triśatāni samutsukāḥ ||61 || ambarādavateruste mahodyānasamīpataḥ | kathāmaṇḍapamāgatya jyeṣṭhe dvādaśikādine ||62|| śuklapakṣe hi gandharvā gāndharvyaśca hareḥ kathām | saṃhitāṃ śuśruvuḥ sāyaṃ nīrājanottaraṃ tataḥ ||63|| lomaśājjagṛhurmantraṃ nāmadhunyaṃ ca jagṛhuḥ | prasādaṃ jagṛhuḥ kṛṣṇapādavāri papuśca te ||64|| caturdaśadinānyevaṃ śuśruvuste kathāṃ śubhām | satāṃ sevāṃ pracakruśca nṛtyaṃ nityaṃ vyadhurmudā ||65|| gāyanaṃ ca vyadhurnityaṃ samārañjanakārakam | kṛṣṇāgre saṃhitāgre ca satāmagre jagurmudā ||66|| bhaktiyuktāścakrureva nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ hareḥ | tena snehena vigatakatmaṣā abhavan drutam ||67|| kṣīṇakleśāḥ kṣīṇasarvavāsanāḥ siddhayoginaḥ | sañjātāste samastā vai mokṣamantraṃ ca jagṛhuḥ | |68|| brahmāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadāso bhavāmi om | saṃgṛhya mantraṃ jepuste narānāryo’tibhāvataḥ ||69|| teṣāṃ prasannaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo’ṣāḍhakṛṣṇe dale drutam | ekādaśyāṃ vimānenāyayau netuṃ nijākṣaram ||4.76.70|| triśatānāṃ tu sarveṣāmuparyeva jalāñjalim | pracikṣepa harirvārikaṇaiḥ spṛṣṭāśca te tadā ||71|| divyadehāḥ samastāste gandharvā muktakoṭigāḥ | gandharvā muktagandharvā abhavan divyavigrahāḥ ||72|| śrīkṛṣṇena samāhūtā āruruhurvimānakam | jayanādairgarjayanto natvā kathāsthalaṃ sabhām ||73|| guruṃ sādhūn namaskṛtya dadhyuḥ śrīkṛṣṇamīśvaram | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo ninye kṣaṇāttataḥ ||74|| himādriṃ ca tato ninye brahmadhāmākṣaraṃ nijam | evaṃ śrībadrike yātāḥ sarve te śāśvataṃ padam ||75|| śṛṇu badrīpriye divyacamatkāraṃ tathaiva ha | kinnarāḥ kimpuruṣā ye himādrau sārase sthale ||76|| śuśruvuśca purā vidyādharāṇāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tataḥ | vimānairāyayurlakṣmīnārāyaṇakathāsthalīm ||77|| sahasrārdhaṃ kinnarāśca kiṃpuruṣāstadardhakāḥ | cāraṇā dve śate siddhāḥ pañcāśatte samāyayuḥ ||78|| mahodyāne vimānāni cāvaterustadāmbarāt | kathāsthānaṃ yayuḥ sarve’vatīrya darśanāya ha ||79|| sammānitā lomaśādyaiḥ śuśravuste kathāṃ śubhām | prasādaṃ jagṛhuḥ pādāmṛtaṃ papurmudānvitāḥ ||4.76.80|| mokṣamantraṃ nāmadhunyaṃ jagṛhurlomaśānmuneḥ | vyāsapūjāṃ kathāpūjāṃ satāṃ sevāṃ ca nityadā ||8 1 || cakrire bhāvayuktāste vaiṣṇavāḥ pāvanāḥ parāḥ | āṣāḍhakṛṣṇadvādaśyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||82|| sākṣātteṣāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ niśāyāmabhavaddhariḥ | sarvābharaṇasaṃśobho rādhālakṣmīsamanvitaḥ ||83|| vimānavaramārūḍhaḥ prasannavadanaḥ prabhuḥ | uvācāyāntu me dhāmākṣaraṃ paramapāvanam ||84|| ityuktā badrike dhanyabhāgyāni tvabhimatya te | sajjā bhūtvā cāruruhurvimānaṃ kṛṣṇaśobhitam ||85|| divyadehāḥ samastāste kṛpayā śrīhareḥ śubhāḥ | abhavan muttarūpā vai cakrurdhunyaṃ vimānake ||86 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībadrike prabhuḥ | nināya tāṃ himaśailaṃ tato dhāmākṣaraṃ nijam ||87|| kinnarān kiṃpūruṣām̐śca cāraṇān siddhayoginaḥ | divyamuktān vidhāyaiva nināya kṛpayā hariḥ ||88|| aho śrībadrike bhāgyaṃ himācalanivāsinām | nārāyaṇavimānāptirnārāyaṇāptirityapi ||89|| brahmalokāptirevāpi kathāśravaṇayogataḥ | satāṃ sevanataścāpi prasādāśanatastathā ||4.76.90|| avatārikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptirvyavartata | ityevaṃ badrike nityaṃ jīvānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ śubham ||91|| kathāśravaṇataścāpi darśanādvandanāt satām | bhavatyeva hareryogāt sarvakāraṇakāraṇāt ||92|| nāgā daityā dānavāścoragā yakṣāḥ sarīsṛpāḥ | ye tatra cāyayurbadri yogāmupāyayuśca ye ||93|| sarve te kṣīṇapāpāśca nirguṇāḥ kṛṣṇayoginaḥ | bhūtvā bhūtvā yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ ||94|| kīṭāḥ śākhāmṛgā vanyāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ paśavo’pi ca | jantavo vallikā vṛkṣā yādāṃsi svedajā api ||95|| ye ye tatra mṛtāḥ satre kārṣṇayogena yojitāḥ | sarve prāpuḥ paraṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ te kṛpayā hareḥ ||96|| yāni sasyāni dhānyāni stambāśca stabakā api | phalapuṣpadalavṛkṣāḥ kathāyogamupāyayuḥ ||97|| paramparayā sākṣādvā svāṃgaiḥ phalādibhiśca vai | te sarve paramaṃ mokṣaṃ prāptāḥ kārṣṇaprasaṃgataḥ ||98|| sarvaṃ vai sulabhaṃ loke satsaṃgo durlabhaḥ sadā | satsaṃgaḥ kṛpayā prāpyo yena mokṣaḥ kare sthitaḥ ||99|| badrike paṭhanādasya śravaṇānmananādapi | bhuktirmuktirbhavedatra śāśvatī paramā gatiḥ || 4.76.100 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kathāśravaṇādibhiḥ svarṇāstaraṇaprabhṛtividyādharāṇāṃ, citrabarhādigandharvāṇāṃ, kinnarakimpuruṣacāraṇasiddhānāṃ ca, mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 76 ||
<4.77> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi yathā yathā dinātyayaḥ | kathāyā jāyate lokā lakṣaśo yānti tatra vai || 1 || māsamātraṃ kathā cāsti pakṣamātramataḥ param | saptāhamātrameveti jñātvā cāyānti lakṣaśaḥ || 2 || narā nāryo bālabālāyutā vṛddhā yuvātmakāḥ | sotsāhā pāpanāśārthaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanalālasāḥ || 3 || mokṣavāñcchāyutāścānye bahavastatra cāyayuḥ | nityaṃ yathā tu goloko vaikuṇṭho dyauryathā ca vā || 4 || tathā śrīśarkarābhūmirdivyā bhaktairvibhāti hi | pūjayanti janā vyāsaṃ kṛṣṇamūrtiṃ ca saṃhitām || 5 || lomaśādīn gurun sādhūn viprān pravaiṣṇavān satīḥ | sādhvīśca yogivaryāṃśca yatinīḥ sāṃkhyayoginīḥ || 6 || upadāḥ pradadū ratnamaṇisvarṇāmbarādikam | śuśruvuḥ sevayāmāsurdadurdānāni muktaye || 7 || śuddhāḥ prasādaṃ bhuktvāpaḥ pītvā bhaktisamanvitāḥ | yayuḥ prasādya sādhūm̐śca hariṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ || 8 || āṣāḍhe śuklapakṣe tu dākṣiṇātyā nṛpādayaḥ | uṣṇālayanivāsāśca prāgjyotirbhūnivāsinaḥ || 9 || brahmadeśanivāsāśca śyāmaśaṃbhunivāsinaḥ | prācīnavāsinaścāpi śibirājyanivāsinaḥ || 4.77.10 || āyayū rāśiyānānāṃ mānavāśca nṛpeśvarāḥ | ketumālanivāsāśca kimpuruṣanivāsinaḥ || 11 || hāritāśca parīdeśanivāsāścāyayurmudā | abriktānāṃ mānavāśca nṛpāstatra samāyayuḥ || 1 2|| amarāṇāṃ janā bhūpā vimānaiḥ samupāyayuḥ | yāvadbhūstaravāsāśca narā nāryaḥ samāyayuḥ || 1 3|| bhūgarbhāntrapradeśānā narā nāryaḥ samāyayuḥ | kathāśravaṇalābhārthaṃ kṛṣṇekṣārthaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 14|| kīrtayantaḥ prabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ rādhāpatiṃ satīpatim | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sarvāvatāriṇam || 15|| teṣāṃ svāgatasammānaṃ madhuparkaṃ jalaṃ gṛham | koṭirāyo rāyahariścakruḥ śrīlomaśādayaḥ || 1 6|| yayāvyakti yathāyogyaṃ svargyaṃ nirmimire sukham | yānabhojanapānārhāvāsān divyān dadustadā || 17|| toṣayāmāsa sarvāṃstān śrīkṛṣṇo’saṃkhyarūpadhṛk | nijabhaktān siṣeve’pi sarveṣṭapūrako’bhavat || 1|| lakṣmī rādhā ramā śrīrbhūḥ mādhavī māṇikī priyā | maṃgalā mañjulā revā suguṇā ca sarasvatī ||19|| gaṃgā bhaktiḥ satī muktirekādaśī ratirdayā | tulasī kāmagauḥ śāntā kamalā virajā himā ||4.77.20 || haṃsā mūrtirgomatī kuṃkumavāpyannapūrṇikā | jayā durgā lalitā sāvitrī santoṣiṇī kalā ||21 || badrī campā mauktikā ca vidyut ṣaṣṭhī ṛtambharā | śvetā raktā siddhayaśca kṛṣṇātha nidhayo’pi ca ||22|| śaktayo’nekarūpādidhāriṇyo janasevanam | yathāyogyaṃ pracakruste kṛṣṇājñayā hyanantaśaḥ ||23|| caturdaśabhuvanānāṃ dehinaḥ kramaśaḥ kramāt | āyayuḥ śrīkathākṛṣṇalābhārthaṃ śarkarāpurīm ||24|| kṛtakṛtyā babhūvuste pumāṃso yoṣito’khilāḥ | divyabhāvaṃ prapannā ye prapannāḥ puruṣottamam ||25|| śṛṇu badripriye devi mahotsavastadābhavat | āṣāḍhaśuklapakṣe vai pārāyaṇāntime dale ||26|| āyayuḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇādyāḥ kuṃkumasthalāt | ye tvāsan tatra vai rūpāntarairbhaktārthamāsthitāḥ ||27|| śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇādyā vṛddhā maharṣayastathā | tathāśrīkambharālakṣmīsahitā brahmayoṣitaḥ ||28|| pārṣadāḥ pāvanādyāśca devā maharṣayo’pare | rājānaśca prajāścāpi kathāyajñe samāyayuḥ ||29|| śrībadrīpriyovācake ke samāgatāstatra śrotumicchāmi nāmataḥ | devā maharṣayo ye ca gandharvāpsarasastathā ||4.77.3 0|| pārṣadā ye ca rājānastān sarvān śrāvaya prabho | pārāyaṇe prasaktānāmāgatānāṃ ṭale’ntime ||3 1 || nāmnāṃ śravaṇamātreṇa vaiṣṇavānāṃ satāṃ tadā | pāpanāśo bhavedeva puṇyaṃ bhāgyaṃ pravardhate || 32|| dhanyāste śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇayogamupāgatāḥ | yeṣāṃ smaraṇamātreṇa māyābandhaḥ praṇaśyati ||33|| śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇubadrīpriye devi dale pārāyaṇāntime | āṣāḍhe śuklapakṣe vai ye ye tatra samāgatāḥ ||34|| ekādaśyāṃ samāptau copasthitā ye’bhavam̐stadā | tān sarvān sampravacmyatra mahābhāgavatān śṛṇu ||35|| āyayurānandadevā bhuvardevāḥ samāyayuḥ | bhāvadevā rāṃbhadevāstathā tāpasadevatāḥ |||36|| ārtavadevā ādhvaradevāḥ pāvakadevatāḥ |. sāvitrā havyavāhāśca bhūmadevāstathāyayuḥ ||37|| auśikāḥ kauśikā devāstathā gāndhāradevatāḥ | ārṣabhāḥ ṣaḍjanā mārjālīyadevāstathāyayuḥ || 38|| vairājakā mādhyamāśca niṣādāḥ prāṇadevatāḥ | ākūtikāścintakāścāyayuśca meghavāhanāḥ || 39|| vijñātikā mānasāśca bhāvā rāthantarāḥ surāḥ | sadyojātā vāmadevā vīrāḥ pītāḥ kumārakāḥ ||4.77.40|| satyādyā vyāsadevāśca sutārādyāśca śaṃbhavaḥ | svāyambhuvādyā manavaḥ pūrṇāhutau samāyayuḥ ||41 || vaimānikāḥ samastāśca sahasrākṣāḥ samāyayuḥ | nārāyaṇāstathādityāḥ prājāpatyāḥ samāyayuḥ |||42|| āmṛtā brāhmadevāśca kalpāvasānikāstathā | pitaro munayaścāpi kathāyāṃ samupāyayuḥ ||43|| dharmo ruciśca dakṣaśca marīcirbhṛgurāyayuḥ | atryaṃgiraḥpulastyāśca vasiṣṭhaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ ||44|| nāradaśca ṛbhuḥ sanatkumārādyāḥ samāyayuḥ | gandharvāḥ siddhapūrṇau ca bahvī pūrṇāśa ityapi ||45|| śataguṇo brahmacārī viśvāvasuḥ suparṇakaḥ | bhānuḥ sucandro varuṇo bhīmasenograsenakau ||46|| suparṇo dhṛtarāṣṭraśca sūryavarcāśca tumburuḥ | gomān subāhuḥ prayutaḥ patravānarkaparṇakaḥ ||47|| bhīmaścitrarathaḥ śāliśirāḥ parjanya ityapi | hāhā hūhūḥ kalirhaṃso jyotiṣṭomaśca madhyamaḥ ||48|| ācāro dāruṇaścāpi vareṇyo varuṇastathā | suruciḥ sumanāścāpi vasurucyādayo’pi ca ||49|| āyayuste tu gandharvāḥ kṛṣṇadarśanalālasāḥ | apsarasaścāyayuśca badrike urvaśī tathā ||4.77.50|| aruṇā vimanuṣyā cānapāyā ca varāmbarā | asiparṇā miśrakeśī śucikālambuṣā tathā ||51 || vidyutparṇā lakṣmaṇā ca tilottamārdrikā tayā | rambhā kṣemāsitā mārīcikā manobhavā tathā ||52|| subāhvī supriyā puṇḍarikā ca sudatī tathā | surasā subhujā cājagandhā haṃsā sarasvatī ||53|| ajayā kamalā sūtā sumukhī haṃsapādikā | arūpā subhagā bhāsī manuvantī sukeśinī ||54|| menakā sahajanyā ca parṇinī pūrvacittikā | kṛtasthalī ghṛtācī ca pramlocāstatra cāyayuḥ ||55||| anumlocā tathā tanvī pūñjikasthalinī uṣā | putryastāsāṃ prapautryaśca sahasraśaḥ samāyayuḥ ||56|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadarśanalālasāḥ | sarvā dāsyastathā tāsāṃ pārāyaṇe samāyayuḥ |||57|| badrike pārṣadāścāpi bālakṛṣṇasya cāyayuḥ | pāvano vṛṣabho gopo vatsalaśca kumārakaḥ ||58|| siddho’ruṇo hāritaśca viśvo vipraśca kuṇḍala | sahasrākṣaḥ suyogaśca mahīmāno vasantakaḥ ||99|| sahasraśirā madhvaścorukramo vikramastathā | viśvākṣaścorugāyaśca viśvātmā jātavedakaḥ ||4.77.60|| ānandaściklītadevo devatrā vijayo jayaḥ | nandaḥ sunandaśca vasuvano jayanta āyayuḥ ||61 || śrutadevaḥ pracaṇḍaśca caṇḍaḥ sāttvata āyayuḥ | viśvaksenaḥ puṣpadantaḥ suparṇaḥ prabalo balaḥ ||62|| kumudaḥ kumudākṣaśca cidātmā garuḍastathā | kaivalyabodho haṃsaśca svaprakāśaśca cinmayaḥ ||63|| prapūruṣaśca kalyāṇaḥ padmadharaḥ sūmūrtakaḥ | prabhogaḥ śrīprasādaśca śrīprakāśo’kṣaro nayaḥ ||64|| santoṣo brahmadṛk pradhyānaścidānanda ūrjakaḥ | paramajñaḥ sunayaśca vinayaśca prabhañjanaḥ ||65|| acintyo’nantaḥ praśamo’moghaśca daharastathā | viśvarūpaśca vaikuṇṭhaḥ prajñānauṃkārakau tathā ||66|| pratattvo nijabodhaśca puṇḍarīkastathottamaḥ | uddhavaḥ śāśvataścāpi pūrṇabhadraḥ prabhūtakaḥ ||67|| ṛṣabhaśca subhadraśca nirālambo videhakaḥ | sālambanastathānandaḥ dyukaṇṭhaśca prasattakaḥ ||68|| haṃsaḥ prahaṃso bhadrākṣo mañjulaśca pradhanyakaḥ | prabodhaśca sujyotiśca satyeśaśca savitrakaḥ ||69|| avyayo maṃgalaścāpi tāpasaḥ suvratastathā | suśīlaśca praturyaśca praviṣṇurvaradastathā ||4.77.70|| prajiṣṇurvallabhaścāpi prasādaḥ pradhanastathā | avadāto’mṛtaścāpi prabhavo’dhvara ityapi ||71|| utsavaśca hiraṇyaścānagho viśruta āyayuḥ | nirdeśo bhūṣaṇaścāpi nivṛttaśca pravardhanaḥ ||72|| saṃvṛtaśca bṛhadrūpaḥ prabhāvo’śoka āyayuḥ | akāmaścāpi niṣkāmaḥ śrīgarbhaśca sudarśanaḥ ||73|| nirvāṇaśca virāmaśca dharmayūpo viśālakaḥ | purātanaḥ pramodaścāmodaḥ supuṇya āyayuḥ ||74|| ādityaśca viśuddhaścodbhavo netrajña āyayuḥ | śrīvāsaḥ kṛṣṇapādaśca pārṣadāste samāyayuḥ ||75|| svastikāḥ śeṣasaṃjñādyā nāgā ye vaiṣṇavottamāḥ | anantādyā āyayuśca pārāyaṇāntimotsave ||76|| rājānaścāpi bhūmisthā badrike te samāyayuḥ | śāvadīno lakṣmaṇaśca jummasemlaśca bhūpatiḥ ||77|| dakṣajavaṃgaraścāpi śibidevaḥ samāyayuḥ | tharkūṭastho vīrajāraḥ śaktyakṣikaḥ samāyayuḥ ||78|| kālimāśo bālakāśaḥ kathakaśca samāyayuḥ | pṛthurājastathoralaketuruṣṭrālarājakaḥ ||79|| tīrāṇaścāpi haṃkāro jayakāṣṭhala āyayuḥ | alvīnaro jīnavarddhiralpaketuḥ samāyayuḥ ||4.77.80|| jayakṛṣṇavanṛpatiḥ parīśānanṛpastathā | indurāyaśca mudrāṇḍo gaṇḍarājaḥ samāyayuḥ ||8 1|| vṛhaccharaśca līnorṇo balalīnaḥ samāyayuḥ | rāyagānalabhūpaśca varasiṃho nṛpastathā ||82|| phenatantunṛpaḥ stokahomaḥ kolaka āyayuḥ | kāṣṭhayāno dinamānārkaśca vai rāyakinnaṭaḥ ||83|| rāyarokīśvaro rāyaraṇajīvaḥ samāyayuḥ | rāyavākakṣakaścāpi rāyamārīśa ityapi ||84|| rāyabaleśvaro rāyalambārabhūpa āyayuḥ | rāyanavārkabhūpaśca rāyahuṇḍeśabhūpatiḥ ||85|| rāyakūpeśabhūpaśca kālīmaṇḍalikeśvaraḥ | vanajeleśabhūpaśca pārāvārapibo nṛpaḥ ||86|| koṭīśvaraḥ śrīsatīśaḥ tretākarkaśabhūpatiḥ | āṇḍajaro bālyarajo rāyasomanabhūpatiḥ ||87|| urugavākṣakaḥ parāṅvrata īśānapānakaḥ | rājārāyapatiścāpi pārāyaṇe samāyayuḥ ||88|| svāyambhuvo manuḥ priyavratottānapadāvubhau | yajñastatrāyayau dharmaścāyayau strīgaṇānvitaḥ ||89|| devau dhātāvidhātārau cāyayatustadadhvare | āgnidhrādyā bhūpatayo nābhiḥ kiṃpuruṣastathā ||4.77.90|| ketumālādayaścāpi hiraṇyo ramyako nṛpaḥ | kuruśceti nṛpāstatra pārāyaṇe samāyayuḥ ||91|| umārāyaḥ kṣīrapururnāgavikrama āyayuḥ | jayādityo vikramārkaḥ kṛṣṇadurgaśca pāñcalaḥ ||12|| prabhālākṣo lakṣaseno’maraśālaḥ śrīlaṃbhanaḥ | prapatpālaḥ prāṇipāto nandibhillaḥ samāyayuḥ ||93|| rāyapāraścendragṛtso gavayendro janāstrakaḥ | karṇaputso’vadhyatejā yāgadevaḥ paṭāsanaḥ ||94|| dārābhāgyo rājamāno mādhavo brahmapānakaḥ | śīlahāro māṇikābhaścittagāṃgeya āyayuḥ ||95|| candranāgo medakośaḥ purukutsa upāyayuḥ | bālasaṃghaḥ pārvateśo nāgavijaya āyayuḥ ||96|| rājabhārurmahendrābho madāśanaḥ samāyayuḥ | śararaṃgo madhurājo virāmāsaḥ samāyayuḥ ||97|| trikūṭorkī mahāsāraścatralāsyaḥ samāyayuḥ | kālikāñcana āpāṇḍa ākkalāryo vivardhanaḥ ||98|| maṇḍalāro javalīna indradyumna upāyayuḥ | māṭharasiṃhaḥ kuṭidhṛk cicintana udaṅprabhaḥ ||99|| śrīnāgarirdharaṇidhṛṅ mūradhvajo rajidhvatajaḥ | kuṃkumāsyastathā khaṇḍarājānaḥ samupāyayuḥ || 4.77.100 || dvīpeśāścābdhitīreśā raṇeśā adriśāsinaḥ | upabhūpāḥ prajāyuktāḥ pārāyaṇe samāyayuḥ || 101 || rājasvargaṃ brahmasabhāsvargaṃ vā kimu dhārmikam | sado vā satyaloko vā śobhate śarkarāpuram || 102|| badrike nāgarājāno bhaktā daityanṛpeśvarāḥ | āyayuḥ śrīsaṃhitāyāḥ pārāyaṇe samutsukāḥ || 10 3|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne pārāyaṇasamāptiprasaṃgotsave samāgatatribhuvanīyarājaprajānāmuddeśanirūpaṇanāmā saptasaptatiṃtamo’dhyāyaḥ || 77 ||
<4.78> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi samājo’nantasaṃkhyakaḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāsamāpane || 1 || abhavaccharkarāpuryā sindhutaṭe samantataḥ | mahodyāne viśāle vai daśayojanavistare || 2 || bhūtale drumasaṃkīrṇe gandhipuṣpādiśobhite | svāgataṃ bhojanaṃ sarvasamājasya vyadhāt prabhuḥ || 3 || nivāsān pārṣadā dāsā dāsyaḥ sevāṃ pracakrire | āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe tvekādaśyāṃ prage hariḥ || 4 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīvallabhaḥ prabhuḥ | brahmapriyābhiḥ snapitaḥ śṛṃgāritaḥ priyājanaiḥ || 5 || vibhūṣito veṣitaśca pūjitaḥ sādhumaṇḍalaiḥ | vandito bandisūtādyairnato’rcitaśca rājabhiḥ || 6 || vardhito vaiṣṇavībhiśca stuto bhāgavatairjanaiḥ | nirīkṣitaḥ strīsamājaiḥ prasādito’ṅgasevakaiḥ || 7 || rājādhirājacihnādyairbṛṃhito divyapārṣadaiḥ | kṛtapūjādisatkarmā vādyadhvaniṃ prakarṣayan || 8 || āyayau rājacihnāḍhyaḥ kathāmaṇḍapamacyutaḥ | gajāsane svarṇamaṇihārāḍhye saṃvyarājata || 9 || āyayau bhagavān vyāsaḥ svataḥprakāśakāyanaḥ | sabhājanaiḥ kṛtotthānaiḥ satkṛtaścāsanaṃ svakam || 4.78.1 0|| alaṃcakāra puṣpādipūjitaḥ śrāvito jayam | lomaśādyāḥ ṛṣigaṇā lālāyanādisādhavaḥ || 1 1|| ramādyāḥ śaktayo maṇimāṇikyādyā haripriyāḥ | devyaśca devatā īśvarāṇya īśvarakoṭayaḥ || 1 2|| viprā vedavidaḥ sarve vaiṣṇavāḥ pāvanāḥ śubhāḥ | siddhāśca bhūpaśārdūlāḥ prajā nāryo narāstathā || 1 3|| āyayuḥ saṃhitāsthāne maṇḍape ca yathāyatham | niṣeduśca kathāraṃbho vyajāyata samaṃgalaḥ || 14|| muhūrtānte saṃhitāyāḥ samāptau śrīharestathā | nyāsasya pūjanaṃ cakruḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇādayaḥ ||15|| koṭirāyo rāyaharistathāgnidhrādayo nṛpāḥ | sarve nṛpāḥ sarvadevāḥ sarvarṣayaśca sādhavaḥ || 1 6|| ānarcuḥ śrīsaṃhitāṃ ca vyāsaṃ svataḥprakāśakam | prajājanāḥ śreṣṭhinaśca patrapuṣpaphalairjalaiḥ || 17|| svarṇarūpyakamudrābhirhīrakādyaiḥ sumauktikaiḥ | maṇibhiḥ svarṇabhūṣābhiḥ pupūjuścandanākṣataiḥ || 18|| rājārhāmbaravaryaiśca rājārhabhūṣaṇādibhiḥ | mukuṭādyairamūlyaiśca pupūjurvyāsamacyutam || 1 9|| svāyaṃbhuvaḥ kṣiteḥ rājyaṃ priyavrato’pi vai tathā | uttānapādaḥ pṛthivīkhaṇḍarājyaṃ hare tava || 4.78.20 || ityārpayat tathāgnidhro hiraṇyādyāḥ samārpayan | vimānāni kiṃpuruṣādyā ārpayan gajāśvakān || 21 || svarṇakośānmahāpadmān kacchapānārpayanmudā | asaṃkhyahīrakamauktikādīn svarṇāni cārpayan ||22|| bahūn dāsān dāsikāśca rājāno’pi samārpayan | pārthivāḥ sārvabhaumāste svasvakhaṇḍān samārpayan ||23|| indrādyāḥ kāmadhenūśca divyaveṣān samārpayan | sudhāmṛtānyasaṃkhyāni divyabhūtīḥ samārpayan ||24|| mānavāśca yathāyogyaṃ dhanaṃ tatra samārpayan | yadyad viśiṣṭaṃ svāyattaṃ tattat tatra samārpayan ||25|| amūlyopakaraṇāni dehopakaraṇānyapi | paryaṃkā yatra tailokyaṃ dṛśyate pratibimbitam ||26||| tānārpayad vācakāya tathā śrīharaye mudā | cintāmaṇīn kalpalatāḥ kalpapātrāṇi cārpayan ||27|| kalpaśastrāṇi divyāni kalpaveṣān samārpayan | dehabhūṣāḥ samastāścārpayan yānāni vai tadā ||28|| pṛthvyāṃ svarge ca pātāle yadyacchreṣṭhaṃ tadābhavat | tattadānīya devādyaiḥ sthānibhiścārpitaṃ tadā ||29|| viṣṇunā cārpito hāraḥ kaustubhānaikyaśobhanaḥ | yena sabhā kṛtā divyā tejobhiḥ sūryavarcasā ||4.78.3 0|| brahmaṇā cārpitaṃ chatraṃ yatra nakṣatramaṇḍalam | divyaṃ prakāśate naddhaṃ divyasvargamivāparam || 31 || śaṅkareṇārpitaścandro lokatimirahārakaḥ | devībhiścāpi sarvābhiḥ śaktayaścārpitā nijāḥ || 32|| sādhubhiḥ puṣpamālādyaiḥ pūjito vyāsasattamaḥ | muktairīśvarakoṭyādyaiḥ pūjito nijasampadā ||33||| jaitrān rathān divyavāhān pradadurdikprapālakāḥ | āśīrvādān dadurdivyā mātaro lokamātaraḥ ||34|| gajasthāṃ saṃhitāṃ dāne daduryajvāna utsukāḥ | ārārtrikaṃ pracakruśca vahnayo rājabhiḥ saha ||35|| nīrājanottaraṃ badri tatra bhūmau mahattamāḥ | vastūnāmupadākhyānāṃ parvatā abhavam̐stadā ||36|| yadyad dravyaṃ hyabhūd yeṣāṃ tattattatrārpitaṃ hyabhūt | pṛthivyāṃ nāmavad ratnaṃ divi pātālake’pi ca ||37|| sṛṣṭau śreṣṭhaṃ ca pūjārhaṃ dānārhaṃ yat prakīrtyate | tat sarvaṃ cārpitaṃ tatra sarvasṛṣṭinivāsibhiḥ ||38|| amukaṃ tatra nāstīti nābhūt sarvasya sammatam | ārārtrikottaraṃ pūjā satāṃ prājāyatottamā ||39|| viprarṣisurapūjyānāṃ lomaśasya gurostathā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapūjottarābhavat ||4.78.40 || ākāśādabhavam̐statra puṣpādīnāṃ suvṛṣṭayaḥ | candanānāṃ sudhānāṃ ca vṛṣṭayaḥ prābhavan divaḥ ||41 || apsarasāṃ nartanāni gītayo brahmayoṣitām | nāmadhunyāni bhaktānāmabhavaṃśca samantataḥ ||42|| kāvyāni ca tathā vyākhyānānyajāyanta vai tadā | viduṣāṃ devagurūṇāṃ kavīnāṃ kāvyakānyapi ||43|| dānāni sarvaratnānāmabhavam̐statra badrike | asaṃkhyavasturūpāṇi dīnānāthādidehiṣu ||44|| annadānāni bahūni svarṇadānāni vai tathā | gavāśvagajadānāni tadānīmabhavan khalu |||45|| kanyādānāni ca śreṣṭhakumāradānakānyapi | kṣetravāṭīgṛhasampaddānāni cābhavam̐stadā ||46|| yajñārthaṃ dravyadānāni rājñāṃ tadābhavan kṣaṇe | evaṃ kathāsamāptiścābhavad badrīprabhe tadā ||47|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇo devaḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | rādhākṛṣṇastathā badri naranārāyaṇo’pyaham ||48|| vāsudevanrāyaṇaśca śeṣanārāyaṇastathā | āśīrvādān dadustatra lokebhyo mokṣadānapi ||49|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathāśravaṇārthinaḥ | prāpsyanti paramaṃ mokṣaṃ kṛpayā no’kṣare pade ||4.78.50|| saṃhiteyaṃ vedapatnī mahābhāgavatī satī | vaiṣṇavīśrīḥ sāttvikī ca kārṣṇanārāyaṇī kathā ||51 || sarvatīrthāśrayā sarvadharmāśrayā pravartate | sarvadānāśrayā sarvajñānāśrayā pramuktidā ||52|| sarvapuṇyāśrayā sarvasṛṣṭisādhvāśrayā varā | sarvasādhvyāśrayā satyāśrayā kṛṣṇāṃgasaṃginī ||53|| sarvanārāyaṇayuktā sarvāvatāradhāriṇī | sarvadevamayī sarvapūjādhyānamayī kathā ||54|| sarvastotramayī sarvavedabījakathāmayī | sarvaśaktimayī sarvapumarthādiparāyaṇā ||55|| sarvasaubhāgyadā sarveṣaṇāpūraṇikā kathā | sarveṣṭasādhikā sarvarakṣākarī hitāvahā ||56|| sarvaiśvaryādisaṃjuṣṭā sarvasiddhiniṣevitā | sarvavighnādihartrīyaṃ kathā vijayate bhuvi ||57|| ye śroṣyanti tadadhyāyaṃ te yāsyanti parāṃ gatim | vācakaṃ ye jalānnādyaistoṣayiṣyanti cāmbaraiḥ ||58|| dhanādyaiścopakaraṇaiste yāsyantyakṣaraṃ hi naḥ | imāmādyāṃ sṛṣṭimūlāmāśritya ca kathāstataḥ ||59|| pravartiṣyanta ākhyānopākhyānagranthakoṭayaḥ | vedaścaikaḥ parabrahmabhāṣitaḥ saṃhitā tathā ||4.78.60 || paranārāyaṇoktā ca dvitīyā vedinī hi sā | vyāsā navanavā bhūtvāśritya vedaṃ ca saṃhitām ||61 || likhiṣyanti granthakathā racayiṣyanti vārttikāḥ | tata eṣā mokṣadā vai dhṛtā smṛtā śrutāvitā ||62|| ityuktvā śrīsaṃhitāyā jayamuccārya saṃgatāḥ | kathāsamāptiṃ kṛtvaiva sabhāvisarjanaṃ tathā ||63|| kurvan śrīkṛṣṇabhagavān badrike pūjanāgatam | yadyat sarvaṃ ca tat tatrotthāya svayaṃ pareśvaraḥ ||64|| dātṛbhya eva sarvaṃ vai prātyārpayat prasādajam | rājyaṃ bhūmirgṛhakṣetrodyānavāhanayānakam ||65|| svarṇaṃ raupyaṃ vibhūṣāśca gavāśvavājimaṇḍalam | tattaddātṛbhya evāpi dīnebhyaścāpi mādhavaḥ ||66|| prasādaṃ rūpaṃ cājñayaiva prātyarpayat pradātṛṣu | dvijeṣu dīnavargeṣu dānaṃ ca vidhinākarot ||67|| sarve prasannacittāste kṛṣṇājñayā prajagṛhuḥ | kṛṣṇārthaṃ kṛṣṇapūjārthaṃ dharmārthaṃ jagṛhuśca te |||68||| viprebhyaścāpi sādhubhyaḥ sādhvībhyaḥ pradadau hariḥ | yathāpekṣaṃ samastaṃ ca tato’vaśiṣṭameva yat ||69|| tattatra mandire naije koṭirāyādinirmitte | sauvarṇe māṇikīlakṣmīrādhāprajñādisevite ||4.78.70|| ārpayajjīvikāsiddhyai kṣetravāṭīdhanādikam | jayakāraṃ tataḥ sarve samuccārya visarjanam ||71 || sabhāyāḥ sampracakraste tadā nāryo narā janāḥ | sabhādhuliṃ patrapuṣpākṣatān jagṛhurutsukāḥ ||72|| patitvopatya cotpatya prasādamṛttikāṃ śubhām | jagṛhuśca jayanādānūcire muktakaṇṭhataḥ ||73|| parihāraṃ vidhāyaiva yajñabhūmiṃ hariryayau | vyāsaśca lomaśādyāśca yayuyajñālayaṃ dvijāḥ ||74|| rājāno’pi yayuryajñasthalīṃ yojanavartulām | yatra pravartate vipradvārā yajñakriyādikam ||75|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ padmāvatīyutaḥ | prajñayā sahitaścāpi patiḥ śrīvallabhaḥ prabhuḥ ||76|| yajñāsane svarṇamaye hyupāviveśa karmaṇe | saṃkalpaṃ lomaśo brahmā kārayāmāsa vai tataḥ ||77|| prāyaścittaṃ pradhānākhyasaṃkalpaṃ ca tataḥ param | diśāṃ rakṣāṃ kalaśārādhanaṃ gaṇeśapūjanam ||78|| svastipravācanaṃ puṇyāhādipravācanaṃ tataḥ | abhiṣecanamevātha mātṛkāpūjanaṃ tathā ||79|| nāndīśrāddhaṃ tathācāryadvijādivaraṇaṃ tataḥ | arghadānaṃ vandanaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ cakāra ca ||4.78.80 || vardhinīkalaśasthāpanāṃ ca maṇḍapaprokṣaṇam | vāstusthāpanamevāpi vāstumaṇḍapapūjanam ||8 1|| sarvatobhadradevānāṃ sthāpanaṃ pūjanādikam | yatradevasthāpanaṃ ca pūjāgnyuttāraṇaṃ tataḥ ||82|| pīṭhapūjāṃ kuṇḍapūjāmagnisthāpanamācarat | gṛhasthāpanamevātha yoginīsthāpanārhaṇe ||83|| kṣetrapālasthāpanārhe kuṇḍamekhalikārcanam | agneḥ prapūjanaṃ grahārhaṇānvādhānacintanam ||84|| āghārāvājyabhāgādihomaṃ cakāra viśvasṛṭ | vāstumaṇḍapadevādihomaṃ cakāra mādhavaḥ ||85|| yoginīhomamevāpi pradhānahomamityapi | vyāhṛtihomamevāpi balidānaṃ dadau tataḥ ||86|| yūpāropaṇamevāpi cakre’dhivāsanaṃ tataḥ | jalamātṛprapūjāṃ ca jalapūjāmakārayat ||87|| śaṃkhaghaṇṭādipūjāṃ ca bhūtaśuddhimakārayat | prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kṛṣṇasya ṣoḍaśādiprapūjanam ||88|| balidānaṃ tathāhutīn sarvadevahavām̐stataḥ | mahāpūrṇāhutihomaṃ ghṛtadhārābhirācarat ||89|| śrīphalaiśca rasaiḥ sarvavidhaiśca pāyasādibhiḥ | candanaiḥ phalapuṣpādyaiścakāra parameśvaraḥ ||4.78.90 || nīrājanaṃ mahārārtrikaṃ cakāra hariḥ svayam | puṣpāñjaliṃ dadau sarvayajamānābhiṣecanam ||91|| brahmā vyadhāttataḥ śreyodānaṃ ca dakṣiṇāḥ śubhāḥ | bhūyasīḥ svarṇaratnāḍhyā āśīrvādān dadau tataḥ ||92|| parihāraṃ savādyaṃ ca kārayāmāsa viśvasṛṭ | phalānāṃ kandamūlānāṃ bhojanānyabhavam̐stataḥ ||93|| pāyasādiprasādānāṃ bhojanāni śubhāni ca | munyannānāṃ cāmṛtānāṃ śākānāṃ payasāṃ tathā ||94|| bhojanānyabhavam̐statra yathāyogaṃ ca dehinām | vratināṃ sarvalokānāṃ tṛptiryathāyathaṃ hyabhūt ||95|| tataḥ śrībadrike cāvabhṛthaṃ sindhujale’bhavat | avabhṛthamahātīrthaṃ khyātaṃ tattu vyajāyata ||96|| avabhṛthamahāsnāne mahāścaryāṇi cābhavan | bahūni svarṇadivyāni vimānāni samāyayuḥ ||97|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇādyadhiṣṭhitāni ca | ye ye tvāsan śuddhabhāvā janā mokṣādhikāriṇaḥ ||98|| narā nāryo nijāndehān tyaktyātha divyavigrahāḥ | bhūtvāruhya vimānāni yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ || 99|| yayuḥ kecana golokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ kecanāpi vai | avyākṛtaṃ yayuścāpi yayuḥ kecana cāmṛtam | | 4.78.10 0|| śrīpuraṃ cāpare bhaktāḥ pare satyaṃ divaṃ yayuḥ | badrīnāthaṃ śvetadhāma kṣīradhāma yayuḥ pare || 101 || kailāsaṃ brahmalokaṃ ca yathāśuddhi yayustadā | mahāścaryamabhūttadvai badrike mokṣadāyakam || 10 2|| tataḥ svasvāvasathām̐śca yayuḥ kīrtanakāriṇaḥ | pattane saṃhitāyāśca bhrāmaṇaṃ pūjanādikam || 1 03|| deśeṣu sārvabhaumeṣu tato’bhūt badrike bahu | gṛhe gṛhe catvarādāvāpaṇeṣvālayeṣvapi || 1 04|| rājadvāre mandirādau pratyaṃgaṇaṃ prapūjanam | vyāsasya saṃhitāyāśca prasthāpanamabhūcchubham || 105||| ārārtrikāni dānāni pūjanānyupadāstathā | naivedyāni prajāyante badrike vai sthale sthale || 1 06|| mahāvādyāni vādyante kīrtyante tadyaśāṃsi ca | kumārikābhiḥ saubhāgyavatībhiśca satījanaiḥ ||1 07|| pūjyante nāgarikābhiḥ rājñībhirgṛhiṇījanaiḥ | śarkarānagare caivaṃ rājadvāre ca mandire | 1 08|| prapratiṣṭhāpanaṃ samyag vidhāya maṇḍapālayam | saṃhitāyā ānayanaṃ jātaṃ mahotsavena ha || 10 9|| gajavājivimānānāṃ vāhanānāṃ ca sarvathā | narayānottamānāṃ ca sammardo’bhūd divaṃ yathā ||4.78.1 10 || darśanaṃ puṇyadaṃ tasya smaraṇaṃ puṇyadaṃ hyapi | cintanaṃ puṇyadaṃ badri dhyānaṃ tasya tu mokṣadam || 111 || evaṃ samutsavaṃ sarve’valambya bhuvi bhūmipāḥ | kariṣyanti mahāyajñān dānavidhīn tathottamān || 112|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya mokṣaḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ | sakāmānāmiṣṭalabdhirbhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ || 11 3|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne āṣāḍhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ saṃhitāpārāyaṇasamāptau śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena devai rājabhiḥ prajābhiḥ sarvasṛṣṭidehibhiḥ saṃhitāyā vyāsasya guroḥ sādhūnāṃ sādhvīnāṃ dvijānāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ ca kṛtapūjanopadārpaṇyārārtrikādikaṃ svasvagṛhālayamandirasaudhādau bhrāmaṇaṃ prapratiṣṭhānaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 78 ||
<4.79> śrībadarīpriyovācanārāyaṇahare kṛṣṇa tataḥ kiṃ samajāyata | kva kva yānaṃ tataḥ kuṃkumākṣarāgamanaṃ kadā || 1 || śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca āṣāḍhaśukladvādaśyāṃ kṛtasnānaprapūjanaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo naije gajāsane || 2 || padmāvatīpriyāyukto vyarājata svadarśanam | prātardātuṃ svataḥprakāśo’pi vai lomaśo muniḥ || 3 || śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇādyā patnīvratāśca bhūsurāḥ | vyarājanta sabhāyāṃ te kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāntike || 4 || viprāḥ satyaḥ sādhavaśca siddhāśca yatayo’malāḥ | virejire sabhāmadhye sūryavarcasvino’naghāḥ || 5 || śrīharerdarśanārthaṃ vai svāyaṃbhuvādisṛṣṭipāḥ | brahmādyā bhagavantaśca mahendrādyāśca devatāḥ || 6 || maharṣayaśca rājāno rājñyaśca devikāgaṇāḥ | śreṣṭhinaśca prajāvargā mahābhāgavatottamāḥ || 7 || āyayuścopadā hastā pupūjuḥ parameśvaram | vyāsaṃ guruṃ lomaśaṃ ca natvopāviviśuśca te || 8 || lomaśaḥ śrīguruṃ sarvān dhanyavādānavāsṛjat | vidāyaṃ pradadau yogyottamebhyo hi yathāyatham || 9 || sādhubhyaśca satībhyaśca maharṣibhyo vidāyakam | mahīmānebhya evāpyāgantukebhyo vidāyakam || 4.79.1 0|| surebhyaḥ pitṛdevebhyaḥ siddhebhyaḥ pradadau tathā | gāndharvasūtabandibhyaḥ sevakebhyo dadau mudā || 11 || karmacārebhya utkṛṣṭavidāyāni dadau muniḥ | pāritoṣikarūpāṇi svarṇādīni dadau mudā | | 12|| viprebhyo dakṣiṇādānottamāni kānakāni ca | hīrakān ratnabhūṣāśca dhanāni pradadau muniḥ || 1 3|| devībhyaḥ strībhya evāpi kanyābhyaḥ pradadau muniḥ | bālebhyo brahmacāribhyo yatinībhyo vidāyakam || 14|| sāṃkhyayoginībhyo brahmacāriṇībhyo dadau muniḥ | yathāyogyaṃ vidāyaṃ vai pūrṇasantoṣakārakam || 15|| svarṇahārān svarṇabhūṣāḥ svarṇāmbarāṇi mudrikāḥ | suveṣān svarṇapātrāṇi dehopakaraṇānyapi || 16|| śṛṃgārottamarūpāṇi kalpapātrāṇi yānyapi | kalpacintāmaṇīn mauktikādihārān dadau muniḥ | | 17|| yānāni gṛhasāmagrīrdadau śrīlomaśo guruḥ | āśīrvādān dadau cānte mahotsavibhya ādarāt || 18|| vihāyaṃ pradadau puṣpahārān kaṇṭheṣu dehinām | atha bhūpāḥ sabhāyāṃ te jagadurlomaśaṃ munim || 19|| nijālayānnijarājyaṃ pavitrayitumāgamaiḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vyāsaśca saṃhitāḥ ||4.79.20|| lomaśaḥ pitarau cānyāḥ śrīlakṣmyādyāśca devatāḥ | yathāyogyaṃ samāyāntu pavitrayantu naḥ kṣitīḥ ||21|| rāṣṭrāṇi naḥ pradeśāṃśca prajāśca mandirāṇi naḥ | pavitrayantu cāgatya bhagavantaḥ pareśvarāḥ ||22|| svāyambhuvo manuścāpi priyavrato nṛpastathā | uttānapādaścāpyāha prāhāgnidhro nṛpastathā ||23|| prārthayam̐śca tadā khaṇḍeśvarā hiraṇyakādayaḥ | pāvayituṃ nijāvāsān nijaprajādibhūmikāḥ ||24|| tathāstvitikṛṣṇanārāyaṇastebhyo dadau vacaḥ | koṭirāyo rāyaharistato vidāyakaṃ mahat ||25|| yathāyogyaṃ nṛpādīnāṃ cakratuḥ sevakāviva | sabhāvisarjanaṃ badri jayanādaistato’bhavat ||26|| bhojanānyabhavam̐statra lakṣāyutādhidehinām | sajjatā prasthānakāni gamanāni tato’bhavan ||27|| prajāḥ svasvarāṣṭradeśān yayuḥ prasannamānasāḥ | mahīmānā yayuścāpi nṛpabhinnāḥ prajājanāḥ ||28|| devā yayuśceśvarāśca tadā kṛṣṇājñayā dine | devairabhyarthitaḥ kṛṣṇo gantuṃ svargādikālayān ||29|| hariḥ kālāntare gantuṃ svīkṛtyatānavāsṛjat | īśvarānapi sarvān vai prārthanākāriṇastathā ||4.79.30|| kālāntare prayātuṃ svīkṛtyeśvarānavāsṛjat | pitṝnapi tathoktvaiva pātālavāsinastathā || 3 1|| kālāntare pragantuṃ ca svīkṛtya tānavāsṛjat | omityāha haristatra bhūpebhyastaddine khalu ||32|| pṛthvyāmeva nṛpāṇāṃ tu gantuṃ gṛhāṇi bhūstarān | svīcakāra kṛpāsindhurlomaśasyānumantraṇāt || 33|| atha sarvasamājo dvādaśyāṃ visṛṣṭa eva ha | kevalāśca nṛpāḥ sajjā bhūtvā pratīkṣaṇe sthitāḥ ||34|| tadā vyacintayat kṛṣṇaḥ sarveṣāṃ lābhakāṃkṣayā | naikarūpadharatvaṃ vai sarvaiḥ saha pramāṇakam || 35|| athaivaṃ saṃvicāryaivānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | badrike’dhārayannaikarūpāṇi sadṛśāni saḥ ||36|| svataḥprakāśavyāsātmā lomaśātmābhavatprabhuḥ | tāvadrūpaśca pitrātmā mātrātmā cābhavatprabhuḥ ||37|| rādhāramādiśaktyātmā dāsadāsīsvarūpavān | yāvanto rājanyavaryāstāvadrūpāṇyadhārayat ||38|| teṣāṃ tāvadvimāneṣu samāruroha mādhavaḥ | tāvatsarvasvarūpātmā sarvasvavargarūpavān ||39|| śarkarānagaraṃ tyaktvāmbare vimānakāni vai | abhavan badrike kṛṣṇājñayā tatsvāmijūṃṣi vai || 4.79.40|| tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayaśabdāstadābhavan | oṃ namo bālakṛṣṇāyānādikṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||41|| namaskārāścābhavam̐śca puṣpākṣatābhivardhanam | cakrurlokā devatādyāścandanādyabhivarṣaṇam ||42||| kṛṣṇājñayā vimānāni niryayuḥ sindhumaṇḍalāt | prathamaṃ koṭirāyasyālayaṃ prati yayau drutam |||43|| dvitīyaṃ tu rāyaharimandiraṃ prati tad yayau | tṛtīyaṃ tu yayau svāyambhuvamandiramujjvalam ||44|| caturthaṃ tu yayau divyaṃ priyavratālayaṃ prati | paṃcamaṃ tu yayau divyamuttānapādamandiram ||45|| ṣaṣṭhamāgnīdhrarājyaṃ vai saptamaṃ tu hiraṇyakam | aṣṭamaṃ ketumālaṃ ca navamaṃ tu kuruṃ prati ||46|| daśamaṃ kāśikārājaṃ yayau vimānamuttamam | śāvadīnaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ ca jummāsemlaṃ nṛpaṃ prati ||47|| dakṣajavaṃgaraṃ śibidevaṃ prati pṛthak pṛthak | tharkūṭasthaṃ vīrajāraṃ śaktyakṣikaṃ nṛpaṃ prati ||48|| kālimāśaṃ bālakāśaṃ kathakaṃ prati vai pṛthak | pṛthurājaṃ pratyuralaketumuṣṭrālarājakam ||49|| tīrāṇaṃ cāpi haṃkāraṃ jayakāṣṭhalakaṃ prati | pṛthak kṛṣṇasya yānāni yayustaistaiḥ sahaiva ha ||4.79.50|| alvīnaraṃ jīnavarddhimalpaketuṃ pṛthak pṛthak | jayakṛṣṇavanṛpatiṃ parīśānanṛpaṃ prati ||51 || indurāyaṃ ca mudrāṇḍaṃ gaṇḍarājaṃ pṛthak prati | vṛhaccharaṃ ca līnorṇaṃ balalīnaṃ pṛthak pṛthak ||52|| rāyagāmalabhūpaṃ ca varasiṃhaṃ pṛthag yayuḥ | phenatantunṛpaṃ stokahomaṃ ca kolakaṃ prati ||53|| kāṣṭhayānaṃ dinamānārkaṃ pṛthag rāyakinnaṭam | rāyarokīśvaraṃ rāyaraṇajīvaṃ pṛthag yayuḥ ||54|| rāyavākakṣakaṃ cāpi rāyamārīśakaṃ prati | rāyabaleśvaraṃ rāyalambaraṃ prati vai pṛthak ||55|| rāyanavārkabhūpaṃ ca rāyahuṇḍeśakaṃ prati | rāyakūpeśabhūpaṃ ca kālimāṇḍalikaṃ prati ||56|| vanajeleśabhūpaṃ ca pārāvārapibaṃ pṛthak | harervimānavaryāṇi yayustān prati vai pṛthak ||57|| koṭīśvaraṃ śrīsatīśaṃ tretākarkaśabhūpatim | āṇḍajaraṃ bālyarajaṃ rāyasomanakaṃ pṛthag |||58|| ūrugavākṣakaṃ parāṅvratamīśānapānakam | rājārāyapatiṃ cāpi vimānāni pṛthag yayuḥ ||59|| yajñaṃ dharmaṃ ca dhātāraṃ vidhātāraṃ pṛthak pṛthak | nābhiṃ kimpuruṣaṃ cānyaṃ ramyakaṃ prati vai pṛthak ||4.79.60|| umārāyaṃ kṣīrapuruṃ nāgavikramaṇaṃ prati | jayādityaṃ vikramārkaṃ kṛṣṇadurgaṃ ca pāñcalam ||61 || prabhālākṣaṃ lakṣasenam āmraśālaṃ śrīlambhanam | prapatpālaṃ prāṇipātaṃ nandibhillaṃ pṛthag yayuḥ ||6 2|| rāyapāraṃ cendragṛtsaṃ gavayendraṃ janāstrakam | karṇaputsamavadhyābhaṃ yāgadevaṃ paṭāsanam ||63|| dārābhāgyaṃ rājamānaṃ mādhavaṃ brahmapānakam | śīlahāraṃ māṇikābhaṃ cittamāṃgeyakaṃ prati || 64|| candranāgaṃ medakośaṃ purukutsaṃ pṛthag yayuḥ | bālasaṃghaṃ pārvateśaṃ nāgavijayakaṃ prati ||65 || rājamāruṃ mahendrābhaṃ madāśanaṃ nṛpaṃ prati | śararaṃgaṃ madhurājaṃ virāmāsaṃ pṛthag yayuḥ ||66|| trikūṭārkaṃ mahāsāraṃ citralāsyaṃ nṛpaṃ prati | kalikāñcanamāpāṇḍamakkalāryaṃ vivardhanam ||67|| maṇḍalāraṃ javalīnamindradyumnaṃ nṛpaṃ prati | māṭharasiṃhaṃ nṛpaṃ kuṭidharaṃ cicintanaṃ pṛthag ||68|| udaṅprabhaṃ śrīnāgāriṃ dharaṇidhraṃ rajidhvajam | mūradhvajaṃ kuṃkumāsyaṃ nṛpaṃ prati pṛthak pṛthak | |69|| yayurharervimānāni badrike saha taiḥ pṛthak | tathā khaṇḍanṛpaiścāpi dvīpeśaiścābdhitīragaiḥ ||4.79.70|| raṇeśairadribhūpaiśca copabhūpaiḥ pṛthag yayuḥ | tattaddeśān samullaṃghya tattadrāṣṭrāṇi saṃyayuḥ ||71 || tattannṛpālayodyānabhūmyādau tānyavātaran | jalapānaṃ bhojanādi kārayitvāmṛtādanam ||72|| nagare bhrāmayāmāsuḥ svasvasmin bhūmipāstataḥ | saṃhitāyāḥ pūjanaṃ ca vyāsasya pūjanaṃ guroḥ ||73|| sve sve divye mahāramye prāsāde cakrurutsukāḥ | upadāścārpayāmāsū ratnahīrakamālikāḥ ||74|| sarvotkṛṣṭaṃ gṛhe yadyad rājye rāṣṭre tathottamam | tattacchrīkṛṣṇasevāyāṃ nyadhuste rājasattamāḥ ||75|| ārārtrikaṃ pracakruśca papuḥ pādāmṛtaṃ hareḥ | prasādaṃ bhakṣayāmāsuḥ śrīsvāmikṛṣṇahastataḥ ||76|| sevayāmāsuratyarthaṃ pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ | enaṃ prasādayāmāsurbhaktyā padmāvatīpatim ||77|| jagṛhuste mahāmantrān prajñānārāyaṇānanāt | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||78|| śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu mama sarvadā | kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt ||79|| śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastivānava | brahmāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto’smi śāśvataḥ ||4.79.80|| brāhmyahaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadāsī bhavāmi om | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ||8 1 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me | bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ ||82|| pitā bandhuḥ suhṛnmitraṃ rakṣakaḥ poṣako’stu saḥ | bālakṛṣṇāya vidmahe’nādikṛṣṇāya dhīmahi | tannaḥ śrīśaḥ pracodayāt ||83|| oṃ śrīlakṣmyai mahālakṣmyai duḥkhabhaṃktryai śriyai namaḥ | oṃ māṃ śrībālakṛṣṇāya samarpayāmi oṃ namaḥ ||84|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto’haṃ śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama | śrīkṛṣṇo vallabhaḥ svāmī śrīsvāmī śaraṇaṃ mama ||85|| śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śrīhariḥ svāmī śrīpatiḥ śaraṇaṃ mama | śrīkṛṣṇo vaiṣṇavācāryaḥ prabhuḥ padmāvatīpatiḥ ||86|| svāmī me śāśvataḥ kāntastasyāhaṃ svāminī priyā | prabhuḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pārameśaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śaraṇaṃ mama ||87|| prabhuḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pārvaṇo nārāyaṇaḥ śaraṇaṃ mama | etānmantrān dadau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ ||88|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa rādhāramāyaṇa ||89|| prabho nārāyaṇa mādhavīśrīnārāyaṇa prabho | jayānārāyaṇa śrīlalitānārāyaṇa vibho ||4.79.90 || kaṃbharāgopālalālaḥ svāmī patiśca māmava | evaṃ mantrān nāmadhunyaṃ dadau cāpi svayaṃ hariḥ ||91 || tulasīkaṇṭhikāṃ cāpi tilakaṃ candraśobhitam | dadau svacaraṇau teṣāṃ vakṣaḥsthaleṣu mādhavaḥ ||92|| jagṛhuste hare raktacaraṇau raṃgaśobhitau | mudrāpitau śubhau sarvapādacihnasuśobhitau ||93|| dakṣahastatalasyāpi sacihnamudrikāṃ śubhām | jagṛhuste tu pūjārthaṃ darśanārthaṃ tu rañjitām ||94|| pratikṛtiṃ pratimāṃ ca pratirūpaṃ ca jagṛhuḥ | citraṃ kṛtvā hariṃ gehe rakṣayāmāsuranvaham ||95|| badrike dvādaśīrātriṃ sarvageheṣu mādhavaḥ | uṣitvā tu tataḥ prātaḥ kṛtasevādarāśanaḥ ||96|| kṛtapūjaḥ samastaiśca toṣitastoṣitaiśca taiḥ | savādyagītayaśasā jayanādaiḥ samantataḥ ||97|| prasthāpito vimāne sve pṛthak samāruroha ca | tadā sarve’ntimāṃ naijāṃ prārthanāṃ cakrurīśinaḥ ||98|| hare svāmin kṛpāsindho pāvitāḥ kṛpayā vayam | tathaiva cāntakāle’pi pāvanān svākṣaraṃ naya ||99|| madhye sadā mūrtirūpo rakṣayāsmān tavāśritān | hṛdaye svaṃ divyarūpaṃ sadā cedaṃ pradarśaya || 4.79.10 0|| tavāsmīti tava smaśca tathā pālaya sarvadā | evaṃ māyāvimoho na bhavannaiveti cintaya || 10 1|| ityevaṃ badrike sarve cakruścābhyarthanāṃ prabhoḥ | pūjāyāmāgataṃ yadyat sarvaṃ prasādarūpi tat || 1 02|| haristebhyaḥ pradātṛbhyaḥ pratyārpayat kṛpāvaśaḥ | āśīrvādān śubhān datvā svīkṛtya prārthanāṃ tataḥ || 10 3|| prāpya vidāyamevāsau paśyan bhaktānnṛpādikān | prajājanāḥ prapaśyam̐śca premṇā vimānamairayat || 1 04|| ambare sahasā kṛṣṇavimānāni samauḍḍayan | tiro’bhavan cidākāśe kṛṣṇātmakāni tāni vai || 105|| ekībhūtāni sarvāṇi saurāṣṭre’śvasaro’ntike | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre vimānamekamāyayau || 1 06|| avātiracchanaiḥ kṣetre dyotayan sarvatodiśaḥ | bhagavān vyāsadevādyā lomaśādyā maharṣayaḥ || 1 07|| pitarau dāsikā dāsā viviśuḥ svasvamandiram | evaṃ śrībadrike pārāyaṇasyāsya mahotsavaḥ || 1 08|| abhūt sarvotsavāgryaśca pārāyaṇāgrya eva saḥ | tatastu cakrire tvanye makhān bhāgavatottamāḥ || 1 09|| svārociṣastathā bhūpā uttamastāmaso’pi ca | raivataścākṣuṣaścāpi vaivasvato’pi tannṛpāḥ || 4.79.11 0||| ete ca manavaḥ pārāyaṇotsavān pracakrire | anye cāpi vidhāsyanti mahābhāgavatottamāḥ || 111 || mokṣaśāstramidaṃ badri dharmārthakāmanāphalam | sarveṣṭadāyakaṃ cātmaparamātmaprasaṅgadam || 1 12|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya kathotsavasya cintanāt | sarveṣṭasiddhiḥ sulabhā sulabhā divyasampadaḥ || 1 13|| mokṣalābho bhaveccāpi sarveṣaṇāprapūrttayaḥ | kalpavṛkṣasamāstasya saṃkalpāḥ saphalā drutam || 1 14|| manaścintāmaṇiprakhyaṃ prajāyeta na saṃśayaḥ | kathānāṃ dhāraṇāllakṣmītulyā nārī bhavedapi || 1 15|| naro nārāyaṇaḥ syācca kathānāṃ dhāraṇādiha | badrike sarvasṛṣṭau tat pārāyaṇaṃ jayatyati || 1 16|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne’khilanṛpārthitaḥ śrīharirnaikarūpadharaḥ san sarvanṛparāṣṭramandirāṇi yayau, pūjāṃ pragṛhya pāvayitvā tirobhūyāśvapaṭṭasaraḥ pratyāyayāvityādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 79 ||
<4.80> śrībadrīpriyovācasarvakalyāṇakartaḥ śrīkānta kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | kiṃ cakāra tataḥ sarvaṃ caritraṃ vaktumarhasi || 1 || śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi svāmikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | nāgavikramabhūpena yajñe tvākārito yayau || 2 || pāravatyā nijapatnyā prabhayā nijakāntayā | yutaḥ santuṣṭayā svasrā dāsadāsīgaṇairyutaḥ || 3 || yayāvasmai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya śarkarāpure | pratijñātaṃ tu yajñārthaṃ yuddhapurādhipena yat || 4 || nāgavikramasaṃjñena samārabdho makhastu saḥ | tatrānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yayau nimantritaḥ || 5 || sarvamedhaṃ mahāyajñaṃ kārayāmāsa mādhavaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīśvaravallabhaḥ || 6 || nāgavikramarājeśo mahābhāgavatottamaḥ | cāturmāsyavrataṃ kurvan sarvamedhaṃ cakāra ha || 7 || yuddhapure lunīnadyāstaṭe viśālabhūtale | pañcayojanavistāre maṇḍapaṃ sa tvakārayat || 8 || śrāvaṇaśuklaikādaśyāṃ kṛtasaṃbhārasañcayaḥ | yajñamārabhata kṣmeśo viprayājñikanoditaḥ || 9 || āyayustatra bhūdevāḥ sādhavo vaiṣṇavā api | narā nāryo lakṣaśo vai dharmakāryaparāyaṇāḥ || 4.80.1 0|| brahmābhavat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān svayam | yajamāno nāgavikramākhyo bhūpo hi vaiṣṇavaḥ || 11 || ṛtvijo gālavādyāśca maharṣayo’bhavanmakhe | phālāyano’bhavattatrodgātā sāmaparāyaṇaḥ || 12|| sārāyaṇo’bhavatpratyudgātā vedārthavittathā | ajāyano’bhavattatrāhartā vaidikasatkriyaḥ || 1 3||| daṇḍāyano’bhavatpratihartā sarvakriyāparaḥ | bhālāyanastu ṛṣirāṭ prastotā cābhavanmakhe || 14|| rasāyano’bhavat pratiprastotā yajñakarmaṇi | hotā dhārāyaṇaścaiva pratihotālavāyanaḥ || 15 || jāpakāścārbudā viprāḥ pauṣkarā havanārthinaḥ | yāmuneyā dvijāścāsan dikpālā vaiṣṇavottamāḥ || 16|| saurāṣṭrīyāḥ pūjakāśca dvijāścāsam̐stadā makhe | gaurjarāḥ pācakāścāsan marujāḥ pariveṣakāḥ || 17|| gāṃgeyā vedamantrādivyākhyātāro’bhavanmakhe | sindhujāḥ pāṭhakāścāsan sabhāsadāstu pūrvajāḥ || 18|| dakṣiṇātyā havanārthā āsam̐statra ca jāpakāḥ | maharṣayo vaśiṣṭhādyā guravastu nirīkṣakāḥ || 1 9|| draṣṭārastatra sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ vai tadābhavan | madhyasthā vaidikā viprā āsan prakhyātanāminaḥ ||4.80.20|| lomaśādyāstathā mārkaṇḍeyādyā divyadṛṣṭayaḥ | haimācalāḥ kṛṣṇanāmnāṃ kīrtaneṣvabhavan sthirāḥ ||21 || evaṃ vai badrike yajñe’bhavan viprā vyavasthitāḥ | sādhavo lakṣaśaścāpyabhavan bhajanakāriṇaḥ || 22|| prajāśca khaṇḍarājanyā āmantritāḥ samāyayuḥ | lakṣātilakṣamanujāḥ sarvamedhe’bhavam̐stadā |||23||| ghṛtakulyā dadhikulyāḥ sudhākulyāstadābhavan | payaḥkulyā madhukulyā śarkarāparvatāstathā ||24|| miṣṭānnānāṃ parvatāśca pānānāṃ prasarāṃsi ca | bhakṣyāṇāṃ setavaścāsan sarvamedhe’tra badrike ||25|| phalānāṃ lehyacośyānāṃ mahādrayo’bhavan makhe | dānārhahomayogyānāṃ meravastatra cābhavan ||26|| samidhāṃ pāyasānnānāṃ kṣīrāṇāṃ sañcayottamāḥ | kaṇānāṃ cāpi śimbīnāṃ rāśayo’pyabhavanmakhe || 27|| vastrāṇāṃ kambalānāṃ ca bhūṣāṇāmadrayo’bhavan | pātrāṇāṃ dāraratnānāṃ dhenūnāṃ maṇḍalānyapi ||28|| dehopakaraṇānāṃ ca gṛhopakaraṇārthinām | āsan prarāśayastatra sampadāṃ divyasampadām || 29|| suvarṇānāṃ rajatānāṃ sañcayāścābhavanmakhe āsanānāṃ sruksruvāṇāṃ haviṣyāṇāṃ prapūrṇatāḥ ||4.80.3 0|| daśa sūtyāstathā badri dīkṣāśca dvādaśāpi vai | upasado dvādaśaśca yathāyogyaṃ vyavartayan || 31 || bhādrapūrṇāvadhiryāgaścatustriṃśaddinātmakaḥ | sarvāṃgapūrṇo hyabhavad badrike kṛṣṇasannidhau || 32|| bṛhaspatisavādyāśca āptoryāmāntakāḥ śubhāḥ | sāṃgopāṃgā hyabhavam̐śca nārāyaṇasamāhitāḥ || 33|| bṛhaspatisave trayastriṃśadgodānamābhavat | vaiśyasave viprasave somasave tathābhavat || 34|| pṛthisave gosave odanasave tathābhavat | marutstome’gnistutau ca mahendrastavane tathā || 35|| āptoryāme nidhane ca save godānakāni ca | abhiṣekāḥ pṛthak cāpi tattaddevābhyapūjanam || 36|| puroḍāśārpaṇaṃ cāpi yathākarmābhavan khalu | savo’bhiṣeka ukto vai yajamānasya caiva ha || 37|| jalenājyena dadhnā ca ghṛtena payasā tathā | abhiṣeko yathāyogyamabhavattatra cādhvare || 38|| puroḍāśāścaravaśca havīṃṣi dravyamuttamam | odanāni saktavaśca manthāstatrābhavan śubhāḥ || 39|| rathantarādisomāśca saṃsthāśca havanānyapi | yathāyogyāni jātāni nirvartitāni śārṅgiṇā ||4.80.40|| avatārā īśvarāśca śaktayo devatāḥ surāḥ | pratyakṣā āgaman badri kṛṣṇāhūtāstadadhvare ||41 || sṛṣṭitraye ca ye devā yajñādhikārayoginaḥ | sarve te balibhogārthamāyayurgocarāḥ surāḥ |||42||| ghṛtadhārābhiretepi haviṣyānnairanuttamaiḥ | rasairmiṣṭānnakaiḥ kṣīraiḥ phalaiḥ samidbhirityapi ||43|| kaṇaiḥ sudhābhiḥ payasā tarpitāḥ śākakandakaiḥ | nityaṃ tatra pradīyante svarṇagodānakāni vai ||44|| bhojanāmbaradānāni dharmadānāni yānyapi | pitṛtṛptipradānāni dīyante vai nṛpeṇa ha ||45|| pūjyante sādhavaḥ santaḥ sādhvyo viprāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ | āgantukānāthadīnā narā nāryaḥ pradānakaiḥ ||46|| lakṣaśo mānavādyāśca bhuñjate gṛṣṭamiṣṭakam | pibanti sadrasān gṛṣṭipuṣṭidān tṛptikārakān ||47|| agnayo gocarāstatra bhuṃjate svakarairmukhe | prasannā devatāḥ saumyā bhuñjate havyamuttamam ||48|| pitaro bhuñjate badri tathānyadevatādikāḥ | samastāḥ śrīkṛṣṇahastārpitaprasādamuttamam ||49|| tṛptāstṛptā vayaṃ tṛptā ityūcuścānalānanāḥ | tato yajñasya bhādrasya pūrṇāyāṃ pūrṇātābhavat ||4.80.50|| pūrṇāhutau haviṣyāṇi trailokyasaṃbhavāni vai | yānyānītāni tāni śrīkṛṣṇo dadau mahānale ||5 1 || udgārāstṛptidāsteṣāṃ surāṇāṃ saṃbhavanti ca | mā meti suravācaścābhavan pūrṇāhutau mudā ||52|| sṛṣṭitrayaṃ tarpitaṃ śrīkṛṣṇena paramātmanā | nāgavikramabhūpasya saṃkalpaḥ saphalīkṛtaḥ ||53||| badrike śrīhariryatra viśvātmā sakalaṃbharaḥ | dātā grahītā bhoktāttā nityatṛpto jaganmayaḥ ||54|| tatrātṛptirna vidyeta paripūrṇo yataḥ svayam | nāgavikramabhūpo’pi kṛtvā yajñaṃ sadakṣiṇam ||55|| kṛtakṛtyo’bhavad badri mahābhāgavatottamaḥ | svarṇarūpyamayīḥ sarvā dakṣiṇāḥ pradadau makhe ||56|| godhanāni vibhūṣāśca kanyādānāni vai dadau | kṣitidānāni ratnānāṃ dānāni vibhavārpaṇam ||57|| vidyādānāni bahūni dharmadānāni sandadau | gṛhadānānyuttamāni vṛttidānāni sandadau ||58|| avabhṛthaṃ tatau rājā cakāra yājñikaiḥ saha | jalamātṛpūjanādi jaladevaprapūjanam ||59|| tīrthasthāne lūṇikāyā jale cakāra bhūpatiḥ | sarvaṃ vidhiṃ sadānaṃ ca kṛtvā snānaṃ samācarat ||4.80.60|| lakṣādhimānavāḥ sākaṃ snānadānāni cācaran | nāgavikramabhūpasya rājñī nāmnārkamālinī ||6 1|| avabhṛthānte dānāni yoṣidbhyaḥ pradadau mudā | hīraratnādihārām̐śca svarṇabhūṣāmbarāṇi ca ||62|| śaṛṃgāraveṣān subhagān svarṇapātrāṇi yāni ca | dehopakaraṇānyeva dadau bhūrīṇi vai mudā ||63|| viprapatnyaḥ kanyakāśca sādhvyaḥ satyaḥ sakhījanaḥ | prasannamānasā jātāstṛptā dānāptisatphalāḥ ||64|| evamavabhṛthe tatra badrike vismayāvahaḥ | camatkāro’bhavattūrṇaṃ taṃ vadāmi nibodha me ||65|| āgataṃ maṇḍalaṃ tvekaṃ piśācānāṃ mahattadā | ākāśājjalamadhye tat patitaṃ nimnavāriṣu ||66|| sahasā te sahasraṃ vai papurvāri mudānvitāḥ | piśācāḥ snātamātrāśca divyadevāstadābhavan ||67|| svarṇakuṇḍalahārādyairbhūṣitāḥ sūryavarcasaḥ | surā devyo’bhavan sarve ṣoḍaśādipravatsarāḥ ||68|| kṛtāñjalayaḥ śrīkṛṣṇamastuvan bhāvagarbhitam | aho vayaṃ purā kṛṣṇa vyāpārārthaṃ vaṇigjanāḥ ||69|| yuddhapurāt thararaṇe nirgatāḥ śarkarāpuram | strībālasahitāḥ kṛṣṇa uṣṭramahoṣṭravāhanāḥ ||4.80.70|| raṇamadhye gatā yāvajjhaṃjhāvāto’tiduḥsahaḥ | protpanno vālukāvṛṣṭivaho madhyāhnanāśanaḥ ||7 1|| uṣṭrā mahoṣṭrā bālāśca nāryaḥ kṣitau hi vāyubhiḥ | vālukāsu muhūrtena garbhasthā abhavanmṛtāḥ ||72|| vayaṃ ye balinaścāpi vālukāvṛṣṭitāḍitāḥ | upaviṣṭā vālukādhastatra channā hi vālubhiḥ ||73|| vālukānāmucchrayā vai jātā vayaṃ tadantare | mṛtā garbhagatā sarve piśācatā raṇe gatāḥ ||74|| yuddhapurābhyāśasīmapradeśeṣu nirantaram | sahasrasaṃkhyakāḥ kṛṣṇa abhavāma raṇālayāḥ ||75|| adya jñātvā sarvamedhayajñasyāvabhṛthotsavam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapādajalāmṛtam ||76|| pātumupāgatāścātra pītvā snātvā padāmṛtam | pāvanāḥ sma ca sañjātāḥ piśācatvavivarjitāḥ ||77|| snānena puṇyalābhena devānāṃ yogyatānvitāḥ | adya jātā vayaṃ kṛṣṇa tathāpi surabhāvanām ||78|| necchāmahe yataḥ kṛṣṇa punarāvartanātmikām | apunarāvṛttibhāvaṃ kāṃkṣāmahe tu sarvathā ||79|| parameśo bhavānatra sākṣād dṛṣṭo’dhunā prabhuḥ | pītaṃ pādajalaṃ te’tra snātaṃ prasādavāribhiḥ ||4.80.80|| tadvayaṃ paramaṃ mokṣaṃ kāṃkṣāmahe tavāśritāḥ | śāśvataṃ brahmanirvāṇaṃ prāpayāsmān kṛpāṃ kuru ||8 1 || śrutvaivaṃ bhagavān badri kare dhṛtvā jalaṃ punaḥ | nijamantraṃ cārpaṇātmātmakamuccārya tatra ca |||82|| saṃkalpaṃ saṃprayojyaivākṣipad vāri suropari | sarve surā drutaṃ muktā abhavan divyavigrahāḥ ||83|| vaikuṇṭhapārṣadāḥ sarve tato’kṣarasya pārṣadāḥ | divyā bhūtvā hariṃ natvā jayamuccārya cāsakṛt ||84|| āgatena vimānena yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ | paśyatāṃ lunikānadyāstaṭe vai lakṣadehinām ||||85||| yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ sarve piśācā muktatānvitāḥ | athāścaryaparā lokāḥ kṣaṇaṃ stabdhā ivābhavan ||86|| jñātavantaḥ pratāpaṃ śrīharermānavadehinaḥ | kṛtvaivaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ snātvāvabhṛthānte nṛpādayaḥ ||87|| sākaṃ śrīhariṇā naijālayān yayurmudānvitāḥ | cakruste vaiṣṇavāḥ sarve devā devyaśca sādhavaḥ ||88|| bhojanāni mahīmānāḥ prajā āgantukā janāḥ | prāpya prasādaṃ kṛtino’bhavan puṇyātiśālinaḥ ||89|| rātrau viśrāntimāpuśca rājā rājñī hariṃ mudā | seṣevāte bālakṛṣṇaṃ vallabhāryaṃ susatpatim || 4.80.90|| pādasaṃvāhanādyaiścātha prage pratipaddine | jajāgara hariḥ snātaḥ kṛtapūjana īśitā ||91 || vyarājatāsane divye sauvarṇe nṛpadarśite | pūjāṃ kartuṃ harestatrāyayuryuddhapurāśritāḥ ||92|| upadāḥ śrīhareragre nyasya candanakuṃkumaiḥ | akṣataiḥ kusumairmālyaiharibhūṣāmbarādibhiḥ || 93|| anādyairārcayan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatiṃ patim | āśīrvādān jagṛhuste pūjakā vaiṣṇavā janāḥ ||94|| rājā vidāyaṃ pradadau mahīmānān samantataḥ | āyayuste nijadeśān vai kṛtārthanā mudānvitāḥ ||95|| madhvaraṃ praśaṃsanto yayurānandasaṃbhṛtāḥ | yuddhapuraprajāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ siṣevire gṛhe gṛhe ||96|| otvā svasvālayānnāryo narā ānandamāpnuvan | mantraṃ jagṛhurbahavo bhaktāḥ kṛṣṇasya vaiṣṇavāḥ ||97|| abhavan yuddhapurīyaprajājanā viśeṣataḥ | rirdinatrayaṃ tatrovāsa rājñyāgraheṇa tu || 98|| caturthyāṃ śrīharirgantuṃ sajjo’bhavannijālayam | tāvat yuddhapure badri sainyaṃ śatrorupāgatam ||99|| nāmato nandibhillasya yamunātaṭabhūpateḥ | dūtaṃ sā praiṣayattūrṇaṃ raṇārthaṃ nandibhillakaḥ || 4.80.100 || yuddhaṃ dehi ca vā rājyaṃ dehi vā karado bhava | ityuvāca hi dūto’pi natvā tu nāgavikramam || 101 || dūtaṃ satkṛtya rājāpi kṛṣṇaṃ nyavedayattu tat | kṛṣṇo jñātvā madaṃ nandibhillasyājñāpayad raṇam || 102|| badrike yuddhanagare yuddhavārtā sthale sthale | prāsarad bhayadā sarvadehināṃ tiṣṭhati prabhau || 103 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne yuddhapattanasya nāgavikramasya nṛpasya sarvamedhayajñaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sampādayāmāsetyādinirūpaṇanāmāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 80 ||
<4.81> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kṣātradharmo hi durjayaḥ | sati rājye’pi rāṣṭrānyat vāñchanti mugdhabhūmipāḥ || 1 || tṛṣṇātanturgale yasya pāśarūpaḥ pravartate | satsu sarveṣu bhogyeṣu mṛtyumukho sa gacchati || 2 || na sampatsukhamṛcchanti tṛṣṇāndhīkṛtabuddhayaḥ | nātmakalyāṇamicchanti rāgadveṣābhivartinaḥ || 3 || rājāpi parabhogecchuḥ paradravyādilālasaḥ | jāra eva hi prokto’sau jāratvaṃ parabhoktṛtā || 4 || kṛṣṇe trailokyanāthe ca prāpte śrīparameśvare | yeṣāṃ tṛṣṇā na śāntā cet ta eva gokharāstviha || 5 || sati jñāne na vai yasyendriyāṇāṃ śāntatā sa tu | vānaro narabhāve’pi paśuryāmyagṛhārhaṇaḥ || 6 || kṛṣṇaḥ sampūjito yena gṛhe mūrtiśca rakṣitā | hṛdaye pūjito naiva rakṣitā na sa rākṣasaḥ || 7 || nandibhillo nṛpo badri kathāyāḥ samaye purā | pupūja śrīhariṃ nītvā vimānena svamandire || 8 || sa eva bhagavānnatra rājate gururacyutaḥ | nāgavikramayajñe vai nandibhillāgururhi saḥ || 9 || śrutvā kīrtiṃ tu yajñasya nāgavikramabhūpateḥ | nandibhillo’sahamāno jñātvāpi gurumāsthitam || 4.81.10 || yuddhapure sthitaṃ cāpi jñātvā yuddhārthamāyayau | so’yaṃ moho vināśārtho nandibhillasya viddhi ha || 11 || yatra śrībhagavānāste taṃ yoddhuṃ yadupāyayau | yatrāste bhagavān sākṣāttasyaiva vijayo dhruvaḥ || 12|| jānannapi nandibhillo yamunābhūpatirbalī | lakṣayoddhṛgaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ yuddhārthaṃ yadupāyayau || 13|| dūtaṃ darduraratnākhyaṃ preṣayāmāsa mohataḥ | nāgavikramabhūpaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇānvitam || 14|| praṇamyāgatya rājānaṃ natvā śrīpuruṣottamam | svasvāmyuktaṃ samastaṃ vai prāha garvabharaṃ vacaḥ || 15|| gagāyamunāsindhūnāṃ madhye samrāḍ bhavāmyaham | anye me karadāḥ sarve bhavān bhavati me tathā || 1 6|| tasmāt karadaḥ khaṇḍeśaḥ karaṃ dadātu me drutam | no ced yuddhaṃ pradadātu nandibhillasya me nṛpa || 17|| nāndibhillīṃ rājadhānīṃ sarvarājyātivartinīm | gṛhṇātu yuddhamūlyena mā ciraṃ karado’sti me || 18|| mayā kṛpālunā nādyāvadhiḥ karaḥ smṛto yataḥ | alpakīrtiḥ kṣudrarājyo bhavānāste vicārya tat| || 1 9|| kintvadya makhamāsādya vartate mūrdhni rohitum | pādatrāṇaṃ kathaṃ mūrdhni tiṣṭheta karado’sti yaḥ ||4.81.20|| yuddhe yuddhapuraṃ datvā yadvā me kiṃkaro’stu ca | eṣo’haṃ sannidhāvasmi yuddhapurasya sīmasu ||21 || anirdeśyavimānāḍhyaścānirdeśyagajānvitaḥ | uṣṭrāśvāśvatarāsaṃkhyamānavasainyasaṃyutaḥ || 22|| śīghraṃ karotu vai prāṇaglahaṃ tvagre hyupasthitam | yadvā prasādamāsādya karotu rājyamuttamam || 23|| ityevaṃ mama nṛpatirbhavate vai yaśasvine | āvedayati dūto’haṃ kathayāmi yathoditam ||24|| ityuktvā badrike dūto virarāma nanāma ca | kṛtādaro niṣasāda siṣeve puruṣottamam ||25|| nandivallimahāsainyaṃ lakṣamānavasaṃkulam | lunīnadyāstaṭe badri cāsīt sannaddhamutsukam ||26|| vimānaśatasaṃyuktaṃ sahasragajaśobhanam | pañcasāhasroṣṭrayuktaṃ daśasāhasravājiyuk ||27|| tathā viṃśatisāhasramahāśvataraśobhanam | tathā viṃśatisāhasravṛṣabhādisamanvitam ||28|| pañcasāhasrarathayuke sarvaśastrārthapūritam | nīyamānaṃ sainyapena nāmnā mayūravāhinā || 29|| etādṛśaṃ mahāsainyaṃ guptacāreṇa vai drutam | jñātvā yuddhapurādhīśo nārāyaṇamupāyayau ||4.81.3 0|| dūtaṃ niṣkāsya dūraṃ vai nyavedayad vipatkṣaṇam | haristasmai vijayāya mahāśīrvādamairayat ||3 1 || yuddhaṃ dehi jayaṃ dhehi prāpnuhi rājyamuttamam | atra tiṣṭhāmi rājendra tava rakṣārthamanvaham |||32|| garviṣṭhānāṃ mahāgarvahartāhaṃ bhaktarakṣakaḥ | pratīpānāṃ nāśakartā bhavāmi bhaktavatsalaḥ ||33|| ityukto badrike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena vai tadā | nāgavikramabhūpaśca tuṣṭo’bhavaddhradantare ||34|| dūtamāhūya prāhetthaṃ nivedaya nṛpāya te | yuddhārthaṃ vai samāyāti nāgavikramabhūpatiḥ ||35|| karado bhava me rājannadyato nandibhillarāṭ | yāhi prayāmi pṛṣṭhe’haṃ sasainyo vai yathābalam |||36|| ityuktaḥ sa tu dūto’pi natvā labdhvā vaco drutam | yayau taṃ nandibhillaṃ vai jagāda tad yathātatham ||37|| sainyaṃ sajjaṃ drutaṃ śrutvā nandibhillo hi sainyapam | indravajrābhidhamājñāpayāmāsa raṇāya vai |||38||| badrike vijñalokānāṃ vijñānaṃ layametyapi | bubhukṣitānāṃ lubdhānāṃ satṛṣṇānāṃ ca kāminām || 39|| garviṣṭhānāṃ mānināṃ ca matsariṇāṃ khalātmanām | kālāvṛtaśikhānāṃ ca durbhāgyānāṃ ca pāpinām || 4.81.40|| samprāptanidhanānāṃ ca nimnabhāgyavatāṃ tathā | śaptānāṃ hiṃsakānāṃ ca kruddhānāṃ dhīrvinaśyati ||41 || viveko līyate badri yuddhadurmadināṃ raṇe | madyapānāṃ yathā bhānaṃ līyate raṇināṃ tathā ||42|| sainyaṃ sajjamabhavacca nandibhillasya sarvathā | caturaṃgaṃ balaṃ sarvaṃ pratyaikṣata ninādanam ||43|| abhavam̐śca tadā sainye cāpaśakunakāni vai | indravajradhvajo mukhyo nyapatad gajapṛṣṭhataḥ ||44|| senāpatiśirastrāṇaṃ nyapatat svakareṇa vai | vāmāṃgāni sphuraṇāni hasticitkāragarjanāḥ ||45|| heṣāśca vājināṃ karṇakaṭhorāstu tadābhavan | vāyurvavau sanmukho’tivegavān dhūlikā vahan ||46|| durdinaṃ cāmbare tasya sainyopari vyadṛśyata | vāhanāni sakampāni vyavartanta svabhāvataḥ ||47|| bhagnamanaskā yoddhāraḥ samajāyanta vai manāk | kākā ghūkāḥ kapotāśca śyenā gṛdhrāḥ patanti ca ||48|| dhvajāgre’mbālikāgre ca rathāgre yoddhṛmastake | gomāyavo rudantyagre pādaskhalanakānyapi ||49|| śastrapātaśca tatkośāt prajāyate muhurmuhuḥ | nandibhillasya vai svapnaṃ kṣaṇanidrāmayaṃ hyabhūt ||4.81.50|| tatra kāṣṭhacayaṃ śuṣkaṃ rathabhaṃgaṃ dadarśa saḥ | veśyāstanyaṃ papau rājā yantrasphoṭamakālikam ||51|| śuśrāva tatra nidrāyāmucchiṣṭabhojanaṃ vyadhāt | śatruvraje svapatanaṃ jalapūre prapātanam ||52|| vanadāhaṃ ca tanmadhye dahanaṃ svaṃ dadarśa ha | mithaḥ sainyasya yuddhaṃ ca svasyaiva vai parasparam ||53|| nagnaṃ svasya svarūpaṃ ca dakṣiṇābhigamaṃ tathā | mastake cārmaṇopānaddhāraṇaṃ sa dadarśa ha |||54||| raktavastrastriyāśliṣṭaṃ vyapaśyannandibhillakaḥ | uraḥpīṭanaṃ kurvantyā padā tāḍitamityapi ||55||| dhūtvā svasya śavaṃ rājā śmaśāne’rdhaniśottare | yayau tatra mahājīrṇaṃ saudhadevālayādikam |||56|| khaṇḍitaṃ patitaṃ cāpi vyalokayad bhayaṃkaram | kākā nipetuḥ śirasi śataṃ tu rājamastake ||57|| vetraṃ hastāttu patitaṃ skhalitaṃ vetradhāriṇaḥ | pradhānaḥ patitaḥ svapne pādaskhalanadoṣataḥ ||58|| paritaścāpi mārgāṇāṃ nirodhaḥ śatrubhiḥ kṛtaḥ | rorūyamāṇā rājñī cetyevaṃ svapne vyalokayat ||59|| nāmnādilāvarīdevī yannāmnā nagarī hyabhūn | dilāvarītinagarī yamunātaṭamāsthitā ||4.81.60 || nandibhillītināmnī vai sabhā yatrābhavat parā | svarṇasphāṭikavaidūryahīrakādivinirmitā ||61 || sāpi patita rājñā vai dṛṣṭā pāṣāṇasañcayā | nagarī sainyavad yāti paścimāṃ diśamityapi ||62|| vyaloki tena rājñā ca rājñyā vaidhavyamityapi | keśānāṃ muṇḍanaṃ rājñyā vyaloki nijamastake || 63|| śmaśānaṃ vikarālāścādṛśyanta yāmyadūtakāḥ | rājñyāḥ keśānapi dhṛtvākuñcane balibhiḥ kṛtam ||64|| kṛṣṇavarṇaistu puruṣairdharṣiteti nṛpapriyā | svapne svāṃ duḥkhasampannāṃ vyalokayattiraskṛtām ||65|| dāsībhirdāsavargaiśca tarjitāṃ cāvamānitām | tathā vyalokayad rājñī rūpavatyo hi kanyakāḥ ||66|| api tejovihīnāśca malināsyāḥ śucānvitāḥ | saudhaṃ tyaktvā gamyamānā araṇyaṃ prati vai tadā ||67|| badrike kṣaṇamātreṇa vīkṣya rājā bubodha ha | sarvamaniṣṭaṃ naijaṃ vai tathāpi na nyavartata ||68|| rājñī śaṃkarapūjāṃ sā cakre vighnajayāya vai | bāṇācchuśrāva sā rājñī hṛtabhāgyo nṛpastava ||69|| mā khedaṃ kuru kalyāṇi jayo yatra hariḥ svayam | rājā kṛtāparādho’sau phalameṣyati vai drutam ||4.81.70|| yatrāste bhagavān sākṣāt tatra yoddhaṃ gato yataḥ | nijadoṣahato rājā madāndho naiva paśyati ||7 1|| ityuktvā śaṃkaro liṅge virarāma dilāvarīm | dilāvarī tu vai mūrcchāṃ prajagāma tadā kṣaṇe |||72||| nirāśā sābhavanmṛtyumahīmāneva rogiṇī | badrike tu tadā kāle nāgavikramabhūpateḥ ||73|| śakunānyabhavan sarvajayapradāni sarvataḥ | āśīrvādaparā viprā āyayustilakānvitāḥ ||74|| pradakṣiṇo’bhavadvahniḥ prasanno dhūmavarjitaḥ | śveto vai devavṛṣabho’dṛśyata gosamanvitaḥ ||75|| kanyakāḥ svarṇaratnāḍhyā bhūṣāmbaradharāstathā | adṛśyanta prasannāsyā nāgavikramabhūpatim ||76|| kokilāḥ sārasā haṃsāḥ śukāśca garuḍāḥ khagāḥ | khe tvāgatya punaryānti dakṣiṇaṃ vijayapradā ||77|| ratnābharaṇabhūṣāḍhyā nartakī vārakāṃganā | adṛśyata nisargādvai svarṇaghaṭasamanvitā ||78|| vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavo divyāḥ śikhāsūtrasamanvitāḥ | sabindutilakāḍhyāścādṛśyantāpyabhisanmukhāḥ ||79|| ghaṇṭānādo’bhavattatra devanaivedyabodhanaḥ | dakṣāṃgānāṃ sphuraṇāni tadābhavannṛpasya vai ||4.81.80|| kṣaṇasvapne vimāne svaṃ dadarśa devapūjitam | tataḥ kṣaṇe gaje svarṇāmbālikāyāṃ sthitaṃ nijam ||81 || divyayā kanyayā padmahāreṇa kṛtapūjanam | dadarśa bahukanyābhiḥ sevitaṃ śayanottame |||82|| pitṛbhistuṣṭahṛdayaiḥ prasannāsyaiḥ pravardhitam | mahotsavairmahāśṛṃgārakaiḥ saṃśobhitālaye |||83|| divyasiṃhāsanasthaṃ svaṃ dadarśa parivāritam | kṣīrabhojanatṛptiṃ ca kamalasya dale kṛtām ||84|| anvabhavat kṣaṇasvapne dīrghatṛptiṃ jale sthitaḥ | evaṃ rājñaḥ śakunāni samabhavan jayāya vai ||85||| rājñyāstasyābhavat svapne mahendrāṇīva darśanam | mahāyajñotsave svāṃ sā dadarśa cakravartinīm ||86|| lakṣmyā śriyā pāśavatyā prabhayāśliṣya vakṣasi | dhṛtāṃ divyapadmahāraircitāṃ hṛdi yojitām ||87|| sapakṣadhavalābhaiśca hastibhirvāhite nijām | vimāne tvambare patyā sākaṃ sthitāṃ dadarśa sā ||88 || sainyānāmapi yoddhṝṇāṃ śakunāni śubhāni vai | nāgavikramarājñaścābhavan jayapradāni hi ||89|| asphuran sarvasainyānāṃ dakṣāṃgāni samantataḥ | nandakūbarasenānīyojitānāṃ tadā kṣaṇe ||4.81.90|| senāyāṃ yuddhanādārthā bheryavādyata vai svayam | pavanaḥ sānukūlaśca pṛṣṭhabhāgād vavau tadā ||9 1|| balaṃ sotsāhamevābhūttaṭā vai nāgavaikramam | sarvaṃ viṃśatisāhasraṃ yuddhārthaṃ yojitaṃ kṣaṇāt |||92|| lunīnadyāstaṭe sarvamupasthitaṃ kṣaṇāddhyabhūt | yuddhapuraṃ prasaṃrakṣya mahārdhacandrasadṛśam ||92 || badrike hi tadā rājñī nāgavikramabhāminī | āyayau śrīkṛṣṇapūjārthaṃ drutaṃ tvarkamālinī ||94|| prapūjya paramātmānaṃ yuddhavārtāṃ samākarot | sabhayāṃ nirbhayā cāpi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāntike || 95|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāminārāyaṇa narāyaṇa | bālakṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa ramāyaṇa ||96|| tava bhaktāsmi deveśa kāṃkṣaye naiva māyikam | kintu kṛṣṇa striyā iṣṭamavaidhavyaṃ sudhārmikam |||97||| prabhāyā iva me cāstu tadiṣṭaṃ me prapālaya | rājyaṃ tavedaṃ sarvaṃ vai sanāthāhaṃ tvadarpitā ||98|| yatheṣṭaṃ kuru kṛṣṇātra prāpte śatrubhaye prabho | ityuktvā badrike kṛṣṇapādayoḥ patitā hi sā ||99|| kṛṣṇastasya dadau tūrṇaṃ dānamabhayasaṃjñakam | adarśayannije rūpe mahākālaṃ bhayaṃkaram || 4.81.10 0|| śatrusainyāni sarvāṇi bhakṣayantaṃ tvarāyutam | jīvayantaṃ rakṣayantaṃ nijasainyāni yāni ca || 101 || tataḥ saumyaṃ kṛṣṇarūpaṃ viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim | adarśayannije rūpe saumyaṃ sāmrājyadaṃ prabhum || 1 02|| aṃke kṛtvā patiṃ naijaṃ hasantaṃ pārvatīpatim | tirobhūya tato naijaṃ mānavaṃ rūpamuttamam || 1 03|| adarśayaddharistasyai sā santuṣṭābhavattataḥ | badrike śrīharistūrṇaṃ yuddhārthaṃ tvarito’bhavat || 1 04|| sajjo bhūtvā rathe sthitvā śvetāśvaparivāhite | sarvaśastrāstrasaṃvijño raṇāgre saṃsthito’bhavat || 1 05|| nāgavikramabhūpo’pi raṇāgre rathamadhyagaḥ | saṃsthitaḥ sarvaśastrāḍhyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇātmanivedavān || 1 06|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne dilāvarīnagaryā nandibhillanṛpasainyasya nāgavikramṃ jetumāgamanaṃ, nāgavikramasya sasainyasya yuddhārthaṃ tatpratiniryāṇaṃ, śakunāpaśakunasvapnādīni cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||81||
<4.82> śrībadrīpriyovācanāgavikramasainyānāṃ kativājigajādayaḥ | kīdṛśaṃ ca tato yuddhaṃ kṛṣṇasya vada me prabho || 1 || śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi sahasrāṇi tu viṃśatiḥ | nāgavikramasainyasyāsan yoddhārastu mānavāḥ || 2 || sahasraṃ hastināṃ tatra pañcasāhasravājinaḥ | uṣṭrāstrīṇi sahasrāṇi vimānāni tu viṃśatiḥ || 3 || aśvatarāstathā pañcasahasrāṇyabhavan mṛdhe | sarve kṛṣṇapratāpāste kṛṣṇadattabalādhikāḥ || 4 || mahārathinaḥ prabalāḥ sarvarathina ityapi | vajradehāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāveśāttadābhavan || 5 | | sainyayorubhayostatra sākṣān gocaratābhavat | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya śāśvataṃ ratham || 6 || raṇāgre vīkṣya sahasā nandibhillaṃ tu tadguruḥ | agnirātaṛṣiḥ sarvaśastrāstrakuśalo’pi san || 7 || sandihya vijaye śiṣyaṃ samuvāca hitāvaham | sarvasṛṣṭimayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nandibhilla vilokaya || 8 || yoddhukāmaḥ puraścāste pratisainye janārdanaḥ | yatsaṃkalpe jagat sarvaṃ jāyate līyate’pi ca || 9 || so’yaṃ śastradharaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sainyāgre tvabhitiṣṭhati | tasya pārśve jayaścāste tathāste vijayo’pi ca || 4.82.10 || mā vṛthā tvaṃ prayāsaṃ vai vidhehi vijayecchayā | nārāyaṇasya jetā na na taṃ jeṣyati kaścana || 11 || rājan rājyaṃ vipulaṃ te kathaṃ kṣipasi bhasmani | bhuṃkṣva bhogān vihāyaiva matsaraṃ yuddhabhūbhṛtā || 12|| tvamāsse nāgarājyādvai śreṣṭho daśaguṇo’dhikaḥ | mahatāṃ jāyate hānirnīcaiḥ saha tu dharṣaṇam || 1 3|| nīcasya vijaye kīrtiḥ śatadhā jāyate drutam | mahatāṃ vijaye saiva yathā sāsti tathaiva sā || 14|| svarūpasya na mānasya hāniḥ parājaye’dhikā | vicāryetthaṃ vihāyaiva yuddhaṃ bhuṃkṣva kṣitiṃ nijām || 15|| na bhāti me vijayo’dya tavāpaśakunādibhiḥ | madvākyaṃ kuru rājendra mā juhudhyanale prajāḥ || 16|| sukhaṃ rājyaṃ sampadaśca mā juhudhyanale vidan | gurorvākyaṃ sukhadaṃ vai laṃghane tasya cāpadaḥ || 17|| ehyāgaccha praṇamyainaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ bhaktibhāvataḥ | āśīrvādān śubhān prāpya kṛtakṛtyaḥ sukhī bhava || 18|| gurvagre mānahānirna kṛṣṇāgre sutarāṃ tu na | sarvanāśābhisamprāptau tyaktvā kiñcit prarakṣayet || 19|| yuvāṃ śiṣyau samau tasya vinītau bhavatāṃ yadi | dvayoḥ śreyovidhātā syāt kṛṣṇo dayāparaḥ prabhuḥ ||4.82.20|| mānaṃ rakṣyaṃ samānāgre nādhikāgre kadācana | tatrāpi gurudevāgre mānaṃ rakṣyaṃ na sarvathā ||21||| pūrveṣāṃ pūrvapūrveṣāṃ guruḥ śāstā hi mādhavaḥ | gurvagre manasā vācā karmaṇārpyaṃ nijaṃ vapuḥ ||22|| samastaṃ cārpaṇīyaṃ vai gurvagre sarvasiddhaye | mātā guruḥ pitā vṛddho gururjñānaprado guruḥ ||23|| hitakṛddhitadaścāpi gururmohavināśakaḥ | trikālajño guruścāpi daṇḍado’pi gururmataḥ ||24|| śāstāro guravaḥ sarve aihikāmutrarakṣakāḥ | bahuśrutānāṃ mantavyaṃ gurūṇāṃ vākyamaiśvaram ||25|| trisandhyaṃ khalu kartavyā guroḥ pūjā hitecchunā | yo guruḥ sa hariḥ prokto yo hariḥ sa gururmataḥ |||26 || yathā haristathā śarvo yathā śarvastathā guruḥ | haravidyā harervidyā gurorvidyā hi mokṣadā ||27|| sarvadevamayaḥ sarvaśaktimayo gururyataḥ | saguṇo nirguṇo vāpi tasyājñāṃ pālayet sadā || 28|| śreyorthī yastu gurvājñāṃ manasāpi na laṃghayet | gacchestiṣṭhan svapan bhuñjan gāyan yadyat samācaran || 29|| samakṣaṃ vā parokṣaṃ vā sa labhetātmasampadaḥ | gurordevasya sānnidhye na yatheṣṭāsano bhavet ||4.82.3 0|| gururdevo yataḥ sākṣāt tadgṛhaṃ devamandiram | guroḥ prasevayā bhaktyā taddharmaphalabhāg bhavet ||3 1|| yathaivānalasaṃsargānmalaṃ tyajati kāñcanam | tathaiva gurusamparkātpāpaṃ tyajati sevakaḥ ||32|| yathā vahnisamīpastho ghṛtakumbho vilīyate | tathā pāpaṃ vilīyeta gurordevasya sannidhau ||33|| yathā prajvalito vahniḥ kaccarādi vinirdahet | guruḥ prasevitastadvatpāpaṃ dahati sarvathā ||34|| brahmā hariśca śaṃbhuśca devā devyo maharṣayaḥ | kurvantyanugrahaṃ tuṣṭā gurau tuṣṭe sukhapradāḥ ||35|| karmaṇā manasā vācā guroḥ krodhaṃ na kārayet | tasya krodhena dahyanti puṇyāyurjñānaśrīkriyāḥ ||36|| guroḥ krodhaprakartṝṇāṃ kṛtā yajñā hi niṣphalāḥ | niṣphalāḥ sampadaḥ sarvā niṣphalā niyamā yamāḥ ||37|| gurorvirodhakṛdvākyaṃ vadennaiva kadācana | vadeccenmūrkhatāyogād rauravaṃ sa vrajed dhruvam ||38|| hṛdā cittena vittena vācā dehena karmaṇā | parokṣaṃ vā samakṣaṃ vā mithyā na kārayed guroḥ ||39|| durguṇe sthāpite tasya daurguṇyaśatabhāg bhavet | sadguṇe sthāpite tasya sarvasādguṇyabhāg bhavet ||4.82.40|| gurorhitaṃ priyaṃ kuryādādiṣṭo vā na vā sadā | asamakṣaṃ samakṣaṃ vā guroḥ kāryaṃ samācaret ||41|| gurorhitaṃ priyaṃ kuryānmanovākkāyakarmabhiḥ | adhaḥ patannapi rājan hitaṃ kuryāt sa vardhate ||42|| gururnārāyaṇakṛṣṇastvayā rājannijālaye | pūjito vanditaḥ so’yaṃ saṅgare’bhyadhisaṅgataḥ ||43|| ahaṃ rājan guruste’smi vipro rājyaguruḥ sadā | matvā me śobhanaṃ vākyaṃ nivartasva raṇāṃgaṇāt ||44|| mā vaidhavyaṃ dilāvaryā rājñyā puryāśca mantraya | nandibhillyāḥ sabhāyā mā nūtneśatvaṃ ca mantraya ||45|| mā roṣaṃ kuru rājendra satyaṃ te nigadāmyaham | mā svahaste sthitaṃ rāṣṭraṃ parahaste nipātaya ||46|| śūrāṇāṃ mā vināśaṃ vai śūratarairvidhāpaya | yoddhavyaṃ māyayā sākaṃ māyāvinā samaṃ tathā ||47|| tathāpi naiva kṛṣṇena yoddhavyaṃ paramātmanā | yatra sarvaṃ yataḥ sarvaṃ yaḥ sarvātmā virājate ||48|| yaṃ sarvaḥ sevate śryarthaṃ taṃ kathaṃ yodhayed raṇe | sevanīyo vijayārthaṃ toṣaṇīyaḥ pramuktaye ||49|| prasādanīyaḥ kṣeyo’rthaṃ prastotavyaḥ praśāntaye | labdhavyaḥ śaraṇaṃ gatvā taṃ kathaṃ yodhayed budhaḥ ||4.82.5 0|| pṛthvī hasati rājam̐stvāṃ yamunājalaphenakaiḥ | sasyapuṣpamayairhāsyaiḥ pṛtanāśastrajaiḥ karaiḥ ||51 || lūnīvāripravāhotthanādaphenabakādibhiḥ | nimantrayati mṛtyuṃ yannandibhillo dilāpatiḥ ||52|| rājan kāle yathāyogyaṃ mayoktamauṣadhaprabham | svatantro’si nije kārye yathāyogyaṃ samācara ||53|| ityuktvā taṃ guruścāgnirātarṣirnandibhillakam | badrike svasti svastyastu vyājahāra punaḥ punaḥ ||54|| pratyuttaraṃ guruṃ natvā nandibhillo dadau tataḥ | dhṛtamūrddhā dhṛtakeśo mahākālena mṛtyunā ||55|| jānāmyahaṃ samastaṃ tad guro bhavatā noditam | sarvaṃ tat sādhubhāve’sti rājyavāde na yujyate ||56|| gururvā janako vāpi bhrātā suhṛt suto’pi vā | saṅgare pratisampannaḥ sa yoddhavyo nṛpeṇa ha ||57|| tṛptistu yatisādhūnāṃ svalpe bhavati yoginām | rājñāṃ tṛptiḥ pṛthivyāśced rājadharmaḥ kamāśrayet | |58|| jayaśca vijayaścaitau sāmarthyabalakiṃkarau | naikāntakṛṣṇapārśvasthau sarvagau hi matau mama ||59|| nārāyaṇaḥ sadā jayyaḥ sarvairiva mumukṣubhiḥ | svārthibhaktā jayantyeva nārāyaṇaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ||4.82.60|| agnirnārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāttasmin homo’pi mokṣadaḥ | nārāyaṇena mahatā nīcasya yodhane mama ||61 || kīrtirvā bahulā syānme mokṣago vā bhavāmyaham | na me hāniḥ kṛṣṇahastahatasya mama kācana |||62|| sukhaṃ rājyaṃ sampadaśca vahnau juhvati mokṣiṇaḥ | kṛṣṇe juhomi tatsarvaṃ vṛthā homo na me guro ||63|| gurorvākye hitaṃ loke jīvanaṃ cirameva yat | avākye yodhanaṃ kṛṣṇe vāsaśca śāśvate pade ||64| dehapṛthivīnāśe’pi lapsye lābhaṃ tu śāśvatam | nirṇītaṃ tu mayā kṛṣṇe sarvārpaṇaṃ tu bhāvataḥ |||65|| aihikāmutrasiddhirme kṛṣṇayogād bhaviṣyati | nṛpadharmaiḥ pūjayiṣye raṇāṃgaṇe hariṃ prabhum ||66|| kālahastena mṛtyostu kṛṣṇahastādvaro hi saḥ | guroḥ sevāṃ raṇayogyāṃ kariṣye pādayoḥ patan ||67|| kariṣye vā harermūrdhni śastrapuṣpākṣatārpaṇam | tyakṣye malaṃ hareḥ śastrānalasaṅgād dṛḍhaṃ drutam ||68|| yadi tuṣṭo bhavet kṛṣṇo mayi śastranipātanaiḥ | tadā me pitarastuṣṭāstuṣṭāḥ surā maharṣayaḥ ||60 || gurau nārāyaṇe kṛṣṇe krodhadoṣo na vidyate | parokṣaṃ vā samakṣaṃ vā kariṣye nṛpadharmataḥ ||4.82.70|| guro prasanno bhagavān yanmāṃ yuddhe vilokitum | āgato’sti hariḥ sākṣāttato bhāgyaṃ kiyanmahat ||71 || gurvagre mūrkhaśiṣyo’pi taratyeva na saṃśayaḥ | parokṣaṃ vā samakṣaṃ vā kṣātraṃ mithyā na kārayet |||72|| kṣātradharmeṇa ganturme dilāvaryā anāthatā | bhāvinī naiva viprarṣe tato dharmo hato bhavet ||73|| karomi dharmasaṃgrāmaṃ saṃgrāme śatruvadguruḥ | āgaccheccharasandhānaiḥ pūjārhaḥ sa gurustadā ||74|| brahmā viṣṇurmaheśo vā mahāviṣṇurnarāyaṇaḥ | yamaḥ kālo mahākālaḥ purāṇapuruṣottamaḥ ||75|| yo vā ko vā samāgaccheccharapūjārha eva saḥ | dharme sthitasya vijayo na tvadharme sthitasya vai ||76|| yuddhaṃ rājñāṃ paro dharmo yuddhasthā vadhagocarāḥ | kṣātradharmāṇa evaite gurudharmāstadā na te ||77|| na pūjyadharmā na śiṣyadharmā na mitradharmiṇaḥ | na putradharmā na ca vā kuṭumbadharmiṇo’pi te ||78|| na svadharmāṇa evāpi paradharmiṇa eva te | sākaṃ taiḥ khalu yoddhavyaṃ kṣātradharmaḥ sa śāśvataḥ ||79|| yuddhe cet kṛṣṇahastena gamiṣyāmi parābhavam | kṛṣṇahaste vijayaḥ sa na vai sa nāgavikrame ||4.82.80 || kṛṣṇaṃ hitvā jayenmāṃ sa tadā manye parākramam | kṛṣṇayuktaṃ jagatsarvaṃ balavadbhāti me guro ||8 1 || sa dhātā ca vidhātā ca sa merurmedinī ca saḥ | sa jetā ca vijetā ca parābhāvayitā ca saḥ ||82|| sraṣṭā poṣṭā poṣayitā rakṣayitāvitāpi saḥ | taṃ śaraṇyaṃ ca kāruṇyapūrṇaṃ prāpya samakṣagam ||83|| atra vāpi paratrāpi jayaṃ lapsye na durjayam | dvayostu kāryayoḥ prāptau nirbalaṃ tatra bādhyate ||84|| gurorvākyaṃ nirbalaṃ vai kṛṣṇāptiryā balānvitā | kṛṣṇāptau puruṣārthāstu nivartante tadantimāḥ ||85|| grāmaṃ tyajet kulasyārthe svasyārthe tu kulaṃ tyajet | svaṃ tyajeccāpi gurvarthe kṛṣṇārthaṃ sakalaṃ tyajet ||86|| jānāti bhagavān māṃ ca jānāti nāgavikramam | nāgakramaḥ sakāmo’sti na me kāmo hariṃ vinā ||87|| hariryuddhaprasaṃgena niṣkāmaṃ samaneṣyati | sakāmaṃ niraye loke pratiṣṭhāpya prayāsyati ||88|| yathā vipro guruścāste tathā dharmo’pi sadguruḥ | dharmo vakti sadā yuddhaṃ kṣatrasya tvapalāyanam ||89|| ārabdhāt karmaṇaścet syāt paścapādo jano yadi | hāsyapātraṃ bhavatyeva dharmahantā sa eva ha ||4.82.90 || vicāryārambhaṇīyāni pāraṃ neyāni tāni vai | phalaṃ vā viphalaṃ vāpi sayatnadaivasātkṛtam ||9 1 || tasmād yotsye namaskṛtvā dhṛtvā hṛdambare harim | tava yogabalaṃ tatrākāṃkṣe’gnirāta sadguro |||92|| ityuktvā tūrṇamevāsau dadhmau śaṃkhaṃ mṛdhārthakam | tāvattūrṇamavādyanta raṇabheryaḥ pṛthak pṛthak ||93|| vigulāni samantācca paṭahānakagomukhāḥ | yoddhṛṇāṃ garjanā vyomavāṇyo yuddhābhidarśikāḥ ||94|| abhavan meghamārge’pi vimānānāṃ pragarjanāḥ | yuddhārthaṃ vijayārthaṃ ca gajānāṃ bṛṃhitāni ca ||95|| hreṣāśca vājināṃ tatra vṛṣāṇāṃ raṃbhaṇāni ca | uṣṭrāṇāṃ gāṃgaṇanāśca samantato’bhavan mṛdhe ||96|| mahākālastathā rudro yamo viśveśvaro haraḥ | ākāśe devatāstatra maharṣayaśca pārṣadāḥ ||97|| vyāpṛtaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ jñātvā samāyayuḥ | cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ naijam ājagatkalanaṃ dhanuḥ ||98|| dadhāra bhagavān śīghraṃ śaraṃ ca grasanāhvayam | nāgavikrama evāpi sarvāstrāṇi dadhāra ha ||99|| senānīrnandakubaro rathastho’gre sthito’bhavat | evaṃ ba nandibhillo’pi senāpendravrajo’pi ca || 4.82.10 0|| svasvarathau puraḥ kṛtvātiṣṭhatāṃ
