pāpanāśārthaṃ sugamaṃ yad vadasva nau || 4 || śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇutaṃ mādhavi sādhvi prajñe saṃsārimuktaye | pāpināṃ pāpanāśārthaṃ sādhanaṃ gopradānakam || 5 || gṛhāśramastu pāpāḍhyo godānaṃ pāpanāśakam | uddhārakaṃ yamadūtabhayāt saṃrakṣakaṃ sadā || 6 || pitruddhārakaraṃ svargapradaṃ vaṃśapradaṃ tathā | sampatpradaṃ hi godānaṃ mokṣadaṃ sadgatipradam || 7 || yena nānyat kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ kartavyaṃ gopradānakam | godānena prajāyante samagrā iṣṭasiddhayaḥ || 8 || godānaṃ pṛthivīdānaṃ pṛthivī gosvarūpiṇī | godānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇadānaṃ dhenuḥ kṛṣṇapriyā sadā || 9 || godānaṃ yajñapuṇyādipradaṃ gauryajñarūpiṇī | godānaṃ śrīramādānaṃ gaurhi lakṣmīsvarūpiṇī || 4.90.1 0|| godānaṃ tu sarvarasapradānaṃ dugdhadā hi gauḥ | gaurmātā sarvalokānāṃ payobhiḥ poṣaṇapradā || 1 1|| dātavyā sarvathā dāne dogdhrī vatsatarīyutā | gurave sā pradātavyā vaiṣṇavāya tu sādhave || 12|| viprāya sā pradātavyā makhine’tithisevine | aṅgane yajamānastu snātaḥ kṛtābhivandanaḥ || 1 3|| yāyād goṣṭhaṃ makhadvāraṃ devālayaṃ maṭhaṃ satām | tīrthaṃ yāyāt prakuryādvai śuddhyarthaṃ tīrthavāriṇā || 14|| ācamanatrayaṃ netre jalasparśaṃ tathācaret | hastapādau ālayecca dakṣe kare jalaṃ śubham || 15|| gṛhṇīyād deśakālādi puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ | gururdānasya saṃkalpaṃ kuryācca kārayettathā || 1 6|| jalaṃ bhūmau pramucyātha namaḥ kuryāt payasvatīm | savatsikāṃ mātaraṃ gāṃ punarjalaṃ kare nyaset || 17|| dharmārthakāmamokṣārthaṃ nijasambandhināṃ tathā | kuṭumbināṃ ca saukhyārthaṃ karomi gopradānakam || 18|| ityuktvā tajjalaṃ pṛthvyāṃ muñced varuṇasākṣikam | namaskuryācca gāṃ paścāt kare dhṛtvā tu kuṃkumam || 19|| yajamāno vadet sveṣṭasiddhyarthaṃ gosamīpataḥ | ārogyārthaṃ sampadarthaṃ putrapautrādisiddhaye |||4.90.20|| vaṃśavistārasaukhyārthaṃ saukhyārthaṃ yaśase tathā | tāpatrayavināśārthaṃ dharmārthaṃ mokṣahetave ||21 || sarvaśatruvināśārthaṃ nirvighnakāryasiddhaye | pretānāṃ mama muktyarthaṃ sarvapāpādiśāntaye || 22|| sarvakleśavināśārthaṃ puṇyārthaṃ goprapūjanam | dhenudānāṃgabhūtaṃ vai karomi kuṃkumādibhiḥ ||23|| binduṃ bhāle kuṃkumena karomi candanādibhiḥ | mama saubhāgyasiddhyarthaṃ karomi tilakaṃ tu goḥ || 24|| mama kuṭumbisaukhyārthaṃ pūjāṃ karomi cākṣataiḥ | mama puṇyasya lābhārthaṃ dīpaṃ dhūpaṃ karomi ca ||25|| mama sampatpravṛddhyarthaṃ gave bhakṣyaṃ dadāmi ca | mama svargasya siddhyarthaṃ gave vāri dadāmi ca ||26|| pitruddhārāya ca gave guḍaṃ miṣṭaṃ dadāmi ca | navasasyāni bījāni kārpāsasya dadāmi ca || 27|| vastraṃ prāvaraṇaṃ pṛṣṭhe dadāmi jhullarīṃ śubhām | mālyaṃ mālāṃ puṣpamālāṃ svarṇamālāṃ dadāmi ca || 28|| ambaraṃ ca vibhūṣāśca gave dadāmi śṛṅgayoḥ | svarṇaśṛṅge rūpyakhurāḥ khureṣu pradadāmi ca ||29|| dohanaṃ tāmrapātraṃ ca śṛṅkhalāṃ pradadāmi ca | suvarṇaghaṇṭikāyuktaṃ hāraṃ kaṇṭhe dadāmi ca || 4.90.30|| bhakṣyapātraṃ pānapātraṃ dohapātraṃ dadāmi ca | gavāṃ kharjananāśārthaṃ kharjakaṃ pradadāmi ca ||3 1 || devagurvoḥ pratuṣṭyarthaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ pradadāmi ca | gulālābīrakuṃkumākṣataiḥ prapūjayāmi gām ||32|| patraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaiścāpi tulasīpatrakaistathā | pūjayāmi prakaromi pradakṣiṇacatuṣṭayam || 33|| pṛthvīpradakṣiṇatulyaṃ cārthayāmi sukhāptaye | namo’stu brahmamūrtibhyo viśvamātṛbhya oṃnamaḥ ||34|| lokādhivāsinībhyaśca rohiṇībhyaśca vai namaḥ | gavāmaṅgeṣu tiṣṭhanti sarve devāstatheśvarāḥ ||35|| avatārāśca pitarastiṣṭhanti śrīramādikāḥ | golalāṭe gaṇeśo’sti gaṇeśaṃ praṇamāmyaham ||36|| gośṛṃgayostu goloko vaikuṇḍastau namāmyaham | gonetrayoḥ sūryacandrau vasatastau namāmyaham || 37|| vaiśvānaro’sti dhenvāsye vaiśvānaraṃ namāmyaham | godanteṣu grahāḥ sarve grahān sarvānnamāmyaham ||38|| gonasoraśvinīputrau kumārau tau namāmyaham | gavoṣṭhayornāradastumburustau praṇamāmyaham ||39|| gokarṇayornaranārāyaṇau tau praṇamāmyaham | gojivhāyāṃ śāradāsti śāradāṃ praṇamāmyaham ||4.90.40|| gokaṇṭhe praṇavaścāsti oṃkāraṃ praṇamāmyaham | brahmā gale kambale tu sāvitrī tau namāmyaham ||41 || śaṃbhuḥ kakudi skandhe tu śivā tau praṇamāmyaham | viṣṇurhṛdaye lakṣmīśca śakṛti tau namāmyaham ||42|| mūtre gaṅgā yamunā ca sarasvatī namāmi tāḥ | pucche tu pitaraḥ santi pitṝn sarvānnamāmyaham ||43|| pṛṣṭhavaṃśe tu ṛṣayaḥ ṛṣīn sarvānnamāmyaham | pārśveṣu devatāḥ santi devatāstā namāmyaham ||44|| romasu sādhavaḥ siddhā vasanti tānnamāmyaham | pucche śeṣaśca viṣṇuḥ śrīstān sarvān praṇamāmyaham ||45|| pucchānte sarvatīrthāni tīrthāni praṇamāmyaham | udare lokapālāśca lokapālānnamāmyaham ||46|| oghasyamṛtasarvasvaṃ brahmāmṛtaṃ namāmyaham | staneṣu sāgarāḥ sarve rādhāputrānnamāmyaham ||47|| vakṣo’gre tu brahmahrado brahma tatpraṇamāmyaham | pādeṣu pārṣadā viṣṇostān sarvān praṇamāmyaham ||48|| khureṣu tu makhāḥ sarve tān yajñān praṇamāmyaham | goṣṭhaṃ brahmākṣaraṃ dhāma gosthalīṃ praṇamāmyaham ||49|| godhūlirjaṃgamaṃ tīrthaṃ dhūliṃ mūrdhni vahāmyaham | gotakraṃ goghṛtaṃ dhenukṣīraṃ gorasamityapi ||4.90.50|| gonavanītamevāpi brahmapīyūṣapañcakam | dāne dadāmi tatsarvaṃ tṛpyantāṃ pitaraḥ surāḥ ||51|| rohiṇyo dogdhrya īśvaryo mātaraḥ pāntu māṃ sadā | gāvo mamāgrataḥ santu gāvaḥ santu ca pṛṣṭhataḥ ||52|| gāvaḥ śirasi me nityaṃ gavāṃ madhye vasāmyaham | vatsatarī bhaktirūpā vatso dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||53|| kṛṣṇaśaṃbhupriyau pātāṃ māṃ sadā sakuṭumbakam | svargaṃ satyaṃ ca vairājaṃ bhaumaṃ vaikuṇṭhamuttamam ||54|| śrīpuraṃ cāmṛtaṃ cāvyākṛtaṃ golokamakṣaram | brahmadhāma ca me gāvo dadatveva ca sampadaḥ ||55|| tvaṃ devi sarvadevānāṃ vāsarūpāsi tāriṇī | kāmadhenusamastānāṃ pratimāyai ca te namaḥ ||56|| sarvakāmaprade mātargolokavāsini priye | pāpahe puṇyade mokṣaprade mātaśca te namaḥ ||57||| māmasmāt sāgarāllakṣmīrūpe tāraya sarvathā | sarvasampatprade kṛṣṇapriye tāraya sāgarāt ||58|| putrān pautrān putrikāśca dhanaṃ dhānyādi dehi me | aiśvaryāṇi ca dīrghāyurārogyaṃ sampradehi me ||59|| saubhāgyaṃ patisaubhāgyaṃ patnīsaubhāgyamityapi | dravyasaubhāgyamevāpi dehi me kāmapūrike ||4.90.60|| ityabhyarthya yajamāno gurorhaste dvijasya ca | jalaṃ dadyānmayā dattā gaurgṛhyatāṃ samuccaret ||61|| gave puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyānnamaskuryād gave sate | gurave cāpi viprāya sādhave pātrayogine ||62|| dhenuṃ dadyāt sugurave mahācāryāya sādhave | viprāya yogyapātrāya vaiṣṇavāya ca śārṅgiṇe ||63|| mahyaṃ kṛṣṇāya dātavyo mandirāya harāya ca | anyaratnāni dhānyāni deyavastūni yāni ca ||64|| tāni sarvāṇi dadyācca yathāyogyebhya ādarāt | bhojayed bālikā bālān satīḥ sādhvī sato dvijān ||65|| puṣpahāraṃ gavocchiṣṭaṃ gṛhṇīyād yajamānakaḥ | gopūjāsalilaṃ pucchapāvanaṃ praṇamed gṛhe ||66|| prokṣaṇaṃ gṛhamadhye vai kuryādgopūtavāriṇā | puṣpahāraṃ rakṣayecca vidhnanāśakaro hi saḥ ||67|| guruṃ sampūjayettatra gopūjāyā anantaram | vatsaṃ vatsāṃ pūjayecca praṇamecca pradakṣiṇam ||68|| dakṣiṇāṃ gurave dadyād yathāśakti kṛtādaraḥ | kapilāṃ gāṃ ca dhavalāṃ raktāṃ karburikāṃ ca vā ||69|| dadyāttasyā phalaṃ sādhvyau vairājapadamuttamam | kṛṣṇāṃ dhūmrāṃ piśaṃgīṃ ca dadyād vedhaḥpadaṃ phalam || 4.90.70|| dogdhrīṃ yāṃ kāṃ pradadyācca phalaṃ tvindrapadaṃ divi | vatsāṃ dadyāt phalaṃ tasya devatābhavanaṃ divi ||71 || dadyādubhayatomukhīṃ phalaṃ tasyāḥ paraṃ padam | ākṣarī paramā muktiḥ śāśvatī pauruṣottamī ||72|| asūtakīṃ pradadyādvai dogdhrīṃ golokadā tu sā | godānasya yajamānaḥ pālayed govrataṃ tadā ||73|| divārātraṃ vrataṃ kuryādekabhojitvameva ha | gavyāśitvaṃ prakuryādvai gosevāṃ sarvathā caret ||74|| brahmacaryaṃ tadekāhaṃ pālayed gosthale svapim | mālayā śrīhariṃ māṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ japet ||95|| godānena samaṃ dadyānmāsagrāsatṛṇānyapi | kārpāsabījakādīni dadyād gobhuktaye sadā ||76|| pratyakṣāṃ gāṃ pradadyādvai śreṣṭhaṃ dānaṃ hi tanmatam | gavālābhe gāṃ prapūjya tanmūlyaṃ cārpayetparam ||77|| mūlyārdhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā svalpaṃ daśāṃśakaṃ ca vā | dadyād yathādhanaṃ bhakto natvā śrīgurave muhuḥ ||78|| yathāśakti mayā dattaṃ kṣamasvāpūrṇamatra yat | kuryācca daṇḍavattasmai vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet ||79|| godānaṃ mandire śreṣṭhaṃ devālaye taduttamam | maṭhe sādhvāśrame śreṣṭhaṃ makhe pārāyaṇālaye ||4.90.80 || vivāhamaṇḍape śreṣṭhaṃ tīrthe sarittaṭe’pi ca | vratāhe puṇyadivase mahotsave śubhotsave ||8 1|| śreṣṭhaṃ dhenupradānaṃ vai svāsthye kuryāt kareṇa vai | yā dhenurdīyate dāne sā divyā maraṇottaram ||82|| svargamārge dharmamārge hyagre’gre yāti rakṣikā | dhenudānapradātā na yātyasadgatimīśvari ||8 3|| vaitaraṇyāṃ duḥkhanadyāṃ dhenuścottāriṇī priye | paraloke pragantuśca pretasya bhojanapradā ||84|| dhenuṃ svarṇamayīṃ dadyād dhenuṃ ca rājatīṃ tathā | dhenuṃ dhānyamayīṃ dadyāddhenuṃ kārpāsakīṃ tathā ||85|| dhenuṃ rasamayīṃ dadyād dhenuṃ sampanmayīṃ tathā | dhenuṃ kanyāmayīṃ dadyāt kanyāhīno jano bhuvi ||86|| vidhivanmaṇḍapaṃ kuryād vedīṃ kuṇḍaṃ ca kārayet| | dānavastūni sarvāṇi tathā ratnāni sannyaset ||87|| dhenuṃ svakanyakāṃ kṛtvā nāmānvitāṃ tadā | kanyāvastrāṇi sarvāṇi kanyakābharaṇāni ca ||88|| kanyādhenuṃ maṇḍape vai kṛtvā dadyād dvijātaye | havanaṃ kārayettatra vāditrāṇi pravādayet ||89|| kanyādānavidhiṃ yogyaṃ kārayenmaṇḍape tadā | kanyādānaphalaṃ tasya dhenudātuḥ prajāyate ||4.90.90|| kanyādhenuṃ rohiṇīṃ vai dadyād vṛṣabhāsaṃginīm | agarbhiṇīṃ mahāvatsīṃ dadyāt kanyāsvarūpiṇīm ||9 1 || mahāvatsīpradānena kanyāvān jāyate tataḥ | evaṃdānapradātā syāt svargabhāk mokṣabhāk tathā |||92|| bhuktimuktimahāmuktisampanno jāyate sadā | pitṝṇāṃ tārakaścāpi kuṭumbināṃ ca tārakaḥ ||93|| sarvapuṇyasupātraṃ ca brahmānandamayo bhavet | anapatyo dhenudātā sāpatyo hi samāntare ||94|| aputraḥ putravān syācca varṣāntare na saṃśayaḥ | śubhaṃ kālaṃ ca satpātraṃ prāpya dadyāt pradānakam |||95|| gataḥ kālaḥ śubho yastu punarnāyāsyati kvacit | gṛhastho dharmakarmārthahīno godānamācaret ||96|| gaustasyoddhārikā sādhvyau śataikādikuṭumbinām | godātre tu gururdadyādāśīrvādān tadākṣataiḥ ||97|| dhanavān putravām̐llakṣmīsampadvān bhava pārthivaḥ | ārogyavām̐stathā śrīmān varcasvavān janeṣvapi ||98|| āyuṣyavān bhogavām̐śca vaṃśavistāravān bhava | svargavān surasampadvān mokṣavān bhava cottare ||99|| vaṃśe te gopradātāro jāyantāṃ mokṣabhāginaḥ | dhārmikā devabhaktāśca prajoddhāraparāyaṇāḥ || 4.90.10 0|| sādhusevāparāḥ santu nāryaḥ santu pativratāḥ | satya santu ca te vaṃśe rādhālakṣmīsamāḥ striyaḥ ||1 01 || svasti te’stu sadā loke paraloke’pi te’stu tat | gauriyaṃ sarvathā svasti karotvagre gatā tava | | 10 2|| oṃ namaḥ śrīgopataye rādhāyāḥ pataye namaḥ | gavātmani sthitaścāhaṃ sākṣī kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ | | 103 || māṃ saṃsmṛtya priye padmāvati kuryādgavārpaṇam | kṛṣṇārpaṇamidaṃ dānaṃ cāstvityuktvā visarjayet | | 1 04|| ityevaṃ supriye śreṣṭhaṃ sādhanaṃ vāṃ mayoditam | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya dhenudānaphalaṃ bhavet | | 105|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne gṛhagītāyāṃ sarvadharmādivarjitagṛhiṇo’pi mokṣādisādhanaṃ godānaṃ gosthadevādi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 90 ||
<4.91> śrīpadmāvatīprajñe procatuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin godānaṃ cet kṛtaṃ na hi | mokṣārthaṃ tvaparaṃ kiñcidasti cennau vadātra ha || 1 || śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa uvāca satāṃ dehena manasā sevā vai karmaṇā sadā | sarvasampatpraṭā mokṣapradā pāpavināśinī || 2 || yeṣāṃ na vratavijñānaṃ dharmajñānaṃ na vidyate | dāridryaṃ vidyate cāpi mālinyaṃ tīrthavarjitā || 3 || teṣāṃ sādhostu satsaṃgāt pāpanāśaśca mokṣaṇam | jāyate nātra sandehaḥ satsaṃge bhagavān sthitaḥ || 4 || satāṃ samāgamo bhārye bahudhā rucibhedataḥ | yasya bhavati tasyāghavināśo mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet || |9 || netrābhyāṃ darśanamātraṃ satsaṃgo darśanātmakaḥ | hastābhyāṃ saṃvāhanādi satsaṃgo dehamardanaḥ || 6 || śuśrūṣā kāryakāritvaṃ cājñāyāmanuvartanam | bhṛtyatā dāsyamevāpi satsaṃgo dehadānakam || 7 || padbhyāṃ gamanaṃ sādhūnāmāśramaṃ prati nityadā | pradakṣiṇaṃ prakartavyaṃ satsaṃgāścaraṇārpaṇaḥ || 8 || mastakena namet santaṃ satsaṃgo namanātmakaḥ | prāñjaliḥ praṇamet santaṃ satsaṃgaḥ prāñjaliḥ sa tu || 9 || praśaṃsejjihvayā santaṃ satsaṃgaḥ śaṃsanātmakaḥ | prasādaṃ bhakṣayet sādhoḥ satsaṃgo rasanātmakaḥ || 4.91.10 || śṛṇuyāttatra kathāṃ sādhoḥ satsaṃgaḥ śravaṇātmakaḥ | spṛśet sādhuṃ snehapūrvaṃ satsaṃgaḥ sparśanātmakaḥ || 11 || gandhaṃ satāṃ tu gṛhṇīyāt puṣpaprasādasaṃbhavam | gandhasāraṃ satāṃ dehāt satsaṃgo ghrāṇanātmakaḥ || 1 2|| āśliṣyet sādhuvaryaṃ tu satsaṃgaḥ sañjanātmakaḥ | prasādayenmodayecca satsaṃgo nandanātmakaḥ || 1 3|| stuvītājñāṃ pālayecca satsaṃgaḥ stavanātmakaḥ | seveta satataṃ sādhūn satsaṃgaḥ sevanātmakaḥ || 14|| viharet sādhubhiḥ sārdhaṃ satsaṃgo bhramaṇātmakaḥ | vicaret sādhubhiḥ sārdhaṃ satsaṃgo maṇḍalātmakaḥ || 15|| nivasettu satā sākaṃ satsaṃgaḥ sa gṛhātmakaḥ | manyeta pitaraṃ sādhuṃ satsaṃgaḥ sa sutātmakaḥ || 1 6|| pramanyeta guruṃ sādhuṃ satsaṃgaḥ śiṣyavartanaḥ | susādhoḥ śaraṇaṃ gacchet satsaṃgaḥ śaraṇātmakaḥ || 17|| bhojanaṃ sādhave dadyāt satsaṃgo bhojanātmakaḥ | dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ dadyāt satsaṃgaḥ sa rasātmakaḥ || 18|| vastraṃ ca kambalaṃ dadyāt satsaṃgaścāmbarātmakaḥ | chatraṃ dadyāccāmaraṃ ca satsaṃgaḥ karaṇātmakaḥ || 1 9|| pātraṃ śayyāṃ pradadyācca satsaṃgaḥ śayanātmakaḥ | gṛhaṃ saudhaṃ pradadyācca satsaṃgo bhavanātmakaḥ ||4.91.20|| yānaṃ dadyādvimānaṃ ca satsaṃgo vāhanātmakaḥ | annaṃ śākaṃ phalaṃ dadyāt satsaṃgastarpaṇātmakaḥ |||2 1 || jalaṃ dadyāt lepayecca satsaṃgaḥ snānanāmakaḥ | sādhuṃ śṛṃgārayet puṣpaiḥ satsaṃgo bhūṣaṇātmakaḥ || 22|| sādhuṃ cāvāhayedgrāme gṛhe vāṭyāṃ prapūjayet | bhrāmayed grāmamadhye ca satsaṅgaścotsavātmakaḥ |||23|| upadeśaṃ dhārayecca satsaṅgo bodhanātmakaḥ | dravyaṃ samarpayettasmai satsaṅgaḥ sa dhanātmakaḥ || 24|| iṣṭadānaistoṣayecca satsaṅgastoṣaṇātmakaḥ | āśīrvādān labhet sādhoḥ satsaṅgaḥ sa varātmakaḥ ||25|| auṣadhādi diśet tasmai satsaṅgaḥ sa nirāmayaḥ | samidādi diśed yajñe satsaṅgaḥ samidātmakaḥ ||26|| adhyāpayettu sādhūn vai satsaṅgo’dhyāpanātmakaḥ | brahmavidyāmarjayecca satsaṅgo brahmabuddhidaḥ |||27|| dhyāyet sādhuṃ ca māṃ nityaṃ satsaṅgo dhyānayogadaḥ | kīrtayecchrīhariṃ sādhūn satsaṅgaḥ kīrtanātmakaḥ ||28|| sādhvarthaṃ sarvaśaḥ kuryāt satsaṅgo nirguṇo hi saḥ | sādhureva hariryasya tasya kāryaṃ na vidyate ||29|| eva satāṃ sevanena satsaṅgena mamāṅgane | mokṣaḥ kare sthito bodhyaḥ kartavyaṃ nāsya śiṣyate ||4.91.30|| śṛṇutaṃ bhāvanāṃ sādhujane gurau yathāyatham | kartavyavidhinā samyak kṛtāṃ saṃvarṇayāmi vām || 3 1|| sādhuṃ divyaṃ vijānīyād brahmamūrtimamāyikam | pāvanaṃ puṇyamūrtiṃ ca nirlepaṃ puruṣottamam ||32|| sādhupādarajaḥ puṇyaṃ sādhuvastraṃ ca pāvanam | sādhusevyaṃ samastaṃ vai pāvanaṃ cāpyamāyikam ||33|| sādhusparśaḥ pāvano’sti sādhubhuktaṃ hi pāvanam | jalānnaphalapuṣpādiḥ prasādaḥ pāvanaḥ satām || 34|| sādhvāsanaṃ pavitraṃ ca pāduke pāvane satām | sarvopakaraṇādyaṃ ca pāvanaṃ sarvathā satām ||35|| sādhordantā nakhāḥ keśāḥ pāvanāḥ pāpanāśakāḥ | sādhvāśleṣaḥ pāvano vai sarvābhicāranāśanaḥ ||36|| upādhyādhivyādhināśakaraḥ sādhoḥ samāgamaḥ | sādhvāśramo mahattīrthaṃ sādhvāśrayaśca pāvanaḥ ||37|| sādhūnāṃ vasatirdivyā mahāvaikuṇṭhaśālinī | sādhvāgamaḥ svastidātā śreyasāṃ varṣakaḥ sukhaḥ ||38|| kalyāṇaśevadhiḥ sādhoḥ prasannatā tu sevayā | sādhoḥ sneho brahmalābhapradaḥ prītiḥ pramokṣadā ||39|| sarvānandapradā sādhoḥ saṅgatirbhayavarjitā | kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyabhayāpahā ||4.91.40|| sādhoḥ śikhānte virajā nadī golokajāsti vai | śikhāmūle brahmahrado’kṣarastho rājate sadā ||41 || brahmarandhe’kṣaraṃ dhāma goloko mastake’sti ca | vaikuṇṭhaṃ tu lalāṭe’sti bhālamadhye ramāpuram |||42|| bhālāntayoramṛtāvyākṛtadhāmadvayaṃ sthitam | karṇayostu mahāviṣṇuvairājau dvāvavasthitau ||43|| netrayoḥ sūryacandrau ca gaṇḍayorve dhruvadvayam | nāsāyāṃ maruto devā mukhe nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||44|| oṣṭhayoramṛtaṃ divyaṃ miṣṭamānandasaṃbhṛtam | jihvāyāṃ sarvavedāśca mukhagarbhe’gnidevatā ||45|| śabde vāṇī śāradāśrīḥ rūpe lakṣmīrhi kandhare | kaṇṭhe sarvā brahmavidyā hṛdaye brahma śāśvatam ||46|| cetane’haṃ parabrahma saṃkalpe kṛṣṇadevatā | vakṣasi dharmadevaśca pṛṣṭhe pitaro devatāḥ ||47|| pārśvayorbrahmarudrau ca viṣṇururasi tiṣṭhati | udare cānnapūrṇāsti nābhau svargaṃ surālayam ||48|| jaghane śrīgaṇeśaśca gupte caiśvaryakoṭayaḥ | kaṭyāṃ pṛthivī dvāvadrī cāstodayau nitambayoḥ ||49|| skandhayoraniruddhaśca pradyumnaśceti tāvubhau | bhruvoḥ saṃkarṣaṇo vāsudevo bhrūmadhyagaḥ satām ||4.91.50|| bhujayostu diśāṃ pālā lokapālāstu hastayoḥ | hastatalayoḥ śrīrbhūśca vibhūtayo’ṅguliṣvapi ||51|| nakheṣu tārakāḥ santi grahā vasanti parvasu | sarvaromasu tīrthāni vasanti sādhuvigrahe ||52|| vacane kāmagāvaśca cintāmaṇayaścintane | kalpadrumā hyanuvṛttau sauhṛde kalpavallayaḥ ||53|| nāḍīṣu tīrthasaritaḥ sarovarāṇi kukṣiṣu | āntreṣu kāśyapāḥ sarve vasanti sādhuvigrahe ||54|| sakthnoḥ śilādaprahlādau jānunorbalivāmanau | jaṃghayornāgalokāśca pādayoḥ śeṣakacchapau ||55|| śaktayaḥ santi sarveṣu sandhiṣu sādhuvigrahe | muktā ghātuṣu vartante pārṣadāḥ sādhusatkṛtau |||56|| siddhayo dhāraṇāyāṃ ca sādhordhyāne haristvaham | sādhutādātmyavāso’smi bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ||57|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo rāje hi sādhuṣu | aṅgane sādhumūrtau na tyāgabhāgau kathaṃcana ||58|| evaṃ tu bhāvayet sādhuṃ tathaiva sevayet sadā | sarvaṃ samarpayed yastu tasya mokṣaḥ kare sthitaḥ ||59|| sādhvike bhāvayitvaivaṃ pūjayet sevayet sataḥ | prātaḥ prabodhasamaye dehasaṃvāhanaṃ caret ||4.91.60|| utthitāya jalaṃ dadyād dantadhāvanamarpayet | jalapātraṃ pradadyācca dehaśaucārthamityapi ||61|| hastaśaucaṃ kārayecca pātraśuddhiṃ vidhāpayet | yatheṣṭavāribhirdivyaistīrthajalaiḥ sugandhitaiḥ |||62|| snānamālepanapūrvaṃ kārayeccāndanairjalaiḥ | sugandhitailasammiśraiḥ snāpayettilacūrṇakaiḥ ||63|| āmalakādicūrṇaiśca mardayet sādhuvigraham | dugdhena snāpayeccāpi paraṃ śuddhajalairapi ||64|| vastraiḥ sammārjayed dehaṃ sugandhaṃ prokṣayettathā | vastrādhānaṃ bhūṣaṇāni śṛṃgāraṃ mālikādibhiḥ ||65||| puṣpaiḥ saubhāgyacūrṇaiśca kuṃkumākṣatacandanaiḥ | kārayecca tato dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tilakaṃ candrakam ||66|| kārayed raṅgarūpādyaṃ raṃjayet sādhuvigraham | kajjalaṃ netrayordadyāt keśeṣu tailamityapi ||67|| āsanaṃ paṭṭikādyaṃ ca siṃhāsanaṃ sate’rpayet | āvāhanaṃ ca pādyaṃ cācamanīyaṃ tathārpayet ||68|| arghyaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ ca dadyāt śrīsādhave rasān | naivedyaṃ ca jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ phalaṃ dalaṃ diśet ||69|| yajñopavītakaṃ dadyānmekhalāṃ yogapaṭṭakam | kambalaṃ naktakaṃ dadyātpuṣpagucchaṃ kare’rpayet ||4.91.70|| naivedyaṃ bhojanaṃ miṣṭaṃ sugandhaṃ bhakṣyamityapi | dugdhasāraṃ kṣīramiṣṭaṃ pūrikāḥ prārpayed dadhi ||7 1 || takraṃ jalaṃ prārpayecca mukhavāsaṃ tathārpayet | paryaṃkaṃ vāhanaṃ yānaṃ pāduke chatramarpayet ||72|| śayyāṃ dadyāt svāpayecca pavanaṃ prārpayettathā | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ dehamardanaṃ dāsyamācaret ||73|| yadyadapekṣitaṃ dadyād daihikaṃ mānasaṃ ca vā | prakāśaṃ cāprakāśaṃ ca yadicchettatprapūrayet ||74|| evaṃ kuryāt satāṃ sevāṃ pāvanīṃ śrīpradāṃ tadā | hariḥ sākṣāt pūjito’haṃ teneyaṃ sṛṣṭirarcitā ||75|| sarvaṃ puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena tīrthaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ tathā | sādhupādajalaṃ divyaṃ pibet tīrthādipāvanam ||76|| sarvaṃ tīrthaṃ vrataṃ dānaṃ kṛtaṃ tena tu sevayā | sādhuḥ prasādito yena tena kṛṣṇaḥ prasāditaḥ ||77|| kṛṣṇaḥ prasādito yena brahmadhāmni sa modate | parānandamayo bhūtvā sarvān kāmān samaśnute ||78|| sādhutoṣaṇakācchreṣṭhaṃ tulyaṃ vā sādhanaṃ param | vidyate naiva saralaṃ mokṣārthaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ bhuvi ||79|| sarvapāpaharāḥ santo hariśīlaparā yataḥ | brahmavrataparā yasmānmahābhāgavatā yataḥ ||4.91.8 0|| nibodhata priye patnyau gṛhī yathā tu toṣayet | patnyai sarvaṃ pradāyaiva yathā patnīṃ pratoṣayet ||8 1 || putraṃ putrīṃ yathā pratoṣayed gṛhī tadiṣṭadaḥ | tathā sādhuṃ pradāyaiva toṣayedabhivāñcchitam |||82|| bhrātre pitre pataye ca pradāyaiva yathā gṛhī | iṣṭaṃ sate tathā datvā toṣayet santamanvaham ||83|| mahīmānārthamevāyaṃ gṛhī yādṛgvyayaṃ bahum | karoti tu tathā kuryāt satāmarthe sa mokṣabhāg ||84|| sate pauṣpaṃ samukuṭaṃ dadyānmūrdhni suśobhanam | sādhave pracchadapaṭīṃ dadyāt pauṣpīṃ ca sūtrajām ||89|| badhnīyāt puṣpakaṭakān bhujayośca prakoṣṭhayoḥ | ārārtrikaṃ prakurvīta bahuvartisamanvitam ||86|| pradakṣiṇaṃ prakuryācca kuryācca daṇḍavanmudā | pādayormastakaṃ dadyānmūrdhni hastau nidhāpayet ||87|| satāṃ prasādaṃ bhuñjītāśīrvādān dhārayecchubhān | puṣpāñjaliṃ sate dadyād dānaṃ yatheṣṭamarpayet ||88|| evaṃ śrīlalane sādhoḥ sevayā gṛhadharmiṇām | satsaṃgasya balāt sarvāghāni naśyanti sarvathā ||89|| satāṃ puṇyaṃ labhetāpi sampatpradaṃ pramokṣadam | prārthayettu sataḥ sādhvīḥ kṣamāpayettadagrataḥ ||4.91.90|| kṛpāsindho dayāsindho śaraṇāgatavatsala | sādho hyasādhulokānāmasmākaṃ śaraṇaṃ bhavān ||9 1|| na sādhanāni jānāmi na puṇyāni karomyapi | nārādhanaṃ pāpahaṃ ca mokṣadaṃ sādhanaṃ na ca ||92|| agatīnāṃ gatistvaṃ me bhavāraṇye’tidurgame | saṃsārasāgare naukā tārayitrī pravartase ||93|| sarvapāpavināśārthaṃ muktyarthaṃ sukhahetave | sādho kṛṣṇasvarūpo’si tvāṃ prapadye harestanum ||94|| vayaṃ nityaṃ patitāḥ smo ghore saṃsārakardame | prakṣālya naḥ samuddhartuṃ samartho’si samuddhara ||95|| pūjane sevane sādho nyūnaṃ vā kramavarjitam | mānahīnaṃ ca vā yattat kṣamasva śaraṇaṃjuṣam ||96|| oṃ namo gurudevāya sādhave paramātmane | asmaddaivatarūpāyoddhārakartre muhurnamaḥ ||97|| ityabhyarthya namaskṛtya samarpya gurudakṣiṇām | visarjayet sadāsmatsu prasanno bhava tāpasa ||98|| āyāhi nityamevātra pūjāṃ gṛhāṇa māmakīm | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca sampattiṃ pradehi me kṛpāṃ kuru ||99|| itivisarjitaṃ sādhuṃ cintayeddharirūpiṇam | evaṃ sādhuvratenāpi sādhvyau mokṣaḥ kare sthitaḥ || 4.91.1 00|| antakāle sādhubhaktā yānti sādhubhireva te | ākṣaraṃ paramaṃ dhāma divyaṃ vimānagaiḥ saha || 101 || naro nārī sataḥ sādhvyā evaṃ pūjanamācaret | varṣe varṣe ca māse vā sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt || 1 02|| yatra sādhoścaraṇaṃ tadgṛhaṃ golokasadṛśam | sādhubhaktāḥ pārṣadāste nāryo muktānikāstu tāḥ || 10 3|| paṭhanācchravaṇādasya sādhupūjāphalaṃ bhavet | ante bhaktyā labhetāpi brahmadhāma na saṃśayaḥ || 1 04|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne gṛhagītāyāṃ sarvadharmakarmādihīnānāṃ gṛhiṇāṃ paramaṃ mokṣasya sādhanaṃ sādhusatsaṃgatirityādinirūpaṇanāmaikanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 91 ||
<4.92> śrīmādhavīprajñe procatuḥ bhagavan karuṇāsindho kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho | svaḥ sañjāte kṛtakṛtye māhātmyaśravaṇāt satām || 1 || athānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīkṛṣṇamādhava | kartumīhāmahe sarvā bhavajjanyajayantikām || 2 || ājñāṃ dehi pate svāmin sarvāḥ kurmo mahotsavam | apūrvamutsavaṃ vīkṣya jīvānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet| || 3 || śrīśvetāyanavyāsa uvāca munayo’nādikṛṣṇāśrīnārāyaṇastadarthanām | gṛhītvājñāṃ dadau kartuṃ tābhyaḥ svāvirdinotsavam || 4 || dvāviṃśatitame janmavatsare kārtike’site | ādye dale’ṣṭamī prāptā tajjayotsavasiddhaye || 5 || śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇastu pitā maṇḍapamuttamam | klṛptayāmāsa sahasā sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ śubham || 6 || viśālaṃ yojanāyāmaṃ paṭamaṇḍapamityapi | gajāsanaṃ ca sauvarṇamaṇḍape sannyadhāddhareḥ || 7 || lomaśo havanārthaṃ vai kuṇḍaṃ cākārayattathā | samagropakaraṇādi sādhayāmāsa lomaśaḥ || 8 || brahmapriyādyāḥ pramadāḥ pakvānnāni pracakrire | padmāvatīpriyāyāśca haripriyāstathāparāḥ || 9 || maṇḍape’tha samājasyopaveśanāni sarvaśaḥ | klṛptayāmāsa bhagavān jyeṣṭho bhrātā harestadā || 4.92.1 0|| śuko bhrātā dvitīyaśca svāgatārthaṃ sthito’bhavat | santuṣṭādyāḥ kumāryaśca devīnāṃ svāgataṃ vyadhuḥ || | 1 || āyayuḥ sarvalokebhyo dhiṣṇyapāḥ svavimānakaiḥ | ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamīprātaḥ kṛṣṇāśīrvādahetave || 1 2|| yogeśā brāhmasamaye’vādyanta vādyakoṭayaḥ | saṃgṛhṇāti ca nārīṇāṃ kīrtanānyabhavan prage || 1 3|| viprāṇāṃ vedaghoṣāścābhavannāśīḥparāyaṇāḥ | gītayaścāpsarasāṃ ca sanṛtyāḥ parito’bhavan || 14|| gandharvāṇāṃ kinnarāṇāṃ kiṃpuṃsāṃ gāyanāni ca | sūtamāgadhabandīnāṃ vandanāni śubhāni ca || 19|| kāvyottamāni ca kavivaryāṇāmabhavam̐stadā | vidyādhrāṇāṃ cāraṇānāmāsan kathānakāni ca || 1 6|| paṇḍitānāṃ nāṭakāni satānāṃ kīrtanāni ca | nāmadhūnyāni sādhvīnāṃ cāsan jayantikotsave || 17|| naiṣṭhikāḥ śrīhariḥ prātaryoganidrāṃ vihāya ca | divyavādyādighoṣādīn śṛṇvan sasnau sarojalaiḥ || 18 | | dadhāra veṣaṃ subhagaṃ bhūṣāḥ śṛṃgārakāṇi ca | sugandhāni sarvasvasticandrakaḥ śuśubhe hariḥ || 19 | | mātāśrīkambharālakṣmīḥ putrasya tilakaṃ vyadhāt | candrakaṃ kauṃkumaṃ cāpi cāndanaṃ kesarānvitam || 4.92.20 || santuṣṭā bhaginī bhāle’kṣatabinduṃ vyadhāddhareḥ | pitā mālāṃ dadau putrakaṇṭhe svarṇamaṇisrajam | | 21 | | athaivaṃ śobhitaḥ kṛṣṇo maṇḍapaṃ samupāyayau | lomaśaścāyayau tatra pūjopakaraṇānvitaḥ | | 22 | | sarvairnamaskṛtastūrṇaṃ vācayāmāsa maṃgalam | puṇyāhaṃ svasti caivāpi gaṇeśapūjanaṃ tataḥ | | 23 || dehaśuddhiṃ prokṣaṇaṃ ca tilakaṃ candrakaṃ hareḥ | bhāle cakāra ṛṣirāḍāśīrvādān dadau tataḥ || 94 | | puṣpahāraṃ gale ramyaṃ dadau kṛṣṇasya lomaśaḥ | tato mātā pitā bhāle bāndhavāśca kuṭumbinaḥ || 25 || tilakaṃ sākṣataṃ cakruryavāṃkurāṇi karṇayoḥ | daduścāśīrvādavāṇīṃ tato brahmā hyupāyayau || 26 || kṛtvā tu tilakaṃ hāraṃ gale datvā stutiṃ vyadhāt | namaskṛtyāsanaṃ prāpa viṣṇustata upāyayau | | 27 | | hāraṃ ca mukuṭaṃ divyaṃ kuṇḍale kaustubhaṃ maṇim | datvā nanāma ca tataḥ śaṃbhurupāyayau harim | | 28 | | natvā datvā puṣpamālāṃ cakre bhāle sucandrakam | indrādayastato devāḥ siddhāśca sādhavo’malāḥ | | 29 || sanakādyā bhavantaḥ śrīhariṃ pupūjurādarāt | nāradādyāḥ ṛṣayaśca sūryādyāstilakaṃ vyadhuḥ | | 4.92.30 || lokapālāśca pitaro gandharvāḥ kinnarāstathā | kiṃpumāṃso mānavāśca viprāḥ santo jaleśayāḥ | | 31 || tīrthāni sāgarā nadyo vṛkṣāśca virudho’pi ca | devā daityā dānavāśca bhaktāḥ sūtāśca māgadhāḥ | | 32 || cāraṇā vaiṣṇavāścānye śaivā gaṇāśca pārṣadāḥ | apsaraso devatāśca devyaḥ sādhvyaśca yoginaḥ | | 33 || yoginyo gaṇikāvṛndā bhaktānikāśca yoṣitaḥ | varṇāśramā narā nāryo yakṣā rakṣāṃsi vandinaḥ | | 34|| vidyādharāśca vidvāṃso kṛṣṇamānarcurutsukāḥ | nāgā yādāṃsi ca jarāyūjāśca svedajāśca ye | | 35 || divyā divyavapuṣmantaḥ pupūjuḥ parameśvaram | ārārtrikaṃ mahāmuktāścakrurmuktānikāstadā | | 3 6|| abhiṣekaṃ tato nadyaḥ pādayoścakrurutsave | upadāśca daduḥ sarve mahīmānottamāḥ surāḥ ||37||| ciraṃ jīvāva naḥ kṛṣṇa kṣemaṃ ca kuśalaṃ tava | ārogyaṃ ca dhanaṃ sampanmahaiśvaryāṇi santu te |||38|| śaraṇyatvaṃ dayālutvaṃ mokṣadatvaṃ sadāstu tai | vaṃśavistāravattvaṃ ca devādhidevarājatā |||39|| saukhyaṃ sarvavidhaṃ te’stu sarvānandādiśevadheḥ | evamāśīrvādavāṇīścāhuḥ surādayastathā ||4.92.40|| lomaśaḥ svāgataṃ mānaṃ dhanyavādān dadau tadā | brahmapriyāḥ samastāśca haripriyāśca yoṣitaḥ ||41 || rādhāramāśrīkamalāvṛndāpāśaṃvatīpriyāḥ | māṇikīsukhadālakṣmībhūlīlābhūtiśāradāḥ ||42|| sāvitrīpārvatīsaṃjñāgāyatrībhagavatpriyāḥ | devyastatheśvarapatnyāvatāriṇyo’parāḥ striyaḥ ||43|| pupūjuḥ paramātmānaṃ bhāle’sya tilakaṃ vyadhuḥ | vṛddhyañjaliṃ duḥkhanāśāñjaliṃ jagṛhurādarāt || 44|| puṣpākṣatāñjalīn kṛṣṇe nidadhurjagadurharim | ciraṃ jīva satīsādhvīśaktīśānandado bhava |||4|| sampatprado mokṣadaśca no hṛtsvavicalo vasa | evamāśīrdadustasmai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya tāḥ ||46|| ārārtrikaṃ ca tāścakrurjalaṃ papuśca pādayoḥ | haristato narānnārīrnamaścakre samutthitaḥ |||47|| vardhito’haṃ mahābhāgyairnamāmi parameśvarān | gurūn vṛddhān mātṛkāśca devīrdevādikānmuhuḥ ||48|| samāgatān kṛpayātra me’rthaṃ tānpraṇamāmyaham | sarve bhavantu sukhino dhiṣṇyapāḥ sampadanvitāḥ ||49|| vaṃśavistāravantaśca lokadhāmādhipāstathā | nirbhayā vimalānandabhogasampatsukhocchrayāḥ ||4.92.50|| ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo rājannijāsane | āhūya pūjyavargāṃśca pradadau bahudānakam ||5 1|| sarvasṛṣṭyadhipān pūrvaṃ dadau ratnāni sarvaśaḥ | tataḥ sādhūn bhūsurām̐śca sūtamāgadhabandinaḥ ||52|| bhikṣukān bālikā bālān yoginaśca satījanān | dāsīrdāsāṃśca bhṛtyām̐śca narānnārīḥ samastakān ||53|| natvā natvā mahāmūlyaṃ dhanaṃ tebhyo dadau hariḥ | yathāyogyaprasādām̐śca bhūṣāpātrāmbarāṇi ca ||54|| dadau cakre tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sabhāvisarjanaṃ drutam | atha tebhyo bhojanāni vicitrāṇyuttamāni ca ||55|| kārayāmāsa bhagavān pitā mātā ca bāndhavāḥ | tarpayāmāsurīśādyān miṣṭānnajalapānakaiḥ || 56|| mukhavāsapradānaiśca viśrāmāsanadānakaiḥ | sevābhirvividhābhiśca satkārairyogyavartanaiḥ ||57|| bubhūjurdehinastatra janmajayantikādine | dvāviṃśativarṣasaṃkhye’ṣṭamyāṃ trilokavāsinaḥ || 58 || madhyāhnottaravelāyāṃ prārthayāmāsuracyutam | nijalokān pāvayituṃ samāgantuṃ hariṃ tu te ||59 || tathāstvevaṃ hariḥ prāha visasarja samājakam | vidāya prāpya te sarve yayurlokānajaṃ vinā || 4.92.60 || brahmā tasthau gṛhe tatra kṛṣṇājñayā sukhena vai | vimānaiste yayuḥ sarve mudā svasvālayān prati || 61 || athāścaryamabhūttatra śṛṇutedaṃ munīśvarāḥ | vardhamānanagarasya rājā nāmnā purañjanaḥ || 62 || āgato’bhūjjanmamahotsave cānye nṛpā yathā | purañjanasya vai rātrau svapnamabhūccirāyitam ||63 || kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre muhūrte brāhmapūrvake | svapne dadarśa rājā svaṃ patitaṃ jvalitānale ||| 64|| ninyustaṃ vikarālā vai dūtā yamasya dakṣiṇām | yāmyapurīṃ sarvakarmaphalabhogārthasaṃsthitām | | 65|| dharmarājo dadau daṇḍaṃ vīkṣya pāpāni bhūbhṛtaḥ | paravittāpatyanārīhartā tvaṃ kālapāśakam || 66 || tāmisraṃ ghoranarakaṃ bhuṃkṣvetyāha yamādhipaḥ | naranārīvañcakastvamandhatāmisrago bhava || 67|| bhūtadrohakarastvaṃ ca hiṃsako rauravaṃ vraja | dehaṃbharo na dātā tvaṃ mahārauravago bhava || 68|| paśupakṣiprāṇahā tvaṃ kumbhīpākagato bhava | pitṛviprabrahmadhruk tvaṃ kālasūtragato bhava || 6 9|| pāṣaṇḍapoṣakastvaṃ vai saṃviśāsidalaṃ vanam | adaṇḍyadaṇḍakartā tvaṃ sūkarānanake pata ||4.92.7 0 || prāṇivyathāpradātā tvamandhakūpagato bhava | pañcayajñavihīnastvaṃ kṛmikuṇḍagato bhava ||7 1 || hiraṇyaratnahartā tvaṃ sandaśe narake pata | agamyāgamakastvaṃ vai tigmasūrmyāgato bhava |||72 || pāṣaṇḍapoṣakastvaṃ vaitaraṇyāṃ pata sarvathā | śaucācāravihīnastvaṃ pūyakardamago bhava ||73 || mṛgayāvyasanī tvaṃ vai yāhi vaiśasamulbaṇam | anṛtārthapravādī tvaṃ yāhyavīcimadhaḥśirāḥ || 74|| madyapastvaṃ raktamadyānalapānakaro bhava | gurvavajñāvidhātā tvaṃ kṣārakardamake pata ||75|| sarvodvegakarastvaṃ vai dandaśūkagato bhava | sādhvabhyāgatapūjāghno vajratuṇḍagato bhava ||76|| evamuktvā yamo yāmyānnṛpaṃ netumuvāca ha | yamadūtā dadau duḥkhaṃ tāḍanaiśchedanaistathā ||77|| ghātanairvahnidāhaiśca peṣaṇaiḥ kartanaistathā | vahnipānairviṣadānaiḥ kṣārapātanakaistathā ||78|| galarodhaiścāntrakarṣairvajraghātairmuhurmuhuḥ | kaṇṭakādau gamanaiścākarṣaṇaiḥ śastribhūtale ||79|| tāmrabandhairjvālanaiśca pāśalambanakaistathā | khaṅgapatrapravāsaiśca pūyaśoṇitapātanaiḥ ||4.92.8 0|| evaṃvidhāni duḥkhāni bhuktvā svapne nṛpaściram | niṣkāsito bahiścāpi pravāsito vidāyavān ||8 1 || āyayau svanivāse vai vardhamānapure hi saḥ | sammānito nṛpo lokairmahotsāhaiḥ prajādibhiḥ |||82|| rājyāsane sthitaḥ paścād viśramya ca dināntare | yātrārthaṃ prayayau kuṃkumavāpīṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau ||83|| janmajayantikāhe vai tatra kṛtvā mahotsavam | vidāyaṃ sa lalābhāpi tāvannidrotthito’bhavat ||84|| śuśoca bahudhā rājā kimidaṃ svapnamulbaṇam | pṛcchāmi paramātmānaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yat tat samastakam ||85|| rājā purañjayaḥ śīghraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya vai | śrāvayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ śokaṃ cakāra vai kṣaṇam ||86|| anādiśrīhariḥ prāha rājatvaṃ pāpakṛt purā | paścād bhakto’si jāto’tra mahāpāpī purābhavaḥ ||87|| sahasrayugaparyantaṃ pāpaphalaṃ tavābhavat | bhogāya yamaloke vai tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ gatam ||88|| mamāśrayeṇa vai rājan yadaṃśaḥ svapnake tvayā | bhuktaḥ sarvo’pi rātrau vai na śeṣaṃ tava vidyate ||89|| athādhunā mama mantraṃ gṛhāṇa śuddhabhāvanaḥ | mukto bhūtvā prayāhyevākṣaraṃ dhāma paraṃ padam ||4.92.90|| tvamagnau patito rājan nāyuṣyaṃ tava vidyate | aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre yāhi dhāmākṣaraṃ mama ||9 1 || ityuktyā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo mantraṃ tu bhūbhate | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā |||92||| dadau vāri dadau naijaṃ pādaprakṣālanodbhavam | papau rājā pādajalaṃ divyadṛṣṭirbabhūva ha ||93|| māyāpārācāravām̐ścābhavat karuṇayā hareḥ | ācakarṣa samastā vai vṛttiścendriyavājinām ||94|| tūrṇaṃ brahmasthitau tiṣṭhan pupūja parameśvaram | ṛṣīn sādhūn vaiṣṇavām̐śca neme paramabhāvavān || 95|| svabhṛtyān śikṣaṇaṃ datvā svastyā tatra kalevaram | āgatena vimānena divyena muktaśobhinā || 96|| yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ śīghraṃ paśyatāṃ sarvadehinām | śrutvā yāmyapradattān vai daṇḍān sarve’nuyāyinaḥ ||97|| tatyajurbhṛtyavargāste dūṣaṇāni hyaghāni ca | jayakāro’bhavad rājñaścaurdhvakṛtyaṃ tato’bhavat ||98|| bhūpasyānucarāḥ sarve mantraṃ jagṛhuracyutāt | nāmadhunyaṃ jagṛhuśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho ||99|| bālakṛṣṇasvāmikṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇaprabho vibho | evaṃ dhunyaṃ pracakruste yayurnaijaṃ puraṃ prati || 4.92.100 || jagadurnṛpamokṣaṃ ca bhejustato hariṃ prabhum | ityevaṃ varculaṃ tatrāścaryamabhūnmayoditam ||1 01 || paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇānmuktibhāg bhavet | māyāṃ vihāya pāpāni brahmalokagato’bhavat || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śrīharerdvāviṃśatitamo janmajayantīdinotsavaḥ, vardhamānapureśituḥ purañjayanṛpateḥ svapne sarvanarakabhogastataḥ śīghraṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmisannidhau mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvānavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 92 ||
<4.93> śrīpadmāvatīprajñe procatuḥ bhaktapriyaharikṛṣṇasvāminnārāyaṇaprabho | brahmā pitāmahaḥ kasmād rakṣito’tra svasannidhau || 1 || śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa uvāca śarkarānagare’haṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo mahe | deveśapitṛnāgādīn teṣāṃ svīkṛtya cārthanām || 2 || teṣāṃ teṣāṃ bhavanāni tataścid gantumāha tān | tallakṣyīkṛtya bhagavāniyeṣaitumajāspadam || 3 || satyalokaṃ pragantuṃ vai brahmaṇā saha kārtike | brahmaṇo mānasapūrtyai prārūrudhaṃ nijāntike || 4 || ūrjakṛṣṇanavamyāṃ māṃ hariṃ brahmā praṇamya tu | apṛcchat kāraṇaṃ svasya nirodhasya sukhāsane || 5 || ahaṃ nyavedaya tatrāsmārayaṃ ca tadarthanām | sarvabrahmapriyāharipriyādyābhiḥ sahaiva ha || 6 || kṛtaprārthanasthānīśālayān gantuṃ tu vedhasam | brahmāpi ca kṛpāṃ labdhvātuṣyaccātīva tatkṣaṇam || 7 || mahyaṃ nyavedayattatra yathāyogyaṃ hitaṃ nijam | bhagavan satyaloke me dīpotsavaṃ vidhāpaya || 8 || annakūṭān divyabhogānarpayiṣyāmi bhāvataḥ | sevālābho hi gāyatryāḥ sāvitryāśca bhaviṣyati || 9 || satyavāsisamastānāṃ tatra sevā bhaviṣyati | tavāṅganānāṃ sarvāsāṃ darśanaṃ ca bhaviṣyati || 4.93.1 0|| yadiṣṭaṃ tat satvaraṃ vai vidhehi bhagavan prabho | matpriye’haṃ tadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’gadaṃ tamom || 11 || susvīkṛtavān brahmoktaṃ tasmāt sajje’dya tiṣṭhatam | sarvābhiścāṃganābhirvai svasrā santuṣṭayā saha || 12|| dāsībhiḥ sevikābhiśca lomaśādimaharṣibhiḥ | pārṣadairbhṛtyavargaiśca saha sajjo bhavāmyaham || 1 3|| śrīśvetāyanavyāsa uvāca kṛtvā caikādaśīṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jagatprabhuḥ | śatayojanavistāraṃ vimānaṃ sūkṣmabhāvagam || 14|| vardhayāmāsa sahasā vyomni sarvāsanārhakam | divyaṃ vaikuṇṭhatulyaṃ vai hiraṇyabrahmanāmakam || 15|| sarvarddhisarvabhogāḍhyaṃ sarvakāmaprapūrakam | vimāne’trānādikṛṣṇonārāyaṇaḥśrīvallabhaḥ || 16|| niṣasāda drutaṃ sarvadāsadāsīprasevitaḥ | atha halahalāśabdo yātrārthaṃ cājñayā hareḥ || 17|| abhavat kuṃkumavāpīnagare’bhita ūrdhvagaḥ | nāryaḥ samastaveṣāḍhyā nītabhūṣāmbarāstathā || 18|| sarvaśṛṅgārakaraṇā hyatiṣṭhan yānasannidhau | ājñāṃ dadau sa tāstūrṇaṃ cāruruhurvimānakam || 19|| śrīhariḥ svapitarau sampraṇamyāpi vimānake | dvitīyena svarūpeṇa brahmaṇā lomaśena ca ||4.93.20 || sadbhiḥ svapārṣadaiḥ sarvapriyābhiḥ saṃvyarājata | atha vādyānyavādyanta puṣpacandanavṛṣṭayaḥ |||21||| ambarādabhavam̐statra jayanādāstato’bhavan | atha śrībadarī badrikāśrame śrīnarāyaṇam ||22|| śrutvā ghoṣān divyaśaktyā papraccha śrīhareḥ kathām | kva yānāditadāha śrīnaranārāyaṇo’pi tām ||23|| śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye kṛṣṇo dvāviṃśaṃ svajanermaham | kṛtvā purañjanamokṣottaraṃ satyastaraṃ prati ||24|| gantuṃ sajjo’bhavattatra sevakā api sarvaśaḥ | dvādaśyāṃ te kṛtāhārā vimānasthāḥ sarovaram ||25||| vāpīṃ kṣetrāṇi natvāpi natvā svadvisvarūpiṇam | narā nāryo harṣayuktā yātrārthaṃ niryayurhi khe ||26|| vimānaṃ jayanādaiśca sahitaṃ cāmbare’gragam | śanairgatiparaṃ jātaṃ vimucyābhrāṇi vai kṣaṇāt ||27|| manovegena ca bhuvaḥ svargaṃ maharjanaṃ tapaḥ | satyaṃ prāpa muhūrtena mahāścaryamabhūddhi tat ||28||| sarvāsāṃ yoṣitāṃ dāsīdāsānāṃ vegadarśinām | uddhoṣaḥ sarvato jāto yātrāyāṃ bhagavān yayau |||29|| sarvalokeṣu sarvatra sā vārtā prāsarat kṣaṇāt | yogino devatāścāpi divyajñā vividuḥ kṣaṇāt ||4.93.3 0|| āyayuḥ satyaloke te hariṃ netuṃ nijālayān | kramāt kṛṣṇo’pi tānāha samāgantuṃ yathāyatham ||3 1 || satyaloke tadā sādhvi satyalokanivāsinām | śrīkṛṣṇasyāgame jāte mahānando vyajāyata ||32|| svāgataṃ satyalokasthā brahmaputrāḥ sanātanāḥ | siddhāḥ sanatkumārādyāstathā satyādhikāriṇaḥ ||33|| devāścakrurharestatra vādyamālārhaṇādibhiḥ | phalākṣatasupuṣpādyairlājāsugandhisaddravaiḥ ||34|| brahmā brahmapurīṃ sarvāṃ śṛṅgāraśobhitāṃ vyadhāt | sugandhisiktamārgāṃ ca dhvajapatākikorjitām ||35|| suvarṇakalaśai ramyāṃ hāratoraṇaśobhitām | satyābhirdevikābhiścasuveṣābhiralaṃkṛtām ||36|| mandirāgārasunyastasvastikādivirājitām | kadalīstambhaśākhāḍhyagopuraiḥ śobhitāṃ tadā || 37|| vimānairvāhanairhaṃsairbahubhiḥ saṅkulām | vividhairdivyavādyaiśca nāditāṃ sumanoharām || 38|| satyadevairdevikābhiścāpsarobhiralaṃkṛtām | siṃhavyāghrahaṃsahastimṛgaveṣitasainyikām || 39|| divyakusumairgucchaiśca vikīritāṃ samantataḥ | dadhimāṃgalyasaṃśobhadagārasaudharājitām ||4.93.40|| karāttākṣatapuṣpādisiddhābhiḥ supratīkṣitām | kṛtrimodyānasaṃśobhaccatvarāvāsaśāntidām ||41|| kāmakalpalatāvṛkṣamālābhirabhirājitām | satyāṃ brahmapurīṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hi vedhasā ||42|| nīyamānaścāviveśa vardhitaḥ pūjitaḥ suraiḥ | bhramitvā śrīharirdīrghāṃ satyāṃ vai lakṣayojanām || 43 || vimānaṃ tu sthirīkṛtya haṃsayānamupāviśat | brahmaṇo bhavanaṃ brahmānayacchrīparameśvaram || 44 || brahmā ca brahmaputrāśca sanakādyā maharṣayaḥ | ṛbhuśca nāradādyāśca pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ||45|| pādāmṛtaṃ papuścārārtrikaṃ cakruḥ samutsukāḥ | hārān bhūṣāścandanādi samarpya ca tato’stuvan || 46|| pāvitaḥ satyaloko’yaṃ bhagavan kṛpayā tvayā | sevāyāṃ na samarthāḥ sma kṣamasvāśaktimacyuta ||47|| brahmā divyasabhāyāṃ ca ninye śrīpuruṣottamam | viśrāmaṃ prāpa bhagavān bhojitaścāmṛtādibhiḥ ||48 || atha sāvitrikāgāyatrikāsarasvatīstriyaḥ | sādhvyaśca siddhayaścāpi surāṇyaḥ koṭiśo’pi ca ||49 || pupūjuḥ śrīhariṃ tatra tathā śrīṃ māṇikīṃ ramām | lakṣmīṃ prajñāṃ pāśavatīṃ rādhāṃ ca śāradāṃ satīm || 4.93.50 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnīḥ pūjayāmāsureva tāḥ | upadā vividhāścāpi dadurdivyāstadudbhavāḥ |||51 || tataścārārtrikaṃ cakrurbhojayāmāsurīśvarīḥ | brahmapriyādikāḥ sarvā dāsīrdāsān samastataḥ | | 52|| viśrāntimandireṣvetā dadurviśramaṇaṃ tathā | sarvapradānakairdevyo bhagavatyo’rhaṇāṃ vyadhuḥ ||53 || sevāṃ cakrurmahīmānayoṣitāṃ sarvato’rpaṇaiḥ | brahmābhavat kṛtakṛtyaḥ sāvitryādyā mudānvitāḥ || 54|| sanakādyāḥ sādhavaścābhavan kṛtārthakāstadā | badripriye brahmasatye kṣaṇamātraṃ tu bhūtale || 55|| yugāyutāyate cāpi mānavasya kṛte khalu | na tu yogavatāṃ cāpi bhagavatāṃ tathāvidhā ||56|| īśvarāṇāṃ na ca tathā sutarāṃ śrīharernahi | kāle dairghyaṃ kṛtaṃ yena vāmanatvaṃ kṛtaṃ tathā || 57|| saṃkalpādhīnamasyāsti kā tatra kālakalpanā | badripriye harikṛṣṇaḥ prapūrya brahmaṇo manaḥ ||58 || brahmaṇādiṣṭadevānāṃ mandireṣu yayau tataḥ | saudheṣu sanakādīnāṃ sādhūnāṃ prayayau purā ||5 9|| brahmaśīlavratānāṃ ca naiṣṭhikānāṃ mahātmanām | siddhānāmāśramaśreṣṭheṣvapi nārāyaṇo yayau || 4.93.60 || pūjitaḥ sādhusaṃghaiśca tato gṛhigṛhāṇyapi | satyāvasānikadevālayeṣu bhagavān yayau || 61 || pūjito vanditaḥ sarvairbhojito’mṛtasadrasaiḥ | nīrājito vardhitaścāyayau brahmālayaṃ punaḥ || 62|| dhanalakṣmīmahāpūjāṃ brahmādyāścakrire tataḥ | trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapūjāṃ pracakrire || 63 || dīpāvalyāṃ śāradāśrīmahāpūjāṃ pracakrire | koṭisiddhāḥ koṭisanto naiṣṭhikā brahmakoṭikāḥ || 64|| ṛbhurnīrājanaṃ cakre brahmāpyapūjayan mudā | sāvitryādyāḥ satīnāryo lakṣmīpūjāṃ pracakrire || 65|| divyasārairamṛtādyairabhiṣekaṃ pracakrire | śṛṅgārāṇi samastāni samastabhūṣaṇāni ca || 66 || samastaveṣasaubhāgyaṃ lakṣmyā devyāḥ pracakrire | satyalokaṃ brahmadīpāvalikoṭisamujjvalam || 6 7|| cakrire dīpanivahaiḥ puṇyātmakaiḥ samastataḥ | nṛtagītamahāmodāmṛtādimiṣṭabhojanaiḥ || 68 || mahīmānamahānandaṃ janayāmāsurīśikāḥ | annakūṭotsavaṃ brahmā cakāra bahuvastukam ||69|| satyalokānnanivahān pācitān susudhābhṛtān | miṣṭānnāni samastāni kṣārānnāni tathaiva ca ||4.93.70 || rasyānnāni ca bhakṣyāṇi bhojyāni vividhānyapi | lehyāni rasayuktāni peyāni vividhāni ca ||7 1 || āsvādyāni samastāni coṣyāṇi cottamāni ca | tiktamiṣṭāmblakaṭūni pravāhitāni yānyapi |72|| sahāyakāni sarvāṇi rūkṣaśuṣkāṇi yāni ca | bharjitāni saṃskṛtāni divyagandharasāni ca ||7 3 || śākapatrāṇi ramyāṇi bhājā bhājīḥ rasaplutāḥ | kandamūlāni sarvāṇi phalapuṣpāṇi yānyapi ||74|| utkṛṣṭotkṛṣṭarūpāṇi sarvakalākṛtāni ca | svarṇapātreṣu mahāsthāleṣu koṭyarbudeṣu ca ||75|| divyabhājanavaryeṣu kalaśeṣu jalāni ca | sākṣātphalāni puṣpāṇi bījāni mañjarīstathā ||76|| saṃskṛtya śimbikāścāpi nyadhuḥ śrīharisannidhau | svarṇahaṃsāsane rājatkṛṣṇo brahmapriyādibhiḥ |||77|| bubhuje brahmaṇādiṣṭaḥ sāvitryādibhirarcitaḥ | praśaṃsyānnāni bhagavān śrīprajñāmādhavīdhavaḥ ||78 || gāyatryādyā brahmapatnyo vyajanaiḥ pavanaṃ daduḥ | sāvitryādyāḥ punastatra pariveṣaṇamācaran ||79 || haristṛpto hareḥ patnyo dāsyo dāsāśca sevakāḥ | sādhavaḥ pārṣadāstṛptāśculukaṃ ca vyadhustataḥ ||4.93.8 0 || vāryamṛtaṃ papuścāpi mukhavāsaṃ ca jagṛhuḥ | tāmbūlakaṃ tu bhagavān sarvāśca śrīharipriyāḥ ||8 1|| mukhavāsāni cānyāni divyapūgīphalānyapi | tathā sugandhibījāni śītakaṇāṃśca jagṛhuḥ ||82||| bhuktvotthāya harikṛṣṇo niṣasāda mahāsane | brahmā ca brahmapatnyaśca brahmaputrādayastathā ||8 3||| prasādaṃ śrīhareḥ sarve vubhujire’tibhāvataḥ | sanakādyā ṛṣayaśca ṛbhvādyā naiṣṭhikottamāḥ ||84|| satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ śāradādyā bubhujire prasādakam | tataḥ śrībhagavān satyalokavāsibhya ādarāt |||85||| śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇe prāptān dadau mantraṃ nijaṃ svayam | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ||86|| oṃ bālakṛṣṇāya vidmahe’nādikṛṣṇāya dhīmahi | tannaḥ śrīśaḥ pracodayādīti mantraṃ dadau tathā ||89||| satyaloke koṭiśo’pi siddhāḥ sādhyāśca naiṣṭhikāḥ | pūrvaprapūrvakalpīyadevādyā nyavasam̐śca ye ||88|| sarve te vaiṣṇavā jātāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśritāḥ | devā devyaḥ samastā vai nāmadhunyaṃ pracakrire ||89|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin ramāyaṇa ||4.93.90 || ityevamutsavaṃ brahmā cānnakūṭasya saṃvyadhāt | dakṣādyāḥ brahmaputrāśca nāradādyā maharṣayaḥ ||9 1 || satyalokagatāḥ kṛṣṇaprasādaṃ jagṛhurmudā | nṛtyaṃ ca kīrtanaṃ cakrurgāndharvā nāradādayaḥ ||92|| brahmasaraso’psaraso vyadhurnṛtyāni vai mudā | yogino yatayaḥ siddhāstāpasā brahmacāriṇaḥ |||93|| cakrire nāmadhunyaṃ ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhoḥ | apunarmārakā devāḥ satyāḥ satyanivāsinaḥ ||94|| pūjanaṃ śrīhareścakrurāgatya brahmamandiram | prasādaṃ jagṛhuste ca mantraṃ ca jagṛhurhareḥ ||95|| atha śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prasādya vedhasam | viṣṇunābhiṣṭutaḥ prāyānnārāyaṇālayaṃ tataḥ ||96|| viṣṇulokaṃ viśālaṃ vai prāpya viṣṇostu mandire | viṣṇunā ca śriyā sarvapārṣadaiḥ kṛtamuttamam ||97|| svāgataṃ pūjanaṃ divyakaustubhādyarpaṇaṃ mudā | jagrāhorjasya pūrṇāyāṃ tithau padmāvatīpatiḥ ||98|| bhojanaṃ ca śubhaṃ pānaṃ prāpya pūjāṃ śriyā kṛtām | vimānena yayau jyotirmayaṃ harapuraṃ prabhuḥ ||99|| koṭikoṭigaṇo’dhyakṣo haro muditamānasaḥ | abhyāyayau hariṃ cakre daṇḍavat gaṇakoṭibhiḥ || 4.93.1 00|| jyotirmaye pure kṛṣṇaṃ bhrāmayitvā vimānagam | naije svarṇālaye ninye pupūja puṣparatnakaiḥ || 101 || ārārtrikaṃ cakārāpi bhojayāmāsa cāmṛtam | sarvānugayutaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sevayāmāsa śaṃkaraḥ || 102|| gaṇā gaṇikāḥ satyaśca śrīsatīsahitā hareḥ | lakṣmyādīnāṃ ca śuśrūṣāṃ cakrire hyatibhāvataḥ || 1 03|| haristebhyo dadau mantraṃ tābhyaśca naijamuttamam | vaiṣṇavān saṃvidhāyaivāsādya pūjāṃ tataḥ param ||104|| svayaṃbhūmanunāgatyārthitaḥ kṛṣṇo yayau saha | arcitaḥ pūjitaḥ sarvasampadbhirvardhitaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 05|| sevitaḥ śatarūpādinārībhiḥ śrīpramāpatiḥ | pratoṣya taṃ manuṃ cānyamanūnāmālayān yayau || 1 06|| sarve te manavaḥ svasvamandire cāṃganāyutam | avasthāpya manuṃ prāpya pupūjuḥ sampadā harim || 1 07|| manūnāṃ patnikāḥ kṛṣṇapatnīḥ pupūjurādarāt | ārārtrikaṃ tataścakrurbhojanāni vyadhustathā || 1 08|| tebhyaḥ prasanno bhagavān dadau pādau tu vakṣasi | prasthāpitastataḥ kṛṣṇo vimānena nijena tu || 1 09|| samāpya bhramaṇaṃ satye tapolokamupāgamat | badrīpriye mārgaśīrṣe sarvasvavargasaṃyutaḥ || 4.93.11 0|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne brahmaṇārthiṃto bhagavān koṭyarbudādipatnyādisahitaḥ śatayojanavimānena satyalokaṃ yayau, tatra dīpotsavānnakūṭādimahotsave brahmasiddhayatimanuprabhṛtibhiḥ pūjito haristān sukhayitvā tapolokamājagāmetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 93 ||
<4.94> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye prajñāpārāvatīśvaraḥ | tapolokaṃ prājagāma tāpasānāṃ nivāsanam || 1 || aryamādikapitṝṇāṃ puṇyasthānaṃ paraṃ divam | pūrvakalpodbhavāḥ sthānadhiṣṇyādhikāriṇaḥ surāḥ || 2 || adhikāraṃ samāpyaiva yatra vasanti nirbhayāḥ | ṛṣayo munayaścāpi pitaraḥ śrāvaṇāśca ye || 3 || yāmyāḥ samvatsarāḥ kālāḥ kālādhidevatāśca yāḥ | ye naiṣṭhikāstāpasāśca vṛddhāḥ puṇyābhiyoginaḥ || 4 || vairājāśca tathā devāḥ sarvathā dāhavarjitāḥ | prājāpatyā devatāśca saumyā barhiṣadastathā || 5 || agniṣvāttāśca kāvyāśca ṛtavaḥ somapāstathā | aṣṭakāpatayaścāpi lekhāstathoṣmapā api || 6 || divākīrtyāśca pitaraśchandajāḥ pitarastathā | śrāddhadevāśca pitaro yajvāno’yonijāstathā || 7 || brahmacaryeṇa tapasā yajñena prajayā tathā | śraddhayā vidyayā dānaiḥ śraddhāyuktena karmaṇā || 8 || paralokagatā ye te yatra vasanti tāpase | vāruṇā bhṛgavaścāpi āgneyāṅgirasāstathā || 9 || mārīcāścātreyakāśca paulastyāḥ paulahāstathā | vāśiṣṭhā vasavaścāpi brahmāṇaḥ pitaraśca te || 4.94.10 || prajāpataya evaite yamo rājā prajāpatiḥ | kārdamāḥ kāśyapāḥ śaiṣā vikrāntāḥ suśravādayaḥ || 1 1|| bahuputrāḥ kumārāśca vivasvantaḥ śuciśravāḥ | prācetaso’riṣṭanemirbahulāḥ pitaraśca te || 4 2|| kuśoccayāśca pitaraḥ prājāpataya eva te | bālakhilyāstathā vaikhānasā aśvisutāvubhau || 1 3|| ete sarve tapoloke vasanti puṇyabhoginaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tatra samāgatam || 14|| viditvā cāryamā rājā koṭisainyaiśca tāpasaiḥ | devībhirmātṛbhiryuktaḥ kṛṣṇasannidhimāyayau || 15|| āryamṇīṃ nijanagarīṃ śṛṃgāraiḥ sarvatomukhīm | prāveśayaddhariṃ sarvastrīvimānasamanvitam || 1 6|| mahāsaudhe nije siṃhāsane’ryamā nyaṣādayat | apūjayaddhariṃ ratnaiḥ puṣpaiḥ suvarṇabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 17|| candanādyaiśca pīyūṣairamṛtairakṣatādibhiḥ | abhojayaddivyabhogairbhojyānnairvividhaistathā || 18|| ārārtrikaṃ cakārāpi pāpau pādajalāmṛtam | āryādevī ca tatpatnī rājñī pitṛśarīriṇām || 19|| pupūja paramātmānaṃ tathā brahmapriyādikāḥ | bhojayāmāsa sarvāstā āryādevī hi mātṛkā ||4.94.20|| atha saudhe pauṣamāse kṛṣṇo’ryamṇo vasam̐stataḥ | tapolokanivāsānānāmālayeṣu yayau muhuḥ ||2 1 || mahāśveto vāmadevādayo ye tu maharṣayaḥ | svasvamandiravaryeṣu śrīkṛṣṇamanayanmudā ||22|| sarvasārthasahitaṃ taṃ hyapūjayan yathādhanam | brahmasattvāyanādyāśca munayo’pyanayaddharim ||23||| yathādhanaṃ ca satkāraṃ hyakurvan bhāvasaṃbhṛtāḥ | śravaṇādyāḥ pitaraśca pitṛrājyakarā api ||24|| sapatnīkāḥ sapatnīkaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ svagṛhe’nayan | apūjayannabhojayan tathāśṛṃgārayan prabhum |||25||| tathā yāmyāḥ pitaraśca dharmadhanākhyamukhyakāḥ | sahasraśo hariṃ nītvā svālayeṣvabhyapūjayan ||26|| tathā samvatsaraparivatsarādyāśca pitṛkāḥ | svasvakuṭumbasahitāḥ svālayeṣvanayan prabhum ||27|| apūjayan yathādravyaṃ hyabhojayan sudhānnakam | ārārtrikaṃ pracakruśca daduḥ svarṇamaṇīn bahūn |||28|| tathā kālādhidevākhyāḥ ṛtavo māsapakṣakāḥ | pitaraḥ śrīhariṃ ninyurnijālaye samārcayan ||29|| atha ye naiṣṭhikā vṛddhāstāpasāḥ puṇyasañcayāḥ | pitaraḥ puṇyajananābhidhāste’pyanayan harim ||4.94.30|| svasvālayeṣu vidhivat pupūjuḥ parameśvaram | atha vairājadevāśca tapolokanivāsinaḥ ||3 1 || svarṇadahanapramukhā ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | svasvālayeṣu vidhivad rājādhirājavat prabhum || 32|| pūjayāmāsurīśeśaṃ maṇiratnāni te daduḥ | atha prājāpatyadevāstapolokanivāsinaḥ |||33|| yogāhārābhidhādyāśca ninyuḥ pārvīprabhumpatim | svasvālayeṣu deveśaṃ pupūjuḥ paramādṛtāḥ || 34|| ārārtrikādikaṃ cakrurbhojayāmāsuracyutam | atha saumyāśca pitaraścāndrāyaṇādināminaḥ ||35|| ninyuḥ śrīparamātmānaṃ nijālayeṣu bhāvataḥ | amṛtādyaiḥ samānarcurbhojayāmāsuramṛtam ||36|| candrakāntādiratnāni daduḥ pūjākṣaṇe ca te | atha barhiṣadāścāpi pitaraḥ kuśikādayaḥ ||37|| svasvālayeṣu nāthaṃ taṃ ninyurānarcurutsukāḥ | yathādhanaṃ ca satkāraṃ pracakrurbhojanādibhiḥ ||38|| atha ye pitaraścāgniṣvāttādyā bhāsurādayaḥ | ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ svasvasaudheṣvānarcuracyutam ||39|| pāyasādīni bhojyāni daduste pāvanāni vai | atha ye kāvyapitaro’pakvabhojanarāgiṇaḥ ||4.94.40|| ninyuste paramātmānaṃ svasvālayeṣvapūjayan | atha somāyanādyāśca somapāśca sudhāśinaḥ ||41|| ninyuste śrīhariṃ svasvālayeṣvānarcurutsukāḥ | sudhābhojyāni ramyāṇi kārayāmāsuracyutam || 82|| athāṣṭakāpatayo’pi tāpasāḥ pitaro’pi ca | uttathyakāyanādyāśca ninyurnijālaye harim |||42||| pupūjurbhojayāmāsurārārtrikādikaṃ vyadhuḥ | atha lekhāśca pitaro vipralīpādayo harim ||44|| ninyurnijāśramaṃ harṣādānarcuścopadā daduḥ | bhojayāmāsuratyarthaṃ sevayāmāsurīśvaram ||45|| athoṣmapāśca pitaraḥ phenilehādayo harim | ninyurnijāśrameṣvevānarcuḥ śrīpuruṣottamam ||46|| navanītādibhojyāni daduste ca yathādhanam | atha ye tu divākīrtyāḥ pitaraḥ ṛṣikādayaḥ ||47|| te’pi ninyurhariṃ naijālayeṣvānarcurutsukāḥ | chandajāḥ pitaraścāpi ninyuranuṣṭupādayaḥ ||48 || hariṃ nijālayeṣvānarcuḥ prabhuṃ parameśvaram | śrāddhadevāśca pitaro ninyuḥ śrīśaṃ nijālayam ||49|| pupūjurbhojayāmāsurārārtrikādikaṃ vyadhuḥ | yajvāno bhūbhṛtaścāpi cakravartina eva ye |||4.94.50|| tapoloke sthitāste’pi ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ gṛhe | pupūjū rājayogyaiśca vastubhirbahumānataḥ ||51 || upadāśca daduḥ śreṣṭhā bhojayāmāsuracyutam | vāruṇā bhārgavāścāpi āgneyāḥ pitarastathā |||52|| āṅgīrasāśca mārīcā ātreyakāśca tāpasāḥ | paulastyāḥ paulahāścāpi vāśiṣṭhā vasavaśca ye ||53||| bhinnabhinnāśramāste’pi prajānāṃ patayo’malāḥ | ninyuḥ svasvāśrameṣvenaṃ śrīpatiṃ rādhikāpatim ||54|| tapoloke tamānarcurbhojayāmāsurutsukāḥ | yamaḥ prajāpatiścāpi nināya svālaye prabhum ||55|| kārdamāḥ kāśyapāḥ śaiṣā vikrāntāḥ suśravādayaḥ | bahuputrāśca pitaraḥ kumārāḥ pitaro’pi ca ||56|| prācetaso vivasvanto’riṣṭanemaya ityapi | kuśoccayāśca pitaro ninyurnārāyaṇeśvaram ||57||| svasvālayeṣu cānarcurupadābhirmudānvitāḥ | bhojayāmāsuratyarthaṃ sevayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||58|| vālyakhilyāśca ṛṣayo vaikhānasāśca ye tathā | devavaidyau bhagavantau tathānye tapaāśritāḥ ||59||| svasvālayeṣu devīśaṃ sapatnīkaṃ vimānakaiḥ | ninyurānarcurārārtrikaṃ vyadhuścopadā daduḥ ||4.94.60 || bhojayāmāsurutkṛṣṭāmṛtānnāni gṛhe gṛhe | bhrāmayāmāsurīśeśaṃ grāme grāme gṛhe gṛhe ||61 || śayanāsanabhogām̐śca daduste gandhimālikāḥ | bhūṣā veṣām̐śca pradadurmaṇiratnasragādikam |||62||| pātrāsanānarghyaśṛṅgārādi daduryathāyatham | navīnopakaraṇāni daduste kamaleśine ||63|| āhārām̐śca vihārām̐ścārpayāmāsuḥ parātmane | puṇyodyāneṣu vāṭīṣu vanāraṇyādribhūmiṣu ||64|| nijarājyeṣu saudheṣu prajāsu vasatiṣvapi | bhrāmayitvā sarvarājaṃ pāvayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||65||| papuḥ pādāmṛtaṃ te te tāstāśca yoṣitaḥ śubhāḥ | bhojayitvā hariṃ tasya prasādaṃ lebhire striyaḥ ||66|| naijaṃ saubhāgyamutkṛṣṭaṃ dhanyaṃ bhāgyaṃ ca menire | nārāyaṇaprasaṃgena kṛtakṛtyā babhūvire ||67|| rāmayāmāsurīśeśaṃ svasvasampatpradānakaiḥ | sevayāmāsuratyarthaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ śayaneśvaram ||68|| prāṇeśaṃ bhojayāmāsurarpayāmāsuruttamam | dravyaṃ dhanaṃ sugandhaṃ ca divyaṃ veṣaṃ ca bhūṣaṇam ||69|| kṛṣṇamāndolayāmāsurdolāsu bahuyoṣitaḥ | pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakruraṃgānāṃ mardanaṃ tathā ||4.94.70|| svasvakalānāṃ kauśalyaṃ darśayāmāsuragrataḥ | oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyasvāmine svāhā ||7 1 || bālakṛṣṇāya vidmahe’nādikṛṣṇāya dhīmahi | tannaḥ śrīśaḥ pracodayādītimantrau ca jagṛhuḥ ||72|| kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakānta ramāyaṇa ||73||| evaṃ te jagṛhurnāmadhunyaṃ śrīmādhavīśituḥ | mātaraṃ śrīramālakṣmīprajñārhaṇāṃ pracakrire ||74|| tathā devyo brahmanārīḥ pupūjuścopadānvitāḥ | nṛtyagītotsavām̐ścakruḥ svāvāse yajjanārdanaḥ ||75|| sarvārpaṇaṃ pracakruśca brahmeśāya parātmane | tuṣṭuvuḥ śrījayākāntaṃ narā nāryaśca tāpasāḥ ||76|| namaḥ sarvāvatārāṇāmavatāriparātmane | muktānāṃ maṇḍalāvāsāyāpi mānuṣavāsine ||77|| kṛpālave satyalokalābhadāya ca te namaḥ | namastāpasadevāya tapolokāgatāya te ||78|| namo mokṣapradātre te namaḥ pitṛpramocine | namo’nantasvarūpāyānantaśaktyabhiśāline ||79|| namo brahmapriyākāntasvarūpāyāntarātmane | haripriyābhisevyāya bālakṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ||4.94.80|| tapolokastapaḥprāpyastapaḥkṣaye kṣayaṃ vrajet | tāpasāśca gataiśvaryā naśyanti bhavasāgare ||8 1 || hariṃ vinā na vai muktiḥ so’yaṃ bhavānupāgataḥ | uddhāraya tapolokāt saṃsārasāgarāditaḥ ||82||| pūrveṣāṃ kalpakālānāṃ puṇyabhājo vayaṃ tviha | kṛpayā nivasāmo hi yadyapi śrībhujaḥ sadā ||83|| tathāpi tava sānnidhyaṃ pādayoḥ pūjanaṃ tu naḥ | kadāpi prāpyate naiva nāvāpyeta kṛpāṃ vinā ||84|| svargasatyāntalokānāṃ nivāsināṃ tu sarvathā | mahāpuṇyāni santyeva kevalabandhanāni hi ||85|| naiva puṇyaphalaṃ bhogamantarānyat pravartate | iyaṃ tu karuṇā te’tra hare yad darśanaṃ tava ||86|| varaṃ tu bhūtale janma yatra kṛṣṇo hyavāpyate | na dinaṃ tu vinā kṛṣṇaṃ sākṣāt pṛthvīgataṃ kvacit ||87|| anyalokeṣvekavāraṃ samāyāsyati gauravāt | mahākāryanivahārthaṃ sarvathā dṛśyase nahi ||88|| varaṃ bhūtapiśācādijanma devarṣipitṛtaḥ | yatra kvāpi milenmuktiryogataḥ śrīhareḥ satām ||89|| tadadya bhagavān prāpto dayāśevadhiracyutaḥ | kuru naḥ sarvathā mokṣamarthayāmo varaṃ tviyam ||4.94.9 0|| śṛṇu badrīpriye devi śrutvā teṣāṃ tadarthanām | purāṇapitṛnivahān śrāddhāpekṣakajīvinām ||91 || purāṇātipurāṇānāṃ mokṣamiyeṣa satvaram | badrike śrīharistām̐śca pāyayāmāsa cāmṛtam ||92|| pādāmṛtaṃ prasādādi bhojayāmāsa sakṛpaḥ | teṣāṃ vakṣaḥsu caraṇau dadau bandhaharau sukhī ||93|| divyatādhāyakau ramyau rādhālakṣmyādisevitau | ūrdhvarekhānvitau raktatalau ca mṛdulāvati ||94|| aṣṭakoṇasvastikāmyā vajrajambūjavāṃkuśaiḥ | ketupadmasucakrādyairyuktaṃ dakṣapadaṃ śubham ||95|| trikoṇakalaśābhyāṃ ca gopādamakarāmbaraiḥ | dhanurmīnārdhacandraiśca mandiracakrakairyutam ||96|| vāmapādaṃ pravīkṣyāpi tuṣṭiṃ te paramāṃ yayuḥ | mastakeṣu nyadhāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ karadvayam ||97|| komalaṃ raktatalakaṃ candrāṃśanakharājitam | mīnadhvajadhanusvastiśaraśūlavirājitam || 98|| catuścakramahādaṇḍaśaṃkhalekhādiśobhitam | dakṣaṃ karaṃ harervīkṣyānandaṃ paraṃ hi lebhire ||99|| vāmaṃ suśobhanaṃ ramyaṃ chatradhenulatānvitam | nirmīcakrayutaṃ cakracatuṣṭayābjarājitam || 4.94.100 || śaṃkhena rekhitaṃ madhyāṃgulyagraṃ vīkṣya te tadā | divyadṛṣṭiyutā jātāḥ sakthna lakṣmīṃ tu vāmake || 101 || rādhāṃ tu jaghane vīkṣya mahānandaṃ prapedire | kṛṣṇasya kṛpayā tūrṇaṃ visṛjya pitṛputtalān || 1 02|| divyadehā abhavam̐śca bahavaḥ pitarastadā | muktā muktānikā jātāḥ pitaro mātaro gaṇāḥ || 10 3|| āyayuśca vimānāni mukteritāni dhāmataḥ | sthitvā niṣadya te teṣu yayurdhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ || 1 04|| ityevaṃ badrike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hi mokṣaṇam | datvā prasādya tān tatra nivasitān prabhāṣya ca || 1 05|| aryamādikṛtārcaśca vimānena svayaṃ prabhuḥ | sarvasārthayutaḥ prasthāpito janaṃ samāyayau || 1 06|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śrīharistapolokanivāsināṃ pitrādidevagaṇānāṃ bhavaneṣu cāryamādikṛtapūjāṃ samprāpya pitṝṇāṃ mokṣaṃ kṛtvā janalokamājagāmetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturnavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 94 ||
<4.95> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi bhagavān pauṣamāsake | janalokaṃ sādhyadevāśritaṃ samāyayau tataḥ || 1 || tatra devāḥ sādhyasaṃjñā jayākhyāḥ pitarastathā | yajñabhājaḥ paradevāḥ svāgataṃ śrīharervyadhuḥ || 2 || brahmaṇo ye mukhājjātā jayā devāḥ prajepsavaḥ | sarve mantraśarīrāste hareḥ svāgatamācaran || 3 || darśākhyaḥ pūrṇamāsākhyo bṛhadvaryo rathantaraḥ | citiścāpi vicittiśca ākūtiḥ kūtirityapi || 4 || vijñātaśca mano yajñaścaite jayākhyadevatāḥ | yajñanārāyaṇasaudhe rājādhirājaśobhite || 5 || yajñadevo hariṃ tatra nivāsaṃ samakārayat | pupūja parayā prītyārārtrikaṃ ca vyadhāttathā || 6 || bhojayāmāsa pīyūṣaṃ sevayāmāsa bhāvataḥ | tuṣitā nāma devāśca tato ninyurnijālaye || 7 || pupūjuḥ parayā prītyā nīrājanaṃ vyadhurhareḥ | tataśca harayo devā ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || 8 || ānarcurbahusampattyā bhojayāmāsuracyutam | vaikuṇṭhā nāma vai devā janalokanivāsinaḥ || 9 || ninyuḥ svamandire kṛṣṇaṃ pupūjuḥ paramādṛtāḥ | haṃsaḥ prāṇaḥ prabhavaścārārtrikaṃ śrīharervyadhuḥ || 4.95.1 0|| aṣṭāpi vasavaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ ninyurnijālāyan prati | dharo dhruvaśca somaśca āpaścāpyanilo’nalaḥ || 1 1|| pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaścānarcuḥ śrīpuruṣottamam | maṇiratnāni bahūni pradaduḥ paramātmane || 12|| atha ninyuviśvadevāḥ kraturdakṣaḥ śravaḥ stavaḥ | kāmaḥ satyo dhuniḥ kālaḥ kuruḥ prabhuśca rocanaḥ || 13|| pupūjuḥ paramīśānaṃ śrīkāntaṃ kambharātmajam | ārārtrikaṃ vyadhuścāpi bhojayāmāsuracyutam || 14|| viṣṇurvai mānasākhyaścājitaścāpi haristathā | satyo viṣṇuśca vaikuṇṭhaḥ sādhyo viṣṇustrivikramaḥ || 15|| ta ete viṣṇavaḥ sarve janaloke kṛtālayāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇana rāyaṇamāhūya mandire || 16 || pupūjurviṣṇuyantāraṃ parabrahma pumuttamam | abhiṣekaṃ pracakruste śrīgopālātmajasya vai || 17|| śṛṃgāraṃ śobhanaṃ pūjāmārārtrikaṃ tato vyadhuḥ | bhojanāni pradaduśca tāmbūlakāni vai tataḥ || 18|| vaiṣṇavāśca janāḥ sarve tathānarcuḥ pareśvaram | vaiṣṇavya indirāḥ sarvāḥ pupūjuḥ śrīramāpriyāḥ || 19|| lakṣmīrādhābrahmapriyā haripriyāśca yoṣitaḥ | indirābhiścārpitāścopadā lakṣmyādisannidhau ||4.95.20 || bhojitāḥ pūjitāścāpi sevitā mātaro’khilāḥ | pradadurviṣṇavaścāpīndirādyā bhūṣaṇāni ha || 21 || sauvarṇaṃ mukuṭaṃ divyaṃ sāgraṃ ratnādisaṃbhṛtam | kuṇḍale śobhane divye karṇapūrau ca kānakau |||22|| kaṇṭhahārān kaustubhāḍhyān maṇiratnādiyojitān | bhujabandhau hīrakādyaiḥ khacitau kānakau daduḥ ||23|| prakoṣṭhaśṛṃkhale svarṇamauktikādivibhūṣite | kaṭake kānake cāpyaṅgulīyakāni cormikāḥ ||24|| padmāni raśanā hārān sudarśanāni vai daduḥ | vetraṃ yaṣṭiṃ kānakīṃ ca naktakaṃ divyatantujam ||25|| pāduke pādabhūṣe ca sauvarṇe divyakānake | pradadurharaye badri viṣṇavaste haripriyāḥ ||26|| haripriyābhyaḥ pradadurindirādyā mahopadāḥ | kucalīḥ kutaladhrīśca śāṭikā kañcukīstathā ||27|| ghargharīścāntarapaṭānyapi daduḥ subhāvitāḥ | keśabhūṣāścandrakāni cipiṭikāḥ sugucchakān || 28|| veṇīveṣān kānakām̐śca dhammiladhrān suvarṇajān | cūḍāmaṇīn taijasām̐śca nandamauktikabhūṣitān || 29|| divyā lalantikāścāpi gaṇḍapadmalalantikāḥ | cibūkacandrikāścāpi karṇaśṛṃkhalikāḥ śubhāḥ ||4.95.3 0|| śrāvaṇīḥ kānakīścāpyālambarāṇīḥ suśobhitāḥ | puṣpakāṇi kānakāni sthalakāni śubhānyapi |||3 1 || tārakā vardhikāścāpi candrikā pradaduḥ striyaḥ | patrikāḥ pañcasarikāḥ sūkṣmatilām̐śca kānakān ||32|| mudgamālāḥ svastimālā badarīmālikā daduḥ | yavamālāḥ svarṇamāṣāḥ suvarṇakaṇṭhikā daduḥ |||33|| patramālāḥ śṛṃkhalāśca maṇimauktikamālikāḥ | dadurindivaraśyāmā vaiṣṇavyaḥ padmamālikāḥ || 34|| sphāṭikānāṃ śubhān hārān sūryamukhīṃ dadustadā | stanacandrau maṇiratnanaddhakānakanirmitau ||35||| natthikā vālikāḥ svarṇajanyā maṇivibhūṣitāḥ | pāṭalīmālikāścāpi maṇihārān daduḥ striyaḥ || 36|| kaṇṭhavalayān sauvarṇatilasrajaśca mādalīḥ | plakṣadalīṃ mahāhārān raśanā mekhalā daduḥ |||37|| svarṇagucchān kandukām̐śca sauvarṇān cakrakān daduḥ | sakthipaṭṭān jānupaṭṭān prakoṣṭhaśṛṅkhalā daduḥ ||38|| jhāṃjharīḥ kāmbikāścāpi daduḥ kadalikāḥ śubhāḥ | pādabhūṣāṃgulibhūṣāṃguṣṭhabhūṣā daduḥ striyaḥ || 39|| alaktakān kajjalāni śṛṃgārakuṃkumāni ca | raṃgān dravān dravasārān tailasārāṇi vai daduḥ ||4.95.40|| rasasārān gandhasārān miṣṭasārāṇi saṃdaduḥ | ambarāṇi bhāsvarāṇi svarṇatāramayāni ca ||41|| divyamauktikanaddhāni dadustābhyastu cendirāḥ | pātrāṇi kundanajāni divyopakaraṇānyapi ||42||| sarvasārātisārāṇi gṛhopakaraṇāni ca | indirāḥ indirābhyaḥ sandaduḥ śayyāḥ samujjvalāḥ ||43|| āsamāni vicitrāṇi keśasādhanakānyapi | ādarśān saurabhacūrṇān pūjāyāṃ pradaduḥ striyaḥ ||44|| pādatrāṇāni ramyāṇi komalāni mṛdūni ca | ālekhanāni ramyāṇi kirīṭān pradaduḥ striyaḥ ||45|| ityevaṃ janalokasthā viṣṇavaścendirāstathā | haraye haripatnībhya upadāḥ subhagā daduḥ ||46 || sevayāmāsuratyarthaṃ janaloke tu badrike | poṣamāsaṃ janaloke bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ || 47|| vyatyayāmāsa janināṃ snehāgrahaprasevanaiḥ | parvatodyānasarito lokayāmāsa sarvataḥ ||48 || darśayāmāsa bhagavān sarvā bhagavatīrnijāḥ | janalokanivāsibhyo dadau mantraṃ hariḥ svayam ||49|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | bālakṛṣṇāya vidmahe’nādikṛṣṇāya dhīmahi ||4.95.50 || tannaḥ śrīśaḥ pracodayādītimantraṃ jagāda tān | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakṛṣṇanārāyaṇa narāyaṇa ||51 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin ramāyaṇa | itidhunyaṃ dadau tebhyaḥ pāvayitvā tato hariḥ ||52|| bahubhyaḥ preṣayāmāsa dhāmākṣaraṃ nijaṃ drutam | yajñadevādayo devā vidāyaṃ haraye daduḥ ||53 || harirmāghe janalokānmaharlokaṃ samāyayau | kalpādhikāridevānāṃ dvijānāṃ yatra vāsitā ||54|| rudrā ekādaśa ye te brahmaputrāstu bhālajāḥ | pūrvakalpodbhavāḥ kalpāvasānikā mahargatāḥ ||55|| teṣāṃ rājyeṣu bhagavān rudrārthita upāyayau | nīlalohitarudrasya mahāpuryāṃ janārdanam | |56|| nīlalohitarudro vai pupūja rudrikāyutaḥ | ārārtrikaṃ pracakāra bhojayāmāsa keśavam ||57|| vāsamāmāsa saudhe sve sevayāmāsa sapriyaḥ | dadau kṛṣṇāya bahulopadā divyāḥ prapūjane ||58 || mukuṭāmbarabhūṣādi maṇiratnavibhūtikāḥ | athānye ye rudravaryā ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ harim || 59|| nijālayeṣu vidhivat pūjayāmāsuracyutam | sahasraikavṛṣabhāṇāṃ dhavalānāṃ prabhājuṣām ||4.95.60 || kakudvatāṃ surūpāṇāṃ giriśṛṃgābhadehinām | vyomagānāṃ hi dhuryāṇāṃ yojite kānake rathe || 61 || sahasraikakalaśāḍhye sahasraikadhvajānvite | śatakammānikājuṣṭe vartule padmasadṛśe || 62|| svarṇavyāghrāsane kṛṣṇaṃ rudrā nyaṣādayan harim | abhrāmayannijapuryāṃ raudryāṃ sarvatra meśvaram || 63 || gṛhe gṛhe ca rathyāsu catvare catvare tathā | udyāneṣu nivāseṣu rudrā ninyurhariṃ prabhum || 64|| pupujuḥ parayā prītyā rudrāstatra sthale sthale | rudrāṇyo dhavalābhāśca pupūjuḥ pārvatīśvaram ||65|| candanākṣatagandhaiśca phalapuṣpairvibhūtibhiḥ | bhūṣāvastranāṇakaiśca divyamānasabhāvanaiḥ ||66 || pūvakalpāntikā devā aṣṭāviṃśatikoṭayaḥ | nītvā nītvālayān naijānānarcurbahurūpiṇam ||67|| bhojayāmāsuriṣṭānnānyatidivyāmṛtānyapi | sevayāmāsurīśeśaṃ devāste devatāyutāḥ ||68|| ānandākhyāśca ye devā bhāvadevāśca ye tathā | rāṃbhadevā ārtavāśca āśvarāḥ pāvakāḥ surāḥ ||69|| havyavāhāśca sāvitrā auśikāḥ kauśikāstathā | ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ svasvamandireṣvabhyapūjayan ||4.95.70 || bhojayāmāsurīśeśaṃ siṣevire samādṛtāḥ | atha gāndhāradevāśca ṣaḍjanā ārṣabhāḥ surāḥ ||7 1 || mārjālīyāstathā devā mādhyamā ninyuracyutam | divyayāne hariṃ naijanagareṣu vyavartayan ||72|| apūjayam̐śca vividhairupahārairanuttamaiḥ | abhojayam̐śca bahudhā divyānnairdivyabhojanaiḥ ||73 || atha vairājakāścānye naiṣādā meghavāhanāḥ | prāṇadevāścintakāścākūtikā mānasāḥ surāḥ || 74|| ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ svasvasaudheṣu cābhyapūjayan | rāthantarāḥ surāścāpi sadyojātā harāstathā ||75|| vīrāśca vāmadevāśca pītavāsādayaḥ surāḥ | sitakalpā aghorāśca viśvarūpāśca ye surāḥ ||76|| ninyuste paramātmānaṃ svasvālayeṣu bhāvitāḥ | abhrāmayan hariṃ naije naije tu pattane gṛhe ||77|| apūjayan maṇiratnairdivyaiḥ sarvopacārakaiḥ | abhojayan sudhānnaiścātarpayannamṛtairjalaiḥ ||78|| rudrāścakrustāṇḍavāni nārāyaṇasamīpagāḥ | nīlalohitarudro vai sucakre tāṇḍavaṃ śubham ||79|| śrībadrīpriyovācakīdṛśaṃ tāṇḍavaṃ cakre kīdṛgrūpo harastadā | vada me tatsvarūpaṃ vai nārāyaṇapareśvara ||4.95.80 || śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca rudro hariṃ prapūjyātmānandamagno babhūva ha | prasannātmā praṇipatya svāmikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ||8 1 || dhanyo’smyadya hareḥ prāpteḥ kṛtakṛtyo’smi sarvathā | yanme gṛhe kṛpāsindhuḥ parameśa upāgataḥ |||82|| ityuktvā harṣapūrṇaśca smayan tāṇḍavamācarat | tatra sthitāḥ śṛṅgibhṛṅgirīṭikirīṭināmakāḥ ||83|| ambākārtikavighneśā abhavannṛtyayoginaḥ | rūpaṃ dadhāra rudro’tra cārdhanārīnarātmakam ||84|| mandasmitānanaṃ bhasmagauraṃ yathārhabhūṣaṇam | vāmapādāṃguṣṭhasaṃstho dakṣapādaṃ samunnayan ||85|| iṣadūrdhvānanaścordhvahasto vakraśca jānunoḥ | samudbhinnabhālacakṣurjaṭāsaratsurāpagaḥ ||86|| nāgarājāḍhyakaṇṭhaśca kṛṣṇabindugalojjvalaḥ | bhālanetrodbhavavahnirekhābhāsitabhūtalaḥ ||87|| siṃhacarmārdhasampannaḥ śāṭikārdhāvṛtāṃgakaḥ | huṅkāranādasaṃghuṣṭasabhāsthalaḥ svarānvitaḥ ||88|| prakoṣṭhayordadhannāgakuṇḍale bhujayorapi | pādaprakoṣṭhayoścāpi ghurghurānaddhabhūṣaṇaḥ ||89|| mahākiṃkaṇikāvyāptaraśanākaṭivartulaḥ | muṇḍāsthimālikārājadvakṣaḥsthalātiśobhanaḥ ||4.95.90 || karṇayoḥ prāntayorlambasvarṇakuṇḍalarājitaḥ | karṇayoḥ parito yasya bhogibālau bhramāyitau ||9 1 || bhāle tilakacandrābhyāṃ suśobho mānasāharaḥ | netraprāntadadhatsnigdhanīlakajjalarekhakaḥ ||92|| phaṇibaddhajaṭājūṭaḥ skandhayoḥ phaṇivigrahaḥ | iṣadvakrāgranamanaḥ kaṭyā dhavalanīlayā ||93 || dhṛtārdhakaupīnaścārdhabaddhāntarvastraguhyakaḥ | dhṛtārdhālakamūrdhā ca tathārdhe jaṭayā yutaḥ ||94|| vāme strībhūṣaṇairyukto dakṣe puṃbhūṣaṇānvitaḥ | satīstanapaṭaprāntayojitottarakañcukaḥ ||95|| kārtikasya mayūreṇa phuṃkārito’tibhogarāṭ | sudhāṃ lihan nṛtyajātāṃ svedātmikāṃ tu vakṣasi ||96|| rājate rajjurūpo’pi bhraman kaṇṭhe’sya karburaḥ | gaṇeśasyondururyatra ciṃciṃkaroti nṛtyavit ||97|| śivāsano mṛgendro’pi karoti garjanāṃ tadā | nṛtyamelānvitāṃ caujovardhinīṃ diṅninādanām ||98|| dhavalo vṛṣabho yatra bhāṃ karoti tadanvitām | teṣāṃ tālapradāno’yaṃ ḍamarūṃ vādayan haraḥ ||99|| hṛṣṭaromā hṛṣṭagātraḥ kampayan dharaṇiśrayam | pāda vikṣepayan caikapādāṃguṣṭena tolayan || 4.95.10 0|| nanarta bhrāmayan dehaṃ bhraman rarāja nṛtyakṛt | pradakṣiṇena dakṣeṇa vāmenāpi tataḥ punaḥ || 101 || pṛṣṭhavaṃśena cāgreṇa pārśvadānena vai punaḥ | padenāpi ca pādābhyāṃ dattakṛṣṇekṣaṇo hariḥ || 10 2|| nanarta cañcalastyaktalajjaḥ sarvāṃgakampanaḥ | kvacit stanaṃ kvacilliṅgaṃ kvacitkarāgramātrakam || 1 03|| kvacinnitambamātraṃ ca kampayan śuśubhe haraḥ | kvacid bhujāṃ kvacit sakthi kvacid gaṇḍaṃ ca gālakam || 1 04|| kvacid bhruvaṃ kvacijjaṃghāṃ kampayan śuśubhe haraḥ | kvacidvakrāṃ kvacinnīcāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ tu saralāṃ kvacit || 1 05|| kvacidūrdhvāmabhitaśca dadat nanarta śaṃkaraḥ | kvacillajjāṃ kvacit sārdhāṃ kvacittu dviguṇāṃ gatim || 1 06|| kvacinmandāṃ sthirāṃ vāpi darśayan sa nanarta ha | kvacinnaman kvacitpremṇā bhāvaṃ snehaṃ ca darśayan || 10 7|| ākarṣayanniva kṛṣṇaṃ svāmināthaṃ nanarta saḥ | ardhāṃge bhāminīrūpe prasannāsye hiraṇyabhe || 1 08|| darśayan sevikābhāvaṃ nanarta śaṃkaro mudā | viśālanetrā subhagā padmapatranibhekṣaṇā || 1 09|| āraktakaracaraṇatalā miṣṭasvarā satī | sarvāṃgasundarī bhūtisitastanābhiśobhanā || 4.95.11 0|| priyārdhaṃ sasvajānā ca sarvāṃgarāgabhāsurā | candracūḍā rūparūpābhirūpakṛtamohikā || 111 || nanartāṅgagatā devī śivā śivamayī tadā | parameśaprasannatvakṛte nanarta sā tadā || 112|| lajjāṃ vihāya kṛṣṇāgre sarvabhāvasamanvitā | hāvabhāvayutā sarvanṛtyāṃgarasasaṃbhṛtā || 11 3|| kaṇṭhe tu śaṃbhuvat kaṇṭhīṃ taulasīṃ dadhatī tadā | nārāyaṇahare viṣṇo kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca || 1 14|| bālakṛṣṇeti tāneṣu vadamānā nanarta sā | rudrājñayā savādyā yā pṛthaksthitābhavat tu sā || 1 15|| nanartādhi tadā bhāvapūrṇā nārāyaṇāntike | rudrāścānye rudragaṇā gaṇikāścāpi nanṛtuḥ || 11 6|| kṛṣṇakare karān nyasya cūmbanānyapi jagṛhuḥ | savādyaghoṣagītaiśca satālagālavādanaiḥ || 1 17|| sarvathā rudradevānāṃ maṇḍalaṃ tannanarta ha | atha vāhanarūpā ye nanṛtuste samutsukāḥ || 1 18|| dhṛtarudrasvarūpā vai pṛthagbhāvo na yatra tu | āścaryaṃ paramaṃ tvetanmaharloke haraiḥ kṛtam || 11 9|| nṛtyātmakaṃ vīkṣitaṃ śrīhariṇā sārthasaṃyujā | prasanno bhagavān svāmī samutthāya nijāsanāt || 4.95.1 20|| āśliṣyacchaṃkaraṃ dhṛtvā nijavakṣasi tanmayaḥ | samāśliṣyat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarvān kṛpāvaśaḥ || 121 || rudrāṇīśca samāślikṣam̐llakṣmīpadmāvatīpriyāḥ | anyā samāśliṣan rudrāṇikāścāśīḥparāyaṇāḥ || 122| upadāḥ pradadurhārān divyān maṇīn vibhūṣikāḥ | nṛtyānte śrīhariḥ prāha tuṣṭo’smi varadānakṛt || 123|| varaṃ vṛṇuta sarve’tra yadicchatha dadāmi tat | rudrāścāhustava sevāṃ bhaktiṃ tvayyavināśinīm || 1 24||| ante brahmagatiṃ cāpi dehi dhāmnyakṣare tava | ityuktvārārtrikaṃ cakrurvidāyaṃ pradadustataḥ || 125|| tebhyo mantraṃ dadau kṛṣṇo naijaṃ nāma dadāvapi | śrīkṛṣṇanrāyaṇasvāmī śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama || 1 26|| divyabhāvaṃ tathāśīrvāṇīṃ dadau parameśvaraḥ | atha vimānamāruhya jayanādaiḥ svarāyayau || 1 27|| svargaṃ kṛṣṇavimānena badrike cākṣaraprabham | vyadyotata surā vīkṣyābhīyu svāgatasiddhaye || 128|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne maharlokanivāsināṃ mandireṣu bhagavataḥ pūjanādi rudrasya tāṇḍavaṃ cetivarṇananāmā pañcanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 95 ||
<4.96> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi śrīkṛṣṇaḥ phālgune prabhuḥ | prathamaṃ svavimānena dhruvasvargamupāyayau || 1 || yatra vai vaiṣṇavo bhakto rājā dhruvo’sti sarvadā yadādhāraṃ lokacakraṃ pravartate bhramatyapi || 2 || vīkṣya viśālaṃ divyaṃ ca sarvalokottaraṃ śubham | vimānaṃ śrīharestūrṇaṃ dhruvaścābhyāyayau drutam || 3 || sasainyaḥ sarvadevaiśca savādyaḥ sahito harim | kṛṣṇaṃ sammānayāmāsa svāgataṃ vyacaranmudā || 4 || praṇamya dhanyabhāgyo’sītyāha kṛtvā ca daṇḍavat | ninye nārāyaṇaṃ naije mahāsaudhe tu kānake || 5 || yatra viṣṇudhruvapūjyo vartate sampadāṃ pradaḥ | viṣṇurnārāyaṇaṃ natvā cakāra daṇḍavattadā || 6 || pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre śubhāsanavirājinaḥ | hareḥ sevāṃ dhruvaścāpi cakre jalāmṛtārpaṇaiḥ || 7 || āvāsadānakaiḥ sarvārpaṇaibhāgavatottamaḥ | ṣoḍaśādyupacāraiḥ saṃprapūjyārārtrikaṃ vyadhāt || 8 || vaiṣṇavī kamalā devī lakṣmyādīnāṃ prapūjanam | dhruvapatnī śāśvatī ca brahmapriyādipūjanam || 9 || anyā mahāmahābhaktānikāścāpi prapūjanam | hareścakrustathā dhruvaprajāḥ pupūjuracyutam || 4.96.10 || upadā vividhāścāpi daduḥ śrīparamātmane | divyasauvarṇaratnāḍhyabhūṣāhāradhanāni ca || 11 || bhojayāmāsurīśeśaṃ sarvogisahitaṃ ca te | sarvārpaṇavidhānena devā devyaḥ prasevanam || 12|| cakruḥ śrībālakṛṣṇasya sarvāvatāradhāriṇaḥ | dhruvarājye mahārājye bhrāmayāmāsuracyutam || 1 3|| prajāśca śrīhariṃ samyak prapūjya manumāpnuvan | nāmadhunyaṃ jagṛhuśca dadhyurnārāyaṇaṃ hṛdi || 14|| kṛṣṇaḥ prapāvayitvaiva dhruvalokaṃ tatastataḥ | drutaṃ vimānamāruhya saptarṣilokamāyayau || 15|| prathamaṃ śrīhariḥ śreṣṭhaṃ vasiṣṭhasyālayaṃ yayau | arundhatīyutarṣiśca svāgataṃ prācaraddhareḥ || 1 6|| puṣpacandanapīyūṣāmṛtākṣatayavāṃkuraiḥ | pupūja paramātmānaṃ pupūjārundhatī hyapi | | 17| | kṛṣṇasārthaṃ samastaṃ ca pupūjārundhatī satī | vāsiṣṭhāśca surādevyaḥ prajāścānarcuracyutam | | 18|| vedamantrairārṣayogairhareḥ prapūjanaṃ vyadhuḥ | bhojayāmāsuriṣṭānnāmṛtādyaṃ bahudhā kṛtam || 19|| ārārtrikaṃ pracakruśca gṛhe gṛhe tatharṣayaḥ | sammānaṃ saṃvyadhuścāpi sevāṃ vyadhurmahādṛtāḥ ||4.96.20 || āśīrvādān sāmagīrbhirdadurnārāyaṇāya te | bhṛguśca bhārgavāścāpi ninyurnārāyaṇeśvaram || 21 || nijālayeṣu cānarcurbhojayāmāsurīśvaram | aṅgirāścāpyāṃgirasā ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ tataḥ ||22|| te’pyānarcurharikṛṣṇaṃ bahūpakaraṇādibhiḥ | marīciścāpi mārīcā ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ gṛham |||23|| atristathā tadātreyā ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ mudā | pupūjurbhojayāmāsurupadāśca nyadhuḥ puraḥ || 24||| pulastyaścāpi paulastyā ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ gṛham | pulahaḥ paulahāścāpi ninyurnijālayān harim ||25||| pupūjuḥ parayā bhaktyā śrīprabhummādhavīpatim | upadāśca nyadhustvagre bhojayāmāsurīśvaram ||26||| mahaiśvaryairhareḥ sevāṃ cakruste ṛṣipuṃgavāḥ | harirvidāya saṃgṛhya badrike drutameva ha ||27|| kratorlokaṃ nibhālyaiva kṛtapūjādaraḥ prabhuḥ | āśiṣaḥ kṛtave datvā śanerlokamupāyayau ||28|| śaninā kṛtapūjaśca datvā tasmai manuṃ nijam | vaiṣṇavaṃ taṃ sūryaputraṃ yuktvāśīrbhistato drutam ||29|| gurorlokaṃ viśālaṃ vai samāyayau hariḥ svayam | bṛhaspatirhareścābhiṣekaṃ vyadhāt tu sāmagaiḥ ||4.96.30|| apūjayat prabhuṃ divyairupacāraiḥ samṛddhibhiḥ | manuṃ jagrāha harito bhojayāmāsa vai tataḥ ||3 1 || uttamābhirupadābhistoṣayāmāsa mādhavam | vidāyaṃ pradadau prasthāpayāmāsa tato’cyutam ||22||| haristūrṇaṃ maṃgalasyālayaṃ tata upāyayau | maṃgalaḥ pūjayāmāsa prabhuṃ ratnādibhistataḥ ||33|| āyayau bhagavān śukrālayaṃ vimānato drutam | śakrastu bahudhā cakre svāgataṃ pūjanādibhiḥ ||34|| tato harirdrutaṃ budhālayaṃ vai samupāyayau | budhaḥ sampūjya mudito bhojayāmāsa mādhavam ||35|| vidāyaṃ pradadau cātha harirnakṣatramaṇḍalam | āyayau svavimānena rohiṇyādigṛheṣu vai || 36|| tāḥ sarvā vai dakṣaputryo nārāyaṇaṃ yathāyatham | pupūjuḥ sevayāmāsurbhojayāmāsuracyutam || 37|| hareḥ patnīgaṇām̐ścāpi santuṣṭāsahitānapi | pūjayāmāsuratyarthaṃ nārīyogyopacārakaiḥ ||38|| tataḥ śrībhagavān sūryalokaṃ samāyayau drutam | ādityaḥ svarṇavarṇastaṃ hiraṇmayayutaḥ pumān ||39|| pupūja paramātmānaṃ sarvadravaiḥ suvarṇajaiḥ | vibhūṣaṇairamṛtaiśca divyānnairambarādibhiḥ ||4.96.40|| pūṣāryamā vivasvām̐śca tvaṣṭā viṣṇurbhagastathā | parjanyo varuṇo dhātā śakro mitroṃ’śurityapi ||41 || pupūjuḥ paramātmānaṃ śreṣṭharddhisampadādibhiḥ | rājādhirājaveṣām̐śca dadurnārāyaṇāya te ||42|| svasvarājyeṣu sarvatra ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ mudā | mukuṭān kaṭakān hārān kuṇḍalāni daduśca te ||43|| maṇiratnamayī ramyāḥ śṛṃkhalāśca dadustathā | akṣayānyapi pātrāṇi mahāmṛtapradānyapi ||44|| daduste haraye lakṣmyādibhyaśca sūryayoṣitaḥ | chāyā saṃjñāśvinī cāpi hiraṇyā ca prabhādikāḥ ||45|| bhojayāmāsurīśeśaṃ vidāyaṃ pradadustataḥ | atha śrībhagavān śīghramāyayau cāndrabhūmikām ||46|| candraloke somarājaścakāra svāgataṃ hareḥ | pūjāṃ sevāṃ cakārāpi bhojanānyamṛtāni ca ||47|| dadau vastrāṇi ramyāṇi rasān pīyūṣasaṃbhṛtān | maṇīn ratnāni ramyāṇi dadau kṛṣṇāya candramāḥ ||48|| tatpatnyaśca dadurbhūṣādikaṃ yoṣidbhya ādṛtāḥ | vidāyaṃ pradaduścāpi tataḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ||49|| tattallokaprajābhyaśca manuṃ svakaṃ dadau mudā | nāmadhunyaṃ dadau cāpi tatastu mānasottaram ||4.96.50|| parvataṃ cāyayau caitre pūrve mahendramandiram | nagaryāmamarāvatyāṃ devendro’bhrāmayat prabhum ||51 || sarvaśṛṃgārayuktāyāṃ divyāyāṃ devavanditam | devaiśca devatābhiśca śacyāpsarobhirarcitaḥ ||52|| pāvayitvā devavargānindrasabhāmupāyayau | indraḥ pupūja bahubhiścopacāraiḥ samṛddhibhiḥ ||53|| tasmai sa pradadau ratnahārān divyām̐stathopadāḥ | indrabhogān samastām̐śca mahendraḥ prabhave dadau ||54|| bhojayāmāsa sarvāśca sevayāmāsa bhāvanaiḥ | rakṣayāmāsa saudhe sve prabhuṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||55||| siddhacāraṇagandharvāḥ siṣevire hariṃ striyaḥ | vidāyaṃ prāpya bhagavān agnestejovatīṃ purīm ||56|| yayau svena vimānena badrike’gnimahālayam | agnayaḥ śrīhariṃ natvā kṛtvā svāgatamuttamam ||57|| prapūjya bhrāmayāmāsurnagare sve gṛhe gṛhe | arcayāmāsuratyarthaṃ bhojayāmāsurādarāt ||58|| maṇiratnādihārām̐śca daduḥ kṛṣṇāya te’nalāḥ | svāhādyāḥ strījanān sarvānānarcuḥ svarṇabhūṣaṇaiḥ ||59|| cāndanairgandhibhiḥ śreṣṭhairdravairamṛtavarṣibhiḥ | vidāyaṃ prāpya bhagavān yayau saṃyamanīṃ purīm ||4.96.60 || yatra vaivasvatastasya prajāḥ pupūjurādarāt | yamāḥ pupūjurīśeśaṃ yamarājaḥ pupūja ca ||61|| yāmyā yamānugāścāpi pupūjuḥ parameśvaram | haristu svavimānena vīkṣituṃ nārakān yayau ||62|| kṛṣṇavāyoḥ prasaṃgena nārakā mokṣamāpnuvan | naiko’pi daṇḍavām̐statra daṇḍyaḥ kuṇḍe’sti śeṣitaḥ ||63|| nāvaśiṣṭastadā tatra pāpī kaścid yamālaye | sarve mokṣaṃ gatāḥ svargaṃ gatāḥ kṛṣṇakṛpāvaśāt ||64|| yamena pūjitaḥ kṛṣṇo vidāyaṃ prāpya satvaram | rakṣovatīṃ purīṃ rakṣobhṛtāṃ nirkatipālitām ||65|| āyayau svavimānena nirṛtiḥ svāgataṃ vyadhāt | rakṣogaṇāśca deveśaṃ pupūjurnirṛteḥ prajāḥ ||66|| tebhyo datvā manuṃ kṛṣṇo labdhvā vidāyamuttamam | āyayau svavimānena vāruṇīṃ sukhinīṃ purīm ||67|| varuṇo bhagavantaṃ taṃ pupūja paramarddhibhiḥ | bhojayāmāsa bahudhā rasānamṛtasaṃbhavān ||68|| siṣevire ca bahudhā tato vidāyamārpayat | haristūrṇaṃ vimānenāyayau tu vāyavīṃ purīm ||69|| gandhavatīṃ cātiramyāṃ prabhañjanena pālitām | prabhañjano hareḥ śreṣṭhaṃ pūjanaṃ sārthamācarat ||4.96.70|| dadau kṛṣṇāya ratnāni vidāyaṃ pradadau tathā | hariścottarabhāgasthāṃ kauberīṃ nagarīṃ yayau ||71|| vibhāvarīṃ ca somasya nagarīṃ bahuśobhanām | yayau tūrṇaṃ kubereṇa pūjitastatra mādhavaḥ ||72|| bahuratnairbahudhanairbhūṣāmbarādibhistathā | sarvakośaiḥ pūjitaśca yayāvīśānapattanam ||73|| īśānaḥ svayaśovatyāṃ puryāmabhrāmayaddharim | apūjayad divyarasaiḥ sagaṇaḥ sagaṇaṃ prabhum ||74|| vidāyaṃ pradadau cāpi kṛṣṇaḥ kāntimatīṃ purīm | āyayau merubhāgasthāṃ niśānāthādisevitām ||75|| bahvībhiścāpsarobhiśca sarvadevagaṇairyutām | sarvathā vaiṣṇavīṃ ramyāṃ tārakābhirnivāsitām ||76|| tatra niśākaraḥ kṛṣṇaṃ pupūja bahubhāvavān | bhojayāmāsa bahudhā bhrāmayāmāsa pattane ||77|| vidāyaṃ pradadau cāpi kṛṣṇo merunivāsinām | gṛhe gṛhe samastānāṃ vyastānāṃ ca yayau tadā ||78|| āhūtaḥ pāvanārthaṃ svamandirāṇi hariryayau | priyavratottānapādau samrājau paramātmanaḥ ||79|| svāgataṃ bahusammānaṃ cakratuḥ pūjanādikam | bhojayāmāsatuścāpi daduranarghyasanmaṇīn ||4.96.80|| dharmadevo ruciścāpi dakṣaḥ kraturmaharṣayaḥ | pupūjuḥ paramātmānaṃ sasārthaṃ copadādibhiḥ ||81 || khecarī vasucārī ca brahmeśo brahmajīvadhīḥ | suṣeṇaḥ śāśvataḥ pṛṣṭaḥ supuṣṭaśca mahābalaḥ ||82|| ta ete cāraṇā divyā ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ gṛham | pupūjuḥ parayā prītyā rannahārādibhistadā ||83|| mantrajño mantravit prājño mantrarāṭ siddhiśobhanaḥ | siddheśaḥ paramaḥ siddhaḥ siddhā ninyurhariṃ gṛham ||84|| pūjayāmāsuratyarthaṃ bhojayāmāsuramṛtam | yakṣo yakṣeśakaścāpi jṛṃbhako maṇibhadrakaḥ ||89|| pūrṇaprabhadrako mālī śitikuṇḍalakastathā | narendraśceti yakṣāśca ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ gṛham ||86|| pupūjuḥ parayā prītyā dadurdivyopadāstathā | viṇājñaḥ kinnarastatra surasenaḥ pramardanaḥ ||87|| atīśayaḥ saprayogī gītajñaśceti kinnarāḥ | ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ naijāvāseṣvapūjayan mudā ||88|| vidyādharaśca vibudho vidyārāśirvidāmbaraḥ | prabuddhaśca kṛtajñaśca śrījñastattvadharādayaḥ ||89|| vidyādhrāḥ śrīhariṃ ninyunijāvāseṣvapūjayan | gāyanairnartanairbhāvairvādyaprakārakaistathā ||4.96.90|| te saṃprasādayāmāsuḥ śrīpatiṃ śrījanairyutam | vāmadevo mahājambhaḥ sugrīvo mardakastathā ||91|| bāṣkalī piṃgalaḥ kuṃbhaścaite bhaktāstu tāmasāḥ | ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ daityāḥ pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ||92|| garutmān khagatirnāgamardano viṣṇuvāhanaḥ | ete hiraṇyavarṇābhā garuḍāḥ parameśvaram ||93|| ninyurnaijagṛhāṇyevānarcuḥ śrīpatimīśvaram | urvaśī menakā raṃbhā ratiścāpi tilottamā ||94|| sumukhī sustanī śāntā kāmukī śāradānanā | alambuṣādyā apsarogaṇā ninyurharim patim ||95|| nijāvāseṣu kānteśaṃ pupūjuḥ kāmagauravaiḥ | siṣevire samāliṅgya pāvitryaṃ prāpurīśvarāt ||96|| gāyanaṃ nartanaṃ cakruḥ cakruḥ sevāṃ ca yoṣitām | bhojayāmāsuratyarthaṃ śṛṃgārāṇi vyadhāpayan ||97|| rāmayāmāsurātmeśaṃ kāntaṃ sasvajire dṛḍham | surabhiḥ sarvatobhadrā suśīlā śrīpradā tathā ||98|| nandinī ceti gāvaśca divyarūpadharāstadā | kāmadughā hariṃ ninyurmerau nijāśrameṣvapi ||99|| pupūjuḥ kāmarūpeśaṃ mahābhiṣekapūrvakam | bhojayāmāsuriṣṭaṃ vai miṣṭaṃ kṣīramayāmṛtam || 4.96.1 00|| athāruṇānapāyā ca vimanuṣyā varāmbarā | miśrakeśyasiparṇā cālaṃbuṣā śucikā tathā || 10 1|| mārīciścādrikā vidyutparṇā kṣemā ca lakṣmaṇā | manobhavāsitā puṇḍarīkājagandhinī tathā || 1 02|| subāhvī supriyā cāpi subhujā sudatī ramā | surasā sumukhī haṃsapādī sūtābhayā jayā || 1 03|| haṃsā ca kamalā bhāsī subhagā ca sarasvatī | arūpā manuvaṃtī ca sukeśī parṇinī tathā || 1 04|| sahajā puñjikasthalī ghṛtācī ca kṛtasthalī | viśvācī pūrvacittiśca pramlocā śāradī dayā || 1 05|| māṇikī cānumlocā maṃjulā haṃsī ca śāntidā | yuvatītvaṃ haraye tā dadū reme ratipriyaḥ || 1 06|| siṣevire svālayeṣu sarvasvārpaṇabhāvanaiḥ | tathā kṛṣṇapriyāṇāṃ ca sevāṃ cakruḥ samanvitāḥ || 1 07|| nanartuḥ śrīhareragre cakrurvallabhakīrtanam | āśīrvādān jagṛhuścopadā nyadhurhareḥ puraḥ || 1 08|| bhīmasenaścograsenaḥ suparṇo varuṇastathā | sūryavarcā dhṛtarāṣṭro gomān bhīmaśca patravān || 1 09|| arkaparṇaḥ prayutaśca citrarathaśca vaikaliḥ | śāliśirāḥ subāhuśca haṃso madhyaśca dāruṇaḥ || 4.96.11 0|| jyotiṣṭamaḥ sadācāro vareṇyaśca varūthakaḥ | vasuruciḥ suruciśca viśvāvasuśca bhānukaḥ || 111 || bahvī siddhastu pūrṇaśca pūrṇāṃśaḥ śatagauṇakaḥ | sucandraśceti gāndharvāḥ pupūjuḥ parameśvaram || 11 2|| ninyurnārāyaṇaṃ naijasaudheṣvānarcuracyutam | upadāḥ pradaduḥ sarve bhojayāmāsuracyutam || 11 3||| divyā meroraṇyānī tathā ca vanadevatāḥ | oṣadhayastathā divyā samūrtāḥ parameśvaram | | 1 14|| pupūjuḥ phalapuṣpādyaiḥ sadrasairbhojanāmṛtaiḥ | tebhyo merunivāsibhyaḥ svamanuṃ mādhavo dadau || 1 16|| nāmadhunyaṃ dadau naijamāśīrvādān dadau tathā | tataḥ svasya vimānena bhuvarlokamupāyayau | | 11 6|| vaiśākhamāse bhagavān badrike bhaktavatsalaḥ | viyaccarāḥ surāstatra pūjayāmāsuracyutam || 1 17|| āvahaḥ pravahaśceti savaho’nuvahastathā | parāvaho vivahaśca parivahaśca vāyavaḥ || 1 18|| nijāsu ramyanagarīṣvānayan parameśvaram | pupūjuḥ parayā prītyā bhojayāmāsuracyutam || 1 19|| bhūtapretapiśācāśca kūṣmāṇḍāśca vināyakāḥ | vīrā vetālakāścāpi bhuvarlokanivāsinaḥ || 4.96.1 20||| pupūjuḥ paramātmānaṃ jagṛhuśca manuṃ hareḥ | divyamuktā babhūvuste harirbhūtalamāyayau || 121 || kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ jyeṣṭhamāse nijālayam | virarāma harirbadri sarvabhaktaprapūjitaḥ || 1 22|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne svargaloke merau bhuvarloke ca bhagavato bhramaṇaṃ kuṃkumavāpikāṃ pratyāgamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṇṇavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 96 ||
<4.97> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre yadāgamat tadā drutam || 1 || vimāne yāni rūpāṇi patnīnāṃ dvaitavanti ca | tāni sarvāṇi tatraiva tirobhāvayadacyutaḥ || 2 || vimānasthāni rūpāṇi bhūstheṣvāviviśustadā | dāsadāsīsvarūpāṇi bhūstheṣvāviviśustathā || 3 || lomaśādeḥ svarūpāṇi bhūstheṣvāviviśustadā | dvaitabhāve vilīne ca nijarūpe hariḥ svayam || 4 || ekabhāvaṃ gatastatra vimānaṃ cāṇutāṃ gatam | ratnabhūṣāmbarahārā upadāḥ svarṇaśobhanāḥ || 5 || sarvā yathāyathaṃ kṛṣṇo dadau yogyebhya eva ca | viprebhyo’nāthadīnebhyaḥ śrībhyo daduryathāyatham || 6 || cāturmāsyamuvāsāpi hariḥ kuṃkumapattane | trayoviṃśaṃ harerjanmadinaṃ prāptaṃ śubhapradam || 7 || prātareva kṛtasnāno’ṣṭamyāmūrjasya cāsite | kṛtaśṛṃgārakaḥ kṛṣṇovallabho’yāt svasaṃsadi || 8 || tadā vādyānyavādyanta gītayaścābhavan śubhāḥ | nartanāni vicitrāṇi devatānāṃ tadābhavan || 9 || sarvotkṛṣṭā sabhā pūrṇā sarvasūṣṭinivāsibhiḥ | jātā sā badrike tatra lomaśaḥ samupāyayau || 4.97.1 0|| pupūja paramātmānaṃ ciraṃ jīveti cāha tam | śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇādyāḥ pupūjuḥ parameśvaram || 11 || avatārā īśvarāśca muktāḥ siddhāḥ surāstathā | ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā mānavāśca narāḥ striyaḥ || 12|| pupūjuḥ kambharālālaṃ cāśīrvādān dadustadā | ārārtrikaṃ vyadhuḥ sarve mahotsavamakārayan || 1 3|| prajñāpadmāvatīlakṣmīrādhādyāścakrurutsavam | atalādinivāsāśca
