rātrindivaṃ vyavasāyaparāṇāmapi naiva ha | pūrṇamupārjanaṃ tiṣye rūkṣaḥ kalistato mataḥ ||78|| tathāpi badrike tatra satkāryaṃ cet kṛtaṃ bhavet | sahasraguṇitaṃ tadvai phaladaṃ śraddhayā kṛtam ||79|| sarvadoṣanidhāne’pi kalau guṇo mahānapi | kṛṣṇakīrtanamātreṇa śuddhiṃ yātīti mānavaḥ ||4.104.80|| pūjanaṃ jalamātreṇa kīrtanaṃ nāmamātrataḥ | smaraṇaṃ rūpamātrasya kalau vai mokṣadaṃ hareḥ ||81|| yādṛśāstādṛśā vāpi kāṣāyāmbarasādhavaḥ | āśritāstārakāstiṣye śrīkṛṣṇāṃkasthitā yataḥ |||82|| sadhūmro vā mandavarcāḥ channo vā malināśrayaḥ | duṣṭādo vānalaḥ śuddhastathā sādhuḥ kalau śuciḥ ||83|| gṛhaṃ kṣetraṃ dhanaṃ nārīṃ grāmaṃ tyaktvā svakaṃ nijam | kṛṣṇāṅke’vasthitaḥ sādhuḥ śraiṣṭhyaṃ cāsya tataḥ sadā ||84|| sattāṃ tyaktvā pāravaśyaṃ tyaktvā śaktiṃ ca dīnatām | śāstiṃ vihāya śaraṇaṃ jagrāhāto varo muniḥ ||85|| kalidoṣe’pi hṛdaye jihvāyāṃ śaraṇe’pi ca | hariṃ rakṣati gṛhṇāti śṛṇotyato varo muniḥ ||86|| dehācāradurācāraparo’pi bhaktimodanaḥ | pāvano brahmavit sādhuryataḥ sa lokapāvanaḥ ||87|| vyabhicāraparaścāpi śāṭyadhaurtyaparo’pi vā | dravyatṛṣṇānvitaścāpi kṛṣṇaputro varo muniḥ ||88|| kṛṣṇasmṛtestu kartā saḥ kārayitā vilokitaḥ | milito rāmavaktā ca vācayitā varo muniḥ ||89 || kṛṣṇaveṣadharo nāṭye kṛṣṇasya smārako yathā | smṛtyā pāpavihantā syāt tathā tādṛgvaro muniḥ || 4.104.90 || kāṣāyāmbaramālokya pāpā namanti taṃ munim | brahmātmabhāvanādhānaṃ tasmāt sādhurvaraḥ sadā ||9 1 || badrike darśanāt sādhoḥ sparśanāt sevanāttathā | mardanād bhojanād vāripānācchuddhyanti mānavāḥ ||92|| sādhoścaraṇarajasā prasādabhojanādapi | sādhostattvāsādanācca sadyaḥ śuddhyanti mānavāḥ || 93 || kṛṣṇadīkṣāvato yogād bhaktasya śīlanādapi | sādhujīvanakaraṇāt kalau śuddhyanti mānavāḥ || 94|| sādhusādhvyo susatsaṅgāt tayoḥ prasādanādapi | sādhvājñākaraṇāt tiṣye sadyaḥ śuddhyanti mānavāḥ || 95 || sādhoḥ pādāmṛtapānāt sādhvāśleṣavidhāpanāt | sādhudehasya yogācca sadyaḥ śuddhyanti mānavāḥ || 96 || sādhave dehadānācca tathendriyasamarpaṇāt | mano’rpaṇājjīvadānānmuktiṃ prayānti mānavāḥ || 97|| sādhau tādātmyayogācca hyanāvaraṇasaṃgamāt | tadrūpākāratāyogānmuktiṃ prayānti mānavāḥ ||98|| yatheṣṭavastudānācca kuṭumbasampadarpaṇāt | śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇakaraṇānmuktiṃ prayānti mānavāḥ || 99 || kṛṣṇanyāsāt kṛṣṇabhāvāt kṛṣṇarahasyasevanāt | kṛṣṇasādhuvratācārānmuktiṃ prayānti mānavāḥ || 4.104.100 || tiṣye tu badrike devā mūrtayo na punanti hi | tīrthāni na punantyeva sadyaḥ punanti sādhavaḥ || 101 || sevāṃ datvā drutaṃ santaḥ punanti mānavān kalau | sevāṃ kṛtvā satāṃ sadyaḥ śuddhyanti mānavāḥ kalau || 102|| āśīrvādaiḥ satāṃ sādhyaḥ sādhavaśca yathā kalau | pavitrāḥ pāvakā yadvattathā bhavanti mānavāḥ || 103 || satāṃ saṃgādāśrayācca kṛṣṇakāntasya kīrtanāt | smṛternāryo narā divyā bhūtvā mokṣaṃ prayānti vai || 1 04|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmisatāṃ muhuḥ | sevanāt kīrtanāt badri mokṣo bhavati dehinām || 10 5|| ityetat saralaṃ tiṣye sādhanaṃ badrike mayā | mokṣasya kathitaṃ sarvārpaṇātmakaṃ suniścitam || 106 || prabhoḥ kṛpāvataḥ svāminaśca kṛṣṇasya yoginaḥ | sevanādasya paṭhanācchravaṇāt smaraṇāttathā || 1 07|| sarvārpaṇādyācaraṇāt tādātmyabhāvayojanāt | tiṣye bhuktirmuktirasti dehināṃ śāśvatī śubhā || 1 08|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kalidoṣāṇāṃ mokṣasādhanaguṇānāṃ satāṃ sevādīnāṃ ca pradarśananāmā caturadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 104 ||
<4.105> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi māyāpālasya bhūbhṛtaḥ | sarvapāparatasyāpi sādhvarpaṇāt pramokṣaṇam || 1 || kāmarūpe pūrvadeśe māyāpālo’bhavannṛpaḥ | māṃsādo madyapaścāpi vyavāyakarmatatparaḥ || 2 || dravyāpahārakaścāpi kanyādūṣaṇakārakaḥ | prajāsu yatra kutrāpi vilokayati śobhanām || 3 || yuvatīṃ kanyakāṃ vāpi vadhūṃ suvāsinīṃ ca vā | prasahya rājadūtaiḥ sa samāhṛtya bhunakti tām || 4 || nityaṃ vadhaṃ paśūnāṃ ca karoti māṃsahetave | pakṣiṇāṃ sarvajātīnāṃ māṃsaṃ khādati bhūpatiḥ || 5 || yādasāṃ bhakṣakaścāpi surāmadyaparāyaṇaḥ | pararāṣṭre nijadūtaiścauryaṃ kārayatītyapi || 6 || viprāṇāṃ vā vidhavānāṃ devānāṃ dharmavartinām | dhanānyāhṛtya rājāpi svakośe sthāpayatyapi || 7 || makhānāṃ dharmakāryāṇāṃ virodhī dānanindakaḥ | sādhūnāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca tiraskāraparāyaṇaḥ || 8 || bhikṣukānāṃ duḥkhakartā homarodhanatatparaḥ | mandirāṇāṃ nāśayitā pūjārodhakarastathā || 9 || devatāṃ manute naiva mūrtau śraddhāsya no gurau | īśvaraṃ naiva manute parameśaṃ kuto’pi na || 4.105.10 || ahamevāsmi bhagavān rājā hi parameśvaraḥ | yajantu nṛpatiṃ māṃ vai prajeśvaraṃ maheśvaram || 11 || pūjayantu prajā māṃ ca prasādaya māṃ harim | rājā sākṣāddharirloke nānyo hariragocaraḥ || 12|| pātivratyaṃ rājarūpe harau kāryaṃ striyā sadā | rājñe karaḥ pradātavyo dharmārtha eva jāyate || 1 3|| rājā bhoktā samastānāṃ śāstā netā ca rakṣakaḥ | mūrtirbrahmamayī rājā yaṣṭavyaḥ sa makhe dvijaiḥ || 14|| kāmanātarpaṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ nānyacchrāddhaṃ vidheyavat | pumarthaḥ kāmanātṛptirindriyāṇāṃ ca tarpaṇam || 15|| bhogaḥ śreyaskaro loke paraḥ pumartha eva saḥ | na svargo nāpavargaśca pretatā nahi kasyacit || 1 6|| yāmyaloko na caivāsti kārāgāro mamaiva saḥ | yamo’haṃ ca kubero’haṃ nārāyaṇo bhavāmyaham || 17|| māṃ bhajantu tataḥ sarve’nyathā daṇḍyā mameti vai | badrike sa nṛpo māyāpālaścaivaṃ samantataḥ || 18|| ghoṣaṇāṃ kārayāmāsa prajāsu rāṣṭragāsu vai | ājīvikā hṛtāstena pūrvarājabhirarpitāḥ || 19|| devālayāḥ sārgalāśca kṛtāstenādhinābhitaḥ | pūjāpravāhā nihatā viprāśca daṇḍitā muhuḥ ||4.105.20 || satīnāryo dūṣitāśca mūrtayaḥ khaṇḍitā hareḥ | tīrthadānādividhayo hatāstena durātmanā || 2 1|| devayajanā viprāstu kārāgāre nipātitāḥ | sādhavo bahavastena nijadaṇḍena tāḍitāḥ || 22|| sādhvyo devyaḥ puruṣebhyaḥ prasahya tena cārpitāḥ | tīrthaṃ nāma hataṃ tena nāstikyena tu bhūbhṛtā || 23|| nijapatnī mahārājñī kāmākṣī nāmataḥ kṛtā | saiva devī saiva lakṣmīrdurgā saiveti ghoṣitā || 24|| sā tīrthaṃ sā devamātā sā mānyeti praghoṣitā | samadyamāṃsanaivedyārpaṇaṃ tasyai karoti saḥ ||25||| rājñe sarvārpaṇaṃ kāryaṃ cetyevaṃ sa karotyapi | prātaḥ siṃhāsane nityaṃ rājā rājñī pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 26|| prajāḥ śāsanarodhena nityaṃ prātaryathākramam | āgatya devavannatvārcayanti tāvubhāvapi || 27|| brāhmaṇā nṛpaterlokānuccārya pūjayanti tau | bhojayanti ca bhūpālaṃ rājñīṃ ca satataṃ prajāḥ || 28 || evaṃ vai badrike cāndhyaṃ prāvartata tadā khalu | māyāpāle hiṃ nṛpatau kāmarūpe pradeśake ||29|| devakopastato jātaḥ prajākopo’pi vai mahān | durbhikṣaṃ cābhavad rāṣṭre rogāḥ prajāsu cābhavan ||4.105.30|| dāvāgnirvanabhūbhāge vyajāyata punaḥ punaḥ | rājño doṣeṇa vai badri prajāpīḍāḥ samāgatāḥ ||3 1|| yato rājānuyāyinyo nāstikyaśca prajā api | rājāśayānusāriṇyastadābhavana gṛhe gṛhe ||32||| durbhikṣeṇa tadā badri hāhākāro mahānabhūt| | nānnaṃ na salilaṃ kvāpi labhate mānavaḥ khalu || 3 3|| brahmaputrī jalahīnā mahānadī vyajāyata | himādrau varṣaṇaṃ nāsti devatānāṃ prakopataḥ ||34|| araṇyāni samastāni parvatīyāni sarvaśaḥ | dāvānalaiḥ pradagdhāni parvatā bhasmaśobhanāḥ || 35 || abhavan badrike bhūmirdagdheva dṛśyate tadā | paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi mṛtā yādāṃsi sarvathā ||36 || nāhāro labhyate rāṣṭre bhavanti vyasavo janāḥ | māṃsādā mānavāstatra mānuṣādāstato’bhavan || 37|| rākṣasā iva cānyonyaṃ bhakṣayanti narān mithaḥ | nāryaśca bālakām̐ścāpi mṛtamāṃsānyadanti ca || 8 || evaṃ vai daivakopena rogeṇāpi hatāḥ prajāḥ | pāpināṃ cātipāpānāṃ phalāni tvatra janmani ||39 || āyāntyeva na sandehastīvravegavatāṃ drutam | saṃgadoṣeṇa puṇyāḍhyā api dahyanti vegagāḥ ||4.105.40|| śuṣkamadhyasthitaṃ cārdraṃ dāvāgninā hi dahyati | rājñaḥ putraśataṃ naṣṭaṃ rogeṇa kanyakāśatam ||41 || rogagrastau nṛpo rājñī vyajāyetāṃ kṣayānvitau | dāsā dāsyo mṛtāḥ sarve rogeṇa paśavo’pi ca ||42|| vāhanāni vinaṣṭāni kṣudhayā pīḍitāni vai | kāmākṣyāḥ paramaḥ kopo rājye’bhito vyajāyata ||||43 || bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca bhramanti nagare tadā | yamadūtāstāḍayanti mārayanti nayanti ca ||44|| evaṃ yāmyālayo rāṣṭraṃ dvitīya iva cābhavat | pādau hastau vikṣipanto dṛśyante mānavā bhuvi ||45|| kṣudhayā tṛṣayā vyāptā mūrchitāścatvarādiṣu | nagnā vivastrā nirlajjā mahāduḥkhātipīḍitāḥ ||46| jalaṃ jalaṃ ca krośantaścānnaṃ cānnaṃ muhuḥ kṣitau | viluṇṭhanto’pyaśaktāste samutthātuṃ vimūrchitāḥ ||47|| kaṇṭharāvān bhayadām̐śca kṛtvā tyajanti tai hyasūn | na dātā vidyate kaścinna hartā śāntido’paraḥ ||48|| samānāvasthagāḥ sarve kaḥ kaṃ saṃbhālayedaho | rāṣṭraṃ vai pralayāvasthaṃ māyāpālasya dṛśyate ||49|| pāpaphalaṃ samastaṃ vai samāyātaṃ samūhitam | hāhākāro’bhito jāto rāṣṭrāntareṣu karṇagaḥ ||4.105.50|| mama loke tathā svarge sā vārtāvartatāpi ca | māyāpālena rājñā vai phalaṃ pāpasya bhujyate ||5 1|| prajābhirbhujyate cāpi pratyakṣaṃ ceha janmani | brahmaputrī nadī cāpi brahmāgre’kathayat kathām ||52|| sanatkumāro bhagavān śrutvā dayāparo’bhavat | natvā svapitaraṃ tūrṇaṃ brahmaputryā samaṃ tadā |||53|| dayāvaśo bhuvaṃ gatvā vyalokayad daśāṃ ca tām | kāmākṣī devikā lajjānamrā satkāramācarat ||54|| divyaḥ sanatkumāraḥ sa brahmaputrī svasā nadī | kāmākṣyā pūjitau cobhau niṣedatuḥ svamandire |||55|| śubhāsane rājamānau papracchāgamakāraṇam | sanatkumāro bhagavānāha kāmākṣikāṃ satīm ||56|| durbhikṣe’tra pradeśe vai tvayānuṣṭhitabhūtale | ārtā naśyanti bahavaḥ prajā nāśaṃ prayānti ca ||57|| rājā pāpaphalaṃ bhuṃkte pāpātmā prajayā saha | devā devālayā yajñā viprā hatāśca bhūbhṛtā ||58|| jātāḥ prajāśca tanmayyastataḥ pīḍāṃ prayānti tāḥ | vārtaiṣā divi satye ca devarṣayo vadanti hi ||99|| brahmaputrīmukhācchrutvā jātadayo’hamāgataḥ | nirīkṣituṃ samīkartuṃ sāntvayituṃ tadāpadaḥ ||4.105.60|| yadi mātuḥ kṛpā cāsti cikīrṣāmi prarakṣaṇam | śrutvaivaṃ badrike kāmākṣiṇo prāha sanatmunim ||61 || rājā pāpatamaścāste tataḥ prajā ca tādṛśī | daṇḍārho vidyate rājā sākṣād daṇḍyo’sti sarvathā |||62|| śikṣottaraṃ kṛpā yuktā devadrohī yatā nṛpaḥ | itikāmākṣiṇīvākyaṃ śrutvovāca sanatmuniḥ ||63|| astvevaṃ pāpakṛd rājā daṇḍaṃ bhunaktu gocaram | tāvad devyā smṛtastatra yamadūtaḥ samāyayau ||64|| vikarālaḥ karālāsyaḥ kajjalābho giriprabhaḥ | samudgaro vyomamārgeṇāvātatāra sannidhau ||65|| māyāpālaṃ vinigṛhya badhvā sadehamambare | nināya mārayanmāraṃ mudgareṇa yamālayam ||66|| citraguptoditakarmaphalabhogārthameva saḥ | kṣipto lohamayīsūrmyāliṃganārthaṃ mahānale ||67|| tato’titaptatailāḍhyakaṭāhe bharjitaḥ sa tu | mahārauravanarake bhakṣito rauravaistataḥ ||68|| asipatravane rājā cālito bhedito bahuḥ | vṛṣadaṃśo vṛścikādyairdṛṣṭaḥ sarpādibhistathā ||69|| viśastaḥ prāṇibhiścāpi nṛpo viśasane muhuḥ | saptaloharasai rājā pāyitaśca punaḥ punaḥ ||4.105.70|| lakuṭaiḥ kṣārayaṣṭyādyaistāḍitaśca vighātitaḥ | adhomastakavān rājā vahnikuṇḍe pradāhitaḥ ||71 || tāmrabhūmau cālitaśca cūrṇito yantrakaistataḥ | peṣitaścakrakaiścāpi randhito bhakṣito yamaiḥ || 72|| sandaṃśena nṛpajihvā niṣkāsitā ca kartitā | karṇayoḥ sīsakaṃ taptaṃ secitaṃ ca mukhe’pi ca ||73|| śūlaṃ taptaṃ netrayośca nihitaṃ ca gale’pi ca | śaktyā rājā bheditaśca vakṣasyeva punaḥ punaḥ ||74|| utkṛtya carma bhūpasya māṃsaṃ vai khāditaṃ yamaiḥ | rudhiraṃ ca yamaiḥ pītaṃ majjāsyāsvāditā yamaiḥ ||75|| śvāpadaiḥ phāḍitaścāpi kuṃbhipāke nipātitaḥ | lohayantre peṣitaśca parvatāt pātitastathā ||76|| vaitaraṇyāṃ vāhitaśca liṅgaṃ tasya vikartitam | napuṃsakīkṛto rājā nirvṛṣaṇo’bhavattataḥ ||77|| strībhagāḍhyaḥ śarīre ca sahasrabhagavān kṛtaḥ | strīmūtraṃ pāyitastatra prāśitaḥ pāśavaṃ malam || 78|| śaṃkunyāsānnāsikāyāṃ gudāyāṃ ca prapīḍitaḥ | galarodhānmāritaśca karasparśena jīvitaḥ ||79|| punaśca bhakṣito rājā punaḥ svasthīkṛto muhuḥ | ityevaṃ karmaṇāṃ rājā phalāni tena varṣmaṇā ||4.105.8 0|| daivecchyāptavān kaṣṭānyanantāni yamālaye | sanatkumāro bhagavān dhyānena ca samādhinā ||8 1 || vyalokayaddhi tatsarvaṃ pāpaphalaṃ nṛpe tadā | punardayāṃ parāṃ prāpyovāca kāmākṣikāṃ satīm |||82|| duṣṭānāṃ damanaṃ dharmaḥ sa ca jāto’sti bhūbhṛti | devānāṃ tu dayā dharmaḥ kartavyo’dya nṛpādiṣu ||83|| bhuṃkte kaṣṭāni bhūpālaścākrośaṃ prakarotyapi | hā hato’smi hā hato’smi trātā me trāṇamāvaha ||84|| na nāstikyaṃ kariṣye’haṃ na vyavāyaṃ na hiṃsanam | na cauryaṃ haraṇaṃ vāpi nindanaṃ śaṭhatāṃ na ca ||85|| na yajñānāṃ nirodhaṃ vā pūjāvarodhanaṃ na vā | na kariṣye’vamānaṃ ca sādhūnāṃ yogināṃ tathā ||86|| hā ced rakṣākaraḥ kaścinnārāyaṇo naro’pi vā | māṃ prarakṣya nijaṃ lokaṃ sadehaṃ prāpayantvitaḥ ||87|| praṇamāmi parātmānaṃ yamaṃ dharmaṃ namāmi ca | viṣṇuṃ haraṃ vedhasaṃ ca praṇamāmi janārdanam ||88|| kāmākṣīṃ ca satīṃ durgāṃ lakṣmīṃ namāmi rakṣikām | tīrthāni praṇamāmyatra sādhūnnamāmi rakṣakān ||89|| devān sarvān praṇamāmi rakṣantu māṃ yamālayāt | bhajiṣye paramātmānaṃ pūjayiṣye dvijān sataḥ ||4.105.90|| satsaṃgatiṃ vidhāsye’haṃ tīrthasnānaṃ gurūtsavam | dānayajñaṃ brahmayajñaṃ kariṣye jñānayajñakam ||9 1 || japayajñaṃ homayajñaṃ kariṣye sādhusevanam | evaṃ pralapan vilapan nanāma cāmbare muhuḥ ||9|| tāvad devājñayā sādhuḥ sanatkumārako muniḥ | kṣaṇamātreṇa cādarśi yamālaye nṛpāgrataḥ ||93|| sūryavadbhāsurāṃgaṃ taṃ taponidhiṃ hareḥ priyam | bhaktipātraṃ jagattrāṇakaraṃ siddhaṃ dayānvitam ||94|| āgataṃ śāntamanasaṃ puṇyanidhiṃ suyoginam | brahmaśīlaparaṃ dṛṣṭvā yamadūtā bhayaṃ yayuḥ || 65|| tyaktvā nṛpaṃ yayustūrṇaṃ dharmarājasabhāṃ prati | jagadustaṃ ca vṛttāntaṃ yameśo vismayaṃ yayau ||96|| utthāya sahasā dharmarājaḥ svāgatamācarat | satkāraṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi stavaṃ cakāra vai muneḥ ||97|| papraccha cānye hetuṃ muneḥ pādajalaṃ papau | rājñaḥ pāśavimuktyarthamāgato’smyāha taṃ muniḥ ||98|| pāpināṃ pāpanāśārthaṃ sādhūnāṃ karma śasyate | tadahaṃ cāsya pāpānāṃ nāśārthaṃ pāśamuktaye ||99|| samāgato’smi dharmandra vimocayainamatra ha | mā ciraṃ kuru dharmendra vimocaya nṛpaṃ drutam || 4.105.10 0|| asya duḥkhasya cānantyaṃ na draṣṭuṃ śakyate mayā | tasmānmocaya rājendraṃ neṣye sadehameva tam || 101 || ityuktvā virarāma drāṅ muniḥ sanatkumārakaḥ | dharmo vicārya vākyāni munaye samuvāca ha || 10 2|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne māyāpālanṛpasyanāstikyaṃ mahāpāpāni ca, tatphalāni, sadehasya yāmyadaṇḍabhogaḥ, tadrakṣārthaṃ sanatkumārāgamaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 105 ||
<4.106> śrīnaranārāyapa uvāca badrike dharmarājastaṃ sanatkumārakaṃ munim | vinayena nṛpasyaiva ceṣṭitaṃ prāha cāghabhṛt || 1 || daṇḍapātraṃ svayaṃ rājā sanatkumāra sarvathā | na moktavyo’tipāpātmā mahāpāpakaro hi saḥ || 2 || madyaṃ māṃsaṃ ghasāśitvaṃ kṛtavānayamulbaṇam | devānāṃ nindanaṃ mūrtināśaṃ makhavighātanam || 3 || devadvijadhanānāṃ cāpahāraṃ kṛtavānayam | ucchedaṃ dānayajñānāṃ kṛtavān stainyamulbaṇam || 4 || kanyāśīlavihantāyaṃ vyavāyaṃ kṛtavānayam | paradārarataścāyaṃ paśupakṣiprabhakṣakaḥ || 5 || dharmakāryavihantāyaṃ hariṃmanyo’tigarvavān | nārāyaṇasya bhāgān vai bhuktavān svayameva ha || 6 || yādasāṃ bhakṣakaścāyaṃ luñcādo luṇṭako’pyayam | satīsādhvīdharṣayitā snānatīrthādilopanaḥ || 7 || devānāṃ devatānāṃ ca mandirāṇāṃ vināśakaḥ | nindakaśca satāṃ dharmakarmaṇāṃ pāpavācanaḥ ||8|| pāpaśravaṇakāraśca nāstiko’dharmavarttanaḥ | vṛttihā jīvikāhantā prasahya śīlanāśakaḥ || 9 || śaraṇāgatahantāyaṃ svargamārganirodhakaḥ | devahavirvirodhī ca vahnipūjāvināśanaḥ || 4.106.1 0|| sādhūnāṃ nāśakaścāyaṃ na moktavyaḥ kathañcana | koṭivarṣasahasrāṇi koṭivarṣārbudānyapi || 1 1|| bhuñjānasya svapāpānāṃ nistāro’tra tathāpi na | evaṃvidho’yaṃ pāpiṣṭho bhagavannindakaḥ sadā || 12|| kṛṣṇadhiṣṇyasthito nityaṃ naivedyaṃ bhuktavānayam | yāvat kṣitirbhaved yāmyaloko yāvacca vidyate || 1 3|| tāvacca nijapāpāni bhuñjānasyāpi nāvadhiḥ | evaṃ pāpatamaścāyaṃ moktavyo na kathañcana || 14|| sādho rājā svayaṃ pāpī prajānāṃ pāpayogadaḥ | prajānāṃ pāpamārgeṣu prerako’yaṃ yataḥ sadā || 15|| ataḥ prajānāṃ pāpātmā prajāpāpaphalāśrayaḥ | brahmaṇo varṣaparyantaṃ moktavyo’yaṃ na vai kvacit || 16|| sarvapāpairmucyate’pi devadrohānna mucyate | viśvāsaghātakartuśca drogdhurdevasya sadguroḥ || 17|| dharmaghātakinaścāpi niṣkṛtirnaiva vidyate | devānāṃ nindakasyāpi yajñanāśakarasya ca || 18|| mūrterharturna vai cāsti niṣkṛtistu mune kvacit | tasmādayaṃ na moktavyo brahmāṇḍapāpavānayam || 19|| śrīsanatkumāra uvāca yogyaṃ daṇḍapradānaṃ vai yamasya daṇḍaśāsituḥ | yogyaṃ daṇḍānmocanaṃ vai sādhordayāvatastathā ||4.106.20||| pāpināṃ pāpanāśārthaṃ sādhavo nirmitāḥ purā | brahmaṇā nirmitaścāhaṃ pāpanāśāya muktaye ||21 || ṛbhuśca sanakādyā me bhrātaro’pi tathā kṛtāḥ | dayālavo’ghahantāro muktidāḥ sarvadehinām ||22||| rājā tu prāptavān daṇḍaṃ bahudhā śikṣaṇāya vai | prajāduḥkhaṃ mahaccāpi vidyate kāmarūpake || 23 || anāvṛṣṭikṛtaṃ rogakṛtaṃ daivāparādhajam | moktavyāstāḥ prajāścāpi mayā vṛṣṭividhāpanāt || 24|| drutaṃ mocaya rājānaṃ nītvā prayāmi nānyathā | svasti te’stu sadā dharma sādhorvākyāni pālaya || 25|| harervācaḥ satāṃ vāco nollaṃghyā vai kadācana | aprasanneṣu satsvatra hānirmahatī cāpatet || 26|| śrīdharmarāja uvāca asya pāpāni kasmaiścid deyāni tu mune tvayā | rājñe deyāni śeṣāṇi tato muktiṃ prayāsyati || 27|| pāpadānaṃ kaṣṭadānaṃ duṣṭadānaṃ hi vidyate | pāpaśuddhiṃ nākartā na vimoktuṃ samarhati || 28|| putro vā pramadā putrī bhrātā guruśca vā sakhā | pāpaṃ cennṛpateḥ sarvaṃ gṛhṇīyānmucyate tadā || 29|| śrīsanatkumā uvāca tiṣṭha dharma kṣaṇaṃ patnī vidyate’sya nayāmyaham | uktyaivaṃ kṣaṇamātreṇānayad rājñīṃ muniryamam || 4.106.30 || vada rājā mucyate’tra pāpaṃ gṛhāṇa bhūbhṛtaḥ | sā prāha nāhaṃ gṛhṇāmi pāpaṃ kaṣṭapradaṃ yataḥ || 31 || puṇyaṃ gṛhṇāmi patyuśca na pāpaṃ kaṣṭadṃ kvacit | mayā kṛtāni pāpāni tāni gṛhṇātu bhūpatiḥ || 32|| rājñaḥ pāpena me putrāḥ putryo naṣṭāḥ śataṃ śatam | prajānāśo vartate ca pāpaṃ gṛhṇāmi naiva ha || 33 || rugṇāhaṃ duḥkhasaṃvyāptā kathaṃ gṛhṇāmi pāpakam | puṇyasya bhāginī syāṃ vai na syāṃ pāpasya bhāginī || 34|| ityuktvā virarāmāsau patnī maunaṃ dadhāra ha | dharmarājastadā badri prāha sanatkumārakam || 31|| gṛhāṇarṣe’sya pāpāni naya taṃ nijarāṣṭrakam | omityāha dayāluḥ sa pāpaṃ jagrāha vāriṇā || 3 6|| rājā nirdoṣatāṃ prāpto yamena mocitastadā | sanatkumāro bhagavān pūjito’tha yamādibhiḥ || 37|| nṛpaṃ nītvā ca yāvat saḥ prasthitastāvadeva tu | nārakāścāsaṃkhya jīvāścakrurākrośamulbaṇam || 38 || pratvalāmo vayaṃ sādho māsmān vihāya yāhi vai | tavāgamena kuṇḍasthā vayaṃ tvadvāyunā tathā || 3 9|| darśanena tava sādho parā śāntiṃ gatāstviha | duḥkhāni dehasaṃsthāni yāmyaviṣolbaṇāni ca ||4.106.40|| taijasāni jvalanāni naṣṭāni cāntarāṇyapi | tasmādāyāhi sādho tvaṃ rakṣayātra ca naḥ sadā ||41 || ityevaṃ nārakāḥ sādhu prārthayāmāsurutsukāḥ | sanatkumāro bhagavān dayāṃ prāpya punastadā ||42|| dharmarājaṃ samuvāca rājannetām̐śca nārakān | vimocaya mahāduḥkhānnarakānmama vāñcchayā ||43|.| sādhoḥ samāgamo nityaṃ duḥkhināṃ duḥkhanāśakaḥ | śāntidaścāghahaścāpi paramoddhārakārakaḥ ||44|| yamarāja mahābāho dayāṃ kṛtvā vimocaya | nānyathāhamito yāmi tiṣṭhāmyatraiva te gṛhe ||45||| ityukto yamarājaśca pratyuvāca muniṃ śanaiḥ | mune samartha evāsi kintu nyāyo na vidyate ||46|| pāpināṃ mocanaṃ naiva yogyaṃ yamālayāt kvacit | pāpabhogaṃ vinā naiva tyaktavyā nigaḍasthitāḥ ||47|| yadyevaṃ mocaye duṣṭān nyāyālayo nirarthakaḥ | sādhūnādāya bahavaścāyāsyantīha mānavāḥ ||48|| nijān vimocayiṣyanti nārakān vā tathāparān | andhanyāyapravāho’yaṃ pravartsyate tataḥ param ||49|| tasmādime samastā vai tyaktavyā nārakā nahi | nṛpaṃ nītvā mune yāhi yatheṣṭaṃ kuru bhūtale ||4.106.50 || ityukto badrike sādhuḥ sanatkumāra ācarat | niṣadya bhagavannāmaraṭanaṃ dhunyamuttamam ||51 || bālakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo hare vibho ||52|| satataṃ śrāvayāmāsa bhramitvākhilatatpuram | nārakāśca samākarṇya muktabandhāstadābhavan ||53|| yamadūtā yayurdūraṃ śrutvā nāma harestadā | nārakā narakaṃ tyaktyā yayuḥ svargaṃ tadottaram ||54|| sanatkumāraḥ satataṃ babhrāma daśavārakam | yamaloke muhuḥ saṃśrāvayan kṛṣṇanarāyaṇa ||55 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa gopālabālaka | kambharāśrīmahālakṣmīnandanācyuta keśava ||56|| prabhokṛṣṇa parasvāmin kṛṣṇanārāyaṇācyuta | svāminnārāyaṇaviṣṇo puruṣottama mādhava ||57|| tālikāṃ vādayitvaivaṃ munirdhunyaṃ yamālaye | cakāra paritastatra vicaran mokṣayan janān ||58|| nārakā narakān hitvā hitvā bhayaṃ ca dūtajam | nirgatya divyadehāśca bhūtvā bhūtvā divaṃ yayuḥ ||59|| kuṇḍāni prāyaśastatra riktāni cābhavam̐stadā | munerbhajanavegena kuṇḍāni riktatāṃ yayuḥ ||4.106.6 0|| naiko’pi nārakī tatra dṛśyate tu yamālaye | evaṃ vai kṛtavān cānugrahaṃ sanatkumārakaḥ ||6 1 || māyāpālo nṛpaścāpi vyadhād bhajanamuttamam | antarātman hare svāmin kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca || 6 2|| tālikāṃ vādayitvaiva cakre dhunyaṃ pravegataḥ | nārakāḥ sukhitāstena mocitāśca yamālayāt ||63 || dharmarājastathā dūtāścitraguptādayo’pi ca | yamāśca bhṛtyavargāścābhavan galitagarvakāḥ ||64|| yāmyaloke na caiko’pi śiṣyate daṇḍadoṣavān | sanatkumāro bhagavān preṣayāmāsa tān divam || 69|| yamo vismayamāpanno pūjāyāmāsa taṃ munim | aho sādhoḥ pramāhātmyaṃ hareriva mahattamam ||66|| anyathākartumevāpi samartho’sti hariryathā | rājā prasannatāṃ prāpto yathā nigaḍabandhinaḥ ||67|| vimocayati tūrṇaṃ svecchayā tadvanmahāmuniḥ | samarthānāṃ prabhāvāgre niyamā yānti saṃkṣayam ||68 || pāpināṃ pāpanāśāya samarthāḥ santa eva ha | bhāgyarekhāsusaṃvyatyāse’pi śaktā hi sādhavaḥ || 69|| śāpānugrahaśaktāśca tārakāḥ pāpavārakāḥ | puṇyapuñjapradātāraḥ samarthāḥ sādhavo’nvaham ||4.106.7 0 || yatra nārāyaṇakṛṣṇasvāmīśrīrvartate hṛdi | sarvā hi śaktayastatra vasanti sādhumādhave ||7 1 || ityuktvāha yameśastaṃ kṣantavyo’haṃ sadā tvayā | sādhunābhyudayāyāpi kṣantavyā gṛhadharmiṇaḥ ||72|| ityabhyarthya dadau pūjāṃ munaye yamarāṭ svayam | puṣpamālāṃ candanaṃ ca nīrājanaṃ ca daṇḍavat ||73 || naivedyaṃ miṣṭamiṣṭaṃ ca kṣīrāmṛtaṃ subhojanam | jalāmṛtaṃ śubhaṃ cāpi mukhavāsaṃ tathottamam ||74|| pādau prakṣālya dugdhena papau dharmaḥ svayaṃ muneḥ | dhūmrorṇāpi ca tatpatnī papau pādajalaṃ muneḥ ||75|| citraguptādayaścāpi brahmaputrāśca lekhakāḥ | papurmuneḥ pādavāri prasādaṃ jagṛhustataḥ ||76|| yamadūtā samastāśca śravaṇā pitarastathā | anye’pi bhṛtyavargāśca yamarājakuṭumbinaḥ ||77|| sarve cakrurdaṇḍavacca sanatkumārakaṃ munim | vidāyaṃ cārpayāmāsurjayaśabdaiḥ sughoṣitaiḥ ||78|| sanatkumārastān sarvānāśīrvādaiḥ prayujya ca | vyomamārgeṇa rājānaṃ nītvā kāmākṣiṇīṃ yayau | |79|| rājapatnī ca rājānaṃ cāsthāpayattadālaye | sadehau tau pravīkṣyaiva yāmyaduḥkhāni sarvathā ||4.106.8 0 || jātau tadāstikau sarva daivakāryaparāyaṇau | yajñārambhaṃ cakratuśca viprairmaharṣibhiḥ śubham ||8 1 || viṣṇuyāge dadatustau dakṣiṇāṃ kośariktatām | sarvasvaṃ nāṇakaṃ svarṇaṃ raupyaṃ dadaturbhāvataḥ ||82|| sanatkumāro bhagavān vartayāmāsa cādhvaram | megho vavarṣa cātyarthaṃ rogā naṣṭāḥ samantataḥ ||8 3|| rājayakṣmā nṛpateśca naṣṭo nirmūla eva ha | muneḥ kṛpayā rāṣṭraṃ ca sasyasampatsuśobhanam ||84|| jātaṃ yāvacca vai tāvat sādhurdadau nṛpāya tu | akṣayāṃ tumbikāṃ divyāṃ miṣṭānnapūritāṃ śubhām ||85|| sācchādanāṃ tathā cānyāmakṣayyavārisaṃbhṛtām | ājñāṃ ca dattavān rājñe rājñyai sanatkumārakaḥ ||8 6|| ariktābhyāṃ tumbikābhyāmannavāri prapūrṇakam | ācchādya dakṣahastena dātavyaṃ ca nirantaram ||87|| akṣayaṃ tajjalamannaṃ varṣamātraṃ bhaviṣyati | tataste tumbike mahyaṃ svayamevāgamiṣyataḥ ||88|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā | mantraṃ dadau nṛpāyāpi rājñyai prajābhya ityapi ||8 9|| ityuktvā dakṣiṇāṃ labdhvā pradatvā tumbike tataḥ | muniryayau vyomapathā satyalokaṃ sukhāśrayam || 4.106.90 || mṛtānāṃ ca tadā rājāvabhṛthe śrāddhamācarat | te’pi pītvā ca bhuktvā ca pitaraḥ pretasaṃjñakāḥ || 91 || brahmaputrījale snātvā muktā bhūtvā yayurdivam | kāmākṣī suprasannā ca sañjātā sarvakāmadā || 92| rājā tāṃ pratyahaṃ rājñī cāpi pupūja mātaram | devālayān samastāṃśca kārayāmāsa vai punaḥ || 93 || pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayāmāsa māyāpālaḥ punastathā | jīvikāṃ dāpayāmāsa yojayāmāsa bhūsurān || 94|| ahiṃsāṃ brahmacaryaṃ cāsteyaṃ rarakṣa bhūpatiḥ | māṃsamadyādisantyāgaṃ cakāra sarvathā nṛpaḥ || 95|| kathotsavān subahulān kārayāmāsa vai nṛpaḥ | annasatrāṇi ramyāṇi vidyāśālāḥ suśobhanāḥ || 9 6|| sādhvāśramām̐śca vipulān kārayāmāsa śobhanān | dharmakṛtyāni dādāni satīsādhvyādisevanam ||97|| anāthadīnarakṣāṃ ca kārayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ | bhajanārthaṃ maṇḍalāni klṛptayāmāsa rāṣṭrake ||98|| bālakṛṣṇa harikṛṣṇānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇa | rādhālakṣmīpate muktapate mokṣaparāyaṇa ||99|| evaṃ dhunyaṃ prajāścakrurmantrajāpaṃ pracakrire | kṛpayā parameśasya vaiṣṇavaṃ rāṣṭrameva tat || 4.106.100 || sañjātaṃ bhagavanmārgaparāyaṇaṃ samastakam | mokṣamārgagataṃ sarvaṃ prajāḥ kālena mokṣaṇam || 101 || prāpurnṛpo’pi kālena sanatkumāratāritaḥ | vimānena striyā sākaṃ yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ hareḥ || 1 02|| evaṃ badrīpriye sādhuḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśakaḥ | sarvapuṇyapradaścāpi kṛpāluḥ sevito yadi || 10 3||| mokṣaṃ dadyād divaṃ dadyād vyasanāni vināśayet | kalikālamahādoṣānnāśayet kṣaṇamātrataḥ || 1 04|| nigaḍāni nāśayecca māyābandhaṃ vimocayet | prāpayet paramātmānaṃ kṛpāpātraṃ nijāśritam || 1 02|| sādhurvai sādhanaṃ tasmāt kalau mokṣapradaṃ mahat | divyaṃ pātraṃ pareśasya sādhuḥ sarvārthasampradaḥ || 1 06|| badrike cātipāpānāṃ nāśakaḥ sādhusattamaḥ | sevanīyaḥ kalau lokaiḥ sarvecchāpūrako hariḥ || 1 07|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kāmarūpabhūpaternāmnā māyāpālasya sadehayamaloke yātanābhogaḥ, sanatkumārasādhunā kṛtastasyoddhāraścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 106 ||
<4.107> śrībadrīpriyovācanaranārāyaṇa viṣṇo kṛṣṇa keśava mādhava | kalau cārdhe gate dharmāḥ pālyā lokaistu kīdṛśāḥ || 1 || dravyahrāse guṇahrāse balahrāso’pi jāyate | kālahrāse dharmahrāsaḥ śraddhāhrāso’pi jāyate || 2 || prātikūlye neṣṭasiddhistato hrāsāḥ samastakāḥ | pravartante prajāvarge nāstikyapreritā muhuḥ || 3 || tadānīṃ śuddhayaḥ śaucaṃ vratāni kīdṛśāni vai | pūjādikaṃ kīdṛśaṃ ca makhā vā kīdṛśāstadā || 4 || kalau pālayitavyān me sadācārān prakīrtaya | prāyaḥ kecana tiṣye’pi pālayanti samāstikāḥ || 5 || śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca badrike nimnavege vai tiṣye nimnā vṛṣā matāḥ | samāsena kathayāmi śṛṇu sarvān tadāsthitān || 6 || śītodakena vai snānaṃ kalau nāstyeva sarvathā | uṣṇodakena vai snānaṃ kvacit kvacittadā matam || 7 || bhasmasnānaṃ kalau tyāgivarge prāyaḥ kalau yuge | karāsyakṣālanamātraṃ prātaḥsnānaṃ kalau yuge || 8 || mukhaśuddhirgaṇḍuṣaiśca bhasmanā kardamena vā | kvacit kāṣṭhena bhavati dhūmrapānena sarvathā || 9 || tailakṣepaḥ śiraḥśuddhiścūrṇena mukhaśuddhikā | ācamanaṃ kalau miṣṭodakapānātmakaṃ tadā || 4.107.10 || devapūjā jalenaiva kalau vā jāyate na vā | naivedyaṃ kalpanāmātraṃ mānasaṃ vai kalau na vā || 11 || ārārtrikaṃ caikavarttivahninādbhiśca vā na vā | namaskāro daṇḍavat sa jayaśabdaḥ stutirna vā || 12|| makhastu cullikāvahnau tailabindūpasarpaṇam | naivedyaṃ śrīphalaṃ māse māse vā vatsare’thavā || 1 3|| veṣadānaṃ tathā māse vatsare vā surādiṣu | sindūradānakaṃ varṣe vastradānādi vā navā || 14|| snāpanaṃ vā tathaiveti māse vā vatsare’thavā | evaṃ devavidhistiṣye hrāsaṃ gato vijāyate || 15|| ātithyaṃ jalamātreṇa kalau vācā ca kevalam | vaiśvadevo mukhe naije kavalasya pradānakam || 1 6|| sāyaṃpūjā tarūdyāne bhramaṇaṃ nāṭake’thavā | utsavaḥ strīdhanayogaḥ kalau cāste gṛhe gṛhe || 17|| keśaprasādhanaṃ strīṇāṃ saubhāgyaṃ cūrṇalepanam | randhitānnaṃ kaṇavadvai na duṣṭaṃ sa vṛṣaḥ kalau || 18|| aspṛśyaṃ randhitānnaṃ na nābhakṣyaṃ kasyacid vṛṣaḥ | sarvavidhaṃ jalaṃ peyaṃ pūtaṃ jalaṃ sadā vṛṣaḥ || 1 9|| pātre’pi bhraṣṭatā nāstyucchiṣṭaṃ pātraṃ su pāvanam | ucchiṣṭajaladhānyā vai kṣiptaṃ dhautaṃ sadā śuci || 4.107.20 || vastreṇa mārjitaṃ pātraṃ śuddhaṃ sarvavidhaṃ tadā | ūrṇāvacchuci kārpāsāmbaraṃ sarvatra vai kalau ||2 1|| malatyāgottaraṃ snānaṃ kalau nāstyeva nāsti hi | karaśuddhirjalenaiva vastreṇa guhyaśuddhikāḥ || 22|| pādaprakṣālanaṃ nāsti kalau bhūśodhanaṃ nahi | prāyaścittaṃ kalau nāsti rājadaṇḍo hi śodhanam |||23|| vāyunā śodhanaṃ sūryakiraṇaiḥ śodhanaṃ kalau | mārjanena ca vā śuddhirlepanaṃ na kalau tadā || 24|| paśupakṣyādisaṃsparśo bhojyeṣu nāsti dūṣaṇam | ucchiṣṭadūṣaṇaṃ naiva paryuṣitasya naiva ca ||25|| pātrauṣṭhasparśadoṣo na kalau tadā gṛhe gṛhe | sāṃkaryaṃ sampradāyānāṃ sadharmo vai kalau gṛhe ||26|| śavasparśe sūtakaṃ tu snānāt tiṣye gataṃ bhavet | rāhusparśaḥ sūtakaṃ na kalau prāyastu sarvathā ||27|| maraṇaṃ sūtakaṃ tāvad yāvacchokasmṛtiḥ khalu | kalau caikādaśāhādiśrāddhabhojyaṃ gṛhe gṛhe ||28|| ekāhādūrdhvamapi tad bhojanaṃ gṛhyate kalau | janmanaḥ sūtakaṃ yāvanmātuḥ svāsthyaṃ na śobhanam ||29|| māturevāpi tattatra nānyeṣāṃ sūtakaṃ kalau | rājasvalyaṃ sūtakaṃ na kalau strīṇāṃ mataṃ tadā ||4.107.30|| rajodarśanamātraṃ tu mūtravad gaṇyate kalau | maithunasyāpyaśuddhirna kalau kalmaṣaśālinoḥ ||3 1|| malatyāge hmaśuddhirna gaṇyate vamane yathā | malavāhāḥ śvapacāśca śuddhāḥ kalau pure pure ||32|| mṛtamāṃsādanāścāpi śuddhā kalau gṛhe gṛhe | yavanāḥ śvapacāścarmakārā bhṛtyā gṛhe gṛhe || 33|| pācakāste sūdakāste brahmakṣatrālayādiṣu | sūkaragardabhaśvoṣṭrasparśadoṣo kalau nahi ||34|| mlecchānāṃ mandire vāsaḥ pavitro vai kalau tadā | vyasanānāṃ susammānaṃ vratānāṃ tyāga eva ca ||35|| sadānnabhojanaṃ dharmaḥ kalau bhavati śastimān | ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ tiṣye gaṇyate copavāsavat ||36|| ekapatnīvratastiṣye gaṇyate naiṣṭhikaḥ sa vai | gṛhasthadharmavām̐stiṣye tyāgī pragaṇyate tadā ||37|| kāmadveṣabharācāryā gaṇyante mokṣadāḥ kalau | dveṣamārgapraṇetāro guravo mokṣadāḥ kalau ||38|| vaitaṇḍikāḥ suvidvām̐saḥ pūjyante ceśavat kalau | ājñāyāṃ kiṃkarastyāgī gṛhasthasya mahāguruḥ ||39|| gṛhasthadāsyakarmā ca tyāgī kalau prapūjyate | gṛhasthaḥ strīpradātā ca tyāgikṛpāparaḥ kalau ||4.107.40|| sa eva bhaktarāṭ tiṣye yaunasambaddha uttamaḥ | tiṣye bhikṣānnabhoktāro gṛhasthā dhārmikā iti ||41|| sādhubhyo bhṛtyatāṃ naijāṃ kārayanti gṛhasthitāḥ | nijasevākaraḥ sādhuḥ śreṣṭho gṛhasudharmiṇām ||42|| kalau tu guruśiṣyāṇāṃ dāraikyaṃ dharma uttamaḥ | udarārthaṃ tu nārīṇāṃ parabhogyatvamityapi ||43|| kalau kalau jāyate tu gṛhe gṛhe jane jane | mṛttikānāṃ tu pātrāṇāṃ sadā śuddhiḥ kalau kalau ||44|| carmasparśo dūṣaṇaṃ na pattrāṇasparśa ityapi | malasparśo dūṣaṇaṃ na kalau sarvaprājāsu vai ||45|| śmaśānavasatirdoṣo śavadhūmro’pi dūṣaṇam | kalau na gaṇyate tiryakśavasparśo’pi dūṣaṇam ||46|| mūtrasparśo dūṣaṇaṃ na gaṇyate tiṣyagairjanaiḥ | nāsikāmalasaṃspṛṣṭanaktakaśca kalau śuciḥ ||47|| dhotraṃ śuddhaṃ kaṭivastraṃ śuddhaṃ kalau ca ghargharī | kaupīnakaṃ kalau śuddhaṃ suravālaḥ sadā śuciḥ ||48|| vāmahastaḥ kalau śuddho nāsā śuddhā malānvitā | kalau kalāvatī nālī śuddhā vāripradā prapā ||49|| carmakośaḥ kalau śuddhaḥ kūpapātraṃ ghaṭī tathā | tailakārasya yantraṃ vai śuddhaṃ śuddhaśca tailakṛt ||4.107.50 || madirākṛt kalau śuddhaḥ śuddhaṃ ca rudhiraṃ kalau | asthi śuddhaṃ kalau sarvaṃ dantidantanibhaṃ tadā ||51 || majjā śuddhā tu matsyānāṃ sūkarāṇāṃ ghṛtaṃ śuci | aṇḍāni kukkuṭādīnāṃ śuddhāni vai kalau tadā |||52|| jalapakvaṃ piṣṭakādi śuddhaṃ kalau gṛhe gṛhe | nāpitaśca kṣuraścāpi śuddhā vāṭakikāsya ca ||513 || mlecchasya dugdhadadhyādipātraṃ śuddhaṃ kalau sadā | auṣadhaṃ māṃsamadyāḍhyaṃ śuddhaṃ kalau jane jane |||54||| bhojyapātre romapāto bhojane’pi kalau śuciḥ | samudrapārayātrādi śuci saudhe ca tālakam ||55|| palāṇḍulaśunādyaṃ ca śuci tiṣye gṛhe gṛhe | patrakaḥ kargadaścāpi śucistiṣye ca kardamaḥ ||56|| gṛhakoṇe tathā bhittau ṣṭhīvanaṃ dvāri gopure | cullībhasmani śayyāyāḥ pārśve tatpāvanaṃ kalau ||97|| sūryodayanādūrdhvaṃ jāgratistu sa kalau vṛṣaḥ | rātryardhe’pi vyavasāyo dharmo bhavati vai kalau ||58|| divārātraṃ tu yantrāṇāṃ gatiḥ kṛtiśca cālanam | āyodhanaṃ mithaḥ kṣudralābhārthaṃ sa vṛṣaḥ kalau ||59|| gṛhāśramo’pi vṛddhānāṃ śasyate tu vṛṣaḥ kalau | anyāyavijayo dharmaḥ kalau kleśakaro mahān || 4.107.60 || yo mṛṣāndolanakarastiṣye dharmagururhi saḥ | kalau kiñcitpradhīḥ prāṇī gurureva sa dharmavit || 61 || aśāstrajñāśca luñcādāḥ kalau vai dharmamūrtayaḥ | brāhmaṃ muhūrtaṃ nidrāyāṃ kelikarmaṇi vā vṛṣaḥ || 62|| adevasmaraṇaṃ sāyaṃ gāyatrīvarjanaṃ divā | ajapaścāpyahotraśca grāmyādhyayanamityapi || 63|| apitṛtarpaṇaṃ dharmāḥ dyūtaṃ bhavanti sarvaśaḥ | pratimā puttalī spaṣṭā na bhāvastatra vai kalau || 64|| nakhakeśotkartane’pi nāśuddhirhi kalau matā | viṣṭāgṛhopaśīle’pi nāśuddhistatra gaṇyate ||65 || śvaśurasparśanaṃ vadhvā dūṣaṇaṃ na kalau tadā | paragotrasvagotrādisambandho bhūṣaṇaṃ kalau ||66 || nimnakanyāgrahaṇaṃ ca praśaṃsādharma uttamaḥ | yajñopavītakaṃ kaṇṭhī daivacihnaṃ sacandrakam || 67|| tilakaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ bhāle kalau dharmo vicandrakaḥ | pitari jīvati putraśmaśrumuṇḍanamityapi ||68 || dharmaḥ kalau praśasto vai vahniṃ vinā vivāhanam | vipraṃ vinā ca dātāraṃ vinā kanyārpaṇaṃ vṛṣaḥ || 69 || āpaṇe tu mahīmānabhojanaṃ cottamo vṛṣaḥ | saṃskārākaraṇaṃ dharmo vyayahīno vṛṣaḥ kalau || 4.107.70 || hatyāgṛhāṇi tiṣye tu puṇyasthānāni vai tadā | dhenūnāṃ tu kalau tatra śakaṭyāṃ yojanaṃ vṛṣaḥ ||7 1 || bahūnāmekapatnī ca kalau dharmo matastadā | prātastu vācanaṃ grāmyapatrāṇāṃ ca vṛṣastadā ||72|| vidhavāgrahaṇaṃ tiṣye paropakāra uttamaḥ | pāpināṃ svīkṛtistiṣye dharmaḥ śreyaskarastadā ||73 || agālitānāṃ pānaṃ ca rasānāṃ ca kalau vṛṣaḥ | adhavāyāḥ putravattvaṃ sagarbhātvaṃ vṛṣaḥ kalau ||74|| kumāryā api bālasya jananītvaṃ vṛṣaḥ kalau | gaṇikāyāśca pūjyatvaṃ bhāṇḍasyāpi kalau vṛṣaḥ ||75|| mauniślokamayī ceṣṭā vyavahāraḥ kalau bahuḥ | śāṭhyamaitihyamevāpi prathamaṃ nirṇaye kalau ||76 || tyāginaśca kalau sarve vyāpāriṇo maṭhe maṭhe | bahustrīmaṇḍalādhyakṣāḥ sannyāsakalpinaḥ kalau ||77|| bhṛtyadvārā surapūjākṣepakāstyāginaḥ kalau | gṛhasthāḥ pūjayā hīnā apatyārcāparāyaṇāḥ ||78 || śāsakānāmubhayatomukhavattvaṃ vṛṣaṃ kalau | dharmalakṣmīprabhoktṛtvaṃ kalau dharmo gṛhasthiteḥ ||79|| kalau dharmadāsaṃsthāyā bhakṣaṇaṃ mānavo vṛṣaḥ | dānaṃ svalpaṃ bahulaṃ cādānaṃ dharmo hi dehinām ||4.107.8 0 || utsaveṣu kṛpaṇatā kanyādhanasya bhakṣaṇam | prajāśoṣaṇaṃ bahulaṃ kalau dharmo’bhitastadā ||8 1 || anyāyayuddhakaraṇaṃ sevā ca karmacāritā | svalpāśābahulā labdherdharmaḥ kalau tadābhitaḥ ||82|| maryādānāṃ vilopaśca rājasī mānasī sthitiḥ | pade pade’nṛtatā ca kalau vṛṣo’bhitastadā ||83 || sarvajātīyalokānāṃ sarvakāryaprakāritā | sarvaveṣādyabhidhṛtirdharmaḥ kalau samānatā ||84|| aurasāḥ kṣetrajā dāsīputrāḥ kalau samāḥ sadā | dāyabhāge samāste ca putryaścāpi samāstathā ||85|| dhiṣṇyādhikāravān yaḥ sa samudāyapratiṣṭhitaḥ | śiṣyaḥ putraśca mitraṃ vā kalau saṃghakṛto mahān ||86 || vipratvaṃ tanumātraṃ vai tiṣyānte tantunāśanam | kṣattratvaṃ balavattvaṃ vai tiṣyānte balanāśanam ||87|| vaiśyatvaṃ dhanavattvaṃ vai tiṣyānte dhananāśanam | śūdratvaṃ bhṛtyatā tiṣye tiṣyānte bhṛtyatālayaḥ ||88|| ekākāraṃ samastaṃ vai samadharmāḥ kalau janāḥ | badrike tatra pāpaṃ na kalerbalājjaneṣu vai ||89|| svalpaṃ dānaṃ sādhave’pi svargamokṣapradaṃ tadā | hareḥ kīrtanamātraṃ vai kalau mokṣasya sādhanam || 4.107.90 || mālikayā japaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti mokṣadaḥ | japaḥ pāpauṣadhaṃ tiṣye nāśakaṃ cāghahārakam || 91 || kalmaṣāṇāṃ kṣālanaṃ sevanaṃ satāṃ gurorhareḥ | āntare smaraṇaṃ viṣṇoḥ śodhakaṃ pāvanaṃ param || 92|| bhāvaśuddhirmahāśuddhistiṣye śuddhistu netarā | bāhyaśuddhiḥ kalau kācit sattvaśuddhistu vai kvacit || 93 || karmaśuddhiḥ kalau nāsti puṇyaśuddhirna sarvathā | japaśuddhiḥ kalau tatra śasyate dhārmikī hi sā || 94|| sarvārpaṇaṃ harau kṛṣṇe gurau sanātane prabhau | kalau dharmaḥ praśasto vai mokṣadastatra cāntimaḥ ||95|| audāsīnyaṃ parakṛtye svakṛtye śāntavṛttitā | kṛtyārpaṇaṃ harau kṛṣṇe kalau mokṣasya sādhanam ||96|| sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ tiṣye ṣaṭkaṃ vai mokṣasādhanam | sevanaṃ cārpaṇaṃ bhaktirdhyānaṃ dānaṃ ca kīrtanam || 97|| kṛṣṇasya sadguroḥ sevā mahāśīrvādadāyinī | pāvanī snehakartrī ca paradhāmapradāyinī || 98|| śrīharau vā gurau sarvārpaṇaṃ niṣkarmarūpi tat | naiṣkarmyaṃ bhogavarjyaṃ tacchuddhidaṃ mokṣadaṃ tadā ||99|| bhaktiḥ snehena dāsyaṃ vai yathājñāvartanaṃ sadā | harau gurau hi kaiṃkaryaṃ snehakṛnmokṣadaṃ tadā || 4.107.100 || dhyānaṃ mūrterdhāraṇaṃ śrīharestu hṛdye sadā | gurordhyānaṃ ca hṛdye tanmayatvapradāyakam || 101 || tadātmakatā mokṣo vai nārāyaṇasvarūpavān | nārāyaṇasamā yā tu sthitiḥ sā dhyānasatphalā || 102 || viśiṣyate tato dhyānaṃ divyavṛṣaḥ kalau sadā | dhyānaṃ mokṣapradaṃ tasmānnārāyaṇāṃgavāsadam | | 103 || dānaṃ nārāyaṇe sādhau dīne vipre gurau dvije | satyāṃ sādhvyāṃ ca vidyāyāṃ paropakaraṇādiṣu || 1 04|| sarvāntaryāmirūpe vai kṛṣṇe dānaṃ pramokṣadam | akṣayyaphalakaṃ dānaṃ svalpaṃ tacchāśvataṃ harau || 1 05|| dānaṃ sakāmanādattaṃ svargadaṃ sampadāmpradam | kṛṣṇabuddhyārpitaṃ sarvaṃ nirguṇaṃ mokṣadaṃ kalau || 10 6|| kīrtanaṃ satataṃ viṣṇornāmnāṃ kṛṣṇa hare prabho | nārāyaṇa mahāviṣṇo puruṣottama sadvibho || 1 07|| svāmyanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīkṛṣṇamādhava | prabhokṛṣṇa pāśavatīkṛṣṇa lakṣmīśa vallabha || 108 || bhajanaṃ mokṣadaṃ tiṣye pāpahaṃ ca pramodadam | badrike tai smāsādvai mayoktaṃ tiṣyavartanam || 109 || na vistāro hi dharmāṇāṃ hrāsaśīle kalau tadā | kalpitāścānukūlāśca dharmāstatra kalau kṛtāḥ || 4.107.110 || svalpadharmo’pi tiṣye vai trāyate mahato bhayāt | paṭhanācchravaṇādasya tiṣyastho nirbhayo bhavet || 111 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne kalidharmāṇāṃ saṃkṣepato varṇanaṃ sevārpaṇabhaktidhyānadānakīrtanetiṣaṭkānyatamaṃ mokṣasādhanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 107 ||
<4.108> śrībadrīpriyovācanaranārāyaṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa jagatprabho | kalerante punardharmāḥ satyā bhavanti vā na vā || 1 || antimasya kalerante kalpānte kīdṛśī sthitiḥ | punaḥ kiṃ jāyate śūnyaṃ yadvā mūrtaṃ navaṃ param || 2 || śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kalerante harīcchayā | saṃbhavāmi tu satyānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ sthāpanāya vai || 3 || tadā tvaṃ cāsirūpā vai śvetasvarūpadhāriṇī | devairabhiṣṭutā divyā jalabhūvyomacāriṇī || 4 || jāyase tīkṣṇadhārāti naro’yaṃ cāśvarūpavān | śvetarūpo bhūmivārikhādivahnipracāravān ||9 || bhūtvā devairabhivandyo yatpārśve sampratiṣṭhati | tadāhaṃ taṃ matsvarūpaṃ śvetāśvaṃ nararūpiṇam || 6 || āruhya dharmaputro’haṃ viṣṇunāmidvijātmajaḥ | tvāṃ tadā divyaśaktyāḍhyāmasirūpāṃ suśobhanām ||7 || saṃgṛhya bhūtale badri vicarāmi jale sthale | kalikalmaṣapāpānāṃ nāśo madvāyunā tadā || 8 || pāpināṃ kalkadehānāṃ vināśaśca mamāsinā | mānasānāmaniṣṭānāṃ maddhyānaiḥ parivartanam || 9 || mānavānāṃ sāttvikānāṃ tadāyuṣyavivardhanam | dharme sthirasvabhāvānāṃ nisargataḥ prasañjanam || 4.108.1 0|| kṛtadharmābhipannānāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ prakāśanam | gurūṇāṃ devakoṭīnāṃ tadā mama sahāyanam || 11 || nārīṇāṃ kanyakānāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca vivardhanam | śīlavrataparāṇāṃ ca tāpasānāṃ tadodayaḥ || 12|| karmaṭhānāṃ satāṃ loke prāyaśaśca sumelanam | sannyāsānāṃ divyadṛṣṭirbālānāṃ bahuvedinām || 1 3|| divyācāryagurūṇāṃ ca prabhāvo janmayoginām | nairmalyaṃ bhūvikārāṇāṃ matprabhāvakṛtaṃ tadā || 14|| sphuraṇaṃ pūrvadharmāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ mokṣadāyinām | satkarmaṇāṃ darśanaṃ ca pravṛttirmakhadharmiṇām || 15 || devānāṃ ca tadā pṛthvyāmāgamanaṃ mamāntike | dharmasṛṣṭeḥ pracāraśca jane jane tadāsti vai || 16 || pṛthivī matpādayogā pavitrā pāvanī śubhā | jalāni mama yogena divyāni sādhakānyapi || 17|| matprasaṃgena tīrthāni bhavanti śaktimantyapi | caityānāṃ cetanatvaṃ ca tadā samupajāyate || 18|| mānasānāṃ balavattvaṃ saphalā kalpanā tadā | sukhaduḥkhasahiṣṇutvaṃ śarīriṇāṃ ca puṣṭatā || 1 9|| dīrghāyuṣṭvaṃ ca bālānāṃ satītvaṃ kanyakādiṣu | saṃhāraścāpi duṣṭānāṃ mlecchānāṃ yoṣitāmapi ||4.108.20|| kalkasampannadehānāmastitvaṃ tatra nāsti vai | tathā carāmi khaḍgena bahuvegena khe bhuvi ||2 1 || varṣamātreṇa lokānāṃ karomi yugaparyayam | madbhaktāḥ kṛtayogyā ye te tiṣṭhanti na cetare ||22|| dhenavaścoṣadhayaśca vanānyudyānavāṭikāḥ | sarasā dugdhapūrṇāśca dīrghajīvā bhavanti te ||23|| madbhayāccauralokānāṃ vilayaśca kṣitestalāt | vināśo mama sainyaiśca divyasvarūpadhāribhiḥ ||24|| tvatsaṃkalpāttadā śvetā aśvāśca divyavigrahāḥ | lakṣaśastava putrāste sainyavāhā bhavanti hi |||25|| matsaṃkalpājjāyamānā devāḥ sainyātmakāstadā | nāśayanti paritaste mlecchaduṣṭādhirākṣasān ||26||| adharmidānavadaityān vidharmimānavān muhuḥ | nirmalaṃ bhūtalaṃ sarvaṃ sarvapāpāspṛśaṃ śubham || 27|| jāyate tu tadā badri kalerante mamāśrayāt | dharmāṃstadāhaṃ bahudhā satyarūpān vadāmi ha ||28|| prajāḥ sarvā mama bhaktā ahiṃsāsatyavṛttikāḥ | śīlavrataparāścāpi manobalasamanvitāḥ |||29||| udayanti kṛtakṛtyāḥ śāntidharmaparāyaṇāḥ | viralāḥ svalpasāhasrā yojane tvekamānavāḥ ||4.108.30|| anye vināśamāyānti mama kālāsinā tu te | mama pṛthvyāṃ bhramaṇena devānāṃ maṇḍalānyapi ||3 1 || vicaranti kṣitau tatra maharṣayo’pyagocarāḥ | tīrthāni dharmadevaśca dharmaputrāśca śaktayaḥ |||32|| matpratāpena cākṛṣṭā mahānandā bhramanti te | pūrvatyaktapradeśeṣvālayeṣu caityabhūmiṣu |||3 3|| ācaranti nivāsaṃ svaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ kṛtāya te | mama saṃkalpayogena kālaparyayatastathā ||34|| bhāvipuṇyabalenāpi prajānāṃ satyaparyayaḥ | sthale sthale vartamānaḥ prakāśate kṛtātmakaḥ |||35||| śāntirloke pravṛddhā ca vartate dehināṃ tadā | yadā candraśca sūryaśca tathā puṣyabṛhaspatī ||36|| ekarāśau sammilanti tadā kṛtayugaṃ matam | evaṃ yoge tu sañjāte sarvaṃ kṛtārhaṇaṃ tadā ||37|| brahmasatrāṇi jāyante viṣṇuyāgāḥ sthale sthale | prāyaścittāni jāyante tīrthayātrāśca dehinām ||38|| utsavā me prajāyante rāṣṭre rāṣṭre gṛhe gṛhe | badrike sattvanairmalyaṃ sattvaprakarṣatā tathā ||39|| sādhuvat sarvavarṇānāṃ nairmalyaṃ kāśate tadā | meghānāṃ varṣaṇaṃ śaśvat rasānāmudayo bahuḥ ||4.108.40|| dugdhānāṃ ca madhūnāṃ ca pravāhā bahavastadā | sampadāṃ cābhivivṛddhiḥ punaḥ punaḥ svato’dhikā ||41|| pravartate kṛte tatra dehināṃ divyadarśitā | surāṇāṃ ca kṣitau sākṣādāgamanaṃ prajāyate ||42|| mānavānāṃ divaṃ pratyapyasti gatistadā kṛte | satītvaṃ yoṣitāṃ cāpi tāpasānāṃ tapasvitā ||43|| śāntatvamindriyāṇāṃ ca dāvāgnīnāṃ śamastadā | uttāpānāṃ praśāntiścodvegānāṃ śamanaṃ tadā ||44|| brahmabhaktipradhānā vai śiṣṭāḥ prajājanāstadā | vedāḥ svayaṃ hṛdayeṣu sphuranti dehināṃ tadā |||45|| varṇāśramavyavasthā ca śaucācārapratisthitiḥ | āstikyaṃ satyavṛttiśca prajāyante kṛte punaḥ ||46|| brāhmamuhūrte stavanaṃ dhyānaṃ snānaṃ prapūjanam | devārādhanamevāpi pitṛtarpaṇapūjanam ||47|| vṛddhābhivādanaṃ cātmacintanaṃ daivayogitā | pañcayajñavidhānaṃ ca satye svabhāvataḥ punaḥ ||48|| pravartante prajāsveva naisargikavicārataḥ | dharmasajīvanaṃ pādacatuṣṭayena vai kṛte || 49|| pratiṣṭhākarma devānāṃ camatkārāśca mānasāḥ | darśanaṃ cāpi devānāṃ svapne prāg jāyate kṛte ||4.108.50|| tataḥ śanaiḥ śanairviprasādhurūpeṇa darśanam | tataścāgamanaṃ sākṣāt kṛte pṛthvyāṃ tu nākinām ||51|| udbhavāśca maharṣīṇāṃ satāṃ kṛte sasiddhikāḥ | camatkārayutā bālāḥ prajāyante ca bālikāḥ |||52|| vāksiddhayaḥ pravartante karmāṇi saphalānyapi | sasyānāṃ smṛddhayaścāpi pradyotante kaṇānvitāḥ ||53|| devānāṃ bhaktiriṣṭā ca prajājane pravartate | rāgadveṣādidoṣāṇāṃ hrāso bhavet kṛtāgame ||54|| vahnayaḥ samprakāśante nirmalāḥ sukhadāḥ śivāḥ | arogā vāyavaścāpi sukhasparśāḥ praśāntidāḥ ||55|| bhūtāni pakṣiṇaścāpi yādāṃsi paśavastathā | sattvaviśeṣakāḥ satye prajāyante yugānugāḥ ||56|| mānavānāṃ śarīrāṇi satyabalānmahānti ca | paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo vṛkṣā uccadehā bhavanti ca ||57|| balaṃ śataguṇaṃ paścāt sahasraguṇitaṃ kṛte | vīryaṃ jñānaṃ vīratā ca sahasraguṇitā kṛte ||58|| anneṣu śaktayaścāpi sahasraguṇitāḥ kṛte | asthijīvā asavaśca kṛte punarbhavanti ca ||59|| vimānāni mandirāṇi nagarāṇi navāni ca | prajāyante kārubuddhibhavāni satyavartane ||4.108.60|| prajānāṃ dṛṣṭayo divyāḥ satīnāṃ satyadivyatā | sādhūnāṃ divyavācaśca prajāyante kṛte punaḥ ||61|| samudragarbhe gatayaścākāśe gatayastadā | bhūvivarte gatayaśca jāyante dehināṃ kṛte |||62|| mlecchānāṃ vilaye badri rājñāṃ rakṣaṇakāriṇām | sthāpanaṃ vai mayā tatra kriyate dvijajātiṣu ||63||| evaṃ dharmasya satye vai catuṣpāttvaṃ pravartate | satyaṃ tapo makho dānaṃ pravartante sthale sthale ||64|| satyānte ca punastretādharmā bhavanti śobhanāḥ | tato dvāparadharmāśca tatastiṣyasya vai punaḥ ||65|| evaṃ yugānāṃ satataṃ cāvartate tu cakrakam | sahasrayugaparyantaṃ tataḥ kalpāvasānakam ||66|| jāyate badrike sāyaṃ kalerante śataṃ samāḥ | anāvṛṣṭirhi mahato sarvasattvavināśinī ||67|| tataḥ sūryāstāpayanti pṛthvīṃ te bharjayanti vai | rūkṣāṃgārasamā pṛthvī jāyate sūryatāpataḥ ||68|| vahnimayaṃ samastaṃ vai bhūtalaṃ jāyate tataḥ | vahnibāṣpodbhavā meghāḥ pravarṣanti śataṃ samāḥ ||69|| svargāntaṃ jalapūrṇaṃ vai brahmāṇḍārdhaṃ prajāyate | daśalokā nimajjanti bhasmarūpā jalāntare ||4.108.70|| kardamāste bhavantyeva kalpānte nimnagā yadā | pātāle kardamāḥ sarve viśramanti jalaplutāḥ ||71 || matsyasvarūpo bhagavānahaṃ bījāni sarvathā | rakṣāmi ca punaḥ sṛṣṭihetave jalamadhyagaḥ ||72|| kalkistu bhagavān sāyaṃ sāśvaḥ sāsiḥ sasainyakaḥ | sūkṣmarūpaḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā tiro mahaḥ prayāmi vai ||73|| rātrau matsyasvarūpo’haṃ rātryante tu bhuvaḥ kṛte | kṛtayatno bhavāmyeva vārāharūpabān bhavān ||74|| matsyo’haṃ tu vicarāmi salile prātareva ha | vārāho’haṃ tale gatvā kārdamaṃ golakaṃ mahat ||75|| kṛtvā nayāmi taṃ golaṃ jalapṛṣṭhe prabhāvavān | tato’haṃ vāḍavo vahnirbhavāmi vaḍavāmukhaḥ ||76|| śoṣayāmi jalādhikyaṃ cāṣṭalokasukhārthakam | yathāpekṣaṃ ca rakṣāmi śuṣkayāmi kṣitiṃ tataḥ ||77|| śvāsairmuhurmuhuḥ saptapātālān racayāmi ca | tatra sarvatra bījāni kṣiptvā prajāḥ sṛjāmi ca ||78|| matsyo’haṃ tu tatastiro bhavāmi jalasañcaraḥ | pṛthvīṃ sthirāṃ cāṣṭapaṭāṃ kṛtvā tirobhavāmi hi ||79|| hayagrīvastato bhūtvā prajābhyo vedasaṃbhavam | jñānaṃ dadāmi sarvābhyastūrṇaṃ kṛtādyasañcare ||4.108.80 || tato’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīvallabhaḥ prabhuḥ | pṛthvyāmādau kṛte svecchārūpadhṛk saṃbhavāmi vā ||8 1|| divi vānyastaṭe tatra karomi varṇarakṣaṇam | upāsanāṃ pravartyaiva sthitvā sapādalakṣakam ||82|| varṣāṇāṃ bhūtale sarvadharmasthitiṃ karomyapi | mokṣamārgaṃ haristatra pravartayāmi sarvataḥ ||83|| kṣīrodaṃ ca tato lakṣmīnārāyaṇo bhavan prabhuḥ | āvirbhavāmi lakṣmīśastatra svapimi vai punaḥ ||84|| badrike ca tataḥ kālāntare sampatkṣayottaram | samudramathanaṃ sarvaratnārthaṃ kārayāmyaham || 85|| kacchapaṃ tu tadā rūpaṃ dhārayāmi gireḥ sthiteḥ | mohinīstrī daityamohakarī bhavāmi sundarī ||86|| amṛtaṃ devatāḥ sarvāḥ pāyayāmi tadāpyaham | tirobhūtvā punaḥ siṃharūpaṃ dharāmi hetave ||87|| hayaśorṣā bhavāmyeva kvacid daityakṣayāya vai | jñānadānāya haṃsātmā bhavāmi kapilo’pi ca ||88|| yajñabhikṣurvāmanaśca bhavāmyāsuralopakṛt | hariścāhaṃ bhaktakṛte bhavāmi duḥkhahārakaḥ ||89|| naro nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo harirbhavāmi dharmataḥ | pṛdhvīpatirdohanāya bhavāmi cakravartanaḥ ||4.108.90|| tāpasaḥ sādhudharmā ca dattadāno bhavāmyapi | bodhadaśca tathā yogī bhavāmi vanagocaraḥ ||9 1 || parśudhṛk kṣatradaṇḍātmā bhavāmyapi kvacittataḥ | cakradhṛgdharmadhārī ca bhavāmi gopa ityapi |||92||| yajñaścāhaṃ tathā svāmī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’pi ca | bhavāmi kṛṣikartāpi rājarājo bhavāmi ca ||93|| vipraśca kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ kiṃkaro’pi bhavāmi ca | yathākālaṃ tathācāryo bhavāmi vyāsa ityapi ||94|| gururvā pramadā vātha gorūpaḥ susatī hyapi | patnīvratākhyavipro’haṃ bhavāmyapyatra bhūtale ||95|| jiṣṇurbhavāmi vai svarge pātāle hāṭakeśvaraḥ | śeṣeśvaraḥ sāgare ca merau viṣṇuścaturbhujaḥ ||96|| devo vā mānavo vāpi gāndharvaḥ saṃbhavāmi ca | cāraṇo vā ca vidyādhro dakṣo vāpi bhavāmi ca ||97|| vanī vā nyāsayogī vā yatirvā brahmaśīlakaḥ | bhavāmi bhūtale badri bahurūpadharaḥ prabhuḥ ||98|| yathāpekṣo yathākālo yathārūpo bhavāmi ca | rakṣārthaṃ mama sṛṣṭīnāṃ mokṣārthaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ ||99|| ārādhanāvaśībhūtaḥ kvacidbhavāmi tādṛśaḥ | kvacitputro’rthitaścāpi bhavāmi sukhadātmakaḥ || 4.108.100 || brahmā viṣṇurmaheśaśca rūpatraya sadā mama | ābhūtasamplavaṃ cāste pravāhahetave sadā || 101 || evaṃ te kathitaṃ badri prāvirbhāvaprayojanam | prayojanaṃ prasādhyaivānandayitvā nijāśritān || 1 02|| tirobhavāmi sahasā vāraṃ vāraṃ hi līlayā | nānto’smi me vibhūteśca na saṃkhyā janmanāṃ mama || 1 03|| na karmaṇāṃ na rūpāṇāṃ caritrāṇāṃ na cāvadhiḥ | śreyasāṃ janakaścāhaṃ prajāśreyaḥ karomi tu || 1 04|| duṣṭānāṃ daṇḍanaṃ bhaktajanānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ tathā | dharmasya sthāpanaṃ bhakteḥ pravartanaṃ kriyā mama || 1 05|| stuto devairviśiṣṭo’haṃ bhavāmyatarkito muhuḥ | bhaktastuto bhavāmyeva bhaktamātrasya gocaraḥ || 1 06|| surāṣṭre dharmarāṣṭre vai nivasāmi viśeṣataḥ | līlayā devakāryāṇi kṛtvā tirobhavāmi ca || 1 07|| matprasaṃgagatā lokā narā nāryaśca vai tadā | prajāyante divyarūpā mokṣagāśca tataḥ param || 1 08|| ityevaṃ me rahasya te kathitaṃ badrike param | yena kenāpi rūpeṇa tvaṃ cāste hi mayānvitā || 1 09|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne tiṣyānte bhagavadapekṣā kalparātrau kalpaprātardivāpi ca bhagavatprāvirbhāvādikathananāmāṣṭādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 108 ||
<4.109> śrībadrīpriyovāca yadā yadā bhavān pṛthvyāṃ svarge satye talādiṣu | vartate ca tadā tatra bhavāmyahaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 1 || kvacinmūrtau kvaciccihne kvacit pārśve kvaciddhṛdi | kvacittvājñākarī yatra kvāpi varte pṛthak sthitā || 2 || tatra sarvatra bhagavan tavāśrayeṇa macchritāḥ | muktiṃ prayānti paramāṃ niṣkāmāḥ sādhusaṃśrayāḥ || 3 || sakāmāstu mama bhaktāḥ svargaṃ rājyaṃ prayānti vā | tadrājyaṃ bhujyate bhaktanṛpaiḥ svarge tu satsuraiḥ || 4 || pārthivaṃ yanmahadrājyaṃ purā kṛtayuge tadā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena paramātmanā || 5 || kasmai dattaṃ bhūmibhṛte kaśca rājā tataḥ param | haimakhaṇḍamahārājyaṃ kasmai sa pradadau purā || 6 || tataḥ paraṃ ca kiṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛtavān vaṃśavistṛtaḥ | kiyān kālo hi kṛṣṇasya pṛthvyāṃ yātastataḥ param || 7 || ityetat sarvamevātra kṛpayā vaktumarhati | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇalīlā manoharāḥ || 8 || śrotumicchāmi tatpaścājjātā yā yāḥ smṛtā api | mokṣadātryo bhavantyeva paramānandaśāntidāḥ || 9 || yannāthasya smṛteścāpi tāpā yānti layaṃ drutam | tatkathāḥ śrāvayodārā naranārāyaṇaprabho || 4.109.1 0|| śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhuḥ | brahmāṇḍānāṃ sādhakaṃ ca sṛṣṭvā vairājapūruṣam || 11 || taddvārā ca samutpādya viśvasṛjo vidhīn bahūn | caturvaktre padmajāya datvotpattividhānakam || 12|| mahārājyaṃ mahāṇḍasya caturdaśastarātmanaḥ | taddvārā janayāmāsa svāyambhuvaṃ manuṃ nṛpam ||13| āgnīdhrādyāśca tanayāḥ svāyaṃbhuvamanoḥ sutāḥ | mānasāste mahāvīryā dvīparājyāni cakrire || 14|| āgnīdhraścājanābhāya dadau khaṇḍaṃ himālayam | ājanābhaṃ mahāvarṣaṃ daśasāhasrayojanam || 15|| ajanābhe bhūpatau tu vairāgyavegamāsthite | vanaṃ yāte tu tapase pṛthivīgarvamāsthitā || 16|| sasyānāṃ sampado ratnabhedān rasānacorayat | tadā tu pṛthave pṛthvīrājaṃ dadau hariḥ svayam || 17|| pṛthurdudoha pṛthivīṃ dadau dugdhāni sarvaśaḥ | prajābhyaḥ prayayau paścāttapase’tha tataḥ param || 18|| khaṇḍarājyāni bhaktebhyo nṛpebhyaḥ pradadau prabhuḥ | divyarājyāni devebhyaḥ pradadau puruṣottamaḥ || 1 9|| candrāya tu dadau rājyamoṣadhīnāṃ ca śākhinām | yajñavratānāṃ tapasāṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ dvijanmanām |||4.109.20|| varuṇāya dadau rājyamapāṃ ca yādasāṃ tathā | kuberāya dadau rājyaṃ dhanakośādisampadām ||21 || ravīṇāṃ ca dadau rājyaṃ viṣṇave dvādaśātmane | vasūnāṃ ca dadau rājyamagnaye dhātuyogine ||22|| prajāpatīnāṃ rājyaṃ ca dakṣāya pradadau prabhuḥ | śakrāya marutāṃ rājyaṃ dadau vai dyunivāsinam || 23|| daityadānavakoṭīnāṃ prahlādāya dadau tu tat | pitṝṇāṃ pradadau rājyaṃ yamāya yāmyavāsinām ||24|| piśācarakṣasāṃ bhūtavetālānāṃ śivāya ca | girīṇāṃ pradadau rājyaṃ himālayāya vai tadā ||25||| nadīnāṃ ca nadādīnāṃ rājyaṃ tadābdhaye dadau | gandharvāṇāṃ kinnarāṇāṃ vidyādhrāṇāṃ tadā dadau ||26|| rājyaṃ citrarathāyāpi kiṃpuṃsāmapi śobhanam | nāgarājyaṃ vāsukaye dadau tāmasayāmakam ||27|| sarpāṇāṃ ca mahārājyaṃ takṣakāya dadau tadā | kariṇāṃ diggajendrāṇāṃ rājyamairāvatāya vai ||28|| patattriṇāṃ suparṇāyoccaiḥśravase tu vājinām | mṛgādhipatyaṃ siṃhāya vṛṣabhāya gavāṃ tathā ||29|| vanaspatīnāṃ tu kalpadrumāya ca dadau tadā | sudharmaṇe pūrvadiśāṃ śaṃkhapadāya dakṣiṇām || 4.109.3 0|| ketumate pratīcīṃ cottarāṃ hiraṇyaromiṇe | evaṃ rājyāni bhagavān brahmadvārā hyadāpayat ||31 || ājanābhe’tra khaṇḍe tu himālayākhyaparvate | pṛthau gate tu tapase viśvagastasya cātmajaḥ ||32||| rājyaṃ cakre’tha yamunāṃ nandibhillo hyarodhayat | dilāvarīṃ ca nagarīṃ strīnāmnāsthāpayannavām ||33|| yamunāyāstaṭe ramye mahādurgasamanvitām | dilāvarīmahārājyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhuḥ ||34|| nāgavikramabhūpāya dadau hatvā tu bhillakam | nandibhikle hate nāgavikramaḥ praśaśāsa tat ||25||| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇopāstibalānvitaḥ | tapastaptvopāsanayā prāpa prāleyakaṃ dhanuḥ ||36|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇācchrīparamātmanaḥ | dhanuṣā tena divyena vimānena vihāyasā ||37|| pṛthvīṃ jetuṃ pracacāra nārāyaṇa ivāparaḥ | bhūpālāstena parito dhanuṣā karadīkṛtāḥ ||38|| vaiṣṇavaṃ bhūtalaṃ sarvaṃ cakre sa nāgavikramaḥ | dakṣapaścasamudrāntaṃ daśasāhasrayojanam ||39|| ājanābhaṃ mahārājyaṃ prāpa vai nāgavikramaḥ | dilāvarī rājadhānī rakṣitā tena sarvadā ||4.109.40 || nāgapurīti saivāpi kṛtā tena svabodhinī | nāgavikramabhūpasya bhāryāsīddhastimālinī ||41 || pativratā mahābhāgā vaiṣṇavī sāttvatī satī | tasyā nāmnā kṛtā pārśve nagarī hāstinīpurī ||42|| prāptavairāgyavegāḍhyo rājā tu nāgavikramaḥ | yuktaḥ sa hastimālinā tīrthārthaṃ niryayau gṛhāt ||43|| yamunāṃ sarayūṃ gaṃgāṃ gogarāṃ gaṇḍakīṃ tataḥ | snātvā kāṃcanagaṃgāṃ ca brahmapurīṃ tataḥ param ||44|| kāpilaṃ sāgaraṃ snātvā puruṣottamamandiram | yayau mahānadīṃ godāvarīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ ca dakṣiṇām ||45|| snātvodadhiṃ śrīmahādriṃ snātvā tāpīṃ ca narmadām | mahīṃ śatruṃjayāṃ snātvā somanāthaṃ yayau tataḥ ||46|| mūladvāravatīṃ kṛtvā kuśasthalīṃ ca gomatīm | bhadrāṃ snātvā yayāvaśvapaṭṭasarovaraṃ mahat ||47|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśritam | lomaśaṃ prathamaṃ natvā pūjayitvā tatastu saḥ ||48|| aśvapaṭṭajale snātvānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | iṣṭaṃ pūjayituṃ sveṣṭadevaṃ prati yayau nṛpaḥ ||49|| gajāsane sthitaṃ svarṇe smṛddhe divyākṣikārake | hariṃ vilokya nṛpatiḥ prapūjya vidhinā tataḥ ||4.109.50|| pādāmṛtaṃ papau patnīsahito bhṛtyasaṃyugaḥ | rājñī papau hareḥ pādāmṛtaṃ bhāvasamanvitā ||51|| upadā vividhāḥ kṛṣṇasvāmyagre nyasya vai tataḥ | ārārtrikaṃ hareḥ rājñī nṛpayuktā cakāra sā |||52|| hariṃ tuṣṭāva bahudhā niṣasādārpitāsane | svāgataṃ ca prasatkāraṃ cakre nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||53|| bhojayāmāsa vidhinā nṛpaṃ rājñīṃ ca mādhava | śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇādyā rājasvāgatamācaran ||||54||| atha rājā sabhāryaśca kṛtāvasatha eva ca | viśrāmaṃ cāptavānnidrāṃ gataḥ samādhimāpa ha ||55|| tatrāpayajjagatsarvaṃ brahmeśaviṣṇupālitam | svargaṃ satyaṃ vyapaśyat sa meruṃ tattannivāsinaḥ ||56|| āvṛtisthānīśvarām̐śca vyapaśyat sa narādhipaḥ | kṣīrasāgarasaṃsthaṃ ca śvetadvīpagataṃ prabhum | |57||| badarīsthaṃ naranārāyaṇaṃ sūrye hiraṇmayam | vahnau vaiśvānaraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ rājā vyalokayat ||58|| sādhyalokān pitṛlokān yajñanārāyaṇaṃ tathā | dhruvalokaṃ yāmyalokaṃ mahendrabhavaṃ tathā ||59|| brahmasabhāṃ viṣṇulokaṃ śivalokaṃ vyalokayat | vairājalokaṃ lalitāśrīdhāmāvyākṛtaṃ tathā ||4.109.60|| amṛtākhyaṃ bhūmalokaṃ vāsudevālayaṃ tathā | sadāśivasya kailāsaṃ sāketaṃ sa vyalokayat ||6 1 || māyālokaṃ mahāviṣṇulokaṃ golokamityapi | vaikuṇṭhaṃ sīmadhāmāni dhāmākṣaraṃ vyalokayat ||62|| paraṃdhāma parabrahmānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | sarvāvatāradhartāraṃ hyapaśyat tvakṣareśvaram ||63|| sundaraṃ ṣoḍaśavarṣaṃ muktākhyaṃ puruṣottamam | muktānikārcitaṃ tejovyāptaṃ bhūṣāvibhūṣitam ||64|| divyamālādharaṃ divyakoṭimanmathaśobhanam | ramaṇīyaṃ yuvānaṃ cāprāṇakhāt susuvarṇakam ||65|| rādhāramāpriyālakṣmīpadmāvatīprasevitam | māṇikīsvāminaṃ badrīśvaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vyalokayat ||66|| sarvalāvaṇyasaundaryāmṛtapīyūṣasaṃbhṛtam | premasnehapramodānāmāśrayaṃ varamūrtikam ||67|| koṭikoṭyarkatejāṃsi yasthaikaromareṇuke | vartante śāśvatatuṣṭitṛptidāni sukhāni ca ||68|| sakaustubhaṃ samukuṭaṃ divyābharaṇabhūṣitam | vyalokayaddhariṃ rājā pitṛbhyāṃ sahitaṃ tadā ||69|| rājñī cāpi kṛpayā vai sarvaṃ vyalokayat satī | vibhūtīśca tathā divyāḥ saubhāgyāni vyalokayat ||4.109.70|| divyabhogān divyayogān sarvāśca divyasampadaḥ | divyāmṛtāni sarvāṇi divyāḥ siddhīrvyalokayat ||71|| divyālayān mandirāṇi divyaratnālayām̐stathā | divyatejomayānnaijān vigrahānavalokayat ||72|| anantasukhamāsādya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya tau | vihāya tattvimaṃ lokaṃ pratyāgantuṃ na cecchataḥ ||73|| ajarāmṛtabhāvaṃ vai prāpya badri tu ko janaḥ | icchenmāyāmaye gantuṃ punaryo bahirūrdhvagaḥ ||74|| tathāpi tau harestatrājñayā punaḥ svavarṣmaṇoḥ | āyayatuḥ prasahyaiva kuṃkumavāpikājuṣoḥ ||75|| utthitau sahasā kṛṣṇasannidhau divyavaibhavau | indriyāntaḥkaraṇāni divyānnabhavannetayoḥ ||76|| na rūpaṃ rocate māyāmayaṃ vilokituṃ tadā | na sparśo rocate māyāmayaḥ spraṣṭuṃ tayostadā ||77|| na rasāścāpi rocante bhoktuṃ sudivyavarṣmaṇoḥ | na gandho rocate māyāmayo durgandhavat tayoḥ ||78|| na śabdo rocate māyāmayo vaktuṃ tayostataḥ | tayormāyāmayaṃ sarvaṃ sahasā nirayāyate ||79|| tyaktāhāravihārau śrīkṛṣṇalagnamānasau | vartate badrike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sannidhau ||4.109.80|| bālakṛṣṇasya vai mūrteḥ sukhānandāśanau ca tau | vindete na kṣudhāṃ naiva tṛṣāṃ tu māyikīṃ tadā ||8 1|| evaṃvidhau mahādivyānandabhogaparāyaṇau | muktau jīvanpramuktau tau videhāviva saṃvṛtau ||82|| kṛṣṇamūrtermahāmūlyaṃ prāptaṃ brahmarasasya yat | na rājyabhogamūlyaṃ vai tadagre sthātumarhati ||83|| asāraḥ khalu saṃsārastayoragre’bhavattadā | na saṃsāre manaḥ sthātumabhavacca tayoḥ sadā ||84|| prabhoḥkṛṣṇaharerdhyānāt samāgamāt prasevanāt | naṣṭāni ca tayoḥ sarvāvaraṇāni samantataḥ |||85|| jale sthale’mbare gehe bhittau vahnau nirodhane | apratyāhatagatikau pārapraveśakāriṇau ||86|| ajāyatāṃ nṛpo rājñī sūkṣmamahatprasiddhikau | evaṃvidhau tu tau divyau kṛṣṇadhyānaparāyaṇau ||87|| kṛṣṇaceṣṭāparau kṛṣṇakarmakāṇḍaparāyaṇau | kṛṣṇārthakṛtasarvasvau vyāvṛttendriyamānasau ||88|| dāsadāsījane naije cādattamānasau sadā | avartatāṃ nṛpo rājñī kṛṣṇapūjāparāyaṇau ||89|| evaṃvidhau tu tau vīkṣya dāsā dāsyo’nugāstathā | śuśucurbahudhā badri tayoḥ kṛte’tisaṃbhramāḥ ||4.109.90|| tarkayāmāsuretau te vicittau kiṃ pramattakau | vāyurugṇau ca vā jātau mantrābhicāradharṣitau ||9 1|| yadvā tūdāsīnavṛttau kiṃ vā piśācaveśinau | bhūtāveśaparau kiṃvā cittabhramātidharṣitau ||92|| asthiramānasau kiṃvā yogyāveśamayau ca vā | grahāveśaprapīḍau vā kimetau saṃbabhūvatuḥ ||93|| ityevaṃ bahudhā bhṛtyajanāstarkān pracakrire | naitayoste tu yāthārthyaṃ sthiteḥ pāraṃ prapredire ||94|| prārthanāṃ cakrire bhṛtyajanāḥ kṛṣṇāya te tadā | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo jagadguro ||95|| rājñyā nṛpasya vaicittyaṃ kiṃvā jānīma eva na | cintāturā janā bhṛtyā rājyaṃ rāṣṭraṃ tathāvidham ||96|| sarvamudvegamāpannaṃ rājñaḥ sthiteratarkanāt | tvamuddhārakaraḥ kṛṣṇo yathāyogyaṃ vidhehi vai ||97|| svāsthyaṃ rājño bhavet samyag rājyaṃ prati prayāti ca | yathā tathā kṛpāṃ kṛtvā vidhehi kuśalaṃ hi naḥ ||98|| rājñī cāpi tathā cāste visaṃjñeva yathā nṛpaḥ | jānāsi tvaṃ paramātman kalyāṇaṃ kuru sarvathā ||99|| bhaktasya bhagavan kṛṣṇa rakṣaṇaṃ kuśalaṃ kuru | ityevamarthayāmāsurbhṛtyādyā nṛpamānavāḥ ||4.109.100|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne brahmaṇaḥ sṛṣṭyuttaraṃ rājñāṃ nirmāṇaṃ, dilāvarīrājadhānīnṛpasya nāgavikramasya tīrthayātrāvicaraṇe kuṃkumavāpyāṃ gamanaṃ, tatra samādhiphalaṃ divyatāpādanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 109 ||
<4.110> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi nāgavikramabhūbhṛtaḥ | bhṛtyādīnāṃ prārthanordhvaṃ yadabhūt tad vadāmyaham || 1 || anādiḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāryaḥ kṛṣṇamādhavaḥ | pratyuvāca tu tadbhṛtyān yathārthaṃ vai śubhaṃ vacaḥ || 2 || nāyaṃ rājā pramatto’sti nonmatto na vicittakaḥ | nāpi bhūtapiśācābhibhavavān nābhicāravān || 3 || madbhakto matpratāpena samādhau māṃ nijākṣare | dhāmni rājādhirājaṃ sa vyalokayat priyāyutaḥ || 4 || divyaṃ māṃ divyadhāmāpi sarvāśca divyasampadaḥ | vīkṣya divyavibhūtīśca divyatāṃ prāptavān hi saḥ || 5 || divyadṛṣṭirdivyakarmā divyadharmāsti sāmpratam | divyabhāvamayaścāste divyāntaḥkaraṇendriyaḥ || 6 || na tasya rocate māyāmayaṃ cedaṃ sakalmaṣam | audāsīnyaṃ gataścāste paśyatyetattu naśvaram || 7 || nirayākhyaṃ samastaṃ vai brahmāṇḍaṃ sa prapaśyati | rājyaṃ naijaṃ ca bhūmyādi sarvaṃ paśyati kardamam || 8 || aśuddhaṃ cāpi vikṛtaṃ kledāḍhyaṃ saṃprapaśyati | videha iva cāste’sau jīvanmukto jitendriyaḥ || 9 || pratyāhṛtāntaḥkaraṇaḥ sastrīko muktavat sthitaḥ | tato’sau yogivadbhūmau vartate hṛtavāsanaḥ || 4.110.1 0|| vrahmadaśāṃ samārūḍho vartate māyikātparaḥ | amāyiko’yaṃ sañjāto matsamādhermadātmakaḥ || 1 1|| sanakādisamaścāste śivatulyo virāgavān | mā śocantu mahābhāgyaṃ divyaṃ nṛpaṃ tato’nugāḥ || 1 2|| asya divyatayā santi nāvaraṇāni kānicit | bhūmau jale’nale pāraṃ gantuṃ śakto’ṇusiddhimān || 1 3|| svarge satye ca vairāje vaikuṇṭhe gantumīśvaraḥ | nāsya rājyaṃ na vai bhṛtyā bādhitumīśvarāstviha || 14|| tato’yaṃ vartate yogisthityā yogīśvaro yatiḥ | satī taddharmabhāryāpi tathaiva vartate parā || 15|| bhavatāṃ pratyayārthaṃ taṃ prerayāmi samakṣagam | sāntvayituṃ bhavataśca kṛtayatno yathā bhavet || 16|| ityuktvā badrike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamahāprabhuḥ | rājānaṃ prerayāmāsa bhṛtyādiśokanuttaye || 17|| śṛṇu rājam̐stava bhṛtyādayaḥ śocanti te kṛte | tān vijñāpaya vṛttāntaṃ naijaṃ yathārthamujjvalam || 18|| ityevaṃ badrike prokto rājā tu nāgavikramaḥ | sbabhṛtyādīn samuvāca virāgiṇīṃ nijāṃ sthitim || 1 9|| śṛṇvantu bhṛtyavargādyāḥ kurvantu ca mayoditam | hitaṃ vadāmi sarveṣāṃ prāptaṃ divyaṃ mayā dhanam ||4.110.20|| ayaṃ vai bhagavān sākṣācchrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ | akṣareśo’vatārāṇāṃ dhartā prāpto mayā tviha ||21 || madyogena bhavadbhiśca prāptaḥ śrīpativallabhaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||22|| tatpratāpena sāmrājyaṃ prāptaṃ mayā viśālakam | tatpratāpena divyā ca dṛṣṭiṃ sthitiṃ gato’smi ca ||23|| akṣaraṃ paramaṃ dhāma tatpratāpena vai mayā | vīkṣitaṃ ca samādhau vai divyarddhayo vilokitāḥ ||24|| yadagre ceśvarāṇāṃ vai smṛddhayo nirayopamāḥ | tataḥ kimuta devānāṃ sutarāṃ mānavarddhayaḥ ||25|| māyāmayyaḥ smṛddhayastā nirayā eva santi vai | na rocante mama tvetāḥ smṛddhayo malinā yataḥ || 26|| harerdivyasya yogena prāpto’haṃ divyatāṃ parām | bhavanto’pi hareryogād gṛhṇantu divyatāṃ parām ||27|| śāśvataṃ paramānandaṃ gṛhṇantvanādimādhavāt | tyajantu vāsanāsainyaṃ nirayaṃ bhautikaṃ gṛham ||28|| hareḥ rājyaṃ samastaṃ vai brahmāṇḍānāṃ paraṃ tathā | samastaṃ śrīhareḥ rājyaṃ na me rājyaṃ manāgapi || 29|| muktirājyaṃ samicchāmi bhuktirājyaṃ na rocate | tato bhavanto bhṛtyādyāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ śrayantu satpatim ||4.110.3 0|| tyaktabhogasukhā nityānandā bhavantu keśave | adhruvaṃ mā ca valgantu valgantu parameśvaram ||3 1|| mṛtasya rājadehasya na rājyaṃ na dhanaṃ gṛham | ātmanastu pramuktasya mahārājyaṃ parākṣaram ||32|| vicāryetthaṃ cārpayāmi samastaṃ paramātmane | dilāvarīmahārājyaṃ cārpayāmi parātmane ||33|| vairāgyaṃ prāptavānasmi sapatnīko na saṃśayaḥ | bhūtvā dāso hareḥ sādhuḥ seviṣye’tra guruṃ harim ||34|| rājyaṃ dadāmi haraye yena dattaṃ purā tu me | sa eva sarvamavatu nāhaṃ rājyaṃ prarocaye || 35|| ityuktvā bhṛtyavargebhyo rājā vai nāgavikramaḥ | haste jalaṃ samādāya rājyaṃ kṛṣṇāya cārpayat || 36 || sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ kṛṣṇapādayornipapāta saḥ | vihāya rājacihnāni kṛṣṇapādarajo’gilat || 37|| rājñī cāpi tathā cakre kṛṣṇapādarajāṃsi vai | jihvayā lehayāmāsa kṛṣṇapādatalaṃ tathā || 38|| āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpuḥ bhṛtyādyāste nṛpānugāḥ | matvaiva dhanyabhāgyāni vavandire hariṃ tadā || 3 9|| praśaśaṃsurnṛpaṃ cāpi mokṣamārgaprayāyinam | sarve bhṛtyādayaścāpi tyāgamārgaṃ prapedire ||4.110.40 || nipatya śrīhareragre nṛpavaccakrire ca te | nijārpaṇaṃ hareragre tyāgārthaṃ prākṛtasya vai ||41 || atha śrībhagavān rājñe dadau dīkṣāṃ tu sādhavīm | nāma kṛṣṇo dadau tasya trivikramāyano muniḥ |||42 || rājñyā nāma cakārāpi kṛṣṇaḥ śrīmālikāyanī | trivikramāyanaḥ sādhuḥ sādhvī śrīmālikāyanī ||43 || pupūjatuḥ parātmānaṃ svāmikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam | guruṃ cānye badri sarve bhṛtyāḥ sahasrasaṃkhyakāḥ || 44|| sādhudīkṣāṃ jagṛhuśca tyāgāśrame sthitāstadā | sarve tyāgaṃ samāśritya bhejuḥ śrīkāntavallabham ||45|| nāryo dāsyaśca yāstā vai sādhvīdīkṣāṃ prapedire | sahasrasaṃkhyakā nāryaḥ sādhvyastatrābhavam̐stadā ||46 || divyabhāvā divyadehāḥ samastatyaktavāsanāḥ | aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre nyavasam̐ste tathāvidhāḥ ||47|| svataḥprakāśo bhagavān svāśrame tānnyavāsayat | te bhejuḥ paramātmānaṃ siṣevire patiṃ prabhum ||48 || śrutvā pṛthvyāṃ janāḥ sarve mahāścaryaṃ prapedire | rājānaścāpi cāścaryaṃ prāpurvai tyāgagocaram ||49 || ityevaṃ badrike tatra rājā vai nāgavikramaḥ | tyāgāśramaṃ tvāviveśa sastrīsainyānugaḥ kṣaṇāt ||4.110.50 || tapastepe hareḥ kṣetre bheje śrīmādhavīpatim | siṣeve śrīprabhuṃ nāthaṃ brahmasthityā hi vartayan ||51 || atha śrībhagavān badri prāha trivikramāyanam | dilāvarīmahārājyaṃ kasmai deyaṃ vadātra me ||52 || muniḥ prāha hare rājyaṃ bhavatā mayi yojitam | bhavatastat, na me rājyaṃ yatheṣṭāya nivedaya ||53|| putro’yaṃ bhavataḥ kṛṣṇa tvatsamo rājate prabhuḥ | mukundavikramo nāmnā cakravartiguṇānvitaḥ |||54||| dakṣahastatale tasya cakracihnaṃ virājate | rājyayogyo bhavatyeṣastasmai cecchasi dehi vai ||55 || evaṃ tvabhihite tatra sādhu sādhviti cābhitaḥ | vāco’bhavan harṣayuktā nārīnarābhyudīritāḥ ||56|| mukundavikramasyārthe jayaśabdastadābhavan | śrīkṛṣṇasya sutāḥ putryaḥ patnyaścāpi tathāvadan ||57|| mukundavikramo rājā jyeṣṭhapatnyagrajaḥ sutaḥ | sarvajyeṣṭhatamastasmād rājyamarhati śobhanam ||58|| evaṃ vāco’bhavan badri maṃgalāḥ sarvatodiśaḥ | omityevaṃ hariścāpi mene tathyāṃ munermatim ||59|| sā vārtā prāsarat tūrṇaṃ kuṃkumapattane’bhitaḥ | ākṣare parame kṣetre saurāṣṭre’pi gṛhe gṛhe ||4.110.60 || ājanābhe tathā khaṇḍe khaṇḍeṣvanyeṣvapi dhruvā | svarge satye ca pātāle sarvalokeṣu satvaram || 61 || nāgavikramanṛpatistyāgināṃ jagṛhe bhuvi | mukundavikramo rājā cakravartī bhaviṣyati || 6 2|| hareḥ putro hareraṃśo dilāvarīśvaro’dhunā | hāstinīnagarīsvāmī haimakhaṇḍe bhaviṣyati ||62 || muktibāleśvarī tasya sahajā yamalodbhavā | samrājñī tatpriyā rājyamātā śreṣṭhā bhaviṣyati ||64|| ityevaṃ bhūtalādau vai prāvartata jane jane | mahāmaṃgalavārteyaṃ kṛṣṇasmaraṇakāriṇī || 65|| utsavāścāpyajāyanta vādyakīrtananartanaiḥ | nārīṇāṃ veṣaśṛṃgārairmānavānāṃ gṛhe gṛhe || 66|| atha śrībadrīke’nādiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | candraṃ tu sanmukhaṃ vīkṣya muhūrte balavattame ||67|| dilāvarīṃ prati gantumājñāṃ dadau nijātmajān | mukundavikramo jyeṣṭhaputro rājā bhaviṣyati ||68 || tadutsave vimānaiśca yugalāni prayāntu vai | mama patnyaḥ samastāśca yāvanti yamalānyapi || 69|| dāsā dāsyo bhṛtyavargā dilāvarīṃ prayāntu vai | lomaśaśca tathā yogī sārthaḥ prakāśakāyanaḥ ||4.110.70 || trivikramāyanaścāpi tathānye sādhavo janāḥ | maharṣayaśca ṛṣayo munayo vedapāragāḥ ||7 1 || karmaṭhā vaiṣṇavā viprā dilāvarīṃ prayāntu vai | evamājñāpya bhagavān preṣayamāsa prāka tu tān |||72|| pārṣadaiścāpi bhūkhaṇḍe preṣayāmāsa patrikāḥ | svarge satye ca pātāle caturdaśastareṣvapi ||73|| preṣayāmāsa vijñaptipatrikāṃ maṃgalāvahām | īśvarān siddhasādhyām̐śca pitṝn surām̐śca mānavān ||74|| dikpālān lokapālāṃśca yakṣarākṣasakinnarān | kimpuruṣām̐ścāraṇām̐śca vidyādhrān daityadānavān ||75|| apsaraso brahmasarasaśca sādhvīḥ satīstathā | yoginīḥ śaktidevīśca devatāśca tatheśvarīḥ ||76|| vijñaptipatrikāḥ kṛṣṇaḥ preṣayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ | dhāmadhāmādimuktām̐śca muktānikāstathā prabhūn ||77|| āhvayāmāsa bhagavān kuṃkumapatrikādibhiḥ | bhaktānnṛpān samastām̐ścāparān khaṇḍāntareśvarān ||78|| dvīpeśvarān bhūbhṛtaścāhvayāmāsa haristadā | śvaśurān nijaputrām̐śca tattaddhāmagṛhasthitān ||79|| āhvayāmāsa bhagavān dilāvarīpurīṃ prati | atha śrībhagavān mātrāpitrā putrādibhiḥ saha ||4.110.80 || patnyādibhiśca sahito vimānena hi satvaram | yayau dilāvarīṃ rājadhānīṃ haimabhuvāṃ śubhām ||8 1 || maṇḍapaṃ kārayāmāsa daśayojanamuttamam | sauvarṇaṃ cānuyamunaṃ divyaratnādirājitam | |82|| divyādivyanṛpavargasiṃhāsanādisaṃyutam | munimaharṣimuktādyāsanapaṃktyādyalaṃkṛtam ||83|| sarvasiddhimayaṃ sarvarājasmṛddhiprapūritam | sarvadṛśyamahādṛśyaśastrāstraputtalānvitam ||84|| sarvaraṃgāvaliśobhaṃ kalpalatādruveṣitam | vidyutprakāśabhāvyāptaṃ divyādarśādiśobhanam ||85|| divyaparīdevatābhiḥ karamālābhivardhitam | divyāstaraṇabhūbhāgaṃ divyatoraṇarājitam ||86|| bahuvyomāntarakakṣānārīvṛndavilāsitam | gandhasugandhasurabhivyāptaṃ susparśavātinam ||87|| sarvapānādisaṃklṛptaṃ sarvasevakavetriṇam | sarvamaṃgalapadmādisvastikādisuśobhitam ||88|| raṃgavallīvitānādyairmālāhārālirājitam | divyayantradhvaniramyaṃ gītigāyanaharṣitam ||89||| vādyasuvādyagāndharvagaṇanṛtyādihṛddharam | manoharaṃ samastābhirviśvakarmakalādibhiḥ ||4.110.9 0 || vahnikuṇḍādibhirdevāsanottamairvirājitam | ābhiṣekopakaraṇaiḥ pūjādravyaiḥ samanvitam ||9 1|| havyairvividhairdānādyaiḥ sampūrṇaṃ sādhanādibhiḥ | rājavidhimahādravyairyuktaṃ veṣādibhistathā ||92|| rājyābhiṣekopakaraṇādyaiḥ samanvitaṃ śubham | svarṇaratnavibhūṣādyairnṛpayogyasuvastubhiḥ || 9 3 || chatracāmaravetrādyaiḥ pādapīṭhādisaṃkulam | sauvarṇakalaśaistīrthajalabhṛtairvirājitam ||94|| miṣṭānnaphalapatrādyaiḥ samitkuśādibhiryutam | divyacandanavaryaiśca gandhasāraiḥ sugandhitam ||95|| rājādhirājaśobhāḍhyaṃ saṃkalpasiddhavastudam | caityacetanadhiṣṇyaiśca lakṣyasaṃkhyairvirājitam ||96|| mahāsiṃhāsanarājanmadhyapaścimapīṭhakam | etādṛśaṃ suvaikuṇṭhaprabhaṃ divyaṃ hi maṇḍapam ||97|| kārayāmāsa bhagavān dhāmayuktakalākaraiḥ | tathaiva bhojanānāṃ ca parvatān miṣṭasadrasān ||98|| payo’mṛtādipānānāṃ sarāṃsi cāpyakārayat | āvāsān klṛptayāmāsa sukhaśayyādiśobhanān ||99|| pānabhojanaveṣāṇāṃ klṛptīḥ sukhakarīstathā | dāsadāsībhṛtyasevākarān rarakṣa tatra ca || 4.110.1 00|| ityevaṃ sarvathā svāmīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | racayāmāsa yogyāni vidheyāni tadābhitaḥ || 101 || badrike ca tadā sarvaprāṇināṃ supramodanam | utsavāścābhavan hṛtsu mahānandā nisargajāḥ || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śrīhariḥ svaputrasya mukundavikramasya rājyābhiṣekaṃ kartuṃ dilāvarīrājadhānīṃ yayau, maṇḍapādīn kārayāmāsa, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā daśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 110 ||
<4.111> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi mukundavikramaṃ hariḥ | upoṣaṇaṃ cādyadine kārayāmāsa śuddhaye || 1 || gavyaprāśanamevāpi kṣaurakarmāpyakārayat | dehaśuddhiṃ tathā tīrthavāribhiḥ snānamityapi || 2 || akṣayyatṛtīyāyāṃ ca prage’bhiṣekamutsavam | kārayāmāsa bhagavān sahasratīrthavāribhiḥ || 3 || gaṇeśapūjanaṃ cāpi kuladevaprapūjanam | hanūmatpūjanaṃ cāpi kārayāmāsa mādhavaḥ || 4 || maṇḍape vāstudevānāmarhaṇāṃ lomaśena tu | kārayāmāsa bhagavān havanāni yathāyatham || 5 || vahneḥ prapūjanaṃ vahnau caroḥ śrapaṇamityapi | homaṃ ca kārayāmāsa viprairvai vedapāragaiḥ || 6 || bahuvādyānyavādyanta strīṇāṃ ca gītayo’bhavan | mahīmānāḥ sarvalokanivāsinaḥ samāyayuḥ ||7|| muktāstathāvatārāśceśvarāḥ siddhāśca sādhavaḥ | satyadevāśca pitaro mātaro devatāḥ surāḥ ||8|| pārṣadāścāpi muktānyo devyo lakṣmyaḥ samāyayuḥ | maṇḍape dyunivāsāśca rudrādyā viṣṇavo hyajāḥ ||9|| lokapālā diśāṃpālā merumandaravāsinaḥ | tīrthāni divyataravaścāyayurvṛkṣavallikāḥ || 4.111.1 0|| tattvāni śaktayaścāpi kāmadughāḥ samāyayuḥ | maharṣayaśca munayaḥ sādhvyaḥ satyaḥ samāyayuḥ || 11 || bhaṭāścāraṇagandharvāḥ sūtamāgadhabandinaḥ | nartakāścāpi nartakyo maṇḍape vai samāyayuḥ || 1 2|| vidvām̐saḥ kiṃpuruṣāśca kinnarā yakṣarākṣasāḥ | uragāśca bhujagāśca nāgā daityāśca dānavāḥ || 1 3|| paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo divyā jātismarāḥ samāyayuḥ | nadyaśca parvatāścāpi samudrāśca rasāstathā || 14|| tārā grahāśca nakṣatramaṇḍalāni samāyayuḥ | mānavāḥ ṛṣayo viprā dīnānāthāḥ samāyayuḥ || 15||| rājāno rājavargāśca prajeśvarāḥ prajājanāḥ | śreṣṭhino vaiṣṇavā bhaktāḥ koṭiśastatra cāyayuḥ || 16|| rājarājeśvarāḥ sarve niṣeduḥ svāsanādiṣu | maṇḍapaḥ sarvasṛṣṭīnāṃ samrājaiḥ śobhano’bhavat || 17|| vedakāryāṇi sarvāṇi pravartante dvijādibhiḥ | vedaghoṣā udbhavanti garjayanti diśo daśa || 18|| gopālaḥ kārayāmāsa pārṣadaiḥ svāgatādikam | śrīkṛṣṇaḥ kārayāmāsa sammānaṃ pādyavāribhiḥ || 1 9|| arghyādibhiścāpi tathā madhuparkaiḥ samarhaṇaiḥ | vimānāni samantādvai vyomnaścāvataranti ca ||4.111.20|| āyānti devavaryāśca maṇḍape divyavigrahāḥ | svāgatenārcitā niṣīdanti siṃhāsaneṣu te ||21 || homakāryaṃ tadā badri pravartate yathāyatham | mukundavikramastatra sapatnīko’nale carum ||22|| juhāva bhāvanāyuktāścājyasamitphalādibhiḥ | atha śrīlomaśastatra kārayāmāsa pūjanam |||23|| suvarṇavarmaṇaścāpi khaḍgasya carmaṇastathā | chatrasya vetrayaṣṭyāśca mukuṭasya paṭasya ca || 24|| śataghnyāḥ pūjanaṃ cāpi gadāyāḥ pūjanaṃ tathā | cakrasya pūjanaṃ lakṣmyā rudrāṇyāḥ pūjanaṃ tathā ||25|| dhanuṣaḥ pūjanaṃ cāpi bāṇasya pūjanaṃ tathā | sarvaśastrāstramantrāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ ca tataḥ param ||26|| rājadhiṣṇyārhaṇāṃ cāpi rudrasya pūjanaṃ tathā | viṣṇośca brahmaṇaścāpi kārayāmāsa pūjanam || 27|| senādevyāḥ pūjanaṃ ca kośadevasya pūjanam | pṛthivyāḥ pūjanaṃ cāpi kārayāmāsa lomaśaḥ ||28|| vārāhapūjanaṃ cāpi svāmiśrīkṛṣṇapūjanam | bhūpamukuṭapūjāṃ ca kārayāmāsa lomaśaḥ |||29|| śriyā lakṣmyāḥ pūjanaṃ ca lābhaśubhaprapūjanam | jayaśrīpūjanaṃ cāpi kārayāmāsa lomaśaḥ ||4.111.30|| dikpālāvāhanaṃ bhūpadehe cakāra lomaśaḥ | surāvāhanamevāpi cakāra lomaśo guruḥ ||3 1|| bhūpatitvārthasaṃsiddhyai cakre bhuvaḥ prapūjanam | prajāpatitvasiddhyarthaṃ cakre prajeśapūjanam ||32|| lakṣmīpatitvasiddhyarthaṃ cakre lakṣmīprapūjanam | daṇḍapatitvasiddhyarthaṃ cakre yamasya pūjanam || 33|| dhanapatitvasiddhyarthaṃ cakre kuberapūjanam | nadyabdhīśatvasiddhyarthaṃ cakre varuṇapūjanam || 34|| annauṣadhīśatāptyai cakre candraprapūjanam | rājatvasiddhilābhāya cakre mahendrapūjanam ||35|| pākapatitvalābhārthaṃ cakre’rkapūjanaṃ muniḥ | ārogyārthaṃ rogapatirudrārhaṇāṃ cakāra saḥ ||36|| tejolābhāya ca vahnipūjāṃ cakāra lomaśaḥ | prāṇarakṣākaraṃ devaṃ vāyuṃ pupūja lomaśaḥ || 37|| mātṛkāpūjanaṃ rāṣṭraprajāvṛddhyai cakāra saḥ | samastasṛṣṭidevānāṃ cakāra pūjanaṃ tathā || 38|| vāhanānāṃ pūjanāni śamigohastivājinām | yānayantravimānānāṃ pūjāṃ cakāra lomaśaḥ ||39|| balidānāni sarvebhyo dadau śrīlomaśastadā | nirṛtirakṣasāṃ cāpi surāṇāṃ grahanākinām ||4.111.40|| balidānāni ca dadau lomaśaḥ sukhahetave | kṛtvaivaṃ vidhivat pūjāṃ śāntiṃ śrāddhaṃ yathāvidhi ||41 || mukhe pūrṇāhutiṃ datvā lomaśastu tataḥ param | prasādatilakaṃ cakre rājarājñīlalāṭayoḥ |||42|| rājaveṣaṃ ca mukuṭaṃ yajñopavītakaṃ srajam | mukuṭaṃ dhārayāmāsa yavāṃkurāṇi bhūpatiḥ ||43|| śastradhāraṇamevāpi cakre mukundavikramaḥ | cakre rājyapratijñāṃ ca prajāpālanagarbhitām ||44|| lomaśādyāḥ ṛṣayaśca vṛddhā nṛpādayaḥ prajāḥ | īśvarāśca tathā muktā viprā ārārtrikaṃ vyadhuḥ ||45|| āśīrvādān daduścāpi ciraṃ jīva prajā ava | putrapautrādimānāssva prajāsevāparo bhava ||46|| svasti te sarvadā cāstu maṃgalāni sadā tava | utsavāste prajāyāṃ tu bhavantu satataṃ sukhāḥ ||47|| avighnaṃ tava rājyaṃ cāsamudrāntaṃ sthiraṃ sadā | ārogyadhānyadhanavat sampannaṃ sarvadāstviti ||48|| athaivaṃ dvijavaryāste samuccārya sumākṣataiḥ | vardhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ puṣpāñjalīn daduḥ kramāt ||49|| trivikramāyanarṣiśca tilakaṃ pracakāra ha | mukuṭaṃ ca srajaṃ tasya mūrdhni kaṇṭhe’nyasattadā ||4.111.50|| anye’pi sādhavo viprāḥ pupūjuḥ kṣmāpatiṃ tadā | guruḥ prakāśo bhagavān rājapatraṃ dadau tadā ||51|| rājyādhikāralekhaṃ ca dadau tasmai nṛpāya vai | jayanādā abhavam̐śca rājānaścopadā daduḥ ||52|| upāyanāni ratnāni maṇihārān suvarṇajān | dadurnṛpāya cāmūlyān sampadaśca parāḥ śubhāḥ ||53|| kaścicchatraṃ tathā kaścid vetraṃ tathā ca cāmare | mukuṭaṃ kuṇḍale kaścit kaṭake ca dhanāni ca ||54|| svarṇarūpyakabhūṣāśca dadū rājanyavaṃśajāḥ | prajājanāḥ surā devavarāśca devatā daduḥ ||55|| upāyanāni bahūni cāmūlyāni tadā tadā | atha śrībhagavānasya tilakaṃ saṃvyadhāddhariḥ ||56|| vaṃśavistāravān rājā bhava cakrādhipādhipaḥ | ityuktvā mastake mālāṃ karaṃ putrasya sandadau ||57|| āha saṃśṛṇvatāṃ sarvabhūpānāṃ saṃsadi prabhuḥ | bhavatāṃ sarvabhūpānāṃ mūrdhanyo’yaṃ mayā kṛtaḥ ||58|| mukundavikramo rājeśvaraḥ samrāṭ karārjakaḥ | sudarśanaṃ mama cakra rakṣārthaṃ dīyate’sya vai ||29|| aśāsane sthitā ye syusteṣāṃ nibarhaṇaṃ tvidam | ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścakraṃ dadau mahat ||4.111.60|| sahasrāraṃ yathāvāñcchā tathārūpadharaṃ śubham | cakradhvajaṃ jaitrarathaṃ dadau śaṃkhaṃ jayapradam ||6 1|| kalpalatāṃ cākṣayaṃ sat pātraṃ dadau hariḥ svayam | puṣpāñjaliṃ dadau kaṇṭhe jīvamālāṃ tato dadau |||62|| athaivaṃ pūjane jāte mukundavikramo nṛpaḥ | śuśubhe kṛṣṇavat tatra rājñīyuto nṛpāsane ||63|| vṛddhābhivādanaṃ cakre śrīkṛṣṇapūjanaṃ vyadhāt | dadau dānāni sarvāṇi svarṇaratnāmbarāṇi ca ||64|| gajavājivimānāni gṛhodyānatalāni ca | dhanāni sampadaścāpi divyānnabhūṣaṇāni ca ||65|| brahmāṇḍadānamevāpi tulādānāni yānyapi | dhenudānāni sarvāṇi kanyādānāni vai tathā ||66|| grāmakṣetrālayadānānyapi dadau tadā nṛpaḥ | jīvikāḥ pradadau devālayadīnāndharogiṣu ||67|| mocayāmāsa nigaḍasthitān pradaṇḍitān janān | miṣṭānnāni tadā tatra bhūrīṇi pradadau nṛpaḥ ||68|| sūtamāgadhabandibhyaścāraṇebhyo dhanaṃ dadau | viprarṣidvijajātibhyo mahādānāni vai dadau ||69|| bhojanāni samastebhyo dadau rājye tadā dine | jayaśabdaiḥ samaṃ tatra sabhāmaṇḍapato nṛpaḥ ||4.111.70|| datvā ca dakṣiṇāstūrṇaṃ parihāraṃ vidhāya ca | utthito rājacihnaiśca sarvarājanyavanditaḥ ||71|| mātaraṃ pitaraṃ natvābhivādyābhijanaṃ nṛpaḥ | rājyāgrapadabhāgbhiśca prārthito bhramaṇāya ha |||72||| jagaryāṃ sainyasahito vardhamāno janaistadā | babhrāma rājamārgeṣu sarvasainyasamanvitaḥ ||73|| vanditaḥ pūjitaścāśīrbhiśca saṃvardhito nṛpaḥ | prajāḥ prasādya yamunāṃ gatvā prapūjya tāṃ nadīm ||74|| jalaṃ pītvāpūjya durgaṃ śanairyāyānnṛpālayam | viśaśrāma kṣaṇaṃ paścādbhājanāni śubhāni vai ||75|| kārayāmāsa sarvebhyo mahīmānebhya ādarāt | bhojayāmāsa sarvāśca vidāyaṃ pradadau tadā ||76|| jayadhvaniṃ ca yantrāṇāṃ śrāvayāmāsa cakrarāṭ | sāyaṃ nṛtyāni modārthaṃ bhūbhṛto’psaraso vyadhuḥ ||77|| gāyanāni ca gandharvāḥ kavayaḥ kavitā vyadhuḥ | ebhyo’pi nṛpavaryo’sau dadau toṣāya saddhanam ||78|| viśaśramustato rātrau sarve rājā prajādayaḥ | prātarjajāgaruḥ śrutvā maṃgalāni śubhāni ha ||79|| mahīmānā yayurnaijān deśān lokān sukhānvitāḥ | bhuktvā vidhāya pānāni cāśīrvādaparāyaṇāḥ ||4.111.80|| athānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ | nijaputrān yamalām̐śca svasvamātāmahādibhiḥ ||8 1 || saha gantuṃ tadājñāṃ vai cakāra bahupūjitān | śvaśurāśca tathā cānye prasannā bahumānitāḥ |||82|| yayurnaijān pradeśāṃśca vimānaiśca nijaiḥ saha | prajāḥ svasvapradeśām̐śca yayurvai mānitāstadā |||83|| athānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svīyajanaiḥ saha | putrāya śikṣaṇaṃ datvā yayau kuṃkumavāpikām ||84|| svapatnyādisametaśca svīyakuṭumbayuk tathā | lomaśādyaiśca sahito yayāvaśvasarobhuvam ||85|| badrike bhagavatputraścābhiṣikto nṛpāsane | śaśāsa pṛthivīṃ dīrghāṃ daśasāhasrayojanām ||86|| karadīkṛtabhūpālo bhagavadbalamāśritaḥ | vaiṣṇavīṃ pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ cakāra dharmaśāsanaḥ ||87|| nāsya rājye hyanāvṛṣṭirdubhikṣaṃ duṣṭapīḍanam | rogā naivākālamṛtyurna ca vaidhavyamityapi ||88|| na śāṭhyaṃ na ca paiśunyaṃ kāpaṭyaṃ na prajāsvapi | na hiṃsā nāpi cauryaṃ ca prasahya haraṇaṃ na ca ||89|| naiva vasatidvārāṇāṃ pidhānaṃ vidyate tadā | udghāṭitakapāṭā vai tadā vasatayaḥ sadā ||4.111.90|| vāgbandhe na vyabhicāraḥ pratijñābhaṃga eva na | vṛddhābhivādanaṃ nityaṃ pañcamakhapravartanam ||9 1|| pañcāgnitāpanaṃ nityaśrāddhādi karma vai satām | viprāṇāṃ vedaghoṣāśca grāme grāme sthale sthale |||92|| sarvāḥ kāmadughā gāvaḥ pātivratyaparāḥ striyaḥ | satyaḥ sādhvyaśca santaśca gṛhasthā api sarvadā ||93|| śamamārgasthitā nārāyaṇadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ | phalanti ca tadā kalpavallikā iva buddhayaḥ ||94|| kṛṣṇārpitāni śastrāṇi divyavigrahavanti ca | pravartante tu daṇḍārthaṃ gatvā duṣṭaṃ svayaṃ tadā ||95|| deśāntare praśāstāraḥ śastrarūpā bhaṭāstadā | kārāgārasya nairarthyaṃ tadābhavat samantataḥ ||96|| agnayaḥ sīmabhāgasthā rakṣantyasya surāṣṭrakam | abdhayo mūrtimantaśca durganirvāhakāriṇaḥ ||97|| asyādhvareṣu vai devāḥ sākṣādāyānti śārṅgiṇā | sahitāḥ pārṣadā muktā īśvarā havyabhojanāḥ ||98|| grāmadevyo vanadevyo rakṣanti tatprajāḥ sadā | daityadānavarakṣāṃsi sattvabhāvaṃ gatāni vai ||99|| tāmasyaḥ sampado yāśca gatāḥ sāttvikatāṃ tadā | vighasāśiprajāścāsya devagṛhānvitagṛhāḥ || 4.111.100 || badrike sarvathā bhaktiḥ prāvartata samantataḥ | hareḥ putrasya rājye vai mokṣadā sampadāvahāḥ || 101 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne dilāvarīrājadhānyāṃ mukundavikramasya rājyābhiṣekotsavādinirūpaṇanāmaikādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 111 ||
<4.112> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi mukundavikramo nṛpaḥ | kṣīrodaputryā lakṣmyāstu sutāya mantriṇe tadā || 1 || vāsudevāya rājyasya dhuraṃ nirvahituṃ sadā | ājñāpya niryayau pṛthvīṃ vīkṣituṃ paritastadā || 2 || vimānena yayau prāk tu tuhīnādrīn tathottarān | kurūn kimpuruṣaṃ cāpi ketumālamilāvṛtam || 3 || pūrvadeśān dakṣiṇām̐śca paścimān bhūpradeśakān | sarvatra bhūpavaryā ye tiṣṭhanti te tu bhāvataḥ || 4 || cakruḥ sammānamarghyaṃ ca pūjāṃ samrāṭ susannibhām | karān daduśca te sarve yathāyogyān svabhūbhṛte || 5 || ekacakraṃ mahārājyaṃ daśasāhasrayojanam | vīkṣyāgatya yamīṃ snātvā dilāvaryāṃ sthiro’bhavat || 6 || koṭiparārdharatnāni rājadattāni cānayat | tāni sarvāṇi ca vāsudevasātkṛtya vai tataḥ || 7 || svayaṃ vrataṃ prajagrāha sadaivātmanivedanam | sarvadā bhagavadbhaktimayaṃ patnīyuto nṛpaḥ || 8 || yamunāyāstaṭe ramye kārayitvā sugahvaram | prarakṣya pitṛbhagavatpratimāṃ tatra kānakīm || 9 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇākhyāṃ śobhanāṃ śubhām | sarvadā sarvathā tasyāḥ sevāparo’bhavannṛpaḥ || 4.112.10 || jaṭādhṛk suvalkalāḍhyaḥ karamālādharastathā | susādhuveṣo’ntarvṛttimūrtidhyānādimānasaḥ || 1 1|| babhūva sarvadā badri yogirāḍiva muktigaḥ | sarvaḥ karmakalāpaśca kṛtastena hareḥ kṛte || 12|| pṛthvītattvaṃ dehagaṃ ca kṛtaṃ haryarthameva tat | jalatattvaṃ ca dehasthaṃ kṛtaṃ haryarthamityapi || 1 3|| vahnitattvaṃ śarīrasthaṃ kṛtaṃ haryarthamanvaham | vāyutattvaṃ dehagaṃ ca kṛtaṃ haryarthamuttamam || 14|| vyomatattvaṃ ca dehasthaṃ kṛtaṃ haryarthamambaram | śabdaḥ sparśo raso rūpaṃ gandho haryarthamityamī || 15|| pādau pradakṣiṇaṃ kartuṃ yojitau śrīharestathā | hastau kṛṣṇasya sevāyāṃ sarvathā yojitau sadā || 16 || vāṇī kṛṣṇasya kīrtau ca vyāpāritā stavādiṣu | pāyūpasthendriye tena kṛte śīle ca saṃyame || 17|| netre tu yojite’nādikṛṣṇarūpādidarśane | śrotre kṛte hareḥ śabdagrahaṇe niyamānvite || 18|| tvaṅnityaṃ sthāpitā kṛṣṇasambandhivastuyoginī | rasanā kṛṣṇanaivedyarasamātrābhivartinī || 1 9|| ghrāṇaṃ kṛṣṇasya surabhergrahe sadā vinirmitam | prāṇān sarvān japagarbhān cakre kṛṣṇārthajīvanaḥ || 4.112.20 || mastakaṃ namane cakre yojitaṃ śrīhareḥ sadā | kaṇṭhaṃ cakāra bhagavatsvarālāpaguṇodaye || 21 || hāsyaṃ
