hareḥ samīpe bhrūkuṭiṃ cakre hareḥ kṛte | nimeṣaṃ bhagavanmiṣaṃ kṣuvanaṃ nāmasaṃgatam || 22|| oṣṭhayormelana kṛṣṇaprasādānnādilehane | jihvāyā bhramaṇaṃ cāsye kṛṣṇaprasādamārgaṇe || 23 || varṇasthānāni sarvāṇi cakre kṛṣṇābhidhākṛte | grīvāṃ cakre hareḥ sragbhirbhūṣitāṃ candanādibhiḥ ||24|| jāgratiḥ spaṣṭamūrtyarthaṃ nidrā mānasamūrtaye | suṣuptisturyarūpe ca kṛṣṇārthaṃ tena yojitā || 25|| kharjanaṃ moḍanaṃ dehatroḍanaṃ śayanaṃ tathā | āsanaṃ guṇṭhanaṃ saṃkocanaṃ cakre hareḥ kṛte || 26|| uttānaṃ bhūpratānaṃ ca pārśvatānamadhaḥsthitim | svastikādyāsanabhedān cakre kṛṣṇe prayojitān || 27||| daṇḍavat karaṇe netre karau pādau manaḥ śiraḥ | vakṣaścetyaṣṭakaṃ cakre’ñjaliṃ kṛṣṇasya sannidhau || 28 || mālikāvartane sarvāṅgulīścakre suyojitāḥ | hastatale’ṅguṣṭhayukte cakre’rhaṇe hareḥ sa vai || 29|| prakoṣṭhayoḥ kriyāḥ kaphoṇikayośca kriyāstathā | skandhayośca kriyāścakre kṛṣṇakāryavidhāpane || 4.112.30 || nitambayośca pṛṣṭhasyodarasya nalayoḥ kriyāḥ | nāḍīnāṃ vāyusañcārām̐ścakre kṛṣṇakriyāyutāḥ || 31 || hṛdayasya dhamanītvaṃ cakre kṛṣṇakriyānvitam | romṇāṃ valīnāmastitvaṃ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārthamasya vai || 3 2|| sakthnośca jaṃghayoḥ puṣṭirdhātūnāṃ klṛptirityapi | bhojanaṃ pānamāsvādaścāsya kṛṣṇakṛte’bhavan | | 3 3|| dehasaṃśodhanaṃ bhūṣāveṣaśṛṃgāramārjanam | dravaddravyapradānaṃ ca sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārthamasya vai | | 34|| romṇāṃ snehodgamaścāpi tathendriyapramodanam | kṛṣṇapramodaprītyarthaṃ rājñastasyābhavat sadā || 35|| ādānaṃ gamanaṃ tṛptistapaḥ saṃyama utthitiḥ | ālasyaṃ saraṇaṃ rodhaḥ sarvamasya hareḥ kṛte | | 3 6|| muṣṭiḥ prasūtirasyāpyañjalirvyaṅgulivistaraḥ | phaṇāprasāra evāpi sarvamasya hareḥ kṛte | | 37|| nakhanikṛntanaṃ romanikṛntanaṃ ca kampanam | nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ bhāvā dhāvanaṃ ca hareḥ kṛte | | 38 || cāñcalyaṃ ca munitvaṃ ca bahirāntaravartanam | udgāraścāpi hikkā ca vyāptatvaṃ ca hareḥ kṛte | | 39|| akriyatvaṃ sakriyatvaṃ vyāpārā varṣmaṇastathā | snānaṃ sandhyā japo homaḥ sarvaṃ tasya hareḥ kṛte | |4.112.40 || lekhanaṃ vācanaṃ puṣpapatrādyādhāraṇaṃ tathā | pūjopakaraṇāvāptiḥ sarvamasya hareḥ kṛte | |4 1 || yānavāhanayogāśca naranāryabhimelanam | prajāpradarśanaṃ cāpi sarvamasya hareḥ kṛte | |42|| mantraṇānumatiḥ kārye kvacitkāryāvalokanam | nirvṛttiḥ sammatirvāpi sarvamasya hareḥ kṛte | |43 || deśāvalokanaṃ śreṣṭhotsavābhigamanaṃ śubham | śobhā pravṛttirevāpi sarvamasya hareḥ kṛte | |44|| rājotsavāḥ sainyaśobhotsavā devotsavāstathā | vratotsavāśca dānāni sarvamasya hareḥ kṛte | |45|| yajñāḥ paropakārāśca nyāyā daṇḍāḥ praśikṣaṇam | smṛddhayaḥ sampadaścāpi sarvamasya hareḥ kṛte ||46|| udayāstamayau tasya madhyāhnaṃ saṃgavastathā | sandhyā velā brāhmakālo niśā cāsya hareḥ kṛte || 47|| ṛtavaścauṣṇyaśaityādi vṛṣṭayaścātapāstathā | vānaṃ gharmāgnisaṃjvālāprākaṭyaṃ ca hareḥ kṛte || 48 || satkāraḥ svāgataṃ cārghyaṃ madhuparkaḥ sugandhanam | sammānaṃ ca mahīmānāgamaścāsya hareḥ kṛte || 49|| āyavyayau ca kṛṣṇārthau kośāḥ kṛṣṇārthakāstathā | dāsā dāsyo bhṛtyavargāḥ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇakṛte’sya vai || 4.112.50 || saṃkalpo mananaṃ bodhaścintanaṃ tṛptirityapi | dhyānaṃ ca bhajanaṃ pratyabhijñānaṃ smaraṇaṃ dhṛtiḥ ||5 1 || bhaktiḥ prītiḥ sthitirmānaṃ sarvamasya hareḥ kṛte | ātmasaṃvedanaṃ cātmabhogaḥ sākṣātsvavṛttitā ||52|| nijānandaśca santoṣaḥ sarvamasya hareḥ kṛte | ekāntasevanaṃ cāpi śvasanaṃ jīvanaṃ ratiḥ ||53|| āhāraścopavāsaśca sarvamasya hareḥ kṛte | ātmano dehavāsaśca tathā vastrādidhāraṇam ||54|| gahvare ca gṛhe vāso vakṣe’syāpi hareḥ kṛte | nibhālayati rājāsau cātmanyātmānamacyutam |||55|| sarvavastuṣu sarvatra nibhālayati mādhavam | ṛṣayo munayo devāstīrthāni mūrtimanti ca ||56|| tadāśrayaṃ samāgatya dṛṣṭvā prayānti nityaśaḥ | satyaśca sādhavaḥ sādhvyo yoginyo yoginastathā ||57|| viraktā vrahmasaṃsaktā jñānino dhyāninastathā | paritastasya tiṣṭhanti divyāśramasya sīmasu ||58|| kṛṣṇakathāḥ pravartante’nuvelaṃ cādhvarā japāḥ | vedaghoṣāḥ kīrtanāni pravartante’sya cāśrame ||59|| abhiṣekā devapūjā balayo bhojanāni ca | caravo devakāryāṇi nīrājanāni cābhitaḥ ||4.112.60|| sughaṇṭājhallarīnādāḥ pravartante’bhito’sya ca | śaṃkhanādā jayanādāḥ kṛṣṇakṛṣṇetighoṣaṇāḥ ||61|| api siṃhā mṛgāḥ sattvāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ paśavastathā | kīṭāścetāḥ pataṃgāśca vadanti brahmagāyanam ||62|| yādāṃsi bhūmigartasthā vṛkṣakoṭaravāsinaḥ | tvāvāsāḥ patravāsāśca vadanti brahmaśāśvatam ||63|| vṛkṣāśca vallikāścāpi smaranti brahma śāśvatam | pratiśabdaiśca garjanti parvatā gartikā jaḍāḥ ||64|| evamasyābhavadbhaktiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe sadā | badrike nṛpateryogāt prajāḥ sarvā narāḥ striyaḥ ||65|| vaiṣṇavyaḥ sarvathā divyā hyajāyanta bhuvastale | prasādaṃ pitaraścāpi labhante devatā grahāḥ ||66|| pūjāṃ labhante dyusado hariḥ sarvatra pūjyate | mānave mānave kaṇṭhī japamālāsya vartate ||67|| mānave mānave mūrtirnārāyaṇasya vartate | grāme grāme makhaścāpi baiśvadevaḥ pratidvijam ||68|| gopure gopure kṛṣṇamūrtigogrāsaśobhanā | nāryā nāryā vibhūṣāsu kṛṣṇābhidhānamastyapi ||69|| śastre śastre harernāma sarveṣūpaskareṣvapi | āpaṇe hyāpaṇe mūrtirnārāyaṇasya vartate ||4.112.70|| grāme grāme mayabhūmau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai | mandiraṃ vartate śreṣṭhaṃ pattane pattane’pi ca ||71|| prātaḥ sāyaṃ harerlakṣmīsvāminaśca prapūjanam | nīrājanāni jāyante ghaṇṭādinādanānyapi ||72|| stutayaḥ sampravartante gītayaḥ kīrtanānyapi | naivedyāni pradīyante tāmbūlāni jalāni ca ||73|| prasādāśca prabhujyante pīyate’mṛtavāri ca | badrike pratyahaṃ grāme grāme sāyaṃ kathāḥ śubhāḥ ||74|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā bhavanti bhūtale | evaṃ vai vaiṣṇavī bhūmirjātā mukundatanmayī ||75|| mukundavikramo rājā tāpaso nityameva ca | prātarutthāya kṛṣṇasya karoti dhyānamanvaham ||76|| snātvā pitṛgaṇebhyaśca tarpaṇaṃ prakaroti ca | sūryārādhanamevāpi sandhyāvandanamityapi ||77|| hareḥ pūjāṃ pratimāyāṃ karoti lagnamānasaḥ | āvāhanaṃ svarṇasiṃhāsane kṛtvā tataḥ param ||78|| pādyamarghyaṃ samarpyācamanīyakaṃ dadātyapi | dantadhāvanamevāpi śaucajalaṃ dadātyapi ||79|| hastapādādiśuddhyarthaṃ mṛda cūrṇaṃ dadātyapi | gaṇḍūṣāya jalaṃ pātramañjanaṃ prakarotyapi ||4.112.8 0|| kṛṣṇamūrtau sugandhibhṛttailasāraṃ dadātyapi | arkasāraṃ rasasāraṃ dadāti mardanaṃ hyapi ||8 1|| candanaṃ ca sugandhaṃ ca dadāti pañcagavyakam | dugdhaṃ dadhiṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ śarkarāṃ tīrthavāryapi ||82|| abhiṣekaṃ kārayitvā mārjanaṃ prakarotyapi | vastradānaṃ vibhūṣāṇāmarpaṇaṃ ca karotyapi ||83|| śṛṅgāraṃ vividhaṃ sarvaṃ karoti kṛṣṇavarṣmaṇi | keśaprasādhanaṃ tailapradānaṃ puṣpayojanam ||84|| netrayoḥ kajjalaṃ bhāle tilakaṃ candrakaṃ śubham | kastūrikāṃ candanaṃ ca mālikāṃ ratnamālikām ||85|| hārān tulasīpatrāṇi tathā yajñopavītakam | akṣatān kuṃkumaṃ cāpi gulālaṃ pradadātyapi ||86|| abīlaṃ cottaragandhaṃ gucchaṃ raṃgādirañjanam | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ phalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ jalam ||87|| karodvartanakaṃ cāpi dadāti naktakaṃ tataḥ | śayyāṃ suśobhanāṃ sarvopaskārasahitāṃ tathā ||88|| preṃkhāṃ dadāti bhāvena vyajanaṃ pavanapradam | chatraṃ sucāmare yaṣṭiṃ pattrāṇe mukuṭādikam ||89|| yānaṃ ca vāhanaṃ cāpi bhramaṇaṃ gṛhakhelanam | madhyāhne bhojanaṃ cāpi dadāti śrīvilāsine ||4.112.90|| pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cāpi viśrāmaṃ śayane śubhe | utthānaṃ bhramaṇaṃ sāyaṃ mahodyāne dadātyapi ||9 1|| khelanaṃ cāpi sandhyāyāmārārtrikaṃ karoti ca | stavanaṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi bhojanaṃ pāyasārpaṇam ||92|| jalārpaṇaṃ mukhavāsaṃ śayanaṃ ca dadātyapi | aṃgānāṃ mardanaṃ cāpi karoti sukhakṛddhareḥ ||93|| pradakṣiṇaṃ daṇḍavacca sevanaṃ vividhaṃ tathā | kathāyā śravaṇaṃ kṛṣṇakīrtanaṃ smaraṇaṃ hareḥ ||94|| dāsyaṃ cātmārpaṇaṃ cāpi karoti kṛṣṇatoṣaṇam | evaṃ karmakalāpaṃ śrīśārthaṃ mukundavikramaḥ |||95|| karoti sarvadā badri nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ | tadbhāryā ca satī muktibāleśvarī virāgiṇī ||96|| vaiṣṇavī pativat sarvāḥ kriyāḥ kṛṣṇārthasaṃbhṛtāḥ | karoti patisevāḍhyā śrīkṛṣṇārpitamānasā ||97|| dehanirvāhayogyaṃ yat sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārthameva tat | patisevopayogyaṃ yat sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārthameva tat ||98|| ityevaṃ badrike tena mukundavikrameṇa vai | arpitaṃ śrīharau divyādivyācaraṇamātmanaḥ ||99|| vaikuṇṭhamaparaṃ bhūmau golokaścāparaḥ kṣitau | kṛtastena harerbhaktyāvatārita ivottamaḥ || 4.112.10 0|| gṛhe gṛhe camatkārāḥ prajāyante navā navāḥ | sākṣāt kṛṣṇaharirbhaktyā bhaktadṛṣṭau prayāti ca || 10 1|| aneke brahmavettāro jīvā nāryo narāstadā | prayānti paramaṃ dhāma śrīhareḥ paramātmanaḥ || 102||| evaṃ satyayugastatra mukundavikrame nṛpe | avartatābdhiparyantaṃ devamānavasadṛśaḥ || 1 03|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne mukundavikramasya rājño bhagavatparāyaṇatādivarṇananāmā dvādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 112 ||
<4.113> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca atha śrībhagavān badri kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | vartate kuṃkumavāpyāṃ sarvasaukhyapradastadā || 1 || vāsudevasahāyārthaṃ putrāstena pare’pi ca | preṣitā rājyapuṣṭyarthaṃ kalāśāstraviśāradāḥ || 2 || śriyāḥ putro rāsakṛṣṇaścopapradhānako’bhavat | prajñāputro brahmaprabhuḥ saināpatyamarakṣayat || 3 || padmāvatīsuto’nantaḥ kārāgārādhipo’bhavat | lalitāyāḥ suto lāleśvaro rāṣṭrādhipo’bhavat || 4 || jayāyā vijayaḥ putraścopamantrī tadābhavat | māṇikyāḥ kaustubhamaṇirnyāyaprado’bhavat tadā || 5 || kamalāyāḥ padmanābhaḥ sabhādhyakṣo’bhavat sadā | ramāsuto rāmasākṣī vidyādhikāravānabhūt || 6 || rādhātmajo rāyakeśī kośādhyakṣo’bhavattadā | nārāyaṇyā naradevaścopasainyādhipo’bhavat || 7 || brāhmyāḥ suto brahmarāto rājapurohito’bhavat | bhāgavatyāḥ suto bhargo yajñakāryakaro’bhavat || 8 || ūrjabalādyā ye cānye khaṇḍapālāśca te’bhavan | dvādaśordhvaśatānāṃ tu putrāste vai yathāyatham || 9 || haryuktavyavasāyeṣu yojitāste’bhavam̐stadā | evaṃ rājyaṃ mahānandapradaṃ cābhūttadābhitaḥ || 4.113.1 0|| badari te sutastatra bādarāyaṇasaṃjñakaḥ | jñānado dānadaścāsīd dakṣiṇādipradāyakaḥ || 11 || prajāśca jñānamāsādya videhā iva cābhavan | sākṣātprabhorjñānavatyo yātrārthamaśvasārasam || 1 2|| draṣṭuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ cāyānti yānti vai muhuḥ | aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthaṃ tīrthottamottamottamam || 1 3|| vyajāyata harervāsādākṣaraṃ kṣetramuttamam | āgatya ca mahābhaktāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya tu || 14|| prayānti cākṣaraṃ dhāma paramaṃ divyamadbhutam | kecit samādhimāsādya gatvā cāyānti tat punaḥ || 15|| varṇayanti harerdhāmākṣaraṃ tatparamaṃ padam | śrutvā śrutvāpare lokā modante sāttvatottamāḥ || 1 6|| praśaṃsanti harerdhāmākṣaraṃ tatparamaṃ padam | golokāccāpi vaikuṇṭhāduttamaṃ paramaṃ padam || 17|| yatraitāḥ śrīhareḥ patnyo muktānikātmikāḥ sadā | virājante’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sevikāḥ ||18|| śrutvaivaṃ badrike śaṃsāṃ jijñāsā kṛṣṇayoṣitām | utpannā vīkṣituṃ divyaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ sukhāspadam || 1 9|| śāśvataṃ brahmalokaṃ taṃ divyaṃ svasvavirājitam | athārthanāṃ tu tā nāryaścakruḥ svāmipatiṃ prati ||4.113.20|| śāśvatasyākṣaradhāmno lokituṃ divyasampadaḥ | hariḥ prāha tadā strībhyo na draṣṭavyaṃ taccādhunā ||21|| yasya vai darśane tatra sthātuṃ manaḥ prajāyate | punarāgamane naiva matirbhavati dehinām ||22| maddhāmāgre’nyadhāmāni nistejāṃsi vibhānti vai | īśvarāṇāṃ nilayāstu bhāsante nirayā iva ||23|| akṣarasya mama dhāmno rase pīte tatastviha | pānaṃ niḥsvādeva syānmāyāmayaṃ rasakṣayam ||24|| akṣarasya mama dhāmno miṣṭānne bhakṣite tviha | bhojanaṃ svādahīnaṃ syānmāyāmayaṃ rasakṣayam ||25|| akṣarasya sugandhe tu gṛhīte’tra tu saurabhaḥ | nyakkāra eva durgandharūpaḥ syānmāyikaḥ khalu ||26|| akṣarasyāsvādite tu pāyase kāmadhenuje | māyāmayāni dugdhāni bhavanti nīrasāni vai ||27|| akṣarasya phalapuṣpādyalaṃkāre tu vīkṣite | bhukte satpatra puṣpādi kledavat saṃbhavanti vai ||28|| tatratyasampadāṃ bhoge bhogāścātra purīṣavat | tatratyānāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ vaukṣaṇe’nyat kurūpavat ||29|| kuṣṭhavajjāyate patnyastasmānna vīkṣaṇaṃ varam | idānīṃ vai bhavatīnāṃ pramanye tu virāgakṛt ||4.113.3 0|| iha loke nivāse tad vighnakartṛ bhaviṣyati | āyuṣo’nte divyadhāma draṣṭavyaṃ nādhunā hyataḥ ||3 1 || ityevaṃ bodhitā patnyo nocurnārāyaṇaṃ prati | kintu tīvratamā tāsāṃ didṛkṣā saṃvyajāyata || 32|| kīdṛśyo vai vayaṃ tatra varṇyamānā tu yogibhiḥ | bhavāmaśca haristatra kīdṛg bhavet prasundaraḥ || 33|| yāvad vayaṃ na paśyāmastāvacchāntirna vai matā | didṛkṣāyāśca vai nityaṃ prābalyaṃ saṃpravardhate ||34|| vicāryetthaṃ dine’nyasmin prāhuḥ padmāvatīṃ priyām | bhagini śrīhareḥ patni priye mānyā matāsi vai ||35|| bhavatyā saṃprārthanīyo’smatpatiḥ vallabhaḥ prabhuḥ | dhāmadarśanalābhārthaṃ tvadvacaḥ pālayiṣyati ||36|| śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca sapatnībhistu sarvābhiḥ preritā mādhavīpriyā | prārthayāmāsa taddhāmadarśanārthaṃ svavallabham ||37|| śrīpadmāvatīpriyā provācaparamapriya nātha tvaṃ dayālo nijayoṣitaḥ | darśayākṣaradhāmādya sarvāsāṃ tvaṃ kṛpāṃ kuru ||38|| punastvamatra cānetuṃ samartho’si mahāprabho | ānetavyāḥ priyāḥ sarvāḥ pūrayitvā manorathān ||39|| athānyāḥ koṭyarbudābjānyapi cakrustathārthanām | pradarśaya prabho svāmin dhāmākṣaraṃ paraṃ tava ||4.113.40 || sarvā vayaṃ samicchāmo vīkṣituṃ dhāma cākṣaram | sarvasaṃkalpitaṃ svāmin pūrayituṃ svavāñcchayā ||4 1 || samartho’si punaścātrānetuṃ śakto’si sarvathā | tasmāddhāmākṣaraṃ naijaṃ pradarśaya pate hare ||42|| śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca ityevaṃ badrike sarvā brahmapriyāśca yoṣitaḥ | cakruḥ samprārthanāṃ tīvrāmaśāmyāmanivartinīm ||43 || harirvijñāya bhāvaṃ ca nijecchayotthitaṃ tadā | vistāraṃ cāpi saṃhartuṃ svayaṃ ceyeṣa tanmiṣāt |||44|| tathāstvomiti tāḥ prāha bhagavān sarvabhāvanaḥ | tāśca sarvāḥ prasannāśca jātā vīkṣitumakṣaram ||45|| badrike bhagavān sarvāḥ prāha sajjā bhavantviti | koṭyarbudābjapatnyastāḥ śrutvājñāṃ svāminaḥ śubhām ||46|| saveṣabhūṣāśṛṃgārāḥ sveṣṭopakaraṇānvitāḥ | atyutsāhabharā nāryaḥ sajjāstūrṇaṃ tadābhavan ||47|| amūlyāmbaradhāriṇyaḥ keśaveṣātiśobhanāḥ | svarṇaratnamaṇīndrāḍhyahārabhūṣādyalaṃkṛtāḥ ||48 || tejo’bhivardhitā divyā yuvatyo naikaraṃgikāḥ | sajjā drutaṃ vīkṣituṃ cākṣaraṃ dhāmābhavan mudā ||49|| mithaḥ pramodavacanānyabruvan snehasaṃbhṛtāḥ | ālyo nāthena kṛṣṇena sanāthā vai vayaṃ sadā ||4.113.5 0 || kāntena kṛpayāsmabhyo darśitaṃ kṣitimaṇḍalam | tataḥ svargāni sarvāṇi pātālānyapyaśeṣataḥ ||51 || darśitānīśvarāṇāṃ ca gṛhāṇi vividhānyapi | īśasṛṣṭiḥ samastā no darśitā paramātmanā ||52|| vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāpi goloko dhāmāvyākṛtamityapi | amṛtaṃ śrīpuraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ darśitāni dayālunā ||53 || paraṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ tasya svāminaḥ sarvato’dhikam | drakṣyāmo’dya mahābhāgyavatyaḥ smo’tra hareḥ priyāḥ ||54|| nānyāsāṃ tādṛśaṃ bhāgyaṃ yadasmākaṃ pravartate | mūlaṃ gṛhaṃ svāmino no drakṣyāmaḥ śāśvataṃ padam ||55|| śrutayo’pi na paśyanti na paśyantyapi yoginaḥ | īśvarā naiva paśyanti tad drakṣyāmo hareḥ padam ||56|| yadatra bhagavānasmadagre kiroti varṇanam | bhavatīnāṃ svarūpāṇi santyakṣare pare pade ||57|| divyātidivyadivyāni svarūpāṇi svayoṣitām | tāni rūpāṇi cāsmākaṃ drakṣyāmo’dya kṛpālavāt ||58|| divyaṃ svasvāminaṃ cālyo drakṣyāmastatra saṃsthitam | asaṃkhyamuktajuṣṭaṃ cāsaṃkhyāvatāradhāriṇam ||59|| anantadivyavāmābhiḥ sevitaṃ svāminaṃ harim | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ drakṣyāma uttamam ||4.113.60|| bhokṣyāmo divyabhogām̐śca vatsyāmaśca yathepsitam | raṃsyāmahe mahānandapradena paramātmanā ||6 1 || udyānāni samastāni mandirāṇi śubhāni ca | brahmahṛdān brahmanadīrdrakṣyāmaḥ paramātmanaḥ ||62|| divyasiṃhāsanādīni divyasaṃsadsthalāni ca | divyarāsavihārām̐śca drakṣyāmaḥ kṛpayā hareḥ || 63|| divyasudhāḥ prapāsyāmo vetsyāmo nijasampadaḥ | atsyāmo miṣṭabhojyāni śrīharerbrahmadhāmani ||64|| ityevaṃ vadamānāstā brahmapriyā haripriyāḥ | kṛṣṇapriyāśca tāḥ patnyaḥ sajjāstadābhavan drutam ||65|| badrike’nādikṛṣṇaśrīnārāyaṇaḥ samutsukaḥ | sasmāra muktavṛndāni tadā svākṣaradhāmataḥ ||66|| āyayurdivyarūpāśca divyāsaṃkhyavimānagāḥ | divyavimāninaścāpi divyavimānavāhakāḥ ||67|| āyayustāḥ samānetuṃ sṛṣṭyāvaraṇavarjitāḥ | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetrordhve’mbare te’bhavan sthirāḥ ||68|| puṣpāṇāṃ divyagandhānāṃ cakruḥ kṛṣṇe pravarṣaṇam | vādayāmāsuratyarthaṃ divyavādyāni vai tadā ||69|| devādyā darśanaṃ kartumāyayurdyunivāsinaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścājñāpayāmāsa nijapriyāḥ ||4.113.70 || mātaraṃ pitaraṃ cāpi dāsān dāsīśca vai tadā | ṛṣīn maharṣīn sādhūm̐śca sādhvīśca sevakām̐stathā ||71|| yamalāni sahasthāni svāpatyāni tadāpi ca | āroḍhuṃ ca vimāneṣu divyeṣu kramaśaḥ khalu ||72||| patnyaḥ sarvā niṣeduśca dāsyo dāsāśca bālakāḥ | sevakāḥ pitarau cāpi niṣedusteṣu cāmbare |||73|| satyaśca sādhavaścāpi parīhāraparāyaṇāḥ | niṣeduste vimāneṣu muktaiḥ saha kṣaṇāntare ||74|| śaṃkhanādo’bhavattūrṇaṃ tataḥ sañcārabodhakaḥ | na kaścidvā kācidapi śiṣyate bhūtale yathā ||75|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ kṣaṇaṃ śūnyamivābhavat | vimāneṣu sthitāḥ sarvanārīnarādikoṭayaḥ ||76|| punarvai śaṃkhanādo’bhūt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ha | na kaścicchiṣyate pṛthvyāṃ dhāmajigamiṣārthavān ||77|| atha kṛṣṇaścakārāpi śaṃkhanādaṃ tṛtīyakam | vimānāni tadā śrīmallomaśenānvitāni vai ||78 || asañcaran vyomamārge kṣaṇādadṛśyatāṃ yayuḥ | vibhidya saptanākāni tathāṣṭāvaraṇānyapi ||79|| īśvarāṇāṃ ca dhāmānyullaṃghyākṣarapadaṃ yayuḥ | akṣarasya tadā sīmni śāradīpūrṇimātithau ||4.113.80 || vegavanti vimānāni madhyāhne tvakṣaraṃ yayuḥ | brahmahrade hariḥ sarvān snāpayitvā vimānagān ||81 || narānnārīḥ samastām̐śca kṛtvā tadyogyavigrahān | divyān divyasvarūpām̐śca brahmadehān samastakān |||82|| ajarāmarasadṛśarūpānnijasvarūpiṇaḥ | śāśvatān caikatattvāḍhyān saccidānandavigrahān ||83|| dhāmayogyaiśvaryasiddhiguṇaśaktisamanvitān | kṛtvāvasthāpya ca punarvimāneṣu samastakān ||84|| yayāvagre hariḥ svāmī naikarūpadharaḥ prabhuḥ | sarvānnītvā sahaivāgre paramākṣaradhāmani ||89|| athāpi badrike divyāpāratejo’bhisampadam | ākṣaraṃ vyoma saṃvīkṣya kṣaṇaṃ te stabdhatāṃ gatāḥ ||86|| tadā śrībhagavām̐steṣu mukteṣvāviśya satvaram | śaktīrnijā dhāmayogyāḥ pradadau tebhya ākṣarīḥ ||87|| athāścaryaṃ mahatprāptāḥ kimetat puruṣā vayam | nārītvaṃ vigataṃ sarvamabhavāmo narottamāḥ ||88|| puruṣottamarūpāḥ svasvāmirūpāśca sarvathā | bhavāmo’tra kimetadvai mahāścaryamidaṃ tviha ||89|| brahmapriyādikamuktāḥ papracchuḥ parameśvaram | kimatra bhagavānno’sti puṃstvaṃ tatkāraṇaṃ vada ||4.113.90|| śrutvā tu badrike’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ | prāha svīyāṃgakoṭibhyaḥ śṛṇvantu mama cāṃganāḥ ||91 || māyā yā prakṛtiḥ proktā mama śaktisvarūpiṇī | sā rādhā kṛṣṇapatnī ca mayā svasmāt prakāśitā ||92|| muktarūpātirūpāḍhyā muktagandhātigandhinī | muktasnaigdhyātisnaigdhyāḍhyā cākacikyātiśobhanā ||93|| suvālā peśalā tanvī sarvalāvaṇyaśevadhiḥ | sarvākarṣaṇadharmāḍhyā darśanīyātisundarī ||94|| vicitrāṃ cañcalāṃ tāṃ ca vīkṣya visṛjya māṃ ca vai | muktāḥ snigdhāḥ parabrahma matvā tāṃ matsvarūpiṇīm ||95|| dadhyurānarcuretā ca siṣevire maheśvarīm | navadhā rādhikāyāstu bhaktiṃ cakrurviśeṣataḥ ||96|| vidanto māṃ tadākṛṣṭāstanmayāste’bhavam̐stadā | athāhaṃ matprabhāvaṃ taṃ jñātvā muktavaśaṃkaram ||97|| kṛṣṇaṃ rūpaṃ samāsthāya cāpāsaraṃ tadākṣarāt | golokaṃ vāsayāmāsa sadā tatra sthito’bhavam ||98|| mūlarūpo’kṣare’traivāvasaṃ muktābhisevitaḥ | tadāsaṃkalpayaṃ cātrākṣare dhāmni pare mama ||99|| prakṛtirvāpi rādhā vā māṇikī lakṣmīrityapi | brahmapriyāśca vā kṛṣṇapriyā haripriyāśca vā || 4.113.1 00|| īśānyaśceśvarāṇyo vā muktānyo bhaktayoṣitaḥ | manmūrteḥ śaktayo vāpi cāvatārastriyo’pi vā || 10 1|| āgaccheyurmama dhāmnyakṣare paramadhāmani | tadā nāryo narā bhūtvānādikṛṣṇasvarūpiṇaḥ || 102||| āviśeyuśca tiṣṭheyurvihareyurmamākṣare | nānyatheti niyamo vai mayā śāśvatikaḥ kṛtaḥ || 10 3|| prakāśaṃ naiva nārīṇāṃ rūpamatra pravartate | tadevaṃ bhavatīnāṃ vai matsvarūpāṇi cākṣare || 1 04|| prajātāni tataścātra madātmakāni sarvathā | sālokyasārṣṭisārūpyasāmīpyaikatvavanti ca || 1 05|| athāpi bahuvāraṃ tā rādhādyā māṃ samārthayan | akṣare nijarūpeṇa sevituṃ māṃ yatheṣṭakam || 1 06|| mayā tato’tisevārthaṃ pratipannaṃ vadāmi vaḥ | yathā muktā na paśyeyurnārīrūpaṃ mamākṣare ||1 07|| tathā rahaḥ prasevantāṃ mandire mama sarvadā | yatheṣṭarūpamādhāya patnīrūpāṇi vai tathā || 1 08|| muktā api prasevantāṃ cāprakāśaṃ tathāvidhāḥ | tato’kṣare pare dhāmni cātra prakāśagocarāḥ || 1 09|| sarve narasvarūpā vai vicaranti madātmakāḥ | agocarāstu te sarve madanyāgocarāḥ sadā ||4.113.1 10|| madaṃganāsvarūpā māmupāsate mama priyāḥ | tathā bhavanto muktāśca pumāṃsaḥ santi gocarāḥ || 11 1|| madanyāgocarāḥ kāle bhavatha matpriyā api | ākarṣaṇātivegenopāsanānyatra no yathā || 1 12|| bhavet tathā nigūḍhāśca pratyekamātragocarāḥ | madyoṣito’nvahaṃ bhūtvā prasevantāṃ yathāyatham || 11 3|| sarve muktāḥ prasevante gūḍhakāmāstathāhi mām | yatheṣṭarūpadhartāraḥ sevante māṃ svamandire || 1 14|| līlāmetāṃ mama dhāmni na jānantyapare mithaḥ | evamapārasāmarthyo’nantalīlādigocaraḥ || 1 15|| atisnehena cāśleṣaṃ dadāmi tābhya uttamam | ityuktvā badrike cāgre vimānāni vyanodayat || 1 16|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne śrīharernijapatnyādīnāṃ paramākṣaradhāmāvalokanaprārthanāṃ svīkṛtya sarvābhiḥ saha koṭivimānaiḥ paramākṣaradhāmābhigamanaṃ, tatra muktanarasvarūpeṣu sarvāsāṃ parivartanaṃ, tajjijñāsāyāḥ samādhānaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trayodaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 113 ||
<4.114> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca badrike’tha vimānāni yānti brahmahṛdottaram | vimānasthā brahmamuktāḥ paśyanti kautukānvitāḥ || 1 || brahmarasasamudraṃ vai sahasrayojanāyatam | asaṃkhyayojanadīrghaṃ brahmānandarasapradam || 2 || yadrasāstatra muktānāṃ śāśvatānandadāyakāḥ | tathā vai śāśvatatṛptipradā divyasudhāmayāḥ || 3 || yadraseṣu ca sāmudrā muktā vasantyasaṃkhyakāḥ | divyaśāśvatasammiṣṭhānandabhogātimodinaḥ || 4 || ratnadharāḥ kṛṣṇarūpā divyakuṇḍalaśobhanāḥ | divyamukuṭakaṭakādibhirvibhūṣaṇairyutāḥ || 5 || rasacārā vyomacārāḥ saccidānandavigrahāḥ | yatheṣṭarūpadhartāraḥ sapakṣāḥ sakarāśca vai || 6 || yādasāṃ rūpadhartāro vihaṃgarūpadhāriṇaḥ | praśākhirūpadhartāro ramāśrīrūpadhāriṇaḥ || 7 || anekāścaryasampūrṇaṃ brahmarasasamudrakam | vīkṣya vimānagāścāgre yayuḥ pāraṃ paraṃ śubham || 8 || divyasamastaratnāḍhyaṃ divyatejo’bhivistaram | divyamṛdvīvālukābhirvyāptaṃ sarvarddhiśobhanam || 9 || koṭikoṭyarkabhāvadbhirnaukāgṛhaiśca koṭibhiḥ | koṭivimānaviśrāmairmahāśālaiḥ suśobhitam || 4.114.1 0|| brahmatattvavimānānāṃ koṭigṛhairvirājitam | ākṣarabhūpradeśānāṃ rājamārgābhisaṃgatam || 1 1|| āgamairvigamaiścāpi vimānānāṃ praghoṣitam | dhāmavimānayānānāmavatāratalānvitam || 12|| asaṃkhyamānasayantrairvastuvinimayānvitam | apāramuktaśālābhivyavasāyavirājitam || 13|| āgatānāṃ lekhaśālā koṭikoṭyabhirājitam | avatāraṇacihnāḍhyadhvajadīpābhibhāsuram || 14|| mahādivyadrumodyānamahārājivanānvitam | dvīpopadvīpaśobhāḍhyaṃ mahābandhasamīkṛtam || 15|| divyasopānasetvāḍhyaṃ divyavelābhiśobhanam | divyāvatārasaṃrājattīrahīrakamañjulam || 16|| viśrāmaśālāsaṃvyāptamasaṃkhyadhāmadhāminām | asaṃkhyanagarāvāsābhirāmaṃ te vyalokayan || 17|| etādṛśaṃ paraṃ tīraṃ prāpya śobhāṃ samīkṣya ca | ātivāhikamuktādyairarcitāste vimānagāḥ ||18|| yayuragre mudā vyāptā vanāni vilulokire | divyasugandhipatrāṇi miṣṭapīyūṣavanti ca || 19|| netrāhlādapradāraṇyānyalokayan vimānagāḥ | praphullapuṣpavallyāḍhyadivyapuṣpitapādapān ||4.114.20|| stabakām̐staruṣaṇḍām̐śca divyaśobhān vyalokayan | yatheṣṭarūpasampannān kāyāvivartanaprabhūn |||21 || sarvasiddhimayān brahmāpūrakān drūn vyalokayan | ākṣarīdivyabhūmisthān naikaraṃgāṃgaśobhanān |||22||| sudhāsvāduphalāḍhyām̐śca divyān drumān vyalokayan | kandimūlidalimuktān śākhitantumato drumān ||23|| kadambakān brahmadārūn pāṭalān pārijātakān | sarjatarūn campakām̐ścāśokān śṛṅgārapādapān ||24|| tilakān bakulān lodhrān kiṃśukān khadirāṃstathā | kundān sahasrapadmām̐śca kesarān sthalapadmakān |||25|| candanān badarān jambīrakān sunavaraṃgakān | kṛṣṇaphalān rāmaphalān lakṣmīphalām̐stathāmṛtān ||26||| śvetaphalān likucām̐śca kadalān nālikerakān | kharjurān khārikām̐ścāpi dāḍimān jambvajīrakān ||27|| miṣṭanimbūn tintiḍīśca panasān madhukām̐stathā | āmrānāmrātakān bilvān cirabilvān ratālukān ||28|| drākṣān kājūn badāmām̐śca santarān sukapitthakān | elālavaṃgajāvantrīdrumān tiktādivallikāḥ ||29||| tvaksārānkīcakān plakṣānvaṭān sāṃgānśamīdrumān | śiśapān nāgavallīśca kalpavallīrjovantikāḥ ||4.114.30|| mālatīścitraparṇāśca kamalāni vyalokayan | kalpadrumānnāspatikān cikukān miṣṭakardamān || 3 1|| sūryamukhān candradalān brahmapatrān ramārasān | sudhādhārānmadhuvrātān kāmapūrān vyalokayan || 32|| payobhṛtān miṣṭakuṃbhān śārkarān samalokayan | miṣṭamohanakān śaityadrumān karpūrakānapi ||33||| ratisvādān modakaṇān āmodadrūn vyalokayan | pramauktikān ratnagucchān svarṇapuṣpān hiraṇmayān ||34|| kānakān rājatān vṛkṣān dārpaṇadrūn vyalokayan | svarṇahārān gandhamālān bhūṣāphalān vyalokayan || 35|| cidambarān satpraṇādān cidānandadrumām̐stathā | dadhikrāvṇān munimodān śrīdravānapyalokayan ||36|| siddhapādānmanovarṣān cintāvallīrvyalokayan | akṣayyapatrakān cājyalatāḥ pradīpapādapān || 37|| takrapuṭān maṇiśākhān svarṇamūlān vyalokayan | kauṃkumān śītacūrṇāṃśca kajjalikān vyalokayan ||38|| ālaktakān piṃgarasān mahīdīnān mahākṣatān | nivārān pūgakān jātiphalān mallikavallikāḥ ||39|| sadāpuṣpā nityaphalā brahmaśimbīrvyalokayan | śrīphalān śrīdrumakām̐ścāmalakān jalapadmakān ||4.114.40 || phalajanān trimūrūm̐śca pravālān vālaśiṃgrakān | keśadhārān mṛdulehyān gandhasārān suśālmalān ||41 || kārpāsakān kuśeyakān kalamān devavigrahān | caitanyaphalinaścāpi kamalāni vyalokayan ||42|| evaṃvidhānyasaṃkhyāni mahāraṇyāni cākṣare | divyamuktasvarūpāṇi kāmarūpāṇi sarvathā ||43||| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārthaṃ saṃsthitāni vai | kāmagāni samastāni vanāni samalokayan ||44|| tejaḥpatrāṇi nālāni mahodyānāni cābhitaḥ | ārāmām̐śca taḍāgām̐śca saritaścāpyalokayan ||45|| vanodyānamayīṃ bhūmiṃ daśasāhasrayojanām | āyatāṃ parito vyāptāṃ cākṣarīṃ samalokayan ||46|| yāsu muktā anantā vai brahmarūpā vasantyapi | araṇyāni sakalāni muktāśritāni vīkṣya ca ||47|| āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpurmuktā brahmapriyādayaḥ | taiḥ kṛtā vividhāḥ pūjāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ||48|| vimāne cāmbare gatvā badrike phalacandanaiḥ | upadābhirdivyadānaistoṣitaḥ svapatirhariḥ ||49|| athollaṃghyāraṇyabhūmiṃ parvatānāgatān bahūn | vyalokayan divyarūpān koṭisūryasamaprabhān ||4.114.50|| araṇyānīyutān dīrghagahvarān muktasevitān | sauvarṇai rājataiḥ śṛṃgai ratnaśṛṃgaiḥ suśobhitān ||51|| maṇibhirvividhairdivyaiḥ saṃbhṛtān hīrakojjvalān | vajraśṛṃgaistathā muktāśikharairatiśobhitān ||52|| padmarāgādripaṃktidhrairanvitān dīrghasetubhiḥ | mārakataiśca śikharairindranīlatalānvitaiḥ ||53|| vaidūryeranvitān puṣparāgaśṛṃgairvirājitān | karketanānāṃ śikharairbhīṣmakānāṃ kaṭibhramaiḥ ||54|| pulakānāṃ madhyabhāgai rudhirabhvā praśobhitān | sphaṭikaśṛṃgahāraiśca vidrumordhvasthalairyutān ||55|| cintāmaṇiyutānadrīn kaustubhādisamanvitān | māṇikyavarṇaiḥ śikharaiḥ suśobhitānalokayan ||56|| siddhamuktanivāsāḍhyān gāndharvamuktaśobhitān | vidvanmuktakṛtāvāsān tāpasānāṃ gṛhānvitān ||57|| yogimuktālayayutān brahmayuktādhivāsitān | kalāmuktāśramayutān sādhumuktādyadhiṣṭhitān ||58|| kamaṭhairhotribhirmuktaiḥ kṛtāvasathamandirān | bhaktidharaistathā muktaiḥ sthale sthale kṛtālayān |||59|| adhityakāsu vai devamuktairudyānavāsibhiḥ | sthāpitaśrīmahāgrāmānadrīn divyānalokayan ||4.114.60 || nikuṃjairmuktakoṭīnāṃ nirjharairdivyavāribhiḥ | āpagābhiśca divyābhirbrāhmībhirupaśobhitān ||61|| saccidānandasalilairamṛtaiḥ saṃbhṛtaiḥ śubhaiḥ | sarovarairmahāramyaiḥ śobhitādrīnalokayan ||62|| kamalaiḥ padmanivahaiḥ kalhāraiḥ kumudaiḥ śubhaiḥ | puṇḍarīkairaravindairnalinīkusumairyutān ||63|| taṭān sugandhipuṣpāṇāṃ parāgāḍhyānalokayan | divyān haṃsān sārasām̐śca garuḍānanalān khagān ||64|| śukamenāmayūrām̐śca divyamuktānalokayan | bhāradvājān cātakām̐śca kāmarūpadharān bahūn ||65|| muktarūpān divyapakṣigaṇān sarvānalokayan | gajānsiṃhān mṛgān divyān divyāśvān samalokayan||66|| dhenūścamarīrmahiṣīrmṛgān śārdūlakānapi | divyān sattvān muktarūpān kāmarūpānalokayan ||67|| śākhāmṛgān divyarūpān hanūyutān plavaṃgamān | sapakṣām̐śca parīgaṇān parvateṣu vyalokayan ||68|| daśasāhasrabhūbhāgāyatān vīkṣya girīśvarān | badrike koṭiśṛṃgākhyaṃ mahāśailamalokayan ||69|| svarṇamātrasvarūpaṃ ca svarṇamātrotthavastukam | asaṃkhyasūryabhāvantaṃ hiraṇyādrimalokayan ||4.114.70|| asaṃkhyayojanadīrghaṃ lakṣayojanakāyatam | saccidānandatattvāḍhyaṃ brahmatattvamayaṃ girim ||71 || asaṃkhyasuramuktānāṃ nagarairadhivāsitam | anekāścaryasaṃyuktamanekajyotiranvitam ||72||| divyāmṛtameghakoṭikoṭyabbhraghanasaṃśritam | asaṃkhyāmṛtasaridācchannanimnapraṇālikam |||73|| divyadīpauṣadhivrātairalaṃkṛtaṃ mahāgirim | suśobhitaṃ pravīkṣyaivopatyakāsu vyalokayan ||74|| lakṣayojanabhūbhāgāyatāsu haritāsu vai | anekamuktasaṃghān saṃsthitān nagarasaṃśritān ||75|| nadīnadataṭākādyairyuktānāvasathām̐stathā | vāṭyudyānamahārāmān vyalokayan vimānagāḥ ||76|| sauvarṇavanamadhye cāpaśyan nṛtyasthalīṃ prabhoḥ | divyakuṃjanikuṃjāḍhyāṃ sarvodbhijjātimuktakaiḥ ||77|| uṣitvā śobhitāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya saukhyadām | yatra vai brahmasaraso brahmamuktānikāḥ śubhāḥ ||78|| brahmapumāṃsa evaite nṛtyanti kṛṣṇatuṣṭaye | vartulāṃ divyasaudhāḍhyāṃ daśasāhasrayojanām ||79|| divyasabhāgṛhagarbhāṃ sarvabhogasamanvitām | koṭikoṭyarkabhāvyāptaśikharāṃ cābhitaḥ śubhām ||4.114.80|| anantarūpadhāriśrīkāntamuktaiḥ sadoṣitām | divyagopuradurgādyairbahukhaṇḍairvibhājitām ||81 || koṭivimānikāyuktāṃ koṭibhūṣālayānvitām | koṭiśṛṃgāraśālāḍhyāṃ koṭivādyādimandirām ||82|| koṭyupakaraṇaiḥ śreṣṭhaiḥ saṃbhṛtaraṃgamaṇḍapām | koṭisiṃhāsanasthānāṃ nṛtyamaṇḍalikāṃ sthalīm ||8 3|| vilokyāgre vimānasthā yayuḥ śrīrāsamaṇḍalam | daśalakṣayojanātmaviśālaṃ pārameśvaram ||84|| koṭistambhakṛtādhāravṛttamaṇḍapaśobhitam | sarvarāsopakaraṇaidivyaiḥ śreṣṭhaiḥ samanvitam ||85|| koṭimuktā nivasanti haryājñayā tu yatra vai | vimānāni suvarṇādidivyāni yatra santi ca ||86|| asaṃkhyakalaśairyuktaścopamaṇḍapaśobhitaḥ | mahāmaṇḍapa evāsau rājate’bjārkavat sadā ||87|| saccidānandasandohāḥ saccidānandabhūstarāḥ | saccidānandavallabhyo rājante yatra maṇḍape ||88|| kalpalatāḥ kalpavṛkṣāḥ kalpatṛṇāni yatra ca | kalpapātrāṇi saṃkalpastabakā yatra santi ca ||89|| cintāmaṇayaḥ śreṣṭhāścākṣayapātrāṇi yatra ca | sarvakāmadughāḥ sthalyo bṛsyaḥ siddharasānvitāḥ ||4.114.90|| sarvavidhānyamṛtāni sarvarasāśca śāśvatāḥ | mahānandataravaśca vartante mānasodbhavāḥ ||9 1 || prakāśā brahmatattvotthā vāyavo divyakhotthitāḥ | sukhasparśāḥ sukhavīkṣā yatra bhavanti sadguṇāḥ ||92|| sarvendriyamahābhogā bhavanti rāsamaṇḍale | akalpyāścāpyagamyāścātarkyāścāpi tu mānasāḥ ||93|| divyabrahmamayā brahmotthitāḥ kṛṣṇecchayā śubhāḥ | śāśvatānandapūrāśca puṣṭidāḥ saṃbhavanti hi ||94|| sukhākarṣaṇadāḥ sarve bhogyā bhogā hi maṇḍape | samāste paritaḥ santi divyāste rāsamaṇḍale ||95 || yatheṣṭarūpadhartāro vasanti muktasādhavaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇarūpasvarūpābhinnavigrahāḥ ||9 6|| bālakṛṣṇasthasāmarthyaśaktisarvasvayojitāḥ | parameśamahāsiddhisamāḍhyātmāna ityapi ||97|| janmajayantikādau ca rāsaramaṇakāriṇaḥ | muktānikāsaṃkhyabhaktānikāmaṇḍalasaṃgatāḥ ||98|| ramante te gītagānairnartanaiḥ kūrdanaistathā | tālikābhiḥ pādasaṃkramaṇairdehavivartanaiḥ ||9 9 || melanairbhāvagarbhaiścāśleṣairvakṣobhiyojanaiḥ | arpaṇaiḥ sarvakāmānāṃ pūraṇaiḥ paramātmanā || 4.114.10 0|| tṛpyanti satataṃ muktā muktānikāsvarūpiṇaḥ | modante śrīhariṃ prāpya kāntaṃ kāmaprapūrkam || 101 || etādṛśaṃ sukhakośa vīkṣya tadrāsamaṇḍalam | tanmuktaiḥ kṛtapūjāśca yayuragre vimānagāḥ || 1 02|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne paramākṣarabrahmadhāmni brahmapriyāharipriyādibhirbrahmahradottarasthabrahmarasasamudratīrāvatāraḥ kṛtaḥ, mahāvanaparvatahiraṇyakoṭiśṛṃgādrivanopatyakodyānanṛtyasthalīrāsamaṇḍalāni cāvalokitānītyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturdaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 114 ||
<4.115> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca rāsamaṇḍalataścordhvaṃ harervihāramaṇḍalam | lakṣayojanavistāraṃ vyalokayan vimānagāḥ || 1 || yatra paramamuktānāṃ nivāsā mandirāṇi ca | prāsādā divyakalaśāḥ santi kṛṣṇālayā yathā || 2 || muktā muktānikā bhūtvā sevante kāntamacyutam | vihāro yatra saudheṣu bhavanti brahmayoṣitām || 3 || koṭikoṭyarbudapatnyo muktānikā hariṃ patim | vihāramaṇḍale naijasaudheṣu divyavigrahāḥ || 4 || sevante paramātmānaṃ sukhaśayyāsvaharniśam | śṛṃgārā yatra vartante navā divyāśca śāśvatāḥ || 5 || pānabhojanabhogāśca vartante’mṛtasaṃbhṛtāḥ | yatra kāmadughā gāvo vidyante mānaseṣṭadāḥ || 6 || yatra śayyāḥ komalāśca nityasugandhisaṃbhṛtāḥ | mānaseṣṭapradāḥ sarvāḥ sukhasparśāścidātmakāḥ || 7 || divyarūpasparśagandhaśabdarasaratipradāḥ | kalpatāmbūlavallyādipatracarvaṇagandhikāḥ || 8 || sugandhyuttarasurabhikesarādivirājitāḥ | kāmapūrāstathā sarvopakaraṇottamāñcitāḥ || 9 || snānaśālāstāpaśālā rasaśālāśca yatra vai | bhojyaśālā rahaḥśālāḥ svāpaśālāśca yatra vai || 4.115.10 || dravaśālā nāṭyaśālā dṛśyaśālāśca yatra vai | gītaśālā nṛtyaśālā veṣaśālāśca yatra vai | | 11 || sarvaśṛṃgāraśālāśca kāmaśālāśca yatra vai | bhogaśālāścāṃgaprasādhanaśālāśca yatra vai || 1 2|| rekhāśālāstathā kāntāśleṣaśālā bhavanti ca | prāsādā kalaśairyuktā divyā svarṇavinirmitāḥ || 13 || śobhante koṭiśo yatra vihāramaṇḍalo’bhitaḥ | nagarāṇi vicitrāṇi vicitramandirāṇi ca || 14| | vartante muktakoṭīnāṃ nivāsā yatra cābhitaḥ | vasatayaḥ sevakānāṃ sevikānāṃ bhavantyapi | | 15 || dāsānāṃ cāpi dāsīnāṃ puṃrūpāṇāṃ bhavantyapi | suhṛdāṃ mitravargāṇāṃ muktānāṃ sugṛhāṇi ca || 16 || bhavanti śrīhareḥ saudhabhābhabhāvanti tatra ha | evaṃ vihārimuktānāṃ vīkṣya vihāramaṇḍalam || 17|| vimānagā yayuragre rāṣṭrapradeśabhūmiṣu | haridvarṇātirasabhṛnmiṣṭakaṇiśavanti vai || 18 || yāsu sasyāni sarvāṇi rājante ṛddhimanti ca | divyabrahmamayānyevākṣataśālibhidhāni ca || 1 9|| godhūmayavanivāracaṇakādīni santi vai | divyabrahmasvarūpāṇi kāmarūpāṇi tāni vai ||4.115.20|| muktarūpāṇi sasyāni dhāmināṃ sukhadāni hi | ikṣukṣetrāṇi paritaḥ śākakṣetrāḍhyavāṭikāḥ || 21| rājante dīrghikāvāpīkūpataḍāgavanti ca | sarito divyajaladā vahanti citsvarūpikāḥ |||22|| sīmabhūmipradeśāśca vidyante phalipādapāḥ | anekapuṣpivṛkṣāṇāṃ vṛtibhirvartulīkṛtāḥ ||23|| rakṣitāḥ sarvato digbhyo mahāsasyasamṛddhayaḥ | mudgamāṣai rājamāṣaiḥ kaṅgūbhiḥ śobhitāḥ śubhāḥ ||24|||| rājikākesarairyuktā dugdhikābṛhatīyutāḥ | anekānnerasaṃkhyaiśca bhājīśākaiḥ samanvitāḥ |||25|| kandapuṣpadalādyaiśca samṛddhāḥ śobhanā hyati | karṣukākhyapramuktānāṃ nagarāṇi ca tatra vai ||26|| santi grāmāśca kheṭāśca kharvaṭā gopakarmaṇām | purāṇi divyayogāni divyavyāpāravantyapi ||27|| bhavanti divyasauvarṇavarṇāni projjvalāni ca | yatra muktā mahāmuktā vasanti brahmarūpiṇaḥ ||28||| tathā paramamuktāśca vasanti brahmayoginaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakhyaparāyaṇāḥ |||29|| yeṣāṃ karmakalāpā vai divyāḥ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ | bhavanti sarvathā badri tām̐ste vyalokayan mudā ||4.115.3 0|| ālayānāśramānāvasathān saudhān kuṭīstathā | gṛhāṇi koṭarān mandirāṇi kuṃjān nikuṃjakān ||31 || saudhān śālā nivāsām̐śca bhavanāni ca garbhakān | vidyālayān kalāśālā gośālā gopurān śubhān || 32|| durgān bhittistambhaśṛṃgāṇyapi vṛttasumaṇḍapān | upagṛhāṇi cārāmān chatrāṇi tūpakām̐stathā || 33|| sabhāgṛhāṇi ca nyāyanṛtyagāndharvabhūmikāḥ | mallanāṭyendraramaṇān mahānasāni yānyapi ||34|| makhālayān rājasaudhānāpaṇān vyomakoṣṭhakān | trivarān dvāradeśām̐śca vīkṣya sauvarṇaśobhanān ||35|| samākāraracanām̐śca svarṇakalaśarājitān | naisargikaprakāśām̐śca sarvarddhipradabhittikān || 36|| kalpakuṃbhīkalpacullīkalpapātravirājitān | akṣayyeṣṭapradān vīkṣya bhojyapānarddhisaṃbhṛtān ||37|| sarvopakaraṇairyuktān divyaśāśvatavigrahān | saccidānandarūpām̐śca sarvaraṃgarddhiśobhanān || 38|| dhvajaiḥ patākikābhiśca vāvātādibhiranvitān | divyamuktagaṇairyuktān vīkṣya prāpya samarhaṇām ||39|| agre vimānagā deśānullaṃghyārbudayojanān | muktavasatīn saṃvīkṣya yayuḥ surāṣṭramuttamam ||4.115.40|| yatra mārgā dīrghatamā brahmasamudrayoginaḥ | vanaparvatavasatīnabhivyāpya ca maṇḍapān ||41|| maṇḍalāni puragrāmān samāyānti surāṣṭrakam | chāyāvṛkṣaiḥ phalivṛkṣairyutāḥ panthāna uttamāḥ |||42|| sarvayātrikasukhadāḥ subhagā ramaṇīyakāḥ | pravāsināṃ sarvabhogyapradāḥ saccidrasapradāḥ ||43|| vidyante te mṛdusparśā gatiśramavivarjitāḥ | śītoṣṇānukūlasarvatattvānandapradāḥ śubhāḥ ||44|| pārśvanadīnadavārisudhāvalīdruśobhitāḥ | tarusūccaphalavālumṛdupārśvasuśobhitāḥ ||45|| puṣpīvṛkṣakṛtarājikadambarājirājitāḥ | latāpratānitachatracchāyādrumasupārśvakāḥ ||46|| śarkarāphalavallīnāṃ kṛtrimanadapārśvakāḥ | cañcaddivyamahāmūlyamaṇigarbhātiśobhanāḥ ||47|| kūṣmāṇḍavallikāvyāptakuṭīyukkṣetramadhyagāḥ | tryamṛtastambakṣetrāntaḥpraviṣṭadīrghayāyinaḥ ||48|| madhusrāvimahāvṛkṣaśākhārasābhiṣekinaḥ | brahmacandanavṛkṣāṇāṃ rasavṛṣṭyā sugandhitāḥ ||49|| devapuṣpavikīraiścāñcitāḥ śayyābhasaukhyadāḥ | muktamuktānikāvṛndapādapadmātipāvanāḥ ||4.115.5 0|| naikadhātupracūrṇotthalaharīvaliśobhitāḥ | pārśvaviśrāntivedībhirmanoharāśrayapradāḥ ||51|| nadīnadamahāsetusaṃkalanādvitīyakāḥ | muktisaukhyapradā mārgāstṛptidā nityasaukhyadāḥ ||52|| madhyakṣetrīyasṛtibhiḥ saṃgatāścatvarānvitāḥ | tānapratānamārgaiśca militā deśadarśakāḥ ||53|| sudhāparvātmakaśālāmṛtadānapramodadāḥ | brahmarāṣṭrāviddhamadhyā parabrahmagṛhāntagāḥ ||54|| anādimuktaviharāḥ śāśvatānandasaṃbhṛtāḥ | apunarāvartanāśca gatānāṃ muktisaṃginām ||55|| māṃgalikarasadravyaiḥ siktāḥ śreyorasādibhiḥ | kalyāṇapadavīyuktā viśālā bahuvistarāḥ ||56|| etādṛśānmokṣamārgān vīkṣyāścaryagatāstu te | agre vimānagā deśānasaṃkhyayojanāyatān ||57|| vīkṣya tulyarddhisampadbhiḥ śobhanān yayurutsukāḥ | apaśyan dūrataste cākṣaradhāmapuraṃ mahat |||58||| parārdhayojanadīrghadivyacidbhūvirājitam | asaṃkhyākṣaramuktānāmāvāsamandirātmakam ||59|| sarvasṛṣṭimahātejo’dhikatejo’mbarānvitam | sarvasṛṣṭamahānandādhikānandāmbarānvitam ||4.115.60|| sarvasaurabhavāsaṃ ca sarvarūpābhirūpavat | sarvarasādhimiṣṭaṃ ca sarvamiṣṭasvarānvitam ||61 || sarvalāvaṇyayuktaṃ ca sarvamādhuryasaṃbhṛtam | asaṃkhyānādimuktānāṃ mahāmandiraśobhanam ||62|| koṭikoṭyabjasūryāṇāṃ tejovatkalaśānvitāḥ | divyaśṛṃgayutā yatra śobhante muktasaṃśrayāḥ ||63|| kāmarūpadharānādimuktavṛndā vasanti ca | divyaratnahīrakāṇāṃ maṇīnāṃ mandireṣu ha ||64|| asaṃkhyapāraṃ taddhāma sarvadhāmottamottamam | asaṃkhyadivyasaṃyānavimānairupaśobhitam ||65|| asaṃkhyanagarairgrāmaiḥ pattanaiḥ kheṭakharvaṭaiḥ | udyānārāmavāṭībhiḥ kṣetrabhūvistarairyutam ||66|| saccidānandatattvaistairbrahmapurairalaṃkṛtam | sarvagopuradurgādyairvanaparvatarājibhiḥ ||67||| ākṣaraiśca nadīsarovarairnadaiḥ suśobhitam | kaustubhānāṃ dīrghaśṛṃgaiḥ parvatairatiśobhanam ||68|| asaṃkhyadivyadugdhānāṃ kulyābhirabhito yutam | sudhāpīyūṣabhojyānāṃ kulyābhirabhirāmakam ||69|| yānavāhanaśayyānāmupaskāraiḥ samṛddhimat | kāmarūpadharamuktamuktānikākṛtāśrayam ||4.115.70|| sarvasamānarūpaiśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśritaiḥ | kṛtāvāsamanantaṃ cāpāramasīmakaṃ mahat ||71 || sarvasasyarddhisaṃyuktaṃ phalānnakaṇasiddhimat | sarvadivyasusauvarṇabhūmigṛhādipattanam ||92|| asaṃkhyastambhasaṃśobhanmahāsaudhālisatprabham | nisargadhāmatattvotthasarvabhogyasuhetukam ||73|| yasya pāro na vai cāsti gantṝṇāṃ vyomacāriṇām | divyacakṣuṣmatāṃ kṛṣṇadṛṣṭyā manāk sugocaram ||74|| yatra muktā asaṃkhyātā rājādhirājarūpiṇaḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇatulyā vṛndātmāno bhajanti tam ||75|| badrike kecana muktāḥ sabhātmānaśca koṭiśaḥ | dhyāyanti paramātmānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ||76|| anye’bjasaṃkhyakā muktāḥ kathāṃ śṛṇvanti śārṅgiṇaḥ | apare padmasaṃkhyāśca stuvanti svāminaṃ harim ||77|| tathānye svāmino vādyaiḥ kīrtanaṃ vidadhatyapi | arcayanti śatavastubhiścetare hariṃ patim ||78|| tathānye dāsyamevāpi kurvanti paramātmanaḥ | ātmanivedanaṃ muktānikāḥ kurvanti satpatau ||79|| ramante śrīhareragre sevante tanmano’nugāḥ | yajñe tathā hariṃ muktā ārādhayanti tanmayāḥ ||4.115.80|| bhojayanti snāpayanti saṃvāhayanti taṃ harim | nīrājayanti taṃ nāthaṃ prasādayanti cārpaṇaiḥ ||8 1 || rañjayanti gandhīyanti śṛṅgārayanti mādhavam | ānandayanti bahudhā pāyayanti sudhāmṛtam ||82|| dhūpayanti dīpayanti yathā tadrūpadhāriṇaḥ | evaṃ vividharūpām̐śca parārdhādhikamuktakān ||83|| vimānagā vilokyaivāścaryaṃ prāpuḥ paraṃ tadā | sevābhaktiprakārām̐śca vīśya nirmānatāṃ gatāḥ ||84|| akṣaraḥ puruṣaḥ so’pi nijālaye pareśvaram | anantamuktasahitaḥ sevate svāminaṃ harim ||85|| sarvadehakṛtābhiśca kvacinnārī kvacinnaraḥ | bhūtvā bhūtvā kriyābhiśca sevate svāminaṃ nijam ||86|| akṣarasya mahāsaudhe koṭyarbudāditoraṇe | koṭyarbudastambhatolaye koṭyarbudādiśṛṃgake ||87|| asaṃkhyabhogyavastvāḍhye’saṃkhyadāsīsamanvite | asaṃkhyamuktamuktānīsevite brahmarūpiṇi ||88|| brahmaholasaṃjñe sve sevate svapatiṃ harim | vīkṣyedaṃ sevanaṃ badri brahmapriyāstu sarvathā ||89|| stabdhā nirgarvabhāvaṃ ca prāptāḥ svasvāminaṃ prati | evaṃvidhaṃ tu taddhāmākṣaraṃ tadvasatīn śubhān ||4.115.90|| bhuktāvasatīn sevāṃ ca vīkṣyākṣaragṛhaṃ tathā | akṣaraṃ sevakaṃ vīkṣya mahānandaṃ pralebhire ||9 1|| akṣarasya gṛhe badri viśāle’saṃkhyayojane | īśvarāṇāṃ samastānāṃ muktānāṃ divyavarmmaṇām ||92|| brahmāṇḍānāṃ ca sarveṣāmuddhayaḥ saukṣmyataḥ sthitāḥ | akṣare vadrike sarvametajjagaccarācaram ||93|| vidyate saṃsthitaṃ badri sarvasṛṣṭisvarūpakam | yadakṣaragṛhe cāste tad brahmāṇḍeṣu vartate ||94|| yadakṣaragṛhe nāsti sṛṣṭiṣu tanna vidyate | ekaikasmin maṇau divye vasanti bhinnasṛṣṭayaḥ || 95|| etādṛśā hi maṇayaḥ santyakṣaragṛhe śubhāḥ | māyādhāmāni sarvāṇi vidyante caikake maṇau ||96 || golokādyā mahābhaumā vidyante caikake maṇau | vaikuṇṭhādyā ālayāśca vidyante caikake maṇau || 97 || vāsudevādayo vyūhāḥ sarvarddhisahitā maṇau | vartante caikake kartuṃ varṇanaṃ naiva śakyate || 98 || etādṛśaṃ brahmapadaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ suśobhanam | asaṃkhyarddhibhṛtaṃ vīkṣya labdhvā pūjāṃ ca tatkṛtām || 99 || avatārālayān divyān mandirāṇyuttamāni ca | asaṃkhyān muktarūpām̐śca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃśajān || 4.115.100 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇarūpān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakān | asaṃkhyasṛṣṭisaṃjātān tadakṣare sadā sthitān || 101 || brahmaśīlaparān sarvāvatārān śrīprabhuprabhān | asaṃkhyaiśvaryasampannān vīkṣya dhāmottarasthitān || 10 2|| ayaṃ svāmī hyayaṃ svāmī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hyayam | ityevaṃ pratipannāste vimānagāḥ kṣaṇaṃ tadā || 103 || asaṃkhyakṛṣṇarūpāṇi prabhūn kṛṣṇānasaṃkhyakān | muktātmakān vilokyaiva vilokya divyacakṣuṣā || 1 04|| sārūpyabhāvamāpannān muktān vijñāya tādṛśān | pratipattiṃ muktarūpāṃ prāpyānandaṃ pralebhire || 1 05|| āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptā adṛṣṭadarśanāt khalu | praśaśaṃsurvimānasthā brahmapriyādayo bhṛśam || 106 || aho bhāgyaṃ hareryogād yadadṛśyādidarśanam | labhāmahe kṛpāleśāt svāmī naḥ paramo yataḥ || 1 07|| badrike cāvatārādyaiḥ kṛtāṃ labdhvā samarhaṇām | prabhuḥ kṛṣṇo hariścāgre’pāsarat mādhavīpatiḥ || 108 || jayanādaistoṣaśabdairakṣatādisuvardhanaiḥ | puṣpāñjalipradānaiścāśīrbhiḥ sahāgra udyayuḥ || 10 9|| vimānāni samastāni divyāmbarābhiyoginām | muktānāṃ śrīhareḥ patyurmandiraṃ paramaṃ prati || 4.115.110 || tadgatyā tadvāyuyogāt paradhāmaprabhāṃśakāt | mahānandakṛtāṃ mūrchāṃ sukhāḍhyāṃ prāpureva te || 111 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne vimānagā harervihāramaṇḍalaṃ rāṣṭrapradeśān surāṣṭramaṇḍalam akṣaradhāmapuram anādimuktapurāṇi divyabhaktikalāpān akṣarabrahmamaholam asaṃkhyāvatāramaholāni vīkṣya paramaṃ dhāma prati cāpāsarannityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 115 ||
<4.116> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi hṛdayaṃ dravate mama | varṇayato harerdhāma pratyakṣaṃ paśyato yathā || 1 || avarṇyānandasandohān prabhuñjāmi pravarṇanāt | ananyamānasī bhūtvā hṛdyaṃ gadyaṃ nibodha me || 2 || sahasraśo gamyamānā vimānagāścidambare | divyadṛṣṭyā mahātejaḥpuñjādriṃ padmayojanam || 3 || brahmatejo’dhikakharvaguṇitejobhivardhitam | vyalokayan dūrataste śatābjayojanocchrayam || 4 || akṣarabrahmaṇastejorāśiryasyāṇumātrake | pradeśe līnatāṃ yāti tādṛk tejo vyalokayan || 5 || akṣarabrahmadhāmnastaddhāma śreṣṭhaṃ paraṃ padam | akṣarāt kharṇaguṇitaprabhāvadaikaromakam || 6 || parabrahmānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya dhāma tat | śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmyakṣareśasya parātmanaḥ || 7 || mūrtijanyaṃ hi tattejaḥ śāśvataṃ caikatānakam | samaikarasaghanakaṃ saccidānandanāmakam || 8 || parabrahmalokarūpaṃ sarvato’nantabhāpradam | yatprakāśaikakiraṇenākṣaraṃ pūrṇatejasā || 9 || pūryate śiṣyate naiva riktaṃ tat tādṛśaṃ dhanam | yattejodarśanaṃ dūrācchītamiṣṭa sudhādanam || 4.116.10 || samarpayati draṣṭṝṇāṃ sarvākarṣaṇatarpaṇam | sarvānandapradaṃ sarvāmṛtavarṣi pramodadam || 11 || anantatṛptidaṃ tejo dūrād vyalokayan priyāḥ | yathā yathā vimānāni cābhiyānti tathā tathā || 1 2|| mugdhāstejo’bhibhūtāntarnetrānuddhāṭanakriyāḥ | vimānagā abhavam̐śca tadā pihitapakṣmakāḥ || 13 || atha śrībhagavān yāvat priyāsvāviśya netradaḥ | netratejomahāśaktiprado’bhavad vimāniṣu || 14|| dāsā dāsyaḥ priyā muktānikā muktāśca te tataḥ | kṛṣṇanetraiḥ kṛṣṇatejo’bhavan śaktā vilokitum || 15|| evaṃ rūpaṃ rasaṃ sparśaṃ śabdaṃ taddhāmagaṃ param | ādattuṃ tvasamarthānāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ śaktīrnijāṃ dadau || 1 6|| kampitānāṃ mahādhairyaṃ dadāvāviśya varṣmasu | viśīrṇānāṃ balaṃ vīryaṃ dadau naijaṃ praviśya ca || 17|| cidambaramahāveṣān dadau dārḍhyabalānvitān | tadā vimāninaḥ svāsthyamāpannā vīkṣituṃ prabhām || 18 || atha śrībhagavān tebhyaḥ parabrahmamahānade | snāpayāmāsa sahasā cidākāśagate pare || 19 || tenāptasarvasāmarthyāḥ parabrahmasvarūpiṇaḥ | parabrahmasamadehāḥ parabrahmātmaśaktikāḥ || 4.116.20 || vimānagāḥ samastāstaddhāmno yogyāstadābhavan | vivṛddhaśaktikā divyākṣarordhvadivyavigrahāḥ ||2 1 || atha svāmipratāpena vimānāni tadantike | nade samlāvitānyeva balavanti tato’bhavan || 22|| āyayurdivyatattvāni paradhāmagamāni vai | parabrahmamahādhāmāntikaṃ niratiśāyini || 23|| mahācidghanatejobhāsīmāntastaṭakāmbare | yāvattāvatparadhāmānandaṃ prāpya vimāninaḥ ||24|| visasmaruḥ sukhaṃ sarvamakṣarasya yadarjitam | paradhāmno’ṇḍabhāge tatsukhaṃ sarvaṃ vyalīyata ||25|| badrike śrīharerdhāmnaḥ sukhāgre gaṇanā tu kā | asaṃkhyākṣaradhāmnaḥ vai muktānāṃ gaṇanā kutaḥ ||26|| cidghane parame dhāmni līnā ivābhavan hi te | bahiṣṭo nahi dṛśyante meghachannā yathā grahāḥ ||27|| mahātejo’ntaḥpraviṣṭā mitho paśyanti garbhagāḥ | antaḥsthāśca bahirnaiva paśyanti tejasādhikāḥ || 28|| paradhāmagatānāmakṣaraṃ tama ivābhavat | śūnyamivābhavat sarvaṃ śūnyaṃ syād gocaraṃ katham || 29|| chāyeva cābhavat sarvamakṣaraṃ paramātmanaḥ | etādṛśaṃ paraṃ tejaḥ paraṃ dhāma vyalokayan || 4.116.30 || tejomayaṃ mahādurgaṃ sauvarṇaṃ cāpyalokayan | ucchritaṃ ca viśālaṃ cobhayathā lakṣayojanam || 31 || dairghye’sya gaṇanā nāsti sā saṃkhyā vidyate nahi | anantāpāradairghyaṃ vai tasya durgasya vidyate || 32|| gopurā lakṣaśastatra koṭiśaśca prakoṣṭhikāḥ | prastarā lakṣaśastatra kakṣāśca lakṣaśastathā ||33|| lakṣaśaścāpi tanmadhye prāsādāḥ setumāśritāḥ | koṭiśo’nādimuktānāṃ nivāsāḥ santi garbhagāḥ ||34|| asaṃkhyamaṇḍapāstatrāsaṃkhyamuktānikālayāḥ | asaṃkhyasaudhaprāsādā yatra vidhanta ūrdhvagāḥ || 35|| asaṃkhyāni vimānāni yatstareṣu śramanti ca | asaṃkhyabhūmikāvāsānādimuktā vasanti ca || 36|| etaddurgasamaṃ divyamasaṃkhyayojanāyatam | nagaraṃ nāparaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ pūrvaṃ vimānagaistadā || 37|| paradhāmno’bhito durgaścāyaṃ sarvottamottamaḥ | asaṃkhyanagarātmā cāsaṃkhyodyānapraśobhanaḥ |||38|| asaṃkhyamuktavasatiśobhāḍhyo dhāmarakṣakaḥ | atrānādikṛṣṇamūrteḥ kiraṇāni samantataḥ |||39|| patanti taiḥ sadā durge smṛddhayaḥ śāśvatātmikāḥ | kiraṇebhyaḥ sudhāvarṣā bhavanti ca yatheṣṭakāḥ || 4.116.40|| parabrahmasudhānadyo durge vahanti madhyagāḥ | mahānadāstaṭākāśca dīrghikā vāṭikāstathā ||41 || nityapūrṇā mahānandapradā bhavanti durgiṇām | rasakulyā ghṛtakulyā dadhikulyā bhavanti ca || 42|| pānakulyā vārikulyā madhukulyā bhavanti ca | śītakulyā ūṣṇakulyāḥ svādakulyā bhavanti ca ||43 || lehyakulyāścoṣyakulyā bhojyadravā bhavanti ca | bhakṣyādrayo bhojyaśailāḥ phalapuṣparasottamāḥ ||44|| miṣṭādanodajānnāni śarkarāḥ saṃbhavanti ca | piṇyākāni samastāni pīyūṣāṇyuttamāni ca |||45||| mūrtirasyāni sarvāṇi tṛptidājyāni yānyapi | navanītāni takrāṇi dugdhasārāṇi yānyapi ||46|| kṣīrāṇi pāyasāniṣṭapriyāṇi saṃbhavanti ca | sarvarasottamā divyāḥ kalpadrumakarandakāḥ ||47|| kalpavallīphalalehyapeyarasā bhavanti ca | śākhidugdhāmṛtasārāḥ siddhānnāni bhavanti ca ||48|| sarvaśākarasāḥ sarvamiśrarasā bhavanti ca | sarvaśṛṃgārabhogārhadravodbhavā bhavanti ca ||49|| sarvaśayyāgandhavāsāḥ kiraṇebhyo bhavanti ca | sarvaśālāsukhapuñjā divyākṣayyā bhavanti ca ||4.116.50 || sarvabhūṣāmbaraveṣā vāṭikodyānasaṃbhavāḥ | sarveṣṭapātrapuñjāścopaskārāśca bhavantyapi ||51 || sarvasaundaryasaddravyāṇyuttamāni bhavanti ca | sarvarāgā rañjanāni cikkaṇāni bhavantyapi ||52|| sarvatejāṃsi varcāṃsi balāni puṣṭayastathā | dhātavaḥ sukhadāḥ kṛṣṇakiraṇaiḥ sambhavanti ca ||53|| kiraṇaiḥ samprajāyante ratnamauktikahīrakāḥ | maṇayo hetavaḥ sarvasādhanāni śubhāni ca ||54|| badrike komalaṃ rūkṣaṃ mṛdu tīvraṃ ca madhyamam | yadvastu yādṛśaṃ yaiścāpekṣyate tatprajāyate |||55||| kāyākalpāḥ prajāyante kāyāvivartakānyapi | yatheṣṭarūpadhāritvaṃ kalpaśṛṃgairbhavanti hi ||56|| asaṃkhyānantabhogānāmālayo durga eva saḥ | yatsamastavarṇanaṃ tu śakyate nākṣarāyuṣā ||57|| vīkṣya durgaṃ vimānasthā dhyajatoraṇarājitam | cakrurmanāṃsi tatraivoṣituṃ cānandadāyinam ||58|| athāpi cohyamānāste tathāgre vīkṣaṇecchayā | yayurvimānagāścāgre sapta durgān pravīkṣitum ||59|| parārdhayojanabhūmyāntarabhāgottarasthitān | anādyanantamuktānāṃ rāṣṭrāṇāṃ rakṣakān śubhān ||4.116.60 || ghanatejomayīṃ bhūmimasaṃkhyanagarāśrayām | asaṃkhyānādimuktānāṃ vasatyādisamāśritām ||6 1 || sarvarddhisahitāṃ sarvarasapūrṇāṃ manoharām | sarvasasyadrumavṛkṣalatāvallītṛṇānvitām ||62|| parabrahmātmakamiṣṭaphalakandadalapradām | sarvabhogyapradāṃ kāmarūpadhrāṃ saridanvitām ||63|| parabrahmarasavāriyuktataḍāgaśobhanām | mahānadanadīvyāptāṃ mahāsāgaraśobhanām ||64|| divyāmṛtasarobhiśca sarvakamalayogibhiḥ | asaṃkhyamuktavallībhiḥ śobhanāṃ hṛdayaṃgamām ||65|| vyalokayan vimānasthā saccidānandatanmayīm | vīkṣya tāṃ dīrghapaṭṭāṃ cāpyanantāṃ divyagocarām |||66|| āgataṃ kānakaṃ durgaṃ ghanatejo’bhirāmakam | vyalokayanmahāścaryayutaṃ pūrvavadāyatam |||67||| pūrvavaducchritaṃ pūrvavat suvasatisaṃśrayam | anādidivyamuktānāṃ prāsādairgopurairyutam ||68||| saṃkalpotthasamastaiśca bhogyabhogopasādhanaiḥ | bhogopakaraṇairdivyaiḥ saṃbhṛtālayaśobhanam ||69|| āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptā vīkṣya vimānagāminaḥ | badrike te kalpayanti pratīkṣante harergṛham ||4.116.70|| mahāścaryamayaṃ cedaṃ prāpya neti vidantyapi | athāgre prayayuścāpi bhūmikāṃ dīrghapaṭṭikām ||71|| asaṃkhyānādimuktānāṃ nagarairadhivāsitām | pūrvavacchobhanāṃ sarvabhogyabhogopasādhanaiḥ ||72|| sarvabhogopakaṇairalaṃkṛtāṃ prabhāsurām | vīkṣyāścaryamayīṃ bhūmiṃ cāsaṃkhyanagarāśritām |||73||| yayuragre paraṃ durgaṃ sauvarṇataijasodbhavam | pūrvavadāyataṃ pūrvavaducchritaṃ manoharam ||74|| asaṃkhyānātimuktānāmāvāsairatiśobhanam | sarvakāmarddhisahitaṃ sarvarasādisaṃbhṛtam ||75||| sarvacintodbhavatattvapradaṃ divyasukhapradam | āvīkṣya taṃ mahādurgaṃ tadantarbhūmimāgatāḥ ||76|| vimāninaḥ samastāste vyalokayan hi rājatīm | śvetāṃ candrasamāṃ bhūmiṃ sarvarddhivasatiśritām ||77|| asaṃkhyānādimuktānāṃ pattanādyadhiśobhitām | asaṃkhyayojanāyāmāṃ yayurdurgaṃ caturthakam ||78|| divyarājatatattvātmatejorāśisamudbhavam | pūrvavadāyataṃ sarvasmṛddhibhogyasamanvitam ||79|| asaṃkhyānādimuktānāṃ śuklānāṃ mandirairyutam | vīkṣyedaṃ vai bhavet kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya mandiram ||4.116.80|| evaṃ pratarkayantaste na prāpyāgre yayurdrutam | bhūmiṃ vai divyavaidūryatejomayīṃ tathāyatām ||8 1 || divyānādimuktavāsāmasaṃkhyarddhirasānvitām | sarvakāmaprapūrāṃ cālokayan bahuśobhanām |||82|| pūrvatejo’dhikatejorasamayīmanuttamām | vīkṣya tūrṇaṃ puro yātā durgaṃ tu pañcamaṃ prati |||83|| sphāṭikākhyamaṇigarbhamahātejo’bhinirmitam | asaṃkhyānādimuktānāṃ divyālayādiśobhanam ||84|| śrīharaiḥ kiraṇaiḥ sarvabhogyatatsādhanānvitam | mahānandapradaṃ badri vīkṣyāgre prayayuśca te ||85|| ṣaṣṭhaṃ durgaṃ tathādīrghāyatocchrayaṃ manoharam | sarvāsaṃkhyamahādivyakaustubhamaṇivigraham ||86|| asaṃkhyānādimuktānāṃ divyamandiraśobhanam | sarvadivyarddhisahitaṃ sarvakāmaprapūrakam ||87|| vimānagāstvidaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśrayasthalam | matvā vīkṣya tamaprāpya yayuragre samutsukāḥ ||88|| līlābhūmiṃ viśālāṃ ca divyatejobhiśobhanām | pūrvapūrvata utkṛṣṭatejorasarddhivardhitām ||89|| asaṃkhyānādimuktānāṃ vasatyā vāsitāṃ śubhām | mahāsāmrājyaśobhāḍhyāṃ sarvānandapariplutām ||4.116.90|| sarvendriyasukhānandapradāṃ divyātmagocarām | vīkṣyāgre prayayuḥ sarve durgaṃ tu saptamaṃ prati ||9 1|| cintāmaṇimahātejaḥklṛptaṃ pūrvavadāyatam | asaṃkhyānādimuktānāṃ mahāmandiraśobhanam ||92|| sarvarddhisahitaṃ sarvabhogyabhogābhipūritam | ayaṃ nāthasya vāsaścetyevaṃ matvānavāpya tam ||93|| yayuragre divyacintāmaṇibhūmiṃ taduttamām | sarvarddhisahitāṃ sarvavanodyānanadādibhiḥ ||94|| śobhanāṃ sarvathā divyāmasaṃkhyayojanāyatām | asaṃkhyānādimuktānāṃ prāsādapattanānvitām ||95|| vīkṣya tūrṇaṃ yayurdurgamaṣṭamaṃ kalpatattvajam | kalpatejomayaṃ sarvakalpakiraṇabhogadam ||96|| asaṃkhyānantamuktānāmanādīnāṃ ca mandiraiḥ | sarvathā sarvato vyāptaṃ sarvadurgottamottamam ||97|| pūrvebhyaścāpi sarvebhyo viśālāyatamucchritam | asaṃkhyabhūmikāvyakṣāstaramālāvirājitam ||98|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇotthakiraṇānvitam | sarvavidhābhirbhābhiśca parabrahmarasapradam ||99|| asaṃkhyagopurairyuktamuparyupari saṃsthitaiḥ | asaṃkhyabhūmikākakṣānādimuktābhivāsitam || 4.116.10 0|| asaṃkhyaghanatejojasvarṇamaṇḍapakoṣṭhakam | asaṃkhyagahvaragarbhamasaṃkhyatoraṇojjvalam || 10 1|| asaṃkhyayānasaṃyānavimānādyabhisaṃśritam | asaṃkhyacandraśālāsthodyānavāṭīsuśobhanam || 1 02|| asaṃkhyadīrghaśikharairyuktaprāsādavigraham | asaṃkhyanagarāvāsaṃ cāsaṃkhyapattanānvitam || 1 03|| asaṃkhyānantasampadbhirbhogyābhiśca prapūritam | bhogopakaraṇairdivyairbhogaiḥ prasādhanairyutam || 1 04|| asaṃkhyānantadivyeṣṭakalpagrāvamaṇikṛtam | asaṃkhyadivyaśālābhirvihārai rāsamaṇḍalaiḥ || 105 || yuktaṃ raṃgavicitrāṃgamaṇḍapairgarbhavartibhiḥ | asaṃkhyāvyayasarvordhvadivyānandasarinnadaiḥ || 106 || mahānandasarobhiśca śobhitaṃ kanakojjvalam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇarūpānurūpibhiḥ || 1 07|| śaktisāmarthyamuktaiścādhyuṣitaṃ sarvatomukhaiḥ | anādimuktamuktānīsāmrājyadivyamandiram || 1 08|| uparyanantaṃ ca tale’pyanantaṃ pārśve’pyanantaṃ parito’pyanantam | madhye’pyanantaṃ kramaṇe’pyanantaṃ hyapārapāraṃ tamalokayam̐ste || 1 09|| samastabhogaṃ ca samastamodaṃ samastapīyūṣamakhaṇḍaśaṃdam | samastasaukhyaṃ ca samaṣṭibījaṃ durgaṃ mahāntaṃ tamalokayam̐ste || 4.116.11 0|| sadaikatattvaṃ bahubhāvarūpaṃ samastasatkāmasupūrakaṃ ca | samastasaccetanakalpakāntaprakhyairmaṇīndrairabhirāmakaṃ tam || 111 || vyalokayan vallabhikāsamṛddhiprakāśanātiprabhumiṣṭadaṃ ca | kalpadrucintāmaṇikalpavallīkalpormikācakramaṇīndragarbham || 11 2|| samastasatsaurabharamyarūpasamastakāsvādanasadrasāḍhyam | asaṃkhyakākarṣaṇabhṛtsvarāḍhyamasaṃkhyasatsparśasukhapradaṃ ca || 113|| yatra kāmadughā gāvo yatra kalpapriyā, ramāḥ | yatrānandapradā muktā nivasantyabhitaḥ sukhāḥ || 11 4|| yeṣāṃ pratyekanilaye dvāradeśe’grabhāgake | sṛṣṭidṛśyo maṇiścāste sarvasākṣātpradarśanaḥ || 115 || yeṣāmantargṛhe bhittau sṛṣṭiśrāvyo maṇiḥ sthitaḥ | sarvasṛṣṭisvaraśabdaśrāvako bodhadāyakaḥ || 116 yeṣāṃ dehalikāmadhye cāste vai mānaso maṇiḥ | sṛṣṭimānasasākṣātkāraprado divyabodhanaḥ || 11 7|| yeṣāṃ gṛhavitāne ca lambate tu sudhāmaṇiḥ | sarvatṛptipradaḥ sarvānandapramodasaukhyadaḥ || 118 || yeṣāṃ tu catvare cāste kalpadrurmaṇisatphalaḥ | sarvāsvādarasadātā śāśvatīṃ tṛptimāvahan || 11 9|| yeṣāmantargṛhe cāste sparśānandaprado maṇiḥ | kṛṣṇasparśapradaḥ sarvasparśadaḥ śāśvataḥ sukhaḥ || 4.116.120 || viśiṣṭaṃ badrike tatra śṛṇu tvaṃ vai rahasyakam | gṛhe gṛhe kāmaphalaṃ muktecchāpūrakaṃ param || 121 || vartate’nādikṛṣṇena dattaṃ tu pratimuktakam | phalaṃ spṛṣṭvānādimukto bhūtvā muktānikā priyā || 1 22|| kāntaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ patiṃ kṛtvā sevituṃ yadi vāñchati | tadā kṛṣṇā priyā bhūtvā kaṇṭhe dhūtvā phalaṃ tu tat || 123 || sevate svapatiṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ ratipriyā | pūrṇānandaṃ paraṃ bhuktvā prasādya vallabhamprabhum || 1 24|| maṇimuttārya kaṇṭhāttaṃ phalākhyaṃ jāyate pumān | etadvai paramaiśvaryaṃ svayaṃ jānāti netaraḥ || 1 25|| yasmai dattaṃ phalaṃ yattu tadvai tasya pravartate | nānyahastagataṃ tadvai pravartate’nyarūpaṇe || 1 26|| etadeva mahāścaryaṃ sarvānandapradaprabhoḥ | muktānāṃ sarvakāmānāṃ pūrakasya parātmanaḥ || 1 27|| san svayaṃ bhagavām̐statra cit sā muktānikā tadā | tayorānanda utkṛṣṭaḥ saccidānanda ityayam || 1 28|| ya etāṃ paramāṃ divyāma muktirahasyabodhikām | upaniṣadaṃ jānāti so’pi yāyātparāṃ gatim || 1 29|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne hṛdyabodhane pare dhāmni divyāṣṭadurgarāṣṭrānādimuktavasatitadālayaiśvaryatadrahasyopaniṣadādivarṇananāmā ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 116 ||
<4.117> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi vimānagāḥ samarcitāḥ | rahasyānādimuktaistairvīkṣya durgaṃ tamaṣṭamam || 1 || bālakṛṣṇeritāścāgre yayurdeśām̐stataḥ parān | anantāsaṃkhyamānāṃścātarkyarddhisaṃbhṛtān śubhān || 2 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇatejobhisaṃbhṛtān | yatrānādimahāyuktā vasanti sarvataḥ khalu || 3 || yatra rahasyamuktāśca nivasanti hareḥ priyāḥ | yatra tādātmyamuktāśca sadā vasanti bhūmiṣu || 4 || yatra vasanti ca mūrtimuktā abhinnabhāvanāḥ | yatra vasanti cādṛśyamuktāḥ kṛṣṇaikagocarāḥ || 5 || badrike varṇanaṃ cāsyāḥ sthiterbuddheḥ paraṃ mama | tān pradeśān lokayanto yayuragre vimānagāḥ || 6 || vyapaśyam̐ste tādṛśānāṃ muktānāṃ nagarāṇi vai | pattanāni nagarīśca vasatīn rāṣṭrakāṇi ca || 7 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇānandavāhinyo yeṣu cāpagā | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtirasadhrāṇi sarāṃsi ca || 8 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāsvādavatyo yeṣu tu dīrghikāḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāsyotthatāmbūlarasasāgarāḥ || 9 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśleṣajanyāmṛtabharā ca bhūḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtidhrāṇi rajāṃsi yeṣu ca || 4.117.10 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūtidhrāṇi vanāni yeṣu ca | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtiphalikā yeṣu vallayaḥ || 11 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtipuṣpiṇaḥ stabakāstathā | kṛṣṇakāntadharā vāṭyaḥ ārāmāḥ kṛṣṇayoginaḥ || 1 2|| udyānānyabhitaḥ santi kṛṣṇamayāni yatra ca | tṛṇāni muktarūpāṇi sasyāni tādṛśāni ca || 13 || kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtidharāṇi santi cābhitaḥ | vividhānāṃ ca muktānāṃ dhyānasevājuṣāṃ hareḥ || 1 4|| maṇḍalāni virājante’bhitaḥ sabhāgṛheṣu vai | kāmarūpadharāḥ sarve kāmamaṇipradhāriṇaḥ || 15 || kāmapūrakakṛṣṇasya kalāṃśāveśarūpiṇaḥ | kṛṣṇāṃgarūpiṇaḥ sarve kṛṣṇābhinnasvarūpiṇaḥ || 16 || kṛṣṇānandabharāḥ kṛṣṇāpṛthaksiddhaviśeṣaṇāḥ | anantabhūpradeśasthā riktasthalīvivarjitāḥ || 17 || pratyekaṃ śrīharermūrtyā sahitāḥ santi sanmukhāḥ | vanāraṇyamahāmuktāḥ sarve’pi kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ || 18 || parvatādimahāmuktāḥ sarve’pi kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ | nadīnadamahāmuktāḥ sarve’pi kūṣṇamūrtayaḥ || 19 || sīmavāṭīmahāmuktāḥ sarve’pi kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ | ārāmodyānagā muktāḥ sarve’pi kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ || 4.117.20 || grāmapattanamuktāśca sarve’pi kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ | nagarāvāsamuktāśca sarve’pi kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ || 21 || prasādālayamuktāśca sarve’pi kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ | kṛṣṇamaṇḍalamuktāśca sarve’pi kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ || 22|| śākhipraśākhimuktāśca sarve’pi kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ | vanyanāgarikā muktāḥ sarve’pi kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ || 23 || svāmikāntasya muktānyaḥ sarvāstāḥ kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ | śaktayaścāpi muktānyaḥ sarvāstāḥ svāmimūrtayaḥ || 24|| parabrahmapriyāḥ kṛṣṇaharipriyāśca śaktayaḥ | sarvā rahasyamuktānyaḥ sarvathā harimūrtayaḥ || 25|| are badri vibhūṣāśca cetanā harimūrtayaḥ | are badri svarṇaveṣāścetanā harimūrtayaḥ || 26 || are badri ca śṛṅgārāścetanā harimūrtayaḥ | are badri cāyudhāni sarvāṇi harimūrtayaḥ || 27|| are badryupaskarāṇi sarvāṇi harimūrtayaḥ | are badri prabhogyāni sarvāṇi harimūrtayaḥ || 28 || are badri suvarṣmāṇi sarvāṇi harimūrtayaḥ | are vadri ca harmyāṇi sarvāṇi harimūrtayaḥ || 29|| are badri samastānīndriyāṇi harimūrtayaḥ | are badri pṛthag yāni tāni vai harimūrtayaḥ || 4.117.30 || are badri nijātmāpi tatrāste harimūrtikaḥ | yatkiñcidvartate dhāmni pare tat kṛṣṇamūrtikam || 31 || sarvaṃ haryātmakaṃ kṛṣṇasvarūpaṃ nānyadasti tat | kṛṣṇānandasukhaṃ kṛṣṇāpṛthakprasiddhavigraham || 32|| ekamevādvitīyaṃ tannānyat paśyati netaraḥ | sarvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇakāntātmānvitaṃ tadrūparūpitam || 33 || tatra kiṃ kena gṛhṇīyāt svātmakaṃ svaṃ pravindate | etādṛśaṃ parabrahma vartate sarvato’nvitam ||34|| badrike’ṇḍapradeśe’pi parabrahma prakāśate | parā brāhmī mahāvidyopaniṣat seyamucyate ||35|| etāmadhītya mukto’pi parabrahmāyate tadā | amukto muktatāṃ yāti mukto’nādipramuktatām ||36|| anādimukta evāpi yāti rahasyamuktatām | rahasyamukta evāpi yāti tādātmyamuktatām || 37|| tādātmyamuktaḥ saṃyāti parabrahmasvarūpatām | nānyadasyāvaśiṣṭaṃ syājjñātavyaṃ paramaṃ tataḥ ||38|| nānyadasya tathāptavyaṃ śiṣyeta kāntataḥ param | svaḥ kāntaḥ kānta eva saḥ sā kāntā kānta eva saḥ || 39|| yatsāmyamevāsya na kiñcidasti yasmātparaṃ nāsti tathā ca kiñcit | yadgarbhamevākhilamasya cāsti tadbhāvya vidvānna pṛthak praśāsti ||4.117.40|| kā vā priyā tatra ca kaḥ priyo’sya yasya priyaṃ sarvamayaṃ sa eva | taṃ preṣṭhakāntaṃ parirabhya dhāmni pare pṛthaktvaṃ vijahāti muktaḥ ||41 || so’yaṃ priyaḥ saiva parā priyā ca sa eva bhoktā ca bhujiṣyikā sā | sa garbhaniṣṭho hṛdaye bahiśca taṃ prāpya kāntaṃ vṛjinaṃ hinasti ||42|| brahmapriyāḥ kṛṣṇaramāśca badrike haripriyā muktaramāśca tāḥ khalu | taṃ prāpya kāntaṃ ca samastarūpiṇaṃ sthātuṃ hi tatraiva manāṃsi cakrire ||43|| vimānagāstāḥ khalu kṛṣṇadehino muktā api kaṇṭhamaṇīcchayā muhuḥ | samutsukāḥ kṛṣṇapatispṛhārthino muhurvyapaśyan smitabhāvagarbhikāḥ ||44|| hariḥ pravijñāya ca vīkṣya bhāvaṃ nijaṃ paraṃ prema tathāvidhaṃ ca | pradarśya śīghraṃ hyanayat puraṃ svaṃ parātparaṃ sarvaparaṃ maholam ||45|| vimānagāśca te sarve vīkṣya muktamayīṃ bhuvam | pārabrāhmīṃ ca vasatiṃ yayuḥ śrīkṛṣṇamandiram ||46|| sarvamuktanagarāṇāṃ vartulānāṃ ca garbhagam | mahādurgābhisampannaṃ nijaṃ rahasyamandiram ||47|| badrike te spṛhāvanto dhāmni sthātuṃ vimānagāḥ | parabrahmapuraṃ dūrān muktavasatimadhyagam ||48| vyapaśyan yāvadeveti tāvannetrāṇi satvaram | tejo’bhibhūtatejāṃsi mimilurvai vimāninām ||49|| parabrahmapuraṃ dṛṣṭamaśaktāste vimānagāḥ | mahimānaṃ viduḥ sveṣāṃ svāminastejasāṃ tadā ||4.117.50|| prārthayan paramātmānaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ dātuṃ taduttamām | harirdadau nijāṃ parākāṣṭhitāṃ dṛṣṭimuttamām ||51|| nijanetramayīṃ dṛṣṭiṃ nijanetrapṛthaksthitām | tadā vimānagāḥ sarve sphāranetrāḥ saśaktikāḥ ||52|| abhavannirnimeṣāśca kṛṣṇatejaḥsahāḥ sadā | vimānāni yayurdrāk ca parabrahmapurāntikam ||53|| ghanatejoghanatejoghanatejo’tighaṭṭitam | yatra tato’pi ca saddhaṭṭatejoghaṭṭātitaijasam ||||54|| parabrahmapuradurgaṃ vyapaśyam̐ste vimānagāḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmatattvanirmitam ||55|| sarvāścaryamayaṃ divyaṃ rahasyamuktasaṃśritam | kaṇṭhamaṇimahāmuktapremamuktādhivāsitam ||56|| koṭyarbudābjapatnīnāṃ dāsā dāsyaśca sevakāḥ | putrā putryaśca yā ye ca te sarve kṛṣṇarūpiṇaḥ ||57|| tatra durge nivasanti parārdhayojanāvṛte | asaṃkhyarddhiyute sarvakṛṣṇabhogābhipūrite ||58|| divyagopurabhūmyabjocchraye’ntaḥpurarakṣake | vimānasthā vilokyāpi tān sarvān kṛṣṇarūpiṇaḥ ||59|| samānān jñātavanto na putrīḥ putrām̐śca sevakān | ṛṣīn sādhūn yatīn sādhvīrvividurna yadā tadā ||4.117.60|| pravedanaparāṃ buddhiṃ dadau tebhyo hariḥ prabhuḥ | drutaṃ prodbhinnamatayaḥ sarvajñāste’bhavan drutam ||6 1 || sarvāvedanayogyāśca sarvāṃste vividustadā | mama putro hyayaṃ putrī ceyaṃ dāso mamāpyayam ||62|| mama mātā pitā cāyaṃ mama dāsī tviyaṃ suhṛt | ityevaṃ prāptavijñānāḥ pramodino vimānagāḥ ||63|| saharṣāścātmasambodhā mitho gāthāḥ pracakrire | badrike te rahasyākhyā muktā api ca satvaram ||64|| vimānagān pitā me’yaṃ māteyaṃ me suhṛnmama | bandhuścāyaṃ kṣitau deśe putro’yaṃ putrikā tviyam ||65|| ityevaṃ bahudhā vyaktamavocurvīkṣya cāmbare | śrutvā vīkṣya nisargotthasnehāḥ kutuhalānvitāḥ ||66|| sasaṃbhramāḥ sacāñcalyā dudruvuḥ premapūritāḥ | sapūjopaskarapātrakarāste kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ ||67|| vimānagāḥ samastāste’pi ca tān premanetriṇaḥ | ālokayantaḥ snehāḍhyāstadāhvānaṃ pracakrire ||68|| koṭikoṭivimānānāmavatāraṇabhūmiṣu | durgamadhyasthalīṣvete svāgatārthaṃ samāyayuḥ ||69|| sarvasaugandhyalāvaṇyavyāptaudyānasubhūmiṣu | parabrahmamaholasyāgārabhāgātmikāsu vai ||4.117.70|| jayaśabdān sukhaśabdām̐ścakrire te mudānvitāḥ | avaterurvimānāni kṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchayā ||71 || tāni sarvāṇi te muktā akṣataiḥ kusumādibhiḥ | candanairamṛtaistoyairvardhayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||72|| mimiluścāvatīrṇāstān nijānnijān haripriyān | samāśliṣan mitho vakṣomelanairnetramelanaiḥ ||73|| ānanānāṃ melanaiśca dehānāṃ melanaistathā | atha badripriye devi rahasyaṃ śṛṇu cottamam ||74|| vimāne ye sthitāścāsan nārīmuktādayo’khilāḥ | avatīrṇā vimānāttu yadā tadā puraḥ sthitān ||75|| vyalokayannijarūpān svāgatārthaṃ samāgatān | anādisiddhamuktām̐stān kṛṣṇakāntātmakān śubhān ||76|| sadā paramadhāmasthān parabrahmapurāśrayān | svātmakān svāpararūpān svabhāvaguṇarūpiṇaḥ ||77|| svāgataṃ kurvataḥ sveṣāṃ svapūjārthaṃ samāgatān | svābhinnarūpiṇastām̐śca svām̐śca tacchāyikātmakān ||78|| vīkṣya vijñāya mūlātmarūpiṇaḥ sarvataḥ sthitān | āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptā abhavan vai vimāninaḥ ||79|| kṛṣṇapūjottaraṃ pūjāṃ prāpya kṛṣṇājñayā tu te | vimānino yayustaistaiḥ sahitāḥ svasvakālayān ||4.117.80|| vimāninā tu muktena pratyekena saha prabhuḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yayau tadālayam ||8 1|| tasya tasya gṛhe divyagajāsane’paro hariḥ | rājate mūlarūpo’pītyevaṃ vyalokayan harim ||82|| haridvayaṃ nijarūpadvayaṃ vīkṣya vimāninaḥ | svīyamanādimuktatvaṃ rahasyamuktatāmapi ||83|| vividurdivyavijñānāścāntarbhāvaṃ nijātmani | mūlarūpe yayuḥ sarve kṛṣṇo kṛṣṇe tiro’bhavat || 84 || sarve’nādikṛṣṇarūpā mūlarūpā yadābhavan | badrike divyaparamāṃ viśrāntimāpuruttamām || 85 || yathā videśe vihṛtya svagṛhe śāntimeti ha | tathā viśrāntimāpannā visasmarurvideśakān || 86 || aho kṛṣṇasya sāmarthyaṃ divyādivyamatipradam | anantarūpadhāritvamasaṃkhyarūpadatvakam || 87 || vimānāni vimāneṣu vyalīyanta kṣaṇāttadā | bhūṣāveṣasmṛddhayaśca vyalīyanta tadarddhiṣu || 88 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇarūpaṃ samastakam | ekamevādvitīyaṃ vai rūpato guṇato’pi ca || 89 || abhavat sarvameveti līlāṃ jānāti ko hareḥ | gṛhe gṛhe hariścāste muktaṃ muktaṃ prati prabhuḥ || 4.117.90 || brahmapriyādikāḥ sarvā rahasyamuktatāṃ gatāḥ | koṭyarbudābjakoṭyaśca prāsādāścātiśobhanāḥ || 91 || asaṃkhyarddhiyutāstatra parabrahmapure sthirāḥ | kaṇṭhamaṇiprabhāveṇa prāsādeṣu sthitāśca te || 92 || vividuśca nijaṃ patnībhāvaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ hariṃ prati | siṣevire tathaivainaṃ patiṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || 93 || tadaṃgārdhasvarūpāḍhyāḥ prāpya svaṃ śāśvataṃ puram | parabrahmāmṛtasnānaṃ cakrire te tadā gṛhe || 94 || parabrahmākṣatapuṣpacandanaiḥ kṛṣṇamījire | parabrahmarasāsvādāmṛtānāṃ bhojanaṃ vyadhuḥ || 95 || parabrahmāmṛtavāripānaṃ pracakrire priyāḥ | parabrahma paraṃ kāntaṃ siṣevire nirantaram || 96 || parabrahmaṇaḥ kāntasyopāsanāṃ cakrire’nvaham | parabrahmaparābhaktiṃ vyadhuste nityamuktigāḥ || 97 || parabrahmānandavārddhiṃ bubhujire’tisevayā | vividurna paraṃ kiñcit kāntasukhāt sukhetarat || 98 || kṛṣṇasya kṛpayā patnyaḥ prāpuḥ kṛṣṇasvarūpatām | atha śrībhagavām̐stābhyo darśayituṃ svamandiram || 99 || koṭyarbudābjakoṭīnāṃ prāsādānāṃ tu madhyagam | manaścakre’tha vai kṛṣṇaḥ sarvāḥ prāha priyaṃ vacaḥ || 4.117.10 0|| parabrahmamaholākhyasabhāsthānaṃ prayāmyaham | āyāntu sahasā sarvāstatra matparamaṃ padam || 10 1|| prāptavatyo bhavatyo’tra sālokyaṃ sārṣṭi cetyapi | sāyujyaṃ cāpi sārūpyaṃ caikatvaṃ pariśiṣyate || 102|| tadapyahaṃ darśayāmi paradhiṣṇayasthite mayi | ityevaṃ badrike proktvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhuḥ || 10 3|| tirobhavaddrutaṃ tattanmandirāt prayayau sabhām | yatra rājādhirājeśādhirājeśvarapūjitaḥ || 1 04|| anādyanantamukteśeśvaramuktādipūjitaḥ | asaṃkhyānantavibhavairavatāraiśca pūjitaḥ || 1 05|| asaṃkhyadivyaśaktyādyairāyudhairabhipūjitaḥ | sarvasṛṣṭisvarāṭ cāste sarvadhāmasvarāṭ patiḥ || 1 06|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāryaḥ kṛṣṇakeśavaḥ | svayaṃ mūle svarūpe sve gatvā sthiro’bhavaddhariḥ || 1 07|| kaṃbharānandano yo’yaṃ gopālakṛṣṇabālakaḥ | prabhuḥ padmāvatīsvāmī rādhālakṣmīvarottamaḥ || 1 08|| paramātmā parabrahma parameśaḥ pareśvaraḥ | puruṣottamasaṃjño vai bhūtvā dhiṣṇye sthiro’bhavat || 1 09|| badrike muktakoṭyastā āyayuśca sabhāṃ prati | harṣitāḥ svapatiṃ proṣya prāptā punaryathāṃganāḥ || 4.117.11 0|| bhuvi prākaṭyadivase saptaviṃśatisaṃkhyake | ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamīrūpe prātareva priyādikāḥ || 11 1|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasmāritamutsavam | kartuṃ tūrṇaṃ yayuḥ sarve muktā muktānikāstadā || 1 12|| gajāsane sthitaṃ kāntaṃ sabhāmaholake’bhitaḥ | sthitvānarcuḥ svāminaṃ svaṃ cārārtrikaṃ vyadhustathā || 11 3|| asaṃkhyamuktā āgatya divyopacārakairharim | pupūjuḥ parayā prītyā jayanādān pracakrire || 1 14|| tatratyāḥ prayayuḥ sarve prapūjya ca nijālayān | sahāyātāstu ye brahmapriyādyā muktakoṭayaḥ || 1 15|| te sarve tu samaicchan vai draṣṭuṃ kṛṣṇamaholakān | omityāha tadā muktān darśayāmīti cāha tān || 116 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne’ṣṭamadurgottarasthāḥ paradhāmapradeśāḥ, parabrahmapuradurgaḥ, parabrahmātmamuktavasatayaḥ, parabrahmapurasthānāṃ vaimānikānāṃ svarūpadvaye’pyaikyaṃ, parabrahmapure svasvālayeṣvavataraṇam, svāgataṃ viśramaṇaṃ, parabrahmaṇaḥ sabhāyāṃ svaśāśvatadhiṣṇyaṃ prati gamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 117 ||
<4.118> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu badrīpriye devi raṃgamaholamuttamam | sabhāmaholamutkṛṣṭaṃ vāsamaholamityapi || 1 || śayyāmaholamucchraiṣṭhyaṃ maholaṃ mandirābhidham | snānamaholanairmalyaṃ khelamaholamityapi || 2 || śāntimaholasaukhyaṃ ca śṛṃgārārhamaholakam | maholaṃ bhojanākhyaṃ ca pūjāmaholamityapi || 3 || sarvāgamamaholaṃ ca bhaktasevāmaholakam | tathā rahasyamuktānīkṛtasevāmaholakam || 4 || paṭṭāṃganāmahāmuktānikāmaholakaṃ tathā | antaḥpuramaholaṃ ca ṣoḍaśetimaholakān || 5 || brahmapriyādyā muktāśca vyapaśyan bahuvistarān | lakṣayojanavistārān pratyekaṃ tān maholakān || 6 || raṃgamaholasaṃjño yo maholaḥ paramātmanaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sannivāsavān || 7 || sarvo divyasuvarṇātmā saccidānandataijasaḥ | sarvarddhisiddhisāmarthyāsaṃkhyaiśvaryādisaṃbhṛtaḥ || 8 || sarvordhvadhvajasaṃśobhadvṛttamaṇḍaparājitaḥ | asaṃkhyastambhaśobhābhiḥ ramaṇīyamanoharaḥ || 9 || kalpalatākṣayapātracintāmaṇyādikoṇakaḥ | sarvabhogyādisaṃrājatpārśvaśālādirājitaḥ || 4.118.10 || asaṃkhyatoraṇālambikammānikātisundaraḥ | divyātidivyatejobhirhareḥ samantataḥ śubhaḥ || 11 || madhye brahmāsanāḍhyaśca vitānachatracāmaraiḥ | divyadevatāmuktābhiḥ puṣpasragābhivarṣitaḥ || 1 2|| yattejāṃsi hareḥ siṃhāsanatejobhavāni vai | tattejāṃsi prasaranti cānyamaholakeṣu ha || 13 || anyamaholatejāṃsi vartulāni prayānti ca | bahirdurgābhisammukhānyatīva sarvasṛṣṭiṣu || 14|| brahmāsane’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo virājate | pareśvaro mūlarūpaḥ sarvasvāmī sadīśvaraḥ || 1 5|| sarvābharaṇabhūṣaśca sarvasugandhasaṃbhṛtaḥ | sarvarūpātirūpāḍhyaḥ sundarebhyo’pi sundaraḥ || 1 6|| yuvāṣoḍaśavarṣonaḥ sarvakāntāmanoharaḥ | sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhāḍhyaḥ sarveṣāṃ hṛdayaṃgamaḥ || 1 7|| sahasrastambhayuksaumyabrahmāsane virājitaḥ | śatasopānordhvapīṭhe samāsīnaḥ sa komale || 18|| sarvapūjopahārādyairarcito muktakoṭibhiḥ | tamenaṃ paramātmānaṃ kāntaṃ paramapūruṣam || 1 9|| dṛṣṭvānandaṃ yayuḥ sarvarahasyamuktakoṭayaḥ | raṃgamahole muktāste vyapaśyan svān hi koṭiśaḥ || 4.118.20 || divyaratnagatarūpān naijānasaṃkhyakānapi | bhittau te ca tato’paśyan dhāmasṛṣṭīḥ samastikāḥ ||21 || caruṣvapi tato’paśyannīśvarākhilasarjanam | paṭṭikāsu tato’paśyan brahmāṇḍāni samastataḥ ||22|| evaṃvidhaṃ paraṃ sākṣādanubhavaṃ hi lebhire | koṇake koṇake sarvasṛṣṭivyūhā bhavanti hi ||23|| talake talake tatra sarvadhāmāni santi hi | phalake phalake sarvabrahmāṇḍāni bhavanti hi ||24|| anantārādhikāstatrāsaṃkhyāśca kamalāstathā | asaṃkhyāścāpi māṇikyaḥ padmāvatyo’pyasaṃkhyakāḥ ||25|| priyā anantakāstatra lakṣmyo’pyanantakā hyapi | ramā anantakāścāpi śriyaḥ santyapyanantakāḥ ||26|| raṃgamaholamadhye śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapriyāḥ | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇarūpapratimā muktavigrahāḥ |||27|| sarvāḥ puṃrūpiṇya iti sevante kāntamutsukāḥ | rahasyarūpadhāriṇyaḥ sevane śayanālaye ||28|| puṃrūpapradhāriṇyastāḥ sevante raṃgamaṇḍape | brahmapriyā asaṃkhyāścāpyasaṃkhyāśca haripriyāḥ ||29|| kārṣṇyo’pyanantāḥ sevante hariṇyo harimacyutam | nārāyaṇyo’pyasaṃkhyāśca mādhavyo’pi tathāvidhāḥ ||4.118.30|| līlāścāpi tathā vāsudevyaścāpi hyasaṃkhyakāḥ | padmāścāpi ca padminyastulasyaścāpyasaṃkhyakāḥ || 31 || śāradāśca sarasvatyo gaṃgā yamyo’pyasaṃkhyakāḥ | puṃmuktākhyāḥ prasevante kāntaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ narāyaṇam ||32|| pūjayanti prabhuṃ kāntaṃ rāmayanti ramottamāḥ | preṃkhāyāṃ śrīharimāndolayanti gītikovidāḥ ||33|| śṛṃgārayanti kamalā svāmiśrīkṛṣṇamīśvaram | saṃvāhayanti cāṃgāni hariṇyaśca hiraṇyabhāḥ ||34|| bhojayanti prabhuṃ sarvarasyabhojanapānakaiḥ | sukhayanti kṛpānāthaṃ sarvāśleṣapradānakaiḥ ||35|| sukhaṃ gṛhṇanti kāntāt tā rahasyamandiraśritāḥ | pāyayanti hariṃ divyaśarkarailārkakesaraiḥ ||36|| miśritāni sudugdhāni kāmadhenūdbhavāni vai | evaṃvidhe mahāraṃgamahole hīrakottamāḥ ||37|| vidyante’saṃkhyaratnāni svarṇahārāśca śobhanāḥ | taistaiḥ kāntaṃ bhūṣayanti kāntāḥ śrīkāntavallabham || 38|| tatra brahmapriyādyāstāḥ svāminā saha saṃgatāḥ | tatrāpi bhagavān kṛṣṇo dvitīyarūpadhṛk prabhuḥ || 39|| tābhirvilokitaḥ kānto dvayoraikyaṃ tato’bhavat | brahmasiṃhāsane tatra vyarājata pareśvaraḥ ||4.118.40|| rājādhirājaśobhāḍhyo’nantamuktābhisevitaḥ | badrike mahadāścaryaṃ vyalokayam̐śca tatsthale ||41 || pratyekaṃ ye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇā hyāsan sahāgatāḥ | pratimuktena sahate parakṛṣṇe layaṃ gatāḥ |||42|| brahmasiṃhāsane’nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇe prabhau | layaṃ yātān nijakāntān vīkṣyāścaryaṃ paraṃ gatāḥ ||43|| tata eva priyā muktā ākṛṣṭāḥ sukhamūrchitāḥ | mugdhāḥ kānte pare deve pupūjustuṣṭuvurmudā ||44|| ārārtrikaṃ pracakrūśca samāślikṣan patiṃ prabhum | samūcuḥ śrīhariṃ muktāḥ pralubdhāḥ parameśvare ||45|| hare kṛṣṇa kṛpāsindho tvameva paramaḥ pumān | rājase’nantakṛṣṇātmā sevanīyo’si naḥ sadā ||46|| bhavataḥ sampadaḥ sarvāḥ pradarśayātra no vibho | maholāḥ ṣoḍaśa divyā bahiṣṭo vīkṣitāḥ khalu ||47|| āntaraṃ vīkṣituṃ sarvaṃ samīcchāmaḥ prabhopate | bahiṣṭo’nantapārāste dṛśyante mādhavīpate ||48|| taijasordhvā yathā sūryāstaijasānāṃ sadādhikāḥ | brahmāṇḍeṣu bhavantyeva tathā maholakāstava ||49|| ṣoḍaśānāṃ sumadhyastho raṃgamaholakastava | koṭisūryātmakaḥ sūrya ivābhāti samantataḥ ||4.118.50|| sarvādhiko mahārāja manomohakaro hi naḥ | pradarśaya prabho sarvān sampadāṃ nilayān hi naḥ ||51 || badrike śrīharistūrṇaṃ darśayituṃ tu taiḥ saha | raṃgamahole babhrāma yatrarddhyo hyasaṃkhyakāḥ ||52|| divyacintāmaṇīnāṃ vai bhittayaśca talāni ca | divyacintāmaṇīnāṃ ca svarṇānāṃ bhūṣaṇāni ca ||53|| divyaratnasrajo ramyā divyatoraṇapaṃktayaḥ | divyaveṣā divyasarvopaskarā divyabhūmikāḥ ||54|| divyasarvāstaraṇāni divyāsanāni mūrtayaḥ | divyapātrāṇi sarvāṇi divyamañjuṣikādikāḥ ||55|| śṛṇu śrībadrike tatra santi raṅgamaholake | ekaikasmād vastunastu bījamaṇīndrasaṃjñakāt ||56|| yatheṣṭamudbhavāḥ sañjāyante’saṃkhyasajātikāḥ | rūpakulyā rasakulyā gandhakulyā maṇīśvarāḥ ||57|| dadhikulyā madhukulyāḥ sudhākulyā maṇīśvarāḥ | ānandaghanapānādikulyāstṛptipradāstathā ||58|| sarvalāvaṇyakulyāśca maṇyo rasyasampradāḥ | rahasyamuktanivahairvīkṣitā bhogyadāstadā ||59|| keśāḥ sarvādhikā badri śṛṃgāradravyasampradāḥ | bhūṣāvastrapradā veṣapradāstatra vilokitāḥ ||4.118.60|| lakṣaśo bhūmikāḥ kakṣāḥ saccidānandabhāyutāḥ | ekaikayā priyayā ca saha sthitaḥ patiḥ prabhuḥ ||61|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāḥ pratyekamandire | vilokitaḥ samastābhirdivyamuktānikādibhiḥ ||62||| sarvotkṛṣṭamahānandaghanavarṣaṇakāriṇaḥ | | vilokitāstatra kṛṣṇamaṇayaḥ kāntamūrtijāḥ ||63|| parāvarttanamaṇyo latākuñjamaṇivrajāḥ | mahodyānādimaṇayaścārāmamaṇayastathā ||64|| vilokitāḥ samastābhistatra ratnādihetavaḥ | hiraṇmayyaśriyaḥ sarvā lokitā vai samantataḥ ||65|| sūryacandrādimaṇayo darpaṇādarśapaṭṭakāḥ | vilokitāḥ samastābhiḥ raṃgamaholake’bhitaḥ ||66|| svasvarūpāṇi sarvāṇi vilokitāni tatra ca | rahasyamuktanivahaiḥ spṛhāvadbhirmaholake ||67|| atyāścaryamidaṃ tatra dṛṣṭipathamabhūd gatam | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtau sthitāyāṃ raṃgamaṇḍape ||68|| paradhāmasamastaṃ vai mastake tairvilokitam | akṣaraṃ dhāma hṛdaye māyādhāmodare tathā ||69|| avatārādidhāmāni mukhe vilokitāni vai | īśvarāṇāṃ tu lokāśca jadyane hyavalokitāḥ ||4.118.70 || brahmāṇḍāni pādayostu vilokitāni taistadā | liṅge saṃkarṣaṇarudraśaṃkarāstairvilokitāḥ ||71 || aniruddhā vedhasaśca nābhau tasya vilokitāḥ | pradyumnā viṣṇavastasya vṛṣaṇayorvilokitāḥ ||72|| mahāpumān mahākālo bhrakuṭau tasya lokitau | prakṛtiśca mahāmāyā tadicchāyāṃ vilokitā ||73||| sākṣī vāsudeva etau buddhau tasya vilokitau | kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇastasya bhujayostairvilokitau ||74|| priyāḥ sarvā harervāme pārśve kukṣau vilokitāḥ | ātmānaśca harerdakṣe narāḥ sarve vilokitāḥ ||75|| vihaṃgamāḥ pṛṣṭhadeśe yādāṃsi tu nitambake | vāme dakṣe tu tiryañcaḥ śākhinaḥ sarvaromasu ||76|| kandā romṇāṃ tu mūleṣu romakūpeṣu vallikāḥ | parvatāḥ kaṭhine tasya nadyo nāḍīṣu sarvaśaḥ ||77|| ekatattvātmake tasmin tasyaiva kṛpayā bahūn | bhedān vilokayāmāsū rahasyamuktakoṭayaḥ ||78|| surāṣṭraṃ tasya bhāle vai bhālamadhye’śvasārasam | tasya nijasvarūpāṇi vyalokayan hareḥ priyāḥ ||79|| āho’sya badrike pāro vaibhavānāṃ na gamyate | yadyanmūrtau ca tatsarvaṃ raṃgamaholake’bhitaḥ ||4.118.80|| vilokitaṃ priyābhirvai vyatiriktaṃ tadicchayā | punaśca kṛpayā tatra tatra vastuni mādhavaḥ ||8 1|| prakāśamagamad vastu tirobhāvamupāgamat | anvitaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīpativallabhaḥ ||82|| vilokitaḥ samastābhiḥ sarvātmako’bhitaḥ patiḥ | śarīrīva tadantaḥstho bahiḥsthaścāpi lokitaḥ ||83|| vastu vilīya sahasā lokitaḥ sa tadaikalaḥ | svarāṭ samrāṇmahārāṭ sa eka evādvitīyakaḥ ||84|| tatraikatāṃ tadā prāptā anādimuktakoṭayaḥ | paramuktakoṭayaśca lokitāḥ śrīharau tadā ||85|| mūrtimagnā jale yadvanmīnā iva hyasaṃkhyakāḥ | ekatvarasavettāraścāpṛthagbhāvamāsthitāḥ ||86|| na niḥsaranti te kvāpi mūrtilagnā bahiḥ kvacit | yeṣāṃ pāro na vā sīmā na saṃkhyā na ca mānakam ||87|| hyeṣā mūrtimayī sṛṣṭiḥ paradhāmno’tirekiṇī | vīkṣya tāṃ paramāścaryaṃ gatā rahasyamuktigāḥ ||88|| mānaṃ ca galitaṃ tāsāṃ nyūnasthityā tadagrataḥ | atha tāścārthayāmāsuḥ kānte sthitiṃ tu tādṛśīm ||89|| harirdadau ca vacanaṃ maholadarśanottaram | tato vai darśayāmāsa vāsamaholamuttamam ||4.118.90|| lakṣayojanamānaṃ ca sarvarddhipūrṇamacyutaḥ | tataśca darśayāmāsa śayyāmaholamuttamam ||91 || koṭyarbudābjakāntānāṃ śayyāparyaṃkamaṇḍitam | sarvaśṛṃgāraveṣārhottamadravyādisaṃbhṛtam ||92|| adṛṣṭapūrvamenaṃ ca dṛṣṭvāścaryaṃ paraṃ yayuḥ | atha svamandiraṃ paścād darśayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ||93|| yatra mātā kabhbharāśrīḥ pitā gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ | santuṣṭā ca svasāpyāste śukaśca bhagavānapi ||94|| vallabhaśca tathā teṣāṃ bhaktā vasanti sarvadā | tattanmūlasvarūpeṣu mātāpitrādikān hariḥ ||95|| sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ tatra kṛpayāntarabhāvayat | āścaryaṃ paramaṃ tadvai vīkṣya te’pi mudaṃ yayuḥ ||96|| tatraivoṣuryatheṣṭaṃ vai mātrādyā mandirālaye | sarvarddhisahite lakṣayojane divyavigrahe ||97|| atha snānamaholaṃ ca darśayāmāsa satpatiḥ | divyasnānavidhānāni vīkṣyāścaryaṃ paraṃ yayuḥ ||98|| prasravaṇāḥ samastāśca kṣīranīrājyamādhavāḥ | sudhāmṛtānandamodapramodādipravāhiṇaḥ ||99|| vīkṣitāḥ sarvasaugandhyamṛdupeśalavāryutāḥ | tatastābhirvīkṣitaśca khelamahola uttamaḥ || 4.118.10 0|| sarvānandaramaṇāni khelasādhanakāni ca | yatra divyāni vai santi kalpalabhyāni sarvathā || 101 || tataḥ śāntimaholaṃ ca darśayāmāsa keśavaḥ | sarvaśāntipradaṃ sarvaśāntisādhanasaṃbhṛtam || 1 02|| tataśca darśayāmāsa śṛṅgārodyānamuttamam | lakṣayojanavistāraṃ suśṛṃgāramaholakam || 1 03||| koṭyarbudābjapadmānāṃ śṛṅgāravastupūrakam | mūrtikalpalatāvyāptaṃ sarveṣṭasampradaṃ śubham || 1 04|| kuṃkumālaktakavallīḥ kajjalākṣatavallikāḥ | candanadravalatikā gandhasāradravadrumān || 1 05|| snehasāranavanītapiṇḍān mṛdurasānapi | vīkṣya modaṃ paraṃ prāptā rahasyamuktigāstadā || 1 06|| bhojanānāṃ maholaṃ ca darśayāmāsa muktikṛt | sarvavidhāsu divyāsvadivyāsu sarvasṛṣṭiṣu ||1 07|| yadyad bhojyaṃ bhakṣyavaryaṃ coṣyaṃ lehyaṃ ca pānakam | tasya sarvasya mūlaṃ vai divyaṃ bhojyaṃ samastakam || 1 08|| sarvaṃ daivaṃ caiśvaraṃ cāvatārīyaṃ ca moktikam | ātmīyaṃ brāhmamevāpi sarvaṃ tatra pravīkṣyatāḥ || 1 09|| spṛhāvatyo’bhavan bhoktuṃ bhojayāmāsa tatpatiḥ | cāntimāṃ paramāṃ tṛptiṃ bahirbhāvāṃ dadau prabhuḥ || 4.118.11 0|| tataḥ pūjāmaholaṃ ca lakṣayojanavistaram | sarvapūjārhaṇāyogyopaskāravastusaṃbhṛtam || 11 1|| darśayāmāsa bhagavān pūjāṃ pracakrire tu tāḥ | sarvāgamamaholaṃ ca darśayāmāsa dhāmapaḥ || 112|| sarvasṛṣṭinivāsānāmāgamārthakṛtakṣaṇam | samādhiyogināṃ yatra kṛṣṇayogaḥ prajāyate || 11 3|| yatraikake maṇau sarvasṛṣṭayo dṛṣṭigocarāḥ | prajāyante ca vīkṣyainaṃ bhaktasevāmaholakam || 1 14|| vyalokayam̐śca te muktā yatra sevāṃ hareḥ sadā | muktāḥ kurvanti vividhāṃ muktasevāṃ haristadā || 1 15|| parasparaprasevānāṃ vīkṣya sevakatāṃ tayoḥ | mahāścaryaṃ yayuḥ sarvāḥ paraṃ bhāgyaṃ hi menire || 1 16|| darśayāmāsa bhagavān svaṃ rahasyamaholakam | yatra kāntā imāḥ sarvāḥ kāntaṃ śrīkṛṣṇavallabham || 1 17|| sarvakāmapradā nityaṃ sevante śayanādiṣu | asaṃkhyakāntādhāmaitad vīkṣyāścaryaṃ gatāḥ striyaḥ || 1 18|| tataśca darśayāmāsa paṭṭāṃganāmaholakam | yatra śataṃ tathā catvāriṃśat santi nijāṃganāḥ || 1 19|| sahasrasevikāyuktāḥ pratyekaṃ svapatiṃ harim | sevante sarvadā badri vīkṣya modaṃ pralebhire ||4.118.120|| tāsu tāstā layaṃ prāptā nijamūlāsu yoṣitaḥ | atha śrībhagavān badri cāntaḥpuramaholakam || 121 || darśayāmāsa sarvāstā anantamānamṛddhidam | bhajante kāntabhāvena kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tu yāḥ || 1 22|| sarvasṛṣṭiṣu sarvatra sarvāstā yānti tatra ha | labhante kāntamevainaṃ cāntaḥpurākhyadhāmani || 123|| vīkṣya tāḥ paramāścaryaṃ prāpya vavandire patim | nijatādātmyayogārthaṃ mūrtau vāsāya sarvadā || 124||| harirvijñāya tadbhāvaṃ samāśleṣaṃ svavakṣasi | dadau premṇā dadau vāsaṃ cāntarbhāvya nije hṛdi || 1 25|| svamūrtau mūrtigarbhākhyasṛṣṭau vāsaṃ dadau sadā | koṭyarbudābjapatnīḥ svāḥ sakhībhiḥ sahitāḥ priyāḥ || 1 26|| antarbhāvya yayau kṛṣṇo nije raṃgamaholake | ekalo bhagavān kṛṣṇaścaikadhā bahudhāpi san || 1 27|| bhaktecchāpūrakaścaivaṃ svecchāsvatantrabhāgapi | svasmin svasyaiva vistāraṃ svaṃ samāveśayatprabhuḥ ||1 28||| putraputryādikaṃ sarvaṃ dāsadāsīpravistaram | svodbhāvitaṃ svavistāraṃ svasminnāveśayatprabhuḥ || 129|| atha kṣaṇāt tirobhūya kuṃkumavāpikālaye | lomaśena punaḥ svataḥprakāśena punastathā || 4.118.1 30|| lakṣmyā hṛdi sthayāśvinyā māṇikyayā ca vāhayā | vimānenāpi yuktaḥ śrīhariścāśvasaro yayau || 131 || prajñāpadmāvatīyukto jalaṃ papau jagadguruḥ | yātrāmetāṃ ca saptāyatanaṃ smaret tu yo janaḥ || 1 32|| sa
