yāyācchrīkṛṣṇasvāmyācāryaśrīharidhāma vai | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prajñā ca mādhavī || 1 33|| lakṣmīśca lomaśaḥ svataḥprakāśo māṇikī ca tat| | saptāyatanametadvai smartavyaṃ sarvadā janaiḥ || 1 34|| parabrahma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastisro’sya śaktayaḥ | jñānaśaktiḥ pramā cecchāśaktirlakṣmīḥ prakīrtitā || 1 35|| padmāvatī kriyāśaktirmāṇikyā śāśvatī chaviḥ | svataḥprakāśaḥ saṃkalpo lomaśo brahmaśīlatā || 136|| sthāpayet pūjayed yastān sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt | harermūrttaḥ prabhā kāntiḥ padmāvatī tu divyatā || 137|| lakṣmīśca kamanīyatvaṃ māṇikyā svacchatātmikā | svataḥprakāśaḥ paridhirlomaśo romarūpadhṛk || 138|| viditvaivaṃ saptarūpaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakam | pṛthaṅmuktimatikramya mūrtimuktiṃ prayāti saḥ || 1 39|| rādhāṃ duḥkhaharāṃ śaktiṃ lakṣmīṃ sampatpradāṃ tathā | prajñāṃ svarūpadāṃ śaktiṃ padmāvatīṃ tu mokṣadām || 4.118.140|| lomaśaṃ me’nādimuktaṃ brahma svayaṃprakāśitam | saptāyatanakaṃ tvevaṃ viditvā kṛṣṇarūpagam || 141|| muktiṃ yānti parāṃ tvevaṃ pare dhāmni na saṃśayaḥ | evamāha purā badri harirmāṃ parameśvaraḥ || 142|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne paradhāmani raṅgamaholādiṣoḍaśamaholānāṃ rahasyamuktebhyaḥ pradarśanaṃ, tadarddhipradarśana, svamūrtau sarvarddhisarvasṛṣṭipradarśanaṃ, śrīharimūrtigarbhagatānāditādātmyamuktasṛṣṭipradarśanaṃ, rahasyamuktānāṃ tatspṛhāvatāṃ mūrtigarbhatādātmyamuktipradānaṃ, saptāyatanasamaṣṭirūpahareḥ kuṃkumavāpīṃ pratyāgamanaṃ, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭādaśādhikaśata tamo’dhyāyaḥ || 118 ||
<4.119> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca badrike tā yā yatra vimānena yayuḥ striyaḥ | tatra tatreśvaraloke pratigṛhaṃ hariṃ patim || 1 || vyalokayan svargaloke satyādau parameśvaram | vairājeṣu tathā ceśvarāṇāṃ lokeṣu sarvaśaḥ || 2 || dhāmasvapyavatārāṇāṃ pratimuktaṃ hariṃ patim | vyalokayan tathā tāścākṣare dhāmni gṛhe gṛhe || 3 || sarvadurgāntarasṛṣṭau pratimuktaṃ hariṃ patim | pratigṛhaṃ tathānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇālayam || 4 || maholeṣu tathā kṛṣṇahṛdaye’pi ca mandiram | pratimuktaṃ pratimūrtiṃ vyalokayannijaṃ prabhum || 5 || vinānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ taddhṛdaye’pi ca | muktā naiva hi vartante mūrtau yatkoṭimūrtayaḥ || 6 || asaṃkhyamūrtayastatra pratimuktaṃ bhavantyapi | tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ tadā tatra mayā dṛṣṭaṃ tathā tadā || 7 || tādātmyatāmavāpsyanti ye te drakṣyanti tattathā | anyeṣāṃ darśanaṃ cāpi naiva bhavati tādṛśam || 8 || sarvotkṛṣṭā mūrtigarbhasṛṣṭistādātmyasaṃjñikā | dvitīyā tu pare dhāmni rahasyabhāvasṛṣṭikā || 9 || tṛtīyā tu pare dhāmni mahāmuktamayī hi sā | caturthī tu pare dhāmni muktasṛṣṭiḥ samānikā ||4.119.1 0|| aṣṭadurgamayī sarvā parabrahmaparāyaṇā | pañcamī tvakṣare dhāmni sṛṣṭiścākṣaramuktigā || 1 1|| ṣaṣṭhī sarvāvatārāṇāṃ dhāmamayī tadātmikā | saptamī ceśvarāṇāṃ tu sṛṣṭiḥ sattvamayī śubhā || 1 2|| aṣṭamī tu triguṇānāṃ sṛṣṭirmāyāmayī tathā | navamī śaṃkarabrahmaviṣṇūnāṃ sṛṣṭiruttamā || 1 3|| daśamī siddhakoṭīnāṃ sṛṣṭiḥ sādhumayī śubhā | ekādaśī tu pitṝṇāṃ dvādaśī dyunivāsinām || 14|| trayodaśī maharṣīṇāṃ mānavānāṃ ca badrike | caturdaśī tiraścāṃ tu pañcadaśī tu śākhinām || 15|| ṣoḍaśī guṇadharmāṇāṃ sṛṣṭayaḥ ṣoḍaśa tvimāḥ | asṛṣṭiḥ paramātmāsāvanādipuruṣottamaḥ ||16|| sarvasṛṣṭidharo nāthaḥ sarvāntaryāmikaḥ prabhuḥ | anvitaḥ sarvasākṣī cānanvitastu svarāṭ paraḥ || 17|| anvitānanvitamiśro’vatārādisvarūpadhṛk | mokṣado bhaktasukhado dharmasthāpanavigrahaḥ || 18|| nāmirūpijagatāṃ sa netā hantā tadanvitaḥ | ityeṣāṃ sampravijñāyopaniṣadaṃ tu ṣoḍaśīm || 1 9|| virajyeta vimucyeta prayāyāt paramaṃ padam | na tasya punarāvṛttirya evaṃ veda ṣoḍaśīm ||4.119.20|| śrībadrīpriyovācakuṃkumavāpīmāgatya bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ | kiṃ cakāra tadācakṣva naranārāyaṇaprabho ||21|| śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāgatya bhūtale | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre cāturmāsyavrataṃ vyadhāt ||22|| aṣṭāviṃśatitamake nijaprākaṭyake’hani | ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamīprātaḥkāle nijotsavottaram ||2 3||| dadau dānāni bhagavān svarṇaratnagavāṃ tathā | prāsādānāṃ rūpyakāṇāṃ rajatānāṃ dvijātaye|| 24|| pātrāṇāṃ cāpi ratnānāṃ maṇīnāṃ vājināṃ tathā | vimānānāṃ ca yānānāṃ gajānāṃ viprajātaye || 25|| dadau dānāni bhagavān vastrāṇāṃ svarṇayoginām | bhūṣaṇānāṃ samastānāṃ paryaṃkānāṃ suvarcasām || 26|| mukuṭānāṃ kaṭakānāṃ śṛṃkhalānāṃ viśeṣataḥ | mauktikānāṃ sphaṭikānāṃ gomedānāṃ sutejasām || 27|| dadau dānāni bhagavān pādukānāṃ srajāṃ tathā | chatrāṇāṃ cāmarāṇāṃ ca vetrāṇāṃ svarṇapatriṇām || 288||| siṃhāsanānāṃ peṭānāṃ mañjuṣāṇāṃ dadau hariḥ | kapāṭānāṃ vṛsīnāṃ ca khaṣṭvānāṃ siṃhacarmaṇām || 29 || gajavyāghrarkṣahariṇadvipigavayacarmaṇām | dadau dantotthavastūnāṃ dānāni bālakṛṣṇakaḥ || 4.119.30 || kambalānāṃ kañcukīnāṃ kañcukānāṃ ca varmaṇām | śastrāṇāṃ ca vitānānāṃ bhūstarāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 31 || kauśeyānāmambarāṇāṃ dhautrāṇāṃ mūrddhavāsasām | sukañcūnā kaṭisthānāṃ raśanānāṃ dadau prabhuḥ || 3 2|| gendukānāṃ cakrakāṇāṃ kaśipūnāṃ ca tūlinām | tulānāṃ musalānāṃ colūkhalānāṃ jalabhṛtām || 33|| preṅkhāṇāṃ bāladolānāṃ ghaṭānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | sthālīnāṃ vāṭikānāṃ ca peṣaṇīnāṃ tathā dadau || 34|| cullīnāṃ vyajanānāṃ ca yantrāṇāṃ pādarakṣiṇām | kavacānāmūrmikānāṃ bāṇānāṃ dhanuṣāṃ tathā || 35|| śarāṇāṃ cāpi khaḍgāṇāṃ mudgarāṇāṃ pravidyutām | rajjūnāṃ darpaṇānāṃ ca keśaprasādhanārthinām || 36|| dadau dānāni ca guptadorakāṇāṃ janārdanaḥ | kṣetrāṇāṃ vāṭikānāṃ ca mahiṣīṇāṃ payomucām || 37|| sasyānāṃ ca kaṇānāṃ ca śubhānnānāṃ viśeṣataḥ | kalabhānāṃ śākhināṃ ca phalināṃ puṣpiṇāṃ tathā || 38 || dhanānāṃ kalaśānāṃ ca yūpānāṃ cāpi sampadām | gṛhopakaraṇānāṃ ca śayyānāṃ paramānasām || 39|| udyāmārāmavāpīnāṃ śakaṭānāṃ dadau hariḥ | śibikānāṃ maṇḍapānāṃ paṭamaṇḍaparūpiṇām ||4.119.40 || parabhittigṛhāṇāṃ ca varūthānāṃ viśeṣataḥ | palyāṇānāṃ ca dānāni kūpāmbālikaśṛṃgiṇām ||41 || niḥśreṇīnāṃ catuṣpādaghoṭīnāṃ paṭṭasevinām | droṇīnāṃ gargarīṇāṃ ca kusulānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||42|| toraṇānāṃ pradīpānāṃ ghaṇṭānāṃ vādyanāminām | dadau dānāni ca vīṇāvipañcīnāṃ janārdanaḥ ||43|| kaṇṭhīnāṃ kanyakānāṃ ca kośānāṃ bhṛtyayoṣitām | dāsānāṃ cāpi dāsīnāṃ dadau dānāni godhano ||44|| tālānāṃ pañcapātrāṇāṃ śāṭīnāṃ payasāṃ tathā | naktakānāṃ pragucchānāṃ pūgānāṃ mukhavāsinām ||45|| lekhinīnāṃ ca vedānāṃ vidyānāṃ dānakānyapi | mahānasīyavastūnāṃ sabhāsthānopayoginām ||46|| mahotsavādivastūnāṃ dadau dānāni vai hariḥ | dhātūnāṃ sarvajātīnāṃ daṃśamatsaranāśinām ||47|| vastraśayyāvitānānāṃ dadau dānottamāni saḥ | piṣṭānāṃ peṭikānāṃ ca nāvāṃ sauvarṇapakṣiṇām ||48|| āsanānāṃ catuṣkīṇāṃ dadau dānāni mādhavaḥ | ghargharīṇāṃ jhallarīṇāṃ strībhūṣāṇāṃ samastataḥ ||49|| makhapātropapātrāṇāṃ dadau dānāni gopajaḥ | vṛṣabhāṇāṃ vatsakānāṃ vatsikānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||4.119.50|| sthālānāṃ kuṇḍikānāṃ ca hīrakāṇāṃ dadau prabhuḥ | śarkarāṇāṃ ca gūḍānāṃ miṣṭānāṃ madhugandhinām ||51 || madhūnāṃ navanītānāṃ ghṛtānāṃ ca dadau prabhuḥ | dvidalānāṃ ca dhānyānāmakṣatānāṃ dadau tathā ||52|| godhūmānāṃ caṇakānāṃ mudgānāṃ parameśvaraḥ | munyannānāṃ tathā kamaṇḍalūnāṃ śreṣṭharūpiṇām ||53|| darvīnāṃ sruksruvādīnāṃ camacīnāṃ dadau prabhuḥ | mahāsthālātiśālānāṃ śirastrāṇādibandhinām ||54|| rājaveṣādiveṣāṇāṃ dadau dānāni badrike | kārpāsānāṃ śaṇānāṃ ca māṣāṇāṃ ca rameśvaraḥ ||55|| saktūnāṃ rājamāṣāṇāṃ kaṅgūnāṃ pradadau tathā | rasānāṃ cāpi gandhānāṃ candanānāṃ dravātmanām ||56|| kastūrīṇāṃ tathā śreṣṭhakarpūrāṇāṃ dadau prabhuḥ | elālavaṃgajāvaṃtrījāyaphalādigandhinām ||57|| rājikāśuṇṭhikātiktakaṭūnāṃ dānakānyapi | bhakṣyāṇāṃ cāpi bhojyānāṃ lehyānāṃ cūṣyatāvatām |||58||| carvaṇārhakaṇānāṃ ca lavaṇānāṃ dadau tathā | veṣavārottamānāṃ ca kandānāṃ śākapatriṇām ||59|| āranālādimūlānāmikṣūṇāmamblapuṣpiṇām | takrāṇāṃ ca carūṇāṃ ca kṣīrāṇāṃ dānakāni ca ||4.119.60|| śukānāṃ pañjarasthānāṃ menakānāṃ ca pakṣiṇām | sārikāṇāṃ ghātakānāṃ garuḍānāṃ dadau prabhuḥ ||6 1 || kokilānāṃ tittirāṇāṃ bhāradvājādipakṣiṇām | mayūrāṇāṃ ca haṃsānāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ bahuśṛṃgiṇām ||62||| ghoṭakānāṃ tathoṣṭrāṇāṃ dadau dānāni dānakṛt | devānāṃ ca pratimānāṃ jīvikānāṃ tathā dadau ||63|| puttalīnāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ puttalānāṃ dadāvapi | brahmāṇḍānāṃ ghaṭānāṃ ca guptadānāni vai dadau ||64|| śālānāṃ mandirāṇāṃ ca saṃhitānāṃ dadau tathā | śirastrāṇoṣṇiṣāṃ prāvaraṇānāṃ kalpaśākhinām ||65|| kalpalatānāṃ dānāni dadau śrīparameśvaraḥ | vajramaṇīn dadau muktāmaṇīn supadmarāgakān ||66|| indranīlānmarakatān vaidūryān pradadau hariḥ | karketanān puṣparāgān bhīṣmakām̐śca maṇīn dadau ||67|| pulakān rudhirān sarvān sphaṭikān pradadau prabhuḥ | vidrumān kaustubhān cintāmaṇīn dadau pareśvaraḥ ||68|| māṇikyān candrahāsām̐śca pāraśān svarṇadām̐stathā | sūryakāntān divyakācān kācayantrāṇi dīpikāḥ ||69|| taijasīrhāṇḍikāścāpi jhumbharān bahuśobhagān | pradadau sarvaśaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo dvijātaye ||4.119.70|| kanyābhyo bahuratnāni kumārebhyo’pi vai dadau | dīnānāthātithibhikṣusadbhyo dadau prabheśvaraḥ ||71 || hiraṇyaparvatadānaṃ tilaparvatamārpayan | suvarṇamedinīdānaṃ kalpapādapadānakan ||72|| hemadhenupradānaṃ ca svarṇalakṣmīpradānakam | tiladhenupradānaṃ ca gosahasrapradānakam ||73|| hiraṇyāśvapradānaṃ ca cakre padmāvatīśvaraḥ | kanyādānāni dīnānāmadāpayat satīpatiḥ ||74|| hiraṇyavṛṣadānaṃ ca suvaṇagajadānakam | lokapālāṣṭakadānaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivārpaṇam ||75|| cakāra sa satāṃ nātho hyaśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe | śrāddhāni vividhānyeṣaścakāra tarpaṇaṃ dadau ||76|| pitṛśrāddhāni sarvāṇi mātṛśrāddhāni yānyapi | nāndīśrāddhāni sarvāṇi cakāra kṛṣṇa eva saḥ || 77|| yadyat kṛṣṇena lokebhyaḥ pūjāyāṃ tu samarpitam | rājadevarṣipitṛbhyaśceśvarebhyaḥ samarjitam ||78 || śreṣṭhibhyaścāpi daityebhyo dānavebhyastathārjitam | yakṣebhyo rākṣasebhyaśca nāgebhyo yadupārjitam ||79|| bhaktebhyaścāpi muktebhyaḥ svabhujābhyāṃ samarjitam | tatsarvaṃ svadhanaṃ cāpi svapatnīnāṃ dhanānyapi ||4.119.8 0 || koṭyarbudābjapadmāni dadau dāne harīśvaraḥ | prāsādikaṃ hareryadvai sarvaṃ divyaṃ ca mokṣadam || 81 || matvā matvā dānapātraṃ bhūtvā bhūtvā surādayaḥ | īśvarāścāpi muktāśca brahmakṣatrādvijātayaḥ ||82|| anyavarṇāścāpi kṛṣṇaprasādamahimecchayā | jagṛhurbhikṣukā bhūtvā sarve yat kṛṣṇabhikṣukāḥ ||8 2|| yairyaiḥ prāptāni divyāni vastūni kṛṣṇahastataḥ | te te tadvastuyogena bhūtvā tu pāpavarjitāḥ ||84|| mahāpuṇyāśrayā bhūtvā bhūtvā divyaguṇālayāḥ | sattvaprakarṣavantaste bhūtvā bhaktā hareḥ khalu ||85|| dehānte te yayuḥ smṛtvā tadyogena paraṃ harim | paraṃ dhāma yayurbrahmalokaṃ lokaṃ tathākṣaram ||8 6|| vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāpi golokaṃ śrīpuraṃ cāmṛtaṃ padam | avyākṛtapadaṃ cāpi yayurviṣṇupadaṃ hyapi ||87|| aho śrībadrike yairyergṛhītaṃ tatprasādakam | te te dāridryahīnāścābhavan pṛthvyāṃ samṛddhayaḥ ||88 || ante’bhavan hareryoge parame mokṣabhāginaḥ | ye’pi dānāni kṛṣṇasya praśaśaṃsurmudānvitāḥ ||89|| guṇaṃ ca jagṛhurye’pi te’pi mokṣagatiṃ yayuḥ | kṛṣṇapradattadhenūnāṃ pītāni yaiḥ payāṃsyapi || 4.119.90 || te’pi dhāma yayustasya prasādasya pratāpataḥ | hīrakādyanvitā mālāḥ kṛṣṇaprasādamūrtayaḥ || 91 || dehe dhṛtāśca yairbhūṣā vastrāṇyapi dhṛtāni yaiḥ | paryaṃkādyā upabhuktā veṣā dhṛtāḥ supāvanāḥ ||92|| yānavāhanaśakaṭānovimānāni yairapi | adhiṣṭhitāni dhiṣṇyāni prasādapāvanāni vai ||93 || gṛhāṇi ca rajāṃsi śrīkṛṣṇapādasya yairapi | yābhiścāpi dhṛtānyeva dehe te tā yayuḥ param || 94|| kṛṣṇaprasādalabdhāni phalānyattāni yairapi | bṛsyāsanāni kauśeyakambalādīni yānyapi ||95|| adhiṣṭhitāni yaiste’pi pūtāḥ paraṃ padaṃ yayuḥ | badrike bhagavānnityaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe || 96|| lakṣaviprān lakṣapatnīyutān dvilakṣabālakān | lakṣakanyākumārām̐śca lakṣadīnātithīn sataḥ || 97|| lakṣasādhujanān lakṣasādhvīrlakṣādhibhikṣukān | bhojayatyeva bhāvena miṣṭānnāni śubhāni vai || 98|| gariṣṭāni sugandhāni vaṃhvājyāni sadā sadā | kṣīrapāyasayuktāni laḍḍukaiḥ sahitānyapi ||99|| meśubhāni ca śākāni suramyāṇyodanāni ca | dadhibhaktāni sājyāni bhojayatyeva nityaśaḥ || 4.119.10 0|| pānatāmbūlakādyaiśca mukhavāsairanuttamaiḥ | dakṣiṇābhiḥ svarṇamudrābhiśca toṣayati dvijān || 101 || varṣakāle samāyātaṃ cāṣṭāviṃśaṃ mahodinam | svajanmano haristatra pūjito viprabhūmipaiḥ || 1 02|| devairmuktaiḥ pitṛbhiśca prajābhirvaiṣṇavaistathā | sādhubhiḥ sarvalokānāṃ dehibhiḥ pūjitaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 03|| nityaṃ prapūjyate tadvat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ | dadāti pūjakānāṃ ca muktiṃ paraṃ pade nijam || 1 04|| badrike bhavane naije rājate’śvasarastaṭe | sarvaduḥkhaharaḥ svāmīśrīkṛṣṇo vallabhaḥ prabhuḥ ||1 05|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne bhagavān svopārjitāsaṃkhyasamṛddhīnāṃ dānāni cakāretyādinirūpaṇanāmā navadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 19||
<4.120> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca badrike śrīharikṛṣṇo vānaprasthaḥ samādvayam | atiṣṭhata mahāśānto mahāvratadharaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 || brahmavrataparo nityaṃ bhaktimārgaprabodhakṛt | ṛṣīṇāṃ ca satāṃ yogiyatīnāṃ maṇḍalaiḥ suyuk || 2 || ātmadhyānaparaścāpi vartate tyāgaśīlavān | sādhyāḥ siddhāḥ samāyānti sabhāyāṃ harisannidhau || 3 || kathāvārtāḥ pravartante hyādhyātmikyo hi mokṣadāḥ | bahavo dehino dīkṣāṃ labdhvā yānti paraṃ padam || 4 || badrike śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’pi niṣparigrahaḥ | sarvavyavahāramuktastyāgimārgaṃ samaihata || 5 || tyāgisādhumahādīkṣāṃ samaicchallomaśādguroḥ | prārthayallomaśaṃ cāpi kārtike śuklapakṣake || 6 || ekādaśyāṃ mahādīkṣāṃ grahītuṃ parameśvaraḥ | āśramakramarakṣārthaṃ dharmasthāpanahetave || 7 || parameśo’pi bhagavān mahādīkṣāṃ samaihata | dharmasyāpi sunirmātā dharmamūrtirvidhāyakaḥ || 8 || āśramāṇāṃ sadādhāro mahādīkṣāṃ samaihata | yasmād dīkṣāḥ pravartante makhā vratāni vai yataḥ || 9 || yadicchāyāṃ mahāmokṣaḥ so’pi dīkṣāṃ samaihata | yadvacastacchrutivākyaṃ yatsaṃkalpo vidhirmataḥ || 4.120.1 0|| yatprasādāt phalaṃ sarvaṃ yatprapattiḥ parātparā | yadīkṣaṇaṃ mahādīkṣā so’pi dīkṣāṃ samaihata || 1 1|| dīkṣayā yatphalaṃ proktaṃ yajjñānaṃ dīkṣayāpyate | yayāghānāṃ kṣālanaṃ ca yadanugrahato bhavet || 1 2|| yāṃ vināpi svayaṃ śakto mokṣaṃ dātuṃ nijecchayā | so’pi sarvāvatāreśo mahādīkṣāṃ samaihata || 1 3|| yatsparśaḥ śastramātrādidvārako mokṣaṇāya vai | pāpināmapi jīvānāṃ so’pi dīkṣāṃ samaihata || 14|| yatsparśaḥ kāmanāpūrvaḥ strīṇāmuddhārakṛt sadā | āśleṣo muktijanakaḥ so’pi dīkṣāṃ samaihata || 15|| yasyāṅguṣṭhajñalaṃ gaṃgā mokṣadā sarvadehinām | yadbhaktā mokṣadāścāpi sopi dīkṣāṃ samaihata || 1 6|| badrike dīkṣayā yatra gantavyaṃ so’sti yaḥ svayam | yadyogena khadehāśca yātā yānti paraṃ padam || 17|| brahmapriyādyā muktāśca yena nītā nijaṃ padam | rakṣitāstatra tenaiva divyadehena yena tu || 18|| yanmantrāptermokṣadāśca bhavanti sādhavo janāḥ | mokṣadāḥ sarvajīvānāṃ so’pi dīkṣāṃ samaihata || 1 9|| yadaiśvaryakaṇaṃ prāpya dīkṣāṃ mokṣaṃ dadātyapi | so’pi dīkṣābhikṣukaḥ san mahādīkṣāṃ samaihata ||4.120.20|| romaśo lomaśaścāpi yadupāsanābhavat | mahāmukto maharṣiśca cirāyurmokṣadaḥ sadā ||21 || sarvakalyāṇakṛt sādhuviprarṣiḥ pāvanaḥ paraḥ | tasmādupāsakāt kṛṣṇo mahādīkṣāṃ samaihata ||22|| sarvopāsyo harirbhaktānupāste premasamplutaḥ | so’yaṃ kṛṣṇo’pi bhagavānupāste lomaśaṃ munim ||23|| śikṣako bālamadhyāpya bālād gṛhṇāti sāravat | dīkṣako munimadhyāpya munergṛhṇāti dakṣiṇam ||24|| evaṃ paramparāṃ pūrvapūrveṣāṃ sṛṣṭirakṣaṇe | rakṣituṃ tāṃ mahādīkṣāṃ lomaśāt kṛṣṇa aihata || 25|| daśamyāṃ śrīhariścakre hyupoṣaṇaṃ sunirjalam | pañcagavyāśanaṃ cakre dehaśuddhiprayojakam ||26|| tathāghamarṣaṇaṃ cakre tīrthasnānādibhistathā | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ cakre gītakīrtanamaṅgalaiḥ ||27|| prātarutthāya vai snānaṃ dhyānaṃ cakre nijātmanaḥ | pūjanaṃ pracakārāpi devānāṃ ca vidhānataḥ |||28|| kṣauraṃ prakārayāmāsa sasnau tīrthādivāribhiḥ | śrāddhādi pracakārāpi pitṛtṛptikaraṃ śubham |||29|| kuṇḍaṃ ca maṇḍapaṃ ramyaṃ kārayāmāsa satvaram | puṇyāhaṃ vācayāmāsa jalaṃ mumoca bhūtale ||4.120.30 || ācamanaṃ tathā nyāsān pracakāra vidhānataḥ | prāṇāyāmān vidhāyātha cakre gaṇeśapūjanam ||3 1 || vāstudevādyarhaṇaṃ ca vardhanīkalaśārhaṇam | kuṇḍamaṇḍapadevānāmarhaṇaṃ pracakāra ca |||22|| grahāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ sarvadikpālānāṃ prapūjanam | lokapālārhaṇaṃ cāpi ṛṣipitrarhaṇaṃ tathā ||33|| devīdevatāpūjāṃ ceśvarāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā | īśanīnāṃ pūjanaṃ cāvatārāṇāṃ prapūjanam |||34|| mātṛkāṇāṃ yoginīnāṃ satīnāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā | muktānāṃ pūjanaṃ muktānikānāṃ pūjanaṃ tataḥ ||35|| parabrahmārhaṇaṃ cakre sarvatattvārhaṇaṃ tathā | kāśyapīnāṃ prajānāṃ ca pūjanaṃ pracakāra saḥ || 36|| prāyaścittavidhiṃ cakre havanaṃ pracakāra ca | vahnipūjāṃ vahnimukhasarvadevapratarpaṇam ||37||| cakāra bhagavān homaṃ kṣīrājyapāyasodbhavam | phalapuṣpamadhūnāṃ ca samidhāṃ havyasañjuṣām || 38|| kavyānāṃ havanaṃ cakre piṇḍānāṃ ca pradānakam | śrīphalādyairmahāhomaṃ cakre ca ghṛtadhārayā || 39|| madhye vyāvartya vastrāṇi kāṣāyāṇi dadhāra saḥ | dhautraṃ cāṃgarakṣakaṃ cottarāsaṃgaṃ samuṣṇiṣam ||4.120.40|| yajñopavītakaṃ pracchadapaṭīṃ cottarīyakam | pāduke ca dadhārāpi kaupīnaṃ ca kamaṇḍalūn ||41 || tilakaṃ candrakaṃ cakre cāndanaṃ kauṃkuma tathā | śikhāṃ baddhvā ca gāyatrīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ jagṛhe guroḥ ||42|| parabrahmaṇe vidmahe’nādikṛṣṇāya dhīmahi | tanno hariḥ pracodayādīti jagrāha lomaśāt ||43|| oṃ parabrahmāhamasmītyaṣṭākṣaraṃ ca jagṛhe | omanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’stu śaraṇaṃ mama ||44|| ṣoḍaśākṣaramantraṃ ca jagṛhe lomaśānmuneḥ | ityevaṃ prāpya mantrām̐strīn trivāraṃ praṇanāma tam |||45|| lomaśaṃ ca tathā vahniṃ devānnatvā pradakṣiṇam | pracakre daṇḍavat sādhuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyanaḥ ||46|| devaprasādaṃ jagṛhe pupūja lomaśaṃ gurum | upadāḥ pradadau divyāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ svarṇamayīṃ tathā ||47|| dakṣiṇāṃ pradadau cāpi tyāgī bhūtvā janārdanaḥ | kṛṣṇavat labhyate yaḥ saḥ śrīkṛṣṇo vallabho’bhavat ||48|| vaiṣṇavo vai parabrahma haṃsovijñānaśobhanaḥ | sādhurūpaḥ parabrahma haṃsastyāgāśramī prabhuḥ || 49|| svāmī nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sarvavallabhatāṃ gataḥ | parameśaḥ svāmibhāve vartate sarvadāpi saḥ ||4.120.50|| dīkṣayā svāmitāṃ prāpya svāmisvāmo tato’bhavat | brahmacaryaṃ vrataṃ nityaṃ bhaktivrataṃ mahattamam ||51|| pālayāmāsa bhagavān kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇāyanaḥ | dīkṣākāle maṇḍape ca maharṣisādhusādhvikāḥ || 52|| āśīrvādān dadustatra śreyase paramātmane | vireje bhagavān dvedhā kāṣāyāmbaradhṛk tathā ||53|| rājādhirājarūpo’pi sarveṣāṃ mānaseṣu saḥ | dīkṣākāle tu vādyāni hyavādyanta samantataḥ ||54|| vedamantrā maharṣīṇāṃ gītayaḥ surayoṣitām | mānavīnāṃ kīrtanāni maṇḍapādau tadābhavan ||55|| upadeśaṃ ca dīkṣāṃ ca labdhvā tyāgāśramaṃ śubham | pūrṇāhutiṃ vyadhāddhomaṃ dadau dānāni vai tadā |||56|| svarṇahīrakarūpyāṇāṃ ratnagodhanavāsasām | parṇaśālāṃ vinā sarvaṃ pradadau bhavanādikam ||57|| lomaśasyāśrame paścācchiṣyarūpo’vasatprabhuḥ | asaṃkhyasādhusañjuṣṭe tyāgināṃ maṇḍale hariḥ ||58|| nyavasat śāntacittātmā sādhusevākṛtādaraḥ | asaṃkhyajīvajātānāṃ mokṣe tu satataṃ rataḥ ||59|| lakṣmīstadā pṛthag bhūtvā sādhvī kāṣāyadhāriṇī | astaut svāmisvarūpaṃ śrīparabrahmaprahaṃsakam ||4.120.60|| oṃ namaḥ śrīparabrahma te namaḥ paramātmane | brahmamuktādhipataye paradhāmanivāsine ||61|| apṛthaṅmuktasaṃsthāya rahasyamuktasevine | namaste śrīraṅgamaholādivāsāya yogine ||62||| nirlepāya mahāmuktānādimuktādisevine | ākṣarairmuktavṛndaiśca sevitāya ca te namaḥ ||63|| avatārairīśvarādyaiḥ sevitāya ca te namaḥ | ṛṣipitṛsurādyaiśca sevitāya ca te namaḥ ||64|| mānavaiścetaraiścāpi yakṣagandharvakinnaraiḥ | nāgaiḥ sarpai rākṣasaiśca sevitāya ca te namaḥ ||65|| udbhijjarāsvedajaiśca prasevitāya te namaḥ | naraiśca pramadābhiśca sarvasthāvarajaṅgamaiḥ ||66|| puṣṭyarthaṃ saṃsevitāya sukhadāya ca te namaḥ | asaṃkhyayogināṃ kāmapūrakāya ca te namaḥ ||67|| asaṃkhyānāṃ svabhaktānāṃ tārakāya ca te namaḥ | māṇikyāyā badaryāśca nāthāya te namo namaḥ ||68|| badaro nāma rājarṣirvyadhād badarikāśramam | yatkṛpāṃśāt svāminaṃ taṃ vande badarikeśvaram ||69|| hemānalāsuro yena parvatādho niṣūditaḥ | tasya badaranṛpateḥ prasannāya ca te namaḥ ||4.120.70|| badarīsvīyamūlādho hemānalamamardayat | yatpratāpena taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ natāsmi sādhurūpiṇam ||71 || badaro rasārūpo’pi yatkṛpāto vyajāyata | phale taṃ paramātmānaṃ vande śrīsvāminaṃ tviha ||72|| naro’pi bījatāṃ prāpto badarākhye phale sadā | yatkṛpātastaṃ phaleśaṃ vande śrīsvāminaṃ prabhum ||73|| śrīśīlasya tu viprasya pretabhūtasya mokṣaṇam | badarasva pradānena kṛtaṃ yena ca te namaḥ ||74|| sādhusādhvīsvarūpābhyāṃ dārābhāgyāya darśanam | datvāpyamokṣayad bhūpaṃ taṃ yastasmai ca te namaḥ |||75|| brahmadevadvijapatnyai datvā dve badare phale | badrikā putrikāputrau dadau badrīśa te namaḥ ||76|| yatpratāpāt kṛṣṇapatnī jātā vai bālayoginī | sureśvarīsutā taṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vande narāyaṇam ||77|| yaḥ kṛṣṇo divyadehāṃ ca cāraṇīṃ nāgnakesarīm | kṛtvā muktānikāṃ ninye’kṣaraṃ tasmai namo namaḥ ||78|| narmakartryā vinodinyāḥ sādhuyogena mokṣaṇam | kṛtaṃ yena kṛto devaloko’pi ca sakhīvidhaḥ ||79|| mokṣaṃ tasmai dadau yaśca tasmai te svāmine namaḥ | bāhulakāya tatpatnyai līlāvatyai ca nartanāt ||4.120.80|| dadau brahmarasaṃ mokṣaṃ tuṣṭo yaste namaḥ sadā | māliyānaṃ mallikāṃ ca mālākārau hariḥ purā ||81 || prasannaḥ pāyayāmāsa brahmarasaṃ tatastayoḥ | mokṣaṇaṃ kṛtavān kṛṣṇo yastasmai svāmine namaḥ ||82|| nikāmadevasaṃjñāya dhīśūrāya hariḥ svayam | mokṣaṃ dadau ca tatpatnyai tasmai śrīsvāmine namaḥ ||83|| nigaḍabhrāmakaivartaṃ matsyāśāpāt suduḥkhinam | tāritaṃ bhaktayā patnyā yasya kṛpādiśevadheḥ ||84|| anayaḥ svaṃ paraṃ dhāma tayā sākaṃ ca yoṣitā | tathā tatputrikā cādyā sādhvī puṇḍarikā satī || 85|| nirvāṇikā satī cānyānandaghanā tṛtīyakā | tathā pañcātmajā jñānadarbhyādayo’pi yaṃ prabhum ||86|| bhajitvā mokṣaṇaṃ prāptāstaṃ bhaje svāminaṃ harim | kṛtaghnyāstu kuthalyākhyastriyā yo rājayakṣmataḥ ||87|| rakṣāṃ cakre dadau mokṣaṃ taṃ vande svāminaṃ prabhum | pratāraṇyā viṣalāṇyāḥ satāṃ samāgamāddhariḥ ||88|| uddhāraṃ kṛtavān yastaṃ vande śrīsvāminaṃ prabhum | gaṃgāṃjanīṃ kaṭakartrīṃ satsaṃgena tvamokṣayat ||89|| ramāñjanīṃ ramāṃ cakre yastasmai haraye namaḥ | sunāriṇīṃ kulālīṃ ca raṇastambaṃ ca tatpatim ||4.120.90|| sādhuyogena tatputraṃ saṃsārād yo vyamocayat | vande taṃ svāminaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vallabhaṃ prabhumīśvaram ||9 1|| svarṇakārastriyā hemasudhāyāstu prabhaktitaḥ | prasanno yo dadau tasyai cānnapūrṇātvamuttamam ||92|| muktiṃ dadau tathānte ca vande śrīsvāminaṃ harim | rādhikāyanayogena vidrumiṇīṃ tu viṣṭiṇīm ||93|| dhāmni rādhāsamāṃ cakre yastasmai svāmine namaḥ | śvapacīṃ mālavānīṃ yo dharmayogena muktigām ||94|| sakuṭumbāmakarod yastasmai śrīsvāmine namaḥ | rathyāmārjanikāṃ kārelikāṃ hitāñjalermuneḥ |||95||| yogāt kathāśravaṇena muktimanayad yaḥ prabhuḥ | hetāñjaleśca putrīṇāṃ nirmohitvaṃ ca yadbalāt ||96|| mokṣaṇaṃ kṛtavān yaśca tasmai te’stu namo muhuḥ | nirañjanādayaścāpi bhrātaraḥ pañca tādṛśāḥ ||97|| muktiṃ yena praṇītāstaṃ vande śrīsvāminaṃ prabhum | yantrakartrīṃ gomatīṃ ca nayarājaṃ ca tatpatim ||98|| arakṣayat rājayakṣmato yastaṃ staumi māvaram | kanakāṃgadāyāḥ kṛṣṇo dhūrtāyā mokṣaṇaṃ vyadhāt ||99|| bhāṇavāṇyā dyūtakartryāḥ śreyaścakāra yo hariḥ | rāyaharinṛpasyāpi taṃ vande svāminaṃ prabhum || 4.120.10 0|| mādhavarāyanṛpateḥ śreyo vyadhāttu yaḥ prabhuḥ | vaidyotikāṃ tu kaṃsārīṃ divyāmamokṣayacca yaḥ || 10 1|| nararājaṃ kuṃbhakāraṃ tadbhāryāṃ ratnikāṃ ca yaḥ | ambālikāṃ svarṇakartrīṃ dhātudhmāṃ ca vinodinīm || 1 02|| amokṣayaddhariryaśca naṭaṃ rañjanakovidam | śrīrāmasundaraṃ cāpi kadaryaṃ yo’pyamokṣayat || 1 03|| vande taṃ paramātmānaṃ svāminaṃ dīkṣitaṃ prabhum | kṣīrodavīraṃ bhūpaṃ ca rājñīṃ ruhāriṇīṃ ca yaḥ || 1 04|| gaṇikāṃ somikāṃ pañcaputrīyutāmamokṣayat | aruṇānīpatiṃ pāṭalānyādīśaṃ namāmi tam || 1 09|| madyapāyā liyāryāśca mokṣaṇaṃ yo vyadhāt prabhuḥ | miṣṭāsavadhvajinaśca taṃ vande svāminaṃ harim || 1 06|| gaṇḍavātābhidhāyāśca cakriṇyāmokṣaṇaṃ vyadhāt | yāskavādasya ca mokṣaṃ taṃ vande svāminaṃ harim || 1 07|| nindākartryā ṭviḥrvadantyā mokṣaṇaṃ yo vyadhātprabhuḥ | dvirgarjanākhyapatyuśca taṃ vande svāminaṃ harim || 1 08|| suraprasādaṃ vipraṃ ca gurughnaṃ yo hyamocayat | mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tasya cāmokṣayattu yaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 09|| nāgavikramabhūpasya devadroharatasya ca | navadrohiyutasyāpi mokṣakartre tu te namaḥ || 4.120.11 0|| śālamitro jīvikāghno jayālakṣmīśca tatpriyā | uddhṛtau yena kṛṣṇena tasmai śrīsvāmine namaḥ || 111 || kanyāghnaṃ yaddharājaṃ yo viṣadaṃ sādhuyogataḥ | amocayad yamadūtān taṃ bhaje svāminaṃ harim || 11 2||| sādhujīvaṃ kumāraṃ ca kumārīṃ sādhujīvanīm | nirviṣādaṃ ca yaḥ kṛṣṇo’mokṣayat taṃ muhurnamaḥ || 11 3|| nārāyaṇyai prabhāvatyai ghaṭamālākhyayoṣite | mokṣaṇaṃ pradadau yaśca tasmai śrīsvāmine namaḥ || 1 14|| anaṃgavallyāḥ kuṭṭanyāstatsakhīnāṃ ca mokṣaṇam | kṛtavān yaḥ prabhuḥ svāmī tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ || 115|| ṣaṇḍhavajrābhidhaṃ ṣaṇḍhaṃ yaḥ saṃsārād vyamocayat | napuṃsakānāṃ puṃstrītvaṃ cakre yaste namo muhuḥ || 11 6|| yavasandhaṃ tu māṃsādaṃ patnīṃ majāvalīṃ ca yaḥ | tatkuṭumbaṃ harirvyamocayat tasmai ca te namaḥ || 1 17|| bhāṇḍaṃ yo bhaṇḍaśīlaṃ tu sakuṭumbaṃ vyamocayat | trigālavām̐stathā bhavāyanādīn yo vyamocayat || 1 18|| harivīryādimallām̐ścamokṣayad yaḥ prabhurhariḥ | vārdhūṣikān harilālādīṃśca vyamokṣayattu yaḥ || 1 19|| kīravaṇādimṛgayūmamokṣayacca yaḥ prabhuḥ | amokṣayacca nāgādaṃ vādiṭaṃ yaśca te namaḥ || 4.120.1 20|| sārahāsīyamārtaṇḍamaṇḍalādipramokṣakam | vilāsadevaṃ luñcādaṃ vyamokṣayacca taṃ bhaje || 121|| daivān prakāśakādīṃśca tatputrān sādhudīkṣitān | mauktikāyanikādyāśca tatputrīḥ sādhvikāstathā || 122|| vyamokṣayacca yaḥ svāmī vande śrīsvāminaṃ ca tam | duritaghoṣanāmānaṃ sarvādaṃ yo vyamokṣayat || 1 23|| tatpatnīṃ ca mahāsatyāyanīṃ vyamokṣayacca yaḥ | tatputrān tatputrikāścāmokṣayad yaśca taṃ bhaje || 1 24|| dharmabhaṭaṃ mahāmātyaṃ śīlayānīṃ ca tatpriyām | amokṣayat prabhuryaḥ śrīsvāminaṃ taṃ sadā bhaje || 1 25|| dharmādhyakṣaṃ prabhurmukundasāvitramamokṣayat | nyāyākṣiṇīṃ ca tadbhāryāṃ yastaṃ vande janārdanam || 126 || viśālarekhakaṃ yaścauddhārayallekhakaṃ hariḥ | śucikāntāṃ ca tatpatnīṃ taṃ vande svāminaṃ prabhum || 1 27|| kṛṣṇakānteśvaronāthaṃ namāmi vallabham prabhum | kāyasthān karaṇādyān yo’mokṣayat parameśvaraḥ || 1 28|| śāhavilāpanādīṃścāmokṣayat taṃ namāmi ca | gṛdhra uddhārito yena pūrvakaulikadehavān || 129|| mārjāraścoddhṛto yena pūrvagobāragopakaḥ | jambūkaścoddhṛto yena purā ṭhaṭhūṭholako vaṇik || 4.120.130 || svarṇāñjanādayo bhṛtyā uddhṛtā yena śārṅgiṇā | śyenaḥ samuddhṛtaścāpi purā yo bharavāṭakaḥ || 131 || caṭakāścoddhṛtāḥ pūrve’jā yāstaṃ naumi mādhavam | kapotā uddhṛtā yena sārthavārāstu ye purā || 13 2|| kākāstathoddhṛtā yena purā ye kaṃkajātijāḥ | gṛhagodhoddhṛtā yena nāṇakī prāk khavāsinī || 133|| mūṣakā uddhṛtā yena prāk śūdrāḥ saṃghavāṭakāḥ | nakulaścoddhṛto yena prāk vāruṭastu sāgaraḥ || 1 34||| kīratārābhidho bhāṭa uddhṛto yena taṃ bhaje | jyotirvettā devagatīśvaro yena samuddhṛtaḥ || 1 35||| puṇyavatī ca tadbhāryoddhṛtā yena namāmi tam | bandijano jayamāno nṛpaśca vajravikramaḥ || 1 36|| prajāścāpyuddhṛtā yena vande śrīsvāminaṃ hi tam | saptābdhisiṃhanṛpatiḥ sūtastasya sukesarī || 1 37|| rājñī rakṣāvatī yena mokṣitāstaṃ namāmyaham | māgadho harṣanayano yogidāsaśca sevakaḥ || 1 38|| yena saurabhasāvitrastāmbūlakṛt samuddhṛtaḥ | raṃgilo raṃgakāraśca ḍamarūkaśca vādyakṛt || 1 39|| cihnarāyo bhāvasāraścoddhṛto yena taṃ bhaje | rameśvaro grāmayājī tathoddhṛto’pi yena ha || 4.120.140|| svarṇāstaraṇo vidyādhraścitrabarhādayastathā | uddhṛtāḥ kinnarā yena kiṃpumāṃsaśca cāraṇāḥ || 141 || asaṃkhyāśca nṛpā yenoddhṛtāstaṃ tvāṃ namāmi ca | nandibhillaṃ hatavān yo rarakṣa nāgavikramam || 142|| hataṃ sainyaṃ punaḥ sañjīvayāmāsa namāmi tam | purañjayanṛpaṃ hyamokṣayad yastaṃ namāmyaham || 143|| mokṣitā yena bahavaḥ saptasvarganivāsinaḥ | saptapātālavāsāśca taṃ namāmi mahāprabhum || 144|| īśvarebhyaśca dhārmibhyo darśanaṃ yo dadau prabhuḥ | sarvastrīdāsavargāḍhyastaṃ bhaje puruṣottamam || 145|| sarvastrībhyo nijābhyaśca yugalāpatyakāni yaḥ | mānasāni dadau tasmai namaḥ śrīparamātmane || 146|| māyāpālo nṛpo mahānāstiko yamalokataḥ | mocito yena kṛṣṇena taṃ bhaje sādhusatkṛtim || 147|| jyeṣṭhaputrāya ca dīlāvarīrājyaṃ dadau tataḥ | svayaṃ patnīdarśayituṃ yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ prati || 148|| dhāma nītvā nijān sarvān sarvāśca pramadāstathā | pare dhāmni svīyamūrtau vāsaṃ datvā hyarakṣayat || 149|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetramāgatya tyāgamāpya yaḥ | sādhudīkṣāṃ parigṛhya vartate sākṣigocaraḥ || 4.120.150|| namāmi svāmine tasmai śrīkṛṣṇaprabhave namaḥ | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyanāya yogine || 151 || yaḥ sadā śrīhariścāste saptāyatanamūrtimān | līnā lakṣmīryadaṃge’haṃ varte sāmaparāyaṇā || 152|| prajñā līnā pāśavatī līnā ca svāmini prabhau | yallīlāḥ śreyase sarvā jīvānāṃ karmadehinām || 153||| tasmai te pataye cāpyapataye praṇamāmyaham | sarvadānīśvaravaryottamāya paramātmane || 154|| namo viśiṣṭarūpāya sarvatīrthātitīrthine | tīrthārthaṃ bhagavan svāmin lokakalyāṇahetave || 155|| abhilāṣā jāyate me mahātmam̐stāṃ prapūrayaḥ | asaṃkhyajanmabhiḥ kṛṣṇoddhṛtāstvayā hi dehinaḥ || 156|| dharmavṛddhiḥ kṛtā sarvā punaścāpi vibhāvaya | lakṣmībhaktā bahavo’tra loke bhavanti tān prabho || 157|| sādhurūpeṇa nirbandhān kṛtvā mokṣaya macchritān | ityarthayāmi bhagavan viramāmi tvayi prabho || 158|| ityuktvā badrike lakṣmīḥ svāminyantaradhīyata | lakṣmīstavaṃ prabhāṣeta bhāvagarbho’pi yo janaḥ || 159|| lakṣmīvacchrīharau līnasthānameṣyati śāśvatam | nārī stavamadhīyānā lakṣmīḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 4.120.16 0|| priyā lakṣmīḥ stavājjātā jātā lakṣmīśca mādhavī | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhet stotrād yatheṣṭāṃ pārameśvarīm || 161 || yatkṛṣṇasya samastaṃ vai tat tasyāḥ syāt samastakam | śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇadakṣāyāḥ kārṣṇyāḥ śrībadrike svakam || 1 62|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne’nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaparamātmano vānaprasthadharmottaraṃ sādhudīkṣāgrahaṇaṃ lakṣmīkṛtastavanaṃ lakṣmīprabhṛtīnāṃ svasvāmini śāśvatī līnatetyādinirūpaṇanāmā viṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 20||
<4.121> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca badrike ca tato’nādiḥkṛṣṇonārāyaṇo hariḥ | lakṣmīṃ prajñāṃ pāśavatīṃ cāntarbhāvya nijātmani || 1 || kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre tvekarūpeṇa cāvasat | dvitīyena svarūpeṇa śriyā yuktena cāntare || 2 || sādhurūpeṇa tīrtheṣu yayau śrīyuktamūrtikaḥ | agocaromuktasevyadevajuṣṭaḥ saekalaḥ || 3 || kuṃkumavāpikātīrthajalaṃ pītvāśvasārasam | jalaṃ pītvācamanaṃ ca kṛtvā snātvā sarovare || 4 || śrīgaṇeśaṃ guruṃ cāpi natvā sampūjya bhāvataḥ | sarvatīrthāni natvāpi kṛtvā saraḥpradakṣiṇam || 5 || prayayau cāmravaṇato vyāghrāraṇyaṃ mahattaram | siṃhāraṇyaṃ yayau paścāt talaśyāmasthalaṃ śubham || 6 || snātvā yayau somanāthaṃ prācīpippalamityapi | mūladvārāvatīṃ naijāṃ tataścoṣṇapuraṃ yayau || 7 || gopanāthaṃ yayau paścād gokarṇaṃ prajagāma saḥ | nṛsiṃheśaṃ śarabheśaṃ kṛtvā vyomnā yayau drutam || 8 || nārāyaṇīṃ mahādīrghāṃ sarvottamāṃ nadīṃ parām | trināsaṃ ca saraścāpi rudalālpasaro yayau || 9 || viṣaturīyakasarastrigāyanasarovaram | nyāyajaṃ ca saraścāpi yayau kaṅgūmahānadīm || 4.121.1 0|| nyāyajarāṃ nadīṃ gatvā bhūmadhyasāgaraṃ yayau | nīparāṃ prayayau dyūnāṃ vātagāmuralāṃ nadīm || 11 || bālakṛṣṇasaraścāpi yayābobīṃ mahānadīm | yāneśīṃ ca yayau kṛṣṇo dvikalaṃ ca sarovaram || 1 2| āyurāṃ ca nadīṃ ramyāṃ cābdhiṃ yayau tataḥ param | bahuliṅgasamudraṃ ca gatvā matkuñcikānadīm || 13 || gartasrāvasaro gatvā līnapādasaro yayau | sūparīśasaro gatvā tato’rkeśāṃ nadīṃ yayau || 14|| samudraṃ ca tato gatvāmāñjanīṃ sunadīṃ yayau | pārānasīṃ nadīṃ gatvollaṃghyasamudramāyatam || 15|| uṣṭrālaye mayūrāṃ ca nadīṃ yayau janārdanaḥ | kāruliṅgīṃ nadīṃ gatvā yayāvaitasarovaram || 1 6|| grāsakāyāṃ nadīṃ gatvā vyomnā brahmapradeśakam | āyayau bhagavān badri menakāṅgīṃ mahānadīm || 17|| śālavīnāṃ tathā cairāvatīṃ nadīṃ yayau prabhuḥ | śikṣāṃgīṃ cāṅgaśikṣāṃgāṃ triyājñikāṃ nadīṃ yayau || 18|| brahmaputrāṃ ca gaṃgāṃ ca godāvarīṃ ca narmadām | śatruñjitāṃ yayau kṛṣṇastato’śvapaṭṭasārasam || 1 9||| āyayau bhagavān vyomnākṣarakṣetraṃ nijālayam | ekonatriṃśāṃ subhagāṃ naijāṃ janmajayantikām ||4.121.20|| vyadhāt kṛṣṇaḥ sādhuveṣaḥ kuṃkumavāpikālaye | evaṃ śrībhagavān badri lakṣmyā mano’pyapūrayat ||21|| padmāvatyāśca prajñāyāḥ manasyapi hyapūrayat | pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni nadīnadādrisāgarāḥ ||22|| vanabhūgahvarāraṇyagrāmadvīpasurālayāḥ | yatra tatra yayau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyano muhuḥ ||23|| śreyase svastaye kalyāṇāya bhadrāya dehinām | mokṣāya muktaye nirvāṇāya śāśvatasiddhaye ||24||| anekān dehinaḥ kṛṣṇa uddadhāra bhavārṇavān | badrike svecchayā naijakṛpayā līlayā dhiyā || 25|| muhurdeśeṣu sarveṣu bhaktavaśaḥ prayātyapi | kṛtvoddhāraṃ janānāṃ ca samāyāti nijālayam ||26|| kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ rājate sādhubhūṣaṇaḥ | lakṣaśaḥ sādhavaḥ sādhvyo yatra vasantyaharniśam ||27|| triśattamādyāḥ kṛṣṇasyotsavā janmanimittajāḥ | kriyante sādhusādhvyādyasaṃkhyabhaktaiḥ pramodadāḥ ||28|| mucyante’saṃkhyamanujāstadyogāt prativatsaram | kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaputrā yugalā ye videśagāḥ |||29|| te’pi tvāgatya pitaraṃ vīkṣya prasevya mādhavam | prayānti te nijamātāmahadeśān sukhānvitāḥ ||4.121.3 0 || asaṃkhyāśca narā nāryo vaiṣṇavā bhaktibhāvanāḥ | badrike nityamāyānti sevanārthaṃ hariṃ prabhum ||3 1 || nikāmaṃ te samprasevya samāsādya manogatam | prayānti nijadeśām̐śca prāpnuvanti paraṃ sukham |||32||| paraṃ padaṃ pare dhāma dehānte samprayānti vai | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe tiṣṭhati bhūtale ||33|| sarvathā kārtayugako vyavartata prajāsu vai | anye yugāḥ prabhāvaṃ na kartuṃ śaktā bhavanti tu ||34|| satye yathā tathā tretāyuge dvāparake tathā | kalau tathā hareryogāt prajānāṃ kṛtavat sthitiḥ || 35|| dharmakāmārthamokṣāṇāṃ balaṃ kṛṣṇakṛpāvaśāt | yathārthaṃ sukhadaṃ cāste sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ tadā || 36|| badrike śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’nādiḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ | brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyairarthitaśca muhurmuhuḥ || 37|| pṛthvyāṃ tasthau lakṣavarṣāṇyūrdhvaṃ ca pañcaviṃśatiḥ | sahasrāṇi tathā pañcaśatāni sarvagocaraḥ || 38|| sapādalakṣavarṣānte paraṃ dhāma nijaṃ padam | tenaiva varṣmaṇā divyaśāśvatena yayau hariḥ || 39|| tataḥ kuṃkumavāpyādau mūrtirūpo virājate | sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ carmacakṣuṣāṃ dṛṣṭigocaraḥ ||4.121.40 || divyadṛśāṃ tu divyātmā pratyakṣaḥ pūrvavat sadā | lomaśādestu bhagavān nityapratyakṣa eva ha ||41 || sādhvīnāṃ ca satāṃ sādhusvarūpo nityagocaraḥ | yogināṃ dhyānagamyaśca muktānāṃ dhāmagocaraḥ ||42|| bhaktānāṃ snehavaśago vartate hṛdaye sthitaḥ | sarvatra vartate sākṣī sa eva parameśvaraḥ ||43|| badrike bahavastasyāvatārāḥ saṃbhavanti hi | naranārāyaṇaścāhaṃ tasyāvatāra eva ha ||44|| tvaṃ cāpi tasya kṛṣṇasyārdhāṃganāsyavatāriṇī | bhaja taṃ paramātmānaṃ kāntaṃ bhajāmyahaṃ yathā ||45|| viṣṇubrahmamaheśādyā yathā bhajantyaharniśam | devarṣipitṛsādhyāśca yathā bhajantyaharniśam ||46|| īśā īśānikā muktā yathā bhajantyaharniśam | smara kṛṣṇaṃ sadā kāntaṃ śāśvatānandadāyakam ||47|| smārayānyān hariṃ taṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | tasyaiva bhajanaṃ badri bhaktiṃ kāraya dehinām ||48|| tasyaiva bhajanenaiva te yāsyanti paraṃ padam | yathaiva bhajanaṃ tasya mokṣadaṃ ca tathāvidham ||49|| saṃhitāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ ca mokṣadaṃ nityamodadam | mayā badri śrāvitāni caritrāṇi harestava ||4.121.50|| bhaktābhaktamokṣadāni camatkāramayāni vai | tallīlālalitaṃ nāthaṃ hṛdi nidhehi badrike ||51|| śrīśvetāyanavyāsa uvāca śṛṇvantu munayo lakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitām | ye śroṣyanti bhāgato’pi te yāsyanti parāṃ gatim ||52|| khaṇḍo’tra prathamaścāste kṛtasantānakābhidhaḥ | dvitīyaśca samāste vai tretāsantānakābhidhaḥ |||53|| tṛtīyo dvāparasantānākhyaḥ khaṇḍo’sya vartate | caturthastiṣyasantānābhidho’styatra camatkaraḥ ||54|| prathame kṛtasantāne’dhyāyāḥ pañcaśatāni ca | navatiśca tathādhyāyā vartante dvijamūrtayaḥ ||||55|| ślokāstu pañcapañcāśatsahasrāṇi tathā punaḥ | pañcaśatānyadhikāni saptaviṃśatiyūñji ca |||56|| dvitīye trītasantāne tvadhyāyāstriśatāni ca | vai dvātriṃśatsahasrāṇi dve śate ca tathā punaḥ ||57|| pañcāśaccāpi catvāraḥ ślokāḥ santi hi tītrake | tṛtīye dvāparasantānake’dhyāyāḥ śatadvayam ||58|| saptatriṃśat tathā santi mokṣadā divyavigrahāḥ | ślokāḥ santi sahasrāṇi pañcaviṃśatirapyatha ||59|| śataṃ ṣaṣṭiśca vai dve ca muktidā bhaktidāḥ khalu | caturthe tiṣyasantāne’ghyāyāstu śatamityapi ||4.121.60 || trayoviṃśatiścāpyeva vartante brahmadhāmadāḥ | ślokāḥ santi trayodaśasahasrāṇi tathopari ||6 1|| aṣṭātriṃśatisarve sākṣānmokṣapradāḥ parāḥ | catuḥsantānarūpāyāḥ saṃhitāyāstu sarvaśaḥ |||62|| adhyāyāścaikasāhasraṃ tadūrdhvaṃ hi śatānyapi | pañcāśat santi ca tathā sarvathā mokṣakāriṇaḥ |||62||| asyāḥ pūrṇasaṃhitāyāḥ ślokāstu caikalakṣakam | tadūrdhvaṃ tu pañcaviṃśatisahasrāṇi vai tathā ||64|| navaśatāni caikāśītiratadūrdhvaṃ bhavanti hi | tato’tiriktāḥ saptāpi vidyante ślokakā api |||65|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīvallabhaprabhuḥ | munayo nyavasat pṛthvyāṃ lakṣavarṣāṇi tatparam ||66|| pañcaviṃśatisahasrāṇyapi pañcaśatāni ca | tatra kṛtāścamatkārāḥ saṃkhyātuṃ cāpya gocarāḥ ||67|| sādhurūpeṇa kṛṣṇena kṛtā ye ye tu te’khilāḥ | likhitā vai sādhusaṃhitāyāṃ sādhubhirādarāt ||68|| sanatkumāraprabhṛtibhistu mokṣaparāyaṇaiḥ | śloke śloke’tra sarvatra hareryogena dehinām ||69|| mokṣecchayā kṛṣṇakṛpā siñcitā durlabhā tu yā | kṛpāmūrtisvarūpeyaṃ saṃhitā mokṣadā tataḥ ||4.121.70|| lakṣmīrūpā saṃhiteyaṃ saṃhitā śrīsvarūpiṇī | yathā lakṣmīstathā ceyaṃ yathā ceyaṃ tathā ramā ||71|| dayitānādikṛṣṇasyārdhāṃganā mokṣadāyinī | pāvanī sarvalokānāṃ jananī muktigāminām ||72|| poṣaṇī caihikānāṃ tu sampatpradāṃ tu kāminām | kṛṣṇakaṇṭhād divyarūpā cāvirbhūteyamīśvarī ||73|| śrutirūpā tataśceyaṃ vedavad vedinī tviyam | vedānāṃ phaladā ceyaṃ pūjitā vācitā śrutā ||74|| sadā śāntikarī ceyaṃ muktivanmodakāriṇī | rādhāvad ṛddhisiddhidhrā sarvarddhisiddhidāyinī || 75||| nārāyaṇī mūrtimatī nārāyaṇasya bodhinī | nārāyaṇaprāptikarī pūjitā vācitā śrutā ||73|| vaiṣṇavīyaṃ mūrtimatī vaiṣṇavānāṃ pramodinī | yoginī yugavārtānāṃ bodhinī brahmayoginī ||77|| brahmarūpakarī śroturvaktuḥ pūjayitustathā | svāheyaṃ sarvayajñānāṃ phaladā dakṣiṇātmikā ||78|| prajñeyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavallabhamūrtijā | brahmapārapradā ceyaṃ yajñāvabhṛtharūpiṇī ||79|| sarasvatī brahmapatnī nityā vāṇī hareriyam | satāmāśīrvādarūpā lomaśena vikāsitā ||4.121.80 || śvaitiprabhatiśiṣyaiśca sanakādyaiḥ supoṣitā | dyaurdivyā devakoṭīnāṃ sajīvanaprakāriṇī ||8 1 || mahāsādhvī satī devī divyeyaṃ cācyutī matā | gaṃgeyaṃ pāpavidhvaṃsakāriṇī viṣṇudhāriṇī ||82|| śiveyaṃ śivadā svastipradānandapradā sadā | saṃjñeyaṃ mānadā saurī gāyatrī trāṇadā parā ||83|| svadheyaṃ sarvapitṝṇāṃ pretānāṃ śreyasāmpradā | kaumudīyaṃ sudhāsvādapradā cāndrī sarojanī ||84|| padmeyaṃ padmikā padmadharīvāvyayakāriṇī | annapūrṇā kṛṣṇatṛptyābhogasukhapradāyinī |||85|| gāṇeśīyaṃ sarvavighnanāśinī kṣemalābhadā | hānumatī mahāśaktiḥ śīlinī brahmavarculā ||86|| kācchapī phaṇinī śaktiḥ pṛthivyuddhārakāriṇī | mahālakṣmīriyaṃ vidyā nārāyaṇasya khelanī ||87|| badarīyaṃ haimagirau tāpasī tāpanāśinī | yamuneyaṃ yamalokagatinirodhinī svasā ||88|| gomatīyaṃ parabrahmakiraṇānāṃ prabhātmikā | kāmadhenuriyaṃ drogdhrī kṛṣṇasaurabhadāyinī ||89|| sarvakāmaprapūreyaṃ sevitā kṣīrapāyasī | amṛteyaṃ sevakānāṃ mahāmṛtapradāyinī ||4.121.90|| kalpavallī śāśvatīyaṃ manovāñcchāprapūraṇī | akṣayyapātrikā ceyaṃ kṛṣṇakathākṣayānvitā || 91 || kalpadrumasvarūpeyaṃ sarvārtharasavarṣiṇī | cintāmaṇiḥ saṃhiteyaṃ sarveṣāṃ kṛṣṇacintanī || 92|| pajramaṇiḥ sadā ceyaṃ vāsanādriprabhedinī | sarvavratamahāśālā saṃhiteyaṃ phalapradā || 93 || sarvatīrthamayī ceyaṃ sarvatīrthaprabodhinī | sarveśvarī mahādevīśvarāṇāṃ smṛtikāriṇī ||94|| dhārmikīyaṃ dharmarakṣākartrī dharmasya dhāriṇī | vibhūtiḥ śāśvatīyaṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇasyāvatāriṇī || 95 || saṃkrāntiḥ sahiteyaṃ ca kṛṣṇasaṃkrāntiyoginī | mahotsavī sadā ceyaṃ śroturvaktuḥ samutsavā ||96|| amūrtā śabdamūrteyaṃ kṛṣṇajihvā rasābharā | kṛṣṇayoniḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇānandapradāyinī || 97|| mokṣavimānikā śreṣṭhā dhāmasṛtiḥ sukomalā | kṛṣṇaśayyātmikā divyā kṛṣṇapārśvapradāyinī || 98 || śrīkṛṣṇāsyasvarūpeyaṃ kṛṣṇatāmbūlapāyinī | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmarūpiṇī tviyam || 99 || bahunā kiṃ sādhavīyaṃ catuḥpumarthadāyinī | tulasīmālikeyaṃ ca sādhvīdīkṣeyamityapi || 4.121.100 || mahāsaṃnyāsinī ceyaṃ kaṇṭhīyaṃ saṃhitā sadā | ṛtambhareyaṃ satataṃ sattvaprakarṣiṇī tviyam || 101 || ātivāhikadevīyaṃ parāvidyeyamavyayā | vidhiśaktiriyaṃ śāstrī bhaktimūrtiriyaṃ tathā || 102|| duḥkhahāśrīriyaṃ nityaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapriyā | lakṣāśvamedhayajñānāṃ phaladā vācitā śrutā || 103 || lakṣaviṣṇumakhānāṃ ca puṇyadā mokṣadā śubhā | sarvavidhānāṃ tapasāṃ phaladā śāntidā tathā || 1 04|| sarvavratānāṃ tīrthānāṃ sarveṣāṃ puṇyadāyinī | koṭidhenugajāśvānāṃ dānānāṃ phaladottamā || 1 05|| brahmāṇḍadānaphaladā jīvābhayapradāyinī | koṭikanyādānaphalā koṭiśrīdānasadṛśī || 1 06|| upaniṣat mūrtimatī kṛṣṇasannidhikāriṇī | ātmavidyā hyakāmānāṃ sakāmānāṃ tu ceṣṭadā || 1 07|| dhanadā putradā putrīpradārogyayaśaḥpradā | rājyadā puṣṭidā nārīpradā ceṣṭapatipradā || 108 || svargadā dhāmadā mokṣapradā kṛṣṇāṃkavāsadā | sarvadā sarvadā ceyaṃ saṃhitā hitadānvaham || 10 9|| gṛhasthā tu gṛhasthānāṃ gṛhasthitiprapoṣiṇī | hṛdisthā tu satāṃ saccidānandahariyoginī || 4.121.11 0|| sarvasaubhāgyadā ceyaṃ sarvotkarṣapradāyinī | anantānandadhāmākhyasāmrājyasukhavarṣiṇī || 111 || vartate saṃhitā ceyaṃ mahāmuktānikā kṣitau | pratyekamasyāḥ santānāḥ putrā nārāyaṇasya vai || 112| nārāyaṇasamā mokṣe bale kīrtau ca sampadi | yathā kṛtaḥ sarvadharme tretā yathākhile makhe || 1 13|| dvīto yathākhile dāne tiṣyo’khile jape’tulaḥ | kṛtaḥ sāmarthyasañjuṣṭastretā divyacaritravān || 1 14|| dvītaśca divyalīlāḍhyastiṣyaḥ śaraṇitārakaḥ | satyaḥ svātmabaloddhartā tretā surādisaṃśrayāt || 1 15|| dvītaḥ kṛṣṇacamatkārāt tiṣyaḥ sādhusamāgamāt | tiṣyo’yaṃ kṛṣṇasantānaḥ kevalaḥ paṭhitaḥ śritaḥ || 1 16|| śrutaśca śrāvitaścāpi pūjitaśca gṛhe’vitaḥ | smṛto guṇairgṛhītaśca tārayatyāśritān drutam || 1 17|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya kānakīṃ śubhām | hareḥ supratimāṃ kṛtvā tiṣyasantānakaṃ tvimam || 1 18|| dadyād dāne tu yo bhaktyā viduṣe brahmavādine | vaiṣṇavāya viśeṣeṇācāryāya gurave’pi ca || 1 19|| viprāyādhyāpakāyāpi kathāvācanaśīline | dhenuṃ vatsāyutāṃ sarvopaskaraṇādisaṃyutām || 4.121.1 20|| śayyāṃ prapūrṇāṃ mṛdvīṃ ca pātrāṇi cārpayettathā | saratnadhānyavastrādi dadyād yaḥ sa tu mokṣabhāk || 121 || sakāmaḥ svargamāsādya brahmakalpāyureva ca | bhuktvā bhogān prayātyeva saṃhitādānato’kṣaram || 1 22|| tiṣyasantānakaścāyaṃ sadbhāvādhāyakaḥ satām | satsu snehakaraḥ sevādharmabodhapradastathā || 1 23|| pāpānāmapi sarveṣāṃ kṣālakaḥ pāpimokṣadaḥ | śaraṇāgatajīvānāṃ brahmadhāmapradaḥ sukhaḥ || 1 24|| api sādhorharervāpi pāpī prasādadhug bhavet | tiryag vā svedajo’ṇḍottho jarājo vā samucyate || 1 25|| tiṣyādhyāyaṃ gṛhe tvekaṃ vācayed yaḥ samāhitaḥ | tiṣyasantānapāṭhasya labhate sa phalaṃ drutam || 1 26|| munayaḥ tiṣyapāṭhānāṃ tiṣyavego na bādhate | tiṣyadoṣā na jāyante yamo’sya yāti dūrataḥ || 1 27|| tiṣyakathāśravaṇārthī matkṛpāpātrameva saḥ | sarvamokṣapradān sādhūn śritvā yatlabhate’kṣaram || 128|| yasya dānaṃ tapo dharmastapo japo na śīlatā | tasya tiṣyāśrayād sādhvīsādhvāśrayāt pramokṣaṇam || 129|| svarṇavimānakaṃ kṛtvā saṃsthāpya tiṣyakhaṇḍakam | prapūjya cārpayet pātre dātā vimānago’kṣare || 4.121.1 30|| sarvakuṭumbasahito modate harimandire | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca labhate śāśvatīṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 131 || iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne’nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya munirūpeṇāpareṇa divyenasvarūpeṇa śrīmanorathapūraṇārthaṃ pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrthābhigamanaṃ, punaḥ kuṃkumavāpikāgamanam, tiṣyasantānasya samastasaṃhitāyāścādhyāyaślokasaṃkhyānirdeśaḥ, samastasaṃhitāyāstiṣyasantānasya ca dānādimahimetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 12 1||
<4.122> śrīśvetāyano vyāsa uvāca śṛṇuta śrīsaṃhitāyāḥ puraścaraṇamuttamam | sarvāyāstu saṃhitāyāḥ kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā || 1 || svayaṃ paṭhet pāṭhayedvā cāṣṭottaraśatadvijaiḥ | vaiṣṇavaiḥ sādhusādhvībhirbrahmaśīlaparāyaṇaiḥ || 2 || maṇḍapaṃ kārayed ramyaṃ viśālaṃ kuṇḍamaṇḍapam | paritaḥ sthāpayed saumyāsanāni corṇajāni tu || 3 || kāṣṭhāsanādīni cāpi tvekaikaṃ pustakaṃ tathā | śreṣṭhāsane tu pratyeke sthāpayet pūjayettataḥ || 4 || ārārtrikaṃ prakuryācca tataḥ pāṭhāni kārayet | pratyahaṃ pūrikākṣīrapāyasānnāni bhojayet || 5 || yadyadapekṣitaṃ sarvaṃ dadyāttu dāpayettathā | māsaṃ pārāyaṇaṃ cātra puraścaraṇamātrakam || 6 || dvimāsaṃ vā kārayecca catuḥpumarthasiddhidam | ṣāṇmāsikaṃ kārayedvā vārṣikaṃ vācayecca vā || 7 || nityaṃ sādhūn vaiṣṇavām̐śca dīnānāthān prabhojayet | viprān sādhvīrbālikāśca bālakān bhojayedapi || 8 || svarṇarūpyakapātrāṇāṃ dānāni dāpayettathā | dhanāmbarakaṇānāṃ cānnānāṃ dānāni kārayet || 9 || anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrteḥ śriyā samam | pūjanaṃ kārayennityaṃ havanaṃ cācarettathā || 4.122.1 0|| rādhālakṣmīramāprajñāvatīśrīmāṇikīyutam | pūjayet paramātmānaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim || 11 || daśāṃśahomaṃ nityaṃ vai kārayed ghṛtapāyasaiḥ | samidbhiḥ puṇyavṛkṣāṇāṃ phalapuṣparasādibhiḥ || 12| māsapārāyaṇe’dhyāyān nityaṃ vai vācayed vratī | dvyadhicatvāriṃśadeva dvimāse tu tadardhataḥ || 13|| ṣaṇmāse cānvahaṃ ṣaṭkaṃ varṣamātre trikaṃ trikam | nyūnādhikaṃ yathāyogaṃ vibhajya vācayed vratī || 14|| ślokānāṃ saṃkhyayānityaṃ dṛśāṃśahavanaṃ caret | dakṣiṇā bahudhā dadyād vācakebhyaḥ sukhapradāḥ || 15|| pustakaṃ navavastreṇa veṣṭayitvā prapūjitam | bhrāmayennagare svarṇahastisthitaṃ sacāmaram || 16|| dānaṃ tataḥ pradadyācca mukhyavācakasādhave | chatradānaṃ pādukādānakaṃ vastrādidānakam || 17|| bhūṣāgobhūhiraṇyādi dadyād vai mukhyasādhave | suvācakāya gurave vidyācāryāya yogine || 18 || vaiṣṇavāya viśeṣeṇa dadyād viprāya bhāvataḥ | bhojayed vipravaryāṃśca sādhūn sādhvīśca bālakān || 19|| bhaktām̐śca vaiṣṇavān sarvān bhojayecca visarjayet | evaṃ puraścaraṇena sveṣṭān kāmānavāpnuyāt ||4.122.20 || mahādānaṃ pravakṣyāmi samrāḍyogyaṃ nibodha me | sārvabhaumo mahārājastvāgnīdhraḥ pradadau purā || 21 || svāyambhuvo manuścāpi pradadau gomatītaṭe | kuberaḥ pradadau cāpi viśālāyāṃ himālaye || 22|| koṭirāyo dadau cāpi sindhutaṭe’bdhisannidhau | evamanye pradaduśca yathākālaṃ yathādhanam ||23|| sārvabhaumamahādānaṃ gadyate tanmayā śṛṇu | atra ye kīrtitā devā bhaktā devyaḥ pramuktigāḥ |||24|| sarvanāmāni saṃgṛhya kārayitvā suvarṇajāḥ | pratimāḥ koṭiśaḥ sarvā dadyād dāne sutīrthake ||25||| saṃhitādevatā yatra caikāpi nātiricyate | sarvadevatā dadyād vai dāne godānapūrvakam || 26|| pūjayitvā vidhānena dadyād vipreṣu sādhuṣu | satpātreṣu samasteṣu puṇyapāro na vidyate || 27|| śrīharerbhagavato’rthaṃ yena, hma sarvasvamarpitam | sa eva kartuṃ śaknoti mahādānaṃ yathārthataḥ |||28|| sa tārayejjagatsarvaṃ mahādānabalāt khalu | mahādānapradātustu sannidhau gocaro hariḥ ||29|| lakṣmīśca gocarā nityaṃ bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ | saṃhitāyāḥ kathāyajñaṃ kuryāt prakārayecca yaḥ || 4.122.30|| tasyarddhayaḥ samastāḥ syurakṣayyā vṛddhimāgatāḥ | kārtike’syā dānakartā brahmā bhavati viśvasṛṭ ||3 1|| mārgaśīrṣe pradātāsyā nārāyaṇāḥ prajāyate | pauṣe dātā saṃhitāyā rudro bhavati śaṃkaraḥ ||32|| māghe dātā saṃhitāyā viṣṇuḥ prajāyate khalu | phālgune’syāḥ pradātā tu jāyate dhanado’calaḥ ||33|| caitre’syā dānakartā vai jāyate sūryadevatā | vaiśākhe dānakṛcchreṣṭho dhruvo bhavati vaiṣṇavaḥ ||34|| jyeṣṭhe dātā virāṭ syāccāṣāḍhe dātā sadāśivaḥ | śrāvaṇe tu mahāviṣṇurbhaved dātā na saṃśayaḥ ||35|| bhādre dātā mahendraḥ syādāśvine tu bṛhaspatiḥ | adhimāse pradātāsyā vāsudevaḥ prajāyate ||36|| evaṃ dānaphalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ saṃproktaṃ matkṛpodbhavam | nārī dātro bhaved rādhā ramā lakṣmīśca mādhavī ||37|| dāridryāni samastāni naśyantyasyāḥ pradānataḥ | trividhānyapi duḥkhāni naśyantyasyāḥ pradānataḥ ||38|| sampūrṇāṃ saṃhitāṃ caitāṃ nidhāya gajamastake | yadvā svarṇagaje svarṇasaṃhitāṃ praṇidhāya ca ||39|| dadyād yastasya sāmrājyaṃ caturdaśabhuvāṃ bhavet | manuḥ syāt khaṇḍadātāpi samastāyāḥ prado hariḥ ||4.122.40|| asyāḥ ślokasya vai vakturnāsadgatirbhavet kvacit | sarvavarṇāśramadharmaphalaṃ cāsyāḥ pradānataḥ ||41 || yo vidvān saṃhitāṃ cemāṃ kaṇṭhe kṛtvā tvaviṣyati | sa tu tenaiva dehena divyabhāvena sarvathā ||42|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇāt prāptavimānena paraṃ padam | prayāsyatyākṣaramuktaiḥ śaṃsitaḥ pūjitaḥ suraiḥ ||43|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā yo hṛdi dhārakaḥ | sṛṣṭyantare bhavedeṣaḥ vaikuṇṭhadhāmna īśvaraḥ ||44|| nārī syādīśvarī lakṣmīrvaikuṇṭhasvāminī sadā | eṣaṇāvān labheteṣṭaṃ sakāmaḥ kāmanāṃ labhet ||45|| niṣkāmo mokṣaṇaṃ preyānnaro nārāyaṇo bhavet | nārī nārāyaṇī syācca saṃhitādhāraṇāt sadā ||46|| catuṣṭayaṃ sadā kāryaṃ śāśvatīṃ bhūtimicchatā | lakṣmīpūjā harerdhyānaṃ dānamasyāḥ kathāśrutiḥ ||47|| catuṣṭayaṃ sadā kāryaṃ śāśvataṃ mokṣamicchatā | satāṃ sevā harerbhaktirlīlāsmṛtistadarpaṇam ||48|| catuṣṭayaṃ sadā kāryaṃ śāśvatīṃ śāntimicchatā | anārambhaśca nivṛttirjapo vivekitātmani ||49|| ya iha sumatimān syācchāśvatānandamicchet, tribhuvanasupatitvaṃ ceśvarāṇāṃ patitvam || api ca paramamuktiṃ cāvatārātmakatvam, pibatu sa satataṃ śrīsaṃhitotthāmṛtāni ||4.122.50|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne’syāḥ śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ puraścaraṇavidhiḥ, sārvabhaumamahādānavidhiḥ, saṃhitādhāraṇāyāḥ phalaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 22||
<4.123> śrīnaranārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu śrībadarīdevi nārāyaṇi pareśvari | tiṣyasantānaviṣayān saṃkṣepāt smārayāmi te || 1 || caturthe tiṣyasantāne naranārāyaṇasya me | śrībadaryāḥ svarūpasya vartanaṃ te samīritam || 2 || rājarṣerbadarākhyasyākhyānaṃ himācalasya ca | hemānalāsurasyaiva garte nikṣepa īritaḥ || 3 || śrīmāṇikyā badarīśīrūpatādi prakīrtitam | śrīśīlasya tu viprasya pretasya muktirīritā || 4 || dārābhāgyākhyabhūpasya parīkṣaṇaṃ ca mokṣaṇam | brahmadevadvijasyāpi vaṃśavattvakathoditā || 5 || badaryā bālayoginyā gītoktā brahmabhāvadā | dāsyaṃ bhāgavatatvaṃ ca vaiṣṇavatvaṃ ca yogitā || 6 || parabrahmapremarasavarṇanaṃ ceti kīrtitam | satsevayā nāgnamukhīcāraṇyā muktirīritā || 7 || vinodinyāstu kāntasya bhaktyā nārāyaṇāgamaḥ | devalikātmakatvaṃ cetyetat sarvamudīritam || 8 || bāhulakasya ca līlāvatyā bhaktirudāhṛtā | saptadaśo’nādikṛṣṇajanmotsavastathoditaḥ || 9 || māliyānamallikayo sevayā muktirīritā | jñānalabhyo brahmarasaścopāstyā kathitastataḥ || 4.123.1 0|| rasapradādhidharmāṇāṃ mahāyogasya varṇanam | anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśca bālayoginīn || 1 1|| vivāhayāmāsa kathā caiṣā tata udīritā | sadbhaktasya tato nikāmadevasya ca mokṣaṇam || 12|| svarūpayogarūpaṃ ca parabrahmaṇi coditam | tato viśiṣṭabrahmādvaitātmā harirudīritaḥ ||1 3|| nirbhayayogakathanaṃ stutiścāpi tathoditā | stutikartryai tathā stotre hyakhiladhāmidarśanam || 14|| sadehadivyamuktiśca tayostata udīritā | nigaḍabhramaṇādīnāṃ kaivartānāṃ pramokṣaṇam || 15|| pipaṭhāyanayogena tata uktaṃ hi badrike | ekalāyāśca kuśalīsāgaryā rājayakṣmataḥ || 16|| rakṣaṇaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cāpi tata uktaṃ hi badrike | vañcayitryā viṣalāṇyāḥ satāṃ prasādabhojanāt || 17|| muktiruktā tato gaṃgāñjanyā mokṣa udīritaḥ | ramāñjanyā ramātva ca mokṣaṇaṃ samudīritam || 18|| striyāṃ raṇastambakumbhakārasya sādhusevayā | candramāḥ putratāṃ prāptastato mokṣaṃ udīritaḥ ||19|| tato devasudhānāmnyāḥ svarṇakartryāścamatkṛtiḥ | durbhikṣe’saṃkhyajīvānāṃ bhojanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tathā ||4.123.20|| viṣṭināryā vidrumiṇyāḥ satsaṃgena ca divyatā | cāṇḍālyā mālavānyāśca sevayā dharmadarśanam ||21 || mūrtamantradarśanaṃ ca mokṣaṇaṃ cāpyudīritam | kārelikāyāḥ śūdryāśca nirmohitvamudāhṛtam ||22|| badrikāyanasādhośca mūkatā śāpamokṣaṇam | yantrakartryāśca gomatyāḥ kṣayaroganivāraṇam ||23|| kanakāṃgadāyā mokṣaḥ sādhūnāṃ sevayā kṛtaḥ | rāyaharibhāṇavāṇyorunmattayostu muktaye ||24|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathādivācanam | aṣṭādaśo harerjanmamahotsava udīritaḥ ||25|| nārāyaṇasaraḥsthānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ rucchabhūbhṛtaḥ | pāvanatvaṃ tathā vidyotāyā mokṣaṃ udīritaḥ ||26|| kuṃbhakārakuṭumbasya svarṇakārastriyāstathā | dhātudhmāyā naṭasyāpi kadaryasyāpi mokṣaṇam ||27|| kṣīrodanṛpateḥ patnyāḥ prajānāṃ muktirīritā | somikādigaṇikānāṃ mokṣaṃ udīritastataḥ ||28|| duḥkhanāśo madyapasya mokṣaśca hariṇā kṛtaḥ | cakriṇo yāskavādasya bahūnāṃ mokṣa īritaḥ ||29|| nindakayordvivadantīrdvirgarjanābhidhānayoḥ | yamadūtadarśanaṃ ca mokṣastata udīritaḥ ||4.123.30|| suraprasādaviprasya guruhantuḥ kathāśravāt | satāṃ prasevayā mokṣastata ukto hi badrike ||3 1|| kārāgrahe patitānāṃ devadrohavatāṃ sadā | nāgavikramādīnāṃ ca rakṣāmokṣa udīritau ||32|| śālamitranṛpateśca rājñyāścāyurvināśanam | mokṣaṇaṃ saṃhitākathāśravaṇāt samudīritam ||33|| yuddharājasya ca viṣapradasya kanyakādiṣu | yamadūtāgamo mṛtyuḥ sādhukṛtaṃ ca rakṣaṇam ||34|| vyavāyinyā garbhahantryā anaṃgavallarīstriyāḥ | pāpanāśo mokṣaṇaṃ ca kathāśrayādudīritam || 35|| ṣaṇḍhavajrādiṣaṇḍhānāṃ kathāśravāt pramokṣaṇam | napuṃsakānāmanyeṣāṃ puṃstrīvyañjakatoditā ||36|| ghātakino yavasandhyākhyasya muktirudīritā | bhaṇḍaśīlākhyabhāṇḍasya bhavāyanasya mokṣaṇam ||37|| harṣavīryādimallānāṃ mṛgayūṇāṃ ca badrike | vārdhūṣikāṇāṃ mokṣaśca kathāśravādudīritaḥ |||28||| nāgādasya vādiṭasya sārahāse ca khelinām | kathāsādhuprasaṃgena mokṣastataḥ udīritaḥ ||39|| vilāsadevaviprasya luñcādasya ca dīkṣaṇam | duritaghoṣasaṃjñasya dīkṣaṇaṃ kīrtitaṃ tataḥ ||4.123.40|| śīlayānyāḥ svāminaśca dharmabhaṭasya mokṣaṇam | nyāyākṣiṇyāḥ svāminaśca nyāyādhīśasya mokṣaṇam ||41 || viśālarekhakāyasthādīnāṃ coktaṃ ca mokṣaṇam | śāhavilāpanakṣatriyasyoktaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ||42|| daṇḍāraṇikaulikasya gṛdhrajanmani mokṣaṇam | govārasya biḍālajanmanaścoktaṃ pramokṣaṇam ||43|| ṭhaṭṭholavaṇijo mokṣaḥ proktaḥ śṛgālajanmanaḥ | svarṇāñjanānibhṛtyānāṃ sevayoktaṃ pramokṣaṇam ||44|| ajāpālasyāpi muktiruktā ca śyenajanmanaḥ | ajānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ coktaṃ caṭakājanmanāṃ tataḥ ||45|| kapotānāṃ purā sārthavāhānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tathā | purā tu kaṃkajātīnāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ kākapakṣiṇām ||46|| nāṇakinyāḥ khavāsinyā gṛhagodhākhyajanmani | mokṣaṇaṃ saṃghavāṭādiśūdrāṇāmākhujanmanām ||47|| sāgaradānavāruṭakīratārākhyabhāṭayoḥ | puṇyavatyāḥ svāminaśca devagatīśvarasya ca ||48|| jayamānabandinaśca vajravikramabhūbhṛtaḥ | kathāśravaṇataḥ proktaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ badrike tataḥ ||49|| saptābdhisiṃhanṛpateḥ sarpadaṣṭasya mokṣaṇam | harṣanayanasaṃjñasya māgadhasyāpi mokṣaṇam ||4.123.50|| yogidāsasya mokṣaśca kathito badrike tataḥ | saurabhasāvitranāmnastāmcūlinaśca mokṣaṇam ||51 || ragilākhyaraṃgakarturmokṣa uktastataḥ param | ḍamarūkābhidhavādyakārasyoktaṃ ca mokṣaṇam |||5 2 || cihnarāyābhidhabhāvasārasyoktaṃ ca mokṣaṇam | svarṇāstaraṇādīnāṃ ca vidyādhrāṇāṃ pramokṣaṇam | | 5 3 || citrabarhādigandharvottamānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tataḥ | kinnarāṇāṃ cāraṇānāṃ siddhānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ||54|| saṃhitāyāḥ kathāyāstu samāptau pūjanādikam | nagare bhramaṇaṃ sarvarājarāṣṭrādiṣu prabhoḥ ||55|| kuṃkumavāpikāyāṃ śrīhareśca gamanaṃ tataḥ | uktaḥ sarvamedhayajño nāgavikramabhūpateḥ || 5 6 || dilāvarīśvaranandibhillasya yodhanaṃ tataḥ | nāgavikramabhūpena saha sainyobhayorapi ||57|| nāgavikramavijayo nandibhillasya saṃkṣayaḥ | dilāvaryāḥ satītvaṃ ca kathitaṃ badrike tataḥ |||58 || prabhuṇā nijakāntābhyaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena tu | gṛhagītā śubhā proktā gṛhiṇāṃ mokṣasādhanam || 99 || vidhyarthājñāvatāṃ mokṣaḥ kathito gṛhiṇorapi | dvāviṃśaḥ śrīharerjanmajayantyutsava īritaḥ || 4.123.60 || purañjayaśitīpasya svapne narakabhogitā | mokṣaṇaṃ kathitaṃ cāpi satyalokaṃ yayau hariḥ ||6 1 || saptalokeṣu bhagavān gatvāśvasārasaṃ yayau | atalādiṣu gatvāpi harirjanmadinaṃ nijam || 62||| caturviṃśaṃ pracakre kuṃkumavāpyāṃ kathoditā | saptadvīpeṣu gatvāpi pañcaviṃśaṃ nijotsavam | | 6 3|| kuṃkumavāpikāyāṃ ca cakāra parameśvaraḥ | vairājeśvaraprabhṛtilokeṣu dhāmasūrdhvagaḥ || 64|| hariḥ pradarśya patnībhyo dhāmāni cāyayau tataḥ | kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ siṃhāraṇyādibhūmiṣu || 65|| vicacāra vihārārthaṃ patnībhiḥ sahitaḥ prabhuḥ | tatra sarvābhiriṣṭāni hyapatyāni harestadā ||66|| sarvābhyaḥ pradadau tatra yugalāpatyakāni saḥ | mānasāni hi divyāni na garbhajāni badrike || 67|| teṣāṃ saṃskāravidhayaḥ kathitāśca tataḥ param | tiṣyasvabhāvakathanaṃ tiṣyaguṇapravarṇanam ||68 || māyāpālanṛpateśca yāmyadaṇḍāt prarakṣaṇam | sanatkumāramuninā kṛtaṃ ca mokṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ||69 || kalau mokṣasādhanāni prāvirbhāvā harestataḥ | nāgavikramabhūpasya tīrthayātrā ca divyatā ||4.123.7 0 || śrīharirnijaputrāya mukundavikramāya tu | dilāvarīrājadhānyāmabhiṣekaṃ cakāra ha ||71 || śrīkṛṣṇo nijapatnīnāmakṣarekṣaṇavāñcchanām | gatvā koṭivimānaiḥ pradarśya pūritavān prabhuḥ ||72|| patnīnāṃ muktapuṃrūpatvaṃ ca vrahmahradāplavaḥ | koṭiśṛṃgādrivīkṣā ca nṛtyamaṇḍapavīkṣaṇam ||73|| rāsamaṇḍapavīkṣā ca vihāramaṇḍalekṣaṇam | rāṣṭramaṇḍalavīkṣā cākṣaradhāmapurekṣaṇam ||74|| brahmamaholavīkṣā cāvatārālayavīkṣaṇam | varṇitaṃ sarvamevaitat tataḥ paramadhāmani ||75|| gamanaṃ tadrahasyopaniṣadādivivecanam | aṣṭadurgavarṇanaṃ ca parabrahmapurasya ca ||76|| parabrahmātmuktādivasatīnāṃ pravarṇanam | rahasyamuktakoṭīnāṃ dvedhātvamaikyamityapi ||77|| ṣoḍaśānāṃ maholānāṃ darśanaṃ varṇitaṃ tataḥ | mūrtigarbhagatānāditādātmyamuktakekṣaṇam ||78|| svapatnīnāṃ samastānāṃ tādātmyamuktatārpaṇam | śrīhareḥ saptāyatanasamaṣṭirūpatoditā ||79|| śrīhareḥ kuṃkumavāpyāmāgamanamudāhṛtam | asaṃkhyānāṃ nijarddhīnāṃ dānāni kathitāni ca ||4.123.8 0|| vānaprasthottaraṃ sādhudīkṣā hareśca kīrtitā | lakṣmīkṛtaṃ stavanaṃ ca tatastīrthābhiyātrikā ||8 1 || harerlakṣmyā sahitasya punaḥ kuṃkumavāpikām | pratyāgamanamuktaṃ śrīsvāminībhiśca koṭibhiḥ |||82||| saṃhitādhyāyasaṃkhyā ca ślokasaṃkhyā hyudīritā | saṃhitādānamāhātmyaṃ puraścaraṇamityapi ||83|| sārvabhaumamahādānavidhistata udīritaḥ | punaḥ kathānāṃ smaraṇaṃ badrike’bhihitaṃ ca te ||84|| ityevaṃ viṣayā badri kathitāste mayākhilāḥ | yeṣāṃ śravaṇātsmaraṇānmuktiṃ vindati dehavān ||85|| viṣayāḥ pratikhaṇḍasya khaṇḍānte tatra tatra ca | kathitā badrike tasmāt jñātavyāstattadantataḥ ||86|| tattatkhaṇḍasya māhātmyaṃ tadante copapāditam | paṭhanācchravaṇāddhyānād bhuktirmuktirmiled dhruvā ||87|| viramāmi kṣaṇaṃ badri kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe’dhunā | tvaṃ virāmaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe yāhi sunandadam |||88||| ehyāgaccha mahānandapayodhau syāva tanmayau | śrīkṛṣṇasvāmijānandaṃ bhujyāsvāti yatheṣṭakam ||89|| śrīśvetakṛṣṇāyano vyāsa uvāca evaṃ vai vartamānāyāṃ kathāyāṃ prāha badrikā | dhanyāsmi tāpasī cāhaṃ mahābhāgyānvitāsmi ca ||4.123.90|| yāhaṃ śaktiścārdhamūrtiḥ puruṣottamarūpiṇī | avaimi māṃ māṇikīṃ ca mādhavīṃ ca pramātmikām ||9 1 || avaimi māṃ ca lakṣmīṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇīṃ svayam | svāmī kānto’nādikṛṣṇonārāyaṇo’sti me patiḥ ||92|| avaimi taṃ sakalāvatāriṇaṃ parameśvaram | sa bhavāniha badrīnārāyaṇo’sti narānvitaḥ ||93|| sāhaṃ nārāyaṇībadrī sarveśī puruṣottamī | naranārāyaṇasvāmin te satsaṃgāt kathāśravāt ||94|| mannimittena lokānāṃ paraṃ śreyo bhaviṣyati | dhanyeyaṃ pṛthivī sarvā dhanyāśca mānavā ime ||95|| yeṣāṃ nārāyaṇo bhartā dhartā kartāvitā sadā | dhanyā nāryaḥ sarvavidhāḥ kṛpā yāsu hareḥ śubhā ||96|| sarvābhyo’pi viśeṣeṇa kṛpā ṣaṭsu hi cakriṇaḥ | kṛṣṇarūpasya rādhāyāṃ lakṣmyāṃ nārāyaṇasya ca ||97|| prajñāyāṃ pāśavatyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ca | nārāyaṇīśriyāṃ cāpi puruṣottamarūpiṇaḥ ||98|| naranārāyaṇasyāpi badaryā mayi śāśvatī | lakṣmyai nārāyaṇenātra śrāvitaḥ kṛtakhaṇḍakaḥ ||99|| rādhāyai kṛṣṇarūpeṇa śrāvitastrītakhaṇḍakaḥ | puruṣottamarūpeṇa nārāyaṇīśriyai tathā || 4.123.100|| śrāvito dvāparasantānako mahyaṃ tvayāntimaḥ | prajñāyai pāśavatyai ca gṛhagītādyudīritam ||1 01 || eṣāhaṃ bhagavannasmi patitā pādayostava | māmantarbhāvya mūrtau tvaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe prabhau || 1 02|| virāmaṃ labha me svāminnaiṣā dhyāyāmi taṃ harim | ityuktvā badarī tūrṇaṃ dhyānamagnā yato’bhavat || 10 3|| tāvattatrābhavattūrṇaṃ mahāścaryaṃ mahādbhutam | mahātejo’bhavad vyāptaṃ śītalaṃ madhuraṃ sukham || 1 04|| tatrāśrayanta sannādāḥ kiṃkiṇīnāṃ manoharāḥ | bibhūṣāṇāṃ pādayośca karayoḥ kaṭivakṣasoḥ ||1 05|| kiṃkiṇīnāṃ miṣṭanādāḥ aśrūyanta sukhāvahāḥ | tatra tejasi kanyaikā vyadṛśyata susundarī || 1 06|| prodbhinnayauvanākoṭicandrakāntidhravigṛhā | caturhasteṣu ramyeṣu caturdhā pustakāni sā || 107|| smitahāsā dhṛtavatī sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā | divyasvarṇakaṭakādidivyamukuṭaśobhanā || 1 08|| divyagandhasugandhāḍhyā divyāmbarasuśobhanā | ramaṇīnāṃ samastānāṃ mohinī cātisundarī || 1 09|| puṣṭā sarvāṃgaramyā ca bharapūrabalānvitā | caturṣu saṃhitāvatsu kareṣu varamālikāḥ || 4.123.11 0|| catasro dhṛtamānā ca prasannavadanekṣaṇā | lakṣmīryadvā rādhikā māṇikī badrī pramāthavā || 111 || mādhavīṃ vāthatāṃ nārāyaṇo’ntare tu saṃhitām | badrī mūrtimatīṃ jñātvemāṃ lakṣmīsaṃhitāṃ tathā || 11 2|| nemāte kuśalaṃ papracchatuścakratuḥ svāgatam | nārāyaṇo’syai pradadau madhuparkaṃ śubhāsanam || 11 3|| kā kutaśca kathaṃ pṛṣṭā sā provāca nijāṃ kathām | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāsmi śrīpuruṣottamī ||1 14|| anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃgād divyarūpiṇī | prāvirbhūtāhamevāsmi rāghālakṣmīsvarūpiṇī || 1 15|| nārāyaṇīśrīsvarūpā badrīrūpā prabhātmikā | padmāvatīrūpiṇī ca caturhastavatī sadā || 1 16|| catuḥpustakadhartrī ca catuḥsantānavigrahā | caturvedodbhavamātā caturdhāmasvarūpiṇī || 1 17|| caturnārāyaṇavāṇī caturyugeṣu vartinī | caturāśramavarṇānāṃ catuḥsādhanasaṃbhṛtā || 1 18|| catuṣpādavatī cāṣmi caturnārāyaṇaśritā | caturnārāyaṇamūrtiścaturmuktisuvigrahā || 1 19|| catūrūpā caturmālādharā ca bhagavanmayī | sampūrṇādya bhavāmyeva caturnārāyaṇātmikā || 4.123.120 || sāhaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ badrīpaṃ puruṣottamam | arcituṃ kāmaye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāryavallabham || 1 21|| ityuktvā sā caturhastaiḥ samālaiḥ śrīnarāyaṇam | arcituṃ tvājagāmāgre tāvattu bhagavān patiḥ || 1 22|| rādhayā saha kṛṣṇo’bhūd dvibhujo muralīdharaḥ | caturbhujadharo nārāyaṇo lakṣmyā sahābhavat || 1 23|| nārāyaṇīśriyā yuktaḥ śrīpuruṣottamo’bhavat | badrīnārāyaṇaścāpi prādurāsīt puraḥsthale || 124|| prajñābadarikāsvāmī caturṣvapi sudṛśyate | pūjāṃ netuṃ kṛpāṃ kartumāśirpayituṃ hariḥ || 125||| tādṛśo dṛśyate tasmai catasraḥ padmamālikāḥ | ārpayaccandrakaṃ bhāle’kṣatakuṃkumacandanaiḥ || 1 26|| kṛtvā prapūjya yugmāni cāstaut tadgatamānasā | vihvalā snehihṛdayā pūrṇakāmāpi saṃhitā || 127|| vicarati yo’kṣare paratare nijadhāmni harirvahuvidhisevitaśca puruṣottama iṣṭapatiḥ | nijatanurūpiṇībhiranugābhiramābhirayaṃ paratama eva so’stu mama sarvavarārthakaraḥ || 1 28|| bahuvidhagopikābhirabhisevita eva ca yo vilasati rādhayā ca sahito’tra sa kṛṣṇapatiḥ | nijajanamānasāni samapūrayituṃ purataḥ sa bhavatu me mano’bhilaṣitaṃ suvidhātumiha || 1 29|| prasarati yaḥ prabhurmuhurasaṃkhyatanurvasatau sa hi kamalāpatirmayi narāyaṇarūpadharaḥ | bahukaruṇākarastviha sugocaratāṃ tu gato vitaratu hṛdgataṃ mama samastatanudhrahitam || 4.123.1 30|| vidhavidhalokināṃ sukhadaśāntikṛte tapasā hyurukamanīyarūpamapi śuṣkavase satatam | agaṇitabodhadaḥ sa iha me badarīśamuniḥ patirabhilāṣagocaramatīva dadātu ca me || 131 || namanamanantakaṃ muhurihāsmi ca dattavatī caraṇatale catuḥpratimadhārihareriha vai | ayugalarūpiṇī yugalamānamavāptumatiḥ prakaṭavacomayau kamanuyāmi catuṣṣu ratā ||1 32|| ityevaṃ sahitādevī tuṣṭāva caturaḥ prabhūn | lajjānamrā pratasthau ca maunamāsthāya kāminī || 1 33|| catvāro harayastasyai varadānāni sandaduḥ | saṃhite subhage devi no mukhebhyo vinirgatā || 134|| rādhāyāṃ ca śriyāṃ cāpi badryāṃ lakṣmyāṃ kṛtasthitiḥ | virājase yato nityā nityāsmadrūpadhāriṇī || 1 35|| asmadabhiprāyagarbhā vartase vedasatprasūḥ | pātraṃ tvaṃ vartase śreṣṭhaṃ varadānāyutasya vai ||1 36|| dadmaste baradānāni catuḥsvarūparūpiṇī | saṃhite śāśvatī patnī caturṇṇāmadyato’si ca || 1 37|| catuṣpatnīsamā caikā prajñāpāśavatīsamā | tā devyo muktidā yadvat tathā tvaṃ muktidā sadā || 138|| sarvadhāmādhidevī ca mahatī puruṣottamī | sarvadā vasa no dhāmālayeṣu divyabhāminī || 1 39|| dvitīyena svarūpeṇa vāṇī vasa vimuktidā | āśritānāṃ pūjakānāṃ śrotṝṇāṃ tava saṃhite ||4.123.140|| tathā vācanaśīlānāṃ paraṃ śreyo’stu dhāmani | dharmo’stu dharmakāmānāmartho’stu cārthakāminām || 141|| kāmaḥ kāmavatāṃ cāstu mokṣo’stu mokṣakāṃkṣiṇām | na caivāstvaśubhaṃ teṣāṃ sadā svastyastu sevinām || 142|| prajārthināṃ prajāḥ santu yaśaścāstu yaśo’rthinām | prajāprādhānyamevāpi rājadhiṣṇyādhipālanam || 143|| śrīśca teṣāṃ vipulāstu śreyaścāstu parātparam | vīryaṃ tejo balaṃ cāstu nirbhayatvaṃ sadāstvapi || 144|| astvārogyaṃ ca saundaryaṃ guṇitvaṃ bahumānyatā | abandhanatvaṃ sarvāpanmocanaṃ putrapautrakāḥ || 145|| vaṃśaśākhāḥ svargarājyaṃ bhūpatitvaṃ sureśatā | īśitā bhogasāmarthyaṃ carddhayaḥ santu sarvadā || 146|| yadyaddhāmābhimuktatvaṃ vāñchitaṃ tad bhavatvapi | vidvattvaṃ ca kalāvittvaṃ bhāvivittvaṃ bhavatvapi ||147|| jātismaratvaṃ sārvajñyaṃ nirāvaraṇatāstvapi | yogitvaṃ kovidatvaṃ ca gāndharvatvaṃ bhavatvapi ||148|| siddhatā yatitā brahmaviṣṇumaheśatāstvapi | saṃhitāsevikā nārī lakṣmī rādhāstvitīśvarī || 149|| naro nārāyaṇaścāstu dadmaste sadvarānimān | saṃhite vedadhātrītvaṃ khyātiṃ loke gamiṣyasi ||4.123.150|| vedādhānasvarūpā tvaṃ vedagarbhā ca vaidikī | evamuktvā viremuste kṛṣṇanārāyaṇādayaḥ || 151 || rādhikādyāstataḥ prāhuḥ prasannavadanāstadā | bhava tvakhaṇḍasaubhāgyavatī mokṣapradā dhruvā || 152|| ityuktvā saṃhitāṃ patnīṃ ninyuḥ saha tirohitāḥ | vāṇīrūpāṃ pṛthivyāṃ tāṃ rarakṣuḥ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ || 153|| seyaṃ vijayate loke kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapriyā | īśaloke brahmaloke sadādhārā haripriyā ||154|| prapūjitā samastairvai sarvamātā pareśvarī | vaiṣṇavānāṃ kuṭumbeṣūvāseyaṃ saṃvasatyapi || 155|| nivatsyati sadā kālaṃ vyāseṣu satsu sādhuṣu | bhāvavatsu prabhakteṣu bhaktāsu jayameṣyati || 156|| jayatu sakalakalpadrumasvarūpātmavallī nigamarasasupātrī brahmasambandhadātrī | śaraṇaraṇitabhartrī saṃhitā mokṣakartrī nayatu nijaguṇāḍhyān svābhidhāmākṣaraṃ naḥ || 157|| jayatvanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’khileśitā | mātā śrīkambharālakṣmīḥ pitā gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ || 158|| kuṃkumavāpī jayatu cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram | saurāṣṭramaṇḍalaṃ jayatvajasraṃ lomaśo muniḥ || 159|| svataḥprakāśo jayatu lakṣmīrjayatu śāśvatī | muktirjayatu bhaktiśca jayatvāśu sukhapradā || 4.123.1 60|| vijayo’stu ca kalyāṇaṃ svastirastu sukhaṃ śubham | maṃgalaṃ sarvadā cāstu parabrahmābhiyogitā || 1 61|| iti smṛtvā paraṃ kāntaṃ dadmaścāśīrvacāṃsi vai | oṃ namo’nādiśāstṛśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya om || 162|| iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe tiṣyasantāne tiṣyasantānaviṣayāḥ, badrikānārāyaṇasannidhau saṃhitāyāḥ kumārīrūpeṇāvirbhāvaḥ, śrīnārāyaṇaśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīpuruṣottamanārāyaṇaśrīnaranārāyaṇānāṃ svasvaśaktibhiḥ sākaṃ tatraiva āvirbhāvaḥ, saṃhitāyai varadānāni, kathāśravaṇaphalaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trayoviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 123 || iti śrītiṣyasantānakhaṇḍaḥ || sampūrṇeyaṃ catuḥkhaṇḍātmikā śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā vijayate ||
